jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Leaning) - Payments Engineering
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Payments team owns how ElevenLabs charges customers: billing, usage tracking, pricing and payments across self-serve and enterprise. Everything we do has to be correct, because it underpins the company's revenue and is immediately visible to every customer and team.

We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) to expand and evolve our payments systems. Your responsibilities might include:

 - Building and maintaining usage tracking so that requests are metered accurately without impacting latency.

 - Leading our migration of enterprise pricing and usage processing, including new stream-processing services for usage events.

 - Making it easy for customers to upgrade and pay, including paying through different entities and supporting new payment providers.

 - Working with Finance and Tax teams to meet compliance, audit and reporting requirements.

 - Enabling pricing and Growth experiments with Growth and product teams.

 - Debugging complex customer billing scenarios: piecing together what happened from the customer's experience, logs and code, and fixing the cause.

 - Collaborating with Sales, FDEs, Finance and engineers across the company.

Much of this work extends or replaces systems that already exist, so you will scope carefully, plan migrations, and roll changes out without disrupting customers.




REQUIREMENTS

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:

 - Expertise in Python.

 - A strong background in backend development.

 - Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.

 - Strong test design and security fundamentals.

 - Care and attention to detail when changing live systems that handle money.

 - The ability to learn a large existing system quickly and to debug complex production issues.

Bonus:

 - Experience with payment processing providers, or with billing and usage-based pricing systems

 - Experience with stream processing or high-throughput event pipelines.

 - Experience working with finance, tax or audit requirements.

 - Experience with Kubernetes.


LOCATION

Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.


#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Sr. Financial Analyst (R14363)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

The Senior Financial Analyst is a key member of the Financial Planning & Analysis team, partnering closely with C-level executives and business leaders to set financial and operational goals and budgets, track performance, and translate results into actionable insights. This role connects financial and operational information across the organization, ensuring the right stakeholders have the context they need to make timely, informed decisions. Success means delivering rigorous forecasts and analysis while helping drive ownership, accountability, and follow-through against Oportun’s financial and strategic objectives.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

• Partner with C-level executives and business leaders to develop financial goals, budgets, and forecasts, and track performance against those commitments.

• Produce monthly and multi-year financial forecasts that provide a clear view of expected performance and support company planning.

• Analyze P&L performance, explain variances to plan, identify current and emerging trends, and surface risks and opportunities.

• Perform financial, cost/benefit, and other ad-hoc analyses to support executive decision-making and strategic initiatives.

• Manage recurring financial and KPI reporting, including clear, decision-ready materials for executives and other key stakeholders.

• Drive ownership and accountability across the organization by establishing clear financial goals, tracking performance, and ensuring stakeholders understand commitments, risks, and required actions.

• Connect insights across financial and operational data, identifying relationships and emerging themes and bringing them to the right stakeholders to enable timely, informed decision-making.

• Bring ideas for how we can do things better—proactively, not just when asked—and look for thoughtful ways to use AI tools to reduce manual work and improve decision-making.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re an intellectually curious, proactive finance professional who enjoys connecting the dots and turning complex information into clear, actionable insights. You combine strong analytical skills and attention to detail with excellent interpersonal skills, allowing you to build credibility and work effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including C-level executives.

You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, and moving forward without perfect information. You communicate clearly, exercise sound judgment, and have the confidence to surface risks, opportunities, and differing perspectives when they matter.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

• 3+ years of experience in finance, FP&A, or a related analytical role; consumer financial services experience is a plus.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, or another analytical discipline.

• Strong financial modeling skills, including cash flow and three-statement financial modeling.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

• Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and detail-oriented capabilities, with a high standard for integrity, accuracy, and precision.

• Strong interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and work effectively with senior stakeholders.

Nice to Have

• Master’s degree in Business (MBA), Finance, or another analytical discipline.

• Experience partnering directly with senior executives in a planning, budgeting, forecasting, or decision-support capacity.

• Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar tools to improve productivity and analysis.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Mexico Benefits:

• Medical Insurance

• Savings Fund and Life Insurance

• Vacation and Parental Leave

• Internet and Electricity Allowance

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers   #LI-REMOTE #LI-VR1

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:  https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/.

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

Integrated Campaign Manager- Contract

About the Role

In the role of Integrated Campaign Manager, you will report to the Director, Campaign Management.

This is a contract role.

We are considering applicants for our Los Angeles office.

As an Integrated Campaign Manager, you will independently lead the planning, integration, and orchestration of global marketing campaigns across Crunchyroll's Brand, Franchise, Growth, and Regional Marketing teams. You will translate approved business and marketing objectives into cohesive campaign plans that connect audiences, markets, channels, investments, and key moments.

From early campaign discovery and greenlight through activation and performance evaluation, you will bring cross-functional teams together, anticipate dependencies, navigate competing priorities, and drive alignment and accountability. You will play a critical role in ensuring global campaigns are strategically connected, effectively planned, and positioned to deliver measurable business impact.

Core Areas of Responsibility

• Integrated Campaign Planning & Architecture: Independently lead assigned global campaigns, translating approved business and marketing objectives into integrated campaign frameworks across audiences, markets, channels, and key moments. Define campaign scope, workstreams, global-to-regional participation, key milestones, and cross-functional dependencies in partnership with business and functional leads.

• Campaign Discovery, Portfolio & Investment Planning: Support early-stage campaign discovery and greenlight planning to establish scope, scale, feasibility, resource requirements, and investment considerations. Maintain visibility across assigned campaigns, identifying competing priorities, capacity constraints, and opportunities for alignment. Develop and maintain consolidated campaign budgets, track investment allocations, and surface potential trade-offs or changes for stakeholder decisions.

• Cross-Functional & Regional Orchestration: Lead integrated planning across Brand, Franchise, Growth, Creative, Media, Partnerships, and Regional Marketing teams, bringing individual workstream plans into one cohesive campaign approach. Establish clear ownership, decision points, and global-to-regional handoffs while enabling regional teams to develop and execute locally relevant plans. Build strong stakeholder relationships, facilitate productive discussions, and drive alignment across teams without direct reporting authority.

• Campaign Governance, Readiness & Risk Management: Own integrated campaign timelines, operating cadences, and centralized sources of truth to maintain visibility and accountability. Proactively anticipate stakeholder needs, cross-functional dependencies, risks, and downstream implications before they impact campaign delivery. Lead campaign meetings and readiness reviews, recommend solutions, facilitate timely decisions, and escalate material changes to scope, budget, priorities, or milestones while ensuring functional teams retain ownership of their execution.

• Campaign Performance, Reporting & Optimization: Partner with analytics and functional teams to align campaign measurement with business objectives and maintain visibility into campaign performance. Lead post-campaign reviews, consolidate insights and learnings, and identify opportunities to improve future planning and execution. Develop compelling presentations and leadership reporting that clearly communicate campaign progress, performance, risks, recommendations, and opportunities for improvement.

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

• You have 5+ years of experience in integrated marketing, campaign management, marketing planning, or cross-functional marketing programs, with demonstrated experience independently leading complex, multi-channel campaigns.

• You have experience translating business and marketing objectives into integrated campaign plans that connect audiences, channels, markets, and key activation moments.

• You possess a strong understanding of integrated marketing disciplines, including brand, content, paid media, social, lifecycle, partnerships, and experiential marketing, and how these channels work together to drive business outcomes.

• You understand creative development, production, localization, and marketing delivery workflows, enabling you to anticipate feasibility constraints, dependencies, and potential risks without directly managing production.

• You are an exceptionally organized, proactive, and forward-thinking planner who anticipates stakeholder needs, identifies risks and dependencies early, and consistently thinks several steps ahead to keep complex initiatives on track.

• You are a confident, engaging communicator and presenter who can independently lead large cross-functional meetings, facilitate complex discussions, and clearly articulate recommendations to senior stakeholders and diverse audiences.

• You have strong presentation development skills, with the ability to create sophisticated, visually polished, executive-ready presentations that synthesize complex information into clear narratives and actionable recommendations.

• You are a personable, influential collaborator who builds trusted relationships, navigates competing perspectives, and drives alignment, decisions, and accountability without direct reporting authority.

• You have experience managing campaign budgets, tracking investments, identifying resource constraints, and supporting prioritization or allocation decisions.

• You are comfortable working across global and regional teams, balancing shared campaign objectives with local market needs and execution considerations.

• You have experience partnering with analytics teams to evaluate campaign performance, interpret insights, and translate learnings into future recommendations.

• You are proficient in Google Slides, PowerPoint, and campaign planning and reporting tools such as Airtable, Wrike, or comparable platforms.

About the Team

The Campaign Management team leads integrated campaign planning, architecture, and orchestration for Crunchyroll's priority global marketing initiatives. Operating across Brand, Franchise, Growth, and Regional Marketing, we connect business objectives, investments, teams, and activation plans to deliver cohesive, high-impact campaigns across markets and channels.

As our organization evolves toward a federated global and regional marketing model, the team plays a critical role in establishing campaign priorities, coordinating integrated planning, strengthening governance, and ensuring visibility and accountability across the global marketing portfolio. Our success is measured by the quality of campaign planning, investment visibility, cross-functional alignment, proactive risk management, and the collective business impact of our global marketing initiatives.

About our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

• Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.

• Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.

• Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.

• Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc., both subsidiaries of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation.

jobs.title: Specialist, TA Business Partner
jobs.location: Blythewood, South Carolina, United States; Charlotte, North Carolina, United States
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

Scout Motors is seeking a Talent Acquisition Business Partner to serve as the primary recruiting partner and point of contact for hiring managers. This role will build a deep understanding of the business, translate workforce needs into practical talent strategies, and guide leaders through an effective, consistent, and candidate-centered hiring process.

Working across a coordinated Talent Acquisition team, the TA Business Partner will bring together the right expertise and resources to meet each hiring need. The role is accountable for aligning stakeholders, shaping recruiting and selection strategies, maintaining momentum, and providing clear insight into progress, risks, and talent-market considerations from intake through hiring decision.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Hiring Manager Partnership & Talent Strategy

• Serve as the primary Talent Acquisition contact for assigned hiring managers, building trusted relationships and a strong understanding of their organization, priorities, and talent needs.

• Lead requisition launch and planning conversations that clarify business outcomes, role requirements, candidate profiles, hiring timelines, decision-makers, and potential constraints.

• Translate workforce needs into practical recruiting strategies that reflect business priorities, talent availability, and the level of urgency.

• Advise leaders on talent-market conditions, role design, selection strategy, competitive positioning, and realistic hiring expectations.

• Maintain clear alignment with hiring managers throughout the search, surfacing risks, tradeoffs, and decisions needed to keep hiring on track.

Integrated Talent Acquisition Delivery

• Coordinate the right Talent Acquisition capabilities and resources for each search, creating a seamless experience for hiring managers and candidates.

• Set clear roles, expectations, milestones, and communication rhythms across the recruiting team and hiring stakeholders.

• Partner with recruiting colleagues to develop pipelines, evaluate talent, address market challenges, and adjust search strategies as needs evolve.

• Ensure consistent handoffs, timely follow-through, and shared accountability across each stage of the recruiting process.

• Contribute insight and best practices that strengthen Talent Acquisition delivery across the broader organization.

Search Execution & Stakeholder Alignment

• Manage a portfolio of open roles with disciplined prioritization, proactive communication, and attention to both business impact and candidate experience.

• Guide hiring teams in developing effective interview plans, defining evaluation criteria, and preparing interviewers to make informed, equitable decisions.

• Facilitate candidate review and debrief discussions, helping stakeholders distinguish evidence from preference and reach timely decisions.

• Provide regular, concise updates on pipeline health, search activity, emerging risks, and recommended actions.

• Navigate changing priorities and complex searches with sound judgment, flexibility, and a focus on solutions.

Recruiting Analytics & Continuous Improvement

• Use recruiting data and market insight to assess progress, identify constraints, and recommend changes to search strategy or stakeholder actions.

• Monitor meaningful outcomes such as pipeline strength, funnel conversion, time to fill, offer acceptance, and stakeholder and candidate experience.

• Maintain accurate, timely information in Scout's applicant tracking system and related recruiting tools.

• Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve consistency, and strengthen the experience for candidates and hiring teams.

• Share recurring themes and talent insights that can inform workforce planning and broader people decisions.

Selection Quality, Candidate Experience & Compliance

• Champion structured, fair, and job-relevant selection practices that support high-quality hiring decisions.

• Ensure candidates receive clear, respectful, and timely communication throughout the recruiting process.

• Represent Scout's culture and employee value proposition authentically in every interaction.

• Maintain recruiting practices that align with applicable laws, company policies, recordkeeping requirements, and Scout's commitment to inclusion and respect.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC or Blythewood, South Carolina.

• This role requires four days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.

• Travel: Domestic travel and minimal international travel may be required as business needs evolve. Valid driver's license required. Passport required.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• 4+ years experience partnering directly with hiring managers and leading recruitment for professional, technical, operational, or other business-critical roles in a highly consultative environment.

• Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into recruiting strategies and manage multiple searches with competing priorities.

• Strong consulting, facilitation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, including the confidence to challenge constructively and influence decisions.

• Working knowledge of structured selection practices, recruiting metrics, applicant tracking systems, and relevant employment requirements.

• Sound judgment, ownership, adaptability, and a commitment to delivering an inclusive and respectful candidate experience.

What Success Looks Like

• Hiring managers view you as a trusted advisor who understands their business and helps them make better talent decisions.

• Search strategies are clear, aligned, and responsive to business needs and market realities.

• Talent Acquisition resources work together effectively, with clear ownership and a consistent experience for stakeholders.

• Candidates experience a thoughtful, transparent, and well-coordinated process that reflects the Scout brand.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

• Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

• 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting

• Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $90,000.00 - $112,500.00

Internal leveling code: IC9

Notice to applicants:

• To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.

• Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

• Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

• Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.

Equal Opportunity

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Presence
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Presence is OpenAI’s team building AI agents that organizations can trust to handle real conversations and get things done. Our mission is to turn advances in frontier models into dependable systems that can resolve customer issues, support employees, and improve through experience in production.

Imagine calling about an unexpected charge. An agent needs to understand your situation, verify your identity, find the relevant account information, apply the right policy, and resolve the issue or bring in a person. It needs to do all of this naturally, accurately, and quickly, even when the conversation takes an unexpected turn. Presence brings together the models, execution systems, integrations, and controls that make experiences like this possible across voice, chat and email.

One of our most exciting challenges is what happens after an agent goes live. We're building a system for understanding where agents fail and making them better: investigate a production conversation, reproduce the problem in an evaluation, use Codex to develop a fix, test it against the current agent, and measure the result after deployment. Our ambition is to make more of this improvement process agentic over time, while giving people control over what changes reach users.

Read the launch announcement https://openai.com/index/introducing-openai-presence/.

 


WHAT WE WORK ON

 - Realtime voice: Natural conversations with fast responses, interruptions, and reliable audio, even under heavy traffic.

 - Agent systems: Orchestration, reasoning, tool execution, integrations with company systems, and enforcing permissions and policies.

 - Agent quality: Production debugging, simulations, evaluation infrastructure, regression testing, and measuring whether changes improve real outcomes.

 - Product and developer experience: Making it easier for teams to build, test, deploy, and operate sophisticated agents using Codex and OpenAI's capabilities.

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

You'll work at the intersection of frontier research, product engineering, and production systems, with a direct feedback loop from people using what you build. We collaborate closely with Research, Forward Deployed Engineers, and customers to understand where models and systems break down and turn those lessons into improvements that can benefit many deployments.

The impact is already tangible. At launch, Presence was resolving 75% of issues coming into OpenAI's English phone support without a human, and its Codex-assisted improvement process helped cut transfers to people by 15 percentage points over ten days. Introducing OpenAI Presence https://openai.com/index/introducing-openai-presence/

We're looking for people excited by ambitious engineering problems, building products people depend on, and helping define how AI agents are developed and improved in the real world.

 


YOUR BACKGROUND MIGHT LOOK SOMETHING LIKE:

 - 9+ years of professional engineering experience, excluding internships, in backend, platform, or product engineering roles.

 - A track record of hands-on technical leadership, including setting architecture, breaking complex problems into clear implementation plans, and guiding engineers through delivery.

 - Deep backend engineering and systems design skills, with proficiency in at least one backend programming language and experience designing services, data models, and interfaces that remain reliable as usage grows.

 - End-to-end ownership of complex systems or product capabilities, from ambiguous requirements and technical design through implementation, launch, and production iteration.

 - Strong production engineering judgment: you can diagnose difficult failures, reason about performance and scalability, and improve reliability through testing, observability, and operational discipline.

 - Strong product judgment that connects technical decisions to user needs, with the ability to balance delivery speed, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability.

 - The ability to move between backend infrastructure and product experiences, contribute across the stack when needed, and quickly learn unfamiliar systems, tools, and domains.

 - Clear technical communication and effective collaboration across disciplines, including explaining trade-offs, creating alignment, and driving complex work forward while remaining hands-on.

 - Experience with AI agents, enterprise workflows, integrations, or agent development and evaluation is a plus, but not required.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Leaning) - Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Core Platform builds the foundations every other team at ElevenLabs builds on: how users, workspaces and permissions work across our products. Our systems sit on the path of every request and are relied on by millions of users and by enterprise customers, so correctness, security and safe rollout matter as much as speed.

We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) for two focus areas. Depending on the team you join, your responsibilities might include:

Workspaces & User Management (serving external customers)

 - Building and improving the building blocks customers touch directly: API keys, login experience, analytics, admin tooling, workspace security and more

 - Working closely with Sales, FDEs and customer teams to turn enterprise and self-serve feedback into the right improvements, and helping large customers with complex organisational structures.

 - Shipping customer-facing features end to end, from backend services to the admin and settings UI.

Permissions & Resources (serving ElevenLabs engineering teams)

 - Designing and building generic resource and permissioning services that product teams use to build features safely and quickly.

 - Solving hard, largely greenfield problems at scale, for example how a customer with a million agents assigns and manages access.

 - Working across product teams to understand their needs, and driving adoption with changes that don't require every team to rework their code.

In both teams you will:

 - Scope work as part of a large existing system: understand what exists, what could go wrong on rollout, whether a migration is needed, and how downstream teams are affected.

 - Roll out changes safely and with minimal disruption to existing users, teams or systems.

 - Debug and operate what you build, working from customer reports, logs and code.

 - Own features from scoping to completion, with the support of experienced engineers who are happy to mentor.


REQUIREMENTS

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:

 - Expertise in Python.

 - A strong background in backend development, with comfort working across the stack where the work needs it.

 - Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.

 - Strong test design and security fundamentals.

 - Care and attention to detail when changing live, business-critical systems, and the ability to learn a large existing codebase quickly.

 - Comfort with ambiguity: working out what should be built, and prioritising among competing signals.

Bonus:

 - Experience with authentication, authorization or permissioning (OAuth, SSO/SCIM, RBAC or similar).

 - Experience with Kubernetes.

 - Experience building internal platforms or services used by other engineering teams.


LOCATION

Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Orientation Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Title: Orientation Specialist

Company: Loenbro, LLC Business Unit/Department: Loenbro LLC - People Operations Location: Westminster, CO or Irving, TX (Hybrid) Reports to: L&D Program Manager, Leadership Development Employment Type: Full-Time FLSA Classification: Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary

As an Orientation Lead at Loenbro, you’re responsible for managing and facilitating the organization's New Hire Orientation (NHO) program, creating a welcoming, engaging, and informative experience that introduces new employees to the company's culture, values, expectations, and resources.

You’ll serve as the primary owner of the orientation experience and work closely with Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, hiring managers, Onboarding Coordinators, Learning & Development, and business leaders to ensure new hires receive a consistent and high-quality introduction to the organization. You’ll oversee orientation planning, scheduling, communications, facilitation, attendance tracking, stakeholder coordination, and continuous improvement efforts.

Role & Responsibilities

NHO Management & Facilitation / Program Improvement & Scalability / Stakeholder Partnership & Collaboration / Culture & Employee Growth

· Lead and facilitate weekly NHO sessions, delivering engaging and professional experience for all new employees.

· Own the end-to-end orientation process, including scheduling, communications, logistics, materials, presenter coordination, and participant management.

· Partner with Talent Acquisition, Human Resources (HR), hiring managers, Onboarding Coordinators, Learning & Development, and subject matter experts to ensure new hires have a seamless and positive orientation experience.

· Coordinate orientation presenters and content owners, ensuring all required topics are delivered consistently, accurately, and on schedule.

· Monitor and track orientation attendance, participation, completion records, and related metrics to ensure accurate reporting and program effectiveness.

· Serve as the primary point of contact for orientation-related questions and support for new employees and stakeholders.

· Gather and analyze participant feedback to identify opportunities for improving the orientation experience and increasing employee engagement.

· Continuously evaluate, enhance, and scale orientation programs, materials, and processes to support organizational growth and evolving business needs.

Skills

· Proficiency in facilitating presentations, workshops, training sessions, or group meetings.

· Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.

· Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.

· Ability to build positive working relationships across all levels of the organization.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and learning or HR technology platforms.

· Proficiency in supporting employee onboarding and orientation programs.

· Proficiency in tracking and reporting participation, completion, or training metrics.

Qualifications

Required:

· 2+ years of experience in employee orientation, training facilitation, employee experience, human resources, learning and development, or a related field.

Preferred:

· Associate’s or Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Learning & Development, or a related field.

· Bilingual (English/Spanish).

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment:

· May require some minimal travel to sites to audit orientations.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

· Medical, dental, and vision insurance

· 401(k) retirement plan with company match

· Paid time off (PTO)

· Life and disability insurance

· Professional development and training opportunities

· Employee assistance program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities. If you’re ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

· Living with Integrity

· Exceeding Expectations

· Acting with Urgency

· Delivering Excellence

…we want to hear from you.

Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employe

jobs.title: Child Care Center Director
jobs.description:
Child Care Center Director (Head of School)

Guidepost Montessori · Evanston · Full-time, on-site · $90k–$100k + bonus

Picture a classroom of children pouring their own water, setting their own tables, and choosing their own work, calmly and on purpose. That’s an ordinary morning at a Guidepost school. We’re looking for a leader to make it happen every day at our Evanston campus, and to grow with us as we bring it to more families.

As Center Director, you’ll lead the whole school community. You’ll report to our Regional Manager and work alongside directors across our network. You won’t be figuring it out alone.

If you’ve run a childcare center or preschool and want to lead one where the program quality and how we serve the community come first, we’d like to talk. You don’t need Montessori experience to start. We’ll support you.

Why Guidepost

We believe young children can do far more than most programs assume. Montessori classrooms give them real work, real independence, and real responsibility, and the results are visible every day. Guidepost is a network of 60+ schools working to make that kind of early education available to many more families.

For you, that means support a stand-alone center can’t offer: training, program, and operations teams who help you solve problems, and a network of school leaders who share what works.

What you’ll own

• Enrollment and retention. Fill the school and keep families with us. You’ll lead tours and admissions with your Assistant Director and turn families into ambassadors who refer their friends.

• Your team. Hire, coach, and keep great teachers. Keep classrooms fully staffed and in ratio, and manage schedules and labor cost. Over time, build up your Assistant Director and lead teachers so they can grow too.

• Financial health. Own the campus budget and drive long-term financial health of the center.

• Program quality. Make sure every classroom meets our Montessori quality standard, with hands-on support from our training and programs team.

• Licensing and safety. Keep the center in compliance with licensing standards, lead inspections, and keep records current.

• Culture and community. Build a team people want to stay on and a parent community families recommend.

Where this role can grow into

Running one strong school is the foundation, and it’s also the way into multi-site leadership. Once you’ve got your school running well, you can get hands-on experience across more than one campus:

• Support nearby campuses during leadership transitions, openings, or busy enrollment seasons.

• Mentor new directors as they join the network and learn the Guidepost model.

Directors who build that track record are strong candidates for regional and network leadership roles as they open.

What you bring

• Meets Illinois licensing requirements for childcare center directors

• 2+ years leading a licensed child care center, preschool, or early childhood program as a director, assistant director, or program director

• A track record of growing enrollment and retaining staff

• Clear, warm communication with families and staff

• Good judgment when you have to decide quickly with incomplete information

• Comfort owning a budget and making staffing decisions against it

• Real openness to Montessori: curious, willing to learn, and excited about children’s independence

Nice to have

• Early childhood classroom teaching experience

• Experience with a multi-site child care operator

• Interest in growing into multi-site leadership

• Montessori credential (AMI, AMS, or MACTE-accredited) or Montessori classroom experience

What we offer

• $90,000–$100,000 base plus a performance bonus

• 75% tuition discount for up to two children at any Guidepost school

• Health, dental, and vision insurance

• 401k plan

• Paid time off and paid holidays

• Montessori training and ongoing professional development

• A network of fellow school leaders who share what works

• Multi-site experience and a path toward regional leadership

Ready to lead a school you’d be proud to send your own children to? Apply today. We’d love to hear what you’ve built and where you want to go next.

jobs.title: Sales Manager, Iberia - Digital Natives
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

Spain

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Senior Sales Manager to lead and scale our Digital Natives business in Spain. You will lead a team of Account Executives with a mandate weighted toward new business acquisition, balancing aggressive market expansion with the continued success and growth of current customers.

You will combine hands-on coaching with strategic market leadership, helping your team build pipeline, execute complex sales cycles, forecast accurately, and articulate Cloudflare’s value to founders, executives, and technical audiences.

You will develop and execute our go-to-market strategy for Spain’s Digital Natives segment, recruit and develop exceptional talent, and strengthen Cloudflare’s presence across the Spanish startup and scale-up ecosystem. Your target customers include SaaS platforms, fintech companies, AI-native scale-ups, developer-focused businesses, and other innovative companies born in the cloud.

You and your team will help customers understand and prepare for the agentic cloud transition, as AI-native applications, agents, and autonomous workloads change their infrastructure, security, performance, and commercial requirements.

In line with Cloudflare’s AI-native culture, you will be expected to use AI actively in your daily workflow and lead its adoption across your team. This includes applying AI to customer and market research, account and territory planning, meeting preparation, pipeline management, and follow-up—using it as a genuine productivity multiplier, not an occasional aid.

Responsibilities

• Revenue growth: Meet or exceed assigned quarterly and annual team targets, leading the business’s growth through disciplined execution, market coverage, and pipeline creation.

• New business: Own a team portfolio weighted heavily toward new business acquisition.. Drive new-logo acquisition while ensuring existing customers realize value, increase adoption, and expand their use of Cloudflare.

• Spain go-to-market strategy: Develop and execute a Spain-specific Digital Natives strategy, including market segmentation, territory design, coverage models, account prioritization, and ecosystem engagement.

• Team leadership and coaching: Manage, coach, and develop a team of quota-carrying Account Executives, creating a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, urgency, curiosity, inclusion, and customer value.

• Deal support: Provide hands-on guidance on pipeline generation, account planning, discovery, deal strategy, negotiation, and executive engagement. Support both high-velocity opportunities and complex, strategic sales cycles.

• Talent acquisition and ramping: Source, interview, recruit, onboard, and rapidly ramp high-performing Account Executives in partnership with Recruiting, Sales Enablement, and regional sales leadership. Help define the ideal AE profile for the Spanish Digital Natives segment.

• Technical customer engagement: Coach the team to build trusted relationships with founders, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform leaders, and security stakeholders. Position Cloudflare’s application performance, security, developer, and Cloudflare One capabilities in the context of customers’ architectures and business priorities.

• Agentic cloud leadership: Develop the team’s understanding of AI-native applications and the agentic cloud transition, enabling credible conversations about their implications for cloud architecture, networking, security, performance, developer platforms, and consumption.

• AI-powered sales leadership: Use AI as an integrated part of account research, territory and account planning, meeting preparation, pipeline analysis, and follow-up. Coach Account Executives on effective AI-enabled workflows, share best practices, and measure productivity or business improvements while validating outputs and protecting confidential information.

• Forecasting and operating discipline: Maintain accurate Salesforce data and team KPIs. Provide reliable weekly pipeline, attainment, consumption, and forecast guidance, using pipeline coverage, conversion rates, deal progression, customer adoption, and revenue trends to guide decisions.

• Business cadence: Run effective forecast calls, pipeline inspections, deal reviews, account planning sessions, and quarterly business reviews. Assess performance against growth objectives and define clear corrective or acceleration actions.

• Cross-functional execution: Partner with BDRs, Customer Engineers, Customer Success, Marketing, Partners, Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Deal Desk, and Product to improve pipeline generation, conversion, onboarding, and expansion.

• Ecosystem development: Build relationships within the Spanish startup and scale-up ecosystem, including founders, technical leaders, venture capital firms, accelerators, technology partners, and developer communities.

• Best-practice development: Document successful strategies and work with Sales Enablement to develop repeatable playbooks for new business, consumption growth, account expansion, and multi-product adoption.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• At least 10 years of technology sales experience, including substantial experience selling to customers in Spain.

• At least 5 years of experience managing quota-carrying sales representatives, with a demonstrated record of achieving new business and expansion targets.

• Experience at a hyperscaler or high-growth cloud infrastructure provider is strongly preferred, particularly where it demonstrates the ability to execute quickly and scale a business.

• Direct experience and established relationships within the Spanish startup and scale-up ecosystem, including knowledge of how digital-native companies build, buy, and scale.

• Demonstrated experience selling through consumption-based commercial models, including forecasting, managing, and growing usage-based revenue.

• Experience in SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, developer platforms, or cybersecurity, with the ability to engage founders, executives, developers, and technical stakeholders.

• Strong technological understanding of the agentic cloud transition, including how AI-native applications, agents, and autonomous workloads affect cloud architecture, networking, security, performance, developer requirements, and consumption models.

• Strong command of sales and forecasting metrics, including pipeline coverage, conversion, deal progression, forecast accuracy, customer adoption, consumption, and revenue attainment.

• Demonstrated integrated-to-strategic AI fluency, using AI regularly for customer and market research, account and territory planning, meeting preparation, follow-up, and vendor or ecosystem mapping.

• A self-starting approach to adopting AI capabilities, refining prompts, combining tools, validating accuracy, and improving outputs through iteration. Experience coaching others on AI-enabled workflows and measuring the resulting productivity or business improvements is strongly preferred.

• Proven ability to recruit, onboard, coach, and retain successful sales teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Genuine passion for technology, innovation, customer success, and building a high-growth Digital Natives business in Spain.

• Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the confidence to engage technical and non-technical audiences at all levels.

• Proficiency with Salesforce and other sales reporting, forecasting, and business-intelligence tools; familiarity with a structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC is preferred.

• A hands-on leadership style that balances strategic vision with tactical execution and speed.

• Self-motivated and entrepreneurial, with the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic and multicultural workplace.

• A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience; an MBA, MIS, or relevant postgraduate qualification is a plus.

• Full professional fluency in Spanish and English, both written and spoken.

• Ability to travel within Spain and internationally as required for customer engagements, ecosystem events, and internal collaboration.

Compensation

For Spain based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €156,000 - €215,000.

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The applicable compensation range and on-target earnings details will be provided by Recruiting before publication.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Director of Fraud Product Strategy
jobs.description:
SentiLink https://www.sentilink.com/ helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 https://www.forbes.com/companies/sentilink/?list=fintech50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260330439998/en/SentiLink-Named-a-2026-FICO-Industry-Vanguard-Decision-Award-Winner-for-Leadership-in-Identity-Theft-Detection. We were also the first company to go live https://resources.sentilink.com/blog/sentilink-makes-history-as-first-ecbsv-provider with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress https://resources.sentilink.com/media/dr.-david-maimons-congressional-testimony-on-emerging-fraud-threats-and-the-evolving-fraud-landscape on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role:

The Director of Fraud Product Strategy is responsible for transforming SentiLink's Fraud Intelligence Team (FIT) into a high-impact fraud intelligence function. This leader will oversee the evolution of FIT's operating model, ensuring the team delivers high-quality fraud labeling, generates actionable fraud intelligence, develops future technical talent, and creates measurable business impact through fraud prevention initiatives.

This role requires a unique combination of operational rigor, fraud curiosity, analytical thinking, innovation, and talent development. The successful candidate will raise performance standards, implement best-in-class, scalable operational processes, and strengthen cross-functional partnerships to ensure FIT serves as an efficient operational machine, a trusted source of fraud expertise, and a pipeline for future leaders across the organization.

Success will be measured by improvements in operational performance, development of high-potential internal talent, increased fraud prevention impact, and FIT's growing influence across Product, R&D, Analytics, GTM, and other business functions.

This is a remote, US-based role.

Responsibilities:

 

 - Establish clear performance baselines and operational metrics for FIT, including labeling volume, quality, turnaround time, cost efficiency, SLA adherence, and downstream business impact.

 - Design and implement scalable quality assurance processes, including sampling methodologies, review frameworks, feedback mechanisms, and escalation procedures to continuously improve labeling accuracy and consistency.

 - Reimagine FIT's operating model, workflows, tooling, and team structure to improve efficiency, scalability, and business outcomes.

 - Build a best-in-class entry-level talent program by defining hiring profiles, onboarding experiences, training programs, and career development pathways for Fraud Intelligence Analysts.

 - Create a repeatable progression framework that enables FIT team members to develop technical, analytical, and fraud expertise while preparing them for advancement and internal mobility opportunities.

 - Develop credible measurement frameworks that connect FIT activities to measurable fraud prevention outcomes, including model improvements, fraud detection enhancements, typology development, and customer impact.

 - Launch and scale initiatives that transform frontline fraud observations into actionable insights for Product, R&D, Analytics, GTM, and customer-facing teams.

 - Serve as a trusted fraud subject matter expert and strategic partner across the company, building strong relationships with stakeholders and ensuring FIT's insights influence key business decisions.

 - Establish recurring reporting, fraud trend analysis, and knowledge-sharing programs that elevate fraud awareness and expertise throughout the organization.

 - Leverage AI, automation, and process optimization opportunities to increase team productivity, improve quality, and enable FIT to focus on higher-value fraud intelligence work.
   
   

Requirements:

 - 8+ years of experience in fraud operations, fraud intelligence, risk management, trust & safety, investigations, analytics, or a related domain, including significant people leadership experience

 - 4+ years of management experience overseeing a team of Fraud Analysts

 - Demonstrated success leading operational teams responsible for high-volume, quality-sensitive workflows and measurable business outcomes.

 - Strong fraud judgment with a deep interest in understanding evolving fraud patterns, typologies, and prevention strategies.

 - Proven ability to design and improve processes, operating models, quality systems, and performance measurement frameworks.

 - Experience developing and coaching early-career talent, building high-performing teams, and creating internal mobility pathways.

 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to identify opportunities, measure outcomes, and drive decision-making.

 - Technical fluency and comfort working closely with product, analytics, engineering, machine learning, and data science teams.

 - Experience leveraging AI, automation, workflow tooling, or operational technologies to improve productivity and quality.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and align diverse stakeholders around shared goals.

 - Strong ownership mindset with a track record of driving change, executing against ambitious goals, and holding teams accountable to high standards.

 - Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

 - Curiosity, first-principles thinking, and a continuous improvement mindset focused on learning, experimentation, and long-term impact.
   
   

Compensation:

 - $180,000-$240,000/year + equity + benefits


PERKS:

 - Employer paid group health insurance for you and your dependents

 - 401(k) plan with employer match (or equivalent for non US-based roles)

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Regular company-wide in-person events

 - Home office stipend, and more!




CORPORATE VALUES:

 - Follow Through

 - Deep Understanding

 - Whatever It Takes

 - Do Something Smart
