jobs.title: Hardware Reliability Engineer, Electrical (Starshield)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

HARDWARE RELIABILITY ENGINEER, ELECTRICAL (STARSHIELD)

Starshield leverages SpaceX’s Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads.

As a Hardware Reliability Engineer for Starshield, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability and performance of our satellites. You will work on identifying, analyzing, and resolving hardware failures to improve the robustness and longevity of our PCBAs. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, including electrical, mechanical, software, and supply chain, to enhance the overall reliability of the Starshield hardware. This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge R&D technology and some of the most complex applications of electrical engineering in the industry.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Perform detailed failure analysis of Starshield satellite hardware, identifying root causes of failures and implementing corrective actions

• Utilize design schematics, test equipment, and inspection processes to identify the physics of the failure

• Collaborate with design, manufacturing, and supply chain teams to improve product reliability and manufacturing processes

• Work closely with the respective test engineers for your products to keep a close feedback loop improving test assets, to reduce false failures, and to increase test coverage to avoid escapes

• Monitor yield rates and quality metrics, driving corrective actions to address non-conforming products

• Conduct benchtop environmental testing to validate product robustness

• Support production and field operations by providing technical guidance on failure resolution and process improvements

• Maintain thorough documentation of failure analysis findings, test results, and corrective actions

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, or other engineering discipline

• 1+ years of experience in hardware development, failure analysis, or reliability engineering (internship and co-op experience qualifies)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Master’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent engineering discipline

• 3+ years of industry experience working with electronic hardware

• Experience with digital and mixed-signal designs, power electronics, or RF electronics using oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, and soldering equipment

• Demonstrated experience troubleshooting and root causing electrical hardware failures

• Experience with environmental testing such as HALT/HASS, thermal, vibration, and TVAC

• Proficiency in programming languages (such as Python, C, or C++) for test automation and data analysis

• Knowledge of quality tools such as Lean principles, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and corrective action

• Experience developing or supporting any of the following products/processes: Analog, digital, and mixed signal circuit testing RF hardware testing Design for excellence (DFX), derating, and related analyses Digital communications interfaces including SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet, and RS422 Statistical Process Control (SPC)

• Active Top Secret, Top Secret SCI, or DOE Level Q clearance, or the ability and willingness to obtain one

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Able to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support critical path development and/or critical on-orbit operations

• An active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions; if so, you will be subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol test

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $115,000.00 - $140,000.00
Level 2: $135,000.00 - $170,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

Kodiak AI, Inc. (Nasdaq: KDK), founded in 2018, is a leader in Physical AI, developing driverless technology that powers machines that move. Its Kodiak Driver is a vehicle-agnostic autonomous driving system that combines AI-powered software with modular hardware. Today it operates in long-haul trucking, industrial trucking, and defense. In 2024, Kodiak launched commercial Driver-as-a-Service operations with no one in the cab, and plans to launch driverless long-haul service between Dallas and Houston by the end of 2026.

Kodiak has partnered with many of the biggest names in freight, including Bosch for scaled hardware production, AWS, and leading customers including Atlas Energy Solutions, IKEA, Bridgestone, Werner Enterprises, C.R. England, Roehl Transport, and General Dynamics Land Systems.

We are looking for experienced commercial drivers to join our Lancaster operations to help us deploy our autonomous technology.  Our Lancaster, Texas Operations team is on the cutting edge of working with our partners to improve and integrate our technology in real world conditions.

CaseGuard is a fast-growing startup based in the DC area, helping organizations securely redact sensitive information. We are seeking a driven Sales Manager to lead our sales initiatives, drive revenue growth, and expand our customer base. You’ll be working with a team that owns and grows a territory across multiple industries, including law enforcement, government, legal, healthcare, education, and enterprise organizations.

Position Overview

The Sales Manager will be responsible for developing and executing sales strategies, managing the sales pipeline, and leading the sales team to achieve revenue targets. This individual will oversee the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations, closing deals, and maintaining strong customer relationships.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record in B2B SaaS sales, strong leadership capabilities, and the ability to develop effective sales processes in a fast-paced, growing technology environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue goals, identify new business opportunities, and expand target markets.

• Establish sales targets, quotas, and performance metrics while monitoring market trends, competitor activity, and growth opportunities.

• Lead, manage, and motivate the sales team to meet or exceed performance targets.

• Recruit, onboard, train, and coach sales representatives on prospecting, presentations, negotiations, and closing strategies.

• Conduct regular one-on-ones, pipeline reviews, and performance evaluations while fostering accountability and a results-driven culture.

• Oversee the sales pipeline, maintain accurate Salesforce records, and prepare sales forecasts and performance reports for executive leadership.

• Build relationships with key decision-makers and oversee high-value sales opportunities, negotiations, and closing activities.

• Collaborate with Marketing on lead generation and sales initiatives, and represent the company at industry conferences, networking events, and customer meetings.

• Partner with Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and executive leadership to align sales strategies, strengthen customer retention, and support account growth.

• Ensure sales messaging and product demonstrations effectively communicate the company's value proposition.

Qualifications & Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field preferred.

• 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, preferably within the SaaS or technology industry.

• 2+ years of experience managing, mentoring, or leading a sales team.

• Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding revenue targets.

• Experience selling enterprise SaaS solutions to government agencies, healthcare, law enforcement, legal, or educational institutions.

• Experience managing complex, consultative sales cycles and negotiating business agreements.

• Strong understanding of SaaS business models, recurring revenue, and customer acquisition strategies.

• Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce.

• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to use sales data to drive business decisions.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and thrive in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 401K

• Paid Vacation

• Ten paid holidays per year

• Friendly and Learning environment

Salary Range: Base salary is from $100,000 - $140,000, OTE $150,000 - $240,000  plus equity

Open to remote candidates, with a preference for candidates located in Washington, D.C., Virginia, or Maryland.

About CaseGuard

CaseGuard is a software company that helps law enforcement agencies, federal agencies, hospitals, schools, airports and others manage all their media redaction needs in one easy to use redaction software. CaseGuard Studio is one of its kind. Our team is driven by a passion for great software design, the creation of great products and the creative process, CaseGuard implements innovative ideas across multiple services and agencies.

jobs.title: Senior Spacecraft Mission Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Spacecraft Mission Operations Engineer is an experienced spacecraft operator. They are exceptional communicators, adept leaders, and a jack-of-all trades capable of applying cross-discipline engineering to bespoke solutions. An ideal candidate is someone passionate to work in a startup environment where you will have the opportunity to fully own on-orbit operations for our Winnie Spaceship and mold a unique new mission framework for operations in space.

Responsibilities

• Develop, coordinate, execute, and lead Varda's on-orbit missions.

• Own the full ops development cycle for mission-unique payloads, from the creation of mission profiles through execution.

• Work with teams across the company to continuously improve upon mission operations and ensure mission success.

• Automate and eliminate operational burden by building webtools.

• Scale up Varda's operational capabilities to support a growing flight cadence.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline, preferably Aerospace, Electrical, or Computer Science.

• 5+ years of experience in a real time operations role on a complex and high consequence operation.

• 3+ years of experience developing software tools in Python, JavaScript, and/or HTML.

• Familiarity with Avionics, GNC, Software, and Thermal design practices for spacecraft.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• 5+ years of experience with spacecraft systems.

• Previous operator experience in a leadership role.

• Previous in-orbit spacecraft operations experience.

• Previous experience with Git and Atlassian products.

• Familiarity with ground stations networks.

Pay Range

• Salary range: Senior: $140,333 - $179,314/ per year.

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.

• Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.

• You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will take ownership of complex engineering challenges, build secure and scalable systems, and raise the technical bar through hands-on execution and collaboration.

• Lead high-impact initiatives that span multiple teams and system boundaries

• Turn ambiguous product and security challenges into clear, executable engineering strategies

• Establish standards for secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems

• Identify systemic risks, architectural gaps, and investments needed for long-term growth

• You thrive in ambiguity. You build the path as you walk it, viewing ambiguity not as a hindrance but as raw material to create impactful solutions.

• You are a problem-solver. You are energized by complex challenges and finding elegant solutions that deliver maximum value.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You build strong relationships through clear feedback, respect, and a commitment to team success.

jobs.title: Systems Administrator II, AV & OT
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

The IT team is responsible for the full scope of computing infrastructure, end-user systems, servers, virtualization, cloud, networking, software services, telecommunications, and information security. You’ll support every function across the company, from the production floor to flight operations, enabling Relativity’s world-class team to design, build, and launch rockets. The team balances near-term execution with long-term vision, developing scalable solutions and processes to enable the company's growth. The evolving complexity of our IT environment offers opportunities to stretch and sharpen problem solving and hands-on technical skills. We invest in our people, encouraging ownership, cross-training, and advancement, so our team can grow as fast and ambitiously as the company itself.

About the Role:

• Help set the design standards and long-term direction for AV across our offices, from huddle rooms to boardrooms and all-hands spaces, partnering with Infrastructure and Workplace teams on new builds and renovations from scoping through commissioning

• Administer and support our conferencing and room-systems fleet across Logitech,Polycom, Q-SYS, and Crestron, including configuration standards, firmware lifecycle, remote monitoring, and fast recovery when a room goes down before a critical meeting

• Own our digital signage and media player fleet: deploy and provision players, manage them centrally, keep firmware and configurations current, and monitor player health so dark screens get caught before anyone reports them

• Hands-on administration of Logitech room systems, Q-SYS (design, DSP configuration, and fleet management), and Crestron control systems, including configuration, firmware management, and troubleshooting

jobs.title: Sr. Avionics Test Engineer (Starshield)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. AVIONICS TEST ENGINEER (STARSHIELD)

Starshield leverages SpaceX’s Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads.

As an avionics test engineer, you will have the unique opportunity to design and develop test systems for all the electronic hardware on our satellites. You will be expected to create test solutions from the ground up and be the last line of defense testing and screening out all electronic hardware for our spacecraft. Our fundamental goal is to improve humanity and ultimately to explore the stars; with it comes extreme responsibility to ensure the safety and reliability of our satellites and payloads.

We’re looking for people who want to dive in and get their hands dirty and those who are not afraid to make important decisions and work to provide data driven rationale. Every day we push the limits of what is possible through innovation, determination, and teamwork and we’re only just beginning.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design, develop, and maintain custom test solutions for flight hardware consisting of in-house developed electronics, optics, RF antennas and modulators, and electro-mechanical hardware

• Select commercial-off-the-shelf hardware and/or design custom PCBAs to measure signals, apply flight-like loads, and power units under test

• Write automation software in Python to interact with units under test, test equipment, instrumentation, and production documentation systems

• Work closely with and consistently provide feedback to responsible design engineers, manufacturing engineers, and test lab teams to drive innovation in design and infrastructure to increase product reliability and yield

• Root-cause test anomalies and failures during various states of testing and development to ensure they are understood and implement mitigations

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, or an engineering discipline with an emphasis in electrical engineering and electronics

• 5+ years of experience with electronic hardware development or software development (academic projects, internships, and traditional professional experience all qualify)

• 5+ years of programming experience using Python, MATLAB, or Embedded C/C++

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience analyzing circuits and developing functional test plans

• Experience developing object-oriented software

• Experience designing and troubleshooting PCBAs

• Experience with test equipment such as oscilloscopes, DMMs, DAQs and measurement techniques to verify and validate product electronic requirements

• Experience with RF test equipment including spectrum analyzers, vector network analyzers, and signal generators

• Understanding of electrical schematics and electronics manufacturing to analyze and improve test coverage

• Understanding of metrology, sources of measurement error, and uncertainty analysis

• Understanding and experience in environmental testing such as HALT, HASS, vibration, shock, thermal, TVAC, and EMI/EMC

• Active Secret, Top Secret or Top Secret SCI clearance, or ability to obtain one desired but not required

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Extended hours and weekend work may be required to support critical project and mission milestones

• Ability to lift heavy harnesses and fixtures

• Note that an active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions; if so, you will be subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
$165,000.00 - $230,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

jobs.title: Staff Program Manager, Strike Team
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Nuro believes self-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that’s why we’re building a universal autonomy platform: self-driving for all roads and all rides.

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.

With years of real-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected.

Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.

About the Role

As we scale and deploy driverless vehicles in operations with our partners, we're building a small team of program owners who take on Nuro's most important new challenges. You'll be given an ambiguous problem, build the plan, execute it, and either hand off to a permanent owner or become one. Then you move to the next problem.

Whereas traditional rotational programs may have rigid formats and expose you to smaller challenges, this is an opportunity to take on mission-critical work. You will own outcomes, not recommendations.

What you'll do

• Take ownership of a critical challenge with no current owner, from scoping through execution.

• Build structure and a plan where none exists, then ship against it.

• Work directly with engineering leads, product managers, and program owners across the company to get context fast and build fast.

• As needed hand off cleanly to a permanent owner, and move to the next initiative or become the permanent owner yourself.

What we're looking for

• Strong technical foundation. CS/Engineering or other technical degree preferred. Consulting experience in technical industries or program leadership at a top company is an equally strong path to success in this role.

• Track record of ramping into unfamiliar domains and topics quickly and producing real output, not just building context and understanding.

• Comfortable owning ambiguous, zero-to-one work without a lot of structure handed to you.

• No AV background required. But we are looking for applicants excited about the space. A willingness to learn it fast matters more than prior exposure.

• Evidence that you can build trust with technical teams quickly, since you'll be the new person in the room more often than not.

• Expertise in running programs, both technical and non-technical.

What makes someone a fit

You'd rather own a hard, undefined problem than execute a well-scoped one. You get energy from the first 90 days of something new, not the steady state. You've probably already done this informally, jumping into gaps other people avoided because they were messy.

At Nuro, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. For this position, the reasonably expected base pay range is between $176,400 and $264,600 for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity, and a competitive benefits package.

At Nuro, we celebrate differences and are committed to a diverse workplace that fosters inclusion and psychological safety for all employees. jobs.title: Production Control I
jobs.description:
Summary

The Production Control I role is responsible for supporting production scheduling, monitoring material availability, tracking production activities, and coordinating with various departments to help ensure efficient workflow and adherence to production schedules. This position assists in identifying production challenges, material shortages, schedule discrepancies, and other issues that may impact operational timelines. Working under the guidance of the Production Control Supervisor and experienced team members, this role helps maintain accurate production information, facilitate communication between departments, and support the timely resolution of production-related issues.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Production Problem Resolution

• Communicate with production personnel to identify and report production challenges or delays.

• Assist in coordinating with other departments to gather information and support the resolution of issues impacting production schedules.

• Identify production or project concerns requiring attention and escalate them to the Production Control Supervisor.

• Maintain and provide updates on production status, potential delays, and outstanding issues.

Monitor Part Shortages

• Monitor and track material availability and shortages that may impact production schedules.

• Communicate identified material shortages to the Production Control Supervisor and appropriate stakeholders.

• Coordinate with Supply Chain Management (SCM) to obtain updates on material availability and expected delivery dates.

• Assist in tracking shortage resolution activities and maintaining accurate records of outstanding material requirements.

ERP Schedule Coordination

• Assist the planning department with monitoring production schedules and maintaining accurate information within the ERP system.

• Review production schedules for discrepancies and communicate identified issues to the appropriate personnel.

• Track schedule updates and assist in communicating changes to affected departments.

• Support efforts to maintain production timelines by identifying and escalating potential scheduling concerns.

MIR Operations Accuracy

• Assist planning and quality departments in maintaining accurate Manufacturing Inspection Record (MIR) operations and related documentation.

• Review information for completeness and accuracy and communicate discrepancies to the appropriate personnel.

• Support the timely communication and tracking of MIR-related information across departments.

• Escalate identified process or documentation discrepancies to the Production Control Supervisor.

Lean Product Flow Support:

• Assist in identifying opportunities to improve product flow and production efficiency.

• Support departmental efforts to streamline processes, reduce waste, and improve workflow.

• Communicate observed process inefficiencies or obstacles to the Production Control Supervisor.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives as directed.

OSP Request Coordination:

• Assist in tracking OSP (Outsourced Processes) requests to support timely processing and completion.

• Monitor the status of outsourced activities and communicate delays or outstanding requirements to the appropriate personnel.

• Maintain accurate records and documentation related to OSP requests.

• Escalate issues impacting outsourced process timelines or production requirements.

Engineering Collaboration for Design and Drawing Releases:

• Coordinate with engineering and production personnel to obtain updates on drawing releases and design changes.

• Assist in communicating released drawings and approved design changes to the appropriate production personnel.

• Help track outstanding drawing releases and identify potential impacts to production schedules.

• Escalate drawing discrepancies or missing information that may affect production activities.

Cross Departmental Communication:

• Maintain effective communication with logistics, quality, program management, engineering, planning, and other departments to support production activities.

• Assist in gathering and communicating information related to project status, production schedules, and outstanding issues.

• Ensure production-related updates are communicated accurately and in a timely manner.

• Support collaboration across departments to help maintain efficient production workflows.

Other Duties as Assigned:

• Perform any other duties as assigned by the Production Control Supervisor, in alignment with departmental goals

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Greenpoint Core Competencies:

• Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, accepts constructive criticism/feedback and changes approach or method to best fit the situation.

• Communications - Expresses ideas and thoughts effectively in verbal and written form, exhibits good listening and comprehension, keeps others informed and uses appropriate communication methods.

• Dependability - Responds to requests for service and assistance, follows instruction and responds to management direction, takes responsibility for own actions and doing the best job possible, keeps commitments, and maintains reliable attendance.

• Initiative - Sets and achieves challenging goals, demonstrates persistence, and overcomes obstacles, measures self against standard of excellence, recognizes and acts on opportunities, and takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.

• Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities, exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views, gives and welcomes feedback, contributes to building a positive team spirit, and puts success of team above own interests.

• Work Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness, displays commitment to excellence, looks for ways to improve and promote quality, applies feedback to improve performance, and monitors own work to ensure quality.

Summary of Education, Experience & Certification

High School diploma or equivalent required.  0-2 years’ relevant experience in an aerospace production environment.  Vocational and technical schooling preferred.

Employees working on programs subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations must qualify as a US Person which is defined as a US Citizen, a Permanent Resident who does not work for a foreign company/foreign government/foreign governmental agency or organization, or a political asylee for legal compliance purposes.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Ability to communicate effectively with others, both verbally and in written format.

• Basic mathematical knowledge and ability to apply it toward routine problem-solving.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple responsibilities, and meet deadlines.

• Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

• Ability to learn and navigate ERP systems and production scheduling tools.

• Ability to follow established processes and procedures and recognize when issues require escalation.

• Ability to work effectively in a team environment and collaborate with cross-functional departments.

• Ability to work under general supervision.

• Ability to travel.

• Ability to work outside of core business hours, as required.

Physical Requirements.

• Able to climb and work on step stools and/or ladders.

• Able to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds without assistance and ability to occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds with assistance.

• Able to reach overhead.

• Able to work in a non-dust-free environment.

• Normal or corrected vision (required to perform exacting tasks).

• Full range of motion with both hands.

About Greenpoint Technologies
Greenpoint delivers nose-to-tail VIP Jet aircraft interiors for private clients and Heads-of-State.  We are proud to be known in the aerospace industry for our design and engineering innovation, award-winning company culture, and on-time delivery of our beautiful products. We use leading-edge tools and employee-built processes to deliver extraordinary, one-of-a-kind custom aircraft interiors.  It’s complex work, but we work smart.  In return for hard work, collaboration, and creativity, our people experience a culture custom built for high achievers:

• Big jobs and stretch assignments.

• High accountability environment, with transparent decisions aligned to values, open communication, and engaged leadership.

• Ability to make a big, visible impact on the end product.

We welcome diverse contributions and provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge R&D technology and some of the most complex applications of electrical engineering in the industry

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead and hire a team of electrical hardware reliability engineers supporting Starshield production

• Provide technical mentorship and guidance to team members leading root cause investigations of electrical hardware

• Align goals and priorities with production and partner engineering teams to achieve program reliability and rate objectives

• Collaborate with team members to create personalized career growth plans that build their technical capabilities and accelerate progress toward their professional goals

• Drive corrective action to products not meeting design specifications through data driven decisions using yield and defect monitoring to identify common failure modes

• Proactively escalate major hardware concerns, secure appropriate resources, and maintain clear communication to drive timely resolution and team alignment

• Maintain thorough documentation of failure analysis findings, test results, and corrective actions

• Collaborate with on-orbit reliability team, driving timely improvements to production through on-orbit investigation findings

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, or other engineering discipline

• 3+ years of experience in hardware development, failure analysis, or reliability engineering (internships and co-ops acceptable)

• 1+ years of experience leading a project, team, or people

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Strong analytical skills with an excellent ability to communicate and collaborate with partners in all disciplines at multiple levels in the organization

• Demonstrated ability to advocate for and implement robust solutions that stand the test of time

• Experience deploying large-scale and/or high impact solutions in a manufacturing environment

• Experience with digital and mixed-signal designs, power electronics, or RF electronics using oscilloscopes, signal generators, digital multimeters, power supplies, and soldering equipment

• Demonstrated experience troubleshooting and root causing electrical hardware failures

• PCBA Fabrication experience (familiar with solder, flux, underfill, staking, reflow, temperature control, etc.)

• Experience with environmental testing such as HALT/HASS, thermal, vibration, and TVAC

• Experience with RF test equipment (e.g. vector network analyzer, spectrum analyzer) and concepts such as S-parameters, impedance matching, and antenna designs

• Active Top Secret, Top Secret SCI, or DOE Level Q clearance, or the ability and willingness to obtain one

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Able to work extended hours and weekends as needed

• An active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions; if so, you will be subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol tests

jobs.title: Care Manager, RN (Worcester Market  /Field Based)
jobs.description:
FreedomCare is a healthcare company that has been dedicated to revolutionizing the home care industry since 2016. We support our patients by ensuring they have the power to choose a caregiver who will care for them in the comfort of their own homes. Our mission spans coast to coast, supporting patients across the U.S.

We pride ourselves on our values which drive the level of care that we deliver to our patients:

- Here For You (An attitude of service, empathy, and availability)

- Own It (Drive and ownership)

- Do the Right Thing (High integrity)

- Be Positive (Great attitude and a can-do positive approach to challenges)

Join our team and make a positive impact on the lives of others! We are looking for a Care Manager, RN for our Massachusetts team!

This is a field-based RN position that requires regular travel throughout an assigned Massachusetts territory to conduct in-home visits and support member care. Coverage areas may include the North Shore, Boston Proper, South Shore & Cape Area, Worcester, and Western Massachusetts.

Department & Position Overview:

FreedomCare’s Massachusetts operations support the MassHealth Adult Foster Care (AFC) program, which helps eligible adults with medical, physical, cognitive, or behavioral health needs receive daily assistance in a home setting from a qualified caregiver with professional care team support.

The Care Manager, RN is responsible for conducting initial in-home assessments, orientations for new patients and caregivers, and providing ongoing care management and support. This role combines clinical assessment, care coordination, patient and caregiver education, and quality assurance to ensure safe, effective, and person-centered care.

The Care Manager, RN collaborates closely with patients, caregivers, and interdisciplinary care teams to assess needs, develop individualized plans of care, and facilitate the seamless initiation and delivery of services. Through regularly scheduled home visits, the RN completes and coordinates applicable clinical assessments and evaluations; develops, implements, monitors, and reviews member plans of care; monitors member health status; provides clinical oversight, education, support, and evaluation of AFC caregivers; and coordinates care with the member, responsible party, care manager, primary care provider, and other service providers. The Care Manager, RN proactively communicates clinical concerns, changes in condition, and potential barriers to care with the appropriate team members to ensure timely intervention, effective care coordination, and optimal patient outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct initial in-person clinical assessments and coordinate timely service activation, ensuring all required documentation, approvals, and standard procedures are completed.

• Develop, implement, and manage individualized plans of care, making and documenting revisions as the patient’s needs or condition change.

• Educate patients, caregivers, and internal teams regarding care needs, safety considerations, service requirements, caregiver responsibilities, and next steps.

• Coordinate patient care through timely communication and documentation with physicians, clinical disciplines, internal partners, and appropriate community resources.

• Provide ongoing education and coaching to support effective use of established best practices, promote caregiver competency, and connect patients and families with appropriate resources.

• Review caregiver documentation regularly and respond appropriately to identified changes in the patient’s condition, environment, or service needs.

• Identify changes in condition, safety concerns, service gaps, incidents, or other urgent issues and escalate them in accordance with established clinical protocols.

• Complete and document assessments, visits, clinical observations, care-plan updates, incidents, communications, and follow-up actions accurately, thoroughly, and within required timeframes.

• Support authorization, renewal, start-of-care, and continued-service processes, as applicable.

• Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements, professional standards, and company policies and procedures.

• Perform other related duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Credentials:

• Current, unrestricted license as a registered nurse issued by the Massachusetts Board of Registration in Nursing.

• At least two years of recent experience providing direct care to elders or adults with disabilities, preferred.

• Completion of tuberculosis screening before assignment and ongoing screening consistent with applicable CDC, Massachusetts Department of Public Health, and MassHealth requirements.

• Successful completion of required CORI, SORI, OIG exclusion, reference, employment-history, and professional-license checks.

• Must not be related to or legally responsible for a member assigned to the RN.

• Valid driver’s license, required automobile insurance, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to member qualified settings.

Qualifications:

• Strong clinical judgment, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.

• Knowledge of person-centered care, professional nursing standards, and home- and community-based services.

• Knowledge of the health, functional, cognitive, behavioral, and safety needs of elders and adults with disabilities.

• Ability to learn, interpret, and consistently apply Massachusetts Adult Foster Care regulations, MassHealth requirements, clinical protocols, and organizational policies.

• Demonstrated commitment to high-quality member and caregiver service.

• Ability to communicate with empathy, patience, professionalism, cultural sensitivity, and respect.

• Strong active-listening and interviewing skills, with the ability to identify needs, risks, barriers, and concerns.

• Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain clinical information clearly to members, caregivers, and interdisciplinary partners.

• Strong clinical documentation skills, with attention to accuracy, completeness, clarity, and timeliness.

• Strong organizational, prioritization, time-management, and caseload-management skills.

• Ability to recognize urgent clinical, health, safety, or compliance concerns and exercise sound judgment regarding escalation.

• Ability to provide clear, effective, and culturally responsive education to members and caregivers.

• Ability to establish and maintain professional, supportive relationships with members, caregivers, primary care providers, and community partners.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with nurses, care managers, program leadership, and other members of a multidisciplinary professional team.

• Ability to work independently in home- and community-based settings while remaining accountable to established clinical and operational standards.

• Proficiency with electronic documentation systems, secure communication tools, and other healthcare technology required for the role.

• Ability to protect member privacy, confidentiality, dignity, rights, and informed choice.

• Dependable, punctual, and able to consistently meet scheduling, attendance, documentation, and performance expectations.

• Ability to adapt to changing member needs, clinical priorities, regulatory requirements, processes, and technology.

Why work at FreedomCare?

We are here for you and committed to providing a best-in-class employee experience. We offer competitive compensation, medical benefits, retirement plans, wellness programs, fun company events and ongoing learning opportunities to grow your career.

This is a place where your voice matters, where we build great relationships, and your work has meaning and a tangible positive impact on others!

At FreedomCare, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, citizenship or immigration status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

This provides our employees with the opportunity to professionally grow and develop within a role. EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com

**Candidate Note: This position is 100% remote for candidates based in US**

We're looking for a Staff Engineer that will focus on a Database Platform that supports Postgres estates and fleets. This position owns the packaging and delivery of a number of Kubernetes operators, across the supported cloud Kubernetes environments (EKS, AKS, GKE, OpenShift/RHOS, kind). The work spans Kubernetes packaging, container builds and CI/CD, Postgres-on-Kubernetes infrastructure, and the customer documentation for those capabilities, and it contributes to database release readiness for each release cycle. You will be part of a supportive team with a breadth of experience.

What you will be doing:

• Solving problems for customers by developing easy-to-use systems and features for EDB’s database platform offering(s).

• Leveraging cloud environments to scale our development, testing, and build systems

• Improving the performance and usability of existing products, features, and automated systems

• Collaborating and mentor engineers on a global distributed team to ensure we are using standard methodologies to build scalable, secure, and operationally sound tools and systems.

• Documenting and evangelizing products, features for use by engineers for the development, testing, and packaging of their products

• Implementing and maintaining Kubernetes operators

• Must be able to independently take a feature from design to implementation, delivering according to release dates and deadlines. Working across different development teams in order to ensure cross dependency.

• Developing distributed systems for Kubernetes environments

• Technical writing for customer-facing product documentation that is passed to the documentation team, and documentation for internal stakeholders.

• Ability to present technical explanations to engineering audiences and internal stakeholders in English.

What you will bring:

• Hands-on experience authoring Kubernetes Operators.

• Expert in Golang (Go).

• Deep Kubernetes experience, both managed (e.g. Cloud) and self-managed (e.g. OpenShift, Rancher)

• Container build tooling: Docker, multi-stage and CI image builds.

• Traditional enterprise networking patterns and best practices.

• Ability to manage work in a globally distributed remote environment.

What will set you apart:

• Familiar with OpenShift, familiar for design systems for OpenShift / RHOS packaging and Red Hat certification.

• Appliance or cloud-marketplace delivery, including air-gapped and private-registry install scenarios.

• IAM, Object Storage, Cloud Storage

• Observability for Postgres workloads.

• CI/CD with GitHub Actions; infrastructure-as-code and config management; linting (hadolint, pre-commit).

• Using CloudNativePG or comparable Postgres operators, with solid Postgres operational knowledge.

• High-availability and distributed systems.

Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. Ennoble Care offers a variety of programs including, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health management, and chronic care management, to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care by a team they know and trust. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

Purpose:

We are looking for an experienced Advanced Provider (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide primary care to homebound and palliative care patients in the Jamaica, Queens, NY region. You will apply medical techniques and principles under the supervision of a physician and you will care for a diverse set of patients with chronic diseases.

• Provide high quality care to primary and palliative patients in and around Jamaica, Queens, NY

• Assess patient's health by performing physical examinations; obtaining, updating, and studying medical histories and creating the best plan for care.

• Effectively communicate with office staff and clinical operations across various internal platforms

• Provide high quality, patient centered care to a panel of patients

• Attend quarterly medical staff meetings

• Develop impressions, diagnosis, and treatment plans

• Foster trust and consult with patients, families, and caregivers during visits

• Order diagnostic testing as medically necessary

• Prescribe medications supplies and appropriate medically necessary interventions

What You'll Need:

• Board Certified, with a valid NP or PA certification in the State of New York

• Strong clinical skills with the ability to accurately and confidently treat, assess, and diagnose

• Positive demeanor and strong people skills

• Ability to confidently problem solve and operate independently

• 1-2 years of primary care experience with geriatric patients (hospice experience highly preferred but not required)

What you'll get:

• A flexible schedule - so you can see your patients during a schedule that works for you

• Autonomy - so you can feel trusted to provide the best care possible.

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Premium Support
jobs.description:
About Integrated Specialty Coverages

Integrated Specialty Coverages, LLC (ISC) is a growth stage technology and data-driven commercial MGA and insurance wholesaler leading innovation in the market.

Backed by one of the leading private equity firms, Onex Partners, and led by a forward-thinking management team, ISC is combining the worlds of insurance and technology to create an Insurtech powerhouse. As a leading online distributor of insurance products for a range of industries and “Main Street USA”, we are looking for the right people to help us in our mission of achieving exponential growth. We strive to be the number one place to go for brokers and agents to source insurance. To accomplish this, we’re building a digitally focused team that deeply understands the intersection between user experience, data, and AI/ML to optimize the way we engage with our customers and partners.

Job Summary

The Sr. Manager, Premium Support owns the customer-facing side of how money moves at ISC: premium audit, billing, payments, and chargebacks. Premium audit fieldwork is largely outsourced, so this role is less about performing audits and more about centralizing ISC's premium audit program across the enterprise, governing audit vendors, resolving disputes, and making the end-to-end experience accurate, compliant, and easy for brokers and insureds.

This leader is the front-office partner to Accounting's back-office work. Accounting books and reconciles; Premium Support explains, resolves, and improves. The role will also lead automation of billing, payment, and audit processes and, as volume requires, build a team to handle billing inquiries, payment questions, FAQs, and chargebacks.

Position Responsibilities

Premium Audit Program Leadership

• Centralize premium audit initiatives across ISC's programs into a single, consistent operating model with clear standards, workflows, and ownership.

• Manage premium audit operations for General Liability (GL) and Workers' Compensation (WC), including outsourced audit vendors, internal staff, quality, and compliance.

• Ensure compliance with state and rating bureau audit requirements (e.g., NCCI and independent state bureaus) across mail-in, phone, virtual, and physical audits.

• Oversee audit vendor performance: completion rates, cycle time, quality scores, waiver/non-compliance rates, and customer satisfaction; lead regular performance reviews with vendors.

• Partner with Underwriting to translate business strategy into an annual audit plan, including audit-type selection, thresholds, and exposure-basis validation.

Disputes & Escalations

• Serve as ISC's point of escalation for premium audit disputes from brokers and insureds; review exposure basis, classification, and supporting records to reach a fair, documented resolution.

• Coordinate re-audits, endorsements, and premium adjustments with Underwriting, Accounting, and carrier partners.

• Track dispute volume, root causes, and outcomes; feed findings back into audit standards, vendor coaching, and underwriting guidance.

Billing, Payments & Money Movement

• Own the customer-facing billing and payment experience, including invoices, installment plans, audit premium billing, return premiums, and refunds.

• Manage payment platform operations and resolve complex payment scenarios (misapplied, duplicate, partial, and split payments; agency bill vs. direct bill questions).

• Lead chargeback and payment dispute management end to end: intake, evidence gathering, response within card-network timelines, and prevention.

• Ensure payment processes meet applicable data security and compliance standards (e.g., PCI DSS) and internal controls.

Automation & Process Improvement

• Identify and lead opportunities to automate billing, payment, and audit processes, from audit ordering and status communications to payment reminders and dispute intake.

• Partner with BX, Technology, and program internal clients to build self-service content, macros, and automations that deflect routine billing and audit questions.

• Define and report KPIs for the function (e.g., audit completion rate, audit cycle time, dispute rate and resolution time, chargeback win rate, first-contact resolution, CSAT).

Team Building & Leadership

• When volume and strategy require, design and build a Premium Support team covering billing inquiries, payment support, FAQs, chargebacks, and audit dispute handling.

• Define roles, hiring profiles, training, SOPs, and quality standards for the team; coach and develop team members.

• Decide what to keep in-house versus route to BPO or audit vendors, in partnership with BX leadership.

Front-Office Partnership with Accounting & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Act as the front-office counterpart to accounting: own customer communication and resolution while Accounting owns posting, reconciliation, and reporting; define clean handoffs between the two.

• Partner with Analytics, Underwriting, Claims, Billing, Compliance, and Product teams to optimize workflows and support profitability.

• Support SOX and internal control requirements related to premium, billing, and cash processes; assist with internal and external audit requests.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• 5+ years in premium audit or underwriting

• 5-9 years insurance billing, or related P&C insurance functions.

• Hands-on experience with GL and WC premium audits, including exposure bases, risk classification, and state/bureau compliance standards.

• Experience with payment platforms, complex payment questions, and chargeback management.

• Track record of resolving escalated customer disputes involving premium or billing.

• Strong analytical skills, including data analysis and financial modeling in Excel or BI tools.

• Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Premium audit designation(s), such as AIPA (Associate in Premium Auditing).

• Experience in a B2B insurance environment (MGA, wholesale, or carrier).

• People management experience, including building a team from the ground up.

• Experience managing outsourced audit or BPO vendors.

• SOX audit and regulatory compliance experience.

• Project management experience, ideally Agile.

• Proficiency with audit technology, automation tools, and ticketing platforms (e.g., Zendesk, ServiceNow, etc.).

• Ability to translate business strategy into operational audit and billing plans.

This role also offers bonus pay. Your ISC Talent Acquisition representative will share more details about the bonus component should you advance in the interview process.

The starting annual pay scale for this position is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on factors such as skills, qualifications, training, and experience. In addition, the company offers comprehensive benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k) plan with match, paid time off, and other benefits.

ISC's salary ranges are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

National Pay Range

$115,000—$135,000 USD

Benefits of Working at ISC

• Employee Ownership Program - every eligible employee shares in the financial rewards that grow when the company grows

• Professional development opportunities

Applicants needing assistance may request accommodation at any time. Please contact ISC at HR@ISCMGA.com or 760-599-7242.

jobs.title: Supervisor, Fluids Test Technicians
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and capital-efficient approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to support a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and supporting a growing space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to design, build, and operate its own spacecraft in orbit. Next, Haven-1 is targeted to become the world’s first commercial space station, with launch anticipated in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced two new offerings leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo: Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line; and Vast Lunar Systems, power, communications, and habitats for the Moon.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities capable of manufacturing America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for Mars, dedicated modules for government partners, and other crewed systems designed to unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for a Supervisor, Fluids Test Technicians, reporting to the Manager, Thermal Test. The Supervisor will lead the technician team and test shop that support development and verification of the thermal control systems needed to design and build artificial-gravity, human-rated space stations.

This is a full-time, exempt position located in our Long Beach, CA location.

Responsibilities:

• Plan, assign, and schedule technician work across thermal control system (TCS) testing operations, including flight component testing, test stand build and activation, and complex development tests.

• Prioritize work against engineering needs, flight schedules, and asset availability.

• Develop technicians into test specialists whom engineers can rely on for complex work.

• Own the team's training plan, track certifications and expirations, and lead hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, development planning, and day-to-day people management.

• Develop, maintain, and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) for the team's work, and keep them current as operations and test assets change.

• Train engineers and other staff to use shop test assets safely and reliably, and define and enforce use and safety expectations.

• Organize, schedule, and maintain the Fluids R&D test shop across its four use areas: Wet Lab: hydrostatic burst and proof testing, CdA flow characterization, and a rough clean line with cleaning verification per IEST-STD-CC1246 Hot Lab: TVAC chamber, vacuum chamber, and furnace Engineering Storage: high-value test articles, in-progress projects, long-term development assets, sensor calibration, and critical spares, with periodic culling to create space Dev Test: four large test cells, including their scheduling, maintenance, availability, and use expectations

• Oversee calibration schedules, preventive maintenance, and asset readiness.

• Keep the shop safe, clean, and organized, including workspace standards, housekeeping, and hazardous material handling.

• Define and maintain the shop's vision, layout, and space utilization plan.

• Lead a roadmap of incremental improvement projects with the team, tracked in Jira and aligned with TCS engineering direction.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical, aerospace, or chemical engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of technical education and hands-on experience

• 10+ years of hands-on experience in a test lab, test facility, or technical operations environment, including practical work on fluid, pressure, or thermal systems and high-pressure testing, with a demonstrated commitment to safe practices for pressurized systems

• Experience with fluid flow testing using multiple hydraulic and thermal fluids, test equipment, instrumentation, and sensor calibration, and experience scheduling or coordinating technical resources across competing priorities

• Experience writing, maintaining, or enforcing SOPs or other controlled procedures, and using Jira or a similar ticketing system to plan and track work, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to train others

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• Prior supervisory, lead technician, or team lead experience, including building a technician skills program or training curriculum

• Experience in an aerospace, space hardware, or spacecraft thermal control environment, including work under an AS 9100 or ISO 9001 quality system

• Familiarity with thermal vacuum (TVAC) testing, vacuum chamber operation, or furnace operation

• Familiarity with cleaning and cleanliness verification standards, such as IEST-STD-CC1246, and experience with hydrostatic burst and proof testing and flow characterization testing

• Experience with test cell scheduling tools or resource-planning systems

• Self-motivated, with strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize across competing demands

Pay Range: California

$94,300—$133,860 USD

We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Vast is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vast is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.

For more information, visit WPP.com.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Position Summary

Bottle Rocket helps clients plan, build, and improve digital products, leading with defined, outcome-oriented offerings. The Business Development Representative (BDR) is the engine at the top of the sales funnel and a key driver of the company’s growth. This role owns outbound prospecting, turning a strong volume of leads into calls, calls into meetings, and meetings into new clients.

The ideal BDR is driven, tenacious, and a great active listener. They understand the front-end digital experience and the back-end that enables it. They can distill the needs behind a prospect’s business challenges, connect them to the right Bottle Rocket solution, and hand a well-qualified opportunity to the Business Development Executive team.

Essential Functions

• Drive a high volume of outbound activity (calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach, and multi-touch cadences) to create a consistent flow of new leads

• Convert leads into live conversations, and conversations into qualified first meetings booked for the Business Development Executive team

• Own and consistently hit weekly and monthly targets for activity, conversations, meetings booked, and pipeline generated

• Lead outreach with Bottle Rocket’s productized offerings, positioning each around the business problem it solves rather than a list of services

• Spot buying signals in research and discovery calls, and connect them to the right Bottle Rocket services: Strategy & Research (Experience Strategy, Research & Insights): unclear priorities, fragmented experiences, a new idea to validate Design & Build (Design & Development, Experience Optimization): aging or low-rated apps, redesigns, falling engagement or conversion Enterprise Engineering (Technical Modernization, Cloud Enablement, AI & Data, Application Engineering): legacy platforms, cloud migration, AI pilots, integration gaps

• Research and build targeted account and contact lists in priority industries (Healthcare, Gaming, Hospitality, Financial Services, and QSR) with Business Development leadership

• Qualify prospects on pain points, fit, budget, decision-making authority, and timeline, and hand off to Business Development Executives with clear notes and context

• Partner with Marketing on go-to-market (GTM) campaigns for each offering, and share feedback on messaging, objections, and what is resonating in market

• Prepare meeting agendas, follow-up emails, and other prospect communications

• Keep activity, lead, and opportunity data accurate and current in the CRM

• Track and report on funnel metrics: activity → conversations → meetings → opportunities → new clients

• Work closely with Business Development, Marketing, and Product Strategy to align on GTM goals, KPIs, and metrics

Additional Duties and Responsibilities

• Stay current on trends in digital products, AI, cloud, and tech modernization, and on the business priorities of target industries

• Learn Bottle Rocket’s offerings, case studies, and delivery model well enough to speak credibly with prospects

• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications and Education Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Economics, or a related field

• 2–3 years of experience (post-college) in an outbound sales role, such as SDR or BDR, selling Technology or Consulting Services, SaaS, software, or similar technology products or services

• Related backgrounds are welcome, such as technology-enabled services, digital agencies, or IT consulting

• Proven, measurable record of meeting or exceeding activity, meeting, and pipeline targets

In this quota-carrying role within the Renewals team, you'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Product to forecast outcomes, reduce churn, and uncover expansion opportunities.
