jobs.title: Security Outcomes Program Lead
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

We are seeking a Security Outcomes Program Lead to join Anduril’s security outcomes team. You will champion
the connective layer between the offensive security engineers who find security issues and the teams responsible for
resolving them.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will own the post engagement outcomes for findings from internal and external offensive security
engagements. You will identify or communicate with the affected teams, contribute to vulnerability policy, establish
accountable owners, surface blockers, coordinate retesting, and maintain reliable status through verified closure.
You will also partner with Offensive Security leadership on testing intake, active assessments, dependencies, and
improvements. Offensive Security owns test strategy, technical findings, and validation verdicts; Product Security
and affected engineering teams own remediation. You contribute to the pipeline connecting them.
This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. It requires technical fluency, operating judgment, and
persistent influence across teams as your work impacts Anduril as a whole.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own findings from internal and external offensive security engagements after delivery, from handoff through verified closure.

• Identify affected teams, establish accountable remediation owners, and make sure they have the technical context needed to act.

• Track remediation progress, run recurring reviews, surface blockers, and escalate overdue or high risk issues.

• Coordinate retesting with Offensive Security and close findings only when fixes are verified.

• Partner with Offensive Security leadership on testing intake, active assessments, and dependencies.Maintain a clear view of open findings, ownership, status, and risk, and report on remediation outcomes and recurring issues to engineering and leadership.

• Contribute to vulnerability policy, remediation targets, and exception handling, and improve the processes connecting testing to remediation.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 3+ years of technical project or program leadership, security delivery, or comparable cross functional engineering program experience, including 2+ years supporting cybersecurity, penetration testing, Product

• Security, vulnerability management, or security engineering.

• Technical fluency sufficient to understand attack paths, vulnerability impact, remediation constraints, and validation evidence, and to know when a decision requires a security engineer.

• Strong written and verbal communication, operating discipline, attention to detail, and ability to maintain trusted status across a high volume portfolio.

• Eligibility to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience operating penetration testing, red team, application security, PSIRT, vulnerability remediation, or security assurance programs.

• Experience in a security consultancy, internal offensive security function, or continuously shipping product organization.

• Familiarity with CVSS, CWE, coordinated disclosure, risk exceptions, secure development practices, and vulnerability management workflows.

US Salary Range

$114,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
Senior Program Manager

Within the Space Missions and Sensing (SMS) Sector, we focus on advancing space sensing, space control, and counter-sensing technologies for critical national security missions.

The Space Sensing Applications Group is seeking a Senior Program Manager to apply their expertise in program execution and proposal development within a dynamic research and development environment. You will support multiple programs focused on space-based sensing applications, serving as the primary program manager or as a member of a broader program management team, depending on the effort’s size and complexity. What you will do:

• Work in partnership with program principal investigators on planning, execution, and delivery of program capability

• Identification of risks and development of mitigation plans. Monitor progress against goals and initiate corrective actions as appropriate.

• Communicate effectively with stakeholders to manage expectations and drive continuous improvements

• Effectively execute multiple programs to ensure cost, schedule, and technical program metrics are being tracked and are within plan

Who you are:

jobs.title: Direct Strategic Sourcing Lead
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


ABOUT THE ROLE?

Cohere’s Procurement team buys everything from pens to compute. We’re looking for a Lead, Direct Strategic Sourcing to own the categories closest to how we build: the technology, software, engineering talent and, over time, the compute that power our research and engineering teams.

Reporting to the Head of Procurement, you’ll build this pillar from the ground up. You’ll set category strategy, run our most complex and highest-stakes technology negotiations, and become a trusted commercial partner to engineering, research and infrastructure leaders. You’ll put the structure in place so these buys scale with both speed and control, and as the function grows, you’ll hire and lead a small team of specialists and analysts.

This is an opportunity for a hands-on, technically fluent sourcing leader who thrives in a high-growth environment, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and wants to shape how a frontier AI company buys the technology it runs on.




RESPONSIBILITIES:




OWN THE ENGINEERING AND R&D CATEGORIES

 - Own end-to-end strategic sourcing for Cohere’s engineering and R&D spend: technology licensing, OEM partnerships, engineering and IT software, developer and infrastructure tooling, and engineering staff augmentation and services.

 - Build and execute multi-year category strategies grounded in spend analysis, market intelligence, and demand forecasts built with Engineering, Research and FP&A.

 - Over time, extend the remit into compute (GPU capacity, cloud commitments, data center and colocation), partnering with Infrastructure, Finance and Legal on some of the largest commitments in the company.




LEAD TECHNOLOGY LICENSING AND OEM DEALS

 - Lead sourcing and negotiation of technology licensing and OEM agreements, including inbound licenses, third-party technology embedded in or distributed with our products, and partnerships that support customer deployments.

 - Structure commercial and contractual terms (licensing models, IP and use rights, SLAs, liability, data protection, escrow and exit provisions) hand in hand with Legal, Security and Product.




SCALE SOFTWARE AND ENG-RELATED SERVICES BUYING

 - Run RFx, benchmarking and negotiations for engineering and IT software, from early-stage tools to enterprise platforms, balancing engineering velocity with cost, risk and vendor consolidation.

 - Own the renewal pipeline: anticipate renewals, right-size licenses based on usage data, and drive multi-year and commitment strategies.

 - Build Cohere’s engineering staff augmentation program: preferred vendor panel, rate cards, SOW standards and guardrails for contractor classification and co-employment risk across countries.




PARTNER, DELIVER VALUE AND KEEP US IN CONTROL

 - Be the go-to commercial partner for Engineering, Product & Research, Infrastructure, IT and Security leaders, brought in at planning stage rather than at signature.

 - Partner with Legal, Security/TPRM, FP&A and Accounting so every deal is compliant, budgeted, properly PO’d and correctly accounted for.

 - Deliver and report measurable value: savings, cost avoidance, improved terms and risk reduction.

 - Maintain audit-ready documentation and controls in line with Cohere’s procurement policy.

 - Use Omnea and AI tooling, including Cohere’s own North, to automate intake, spend analysis and negotiation preparation.

 - Create the playbooks for your categories and grow the team behind them: hire, coach and lead specialists and analysts as the function scales.
   
   


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE:

 - 8+ years of progressive procurement or strategic sourcing experience, with significant time owning technology categories (compute, software, technology licensing, IT and engineering services), ideally in a high-growth technology company.

 - A track record of negotiating complex, high-value, multi-year technology agreements, including enterprise software and technology licensing or OEM deals.

 - A deep understanding of software commercial models (SaaS, usage-based, enterprise license agreements, cloud marketplace and commit structures) and the contract terms that matter in them.

 - Experience sourcing engineering staff augmentation, contingent labour or IT professional services, including SOW and rate management.

 - Technical fluency: you can discuss architecture, usage and roadmap trade-offs with engineers and researchers and earn their trust.

 - Strong analytical skills: TCO and should-cost modelling, spend analysis and clear, data-driven recommendations.

 - The ability to influence without authority and communicate crisply with senior leaders.

 - A builder’s mindset: you’re comfortable creating structure, prioritizing in ambiguity and moving fast without losing control.

 - Experience with procurement and P2P tooling (Omnea and NetSuite a plus).

 - A bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, computer science, finance or a related field, or equivalent experience.




BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

 - Experience sourcing compute or cloud infrastructure: GPU capacity, hyperscaler commitments, data center or colocation.

 - Experience in an AI/ML, cloud or infrastructure company.

 - Experience operating under SOX or comparable internal-control frameworks.

 - Experience contracting across multiple jurisdictions (Canada, US, UK, EU).

 - Experience using AI tools to build and improve procurement workflows.

 - A professional procurement certification (e.g., CIPS, CPSM).




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

jobs.title: Member Support Specialist (West Portal)
jobs.description:

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is building the payment layer for life's financial obligations, giving households one place to see, split, and pay their bills around how they live and get paid. By offering greater choice over how and when payments are made and allowing eligible on time payments to help build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow.

That work brings together people with different perspectives who challenge the status quo and take ownership of solving difficult problems. For you, that means doing the best work of your career next to people who make you better, and together bringing ideas to life that make a real impact for the people we serve.

About the role

Flex is seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Executive Administrator to join our growing executive support function and directly support a pod of senior leaders. This role sits at the center of how Flex's executive team operates — protecting time, enabling focus, and ensuring the coordination that powers our leadership runs smoothly and intentionally.

As Flex scales rapidly, this is not a traditional administrative role. Executive Administrators at Flex are expected to be genuine partners to the leaders they support — understanding priorities, exercising judgment, and operating as part of a coordinated team rather than optimizing in isolation. You'll work closely with the Manager, Executive Administration and peer EAs to ensure cross-executive scheduling reflects org-wide priorities, not just individual availability.

What you’ll do

Calendar Management & Prioritization

• Own end-to-end calendar management for a pod of 2–3 senior executives, including scheduling, rescheduling, and proactive prioritization

• Manage competing demands with judgment — pushing back, protecting focus time, and escalating tradeoffs when appropriate

• Coordinate cross-executive scheduling in partnership with peer EAs, with an org-wide lens on how time is being used

• Maintain meeting hygiene standards: appropriate durations, clear agendas, and timely prep materials

Travel & Logistics

• Book and manage business travel for supported executives, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, and itineraries

• Anticipate logistics needs and proactively solve for complications before they become problems

• Support coordination of leadership offsites, board meetings, and all-hands logistics as needed

Meeting Preparation & Follow-Through

• Prepare briefing materials, agendas, and context documents ahead of key meetings

• Leverage AI transcription and action-tracking tools to capture outputs and ensure follow-through from executive meetings

• Help executives stay on top of commitments and action items that emerge from high-priority meetings

AI-Assisted Workflows

• Use AI scheduling and productivity tools as a core part of your workflow — for calendar analysis, meeting prep, transcription, and logistics research

• Contribute to the team's evolving AI tooling practices by sharing what's working and helping refine approaches over time

Team Coordination & Operations

• Participate in weekly EA team alignment and contribute to a coordinated, high-trust team dynamic

• Partner with the Manager, Executive Administration to flag coordination issues, capacity concerns, or process gaps

• Contribute to playbooks and documentation that help the function scale consistently

Key qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in executive administration, executive support, or a similar role in a fast-paced environment

• Experience directly supporting senior or C-suite executives with complex, high-volume calendars

• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail — you follow through, every time

• Sound judgment and discretion; able to handle sensitive information and navigate ambiguous situations with maturity

• Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work, with a genuine interest in how they can create leverage (scheduling assistants, transcription tools, meeting prep, etc.)

• Collaborative team player who understands that great executive support is a team sport, not a solo act

• Clear, professional communicator — written and verbal — who can represent executives with confidence

• Thrives in a dynamic, high-growth environment where priorities shift and speed matters

Compensation

Flex takes a market-based approach to pay, ensuring compensation is commensurate with a candidate's experience and our internal leveling guidelines. For candidates located in our Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area) markets, the base salary pay range for this role is below. Flex utilizes a geographic pay differential based on a cost of labor index. If you are located outside of the cities listed below, your starting pay will be adjusted to align with the market conditions of your specific geographic zone. Please speak with your recruiter for additional information regarding the specific range for your location.

Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area)

$128,000—$160,000 USD

Life at Flex

Building a successful company takes a diverse team of intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self-aware people. Our headquarters is in New York City, with employees across the US, Australia, Canada, and South America. We’re growing quickly and deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. We value the perspectives our people bring and take pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.

Benefits

View our benefits and more at getflex.com/careers.

jobs.title: SAP System Test Lead
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

The work

As the SAP Automation Lead, you will play a pivotal role in guiding the automation and quality assurance efforts for a major SAP ECC to S/4HANA migration and implementation program for a large Department of Defense client. Your responsibilities will include overseeing the design, development, and deployment of both attended and unattended automation solutions using UiPath, while ensuring seamless integration with UiPath Orchestrator. You will be expected to build and maintain a comprehensive process repository, manage work prioritization, and allocate team capacity to meet strict project timelines. Your leadership will be essential in coordinating test automation activities, driving the development of robust test scripts, and ensuring the successful execution of, integration, and regression testing phases.

Exposure to a variety of automation and testing tools will be highly beneficial in this role. While UiPath is the primary platform, familiarity with alternative automation solutions such as WorkSoft Certify, Tricentis TOSCA, or Automation Anywhere will enable you to adapt to evolving project needs. Experience with SAP S/4HANA deployment, particularly in environments aligned with Department of Defense or Federal Civilian agency requirements, will be crucial. A strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), especially as it pertains to SAP ECC/S4 end-to-end process testing, will help you ensure quality and compliance throughout the migration process. Active Secret Clearance (T3 Investigation) is required, as you will be working with sensitive client data and systems

Key responsibilities:

• Lead design, development, and deployment of UiPath attended and unattended automation solutions

• Oversee integration with UiPath Orchestrator and maintain automation reliability

• Build and maintain a comprehensive automation process repository

• Manage work prioritization, capacity planning, and timeline adherence

• Lead test automation development and execution across system, integration, and regression testing cycles

• Provide leadership across automation and QA teams

• Support SAP ECC/S4 end‑to‑end testing aligned to DoD/Federal requirements

• Integrate or evaluate alternative automation platforms (WorkSoft Certify, Tricentis TOSCA, Automation Anywhere)

• Drive continuous improvement in automation capability and QA effectiveness

• Collaborate closely across functional, technical, and testing teams

Here’s what you need:

• 7+ years of SAP Test Automation experience

• Experience with attended and unattended automation

• SAP S/4HANA deployment experience

• Test script development experience

• Familiarity with SDLC and SAP system/integration/regression testing

• Experience with tools like WorkSoft Certify, Tricentis TOSCA, or Automation Anywhere

Bonus if you have:

• Bachelor's degree in related field

• UiPath expertise, including UiPath Orchestrator

• Experience in SAP ECC to S/4HANA migration/implementation programs

• Proficiency in multiple automation platforms beyond UiPath

Eligibility requirements:

• Active Secret Clearance

• U.S. Citizenship required

jobs.title: Lead Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
BUILD A SAFER WORLD.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

We’re looking for a Senior Recruiting Coordinator to deliver an exceptional candidate and interviewer experience and help lead the day-to-day work of our global coordination team. You’ll own complex interview scheduling, bring deep Ashby expertise, use metrics to improve performance, and mentor fellow coordinators. You’ll also manage the day-to-day work of the AI agents we’re building to support recruiting coordination.

Partnering closely with Talent Operations, you’ll improve how our people, systems, and AI agents work together. This is a hands-on role for someone who communicates proactively, brings solutions, and moves with urgency, with opportunities to grow into people management over time.




THE IMPACT YOU WILL HAVE:

 - Own complex interview scheduling across teams and time zones, delivering a responsive, well-organized experience for candidates and interviewers.

 - Serve as the team’s Ashby expert, resolving scheduling issues, coaching coordinators, and partnering with Talent Operations to improve workflows.

 - Own day-to-day coordination operations and support Talent Operations projects, keeping Ashby records, interview plans, and scheduling data accurate and up to date.

 - Drive coordination performance through accurate reporting on interview volume, time to schedule, SLA adherence, reschedules, and candidate and interviewer feedback.

 - Develop fellow coordinators through onboarding, training, and practical coaching, helping the team manage priorities, workloads, and coverage.

 - Manage AI agents that support recruiting coordination, reviewing their work, resolving exceptions, and improving their accuracy and reliability with Talent Operations.

 - Partner closely with recruiters and the Talent team, aligning on priorities, communicating risks early, and bringing clear recommendations that keep interviews moving.
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 4+ years of recruiting coordination experience, with demonstrated success managing complex, high-volume scheduling in a fast-moving environment.

 - Advanced Ashby expertise is required, including interview plans, interviewer pools, scheduling links, calendar integrations, and independent troubleshooting.

 - Experience supporting Talent Operations or coordination operations, including ATS data quality, workflow maintenance, and process documentation.

 - Strong command of Ashby reporting and coordination metrics, with a track record of translating data into better scheduling outcomes.

 - Experience mentoring coordinators, leading training, and helping teammates use Ashby confidently and effectively.

 - Clear, proactive communication and the ability to build trusted partnerships with candidates, interviewers, recruiters, and Talent Operations.

 - Sound judgment and a strong sense of urgency: you investigate problems, recommend solutions, and follow through without repeated direction.

 - Applied AI fluency, including writing instructions, evaluating outputs, and identifying when human judgment is needed. Experience managing AI agents is a strong plus.


ABOUT THE TEAM:

 - Our talent team is fully remote, embracing async communication and collaboration through Slack channels, thorough documentation, and proactive updates to keep work moving forward smoothly across time zones.

 - We hold weekly RC team syncs to review priorities and solve coordination challenges. Coordinators also participate in hiring syncs for the roles they support, staying close to candidate progress, hiring decisions, and upcoming needs.

 - Driven by a dedication to our craft, we continuously refine our best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for both internal stakeholders and candidates, supported by precise, reliable reporting.


TEAM OPERATING RHYTHMS:

 - Based in the Pacific Time Zone, working 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. PT.

 - As a globally distributed team, we operate across various time zones, yet most of us overlap for collaboration and meetings between 7 a.m.–12 p.m. PT.

 - An active scheduling workload alongside coordination operations, Ashby data maintenance, mentoring, reporting, and AI agent oversight.

 - Advance coverage planning for holidays and absences, with clear owners and next steps.


LEARN ABOUT TRM SPEED IN THIS POSITION:

 - When an interviewer cancels, you promptly identify alternatives, recommend a solution, and confirm the revised plan with the candidate and interview team.

 - When scheduling misses turnaround targets, you use Ashby data to diagnose the issue, recommend a change, and track whether performance improves.

 - When an AI agent sends incomplete instructions, you correct the affected communications and partner with Talent Operations to test a fix.




APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.




INTERVIEWING WITH TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

 - Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

 - Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

 - First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

 - Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

 - References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

 - Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

 - Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.




AI FLUENCY AT TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

 - Accelerate repeatable workflows

 - Structure and solve problems

 - Improve output quality

 - Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.




LIFE AT TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

 - Priorities and targets to change quickly

 - Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

 - A high level of personal ownership and accountability

 - Close collaboration across teams and functions

 - Frequent, high-touch communication

 - Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

 - A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 




LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

 - Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

 - Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

 - Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.





JOIN OUR MISSION

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. 





PRIVACY POLICY AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy https://www.trmlabs.com/policies/privacy-policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc6e8jRCl2cQwgIzXLpIGQXtwvMQh__TcokvO2toAAkT44A6Q/viewform?usp=dialog. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSevmAzPxWOYm_7kMHb9lEJlX3tpdBeHvvvNWjsI_6xhUfnXjw/viewform?usp=dialog.




RECRUITMENT AGENCIES

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

jobs.title: Practice Manager

jobs.title: ADESA Customer Service Representative / Customer Advocate
jobs.description:
IN PERSON HIRING EVENT - Monday, November 23rd.

This event is only open for the ADESA Customer Experience Advocate - Onsite (Tempe, AZ) position only. No interviews will be hosted for other open Carvana roles on this day.

Compensation: Starting at $18/hour; bilingual candidates start at $19/hour

About Us

ADESA, a Carvana-owned company, currently operates over 50 locations throughout the U.S. We remarket hundreds of thousands of vehicles across North America from Dealers, Commercial Lenders, Manufacturers & more. We work in a service industry and embrace a "we" versus "I" culture - help others, and they will help you. Our industry is fun, fast-paced, and competitive, and filled with the best people who are passionate about what they do.

Build a Career with Us

We want team members who aren't afraid to dive in, solve problems, and level up their skills. Because we’re always evolving, there is always room for high performers to step into higher-level roles. Hard work doesn't go unnoticed here—if you drive an impact, you'll find plenty of space to advance.

About the Role & Team

We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Customer Experience Advocate to join the ADESA Central Operations team. This role is crucial for resolving a diverse range of product and service issues, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for our customers (buyers, sellers, transporters, and dealers).

Important Note: We have a similar job posting for Carvana-focused Customer Experience Advocates, but please note that this position is exclusively for the ADESA CX Advocate role, which focuses solely on ADESA's wholesale remarketing operations.

Location & Working Hours

• Location: Join our team of Advocates working in person at our Tempe headquarters!

• Hours: This is a full-time, hourly role with an assigned schedule (typically 38–45 hours per week). Our team supports our customers from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday, which translates to 5 AM to 5 PM or 6 AM to 6 PM AZ time, depending on the time of year.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Create exceptional experiences by handling customer interactions across multiple channels, including calls, chats, and emails.

• Problem-solve with a purpose by resolving a wide range of product or service issues such as title questions, login difficulties, payment concerns, and dealer access problems.

• Clarify and resolve customer concerns efficiently to achieve First Contact Resolution.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues quickly, ensuring accurate logging of interactions in Salesforce and escalating complex backend issues to appropriate technical support or internal departments when necessary.

• Navigate cross-functional issues like a pro by connecting customers with internal departments, including Titles, Dealer Registration, Arbitration, Payments, Technical Support, Financial Operations, IT, and Auction partners.

• Practice active listening to provide personalized support and effectively address unique customer needs.

• Provide feedback on system inefficiencies or common customer pain points to support continuous improvement initiatives.

What You’ll Bring

• High School diploma or equivalent required.

• 1+ year of previous customer service or contact center experience.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with active listening and the ability to provide personalized, empathetic support.

• Strong problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, demonstrating an ownership mentality to solve problems thoroughly.

• Basic technical proficiency, including the ability to utilize multiple screens and quickly learn new systems.

• Flexibility and ability to adapt in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Familiarity with automotive titles, logistics, or dealership operations is a plus.

• Experience in multi-channel customer support (chat, email, phone) or knowledge of ADESA/Carvana systems is a plus.

• Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.

What we’ll offer in return

• Competitive Pay and Quality Benefits

• Holiday and Paid Time Off

• Education and Equipment Reimbursement Programs

• Matching 401(k)

• Career Path Opportunities - High performers unlock incredible advancement paths!

• And More!

Legal Stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. ADESA is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. ADESA also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

jobs.title: Senior Value Engineer
jobs.location: Remote, New York, United States, AMER
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

As a Business Value Engineer at Fivetran, you’ll own value realization across the customer lifecycle, making sure the outcomes we promise are the outcomes customers realize, measure, and renew on. You’ll partner with Customer Solutions, Customer Services, and Sales to drive expansion, strengthen customer loyalty, prevent churn, and prove the impact of Fivetran. You’ll regularly present to customers and executives as a trusted advisor, and you’ll build the tooling that automates value reporting at scale.

This is a high-visibility role at one of the fastest-growing, AI-powered data companies, combining technical depth, analytical rigor, and business-value expertise.

What You’ll Do

• Collaborate with Customer Solutions, Customer Services, and Sales on value realization plans that drive expansion and prevent churn.

• Present value progress and outcomes to customers, including Champions and executives, and align on success criteria.

• Bridge the sales cycle and the customer lifecycle by turning pre-sale business cases and success criteria into measurable outcomes, KPIs, and adoption milestones.

• Help customers realize intended value by understanding gaps between expected and actual results and driving corrective action.

• Build tools and automation that generate customer value reports at scale from usage data.

• Lead business value reviews and renewal and expansion business cases for Champions, Economic Buyers, and executives, including AI-driven outcomes.

• Analyze usage and consumption patterns to surface expansion opportunities, flag at-risk accounts early, and tie spend to quantified value.

• Build value-based GTM motions, including expansion plays and churn-prevention playbooks.

• Enable and support Customer Solutions, Customer Services, and Sales teams, and share frameworks and tools across the practice.

Skills We’re Looking For

• Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, work independently, and bring ambition to building programs from the ground up.

• Are a confident, empathetic communicator who can translate technical capabilities, including AI, into business impact.

• Bring a consulting mindset: structured, curious, analytical, and a strong storyteller.

• Are committed to customer success.

Bonus Skills​

• Business Value experience at a high-growth, AI-forward data company, ideally building a team from the ground up.

• A track record of influencing Business executives and driving measurable outcomes through renewals and expansions.

• Experience quantifying the value of data and AI initiatives.

• Experience building automated value, adoption, or health reporting for customers.

Qualifications

• 6+ years in value engineering, consulting, solutions or sales engineering, post-sales or technical support, or business value roles.

• Comfortable presenting to customers, including executive audiences and Economic Buyers.

• Required: experience with usage-based or consumption-based pricing, including business cases, tracking value against consumption, and supporting expansion and retention.

• Technical background as a consultant or data practitioner, with hands-on SQL and data pipeline, modeling, BI, and AI experience.

• Expert knowledge of value-based selling and value realization, including presenting business cases to Economic Buyers and executives.

• Experience prioritizing use cases and acting as a change agent through a value delivery model.

• Ability to manage multiple workstreams, stay responsive, take on challenging problems, and act decisively amid ambiguity.

This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings.

OTE (On Target Earning)

$197,516.45—$274,329.23 USD

Perks and Benefits

• 100% employer-paid medical insurance*

• Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.

• RSU stock grants*

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities

• Monthly cell phone stipend

• Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here.

We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.

jobs.title: VP, Enterprise Partnerships
jobs.location: Florida, Texas, North Carolina, or Remote
jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking multiple Vice President, Enterprise Partnerships to drive net-new partnerships across key target markets (Central, South, and Midwest), consultatively build and close relationships with health systems, large physician groups, and ACOs participating in Medicare’s Value Based Care programs. This is an opportunity for a highly motivated industry leader to build and execute a strategy that provides scalable success within the region and across the organization.




WHO WE ARE

Pearl Health is dedicated to empowering primary care providers, health systems, and physician-led networks to succeed in the shift to value-based care. Our platform delivers the technology, financial tools, and expert services that enable practices to provide more proactive, effective care to their Medicare patients, ultimately lowering costs and improving health outcomes.

Founded in 2020, we are a team of healthcare and technology innovators backed by premier investors like Andreessen Horowitz, Viking Global Investors, and AlleyCorp. We partner with thousands of providers across 44 states to build a more sustainable future for American healthcare.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

As Vice President, Enterprise Partnerships, you will drive net-new growth for your assigned regional team, reporting to the regional Market President. You will personally own and execute a full cycle acquisition strategy to identify, open and win new partnerships with health systems, large physician groups, ACOs, and IPAs participating in Medicare Value Based Care. To be successful in this role, you will:

 - Own the full deal lifecycle for the region's enterprise accounts (sourcing, deal structuring, pricing proposals, contract negotiation, and closing), partnering with Finance and Operations to ensure timely, strategic closings that meet regional pipeline targets.

 - Build and execute regional enterprise growth strategies, from targeting methodology, funnel development, and relationship development.

 - Serve as Pearl's external evangelist in your designated market, cultivating and owning relationships with prospective enterprise partners and representing Pearl at regional industry events and forums.

 - Partner cross-functionally to surface regional market trends, help shape offerings that meet market demand, build business cases and progress deal stages.

 - Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene and CRM discipline for the region, ensuring the Market President has real-time visibility into deal status, risk, and timing to inform regional forecasting and enterprise KPI tracking.

 - Contribute to regional business strategy and operations, aligning commercial execution with long-term regional market goals.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 10+ years of experience in sales, business development, or commercial leadership roles, with a deep understanding of the healthcare industry and value-based care.

 - An established and active network of contacts across health systems/hospitals, large provider groups, ACOs, and IPAs within the North Carolina, Florida and Texas regions specifically. Candidates must possess established provider relationships within one of these target regions.

 - Proven track record of successfully developing and executing large, complex commercial deals with multiple stakeholders across the full sales cycle.

 - Excellent communication and executive presentation skills; comfortable engaging confidently with C-suite and physician leadership.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to build and defend a data-driven business case.

 - Deep clinical knowledge in quality, outcomes and population health drivers.
   
   


OUR VALUES

🤝 Collaborate to Innovate: We believe the best solutions arise from intelligent teamwork. We trust the expertise of our teammates and pursue opportunities to learn and grow from each other. By embracing diverse perspectives and encouraging authenticity, we create and evangelize groundbreaking health solutions.

🗣️ Trust Through Transparency: We prioritize transparency in all our interactions, ensuring that employees, patients, clinicians and partners have access to the information they need to make informed decisions. Integrity is at the core of how we operate, from building products to fostering relationships, and is crucial to our ability to communicate openly and gain trust.

❤️ Serious Impact, Big Heart: We go above and beyond with our efforts to empower proactive, patient-centered care — and we celebrate every step forward. Humor and positivity fuel our creativity, strengthen relationships, and remind us to acknowledge the journey as much as the destination.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer on a mission to improve lives. Our strength comes from the diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives of our team. We welcome all candidates and are committed to a fair, inclusive hiring process free from discrimination.




WHAT WE OFFER

The expected offer for this role includes the following components:

 - Base Salary Range: $185,000 - $235,000 per year.

 - Additional Compensation: This role is eligible for a discretionary performance bonus and equity options.

 - Benefits: We offer a competitive benefits package. More on our careers page.

Final compensation for this role will be determined by a variety of factors, including a candidate's relevant skills, experience, labor market conditions, and location.




AGENCY SUBMISSIONS

We are not currently working with contingency search firms. If a resume is submitted to any Pearl Health employee by a third party without a valid written and signed search agreement, it will become the property of Pearl Health and no fee will be paid, irrespective of whether the candidate is hired.




THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

While steps may vary by role, you can typically expect:

 1. Recruiter Screen: An intro call to discuss your background and motivations.

 2. Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper-dive conversation with your potential manager.

 3. Panel Interview: A round of meetings with teammates and cross-functional partners.

 4. Case Assignment/Presentation: A practical exercise inviting you to solve a real-world problem or relevant challenge.

 5. Executive Interview: A deeper-dive conversation with the department leader.

 6. CEO Interview: A final conversation with our CEO.

The Moveworks Sr Advisory Solution Consultant- US Public Sector is a technical & business consultant with the advanced ability to develop, position and provide industry and product specific solutions during sales cycles while achieving quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory.

· Partner closely with ServiceNow Account Executives as the Moveworks product, AI, and domain expert, supporting complex sales cycles and driving deal strategy across Fed and/or SLED accounts.

· Lead customer discovery sessions and workshops to understand business challenges, technical environments, and success criteria, aligning Moveworks capabilities to customer needs and outcomes.

· Deliver compelling, persona- and value-based product demonstrations that “explain by showing” how Moveworks and ServiceNow together automate work and improve employee experiences.

· Facilitate technical and architectural workshops covering Moveworks’ AI/ML approach, integrations, security, and platform architecture, in the context of the customer’s ServiceNow environment.

· Partner with Business Value Services to build data-driven business cases, prioritize use cases, and articulate measurable ROI using reports, calculators, and insights.

· Define customer success criteria and lead the design, execution, and management of end-to-end proof-of-concept engagements.

· Develop trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and client partners, guiding strategic programs such as roadmap alignment, customer journey mapping, and outcome planning in top accounts.

· 5+ years of experience in pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering roles supporting enterprise application platforms.

· Experience in enterprise industries such as technology or telecommunications is preferred.

· Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or deep technical experience with other enterprise cloud software solutions.

· Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services teams.

· Strong territory and pipeline management skills, with experience partnering closely with sales counterparts to drive consistent execution.

· Willingness to travel approximately 25% for customer meetings and internal events

jobs.title: People Strategy Lead
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a People Strategy Lead to join our People team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

The Senior Director, People Strategy will develop and implement HR strategies that align with the company's business objectives fostering a high-performing culture, and ensuring effective HR service delivery across all business units. The Sr. Director will lead a team of People Strategy Partners, providing guidance and support to drive talent management, organizational development, and employee engagement initiatives.

You will report into the VP, People Strategy & HR.

Work Location: This position is based in our New York City office, requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week. Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule. #LI-Hybrid

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $218,592 - $286,902 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, company equity grants, and annual performance bonuses.

Responsibilities:

• Partner with executive leadership and cross functional partners to set vision and build toward a best in class future state while serving as a single People strategy point of contact across the Insurance organization.

• Lead initiatives to define our team's key objectives (alongside the business) and create frameworks for team members to set goals that align with those objectives and identify measurable results.

• Drive the talent strategy agenda across multiple lines of business and keep the voice of the employee base in mind.

jobs.title: Director, RWE Solutions
jobs.description:
Director, RWE Solutions

Remote or Boston

About Manifold

Manifold is the AI platform for life sciences, accelerating life-changing medicines to patients. Our products speed up workflows in areas from target identification and clinical development to market access and precision medicine in the clinic, while maintaining the governance life sciences requires. Global companies and premier research institutions use Manifold to operate faster and more effectively. Backed by leading investors including Reach Capital, TQ Ventures, Calibrate Ventures, SilverArc Capital, and Industry Ventures, Manifold serves tens of thousands of users across hundreds of organizations globally.

About Our Customers

Manifold is building the AI-native workspace for the world's biomedical data. Our customers are the companies and institutes that discover and deliver medicines to patients. When their scientists spend a week wrangling data instead of thinking, patients wait. We want to give that week back, at scale, across the industry.

About the Role

The Director RWE Solutions is a critical role on our Solutions team, the scientific and technical layer that turns a customer's research and business problem into value on the Manifold platform, before and after the sale. You will lead conversations with senior stakeholders, such as a pharma VP of HEOR or head of real-world data,  that range from deeply scientific to the business case, own strategic opportunities from discovery through technical win, and stay involved after the sale to drive adoption and expansion. This role is ideal for someone with real-world evidence (RWE) or health outcomes research experience who is equally comfortable in front of a researcher, an executive, and a product team. You will have the autonomy to carry a technical evaluation from first call to signed scope, and your work shortens the path from a research question to evidence that reaches patients. This role reports into our VP Scientific Solutions.

What You'll Do

• Lead discovery with prospects and customers, mapping their science, data, and workflows to the Manifold platform and building champions across research, data, and business teams.

• Design and deliver tailored demos and prototypes anchored on the customer's value question, including connecting relevant data and configuring AI agents that reflect their workflows.

• Be accountable for technical wins on strategic opportunities, including proofs of concept, trials, RFI/RFP responses, and scoping of statements of work.

• Partner with our Sales, Strategic Account Management and Forward Deployed Engineering teams as a trusted scientific advisor, pairing with account executives on deals and supporting them in running effective customer conversations.

• Stay engaged after the sale as a scientific subject-matter expert: support onboarding handoffs and adoption, and spot expansion opportunities across new use cases and teams before the customer raises them.

• Service as Product and Engineering’s first line of field feedback and scientific thought partner. Test new capabilities as an end user, relay customer needs, and help Product and Product Marketing position new features for researchers.

• Contribute to building reusable assets for the team, including playbooks, demo projects, and solution packages, and help the Solutions team scale how it serves customers.

What You'll Bring

• Advanced degree (MS, PhD, MPH, or equivalent experience) in epidemiology, pharmacoepidemiology, outcomes research, biostatistics, data science, or a related scientific field.

• 8+ years of experience in RWE, HEOR, or health data analytics, including hands-on study design and interpretation with claims, EHR, or registry data.

• Experience in a customer-facing role such as solutions, consulting, sales engineering, or commercial science, with the judgment to know what to escalate versus resolve independently .

• A track record of supporting complex deals, including proposals, RFPs, or technical evaluations.

• Excellent communication skills. You can explain complex methods in plain language to technical, scientific, and executive audiences.

• A customer-first mindset with strong listening and diagnostic skills: you quickly identify a customer's real problem and mobilize the right internal resources to solve it.

• Comfort using AI tools and agents, and a willingness to evaluate them critically.

• Self-directed and organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt in a fast-moving team, and travel as needed.

What Helps You Stand Out

• Experience at an RWD/RWE vendor, analytics platform, data provider, or life sciences consultancy.

• Familiarity with pharma HEOR, market access, and clinical development workflows.

• Background in oncology, genomics, or multimodal data.

• Working knowledge of common data models (such as OMOP) and basic SQL, R, or Python.

• Experience coaching or leading small teams, formally or informally.

Why Manifold

• The opportunity to work at the frontier of AI in life sciences, helping the world's leading research and clinical institutions adopt transformative technology.

• A high-autonomy, high-impact role where your work directly leads to positive customer outcomes and company growth.

• Exposure to a wide range of technical and business challenges across oncology, genomics, and clinical data.

• A collaborative team of engineers, scientists, and operators who are building something genuinely important.

• Competitive compensation and equity in a high-growth company backed by leading investors.

Salary Range

The base salary range for this position is $165,000 to $195,000 annually.

• Please note: Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including prior experience and expertise, and may vary from the amount above. This range does not represent additional compensation benefits (such as equity, 401K match or medical, dental or vision insurance).

jobs.title: Vulnerability Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

We are seeking a Vulnerability Security Engineer to join Anduril’s vulnerability management team. There are two
primary responsibilities to this role: To be the technical front door for bug bounty and vulnerability disclosure
reports and to contribute to offensive security engagements across all of Anduril.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will own the intake, technical validation, coordination, and closure of externally reported vulnerabilities. You
will validate and if needed, work directly with researchers and identify the engineering, product, infrastructure, or
operations teams affected by each finding, then provide those teams with the evidence and context needed to
resolve it.

You will also assist senior offensive security engineers throughout offensive security engagements; from scoping
and target research through execution, reporting, remediation guidance, and retesting. As your technical breadth
and judgment grow, you will independently own bounded portions of engagements in your demonstrated areas of
strength.

This role is designed as a development path to Senior Offensive Security Engineer. It is not a vulnerability
management ticket routing position or a reduced scope web testing role. You will be expected to validate attack
paths, build practical prototypes and tooling, communicate with technical credibility, and steadily expand into
unfamiliar target classes.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Triage and coordinate bug bounty and vulnerability disclosure reports, including scope, quality, duplication,

• validity, impact, urgency, ownership, and case status.

• Reproduce reported behavior, adapt or complete proofs of concept where appropriate, establish affected components and conditions, and provide a clear technical basis for disposition and severity.

• Identify affected teams across Anduril, communicate the issue and practical attack path, establish accountable owners, and shepherd remediation across organizational boundaries.

• Retest fixes and mitigations implemented from internal offensive security engagements as well as external contributions.

• Monitor relevant CVE publications, vendor advisories, exploit research, and technical writeups; research applicability to Anduril systems and provide affected teams with concise exposure analysis and recommended

• next actions.

• Assist or shadow senior offensive security engineers on security research, engagement execution, and internal tooling prototypes.

• Independently execute bounded engagement work within demonstrated areas of experience and deliver technically sound findings, reproduction steps, and remediation guidance.

• Build and maintain scripts, proofs of concept, validation harnesses, agent assisted workflows, lab infrastructure, and documentation that make vulnerability response and offensive testing more repeatable.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 3+ years of hands on security testing, penetration testing, vulnerability research, or offensive security experience across two or more of the following:

• Web application penetration testing Cloud penetration testing

• Software or thick client penetration testing

• Firmware analysis

• Familiarity through practical projects, lab work, or assisted engagements across two or more of the following:

• Hardware penetration testing

• Red teaming

• Offensive use of agentic LLM systems

• Reverse engineering

• OT/ICS

• Experience reproducing and validating vulnerabilities, and using scripting, development, or LLMs to automate testing and validation workflows.

• Strong professional communication skills, with the ability to coordinate among researchers and engineering teams without losing technical accuracy or ownership.

• Eligibility to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience triaging bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure submissions and driving reported issues through

• remediation and verified closure.

• Familiarity with CVE, CVSS, CWE, coordinated disclosure, and vulnerability case management workflows.

• Participation in scoped red team, hardware, firmware, reverse engineering, OT/ICS, or AI security

• engagements.

• Public or internally reviewable security research, technical walkthroughs, tools, lab projects, or proofs of

• concept.

• Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar systems, accept technical feedback, and expand from assisted work into independent engagement ownership.

US Salary Range

$114,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.
