jobs.title: Senior Customer Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You’ll Do

The Senior Customer Enablement Manager is responsible for bringing the foundational Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai Customer Academy to life and helping customers realize value from NodeZero faster.

This role will design, build, and continuously improve a customer learning experience that enables customers to confidently use NodeZero across its capabilities, tiers, workflows, and functionality. The focus is practical, technical, and outcome-oriented: customers should not only understand what NodeZero does, but also be able to use it effectively in their own environments.

You will build customer certifications, technical “how-to” modules, guided learning paths, hands-on exercises, and other enablement experiences that accelerate time to value, improve adoption, and create a consistent standard for customer readiness.

This is a highly hands-on role. You will personally create and refine learning content while partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Product Marketing, Attack Research, and other subject-matter experts. The ideal candidate combines strong NodeZero domain knowledge (or the ability to build that knowledge quickly)  with excellent instructional design and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, useful, and impactful customer education.



You will work closely with the Head of Global Enablement and the broader enablement, Customer Success, Product, and technical SME communities across Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai.




CUSTOMER ACADEMY STRATEGY AND ARCHITECTURE

 - Help define and bring to life the foundational Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai Customer Academy.

 - Build a clear curriculum architecture that organizes learning by customer role, use case, capability, product tier, and level of proficiency.

 - Define learning paths that take customers from foundational concepts through advanced NodeZero usage and operational best practices.

 - Establish a scalable framework for customer education that can grow as NodeZero capabilities, products, and customer needs evolve.

 - Partner with Customer Success and Product leadership to prioritize the learning experiences that will have the greatest impact on adoption and time to value.


CUSTOMER CERTIFICATIONS AND READINESS PROGRAMS

 - Design and launch customer certification programs that validate practical ability, not just content completion.

 - Define certification levels, learning requirements, assessments, hands-on activities, and completion criteria.

 - Build certifications that help customers demonstrate proficiency across NodeZero workflows, capabilities, and use cases.

 - Create practical assessments such as knowledge checks, scenario-based exercises, configuration activities, test planning, result interpretation, and reporting workflows.

 - Establish a repeatable approach to maintaining, improving, and expanding certifications as the platform evolves.


TECHNICAL “HOW-TO” CONTENT AND HANDS-ON LEARNING

 - Create clear, practical technical modules that show customers how to use NodeZero effectively.

 - Develop step-by-step learning experiences covering core workflows, configuration, test execution, findings review, reporting, remediation validation, and other relevant platform functionality.

 - Translate complex technical concepts into concise, usable instruction that customers can apply in their own environments.

 - Build a blend of formats, including interactive lessons, demonstrations, walkthroughs, videos, job aids, reference guides, scenario-based exercises, and hands-on labs where appropriate.

 - Ensure content reflects the real customer experience, including prerequisites, expected outcomes, common mistakes, troubleshooting guidance, and indicators of successful execution.


NODEZERO PRODUCT AND DOMAIN ENABLEMENT

 - Develop and maintain deep working knowledge of NodeZero, its capabilities, product tiers, technical workflows, and customer use cases.

 - Become a trusted translator between Product and technical subject-matter experts and the customer learning audience.

 - Stay current on product releases, roadmap changes, technical enhancements, attack research, and evolving customer needs.

 - Convert new functionality and product changes into customer-ready learning experiences in partnership with Product and Customer Success.

 - Help identify gaps where customers need clearer guidance, better workflows, or additional education to achieve meaningful outcomes.


SUBJECT-MATTER EXPERT PARTNERSHIP

 - Build strong working relationships with Product, Engineering, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Attack Research, and other technical SMEs.

 - Create efficient processes for gathering expertise, validating technical accuracy, and turning SME knowledge into structured customer learning.

 - Facilitate content reviews and maintain a high bar for accuracy, clarity, usability, and instructional quality.

 - Make it easy for SMEs to contribute without requiring them to own the entire learning design or content-production process.

 - Establish clear ownership, review cycles, and update processes so customer education stays accurate as the platform evolves.


LEARNING EXPERIENCE DESIGN AND CONTENT PRODUCTION

 - Personally design and produce high-quality customer enablement content for live, virtual, and self-paced learning experiences.

 - Use adult learning principles, instructional design best practices, and customer-centered design to create experiences that change behavior and build confidence.

 - Use tools such as Articulate Rise and other content creation, screen recording, video, assessment, and learning management platforms to produce engaging learning experiences.

 - Build reusable templates and standards for lessons, modules, assessments, facilitator guides, labs, and certification materials.

 - Continuously improve content based on customer feedback, learner performance, product changes, and adoption data.


MEASUREMENT, ADOPTION, AND CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

 - Define and track measures of customer readiness, engagement, certification, adoption, and time to value.

 - Use completion data, assessment results, customer feedback, support themes, and Customer Success insights to identify learning gaps and improvement opportunities.

 - Partner with Customer Success and Operations to understand whether academy participation and certification correlate with stronger adoption and customer outcomes.

 - Maintain a clear roadmap for new courses, certifications, updates, and retired content.

 - Share progress, risks, and impact with enablement and cross-functional leadership.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE


FIRST 30 DAYS: LEARN, ALIGN, AND PRIORITIZE

 - Build a strong working understanding of NodeZero, its capabilities, product tiers, technical workflows, customer use cases, and current adoption challenges.

 - Meet with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Sales Engineering, Product Marketing, Attack Research, Support, and other key SMEs to understand customer needs and available expertise.

 - Review existing product documentation, training, certification, and product resources to identify gaps, duplication, and quick wins.

 - Define the initial Customer Academy audience, priority personas, core learning paths, and the highest-value use cases to enable first.

 - Produce a prioritized Academy roadmap with clear near-term deliverables, owners, dependencies, and launch criteria.


BY 60 DAYS: BUILD, VALIDATE, AND LAUNCH EARLY WINS

 - Establish the Academy structure, content standards, course templates, certification framework, and SME contribution process.

 - Build and release an initial set of practical technical “how-to” modules for high-priority NodeZero workflows.

 - Develop the outline and requirements for the first customer certification, including proficiency standards, learning objectives, practical exercises, and assessment criteria.

 - Create at least one pilot learning path or certification experience and validate it with internal technical SMEs and a small set of customer-facing stakeholders or customers.

 - Establish a regular review cadence with Product, Customer Success, and technical SMEs to keep content accurate and moving toward launch.


BY 90 DAYS: SHIP THE FOUNDATION AND ESTABLISH THE OPERATING RHYTHM

 - Launch the first production-ready Customer Academy learning path and initial technical modules.

 - Launch or pilot the first customer certification with clear completion requirements and a defined feedback loop.

 - Publish a maintainable curriculum map covering priority NodeZero capabilities, tiers, workflows, and use cases, with identified gaps and sequencing.

 - Establish the Academy operating rhythm, including intake, prioritization, content production, technical review, release updates, learner feedback, and content maintenance.

 - Define initial success measures for enrollment, completion, certification, learner confidence, adoption, and time to value.

 - Present a clear first-year roadmap and progress readout to enablement, Customer Success, Product, and executive stakeholders.


FIRST-YEAR OUTCOMES

 - The foundational Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai Customer Academy is live with a clear structure, audience strategy, learning paths, and an actively managed roadmap.

 - Multiple customer certifications and practical technical learning paths are live, covering priority NodeZero workflows, capabilities, tiers, and use cases.

 - Customers can use the Academy to build demonstrable proficiency in NodeZero, not simply consume product information.

 - Customer Success and other customer-facing teams actively use Academy content in onboarding, adoption, and value-realization motions.

 - Product and technical SMEs have a repeatable contribution and review process that supports speed without sacrificing technical accuracy.

 - Academy engagement, completion, certification, learner feedback, and adoption data are being used to improve content and prioritize future development.

 - The Academy is recognized as a practical path to customer readiness and faster time to value, with a clear connection to successful NodeZero adoption.
   
   


WHO YOU ARE

 - You are a hands-on customer enablement builder who enjoys creating the content as well as designing the strategy behind it.

 - You can understand complex technical products and turn them into clear, practical, and engaging learning experiences.

 - You are comfortable working directly with technical products, workflows, demonstrations, and customer use cases.

 - You have strong instructional design instincts and know how to make learning useful for busy technical practitioners.

 - You are confident partnering with SMEs, asking good questions, challenging unclear explanations, and bringing structure to expert knowledge.

 - You are highly organized and able to manage multiple content workstreams while maintaining quality and consistency.

 - You are curious, collaborative, detail-oriented, and motivated by helping customers become successful and self-sufficient.

 - You care about measurable outcomes such as readiness, adoption, proficiency, and time to value.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in customer enablement, technical enablement, instructional design, customer education, learning experience design, or a related field.

 - Demonstrated experience building technical customer education, certifications, academies, onboarding programs, or product training.

 - Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical, and outcome-oriented learning content.

 - Hands-on experience creating digital learning content using tools such as Articulate Rise or comparable authoring platforms.

 - Experience designing assessments, knowledge checks, practical exercises, or certification programs.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with technical SMEs and customer-facing teams.

 - Strong project management skills and the ability to manage content development from intake through launch and iteration.



What Sets You Apart?

 - Direct experience with NodeZero, autonomous penetration testing, offensive security, exposure management, vulnerability management, cloud security, identity security, or adjacent cybersecurity domains.

 - Experience enabling security, IT, infrastructure, DevOps, or technical practitioner audiences.

 - Experience building a customer academy or education program from the ground up.

 - Experience creating hands-on labs, technical demonstrations, interactive simulations, or scenario-based learning.

 - Familiarity with learning management systems, video and screen-recording tools, assessment platforms, and customer education analytics.

 - Experience working closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales Engineering in a high-growth B2B SaaS or cybersecurity company.

 - Experience working with enterprise customers and translating their questions, friction points, and success patterns into better education.




TRAVEL REQUIRED

This role may be remote in the regions where Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai operates. Moderate travel may be required for customer meetings, enablement events, internal planning sessions, and company gatherings. 



Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range: $142,000 - $180,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.



Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 



Application Note

jobs.description:
ABOUT BLANK STREET

At Blank Street, we’re on a mission to become the defining food and beverage brand of our generation. From the very beginning, we’ve set out to add a spark to ordinary experiences through elevated products, attention-to-detail, and a commitment to making every moment memorable. We’re motivated by the millions of customers we serve across cities, and know that our potential is unlimited. It all starts with our people and their commitment to make magic happen each and every day.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Shift Lead, you’ll play a key role in bringing our mission to life. You’ll lead by example on the floor, ensure smooth operations during your shift, and create an environment where both customers and Baristas feel valued. This is a hands-on leadership role where you will work closely with your manager to set the store and team up for success. You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy fast-paced environments, connecting with people, motivating your team, and delivering great hospitality.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

1. Be our Ultimate Product Master

• Explain our menu: Talk customers through our classics, signatures and limited-time drinks and guide them to the right one. That means you are required to showcase product knowledge at all times.

• Set the bar for every drink: Serve drinks perfectly to our recipe and preparation standards. That means you are a role model to your peers on the floor.

• Coach your peers: Coach Baristas on recipes, technique and the latte art heart behind the bar, so every drink on your shift hits the standard.

2. Run the Shift

• Open and close the store: Open and close the store on your own (including required checklists and procedures), and run the store whenever your GM is not in.

• Prepare the shift: Batch ingredients (matcha and syrups), stock required quantities (milk, ice and front of house storage), and keep the counter clutter-free before every shift.

• Keep the line moving at peak: Run the shift plan your GM sets, spot bottlenecks before they build, and work around any issues and stockouts in the moment. That means you own speed of service on your shift.

• Manage inventory and waste on your shift: Receive and organize stock, support your GM on ordering and counts (and own them in your GM’s absence), and keep waste down by batching to demand (e.g., no large matcha batch an hour before close).

3. Lead the Customer Experience

• Set the tone on the floor: Greet every customer, serve every order with a personal touch, and keep service warm through every peak, so the team follows your lead.

• Resolve customer issues: Handle customer issues on the spot with care, and escalate to your GM as needed.

4. Keep the Store Sharp

• Hold the standards on shift: Walk the floor and back of house against the cleanliness and presentation standards your GM sets, and fix anything that slips, including giving your peers feedback in the moment.

• Run daily checks & troubleshoot: Complete safety and cleaning checklists every shift, troubleshoot equipment where required, and escalate unresolved issues to your GM.

5. Lift your Team

• Train new hires: Execute the onboarding plan set by your GM and train new hires on a day-to-day at every station during your shift.

• Be a support pillar: Bring positive energy and teamwork mentality to every shift, actively support your peers (including in the moment feedback), and serve as the go-to point of contact when your GM is away.

WHO YOU ARE

• Your Experience: At least 1 year of experience in a customer service leadership position (e.g. Shift Leader, Shift Supervisor, Key Holder), preferably in hospitality, coffee, or beverage

• Your Skills: People leader: You confidently guide and motivate your team, set a high standard through your own actions, and step in to support others when needed. Passionate about hospitality: You love creating exceptional customer and employee experiences, and care about setting the bar high in every shift you’ve run. Team player: You are comfortable working in a team, communicate clearly, support the people around you, and contribute to a positive team environment. Reliable in a fast-paced environment: You are able to stay calm, focused, and effectively manage time and priorities, including during busy rush periods where a sense of urgency is necessary. Detail-oriented: You notice the small things and take pride in maintaining highest standards across presentation, compliance, and cleanliness. Eager to learn: You are curious, adaptable and always willing to learn about our products and operating procedures.

REQUIREMENTS

• 18+ years of age

• Able to lift 25+ lbs, and to stand for long periods of time

• You must be authorized to work in the U.S.: upon acceptance of a job offer and completion of the Form I-9 with acceptable documents, Blank Street will provide the federal government with employees’ Form I-9 information to confirm authorization to work in the U.S. (a process known as ”E-Verify”)

• Availability that meets the needs of our stores Full Time: 30-40 hours per week, 4-5 days per week and must be able to work 2 peak days (peak days: Friday, Saturday, Sunday) Weekend and holiday availability required

BENEFITS & PERKS

• $21.00/hour plus tips

• A comprehensive Barista accreditation and training program

• Tenure based paid time off

• Commuter benefits

• Sick time

• 1.5x pay on select holidays

• Complimentary coffee and treats on shift

• Free Blank Street swag

Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

Lead Store Associate

Type of Work: Full-Time
Shift Availability: The candidate must have open availability on weekdays, evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Starting Hourly Pay Rate: $17.50/hr
Location: 6600 International Dr, Orlando, FL 32819

About the Role:

As a Lead Store Associate, you'll be at the forefront of delivering exceptional experiences to our customers while guiding and inspiring your team. As a key player in our retail operations, you'll serve as a brand ambassador, drive performance, and help shape a welcoming, compliant, and high-performing retail store environment.

What You’ll Do:

Customer Experience & People

• Lead by example to create a warm, welcoming environment where every guest feels valued, and coach your team to deliver exceptional service with every interaction.

• Empower associates to build meaningful customer relationships through personalized product recommendations and expert guidance.

• Drive consultative selling on the floor by encouraging open-ended questions, active listening, and thoughtful product education.

• Support your team in resolving customer concerns with empathy and professionalism, ensuring every challenge becomes an opportunity to build trust.

Operational Excellence & Processes

• Execute opening and closing duties, including daily huddles and cash reconciliation.

• Lead inventory counts and participate in overnight audits.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and guest-ready store environment.

• Uphold compliance with SOPs, safety protocols, and state regulations.

Sales & Performance

• Achieve daily KPI goals through consultative selling and upselling strategies.

• Reinforce customer purchase decisions and highlight complementary products.

• Stay informed on promotions and product updates to deliver a seamless shopping experience.

Leadership & Team Development

• Guide and support store associates in daily operations.

• Lead by example in customer service and operational excellence.

• Train new hires and conduct ongoing training sessions.

• Provide real-time coaching and feedback to drive team performance.

• Delegate tasks effectively and act as the go-to leader in the absence of store management.

• Support conflict resolution and promote a positive workplace culture.

• Adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment and take on additional duties as needed.

What You’ll Bring:

• Must be 21 years of age or older.

• High School Diploma or General Educational Development (GED) certificate.

• A minimum of 1 year of experience in a customer-facing or sales environment.

• A minimum of 1 year of experience using point-of-sale (POS) systems and cash handling.

• A minimum of 6 months of leadership experience in a retail environment.

• Minimum of 6 months of hands-on experience in retail store operations, including but not limited to executing opening and closing procedures, and reconciling cash drawers.

• Curaleaf Team Members need a minimum of 6 months of experience as a Store Associate demonstrating consistent performance.

• Strong leadership and team-building skills with the ability to coach and motivate others.

• Familiarity with retail standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety protocols, and loss prevention practices

• High level of attention to detail, especially in cash handling and inventory management.

• Excellent customer service and interpersonal communication skills.

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a high-volume, compliance-driven setting.

• Availability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and occasional overnights.

• Multi-tasking with the ability to quickly pivot to other tasks

• Comfortable using technology and learning new tools to support operations and customer interactions.

• Strong time management and organizational skills.

• Strong de-escalation skills and the ability to redirect upset customers to result in a positive guest experience.

• Basic proficiency in mathematics and computer applications.

• The ability to maintain a solution-driven mindset when dealing with upset customers.

• Strong conflict resolution skills and the ability to handle high-stress situations.

• Ability to support store leadership by taking initiative and a proactive approach

• Ability to work across all stations within the store, based on business needs.

Even Better If You Have:

• Previous knowledge of inventory management, systematic restocking of merchandise, fulfillment of online and in-store orders, and conducting daily inventory counts and comprehensive inventory audits to maintain stock accuracy and compliance.

• Background in a sales role with a focus on tracking KPIs and meeting sales targets.

• Previous experience within a regulated retail setting.

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to stand for extended periods, regularly stand, walk, talk, or hear, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, use hands and fingers to feel, reach with hands and arms, and lift up to 25 pounds. The employee is occasionally required to climb, balance, and lift up to 50 pounds.  This position requires close vision (clear vision at 20 inches or less).

Work Environment:

This position has allergen warnings, including potential exposure to dust, pollen, and plant pathogens, and requires the ability to work in confined spaces, possess high stress tolerance, adaptability, and flexibility to work in an ever-changing environment.

Curaleaf Pay Transparency

$17.50—$19.25 USD

What We Offer:

• Career Growth Opportunities

• Competitive Pay and Benefits

• Generous PTO and Parental Leave

• 401(K) Retirement Plan

• Life/ Disability Insurance

• Community Involvement

• Referral Bonuses and Product Discounts

Benefits vary by state, role type, and eligibility.

Instagram: @curaleaf.usa
Twitter: @Curaleaf_Inc
LinkedIn: Curaleaf LinkedIn

jobs.title: General Superintendent
jobs.description:
At Nox Group, we are dedicated to humanizing construction as one of the fastest-growing industrial enterprises in the US. Nox Group owns and operates Corbins, RMCI, Nox Innovations, and Construction Labels, and our teams set the standard as industry leaders. As we continue to expand our reach nationwide, we seek people who are passionate about personal growth and eager to make a positive impact throughout the industries and communities we serve. We prioritize our people, our partners, and our relationships. Start your journey today and join our skilled team.

We are currently seeking a Medium Voltage General Superintendent to support the construction of some the most challenging and exciting projects in the Southwest, including commercial, industrial, mission-critical and water/wastewater treatment facilities.

Responsibilities

• Leads execution of medium voltage (5kV–35kV) electrical systems including planning, installation, testing, commissioning, and energization.

• Oversee high-risk switching activities and energization plans, ensuring all work is executed safely, in compliance with NFPA 70E, LOTO procedures, and project-specific safety protocols.

• Coordinates closely with utilities, commissioning agents, and clients to successfully bring MV systems online safely and on schedule.

• Ability to manage several complex projects, simultaneously, or a large construction program with a high degree of effectiveness and accountability.

• Has overall responsibility for project team success, including alignment with Corbins’ culture and Core Values, in addition to project safety, quality, schedule, client satisfaction and profitability.

• Ensures all Project Superintendent responsibilities are properly managed and executed.

• Establishes and maintains professional working relationships with owners, engineers, architects, and trade partners.

• Mentors and develops Project Superintendents, Field Superintendents and Foremen for future leadership roles.

• Ensures corporate safety and quality plans are aligned with project-specific requirements and are implemented throughout the duration of the project.

• Responsible for the quality of all site production while working closely with the QA/QC department to ensure the project QA/QC execution plan is being followed.

• Partners closely with VP of Ops and/or Project Executives to ensure labor projections are accurate and the project is adhering to the schedule.

• Leads the development of comprehensive project plans, incorporating all requirements, constraints, and opportunities.

• Builds rapport with each customer by displaying integrity, honesty and transparency while mitigating risks and upholding contracts.

• Familiar with Lean Construction philosophies and implements them into the project.

• Ensures the project site is kept clean and all working conditions are safe.

• Continually reviews processes and procedures, providing input when necessary to further refine and improve efficiencies.

Qualifications

• 10+ years delivering medium voltage (5kV–35kV) electrical construction projects.

• Proven ability to lead multiple crews, foremen, and large field teams on complex electrical scopes.

• Demonstrated track record of bringing complex MV systems online safely and on schedule.

• History of long-term tenure with previous employers and commitment to seeing major projects through completion.

• Strong understanding of medium voltage distribution systems including switchgear, transformers, and cable systems.

• Ability to read and interpret one-line diagrams, protection schemes, and construction drawings.

• Experience with medium voltage cable installations, terminations, splicing, and testing methods (hi-pot, megger, etc.).

• Experience with MV testing, commissioning, and energization planning.

• Proven ability to manage high-risk switching procedures and coordinate energization activities.

• Builds stable, high-performing field teams capable of executing complex MV scopes.

• Demonstrated leadership of a zero-incident safety culture.

• Deep knowledge of NFPA 70E, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and high-energy electrical hazards.

• Proven ability to enforce safety standards and lead teams through high-risk electrical operations.

• Ability to assume responsibility, interface and effectively communicate with others.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)

• Proficiency with Primavera P6 scheduling software.

• Positive and teachable attitude.

• Possesses excellent organizational, verbal, written and presentation skills.

• Extensive experience leading project teams and successfully achieving project goals.

Education & Certifications

• OSHA 30 Certification

Safety Level

This is a safety sensitive position, and all applicable policies including drug test and background check will apply.

• The inherent responsibilities of your role may include physical working conditions. In order to safely and successfully perform job duties you must be able to: Potentially lift up to 50 pounds Potentially need to do repeated pushing, pulling, carrying, reaching (or working above shoulder), walking, standing, sitting, stooping, kneeling, bending, and climbing Potentially operate a motor vehicle, crane, tractor, etc.

• We reserve the right to continually monitor your ability to safely and successfully complete these inherent physical responsibilities and take action as deemed appropriate in accordance with the Americans with Disability Act (ADA)

jobs.title: Sr. Mechanical Commissioning Manager (Power Plant)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. COMMISSIONING MANAGER (POWER PLANT)

SpaceX is building and operating large-scale power generation for launch and compute. This role leads commissioning of the power plant: gas and steam turbines, heat recovery steam generator (HRSG), balance of plant, electrical, and controls, from mechanical completion to reliable operation. This is not a desk job. You will be in the control room during startup and in the field troubleshooting.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Build and run the commissioning plan: system turnover, pre-commissioning, first fire, synchronization, performance test, and reliability run

• Own the commissioning schedule, budget, and staffing plan

• Lead the commissioning team and the OEM field crews

• Accept a system from construction only with a complete mechanical completion package

• Start up aeroderivative and simple-cycle units; where an HRSG is in scope, run chemical cleaning and steam or air blows before the steam turbine takes steam

• Own procedures, punchlists, deficiency tracking, and the decision that a system is ready

• Close punch by category, commercial deficiencies included, before commercial operation

• Own LOTO, permit-to-work, and energization authority from first backfeed through commercial operation

• Commission controls and protection with the electrical and automation team

• Run guarantee and performance tests against the contract and carry the reliability run through commercial operation

• Hand operations a plant that starts, trips, and recovers as designed

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline

• 5+ years of experience commissioning utility-scale power plants, including gas turbines, in the field

• Experience leading commissioning on a utility-scale or multi-unit plant, not only single-skid support

• Experience writing or owning startup procedures

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 10+ years of experience commissioning utility-scale power plants, including gas turbines, in the field

• Experience as an OEM commissioning lead (GE Vernova, Siemens Energy, Mitsubishi Power, Solar Turbines, Baker Hughes, or equivalent)

• Direct startup experience with H- or F-class and/or aeroderivative gas turbines (LM2500 / LM6000 class or equivalent)

• Experience with DCS/turbine control platforms (Mark VIe, SPPA-T3000, or equivalent)

• Experience with Mitsubishi DIASYS Netmation or Emerson Ovation DCS

• Experience with HRSG and steam turbine integration and performance testing

• Familiarity with ASME PTC 22 (gas turbine) or PTC 46 (overall plant) performance test codes

jobs.title: EMIS/ CTE Specialist
jobs.description:
About ACCEL Schools

ACCEL Schools is a growing network of 100 charter schools employing a diverse staff of passionate professionals who value research-based practices and desire to grow professionally. Due to our expanding Career Tech Education (CTE) and central state reporting programs across our schools, we are seeking a dedicated Education Management Information Systems (EMIS) / CTE Specialist to join our remote state reporting team.

Job Summary

The EMIS / CTE Specialist is responsible for accurately capturing, mapping, and reporting Career Tech Education and district-wide student data. This role ensures compliant data extraction, file preparation, and submission to the Ohio Department of Education and Workforce (ODEW). The specialist actively troubleshoots Level 1 and Level 2 errors, coordinates with school-level end-users, manages state compliance programs, and maintains critical staff data systems. This position is Remote and Ohio Residence is Required.

Key Responsibilities

• Data Submissions & Validation: Extract district data from various source systems, prepare files, and upload them into the Data Collector for compliant EMIS processing and timely submission to ODEW under strict state deadlines.

• CTE Course Mapping & Data Entry: Record CTE classes for each school onto Smartsheet, determine necessary course mapping, and adjust course sections within the state reporting area as required.

• Special Student Populations: Enter, update, and manage student data related to special education, Limited English Proficiency (LEP), and gifted programs within the Student Information System (SIS).

• Error Resolution & Systems Audit: Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve Level 1 and Level 2 submission errors. Work within the Ohio District Data Exchange (ODDEX) to resolve flags and errors.

• Federal & State Reporting Programs: Complete Civil Rights Data Collection (CRDC) reporting and Federal Low Income Count System (FLICS) reporting.

• School & Team Collaboration: Communicate submission errors and systemic problems directly to the CTE Department and school end-users, guiding and assisting local staff to correct data at the source.

• Records & Documentation: Maintain history records for Effective Date Records (including the Disadvantagement field), organize Level 2 Reports to SharePoint, and author clear, user-friendly EMIS documentation for district end-users.

• Staff Data Maintenance: Maintain and update staff data for compliance reporting within the Uniform School Payroll System (USPS).

• Continuous Compliance: Maintain deep, up-to-date knowledge of Ohio state reporting requirements by attending ODEW professional development sessions and participating in all monthly EMIS team meetings.

Qualifications

• Education: High School diploma or equivalent required.

• Residency: Must be a current resident of the State of Ohio.

• Experience: Minimum of three (3) years of prior EMIS data reporting experience required.

• Specialized Knowledge: Direct experience with CTE Reporting (including specific coding and state requirements), proficiency with ODDEX, and a comprehensive understanding of general EMIS compliance (student, staff, course, calendar, testing, and financial data).

• Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in data entry and MS Office (specifically Excel and Word). Demonstrated competency with education software and tools (e.g., PowerSchool, Salesforce, USPS, Data Collector, Cross Check, Smartsheet, and SharePoint). Experience using help desk ticketing systems is preferred.

• Professional Skills: Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with a team; strong prioritization skills to execute tasks under pressure and meet rigid state deadlines.

• Communication: High-quality written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to manage and protect confidential student and employee information.

• Background Screening: Successful completion of state and federal criminal background checks.

Compensation and Benefits: The compensation and benefits information below is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

The annual starting salary for this position is $65,000 - $70,000. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

We offer the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, life insurance, long-term disability insurance, short-term disability insurance, 10 paid holidays annually.

Paid Time Off: Paid Time Off to cover sick, vacation, and personal absences.

We offer several plans to choose from, with a wide range of deductibles and co- insurance levels. We offer plans with set co-pays for certain medical services, as well as a high deductible plan with set co-insurance levels after deductibles have been met. All plans offer both in-network and out-of-network coverage. We also offer flexible spending and health savings accounts.

jobs.title: Sr. Electrical Commissioning Manager (Power Plant)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. COMMISSIONING MANAGER (POWER PLANT)

SpaceX is building and operating large-scale power generation for launch and compute. This role leads commissioning of the power plant: gas and steam turbines, heat recovery steam generator (HRSG), balance of plant, electrical, and controls, from mechanical completion to reliable operation. This is not a desk job. You will be in the control room during startup and in the field troubleshooting.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Build and run the commissioning plan: system turnover, pre-commissioning, first fire, synchronization, performance test, and reliability run

• Own the commissioning schedule, budget, and staffing plan

• Lead the commissioning team and the OEM field crews

• Accept a system from construction only with a complete mechanical completion package

• Start up aeroderivative and simple-cycle units; where an HRSG is in scope, run chemical cleaning and steam or air blows before the steam turbine takes steam

• Own procedures, punchlists, deficiency tracking, and the decision that a system is ready

• Close punch by category, commercial deficiencies included, before commercial operation

• Own LOTO, permit-to-work, and energization authority from first backfeed through commercial operation

• Commission controls and protection with the electrical and automation team

• Run guarantee and performance tests against the contract and carry the reliability run through commercial operation

• Hand operations a plant that starts, trips, and recovers as designed

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline

• 5+ years of experience commissioning utility-scale power plants, including gas turbines, in the field

• Experience leading commissioning on a utility-scale or multi-unit plant, not only single-skid support

• Experience writing or owning startup procedures

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 10+ years of experience commissioning utility-scale power plants, including gas turbines, in the field

• Experience as an OEM commissioning lead (GE Vernova, Siemens Energy, Mitsubishi Power, Solar Turbines, Baker Hughes, or equivalent)

• Direct startup experience with H- or F-class and/or aeroderivative gas turbines (LM2500 / LM6000 class or equivalent)

• Experience with DCS/turbine control platforms (Mark VIe, SPPA-T3000, or equivalent)

• Experience with Mitsubishi DIASYS Netmation or Emerson Ovation DCS

• Experience with HRSG and steam turbine integration and performance testing

• Familiarity with ASME PTC 22 (gas turbine) or PTC 46 (overall plant) performance test codes

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be available to work on site during startups, including nights and weekends

• Ability to work around energized equipment and live construction

• Ability to work 10–12 hour shifts outdoors in heat and high noise during startup

jobs.title: Senior Outside Plant Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
At gFiber, we believe that great internet has the power to drive innovation, strengthen communities, enable the impossible, and do all the everyday things that make all of our world go round. And the job of creating better internet is never done - so we’re growing! Our team is committed to building a place where people who want to make a difference can grow their careers and find their spot to belong.

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

The application window will be open until at least November 22nd, 2026. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.

Area Description:

The Field Operations team is responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of residential and small business services. Within gFiber’s Field Operations, the Plant Maintenance team supports wired and wireless customer installation and network construction leading to the growing and maintaining of gFiber networks.

Role Description:

As a Senior Outside Plant (OSP) Maintenance Technician, you will focus on the installation, repair, and maintenance of the gFiber physical plant in the Distribution Network. You will diagnose and correct all service impacting root causes from the central office, remote terminal, or hut location to the customer’s premise equipment. You will assist vendor partners to develop expertise in the installation, maintenance, and repair of outside plant (OSP) while continuing to provide coverage for downstream portions of our network infrastructure.

In this role, you'll:

Technical Expertise:

• Network Troubleshooting:

• Ensure continuous residential and small business services by identifying and resolving service-disrupting issues spanning from the central office to customer premise equipment within the gFiber network.

• Diagnose and correct issues with outside plant (OSP) network connectivity, including drop cabling, network interface units, patch panels, media cabinets, and Optical Network Terminals (ONTs).

• Troubleshoot and resolve problems related to inside wiring (fiber, ethernet, coaxial, and twisted pair cabling), powering systems (including backup power, UPS, etc.), and network devices (media gateways, modems, routers, switches).

• Network Infrastructure:

• Install, restore, or maintain aerial and underground cable plant.

• Install and test Ethernet jacks, make cross connects in telecom spaces, and perform installation/construction duties, maintenance, and troubleshooting of cabling and network devices.

Customer Service:

• Navigate complex customer interactions with exceptional client service, professionalism, and thoroughness.

• Communicate effectively with internal colleagues and external customers.

• Cultivate relationships with property managers and building owners through advanced technical knowledge, effective communication, and collaboration.

Teamwork and Leadership:

• Execute operational processes and procedures with attention to detail.

• Foster a culture of continuous learning by collaborating with team members to achieve proficiency in troubleshooting complex issues affecting network connectivity and inside wiring.

Additional Responsibilities:

• Ability to work non-standard working hours, including nights, weekends, holidays, and varying shifts, and be willing to travel domestically up to 10% of the time.

At a minimum we’d like you to have:

• 5 years experience in Fiber to the Home (FTTH)/ Gigabit Passive Optical Network (GPON) network construction and/or fiber network deployments.

• 3 years of experience in fiber splicing for both termination and midspan use cases, optical time-domain reflectometer (OTDR) and Power Meter fiber optic testing.

• 3 years of experience managing relationships with contractors and vendors of varying types and sizes.

• Experience with physical layer components of networking infrastructure, including twisted pair copper cabling (Category 5 or greater), 66 blocks, 110 blocks, patch panels, fiber optic cabling, etc.

• Valid driver's license.

• Ability to lift/move up to 50lbs of equipment as required.

• Ability to pass a motor vehicle record check that meets company standards.

• Ability to work non-standard working hours as needed including nights, weekends, holidays, and differing work rotations/shifts as well as 10% domestic travel.

It’s preferred if you have:

• Experience interfacing with local pole owners and utility companies, coordinating with city/local permitting offices, and subject matter expertise in outside plant Fiber to the Home (OSP FTTH) deployments with experience in service drop installations.

• 3 years of experience with fiber to the business-to-business (B2B)/Enterprise level fiber network construction/operations.

• Experience troubleshooting Ethernet network issues related to routers, switches and hubs.

• Experience with rack and stack work, assembling server stanchions, telemetry closet work (MPOE, DMARC, etc.), and patch panels.

• Ability to safely operate bucket vehicles that elevate up to 25 feet above ground.

• Ability to operate Google Workspace and Salesforce applications.

jobs.description:
Join Cortica as a School Behavior Technician

Empower students. Support families. Advance the standard of neurodevelopmental care.

Cortica is seeking a dedicated and compassionate School Behavior Technician (SBT) to provide 1:1 behavior support to students with autism and other neurodevelopmental differences in school settings. You’ll work closely with educators, caregivers, and Cortica’s clinical team to help students succeed across their school day.

Cortica was founded to fix the fragmented journey families often face when seeking therapies for their children. By blending neurology, research-based therapies, and technology into one cohesive care model, we deliver life-changing neurodevelopmental care—one child, one family, one community at a time.

As part of this mission, we proudly partner with local schools to provide ABA therapy in educational settings. This extension of our care reflects our commitment to supporting children not only in clinics and homes, but also in the environments where they learn and grow.

Schedule & Availability
This position follows a consistent Monday–Friday schedule, with required availability from 7:30 AM to 3:45 PM. While actual working hours vary based on student needs, you’ll receive a minimum of 4 hours of paid work per day when you remain available and accept assignments.

At times when you are not yet assigned to a designated client, you may follow an administrative schedule from 7:30 AM to 11:30 AM. During this window, you’ll stay engaged with administrative tasks from home and be ready to step into a school session if one becomes available.

School-Based Role
This role follows the school’s academic calendar and includes unpaid breaks during periods such as Winter Break, Spring Break, and Summer. During the school year, you’ll play a vital role in supporting student success within their educational environments.

What will you do?

• Provide direct implementation of holistic, neurodiversity-affirming behavior analytic services to students in one-on-one and group settings within schools.

• Implement individualized behavior intervention plans (BIPs) and skill acquisition programs, aligning with the student’s IEP and school goals.

• Work closely with school teams to integrate behavioral strategies into the daily classroom routine and support students’ engagement and learning.

• Support student development in communication, social skills, self-regulation, and self-care (e.g., toileting, hygiene, dressing) as appropriate to the school context.

• Utilize a strengths-based treatment approach developed in collaboration with the educational team.

• Collect data consistently on student progress and behaviors during each session and complete timely documentation, including session notes and incident reports.

• Participate in classroom observations, team meetings, and school-based training sessions as assigned.

• Implement proactive behavior support strategies and follow school safety and crisis protocols, including de-escalation and mandated reporting procedures.

• Travel between assigned work sites, as needed, within the designated service area.

• Other duties as assigned.

We’d love to hear from you if:

• You have at least one year of work experience in ABA / Behavior Technician roles

• You hold a high school diploma or equivalent.

• You can maintain reliable transportation and must be able to travel between work locations.

• You have a first aid/CPR certification or ability to obtain.

Your Compensation & Benefits

Cortica cares deeply about the well-being of each member of our team, and we have created a passionate, caring, and growth-minded culture that helps teammates to thrive! jobs.title: 3D Digital Manufacturing Technician
jobs.description:
Do you want to change how the world creates?

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.

We are seeking a detail-oriented 3D Digital Manufacturing Technician to join our team and help lead and execute day to day operations related to preparing, slicing, and optimizing parts for additive manufacturing. Your expertise in print setup, orientation strategies, Design for Manufacturing (DFM), and troubleshooting will ensure consistently high-quality output and streamlined production workflows.

Responsibilities:

• Prepare and slice CAD models for various 3D printing technologies (including FDM, SLA, and SLS) using various slicing software.

• Optimize print orientation, support structures, and settings to maximize quality, efficiency, and material usage.

• Identify and communicate potential design improvements using DFM principles to enhance printability and reduce post-processing.

• Troubleshoot print setup and orientation issues, analyze failures, and implement effective solutions.

• Collaborate with the internal teams and external customers to ensure alignment on technical requirements and improvements.

• Provide occasional support for printer operation tasks, including setup, maintenance, troubleshooting, and monitoring.

• Serve as the main liaison for customer inquiries regarding orders, project status, and technical specifications, ensuring professional and timely communication.

Required Skills & Experience:

• Hands-on experience with slicing and print setup software (PreForm, Cura, Simplify3D, Magics, Netfabb, etc.).

• Solid understanding of additive manufacturing processes and materials, particularly around print orientation, support generation, and print settings.

• Familiarity with Design for Manufacturing (DFM) concepts, specifically for 3D printing.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing and resolving printing issues.

• Ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience operating industrial and consumer 3D printers

• Basic proficiency with CAD software (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Onshape, ect).

• Familiarity with programming or scripting languages (Python) for automating processes.

Our Perks & Benefits:

• Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• Low cost fund options in our 401K and access to advisors

• Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits

• Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats

• Regular sponsored professional development opportunities

• Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community

• And of course… unlimited 3D prints

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

Compensation:

At Formlabs, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. Your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, location and expected impact on the organization.

The hourly base pay range for this role is:

$20—$22 USD

jobs.title: Content Operations Producer

jobs.description:
Business Insider is looking for a Programming and Operations Senior Producer to join our BI Live editorial events team in the newsroom.

This role sits at the intersection of programming operations and content production. This role will help keep our event pipeline running smoothly behind the scenes while also shaping the content from our live events that millions will view across Business Insider’s social platforms.

This Manager works closely with our editorial and production teams to ensure every session, from flagship interviews to sponsored programming, is well-run, well-documented, and well-distributed. This is a great fit for someone who's organized and detail-oriented but also has a creative eye, especially for short-form video that performs well on social platforms.

Our BI Live events and editorial team is growing, which means the person in this role will play a key part in building our offerings. There is also a growth opportunity to work closely with the revenue team to help shape sponsored session content in partnership with our sales team.

This role is based in our downtown New York offices and requires in-office attendance of at least 3 days a week. This role reports to the Editorial Director of BI Live. There may be opportunities for occasional travel. This role is union eligible.

The ideal candidate has:

• 5 years of editorial experience in media, events, and/or video

• Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple moving pieces — contracts, assets, timelines — simultaneously

• Experience with CRM or database tools for tracking outreach (e.g., Airtable, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)

• Hands-on video editing skills (Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar) and a good editorial instinct for what makes a clip work on social

• Excellent written communication and follow-through

• A collaborative, calm-under-pressure approach — live events don't pause for problems

• Familiarity with livestream or broadcast production workflows

• Familiarity with working directly with sponsors/partners in a way that respects both commercial goals and editorial standards is a plus

Key Responsibilities:

Programming and Live Show Production

• Partner with the Deputy Editor of BI Live to produce a live weekly streaming show

• Brainstorm and book guests for the live show in our newsroom

• Responsible for all production aspects of weekly show: coordinating with studio and control room crews; communicating with guests; conceiving and executing/overseeing execution of show assets; providing materials for anchors and other journalists as they prepare for interviews

• Assist with show promotion across all platforms

Event Programming Operations

• Assist with booking events speakers and guests

• Draft, send, and track speaker agreements, ensuring timely execution and proper documentation

• Manage the collection of speaker assets (bios, headshots, AV requirements) ahead of events

• Maintain and update a database/CRM of speaker and partner outreach, tracking status from first contact through post-event follow-up

• Coordinate logistics with internal stakeholders (production, editorial, marketing) to keep programming on schedule

• Build and maintain repeatable workflows/checklists to make programming operations more efficient as the event slate grows

Video & Social Content

• Identify the most compelling moments from all live sessions — the soundbites, reactions, and exchanges likely to perform well on social

• Create short, social-ready clips from the weekly streaming show and our live events

• Partner with Business Insider’s audience team to deliver clips on tight post-event turnaround timelines

• Cut full interviews from all live events and prepare for publication on YouTube and BusinessInsider.com

• Apply a working knowledge of platform-specific best practices (pacing, captions, aspect ratio, hooks) across channels like Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube

Salary & Benefits

• Salary range: $90,000 - $100,000 (dependent on skills, experience, and competencies)

• Unlimited PTO, 10 paid holidays, and 16 weeks of parental leave

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans

• Matched and vested 401k plan

• Access to resources for financial planning guidance, family planning services, mental health resources and Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)

• Additional benefits include commuter benefits, phone reimbursement, gym membership discounts, and more

Business Insider is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and, when making employment decisions, does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, sex, sexual orientation, age, nationality or national origin, religion, disability, familial status, and military or veteran status. We encourage members of traditionally underrepresented groups to apply.

Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles – first articulated as The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II – remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. At BRINC, we are building the technology that will define the future of emergency response. As a vertically integrated U.S. drone technology company, BRINC designs and manufactures unmanned aircraft systems, autonomous drone stations, command-and-control software, and advanced autonomy for public safety. Today, BRINC deploys Drone as First Responder (DFR) networks that dispatch drones directly to 911 calls, providing real-time aerial intelligence before ground units arrive and helping first responders make faster, safer decisions. BRINC serves more than 1,000 public safety customers across all 50 states, is the sole drone supplier to Motorola Solutions, and has raised more than $280 million from leading strategic and technology investors, including Motorola Solutions, Index Ventures, Sam Altman, Dylan Field, and others. BRINC is recruiting exceptional engineers to build the next generation of autonomous emergency-response technology, including flight-critical firmware and advanced pilot-assistance capabilities.

At BRINC, we are redefining public safety with an innovative ecosystem of life-saving tools. Our journey started with the development of drones and ruggedized throw phones, designed to access unsafe areas and establish communication to de-escalate situations. As our Partner Marketing Manager, you’ll own marketing to, with, and through our partners, building on an established partner strategy. You’ll work closely with our partnerships and marketing teams to bring joint solutions to market, build relationships across our ecosystem, and help partner sellers understand where GrowthLoop fits and when to bring us into a customer conversation. This is a hands-on role: you’ll shape the plan and drive the details that deliver results.

What You'll Do

• Own partner event marketing from planning through follow-up. Turn conferences and joint events into opportunities to reach the right buyers, deepen partner relationships, and create sales conversations.

• Lead co-branded product launches and customer announcements, coordinating the joint story, partner quotes and approvals, content, and promotion.

• Build marketing relationships with priority technology, cloud, and advisory partners. Develop joint campaigns that support shared sales priorities and give partners a reason to introduce GrowthLoop to their customers.

• Help sellers at our strategic partners understand, trust, and recommend GrowthLoop through relevant content, enablement, and opportunities to engage with our team.

• Bring key partner marketing opportunities into GrowthLoop’s broader quarterly marketing plan. Coordinate with partnerships, sales, marketing, and partner teams to deliver joint initiatives with clear owners, timelines, and goals.

• Proactively involve strategic partners in our major marketing announcements by securing endorsements and/or social media amplification and coordinating with content and product marketing.

• Work with content and product marketing to create partner-targeted content and sales materials, including solution one-pagers, decks, and joint customer stories.

• Collaborate with content marketing on co-branded content, such as drafting guest blog posts and lead generation assets (eBooks, whitepapers).

• Keep external partner listings and the partnerships sections of our website up to date.

• Run partner campaigns in HubSpot, including audience lists, campaign setup, lead capture, routing, and reporting, so engagement turns into timely sales follow-up.

• Work with sales to track partner engagement, event follow-up, and sales opportunities generated or supported by partner programs. Use the results to improve programs and decide where to focus next.

• Regularly analyze and report on partner engagement and results of partner marketing initiatives.

What You Bring

• 4–6 years of relevant partner marketing experience in enterprise B2B.

• Experience running partner campaigns, joint launches, and event marketing, including lead capture and sales follow-up. You can explain what you owned and how you measured the results.

• Strong relationship-building skills. You can earn a partner’s trust, find a shared opportunity, and get commitments, content, and approvals across the finish line.

• Clear writing and messaging skills, with the ability to turn a joint solution into a story buyers and partner sellers understand. You’re comfortable creating content, collateral, and presentations.

• Strong project management and follow-through. You can coordinate multiple teams, manage competing deadlines, and keep work moving when priorities change.

• You’ve run partner marketing programs that led to customer introductions or sales conversations, and can explain what worked and how you measured it.

• Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar marketing automation platform. You’re comfortable setting up campaigns, managing lists and workflows, and tracking results yourself.

About GrowthLoop

GrowthLoop built the first composable CDP, helping marketers leverage live, first-party data from their cloud warehouse to launch highly targeted campaigns. That composable foundation gave way to the Compound Marketing Engine, an evolution of the composable CDP that drives compound growth by using agentic AI to accelerate the marketing cycle.

Now, we’re building what comes next: an agentic system that uses causality data to find the actions that actually improve customer outcomes and gets smarter with every campaign cycle.

Founder-led, we’re partnering with the world’s most innovative brands to close the loop between people, data, and AI. Enterprise marketing teams at Google, Costco, Ford, and Whirlpool (to name a few) choose GrowthLoop to launch smarter, more personalized marketing programs that compound growth with every campaign.

About You

You’re a builder who enjoys turning a shared idea into something real, whether it’s a partner event, a joint launch, or a campaign that opens doors. You take ownership from planning through follow-up, bring clarity when priorities shift, and care about the details that make the work successful. You build trust by listening, communicating directly and kindly, and doing what you say you’ll do. You’re curious about our partners, our customers, and how to do the work better, including using new tools thoughtfully. You pitch in where needed, make the people around you better, and measure success by what the team and our partners achieve together.

What We Offer

The on-target earnings range for this role is USD $125,000–$135,000. Total compensation includes equity.

Final base salary decisions will be based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors unique to each candidate, such as the individual’s skill set, location, depth of experience, and qualifications.

Rewards

• See your work impact some of the most important businesses in the world, including Google, Priceline, and Indeed.

• Spot bonuses for major milestones and product feature graduations

• Opportunities for career progression and dynamic collaboration across teams

• Equity incentives for employees making an impact

Flexible Work Style

• Remote-First Culture

• Unbounded PTO

Competitive Benefits

• Free Platinum Health Insurance with Aetna

• 401(k) Program with Generous Company Match

Learn and Grow

• Work closely with our world-class executive team

jobs.title: Lead and Staff Certified Midwife (CM/CNM)
jobs.description:
Oula delivers maternity care built around our patients—offering comprehensive support before, during, and after pregnancy. With fewer C-sections and higher VBAC success rates, our research-backed approach is delivering better outcomes. Our team of trusted midwives, OBGYNs, and dedicated care navigators ensure our patients get the type of care they need in the moments that matter most.

Since launching in 2021, we’ve expanded our care options to include Preconception and Miscarriage Care, Pregnancy Care, Postpartum Support, and Gynecology. Today, we serve patients across six clinics in three states, with continued expansion planned for 2027 and beyond. Join our team of clinicians, innovators, operators, and technologists who are passionate about setting a new standard in maternity care.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead and Staff Certified Nurse-Midwife (CM/ CNM) to join our growing maternity care practice in Queens, NY. We’re searching for someone who is thoughtful and passionate about delivering patient-centric, judgment-free care, and is excited to join a dynamic and innovative team.

This is the perfect opportunity for a CM/ CNM who is excited to expand their skill set and help define and build a new best-in-class maternity care experience. You will be responsible for delivering full-spectrum perinatal care, as well as helping to shape and refine Oula’s clinical care model.

At Oula, midwives lead their own panels within a truly collaborative model — OB-GYNs are integrated members of the same team, not a separate referral tier — and our patients deliver at our partner hospital. With fewer C-sections and higher VBAC success rates, our research-backed approach delivers better outcomes for the communities we serve. This is the autonomy-with-backup practice many midwives are looking for and rarely find.

This is a full-time position with a flexible schedule that varies based on market and operational needs. At steady-state staffing, a typical schedule includes approximately two office days per week, an average of 24 hours of on-call coverage per week (with a protected post-call day off where applicable), and dedicated administrative and didactic time. During the launch of new markets or other ramp-up periods, scheduling needs—including on-call responsibilities—may temporarily be greater as the practice grows.

Schedule: Full-time, flexible schedule based on market and operational needs.

Employment type: Full-time, Benefits Eligible

What You'll Do

Full-Scope Midwifery Care

• Provides full-scope midwifery care during pregnancy, labor, birth, and postpartum across a variety of settings: our clinics, our partner hospital, and virtually.

• Attends births as the primary delivering clinician for low-risk patients, supporting physiologic labor and birth while recognizing when escalation or consultation is indicated.

• Collaborates with other team members (e.g., obstetricians, nurses, MAs, doulas, coordinators, therapists, etc.) to provide whole-person care.

Patient Communication & Education

• Communicates effectively with patients during and between appointments to ensure questions are answered and concerns are addressed by leveraging Oula’s technology.

• Able and excited to educate about and promote the midwifery model of care to current and prospective patients, with a focus on growing Oula’s patient population.

Clinical Model & Product Collaboration

• Works collaboratively with Oula’s product & engineering team to give feedback on the patient portal to create a more personalized, inclusive, and consistent approach to care.

Qualifications

Required

• Must hold active state licensure as required to practice midwifery in the clinic’s state (or be eligible to obtain it before start), and current certification by the AMCB as a Certified Nurse-Midwife or Certified Midwife.

• Experience caring for diverse communities with a wide variety of needs.

• Great professional references and a reputation for providing exceptional patient care valued by your patients and colleagues.

Preferred

• Two or more years of full-scope clinical midwifery experience preferred; we also welcome strong earlier-career candidates who are approaching that mark.

• Experience with telemedicine or elements of virtual care.

• Any extra “bonus” skills or passions that will help us serve our patients (i.e. the ability to communicate with patients in their preferred language, passion for birth equity work, lactation certification, nutrition/diabetes training, etc.).

Preferred Skills

• Early pregnancy loss options counseling and medical management.

• Familiarity with Perinatal Mental Health.

• Basic bedside sonography skills (1st Trimester Viability and positioning confirmation).

You Are the Perfect Candidate If You

• Are passionate about improving maternity care through a combination of clinical care, technology, patient empowerment, and education.

• Are enthusiastic about collaborative care models leveraging diverse teams with a wide variety of skill-sets.

• Exude empathy and compassion for patients and team members alike and can rally your team to provide exceptional patient experience regardless of the situation.

• Uphold the core principles of reproductive justice to support principles of body autonomy, self-determination and cultural respect.

• Are comfortable with ambiguity and change, and energized by building processes from the ground up.

• Are excited about realizing the Oula mission, and building the kind of collaborative practice that midwives and patients dream about.

How We Work

Our values are Excellence, Candor, Humanity, Ownership, Evidence, and Service. In practice, that means we care about our patients and each other, have honest conversations with respect, make decisions based on evidence, and keep the patient at the center of everything we do.

Oula offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, and  comprehensive benefits. Exact compensation inclusive of salary and any bonuses is determined based on a number of factors including experience and skill level, location, and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Oula is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone's contributions are valued.

Salary Range

$139,000—$180,000 USD

Oula's Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer:

We're committed to an inclusive workplace that reflects the communities we serve. You can be a great candidate even if you don't meet every qualification listed. If that's you, tell us about yourself in your cover letter. We especially encourage applicants from historically underrepresented communities, including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ people, veterans, and people with disabilities.

Oula Health participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.
