Position Summary

The Field Staff Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing all operational aspects within Centria Autism, including developing and managing schedules for Behavior Technicians, coordinating and overseeing assessments for clients, coordinating staffing activities, and serving as a liaison with facility management to help maintain a clean and safe working environment. This role will also develop strategies and initiatives to improve client and Behavior Technician retention. The Field Staff Manager will play a vital role in ensuring smooth operations and maintaining high-quality standards throughout the organization. It is important that the Field Staff Manager builds strong relationships with families and maintains high family satisfaction.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Scheduling Coordination Develop and manage schedules for Behavior Technicians, ensuring optimal coverage and adherence to company policies and guidelines. Coordinate and oversee the scheduling of assessments for all clients, including the option to assist with re-assessments when necessary. Align families, Behavior Technicians, and Supervising Clinicians to start new cases and confirm authorization, ensuring a smooth case start. Coordinate staffing activities, including permanent staff allocation, substitution arrangements, and assigning multiple Behavior Technicians to clients as needed. Assist clients seeking center tours. Confirm schedules weekly with Behavior Technicians and families.

• Oversee Behavior Technicians and Operational Processes Monitor Behavior Technician attendance and professionalism, in consultation with the Area Operations Director (AOD), and implement measures to maintain high performance standards. Ensure smooth coordination of care for clients, including effective communication and collaboration with healthcare providers. Address and resolve issues related to paper document management, implementing efficient solutions to enhance accuracy and productivity.

• Ensure the Operations Workflow Runs Smoothly by Coordinating with Other Departments and Families Facilitate effective communication and handoff processes between the Onboarding and Intake Teams and the Operations Team for seamless transition and service initiation. Review and coordinate conversations regarding insurance changes for clients, changes in case status, and ensure timely confirmation of authorizations. Develop strategies and initiatives to improve client and Behavior Technician retention rates. Ensure ongoing engagement with clients, including before the start of services and/or while they are on hold, addressing their needs and concerns, and maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

• Maintain Compliance Regulations Ensure compliance with the dormant policy, manage offboarding processes for team members, and oversee the collection of iPads from departing team members.

• Oversee Financial Processes Oversee payroll and billing processes, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with relevant regulations. Provide administrative triage and one-call resolution for authorization and coordination of benefits (COB) issues, resolving them promptly and accurately.

Rate

$50,000 - $60,000, plus bonus potential for 75k total compensation

Qualifications

Education

• High school diploma or equivalent, required

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience, preferred

Work Experience

1 - 3 years of experience in operations management or sales, prior management of a team preferred.

Equipment and Technology Requirements

• Working knowledge of laptop/desktop PC

• Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel)

• Proficiency in G Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Google Meet)

Other Competency Requirements

• Ability to follow written instructions

• Ability to use computers and computer/software programs

• Ability to communicate expressively and receptively

Knowledge and Skills

• Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and manage a diverse team.

• Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.

• In-depth knowledge of credentialing processes, HR practices, and compliance requirements.

• Proven experience in managing budgets and financial performance.

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Proficiency in using technology platforms and systems for operational management.

• Knowledge of accreditation standards and privacy regulations.

• Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and changing work environment.

• Availability for occasional travel as required.

Working Conditions

• Centria's office hours are Monday through Friday from 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM.

• Additional time or occasional shift in schedule may be required to complete the above work or meet company objectives.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, physical requirements such as bending, reaching, lifting, pushing, or pulling up to 30 pounds may be required. This role will require sitting most of the day as well as walking and standing periodically. This role may require close visual acuity on computer screens or monitors and the ability to analyze data and figures on a screen.

jobs.title: Multi-Site Residential Manager
jobs.description:
At Bozzuto, every team member shares a deep commitment to doing good for those around us. We live this each day by designing, building, managing and maintaining one-of-a-kind residences. Whether it’s the talent within our communities or the expertise across our property operations teams, we work together to make extraordinary happen for our clients, residents and fellow team members.

Our people are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to everyone we serve including each other. This shared purpose drives us to excel in every role and fosters a welcoming, inclusive workplace where teamwork thrives. Guided by our core values of concern, creativity, passion and the pursuit of perfection, we are inspired and empowered to reach higher, unlock our full potential and be truly extraordinary.

Primary Responsibilities:

You work to create value for ownership by helping to achieve the operational and financial goals for the property as well as maintaining strong resident relations. You will do this by managing renewals, overseeing apartment leasing, resident retention activities and assisting with property operations.

As a Multi-Site Residential Manager, your primary responsibilities include:

• Assist with supporting 3 properties

• Follow up on all resident inquires and issues.

• Ensure team delivers superior customer service.

• Effectively and professionally resolve conflict

• Initiate lease renewal letters within 90 days of lease expiration date.

• Timely follow up on all resident and lease issues.

• Manage resident event planning activities.

• Coach and motivate sales team to meet or exceed occupancy targets by driving an aggressive sales effort.

• Maintain close ratio no less than 30%.

• Ensure team manages 100% of leads and completes a minimum of 3 follow ups per lead.

• Create and manage marketing and outreach programs.

• Maintain a high performing, customer focused team by developing the team and providing ongoing learning opportunities for skill building and career advancement.

• Develop programs and incentives that foster high team morale.

• Maintain turnover at equal to or less that budgeted rate.

• Document and alert Property Manager to all performance issues immediately.

• Enforce company and/or property dress code.

• Complete and submit to management and ownership all required weekly reports, month-end reports and market surveys.

• Ensure daily site inspections are completed and all issues addressed.

• Prepare and manage staff schedules

• Organize and maintain all lease files.

• Conduct quarterly lease audits.

• Manage renewal paperwork.

• Assist with any budget preparation.

What You Bring to Us:

• 4 year college degree or equivalent relevant experience

• 1-3 years of experience in the Property Management industry, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding requirements of the job

• Strong Financial Analysis, Budgeting, P&L Management skills

• Lead the secure access service edge (SASE) and always-on virtual private network (VPN) rollout, and own data loss prevention policy. Coordinate Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) boundary decisions with Security Compliance, working with Endpoint Engineering on clients and device posture signals and Identity Engineering on Okta network-zone policy.

• Run the corporate email gateway and own domain-based message authentication, reporting, and conformance (DMARC), sender policy framework (SPF), and DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) across GitLab domains, including the FedRAMP tenant. Complete the separation of product email flow from corporate Google Workspace.

• Operate Sandbox Cloud across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including the self-service portal, demo and training environments, the SSP GitLab instance, and other gitlab.systems environments. Build automated deprovisioning and cost guardrails while keeping identity and access management with Identity Engineering and production infrastructure with Infrastructure Security and Site Reliability Engineering.

• Own Corporate Security's operating-model reporting, annual operating plan, software spend, change management, systems directory, handbook upkeep, and dashboards. Coordinate audit evidence across all three teams for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2), and FedRAMP, replacing screenshots with code and query exports.

• Run departmental intake and reduce repeated requests through Slack automation, Serval, self-service security reviews, documentation hubs, and AI-assisted answers. Help each team focus on the systems it owns rather than routine triage.

• Represent Platform Engineering in Corporate Security and Security leadership forums, the Authorization to Operate Council, and monthly AI spend reviews. Partner with Corporate IT, Infrastructure Security, security incident response, Security Compliance, Security Risk, Enterprise AI, Legal and Privacy, Procurement, and Finance to resolve shared priorities and ownership questions.

What you’ll bring

• Experience managing security or platform engineering teams across time zones, including hiring engineers and developing senior individual contributors. Experience defining a team's remit and redirecting work to the right owner.

• Experience owning several categories of corporate security tooling, such as network security, email security, software-as-a-service security posture, asset visibility, and cloud sandboxes. Sound judgment about when to adopt, consolidate, or retire tools.

• Experience leading a team that operates tools as code using Terraform or OpenTofu, GitOps, merge-request change management, continuous integration pipelines, and Python or a similar language. The technical depth to review designs and code.

• Hands-on experience deploying SASE, zero-trust network access, or always-on VPN solutions, alongside data loss prevention controls, in a remote-first company.

• Knowledge of AWS and GCP organization structures, account provisioning, guardrails, and cost controls sufficient to operate a self-service sandbox platform safely.

• Experience owning objectives and key results, vendor relationships, budgets, and security audit evidence programs, with the ability to write clear, concise plans for senior Security leadership.

• Experience using agentic AI tools in your work and a clear approach to governing AI tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and credentials. The ability to run an enablement program without becoming the approver for every tool.

• Clear written and asynchronous communication, a record of resolving ownership questions across functions, and an approach aligned with GitLab's values and all-remote, handbook-first ways of working. We welcome diverse backgrounds and transferable experience relevant to this work.

About the team

Platform Engineering owns shared security tooling, non-production environments, and department-wide programs within Corporate Security. The team works alongside Endpoint Engineering and Identity Engineering, with clear boundaries around each team's responsibilities. Its focus is to make security services easier to operate and use through automation, self-service, and written documentation, while keeping ownership, costs, and audit evidence clear. You'll lead a small, distributed team and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with technical, security, and business partners.

jobs.description:
(ID: 2026-4006)

Axle is a bioscience and information technology company that offers advancements in translational research, biomedical informatics, and data science applications to research centers and healthcare organizations nationally and abroad. With experts in biomedical science, software engineering, and program management, we focus on developing and applying research tools and techniques to empower decision-making and accelerate research discoveries. We work with some of the top research organizations and facilities in the country including multiple institutes at the National Institutes of Health (NIH).

Axle is seeking a Scientist  to join our vibrant team at the National Institutes of Health (NIH) supporting the National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH) located in Bethesda, MD.

Benefits We Offer:

• 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage for Employees

• Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

• 401K match up to 5%

• Educational Benefits for Career Growth

• Employee Referral Bonus

• Flexible Spending Accounts: Healthcare (FSA) Parking Reimbursement Account (PRK) Dependent Care Assistant Program (DCAP) Transportation Reimbursement Account (TRN)

Position Overview
The Scientist will provide scientific laboratory support for ongoing research studies within the laboratory's overall research program. The position will support the execution of established experimental procedures, the collection and analysis of research data, the maintenance of research records, and the communication of experimental results. Responsibilities include performing electrophysiological and multi-electrode recordings in studies of sensory coding and neural plasticity, maintaining and troubleshooting recording equipment, analyzing data, preparing figures, reports, and manuscripts, and training experience. This position is based at the NIH campus in Bethesda, MD (Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week) and is telework eligible.

Additional Qualifications
• Master's degree in a related discipline and three years of experience
• Biology
• MS Office
• Data presentation

Deliverables
• Work products and documentation associated with the performance of established experimental procedures and ongoing electrophysiological and multi-electrode recording studies — Ad-Hoc
• Research data and analyses associated with ongoing laboratory studies, including organized datasets and figures — Ad-Hoc
• Scientific summaries, reports, presentations, figures, and related documentation describing experimental methods and results — Ad-Hoc
• Documentation and technical support materials associated with laboratory equipment, recording methods, and established research techniques — Ad-Hoc
Statement of Work Details
• Support the planning and execution of research experiments in the context of the laboratory's overall research program.
• Design and conduct experiments and studies requiring the application of broad professional knowledge of scientific theories and principles.
• Conduct experiments using established laboratory protocols and procedures, including multi-electrode recording methods.
• Perform electrophysiological recordings in support of ongoing research studies.
• Perform electrical recordings in response to optogenetic-induced light stimulation.
• Support ongoing research studies involving sensory coding and neural plasticity.
• Provide technical support to laboratory staff in the use of multi-electrode recording methods, imaging, and related experimental techniques.
• Calibrate, maintain, and troubleshoot instruments and equipment in the laboratory, including equipment associated with electrophysiological recording procedures.
• Maintain and update laboratory notebooks and databases.
• Manage scientific equipment and resources (e.g., reagents, stocks of frozen cells, animal samples), including acquisition, documentation, and storage.
• Analyze data generated from ongoing multi-electrode recording studies using established analytical approaches.
• Organize study data and assemble them in figure format appropriate for publication.
• Prepare summaries, reports, presentations, and other documentation describing experimental methods and results.
• Contribute to writing research proposals and manuscripts describing results.
• Provide interpretation of results, guidance, and scientific support to the management team.
• Train and provide support to junior staff on multi-electrode recording methods.

jobs.title: Head of Risk & Compliance
jobs.description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.




THE ROLE

You will own DA Global’s compliance and risk management functions as the firm moves from application to authorised DLT Provider. You will build and run the second line of defence: making sure the firm knows every obligation that applies to it, has controls that work, and operates within the risk appetite set by the Board. You will be the firm’s day-to-day contact with the GFSC.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING


Compliance

 - Own the compliance framework: policies, procedures and the regulatory obligations register, mapped to the DLT regulatory principles and the conditions of the licence.

 - Design and deliver a risk-based compliance monitoring programme, and report results and remediation to the Board.

 - Manage the preparation and submission of the GFSC regulatory returns and notifications, and manage information requests and supervisory engagement.

 - Track regulatory change in Gibraltar and relevant markets, assess its impact and lead implementation.

 - Advise the business on new products, partners and jurisdictions, and give compliance sign-off.

 - Work closely with the MLRO on AML/CFT matters, including Travel Rule compliance, without taking over the MLRO’s independent reporting responsibilities.

Risk management

 - Own the enterprise risk management framework: risk taxonomy, risk register, methodology and risk and control self-assessments.

 - Develop the Board-approved risk appetite statement and key risk indicators, and monitor the firm against them.

 - Oversee custody and safeguarding, operational and technology, cyber, outsourcing, liquidity and financial crime risk.

 - Contribute to the assessment of capital adequacy, stress testing, operational resilience and wind-down planning.

 - Run the incident and breach management process, including root-cause analysis and GFSC notification where required.

 - Oversee outsourcing and third-party risk, including intra-group arrangements.

Governance and reporting

 - Deliver quarterly compliance and risk reports to the Board and support its independent non-executive directors.

 - Escalate material breaches and risk appetite breaches to the Board promptly.

 - Support the Board’s review of whether dedicated Risk and Audit Committees are needed.

 - Build and lead a small compliance and risk team as the business grows.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - At least 8 years in compliance and/or risk management in regulated financial services, including at least 2 years in a senior or head-of-function role.

 - Direct experience of GFSC supervision, ideally with a DLT Provider, e-money institution, payments firm or investment firm in Gibraltar.

 - Strong working knowledge of the Financial Services Act 2019, the DLT Providers Regulations 2020, the Proceeds of Crime Act 2015 and GFSC guidance notes.

 - Experience building a compliance monitoring programme and an enterprise risk framework from an early stage.

 - Able to obtain GFSC approval as a Regulated Individual for both functions, with a clean regulatory and personal record.

 - Based in Gibraltar or willing to relocate.

 - Clear written English and confidence presenting to a board and a regulator.




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience with virtual asset custody, stablecoins or crypto exchanges.

 - Familiarity with MiCA, FATF standards for virtual asset service providers and the Travel Rule.

 - A recognised compliance or risk qualification (for example ICA Diploma, IRM or equivalent).

 - Spanish, given the group’s Latin American operations.




BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary and benefits

 - Stock options, so you own part of what you build

 - Discretionary performance bonus

 - The latest tools and technology

 - A world-class team that will challenge and grow your skills

 - Office Policy: 3-4 days a week in-office

jobs.title: Director - SimCorp Partnership Lead
jobs.description:
About Alpha Group

Alpha Group is a leading global consultancy to the financial services industry. Founded in 2003, Alpha has spent over 20 years bringing together specialist, sector-focused strategy, management consulting, and technology expertise to support the entire client transformation lifecycle. Having partnered with more than 1,200 clients worldwide across the asset and wealth management, alternatives, and insurance industries, Alpha is a trusted advisor for complex change programs. We now have over 1,180 consultants working with clients across North America, the UK, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC. In 2024, in recognition of our successful track record and strong growth prospects, Alpha was acquired by Bridgepoint, one of the world's leading quoted private asset growth investors. Our people are at the heart of everything we do. Many of our team have built long and fulfilling careers with us, often staying for over a decade. Alpha offers a genuinely rewarding place to work: a meritocratic environment where your career can flourish, and a welcoming culture where you can be yourself, connect with others, and thrive. As we look to the future, we’re excited to be looking for new Alpha colleagues—individuals who are collaborative, innovative, and ambitious. We hope you will join us and help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

Why join Alpha?

• Established yet entrepreneurial – with over 20 years of success and a proven record on the London Stock Exchange, Alpha offers the stability of an established consultancy with the energy of a fast-growth business.

• Backed by Bridgepoint – as part of one of the world’s leading growth investors, Alpha benefits from strategic investment that fuels innovation, expansion and new offerings – creating even more opportunity for our people.

• Exposure to senior leadership – whether you are in an internal or a client-facing role, you will have the opportunity to work with and learn from the best of the best – high performers at the top of their game.

• Learning and growth opportunities – we run tailored training to help you be successful, provide you excellent mentorship, and offer up to 5 days paid training time per year. Perhaps the best training though is the experience on the job – as everyone at Alpha has high responsibility and autonomy, you can develop your skillsets quickly.

• Performance-driven culture with real impact – advancement at Alpha is based on impact and capability, not tenure or quotas. You’ll have autonomy and see the tangible difference your ideas and decisions make.

About the Role

Alpha is seeking an experienced Director to lead and grow its SimCorp partnership across North America, with accountability for partnership management, commercial performance, implementation delivery, operational excellence and regional business development. This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of strategic vendor partnerships, investment technology implementation, consulting delivery and commercial growth. The successful candidate will be responsible for building and scaling Alpha's North American SimCorp business, leading the direct vendor-partner implementation opportunities. As the North American partnership lead, you will be accountable for the regional partnership and scale. This includes harvesting the implementation pipeline, building and maintaining a qualified delivery bench, managing commercial outcomes, KPIs and ensuring consistently high-quality delivery consistent with the global partnerships guidelines model. You will work closely with SimCorp's North American leadership, professional services organization and account teams, as well as Alpha's Investments and Operations leadership, global partnership leadership and international delivery teams. You will also collaborate with Alpha's Investments practice to identify opportunities to expand implementation capabilities and support the continued growth of the SimCorp relationship. The role requires a commercially minded leader with deep knowledge of the investment management industry, practical understanding of enterprise investment technology implementations, strong vendor relationship management experience and exceptional verbal and written communication skills. The successful candidate must be equally comfortable engaging senior executives, developing business opportunities, and building high-performing teams. You will report to Alpha's Global Partner Executive, who is accountable for the overall commercial relationship, and will serve as Alpha's primary North American operational and partnership lead for SimCorp.

Key Responsibilities

1. SimCorp Partnership Leadership

• Lead and develop Alpha's North American SimCorp partnership, serving as the primary regional leader and point of coordination between Alpha, SimCorp and Global Partnerships.

• Build and maintain trusted relationships with SimCorp's North American leadership, professional services organization, account owners and other key stakeholders.

• Translate the Global Partnership objectives into actionable regional growth, delivery and operational plans.

• Establish effective partnership governance, including regular executive engagement, account planning and performance reporting.

• Work closely with SimCorp's professional services and account teams to understand their implementation requirements, resource needs, client priorities and regional growth objectives.

• Identify opportunities to expand Alpha's role within the SimCorp ecosystem, including white-label resource delivery, implementation services, specialist capabilities and direct vendor-partner implementation engagements.

• Maintain a consistent approach to the SimCorp relationship across all regions, coordinating with international partnership leadership on resource sharing, delivery standards, commercial arrangements and go-to-market activities.

• Ensure Alpha maintains a strong reputation as a trusted, responsive and high-quality implementation partner.

• Work with Alpha Legal and commercial leadership, as required, on partnership agreements, Statements of Work (SOWs), commercial negotiations and contractual governance.

• Operational Leadership

• Ensure the consistent supply of high-quality implementation resources to support SimCorp's professional services requirements and direct client capacity and onboarding needs.

• Support resource and capacity planning, recruitment coordination across North America and the GCC, resource deployment, utilization, capability development and delivery performance.

• Work closely with delivery leaders to ensure implementation engagements are appropriately staffed, governed and delivered to agreed quality standards, timelines and service levels.

• Establish effective processes for resource assessment, profile submission, client matching, onboarding, training and deployment.

• Maintain oversight of delivery quality, client satisfaction, resource performance and engagement economics.

• Proactively identify and resolve delivery challenges, resource constraints, client concerns and partnership escalations.

• Support the development of regional and global Centers of Excellence (CoEs) to strengthen SimCorp implementation capability and provide access to specialist expertise.

• Ensure effective knowledge transfer and collaboration between Alpha's North American, international and GCC-based teams.

• Commercial Management & Business Performance

• Own the commercial and financial performance of Alpha's North American SimCorp white-label business, with accountability for revenue, utilization, gross margin and delivery economics.

• Develop and manage regional financial and operational plans aligned with partnership growth objectives.

• Maintain minimum gross margin white-label roles in line with the tolerances set by Global Partnerships.

• Drive resource utilization, balancing resource availability, deployment timelines and pipeline demand.

• Maintain commercial discipline across pricing, rate cards, resource costs and engagement profitability.

• Monitor revenue and financial performance against the approved North American business plan and proactively address gaps or risks.

• Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, resource economics, margin performance and scalability.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Team

CoreWeave is looking for a motivated Executive Assistant to join our growing team. At CoreWeave, we are building the next generation public cloud for accelerated workloads. This role will provide administrative support to three VPs:  Vice President Engineering, Compute Architecture, Head of HPC Networking, and VP, Global Network Infrastructure.  The ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented, experienced planner with the demonstrated ability to respond effectively and efficiently while maintaining flexibility, composure and be willing to be onsite up to five days a week.  You will anticipate needs before they are expressed, make judgment calls confidently, and keep the VPs focused on high-impact work without being asked.

The individual in this role must understand business priorities, demonstrate the ability to proactively anticipate needs and drive improvements to build capacity for the engineering organization. This role requires the utmost confidentiality; candidates with experience operating in highly private, discreet environments are strongly preferred. A high level of integrity and discretion in handling confidential information as well as professionalism in dealing with executives inside and outside of the company is critical. The successful candidate will possess the ability to complete complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance, react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround, and take effective action without having to know the whole picture. The ideal candidate must be able to work successfully in a team environment and build effective working relationships inside and outside the group.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own and strategically manage a complex calendar across multiple time zones, proactively resolving conflicts, protecting focus time, and making real-time decisions aligned to business priorities.

• Make all travel arrangements, including frequent domestic and international itineraries

• Travel alongside the Vice President Engineering, Compute Architecture as needed — this role requires travel approximately 60% of the time

• Proactively develop positive working relationships with key partners, agencies and vendors, as well as across internal departments

• Act as a gatekeeper and partner, ensuring the VPs spend time on the highest-impact priorities

• Collaborate with other assistants to organize and execute team activities (all-hands, off-sites, team social events)

• Handle expense reports and reconciliation

• Work closely with other assistants on collaborative company-wide projects and initiatives

• This role may require occasional assistance with personal administrative tasks

Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience providing administrative assistance

• Experience with Engineering or Product teams a plus

• Ability to prioritize and handle multiple assignments at any given time

• Light project management and event planning experience

• Demonstrated ability to make decisions independently with limited context

• Strong business judgment and the confidence to push back when needed

• Experience supporting leaders in fast-paced, high-growth or technical environments

• Highly motivated, organized individual who is able to work effectively with minimal supervision, coordinating with staff across multiple locations and time zones

• Experience with Google Suite, Slack, Zoom preferred

• Prior experience supporting executives in environments requiring a high degree of privacy and confidentiality preferred

• Willing to travel 60% of the time

• Onsite whenever the Vice President Engineering, Compute Architecture is in the office (up to 5 days per week)

• Willing to work outside of traditional business hours, including availability by phone on evenings and weekends for travel changes and urgent needs

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!  We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

• Be Curious at Your Core

• Act Like an Owner

• Empower Employees

• Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences

• Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base salary range for this role is $108,000 to $143,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave

• Flexible PTO

• A casual work environment

• A work culture focused on innovative disruption

California Consumer Privacy Act

All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.

jobs.title: Agile Coach (AI-Native / Agentic Ways of Working)
jobs.description:
Job description

<our consulting company>, is hiring an Agile Coach to help delivery teams work well as AI agents become part of their daily work. This is a coaching role first. You will shape how teams plan, collaborate and improve when copilots and agents share the work, not build the AI tools yourself.

We want someone who has already done this: coached real teams through the shift to AI-native ways of working and can show what changed as a result.

What you'll do

• Coach agile teams as they bring AI copilots and agents into how they plan, build, test and release work.

• Redesign team practices where agents change the work: refinement, sprint planning, definition of done, reviews and retrospectives.

• Help teams decide which work humans own, which agents handle, and how people review and stay accountable for agent output.

• Coach product owners and team leads on backlog management, prioritization and flow in an AI-assisted environment.

• Track flow and outcome measures (cycle time, quality, predictability) to show whether AI is improving delivery, not just adding activity.

• Work through resistance and uneven adoption, building team confidence and healthy habits with new tools.

• Partner with engineering, architecture and AI enablement groups so team practices fit client's technology, risk and governance standards.

• Share what works across teams through communities of practice, playbooks and workshops.

Must-have qualifications

• 5+ years as an agile coach working directly with delivery teams, with coaching as your main job.

• Hands-on experience in the last 2 years coaching teams in an AI-native environment or teams using agentic solutions (for example, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise or agent frameworks in the delivery lifecycle).

• Specific examples of team practices, roles or working agreements you changed because AI or agents were part of the work, and the results.

• Enough AI fluency to talk credibly with engineers about LLMs, agents and their limits, without being the person who builds them.

• Strong Scrum and Kanban foundation; comfortable working within a scaled framework such as SAFe.

• Excellent facilitation, communication and change-management skills with teams and their leaders.

• An agile coaching certification such as ICP-ACC, ICE-AC, CSM/CSP, PSM or SAFe SPC.

Nice to have

• Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated industry.

• Has led or supported an AI enablement or AI adoption program.

• Has coached teams building LLM or agent-based products.

• Has written, spoken or run workshops on AI and agile ways of working.

jobs.title: Construction Inspector II
jobs.description:
Pay Range: $26.57 - $33.21/hr.

Job Posting Closing on: Tuesday, December 1, 2026 📅

Workdays & Hours: Monday – Friday 7:30 am – 4:30 pm; Some evening/weekend work required.

Benefits for this position include: 11 Paid Holidays, Medical, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off, Pension Plan, Professional Development Opportunities, and Find Out More!

The City of Fort Worth is one of the fastest growing large cities in the U.S. Our employees serve the needs of over 1,000,000 residents, promoting our values of exceptional customer experience, mutual respect, embracing our diversity, continuous improvement, ethical behavior, and accountability.

A Construction Inspector II position is available with the City of Fort Worth’s Transportation & Public Works Department, Capital Delivery Division. The selected candidate will be responsible for reviewing and interpreting construction plans and overseeing infrastructure projects involving utilities, storm drainage, concrete, and asphalt paving to ensure full compliance with plans, specifications, contracts, and all applicable regulatory requirements. This includes ensuring that workmanship and materials meet all required standards and verifying compliance with Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ) regulations, the Texas Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (TMUTCD), and all work zone safety requirements.

The role also involves establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with contractors, utility providers, the general public, and fellow employees. The ideal candidate is responsible, dependable, highly detail‑oriented, and committed to working collaboratively as part of a team.

Minimum Qualifications:

• High School Diploma/GED

• Two (2) years of construction inspection experience involving the construction and maintenance of public works, storm drainage systems, and structures

• Valid driver’s license

• Possession of, or ability to obtain, within one (1) year of employment, a Class C Water Distribution certification from the State of Texas

• Must pass the City of Fort Worth Human Performance Evaluation (HPE) and a Drug Screen

Preferred Qualifications:

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office computer skills (Word, Excel and Outlook)

• At least three (3) years’ experience with utility, storm drainage, concrete/asphalt

• Availability to work overtime and respond to call-backs on weekdays, weekends, and holidays

• Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ) Class C Certification

The Construction Inspector II job responsibilities include:

• Inspects work quality and materials used in a variety of public works projects during various stages of construction to ensure compliance with construction standards and codes, ordinances, and regulations

• Uses basic math skills for measurements on job sites

• Performs preliminary and final inspections and recommends acceptance of developments

• Observes work during progress and upon completion

• Coordinates change orders and advise contractors of changes in plans and specifications

• Ensures that safety procedures are followed

• Inspects various public works structures including utilities, streets, sidewalks, gutters, structural concrete, storm systems and various other facilities

• Acts as liaison between contractors and the general public with respect to various construction projects

• A strong interpersonal, management, and excellent communications skills with the unique ability to be able to transfer these concepts clearly and effectively both verbally and in writing with the development community and internal City staff

• Responsible for driving a City vehicle

Working Conditions and Physical Demands

Medium work – Depending on assignment, positions in this class typically exert up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 20 pounds of force constantly having to move objects.

Depending on assignment, positions in this class typically require touching, talking, hearing, seeing, grasping, standing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, walking, repetitive motions, climbing, balancing, pushing, pulling and lifting; depending on assignment. Incumbents may be exposed to moving mechanical parts, odors, dusts, poor ventilation, chemicals, oils, extreme temperatures, inadequate lighting and intense noises.

Apply Now! Come be part of something special in Fort Worth. 🌟

jobs.title: Associate, MES & Shopfloor IT
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

• Provide day-to-day support for the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and related shopfloor systems used by Production, Logistics, Production Control, Quality, and Operations.

• Monitor system health, interfaces, transactions, production orders, sequencing, and logistics processes; identify abnormal conditions and assist with troubleshooting or escalation.

• Gather issue details, follow established troubleshooting procedures, and work with experienced team members, internal departments, and suppliers to support resolution.

• Support routine production control, order management, logistics execution, traceability, reporting, and exception-handling activities.

• Create, update, and track support tickets, defects, open points, troubleshooting guides, operating procedures, and lessons learned.

• Assist with approved user access, system configuration, testing, validation, deployment, and change-control activities.

• Provide basic user guidance on system functionality, issue reporting, and established production-support procedures.

• Participate in launch support and continuous improvement activities while developing knowledge of MES, manufacturing processes, logistics systems, and shopfloor technologies.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in Blythewood, South Carolina

• This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.

• Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• 0–2 years of professional, internship, co-op, academic, or related experience in Information Technology, manufacturing systems, industrial technology, engineering, automation, data analysis, or a related field.

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Foundational understanding of information systems, manufacturing processes, production systems, automation, logistics, databases, networks, or system interfaces gained through education or practical experience.

• Interest in learning and supporting MES and related shopfloor technologies, including production control, order management, sequencing, material flow, reporting, traceability, and exception handling.

• Basic troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, including the ability to gather information, identify symptoms, follow established procedures, document findings, and escalate issues when needed.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively with technical, production, logistics, and operational teams.

• Responsible, detail-oriented, and service-focused approach, with curiosity, a willingness to learn, and comfort seeking guidance when needed.

• Willingness to support production outside normal business hours when required and ability to travel domestically and internationally.

Preferred:

Job Title: Integration Manager, Mergers and Acquisition (M&A)

Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: Loenbro LLC - Integration
Location: Dallas, TX On-site
Reports to: Vice President of Integration
Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Classification: Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary

As an Integration Manager within our M&A team at Loenbro, you’ll run the Integration Management Office (IMO) on one or more deals at a time, from deal signing through target end state.

With our continued growth, you’ll pick up the diligence findings, synergy plan, and risks, actions, issues, and decisions (RAID) log at signing, then lead Day 1 readiness and integration, sizing the approach to each deal while staying within Loenbro's integration norms.

Role & Responsibilities

Run deals in parallel

• Own the IMO for each assigned deal from signing to end state. Set up governance, the integration plan, the RAID log, and the Steering Committee (SteerCo) cadence, sized to the deal's scale and complexity using existing Loenbro integration playbook

• Keep several deals moving at once by using shared playbook templates and one reporting rhythm across deals. Escalate capacity and priority conflicts to mitigate quality or timing risks.

Hand off at signing and prepare for Day 1

• Confirm that the signing handoff from corporate development is complete (diligence findings, synergy plan, RAID log), then lead integration planning with functional leaders.

• Define Day 1 readiness criteria with functional leaders, track workstreams against plan, and report open gaps to the SteerCo for resolution.

• Build and maintain the critical path for each deal and track cross-functional dependencies.

Integrate and capture value

• Lead post-close integration across Operations, Finance & Accounting, Business Applications, Information Technology (IT) Infrastructure, People Ops, Legal, Safety, Sales & Pre-Con, and Marketing, working with the functional leads who own each workstream. Keep operating data and dashboards working through system changes and cutovers.

• Maintain the synergy tracker jointly with Finance, hold line owners to committed targets, and report progress against the approved case.

• Align each integration plan to the deal thesis and revisit the plan when the deal model or assumptions change.

• Build and track the integration budget for assigned deals.

Communicate and improve

• Prepare SteerCo materials, status reports, and decision requests for executives, regional leaders, and functional leaders, each with the bottom line, risks, and decisions needed. Provide integration inputs to board materials as requested.

• Run a lessons-learned review after each deal milestone and feed the results into the Loenbro deal playbook, templates, and standards.

Ownership and judgment: Makes sequencing, escalation, and resourcing calls on assigned deals without waiting for direction including with incomplete information and knows when to take a decision to SteerCo.

Scalable approach: Sizes plans, governance, and reporting to the deal, and stays within Loenbro norms and playbook assumptions.

Cross-functional influence: Gets commitments from leaders who report elsewhere.

Executive communication: Gives the bottom line first, then risks and decisions needed.

Discretion and follow-through: Protects confidential deal information and closes loops across concurrent deals.

Skills

• Track record of running several workstreams or deals at once, with integration plans, RAID logs, and dependency tracking that other leaders rely on.

• Ability to align cross-functional leaders who do not report to this role.

• Clear, concise written and verbal communication with executives, covering status, risks, and decisions needed.

• Proficiency in analyzing financial statements and deal models to track synergies and the integration budget with Finance.

• Proficiency in understanding how integration touch operations such as systems cutover and consolidation of financial reporting.

• Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and project planning tools.

• Proficiency in consolidating an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS), or field platform during an integration.

• Proficiency with Smartsheet.

• Proficiency with change management and employee communications for acquired businesses including measuring employee sentiment and recommending actions with People Ops.

Qualifications

Required:

• Bachelor's degree in business or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Five to eight years in M&A integration, integration or program management offices, management consulting, or corporate development, including three or more years directly running integration workstreams or an IMO.

• Direct experience on at least one acquisition from signing through Day 1 and into post-close integration, with a clear role in planning and governance.

Preferred:

• Integration experience in construction, electrical, industrial services, energy, or another field-based, multi-site operation.

• Project or program management certification such as Project Management Professional (PMP).

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment:

• Travel up to 25 percent.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO)

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee assistance program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities.  If you’re ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

• Acting with Urgency

• Delivering Excellence

…we want to hear from you.

jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE COMMERCIAL TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Close gigawatt deals faster than anyone on the planet. The customers building frontier AI need capacity now, and the ones who lock it first win. You'll take deals from first conversation to signature at a pace the market can't match.

 - Sign 10s of GW of deals by the end of the decade. Every deal is measured in gigawatts, not megawatts, and the goal is to sign more capacity this decade than anyone in the market.

 - Own everything from LOI to site mobilization. No handoffs, no dropped context. You'll run the whole process, from a signed LOI through to mobilizing the site, and keep it moving the entire way.




ROLE SCOPE

 - Close multi-hundred-megawatt data center leases from LOI to signature in weeks across powered shell, turnkey, build-to-suit, and wholesale colocation capacity.

 - Negotiate the terms that decide whether a lease delivers (rent economics, delivery schedules, energization dates, fit-out splits, expansion rights, ROFO and ROFR, and performance remedies) with landlords and developers who don’t share our urgency.

 - Translate engineering requirements for power density, redundancy, cooling, security, and networking into lease terms so technical gaps are closed at LOI.

 - Quarterback every lease across legal, finance, engineering, and construction with 15+ stakeholders, running the daily rhythm of decisions and escalations that surfaces issues weeks before they hit the schedule.

 - Hand off signed leases to delivery and operations with no dropped terms, then own amendments, expansions, and landlord performance across the portfolio.

Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose: economic empowerment. We build technology that increases access and independence for sellers, individuals, and artists around the world. Working at Block means working on and across our brands—Square, Cash App, Afterpay, TIDAL, Spiral, and Proto— in roles that connect, enable, and push all of them forward faster.

We’re remote-first by design and operate with intelligence at the center of everything we do. At Block, you'll be challenged by some of the brightest, most creative minds in the industry and have the tools and autonomy to do the most meaningful work of your career.

The Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Sales Compensation Systems & Data Engineer to build and maintain the technical foundation of our sales compensation operations. You’ll own data pipelines, integrations, data models, and calculation logic that produce accurate, reliable, and explainable commission results.

You’ll partner with Sales Compensation Operations, Finance, Payroll, and technical teams to translate approved compensation plans and business requirements into tested, maintainable systems.

• Establish access controls, audit trails, and reproducible processing to protect sensitive data and support reconciliation.

You Have

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States; New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)
jobs.description:
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –  Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:

• TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)

• Fortune Change the World (2024)

• CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)

• Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)

• Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)

• Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)

• Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the Role:

As a Senior Executive Assistant, you will support four to five members of Maven’s C-suite and play an important role in helping them use their time effectively. You’ll manage complex calendars, coordinate travel and meetings, anticipate needs, and keep priorities and follow-ups moving. This role calls for strong judgment, discretion, and a calm, proactive approach. You’ll work closely with the executives you support, the broader Executive Assistant team, and partners across Maven to make sure the details are handled and leaders are prepared to focus on the work that matters most.

What you'll do:

• Manage complex calendars and scheduling. Coordinate internal and external meetings across competing priorities, maintain clean calendars, and proactively resolve conflicts. Build in appropriate preparation, travel, and follow-up time.

• Help executives make the best use of their time. Learn their priorities and working styles, flag calendar tradeoffs, identify meetings that may need to be delegated or reconsidered, and surface conflicts or risks early.

• Coordinate meetings from start to finish. Prepare agendas and materials as needed, confirm attendees and logistics, and make sure meeting links, rooms, and technology are ready. Help executives prepare for high-stakes conversations and track resulting follow-ups.

• Manage travel and expenses. Arrange door-to-door travel and accommodations, share clear itineraries and relevant materials in advance, monitor travel changes, and submit expenses promptly in line with company policy.

• Communicate on executives’ behalf. Serve as a thoughtful point of contact for colleagues and external stakeholders. Draft and coordinate clear, concise communications that reflect each executive’s tone and priorities.

• Support board and investor logistics. Coordinate scheduling, materials, and logistics for board meetings, investor interactions, and other external stakeholder engagements, with discretion and care. Place after “Own logistics of events and gatherings.”

• Track work and close loops. Maintain an organized view of open tasks, deadlines, and commitments; keep executives and stakeholders informed; and make sure handoffs have clear owners and next steps. Be comfortable working cross-functionally with teams that your execs depend on.

• Support special projects. Take ownership of selected projects that improve executive operations, team coordination, or the EA team’s shared resources. Identify and implement process improvements for your executives and the EA team.

• Own logistics of events and gatherings. Coordinate executive and team meetings, offsites, dinners, celebrations, and other events, managing logistics and working with internal partners and vendors often on the ground.

• Project manage cross-functional strategic initiatives. Be a key player in project management of key projects within your executive’s teams and function, enabling your exec to ensure effective ways of working with their teams and achieving key strategic goals.

• Use AI thoughtfully to improve how the work gets done. Apply approved AI tools to streamline tasks such as meeting preparation, travel briefs, communications, follow-up tracking, and repeatable workflows. Review AI-generated work for accuracy, use good judgment about what information belongs in which tools, and maintain confidentiality.

What you'll bring:

• 4-6 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, including experience supporting senior or C-suite executives; experience supporting multiple executives is a plus.

• Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several priorities and adapt as plans change.

• Sound judgment and the confidence to ask clarifying questions, make recommendations, and escalate risks or blockers early.

• Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with the ability to shift priorities quickly.

• A proactive and hands-on approach: you anticipate needs, prepare ahead, and follow through without needing repeated reminders.

• Clear, polished communication across email, Slack, meetings, and in-person interactions.

• The discretion and reliability to handle confidential company, personnel, and executive information.

• Responsiveness and reliability. Reachable for urgent matters, with the ability to support executives consistently.

• Experience coordinating complex meetings, travel, and events.

• Comfort using Google Workspace, Slack, project-management tools, and virtual meeting platforms.

• Curiosity about AI and experience using AI tools in your work, or the initiative to learn and apply them responsibly.

• A team player with a collaborative working style, strong accountability, and extreme ownership, who shares knowledge, supports coverage, and helps the EA team work well together.

• Flexibility to adjust your schedule occasionally, including for travel or time-zone differences, to meet business needs or time-sensitive changes.

The base salary range for this role is $128,000 - $150,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

This role requires active work authorization in the US.

Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week  (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend monthly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

• Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.

• Whole-self care through wellness partnerships

• Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days

• 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)

• Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens

• 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.

Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com. For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Overview

AvidXchange is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to build best-in-class products. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as Product and Architecture, to analyze, design, develop, test, maintain, and implement premier software solutions.

What You'll Do

• Perform full life cycle application development, enhancement, research, and proof of concepts.

• Write and refine specifications that drive design, implementation, and testing as part of our Spec-Driven Development (SDD) practice.

• Use AI-assisted development tools daily to design, build, test, and review code, and validate every AI-generated output for correctness, security, and maintainability.

• Help shape our move to agentic use cases by identifying where AI agents can improve our products and engineering workflows, and by building proofs of concept to test those ideas.

• Share effective AI development practices, prompts, and patterns with the team, and help set standards for responsible AI use.

• Participate in both low-level and high-level application design, providing guidance and feedback on available technology options.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement API integrations for seamless data exchange.

• Develop and maintain modern pipelines that use data streaming and APIs to support various business applications.

• Implement event-driven architectures to improve real-time data processing and streamline data flows for timely decision-making.

• Implement cross-domain solutions, including integration patterns for customer-facing, operational, and analytic systems, along with workflows, policies, support, and reporting associated with enterprise MDM capabilities.

• Collaborate with other developers and architects to determine the best solutions for architecture, efficiency, maintainability, and scalability.

• Follow DevOps principles such as CI/CD to automate and streamline data engineering workflows.

• Support Solution and Enterprise Architects in the design, review, and implementation of new architectural solutions.

• Mentor Software Engineers, including onboarding, explaining domain knowledge, teaching best practices (including effective AI-assisted development), and performing code reviews.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize code to ensure strong performance and security.

• Work closely with QA to review, approve, and design test cases, ensuring all requirements are met.

• Support Product Management in creating product roadmaps and ensuring quarterly objectives are realistic and achievable.

• Collaborate with other product development teams to create alignment and consistency across projects.

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 10+ years of .NET software development experience creating SaaS-based applications.

• Hands-on experience using AI development tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) in your daily work, with examples of how they improved speed, quality, or both.

• Strong prompt and context engineering skills, including the ability to guide AI tools with clear requirements, constraints, and acceptance criteria.

• Experience working from written specifications, with a track record of turning requirements into well-defined, testable work. Familiarity with Spec-Driven Development is strongly preferred.

• Sound judgment in reviewing AI-generated code for defects, security risks, licensing concerns, and fit with existing architecture.

• Strong knowledge of .NET, C#, Visual Studio, HTML, JSON, Entity Framework, and SSIS/T-SQL.

• Experience designing and building APIs and event-driven services, including REST and other modern API styles (such as GraphQL or gRPC), API-first design with OpenAPI, and asynchronous messaging patterns.

• Experience developing and integrating RESTful APIs, including authentication and authorization (such as OAuth 2.0), versioning, and contract testing.

• Experience with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka, Azure Service Bus, and Azure Event Hubs, including event schemas, idempotent processing, and error handling for failed messages.

• Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure.

• Understanding of DevOps principles and CI/CD practices.

• Strong interpersonal, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.

• Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

Nice to Have

• Experience building agentic solutions, such as AI agents that plan, call tools, and complete multi-step tasks.

• Experience with agentic development workflows, including running coding agents, orchestrating multiple agents, and setting up guardrails and review checkpoints.

• Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), including building or integrating MCP servers and tools.

• Experience integrating large language model APIs into production applications, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and vector databases.

• Experience evaluating AI output quality, including building test suites, evals, and monitoring for AI-enabled features.

• Knowledge of AI security and governance practices, including data privacy, prompt injection risks, and responsible AI use in a regulated, financial services setting.

About AvidXchange

AvidXchange is a leading provider of accounts payable (“AP”) automation software and payment solutions for middle-market businesses and their suppliers. By trade, we are a technology company, but if you ask anyone who works here, they’ll tell you our people are at the core of who we are. At AvidXchange, mindset is everything. We are Connected as People, Growth Minded, and Customer Obsessed. AvidXchange is proud to be Certified™ as a Great Place to Work®. The prestigious recognition is based on anonymous data from our teammates and makes official what our teammates have known for years – that AvidXchange is a Great Place to Work®.

Who you are:

What you’ll get:

AvidXchange teammates (we call them AvidXers) get the perks and prestige of a growing tech company paired with the flexibility of a founder-led startup.
