jobs.title: Project Manager (Data Center)
jobs.description:
Join the Team!

Is technology your passion? Do you want to work with smart, forward-thinking individuals? Do you want to grow in a career you love?

At Align, our professionals are the key to our success. We don’t just hire talent, we invest in exceptional people who are forward-thinking, results-driven, and passionate about what they do. We’re a group of tech-savvy professionals who are motivated by making an impact. Our culture is one of unbounded opportunity that celebrates the passions, skills and ideas of our team—work hard, play hard, be smart!

We believe great communities lead to great companies. That’s why we offer a dynamic workplace where you feel inspired, engaged and innovative. We offer professionals opportunities to train in the leading technologies, make an impact within the industry and acquire valuable new skills whether on client sites or in one of our regional offices.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Construction Manager to oversee the fit-out of hyperscale data center white space within colocation environments. This role is responsible for managing all aspects of tenant fit-out construction, including coordination of trades, sequencing of work, quality control, and delivery of mission-critical infrastructure.

The ideal candidate has strong construction management experience in data centers, with a solid understanding of white space infrastructure such as containment systems, overhead conveyance (including ladder racks and cable tray systems), structural support frameworks, and cooling components (HVAC). Familiarity with structured cabling systems (low voltage and fiber) is a plus.

• This is a full-time salaried position offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, paid time off, paid training and performance-based bonuses.

• This position is based in the Atlanta metro area and will work onsite for local data center projects. Approximately 50% travel outside of the Georgia area should be expected at times.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead on-site construction management for data center white space fit-out projects

• Oversee installation of: Hot aisle / cold aisle containment systems Overhead cable tray systems and ladder rack conveyance Structural support systems for cabinets, racks, cable trays, and electrical power distribution infrastructure Cooling infrastructure, including HVAC units Power distribution from PDU down to cabinet level

• Manage trade contractors and ensure proper sequencing of work (e.g., structural supports → overhead conveyance → electrical distribution → cabling → containment) to maintain schedule and avoid conflicts

• Coordinate with general contractors, subcontractors, and client stakeholders

• Enforce quality control (QC) processes to ensure installations meet design specifications, load requirements, and industry standards

• Monitor project schedule, budget, and progress; proactively identify and resolve risks/issues

• Ensure compliance with safety standards and site protocols

• Review construction drawings, submittals, RFIs, and shop drawings related to supports and overhead systems

• Verify proper installation tolerances, anchoring, and support systems for overhead infrastructure

• Support commissioning and handover processes

Required Qualifications

• 5-10+ years of construction management experience, preferably in mission-critical or data center environments

• Proven experience managing white space fit-out / tenant improvement projects in colocation or hyperscale data centers

• Strong understanding of construction sequencing, trade coordination, and site management

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple subcontractors and deliver projects on schedule

• Strong knowledge of QA/QC processes, including inspection of support systems and overhead installations

• Project Management skills including scheduling and budgeting

• Candidate must have strong problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Strong stakeholder and client communication

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with low voltage cabling (LVC) and/or fiber optic infrastructure within data centers

• Procore experience is strongly preferred

• Working knowledge of structured cabling systems, pathways, and routing within overhead conveyance systems

• RCDD-level knowledge or experience with structured cabling design standards (e.g., setting or enforcing standards)

• Experience coordinating structural support systems with electrical and mechanical trades

• Experience in commissioning or turnover of data center white space environments

To support a fair, consistent, and high-quality hiring experience, some interviews may be recorded. These recordings help our team focus fully on the conversation at hand, rather than note-taking, and allow us to better evaluate and improve our recruitment process. Recordings are used solely for internal purposes such as training, quality assurance, and process improvement. Candidates will be informed in advance and asked to provide consent before any recording takes place.

Benefits and Perks:

At Align, we believe that supporting our employees both personally and professionally is key to our success. We offer a competitive benefits package designed to promote health, wellness, financial security, and work-life balance, including:

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

• Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options 401(k) plan with a dollar-for-dollar company match at 3% up to an annual maximum of $5k.

• Complimentary ClassPass membership to support your health and wellness goals

• Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Company-paid holidays

• Cellphone Reimbursement Program

• Floating Holiday to celebrate a day that is meaningful to you

• Pre-tax commuter benefits, where applicable

• Employee wellness programs, events, and team-building activities

• Employee referral program

Align is a premier global provider of technology infrastructure solutions.

Align specializes in designing and deploying technology infrastructure solutions from the data center to the desktop as well as providing managed IT services for clients.

Our professional services team, which includes Data Center Solutions, provide strategic consulting, design, project management, engineering, implementation and support. Our best-in-class Managed Services team provides IT services and cybersecurity advisory for clients within the Alternative Investment industry. Align is a Microsoft Tier 1 Cloud Solutions Provider (CSP) and Gold Partner.

Our client centric approach and passion for driving IT innovation has enabled us to provide tailored solutions and business transformations for over three decades. Leading firms have relied on Align to provide forward-thinking technology strategies that support their current and future business needs.

Our teams have flawless track records of delivering technical solutions and have established long-standing relationships with an impressive client list of both Global 1000 and SMB clients. We work across a diverse list of industries including financial services, life sciences (pharmaceutical and health care), retail, technology, media and telecommunications.

For more information, visit: www.align.com

jobs.title: Mid to Senior Construction Project Manager
jobs.description:

Unlock Your Potential

$110,000 - $140,000 per year (commensurate with experience)

jobs.title: Customer Support Engineer II
jobs.description:
A career that’s the whole package!

At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.

Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

Reports to: Manager, Customer Support

Location: Sofia, Bulgaria - hybrid

Working hours: Monday to Friday: 8 hours between 07:00 and 18:00. Weekend: stand-by and call-out work on a rota system.

A Quick Snapshot…

Conga’s Product Support Engineers are critical to the overall success of Conga, our customers and business partners. You will provide product support for a Conga custom built product used within Salesforce, serving a global customer base in a fast-paced software environment. By understanding the customer’s break/fix issue you will successfully troubleshoot it to resolution, delivering the highest quality support possible to build, maintain and improve customer satisfaction. The team provides Tier 1 and Tier 2 support.

Why it’s a big deal…

You will have the opportunity to help our customers in EMEA and around the world, using our tools and technologies to make their lives easier. You will get a great sense of satisfaction in resolving their issues. We measure our success by our customer satisfaction.

What you’ll do…

Provide timely and professional product support to our global customer base, collaborating and communicating with customer users in line with Conga’s standard support procedures and communication guidance.

Triage customer-reported incidents, research them and isolate them into a reproducible format, then resolve them or escalate to other teams as necessary.

Organize and lead live working sessions with customers to resolve critical issues and requests.

Learn and follow Conga’s internal processes for handling customer issues and requests.

Develop and customize reports, queries and tools to improve working efficiency.

Participate in QA activities and review documentation for accuracy.

Review customer training materials and suggest improvements.

Learn how to use the product from the customer’s perspective.

Exceed departmental service level metrics and provide feedback to improve service levels.

Represent the customer support team in collaboration with other internal departments.

Are you the person we’re looking for?

Strong troubleshooting skills and logical thinking are your forte. This is an absolute must. Your proven ability to solve complex problems and apply logical thinking to determine the root cause of an issue is fundamental to success in this role.

You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline and have 1-3 years’ experience in technical support, which has prepared you to effectively investigate technical issues, prioritize and escalate as needed, to ensure timely resolutions that are in line with client SLAs. You have a working knowledge of SQL with Microsoft SQL Server.

Customer centric.  You have a dedicated focus on customer success. Relating to customers comes easy to you and you genuinely enjoy interacting with customers and strive to make every customer interaction a positive experience. You will provide proactive best practice guidance and advocate customers’ priorities internally within Conga.

Communication.  You have excellent written and verbal communication skills with proven ability to initiate and manage relationships via phone and email. Communicating complex technical topics with users at all levels of technical expertise is one of your strengths.

Natural collaborator.  You work effectively with developers, product managers and fellow engineers. You are comfortable collaborating on best practices across multiple teams. You constantly seek opinions and solicit feedback to create the best work possible. It’s a team effort and you totally appreciate that.

Desire.  You have a proven ability to learn new technologies quickly and you are keen to continuously develop your technical skills.  Training on Conga products will be provided.

What will give you an edge?

Experience supporting and/or administering in the Salesforce ecosystem.

Working knowledge of the Microsoft Azure platform.

Experience in OOD/OOP with Java.

Experience working with XML and XSL.

Experience working with OLAP and MDX.

Experience with UI technologies such as JavaScript and Flex (ActionScript).

A second European language.

Did we pique your interest?

If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!

Preferred Resume Format

We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.

Don’t meet every requirement for the role?

Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Additional Information

Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.

Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement

The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.

jobs.title: Montesori Toddler Teacher/Guide
jobs.description:
Help toddlers discover who they are and what they can do.

At Guidepost Montessori, our Lead Toddler Guides create calm, purposeful environments where curiosity, independence, and confidence grow every day.

If you’re passionate about early childhood development and ready to lead a classroom designed for exploration and independence, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Your Role

As a Lead Toddler Guide, you’ll lead a 2-3 toddler classroom in a Montessori environment thoughtfully designed to support children during one of the most formative stages of development.

Montessori guides prepare beautiful, orderly environments that invite exploration and support independence. Through careful observation, individualized lessons, and respectful guidance, you’ll help each child develop language, coordination, self-regulation, and confidence.

Your leadership will empower toddlers to explore freely, make choices, and take pride in what they can accomplish laying the foundation for lifelong learning.

What You’ll Do

• Observe each child closely to understand and support their physical, emotional, and cognitive development

• Prepare and maintain a beautiful, orderly classroom that fosters focus, independence, and exploration

• Support independence by encouraging toddlers to “do it themselves”

• Provide lessons in practical life skills, language development, and grace and courtesy

• Build warm, trusting relationships with children and families

• Communicate and collaborate with parents to support each child’s growth

• Lead classroom routines and collaborate with team members to create a respectful, joyful community

The Montessori Prepared Environment

Every Guidepost toddler classroom is fully equipped with high-quality Montessori materials and designed according to the principles of beauty, order, and independence.

Our toddler environments feature:

• Open spaces that encourage movement and exploration

• Child-sized furniture and tools to support independence

• Curriculum that builds skills in dressing, feeding, and toilet learning

• Scientifically designed materials for fine and gross motor development

• Natural elements including cozy rugs, real plants, and abundant light

• Beautiful, breakable materials made from wood, metal, and glass

• Opportunities to climb, crawl, and explore without restrictive devices

What We’re Looking For

• Interest in pursuing fully sponsored Montessori certification through our Prepared Montessorian Institute, or a previously earned Montessori diploma

• Experience working with children ages 0–3 in a group care or early learning setting

• Alignment with child-led educational approaches (Montessori, Reggio Emilia, or similar)

• Required ECE or Child Development credits

• Bachelor’s degree (Child related field)

What We Offer

• Sponsored Montessori diploma training and ongoing professional development

• Competitive salary: $40,000 - $50,000 depending on education and experience

• Health, dental, and vision insurance

• Paid time off and paid holidays

• 75% tuition discount for up to two children at any Guidepost school

• A collaborative, supportive network of peers and mentors

• Clear opportunities for career growth and leadership advancement

About Guidepost Montessori

Guidepost Montessori is a growing network of over 100 schools across the U.S. and Asia, serving children from 3 months to 6 years old in our Nido, Toddler, and Children’s House programs.

We believe children are capable and we intentionally design environments that empower them to explore, grow, and flourish. Our mission is to transform education by nurturing independence, joy, and lifelong learning.

If you’re inspired by toddler development, excited to partner with families, and ready to lead with purpose, we’d love to welcome you to Guidepost Montessori.

Apply today and help toddlers take their next big steps.

Guidepost Global Education and Guidepost Montessori are committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO). We will not discriminate on the basis of age, sex, race, color, creed, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, alienage or citizenship, disability, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under applicable federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances. Our leadership is dedicated to ensuring the fulfillment of this policy. When requested, we are committed to reasonably accommodate employees and applicants with disabilities or special needs that may require an accommodation.

jobs.title: Career Navigator
jobs.description:
Career Team is a leading workforce development organization on a mission to transform lives.  We blend cutting-edge technology with compassionate, high-touch services to drive real, measurable outcomes in the lives of job seekers across the country.  At Career Team, we’re solving today’s unemployment challenges with smart software, world-class trainers, dedicated case managers, dynamic job developers, and innovative partners. If you're passionate about making a difference and believe in the power of technology to transform lives, you’ll feel right at home here.

Career Team is looking to hire a dynamic Career Navigator to work with adults from Ventura County, CA  to provide career counseling and intensive case management for the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA) program. In this role, you will work with WIOA  Unemployed and Underemployed Adult/Dislocated Job Seeker customers. The Career Navigator will be able to work well autonomously, and within a team to be able to maintain and strengthen partnerships with existing partners.

The WIOA Career Navigator  is an integral part of our team and will assist us with our mission of accelerating the human condition!

Your Impact on Career Team's Success:

• Provide intensive case management services to registered customers within the One-Stop system

• Complete intake and eligibility determination for the workforce program. Assess jobseekers’ employment and training needs and abilities through interviewing, testing and other methods

• Enter data into and otherwise use and process clients through the Career Edge data systems

• Assist all clients to complete career assessments and to develop a comprehensive Individual Employment Plan (IEP)

• Counsel clients on available job opportunities, training programs, and other services;

• Complete Individual Training Account (ITA) vouchers, and other documents required for clients entering training

• Refer individuals to appropriate services, training programs or job opportunities and follow-up on those activities

• Conduct orientation sessions, workshops, job clubs and other group presentations for clients

• Follow all policies, procedures and regulations related to eligibility documentation to ensure that case files have originals and/or copies of required documents for service delivery.

• Maintain accurate individual case files for each registered customer assuring that each file contains all required eligibility documents and meets compliance requirements

• Provide referral and tracking of eligible customers into contracted programs provided on-site at the One-Stop centers and/or located in the community in accordance with established contracts

• Meet and/or exceed program benchmarks. Participate in all staff related events as required including but not limited to: training, staff meetings and individual supervision

• Complete all required reports

• Approach each day and task with a “ZAG” mindset

• Other duties and projects as needed

The Ideal Qualifications Include:

• High School Diploma/GED or higher

• Working knowledge of WIOA

• 2+ years of work experience combining elements of training, counseling, case management, or other services

• 2+ years of case management experience and the ability to read and interpret policies and procedures

• 2+ years of experience with computer proficiency in Microsoft Office suite and Google suite including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Google Mail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Drive

• 2+ years of demonstrated ability working in a dynamic team environment with an aptitude for communication, interpersonal skills to work cooperatively with others, show courteousness, and having a high level of professionalism

• Experience in recruiting or marketing services

• Experience and knowledge of workforce and/or government contracts/programs

• A demonstrated ability to work in a variety of settings with a culturally-diverse customer base with the ability to be culturally sensitive

• A demonstrated ability to serve as a role model to customers and motivate them towards achieving goals

• Exceptional time management skills to meet deadlines and work under pressure

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• A Valid Driver’s License

Hourly Rate:  $28-$32/hr

Travel: Position may require local travel up to 30% of the time

Position Type: Non-Exempt, full-time

About Career Team:
Founded in 1996, Career Team, LLC is a private workforce development organization.

Career Team’s outstanding record of building the modern infrastructure powering America's workforce has resulted in numerous honors:

• Named by Inc. Magazine as one of America's 500 fastest growing privately held companies

• Recipient of the US Chamber of Commerce Blue Chip Enterprise Award for innovation

• Featured by 60 Minutes, CNN, Money Magazine, Inc. Magazine and the British Broadcasting Network as an innovative, government funded solutions program

• Invited to the White House after being cited by the National Welfare-to-Work Partnership and National Alliance of Business as a top 10 US training provider

As a socially conscious organization, Career Team has found a healthy balance between for-profit innovation and community enrichment. Looking ahead, the organization will continue to close the nation’s opportunity divide with additional government-funded workforce sites; while also building staff capacity of workforce funding sources and industry providers. See www.careerteam.com for more information.

Career Team is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Background Check Requirements. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check (including criminal, prior employment and education verification). Failure to satisfactorily complete the background check may affect the application status of applicants or continued employment of current employees who apply for the position.

California Consumer Privacy Act ("CCPA").  Career Team is committed to complying with the CCPA and all data privacy and laws in the jurisdictions in which it recruits and hires employees. Career Team collects and uses Personal Information for human resources, employment, benefits administration, health and safety, and business-related purposes and to be in legal compliance. Below are the categories of Personal Information we collect and the purposes for which we intend to use this information:

jobs.title: Community Lead
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Team

Product Marketing & Growth bridges product innovation and market adoption at CoreWeave. Within it, Developer Relations builds technical credibility with the people who build AI: the researchers, ML engineers, and AI application developers who use CoreWeave including CoreWeave Forge and all its capabilities on a daily basis. The team runs community programs, community events, education and certifications, hero programs, and the feedback loops in person and via platforms like Discord that turn product usage into advocacy and advocacy into adoption.

As Community Lead, you will own CoreWeave’s developer community end to end: the strategy, the spaces where builders gather, the programs that turn power users into champions, and the metrics that prove community drives adoption. Few companies give one person a community that spans the full AI stack, from experiment tracking, evaluation, and fine-tuning tools to the GPU cloud that trains and serves frontier models. This is a senior individual contributor role with the potential to grow into a management role. You will set the standard for how CoreWeave shows up for developers, partnering with Evangelists, Developer Experience, Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Brand, and Field Marketing.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the developer community strategy across Weights & Biases, OpenPipe, and the CoreWeave platform: one community architecture, clear member journeys, and annual goals tied to growth and diversity across new personas like AI engineers.

• Build and run the spaces where AI builders gather (Discord, Slack, forums, GitHub Discussions, and in-person meetups in hubs such as San Francisco, New York, Seattle, and London), with moderation standards, response SLAs, and escalation paths agreed with Support and Engineering.

• Design, launch, and scale a champion and ambassador program covering recruitment criteria, tiers, incentives, and contribution paths, so power users, researchers, and open-source maintainers become credible advocates.

• Plan and run hackathons, workshops, and community events, online and in person, around product launches and major moments on the AI developer calendar such as NeurIPS, KubeCon, and PyTorch Conference.

• Partner with Product Marketing on launches: recruit beta cohorts, drive day-one community activation, and feed early developer reaction into positioning.

• Run the developer feedback loop: turn community sentiment, feature requests, and friction points into a recurring readout for Product and Engineering, and close the loop publicly when changes ship.

• Define and report community metrics that connect to the business, including active members, contributor growth, time to first response, community-sourced sign-ups, and activation and retention of community-engaged users.

• Build community operations: tooling and analytics, CRM integration, playbooks, and governance. Mentor community operations partners and set the quality bar for community programs across the team.

• Represent CoreWeave in the AI developer ecosystem, including open-source communities, agent framework and model provider communities, and developer-focused events such as AI Engineer World's Fair, NVIDIA GTC, NeurIPS, and KubeCon.

• Build relationships with developer-facing partners and community leaders to run joint programs, co-hosted events, and content collaborations.

• Shape the developer track at CoreWeave's own event, Fully Connected, in partnership with the events and product marketing teams.

Qualifications:

• 8+ years in developer community, developer relations, or developer marketing, including 4+ years building and leading community programs for a technical, developer-facing product (AI/ML, cloud, data, or open source).

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• A quantified track record of growing a developer community (for example, 10,000+ members), with measurable gains in engagement, contribution, or product adoption.

• Owned a champion, ambassador, or MVP program from design through launch and scale.

• Ran developer events end to end (hackathons, meetups, workshops), including budget ownership and post-event reporting.

• Hands-on experience with community platforms (Discord, Slack, Discourse, GitHub) and community analytics tools (such as Common Room or an equivalent), including dashboards that tie community activity to funnel metrics.

• Working technical fluency in the AI/ML developer workflow (Python, notebooks, model training or fine-tuning, evaluation, or agents), enough to take part credibly in technical threads and review technical content.

• Built structured feedback loops with Product and Engineering that led to shipped product changes.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience with AI developer tooling such as experiment tracking, LLM observability and evaluation, fine-tuning and RL, or notebooks, or with ML infrastructure.

• Experience with open-source communities, including maintainer relationships, contributor programs, and GitHub governance.

• Public technical presence through conference talks, livestreams, workshops, or technical blogs.

• Built academic or research community programs, such as university partnerships or research credit programs.

• Unified multiple product communities into one, for example after an acquisition or platform consolidation, at a high-growth AI, cloud, or developer-tools company.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

• Be Curious at Your Core

• Act Like an Owner

• Empower Employees

• Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences

• Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base salary range for this role is $198,000 to $300,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave

• Company-paid Life Insurance

• Voluntary supplemental life insurance

• Short and long-term disability insurance

• Flexible Spending Account

• Health Savings Account

• Tuition Reimbursement

• Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

• Family-Forming support provided by Carrot

• Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside

• 401(k) with a generous employer match

• Flexible PTO

• Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations

• A casual work environment

• A work culture focused on innovative disruption

California Applicants

California Consumer Privacy Act

All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. Any such access will be provided only in compliance with applicable U.S. export control requirements. jobs.title: Customer Support Engineer I
jobs.description:
A career that’s the whole package!

At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.

Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

Reports to: Manager, Customer Support

Location: Sofia, Bulgaria - hybrid

Working hours: Monday to Friday: 8 hours between 07:00 and 18:00. Weekend: stand-by and call-out work on a rota system.

A Quick Snapshot…

Conga’s Product Support Engineers are critical to the overall success of Conga, our customers and business partners. You will provide product support for a Conga custom built product used within Salesforce, serving a global customer base in a fast-paced software environment. By understanding the customer’s break/fix issue you will troubleshoot it to resolution, delivering the highest quality support possible to build, maintain and improve customer satisfaction. The team provides Tier 1 and Tier 2 support.

Why it’s a big deal…

You will have the opportunity to help our customers in EMEA and around the world, using our tools and technologies to make their lives easier. You will get a great sense of satisfaction in resolving their issues. We measure our success by our customer satisfaction.

What you’ll do…

Provide timely and professional product support to our global customer base, collaborating and communicating with customer users in line with Conga’s standard support procedures and communication guidance.

Under guidance from senior team members, triage customer-reported incidents, research them and isolate them into a reproducible format, then resolve them or escalate to other teams as necessary.

Learn and follow Conga’s internal processes for handling customer issues and requests.

Participate in QA activities and review documentation for accuracy.

Learn how to use the product from the customer’s perspective.

Exceed departmental service level metrics and provide feedback to improve service levels.

Are you the person we’re looking for?

Strong analytical skills and logical thinking are your forte. This is an absolute must. Your ability to solve complex problems and apply logical thinking to determine the root cause of an issue is fundamental to success in this role.

You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, and you are ready to learn how to investigate technical issues, prioritize and escalate as needed, to ensure timely resolutions that are in line with client SLAs.

Customer centric.  You have a dedicated focus on customer success. Relating to customers comes easy to you and you genuinely enjoy interacting with customers and strive to make every customer interaction a positive experience. You will advocate customers’ priorities internally within Conga.

Communication.  You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with customers via phone and email. You can explain complex technical topics to users at all levels of technical expertise.

Natural collaborator.  You work effectively with developers, product managers and fellow engineers. You constantly seek opinions and solicit feedback to create the best work possible. It’s a team effort and you totally appreciate that.

Desire.  You have a proven ability to learn new technologies quickly and you are keen to continuously develop your technical skills.  Training on Conga products will be provided.

What will give you an edge?

Experience supporting and/or administering in the Salesforce ecosystem.

Working knowledge of SQL with Microsoft SQL Server.

Working knowledge of the Microsoft Azure platform.

Experience in OOD/OOP with Java.

Experience working with XML and XSL.

Experience working with OLAP and MDX.

Experience with UI technologies such as JavaScript and Flex (ActionScript).

A second European language.

Did we pique your interest?

If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!

Preferred Resume Format

We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.

Don’t meet every requirement for the role?

Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Additional Information

Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.

Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement

The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.

jobs.title: Government Pre-Sales Engineer
jobs.location: Huntsville, Alabama, United States; McLean, Virginia, United States; Richmond, Virginia, United States
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Exiger is the AI partner for supply chain and procurement automation. Its centralized 1EXIGER.AI platform allows organizations to manage their entire operating network, from parts to suppliers, regulators, and customers, through an autonomous agentic workforce that learns, adapts, and augments with every decision. The AI-native platform, combined with the largest supply chain knowledge asset, empowers 550+ global customers, including 150 Fortune 500 and 80+ government and defense industrial organizations, to act first. Exiger is FedRAMP® authorized and a 2x Leader in Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management.

Government Pre-Sales Engineer

Location: McLean, VA, Richmond, VA, or Huntsville, AL
Work Environment: Hybrid

Role Summary:

Exiger helps companies and government agencies find and act on risk in their supply chains. Customers use the 1Exiger platform to map suppliers below the first tier, screen them for foreign ownership, financial, and cyber risk, and monitor the parts, materials, and software they depend on. Our Government business brings that capability to federal, defense, and state and local missions.

We are hiring a Government Pre-Sales Engineer to serve as the technical partner to our Government Sales team. You will bring domain expertise in government supply chain and mission problems, learn each customer’s problem firsthand, and build working solutions that show how Exiger’s platform, data, and AI capabilities solve it.

Customers now expect working, AI-built answers on their own data. In this role you will co-develop those solutions with customers and with Exiger’s Product and Engineering teams, from the first discovery call through deal close, supporting Federal Civilian, Defense, Intelligence Community, state and local, and Defense Industrial Base customers.

What You’ll Do:

• Own the technical pre-sales motion for U.S. Government customers from the first discovery call through deal close

• Act as a subject matter expert on government supply chain and mission problems, with customers and inside Exiger

• Lead discovery to understand each customer’s mission, problem, and desired outcome before any demonstration

• Build working prototypes and proofs of value on customer data, using AI tools to move from idea to solution quickly

• Co-develop new solutions with customers, Product, and Engineering, and turn what works into reusable assets and playbooks

• Partner with Account Executives and capture teams to qualify pursuits and focus effort where Exiger can win

• Lead the technical response to RFPs and RFIs with clear, accurate answers to what the customer asked

• Translate government regulatory, security, and procurement requirements into solution designs customers can adopt

What You Need:

• 5 to 10 or more years of experience in solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, data integrations, enterprise architecture, or technical consulting, supporting U.S. Government customers

• Domain expertise in one or more of: supply chain risk management (SCRM), defense acquisition and sustainment, parts and bill of materials data, third-party risk, or software supply chain security

• Hands-on ability to build technical solutions yourself using data integration, APIs, analytics tools, and AI, with the discipline to verify the output

• Interest in co-innovation: you want to create new solutions with customers and product teams as well as present existing ones

• Experience running customer discovery and supporting complex, multi-stakeholder, RFP-driven sales cycles, including demos, proofs of concept, and technical evaluations. Experience with MEDDPICC or a similar qualification method is a plus

• Understanding of government procurement processes and compliance requirements such as FedRAMP, CMMC, NIST, DFARS, and ITAR

• Ability to explain technical concepts in clear, mission-oriented terms, in writing and in person, for both technical and non-technical audiences

• Sound judgment and the ability to manage several pursuits at once on short deadlines

• U.S. citizenship is required; active security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain a clearance is preferred

Why Exiger:

• Work on federal and defense programs where supply chain decisions affect mission readiness

• Own the technical side of priority government pursuits from the first call to close

• Build new AI-based solutions alongside product and engineering teams, with customers as partners

• Help shape how Exiger shows up technically across the U.S. Government market

Why You’ll Love Working at Exiger:

• High-performance culture rooted in accountability, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence

• Discretionary Time Off for all employees, with no maximum limits on time off

• Industry-leading health, vision, and dental benefits

• Competitive compensation package

• 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

• Flexible, hybrid approach to working from home and in the office where applicable

• Focus on wellness and employee health through stipends and dedicated wellness programming

• Purposeful career development programs with reimbursement provided for educational certifications

#Li-Hybrid

Exiger is named a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management, twice selected as one of Fast Company's 'Brands That Matter,' and recipient of the Third Party Risk Association's Innovator Award, Exiger's technology has been recognized by leading analyst evaluations and 50+ awards. Learn more at Exiger.com and follow Exiger on LinkedIn.

At Exiger, our values define how we work and why we lead. We are mission-inspired, imagination-driven, trust-anchored, and compassion-focused—committed to building technology that makes the world safer, more transparent, and more resilient.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Director, People Business Partner, Product and Technology
jobs.description:
About the role

Convera is looking for a Director, People Business Partner for Product and Technology. Supporting the Chief Operating Officer and the Product and Technology Leadership team, this role translates Convera's Product & Technology strategy into an integrated organization, workforce and talent agenda that enables innovation, execution and sustainable growth.
As a trusted advisor to senior leaders, the Director PBP helps shape the organization required for the future, ensuring Convera has the right structure, leadership, capabilities and talent to deliver its Product & Technology priorities. The role leads and influences organization design and effectiveness, strategic workforce planning, talent and succession, leadership effectiveness, performance, transformation, employee relations and culture across a globally distributed organization.
The Director PBP brings both a Product & Technology and enterprise perspective to decisions, balancing immediate business requirements with Convera's longer-term capability and talent needs. Working across the People organization, the role serves as the integrator of People solutions for Product & Technology.

This is a senior individual contributor role, reporting directly to the SVP, People, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Chief Operating Officer (COO.)

Key responsibilities:

• Serve as the strategic People advisor to the COO and Product & Technology leadership team, aligning talent, workforce and organizational priorities to business strategy.

• Lead organization design and effectiveness initiatives, including operating model evolution, restructuring and transformation programs.

• Develop and deliver strategic workforce plans, ensuring the right skills, leadership capability, locations and resources are in place to support business growth.

• Own the Product & Technology talent agenda, including talent reviews, succession planning, leadership pipelines, retention strategies and critical talent risk management.

• Partner with leaders to navigate AI, automation and evolving ways of working, redesigning roles, teams and processes to improve productivity and effectiveness.

• Drive leadership capability, performance and accountability through executive coaching, organizational health initiatives and high-performance culture development.

• Provide expert guidance on complex employee relations, change management and organizational challenges across a global workforce.

Key requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Psychology or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Extensive, proven HR experience, including significant HR Business Partnering support for senior and executive leaders.

• Experience supporting Product, Engineering, Technology or other complex technical organizations within global, matrixed environments

• Strong expertise in organization design, workforce planning, talent management, succession planning and organizational transformation.

• Proven track record in leading large-scale change, restructuring and operation model transformation initiatives.

• Strong business acumen, analytical capability and executive-level influencing, coaching and stakeholder management skills.

Convera is a global leader in commercial payments. From small businesses to CFOs and treasurers, we’re helping our customers grow with confidence. Convera makes business payments simple, smart, and secure.

Our teams care deeply about the value we deliver to our customers, which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we expand our team with growth-minded, results-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment.

As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.

We offer an abundance of competitive perks and benefits including:

• Competitive salary package

• Great career growth and development opportunities in a global organization

• Corporate benefits programme

• There are plenty of amazing opportunities at Convera for talented, creative problem solvers who are customer champions and are looking to transform business payments.

Apply now!

Pay Transparency Statement

Convera is committed to pay transparency and equity in accordance with applicable U.S. state and local laws. For this position, the expected base salary range is $195K - $217K per year, depending on factors such as experience, qualifications, and geographic location. We use a tiered geographic pay system to ensure fairness across regions. Candidates in high-cost areas may receive higher offers within the posted range.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, which may include:

Final compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process and may vary based on individual circumstances and business needs.

Schedule:

If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 836-4911, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?

• Paint Prepper (min 6 months professional experience): prepare vehicles for cosmetic paintwork, including sanding, masking, taping, bagging, unbagging/tear down, and buffing

• Entry-Level Painter (min 1 year professional experience): prime vehicles and perform final sanding before the vehicle is painted, along with buffing, touch-up, paint mixing, and airbrush.

jobs.title: Lead Maintenance Technician, Silicon Packaging (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LEAD MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN, SILICON PACKAGING (STARLINK)

One of the most ambitious missions that SpaceX has undertaken to date, the Starlink satellite constellation, is our solution for providing reliable internet to the entire world. In true SpaceX fashion, Starlink is taking the next step in vertical integration by bringing integrated circuit packaging and assembly in-house for development and manufacturing. You will work closely with silicon packaging technicians, process and equipment engineers, equipment manufacturers, and leadership to keep packaging tools running at high uptime, yield, and safety.

The success of Starlink depends on the quality, reliability, cost, manufacturability, throughput, and security of the products that you deliver. If you seek a fast-paced, dynamic environment; if you thrive on solving difficult problems where resolutions have a high impact; and if you love the challenge of building something from scratch, then this role will be an ideal next career step.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Provide training and mentorship to a growing team of highly skilled silicon packaging maintenance technicians

• Serve as a primary path for escalating equipment downtime, safety, and reliability events, and for elevating and removing blockers to daily production targets

• Own preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance for silicon packaging equipment; plan and execute PM schedules that protect uptime and process capability

• Partner with engineering to drive equipment reliability, MTBF/MTTR improvement, spare-parts strategy, and root-cause analysis of recurring failures

• Provide daily status updates on tool health, open work orders, and issues impacting production target attainment

• Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain surface mount technology, automated optical inspection, reflow, aqueous deflux, convection and vacuum bake, compression molding, laser marking, ball grid array, tape mount, singulation, physical vapor deposition, vision, and pick-and-place machines

• Diagnose and restore process tools that support uniformity, interface adhesion, and contamination control, including systems used with scanning acoustic microscopy, 3D profilometers, ellipsometers, reflectometers, and X-ray metrology

• Maintain dicing saws, laser dicers, and plasma etching tools used for mechanical, laser, or hybrid singulation of wafers, substrates, printed circuit boards, and mechanical subassemblies

• Monitor recipes, interlocks, sensors, and in-situ controls for process stability; restore tools to qualified process windows after maintenance

• Maintain underfill and overmolding systems, die attach equipment (epoxy dispensers, pick-and-place bonders, and reflow stations), and vacuum, thermal, motion, vision, and fluid-delivery subsystems to micron-level process requirements

• Manage critical spares, consumables, and tooling inventory; perform cycle counts and escalate long-lead or single-source parts risks

• Document work orders, lockout/tagout, calibrations, and equipment history; drive standard work, PM procedures, and tribal-knowledge capture

• Comply with cleanroom gowning protocols (ISO), chemical safety standards, electrical and mechanical safety, lockout/tagout, and strict electrostatic discharge (ESD) guidelines

• Coordinate with OEMs and vendors for installs, upgrades, warranty work, and complex repairs; support new-tool bring-up as the packaging line scales

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 3+ years of professional experience maintaining semiconductor wafer fab, packaging, or high-volume electronics manufacturing equipment

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field

• 3+ years of practical experience in high-volume semiconductor manufacturing maintenance or equipment engineering support

• Hands-on skill with industrial controls (PLCs, motion systems, vision, and robotics), vacuum systems, thermal systems, pneumatics, and precision mechanics

• Experience reading electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and OEM manuals; ability to use multimeters, oscilloscopes, and other diagnostic tools

• Proficiency with CMMS/work-order systems and with data analysis for equipment reliability and statistical process control (SPC)

• Experience with packaging or assembly platforms such as die attach, wire-bond or flip-chip-related tools, mold, dicing/singulation, SMT, AOI, reflow, PVD, or related metrology

• Physical stamina to manage equipment in a cleanroom suit and to handle sensitive substrates and tooling

• Excellent manual dexterity and the ability to perform precision mechanical and electrical work, including under a microscope when required

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to work all shifts and be willing to work overtime and/or weekends as needed

• Must don and wear cleanroom attire for full shifts (e.g., bouffant caps, gowns, masks, nitrile gloves, ESD footwear, ESD frocks, lab coats and/or bunny suits, and hoods)

• Must be able to stand for long periods and to bend, grasp, sit, pull, push, stoop, and stretch

• Must be able to lift up to 35 lb unassisted

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager - Scaling Biology & Platforms
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Cell Signaling Technology (CST) is a different kind of life sciences company, one founded, owned, and run by active research scientists, with the highest standards of product and service quality, technological innovation, and scientific rigor for over 20 years. We consistently provide fellow scientists around the globe with best-in-class products and services to fuel their quests for discovery.

Helping researchers find new solutions is our main mission every day, but it's not our only mission. We're also dedicated to helping identify solutions to other problems facing our world. We believe that all businesses must be responsible and work in partnership with local communities, while seeking to minimize their environmental impact. That's why we joined 1% for the Planet as its first life science member, and have committed to achieving net-zero emissions by 2029.

The Role:

The Product Marketing Manager, Scaling Biology & Platforms will communicate the value of CST's antibody portfolio for high-growth, technology-driven applications such as multiplexed IHC, spatial biology, single-cell analysis, and next generation immunoassays. Reporting to the Associate Director, you will carry out the go-to-market plan, positioning, and messaging for these applications and for the instrument and technology platforms our antibodies work on. Working closely with the Product Manager on your team, and drawing on hands-on experience with high-plex or platform-based workflows, you'll turn what researchers need into clear messaging, technical content, and sales tools that help customers choose and succeed with CST antibodies on their platform of choice.

Reports To: Associate Director, Strategic Marketing – Scaling Biology

Team: Works closely with the Product Manager on the Scaling Biology & Platforms team and partners with R&D, Sales, and MarComm

Applications Covered: Spatial biology, multiplexed IHC, single-cell analysis, and automated / high-throughput screening platforms

What You'll Do:

Value Proposition & Messaging:

• Develop positioning and messaging for CST's scaling biology tools/reagents/solutions that speak to the needs of researchers in spatial omics and other high-plex or next-gen applications

• Build evidence-based value propositions that show how CST tools/reagents/solutions perform on specific platforms and workflows

• Work with the Product Manager and the Associate Director to prepare and carry out launches of new scaling biology products

• Help set the metrics used to measure launch success, including adoption, customer feedback, and sales performance

Technical Content & Campaigns:

• Create and maintain technically rich content such as application notes, validation data packs, platform-specific protocols, webinars, and case studies that support customer adoption

• Plan and run campaigns that build awareness and generate high-quality leads for scaling biology applications

• Work with MarComm and Channel Owners on web, digital, and social content, and with regional marketing teams to localize campaigns

• Bring voice-of-customer feedback into campaign plans to keep messaging relevant

Sales Enablement:

• Build and deliver sales and distributor training, tools, and competitive and objection-handling guides so commercial teams can confidently explain our value in technical sales conversations

• Align marketing activity with sales strategy to improve lead generation, pipeline speed, and revenue growth

• Support distributors and e-commerce platforms with targeted resources and programs

Platform & Partner Marketing:

• Carry out co-marketing programs with instrument and technology partners in spatial biology, automation, and imaging, working with the Associate Director who leads these partner relationships

• Keep platform compatibility information accurate and easy to find for customers and sales teams

• Work with R&D and Product Management so validation results and platform claims match what we tell customers

Market & Customer Insight:

• Run ongoing research, including voice-of-customer interviews, surveys, and competitive analysis, on scaling biology needs and technology trends

• Connect with customers and KOLs in spatial and single-cell biology to test messaging and gather field intelligence, sharing emerging needs with the Associate Director

• Track campaign and product performance with MarComm and Channel Owners, and report results and insights to leadership

Skills & Competencies:

• Customer focus and a collaborative, team-oriented approach to work

• Hands-on technical knowledge of antibody-based products and the platforms and workflows they are used on, translated into clear messaging and sales tools

• Strong project management skills across multiple campaigns and launches at once

• A data-driven approach to measuring and improving marketing performance

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable simplifying complex scientific concepts for diverse audiences

• A commitment to quality and continuous improvement

What You'll Bring:

• Master's or PhD in life sciences (e.g. molecular biology, cell biology, immunology) or a related field; MBA a plus

• 5+ years of product marketing or related experience in the life sciences industry

• Hands-on experience with high-plex or platform-based workflows such as multiplexed IHC, spatial biology, single-cell analysis, flow cytometry, or high-content imaging

• Experience working with global sales channels and distributors

• A plus: experience managing a reagent product line, working with instrument or technology partners, and familiarity with Pragmatic or similar marketing frameworks

• Ability to build strong cross-functional relationships

• Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to think outside the box

• Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and internal equity.

Providing a safe, inclusive, and stimulating working environment that understands the importance of diversity, human dignity, and meaningful work is as important as establishing company policies that incorporate excellent health insurance and pay benefits. Pansophic Learning is an education company that strives to provide students and educators exceptional learning solutions that enable them to maximize their success academically and in life, regardless of geographic, financial, or demographic circumstance. We believe every child should be able to be whatever they want to be in life regardless of where they were born.

Our Early Learning Academies (learning centers) focus on providing high-quality early childhood education that prepare children for kindergarten and provide the foundation for long-term academic success. As the population of children with two working parents grows, so does the demand for childcare where families are engaged in their child’s learning experiences. Parents increasingly focus on early education rather than simple “day-care” – this secular trend is resulting in a shift in consumer preference towards more educationally focused childcare offerings.

The Senior Financial Analyst will support the Early Learning Academies division and serve as a key strategic partner in financial planning, resource allocation, operational performance management, and growth initiatives. This role will work closely with leadership, operations, accounting, and finance teams to deliver actionable insights that drive informed business decisions and support the organization's continued expansion.

The ideal candidate combines strong financial modeling and analytical capabilities with the ability to translate complex data into meaningful business recommendations. • Partner with multiple departments to curate information, deliver key insights and provide strategic perspectives; provide actionable recommendations based on data and performance objectives

jobs.title: Associate Director, Pharmacovigilance Operations
jobs.description:
Definium Therapeutics is a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company and our mission is to forge a new era of psychiatry by applying scientific rigor to psychedelics, with the goal of developing accessible treatments that unlock healing at scale.

Our lead product candidate, lysergide tartrate (our proprietary orally disintegrating tablet form of lysergide (LSD) D-tartrate), represents a highly differentiated, potential best-in-class opportunity for patients suffering from generalized anxiety, major depressive disorder, and posttraumatic stress disorder. Our early stage pipeline includes DT402, the R-enantiomer of MDMA and is under development to target the core symptoms of autism spectrum disorder (ASD), specifically addressing social communication challenges.

Guided by the recognition that patients deserve more than better, Definium is relentlessly advancing a new generation of therapeutics intended to address the underlying causes of psychiatric and neurological disorders. By turning evidence into impact, Definium aims to change the trajectory of today’s mental health care crisis and enable a healthier future. Headquartered in New York, Definium Therapeutics trades on Nasdaq under the symbol DFTX.

Together we are moving psychiatry forward—beyond better, into a boundless future. Join us!

Definium Therapeutics, Inc. is seeking a Associate Director, Pharmacovigilance Operations to play a key role in setting and executing on departmental strategy, as well as managing the day-to-day functioning of the Pharmacovigilance department. The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing departmental activities associated with investigational products. This role provides an outstanding opportunity to work in a matrix environment and collaborate with colleagues from Biometrics, Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Medical Affairs, and Regulatory Affairs.

Responsibilities:

• Contribute to the development and execution of Pharmacovigilance Operations strategy and manage the day-to-day operations of the department for investigational products

• Oversee the intake, processing, medical coding, quality review, and timely reporting of individual case safety reports (ICSRs), including serious adverse events (SAEs) and suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions (SUSARs), in compliance with applicable regulations

• Oversee the set-up of new safety clinical studies, including development of study-specific Safety Management Plans and set-up of clinical studies in safety systems

• Ensure adverse event data are accurately entered, coded, and reconciled in the safety database, and that case processing conventions and workflows are maintained

• Apply knowledge of medical terminology and principles of clinical assessment to the evaluation of adverse events, including seriousness, causality, and expectedness, in collaboration with Medical/Safety Physicians

• Oversee MedDRA coding of adverse events and medical history and manage dictionary version updates and coding conventions and quality

• Select, manage, and oversee pharmacovigilance vendors and service providers, including contracting support, performance and quality metrics, issue escalation, and oversight of deliverables

• Ensure compliance with applicable FDA, EU, UK (MHRA), and ICH requirements and guidelines for safety reporting and pharmacovigilance

• Develop, review, and maintain pharmacovigilance SOPs, work instructions, safety management plans, and other controlled documents

• Support the preparation and review of aggregate safety reports (e.g., DSURs) and contribute to safety-related sections of regulatory submissions and clinical documents as needed

• Support safety data reconciliation with Data Management and vendors, and provide safety input to study-related documents, plans, and cross-functional team meetings

• Support audit and inspection readiness activities, including preparation of documentation, responses to findings, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs)

• Collaborate with colleagues in Biometrics, Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Medical Affairs, and Regulatory Affairs to ensure patient safety and the integrity of safety data

• Identify and implement process improvements, and track and report pharmacovigilance operational metrics to management

Qualifications:

• BS or BA in a life sciences discipline required. Clinical experience (e.g., nursing or pharmacy background) preferred

• A minimum of 6 years of pharmacovigilance experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry

• High-level knowledge of relevant FDA, EU, UK, and ICH regulations and guidelines

• Knowledge of medical terminology and principles of clinical assessment of adverse events in the pharmaceutical industry

• Expertise in the MedDRA dictionary, with relevance to adverse event coding

• Experience working with software-based drug safety systems (e.g. Argus, Veeva)

• Experience in vendor management and oversight

• Strong computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office applications

• Strong written and verbal communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in a matrix environment and manage multiple priorities

Individual compensation within the range is determined based on factors such as relevant skills, experience, qualifications, scope of the role, and other legitimate business considerations.  In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus and equity opportunities. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k) with company match, flexible time off and additional wellness benefits and perks.  Learn more about our benefits on our Careers page.

$160,000—$240,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Electro-Mechanical Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Manufacturing team is seeking a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. The EW Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware for Electromagnetic Warfare. This responsibility includes everything in the manufacturing value-chain, including, but not limited to, Design for Manufacturability work, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.

As a Senior Manufacturing Engineer within EW, you will be responsible for driving process improvements, ensuring the highest quality of production, and supporting the development and implementation of new products. You will play a crucial role in optimizing manufacturing processes, reducing costs, and increasing efficiencies on existing technologies while also developing new products and scaling to full scale production.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain that includes Assembly, Integration & Test (AI&T) for electro-mechanical assemblies

• Contribute to operational excellence with a strong continuous improvement mindset and leading impactful Kaizen events

• Be a strong partner with Product Quality Engineering to drive and support RCCA burndowns that tackle key issues both internally and externally to EW Production

• Collaborate with Design Engineering teams in early to late phases of the development process to provide DFx for smooth NPI transitions

• Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes

• Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing their hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.

• Work with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metallic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production

• Work with technicians and other engineers hands-on, building prototype hardware

• Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Degree in a technical field preferred such as engineering, math, or a hard science

• 8+ years of experience in a relevant field, preferably manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware

• Demonstrated ability to creatively deliver electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment

• Demonstrated ability to contribute to the delivery of electromechanical hardware in a resource-constrained environment

• Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.) Work on personal or extracurricular projects is a plus.

• Prior experience working with JIRA, Siemens NX, Teamcenter (PLM), or Oracle (ERP) or equivalents

• Experience with RF Products that require system AI&T (assembly, integration, and test)

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

US Salary Range

$146,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:
