jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Data Strategy Engagement (P4657)
jobs.description:
84.51° Overview:

84.51° is a retail data science, insights and media company. We help The Kroger Co., consumer packaged goods companies, agencies, publishers and affiliates create more personalized and valuable experiences for shoppers across the path to purchase.

Powered by cutting-edge science, we utilize first-party retail data from more than 62 million U.S. households sourced through the Kroger Plus loyalty card program to fuel a more customer-centric journey using 84.51° Insights, 84.51° Loyalty Marketing and our retail media advertising solution, Kroger Precision Marketing.

84.51° follows a 5‑day in‑office work schedule to support collaboration, alignment, and team connection.

Join us at 84.51°!

__________________________________________________________

The Lead, Data Strategy Engagement PM will help bring the enterprise Data Strategy to life by connecting strategy, people, communication, and execution across the organization.

This highly visible, communication-intensive role will partner with business, data, technology, AI, product, and governance teams to build understanding and adoption of the Data Strategy, identify emerging business and data needs, and connect stakeholders to the right capabilities, resources, and expertise.

Success requires a strong understanding of enterprise data strategy, exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, and the ability to lead strategic conversations with Data Spokes and business leaders. This role will also continuously translate complex data concepts into clear, compelling content that makes the Data Strategy understandable, relevant, and actionable.

SUMMARY:

The Lead, Data Strategy Engagement PM will serve as a strategic connector between the enterprise Data Strategy and the business and technology teams responsible for putting that strategy into practice.

This individual will lead relationships with assigned Data Spokes, facilitate conversations with business and data leaders, understand business priorities and pain points, communicate enterprise Data Strategy direction, and identify where Data Strategy, Data Program capabilities, governance, standards, tools, or expertise can enable business outcomes.

The role will also act as a feedback loop between enterprise Data Strategy and the spokes, bringing emerging needs, challenges, risks, adoption barriers, and opportunities back into Data Strategy priorities and leadership conversations.

Responsibilities

Data Strategy Communication & Content

• Translate enterprise Data Strategy and complex data concepts into clear, simple, and compelling narrativesfor business, technical, and executive audiences, adapting the message while maintaining strategic intent and accuracy.

• Clearly defining and maintaining the Data Strategy & Data Program roadmaps & readouts on a regular schedule.

• Develop and maintain a strong working knowledge of enterprise Data Strategy and related capabilities, including Data Governance, AI-Ready Data, data products, data quality, metadata, discoverability, semantic capabilities, and data maturity.

• Create high-quality content daily, including executive presentations, emails, talking points, newsletters, Data Hub content, meeting materials, training, playbooks, announcements, and stakeholder updates.

• Develop stories, examples, and use cases that connect enterprise data capabilities and strategy to real business priorities and outcomes.

• Ensure Data Strategy messaging is consistent and connected across stakeholder meetings, Data Spokes, leadership forums, the Kroger Data Hub, Fresh Bytes, Data Community of Excellence, and other enterprise communication channels.

Data Spoke Leadership & Engagement

jobs.title: Research Intern
jobs.description:
About Us

Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets https://socket.dev/love to see for yourself!)


Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh https://www.linkedin.com/in/feross/, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $ https://socket.dev/blog/series-b125M in funding https://socket.dev/blog/series-c from top angels, operators, and security leaders.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You will collaborate with world-class researchers and software engineers to conduct research on the emerging threats against software supply chain. This internship offers a unique opportunity to translate cutting-edge research ideas into real-world systems that safeguard millions of developers worldwide. You will contribute to the design and implementation of large-scale data collection and analysis pipelines, conduct in-depth investigations of malicious activity in open source ecosystems, and prototype novel techniques for detecting fraud and abuse on platforms such as GitHub. We are interested in research on any aspect of software supply chain security.



As one of our research interns, you will not only push the boundaries of software supply chain security but also help shape the culture and direction of a fast-growing security company. This role is ideal for PhD students eager to bridge academia and industry and bring innovative research into production environments while gaining hands-on development experience in a high-impact, mission-driven setting.



You can read more about Socket Labs here https://socket.dev/labs.



What You'll Do

 - Conduct applied research on emerging threats in the software supply chain (e.g., self-propagating malware in package ecosystems, dependency hallucinations, AI emerging threats) and translate findings into detection prototypes and publish the results.

 - Design and evaluate novel algorithms for identifying malicious or inauthentic activity across ecosystems such as npm, PyPI, and GitHub.

 - Leverage data science and machine learning techniques to model suspicious publishing behaviors, coordinated activity, and fraud campaigns.

 - Develop automated research tools to collect, transform, and analyze large-scale datasets from third-party APIs (e.g., npm, GitHub, PyPI).

 - Prototype and validate detection systems that can be integrated into Socket’s threat intelligence platform, bridging research insights with production impact.

 - Collaborate with engineers and designers to experiment with new ways of surfacing research findings in user-facing interfaces and developer workflows.

 - Publish research outputs internally (dashboards, reports, proofs-of-concept) to influence product strategy and publish papers in conferences/share with the broader research community.

 - Contribute to the early team culture, bringing a research-driven perspective to technical discussions, prioritization, and the company’s long-term vision.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - You must be enrolled in a PhD program in computer science (or related field) and eager to apply your research expertise to real-world problems in software supply chain security.

 - Strong background in one or more of the following research areas: software supply chain security, program analysis, or AI security.

 - Proficiency with languages commonly used for prototyping and research (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar).

 - Familiarity with software and systems security concepts, such as threat modeling, malware analysis, or adversarial behavior in open ecosystems.

 - Experience conducting research involving data analysis, statistical methods, and experimental evaluation.

 - Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills; able to explore novel approaches and rigorously evaluate their effectiveness.

 - Self-motivated and comfortable driving independent research while collaborating with an interdisciplinary team.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills for presenting research findings and collaborating across engineering and design.

 - Experience with publishing research at top-tier academic conferences, like IEEE S&P, USENIX Security, CCS, and NDSS.

 - Prior work in one or more of the following is a plus:
   
   - Static/dynamic analysis of software or binaries
   
   - Open source security research
   
   - Experience with Socket-supported ecosystems
   
   - Vulnerability discovery
   
   - Building scalable data pipelines or visualization dashboards

Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy  https://socket.dev/hiring-philosophyand how we approach the process at Socket.



Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:

 - Market competitive salary bands

 - Meaningful equity program

 - Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)

 - Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge

 - Paid parental leave

 - Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites 



At Socket, we

 1. Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.

 2. Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action.

 3. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.

 4. Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve.

 5. Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains.

 6. Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.

Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

About the Team

The Prototype Build team within Engineering Garage Operations turns new vehicle designs into physical prototype and pre-production vehicles. Working across engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, launch, and logistics, the team assembles vehicles, validates build readiness, identifies design and process gaps, and supports rapid issue resolution.

The work spans low-volume electric vehicle builds, rework, instrumentation, repair, parts readiness, work-instruction improvement, and vehicle preparation for test and evaluation. This team provides the hands-on feedback needed to improve both the product and the production process before higher-volume execution.

About the Role

The Prototype Technician is a hands-on contributor responsible for supporting the assembly, modification, repair, and preparation of next-generation electric vehicles during prototype and pre-production build phases.

Reporting to a Hardware Engineering Supervisor within Engineering Garage Operations, this role works alongside experienced technicians, engineers, and cross-functional partners to safely execute vehicle builds and develop technical knowledge across vehicle systems and prototype processes.

This position is designed for individuals who have a strong mechanical or automotive foundation and are ready to expand their skills in a prototype engineering environment. Success in the first 12 months will be demonstrated through safe and high-quality workmanship, accurate execution of assigned build activities, effective communication of build issues, continued development of technical skills, and consistent adherence to engineering specifications, work instructions, and safety requirements.

The role provides hands-on exposure to complete vehicle systems and an opportunity to develop the technical knowledge and experience needed to grow within Prototype Build and Engineering Garage Operations.

What You Own

• Prototype Vehicle Build: Perform assigned assembly and integration activities on prototype and pre-production vehicles according to engineering specifications, work instructions, and established procedures. Work may include mechanical, electrical, thermal, chassis, body, interior, harnessing, and other vehicle systems within authorized scope.

• Vehicle Repair and Rework: Perform approved installation, removal, repair, adjustment, and rework activities using appropriate tools, procedures, and safety practices. Seek technical guidance when work falls outside established instructions or individual authorization.

• Basic Troubleshooting: Support identification and troubleshooting of vehicle, assembly, fit, function, tooling, and process issues. Perform approved corrective actions within your training and experience level and escalate complex concerns to senior technicians, supervisors, or engineering.

• Build Issue Documentation: Identify, document, communicate, and escalate build findings, missing or conflicting information, part shortages, quality concerns, and other conditions that may impact build progress using approved systems and processes.

• Engineering Change Execution: Follow drawings, bills of material, work instructions, engineering direction, and approved change documentation to correctly install or modify vehicle components while maintaining the required build configuration.

• Build Readiness: Support verification and organization of parts, kits, fasteners, tools, fixtures, work instructions, and station equipment needed for scheduled build activities. Identify missing or incorrect items and communicate concerns through established channels.

• Quality and Safety: Follow established safety requirements, specifications, torque requirements, quality checks, tool-control practices, and documentation processes. Stop and escalate work when conditions are unsafe or requirements are unclear.

• Continuous Improvement: Provide practical feedback based on hands-on build experience to help improve assembly processes, work instructions, tooling, ergonomics, quality, and vehicle build readiness.

• Technical Development: Actively develop proficiency across vehicle systems, tools, diagnostic methods, engineering documentation, and prototype build processes through hands-on experience, training, and collaboration with experienced technicians and engineers.

What You Bring

Required (Minimum Qualifications)

• 2+ years of hands-on automotive, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, assembly, maintenance, or similar technical experience.

• High school diploma or GED/equivalent required. Automotive, electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, or other relevant technical training is preferred.

• Basic understanding of automotive or mechanical systems and experience safely using common hand tools, power tools, measuring equipment, and/or diagnostic equipment.

• Ability to follow written work instructions, technical procedures, specifications, drawings, or other technical documentation.

• Ability and willingness to learn prototype vehicle assembly, repair, and troubleshooting processes across multiple vehicle systems.

• Ability to recognize abnormal conditions, workmanship concerns, missing information, or potential quality issues and escalate them appropriately.

• Ability to accurately document completed work and clearly communicate technical observations to technicians, supervisors, engineers, and other team members.

• Basic computer skills and ability to learn Microsoft Office and digital work-management, manufacturing, and engineering systems.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, hands-on environment where priorities, vehicle configurations, and build requirements may change.

• Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English sufficiently to perform the essential duties of the position, including understanding work instructions, safety procedures, and job-related communications.

Preferred Qualifications

• Automotive technician, dealership, manufacturing, vehicle assembly, service, maintenance, motorsports, fabrication, aviation, industrial maintenance, or similar hands-on technical experience.

• Certificate, coursework, or associate degree in Automotive Technology, Electrical Technology, Mechanical Technology, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Technology, or a closely related technical field.

• ASE certifications or other relevant automotive or technical certifications.

• Exposure to electric vehicles, prototype assembly, pre-production builds, vehicle repair, or low-volume manufacturing.

• Familiarity with electrical diagnostics, wiring or harness installation, mechanical assembly, torque procedures, vehicle interiors, chassis components, body components, or thermal systems.

• Exposure to technical drawings, bills of material, CAD information, work instructions, or manufacturing documentation.

• Experience with digital work-management or manufacturing systems such as Jira, MES, PLM, or similar systems.

• Fabrication, welding, electrical repair, alignment, glass installation, sealing, or other specialized technical skills are a plus.

Physical Requirements

• Standing and Walking: Ability to stand and walk for extended periods on hard surfaces in a workshop or production environment.

• Manual Dexterity: Frequent use of hands for tools, connectors, fasteners, component installation, measurement equipment, and diagnostic devices.

• Lifting and Carrying: Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds regularly; heavier components require team lifting or approved material-handling equipment.

• Positioning: Ability to bend, reach, twist, kneel, squat, climb steps, and work in and around vehicle interiors, underbody areas, and assembly stations.

• PPE: Ability to wear required PPE, including safety footwear, gloves, protective sleeves, eye protection, and hearing protection, in accordance with company requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Acquia

Acquia empowers the world’s most ambitious brands to create digital customer experiences that matter. With open source Drupal at its core, the Acquia Digital Experience Platform (DXP) enables marketers, developers, and IT operations teams at thousands of global organizations to rapidly compose and deploy digital products and services that engage customers, enhance conversions, and help businesses stand out.

Headquartered in Boston, MA, Acquia is a Great Place to Work-CertifiedTM company, is listed as one of the world’s top software companies by The Software Report, and is positioned as a market leader by the analyst community. We are Acquia. We are building for the future and we want you to be a part of it!

Career Exploration at Acquia

Our recruitment process is designed to empower you in making the most informed decisions. Acquia is committed to providing an inclusive, transparent, efficient, and educational interview experience that cultivates exploration into career opportunities at Acquia

You will discover the opportunity to grow your career here and learn from a global team that empowers you to exceed boundaries and achieve the extraordinary.

The Mission

Acquia is in the middle of its biggest platform transformation in a decade, and the economics of that transformation need an owner. As Senior Product Manager, that’s you.

This is not an accounting role. Finance closes the books, runs the monthly close, and owns the numbers. What you own is the story on top of them: what platform costs are doing and why, where margin is moving and what it means, what investment cases actually say when the assumptions are pressure-tested. You are the financial voice inside the product organization, the person PMs bring their business cases to before they go up, and the person leadership turns to when they need to understand what’s happening with the platform’s economics.

You also own the platform economics story, the ongoing performance narrative that keeps leadership aligned on how the business is performing and where the opportunities and risks are. That means driving the executive check-ins and reviews, in partnership with the Cloud PM group, that keep platform economics visible and actionable at the right level.

The role is also expanding into new territory. AI is restructuring what cloud platforms cost to build and run, faster than most organizations are ready for. You will build the frameworks, internal and external reporting, chargeback models, CapEx planning, that give Acquia visibility and control over AI-driven costs as they grow. And you will own the strategic vendor relationships where Acquia needs someone who can hold both the financial negotiation and the product judgment at the same time.

The Profile

• The Margin Owner: You are the ongoing source of truth for how the platform portfolio performs economically. You track actuals, understand what’s driving them, and run the leadership rhythm, executive check-ins and cross-functional reviews with the Cloud PM group, that keeps margin performance visible and actionable at the right altitude. When something moves, you know why, and you know what to do about it.

• The Platform Economist: You read cost trends, consumption patterns, and margin signals the way other PMs read usage data: as a window into what’s working, what’s at risk, and where the platform needs to change. Platform cost efficiency, customer-level economics, cost trending across the portfolio, these are your inputs. Your output is clarity, in language engineers, PMs, and executives can all act on.

• The Financial Advocate: Every PM on the team builds business cases. You make those cases better. You review assumptions before they become commitments, model the cost implications of a feature before it goes into the roadmap, and make sure significant investment decisions are economically grounded, not just technically compelling. This is not a gatekeeper role. It’s a force multiplier.

• The AI Cost Pioneer: AI is changing what it costs to build and run a cloud platform faster than most finance teams are tracking it. You are building the frameworks, internal reporting, external customer visibility, chargeback models, CapEx planning, that let Acquia understand and manage AI-driven costs proactively, not reactively. This is early work with real impact, and you are the person defining what it looks like.

• The Vendor Strategist: You own the financial and product dimensions of Acquia’s key strategic vendor relationships, cloud infrastructure, cost intelligence tooling, and OEM partnerships. You bring the financial rigor and product judgment that Acquia needs in the room on renewals, negotiations, and procurement decisions, and you manage those relationships as long-term strategic assets, not just contracts to renew.

• The Context Architect: You thrive in an Agentic PDLC environment. You build and maintain the economic context, margin models, cost benchmarks, vendor frameworks, that lets the team’s agentic workflows scale financial analysis and reporting without requiring your involvement in every step.

Key Responsibilities

• Own Gross Margin Reporting and Executive Engagement. Track and report on gross margin performance for the platform portfolio on an ongoing basis, in partnership with the Cloud PM group. Understand what’s driving the numbers, surface the risks and opportunities that matter, and run the executive check-ins and leadership reviews that keep platform economics visible and actionable at the right level.

• Own the Platform Cost Narrative. Work from Finance’s data to build the product-side view of what the platform costs to run and why. Track platform cost efficiency, customer-level economics, and cost trends across the portfolio, and turn those signals into product priorities, investment sequencing, and recommendations leadership can act on.

• Be the Financial Advocate for Every PM on the Team. Review business cases before they go up. Model feature and product costs. Help PMs pressure-test their assumptions so significant investment decisions are economically grounded, not just technically compelling.

• Build the AI Cost Frameworks. Own AI cost reporting for internal and external audiences. Build the chargeback models that let Acquia track AI cost at the product and customer level. Develop CapEx frameworks that let the organization plan AI infrastructure investment with clarity, and advocate for AI cost best practices across the business.

• Partner on Strategic Vendor Relationships. Serve as the financial and product voice in Acquia’s key vendor relationships across cloud infrastructure, cost intelligence tooling, and OEM partnerships. Contribute to renewals, negotiations, and procurement approvals with both financial precision and product judgment, and help ensure those relationships are managed as strategic assets, not just recurring line items.

• Manage Third-Party Tool Economics. Own expense reporting, expense modeling, and contract management across the third-party tool portfolio. Maintain and evolve the platform’s cost intelligence infrastructure, including ongoing tool administration, dashboard development, and design partnership with key vendors.

• Contribute to Platform Investment Planning. Feed into hosting forecasts and reservation planning, making sure platform infrastructure commitments are sized and sequenced against the product roadmap, not just current-state usage.

• Agentic Collaboration. Build and maintain the shared economic context structures, margin models, cost frameworks, vendor intelligence, AI cost dashboards, that let the team’s agentic workflows scale financial analysis and reporting without manual overhead.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in a role that required both financial modeling and strategic product or business judgment, ideally at the intersection of PM and FP&A in a SaaS or managed cloud platform business — finance-fluent, not just finance-adjacent

• A track record of building financial models from scratch: cost models, gross margin analysis, business cases, consumption forecasts — not updating someone else’s

• Demonstrated experience owning executive reporting cadences and driving leadership reviews with your own recommendations, not just contributing the numbers

• Hands-on cloud economics depth: consumption-based cost modeling, reserved capacity planning, or gross margin analysis in a cloud infrastructure or SaaS business — you’ve done the work, not observed it

• Hands-on experience with FinOps tooling (CloudZero, Apptio, Cloudability, or equivalent) — not passing familiarity

• Experience contributing to vendor negotiations and renewals where both financial outcomes and product strategy were on the table, not just one or the other

• Enough PM craft to work as a peer to PMs, not just a finance partner to them — experience writing requirements, running discovery, or owning a roadmap area

• Comfortable presenting financial narratives to VP-level or above, with accountability for the recommendations, not just the deck

• Demonstrated interest in AI-assisted analysis and agentic workflows, and the drive to build those into how this role operates from day one

We are an organization that embraces innovation and the potential of AI to enhance our processes and improve our work. We are always looking for individuals who are open to learning new technologies and collaborating with AI tools to achieve our goals.

Acquia is proud to provide best-in-class benefits to help our employees and their families maintain a healthy body and mind. Core Benefits include: competitive healthcare coverage, wellness programs, take it when you need it time off, parental leave, recognition programs, and much more!

Final compensation will be commensurate with your experience and will be determined by a variety of factors, including city of residence, relevant skillset, and job-related knowledge.

Acquia is an equal opportunity (EEO) employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veterans status or any other protected status or characteristic under federal, state or local law unrelated to the ability to perform the job.

We are seeking an AI-Native candidate who treats AI not as an external tool, but as a fundamental extension of their cognitive workflow. The ideal candidate possesses an orchestration mindset—the ability to skillfully prompt, manage, and direct AI to navigate complexity—and maintains a high degree of AI fluency.

You should be characterized by radical adaptability and a "builder" mentality, showing a restless drive to transform traditional work processes into agentic workflows. Beyond technical proficiency, we value intellectual humility: the willingness to constantly unlearn old methods in favor of more efficient, AI-augmented processes. You don't just use AI to do your job; you use it to redefine what your job can achieve.

Pay Range

$160,000—$170,000 USD

Company Overview:

ANSER enhances national and homeland security by strengthening public institutions. We provide thought leadership for complex issues through independent analysis, and we deliver practical, useful solutions. ANSER values collaboration, integrity, and initiative and we are client focused in all that we do. Because we were established for the purpose of public service and not for profit, we measure our success in the impact of our service.

Position Summary:

ANSER is seeking a Senior Operational Planner. In this role you will provide technical leadership and direction to either INDOPACOM headquarters, or a component staff in the development, revision, and review of Operational Plans (OPLANS), Contingency Plans (CONPLANS), and Campaign Plans.

Day to Day Responsibilities:

• Assist staff planners in the development of strategic and operational concepts for new OPLANs/CONPLANs and possible branch plans to existing OPLANS/CONPLANs.

• Make recommendations, where appropriate, to change planning procedures or ways of conducting planning to the staff and subordinate command staffs.

• Support higher, adjacent and supporting headquarters planning ensuring proper employment of forces; and review and provide written comments on regional combatant commander and JTF OPLANS/CONPLANS.

Required Qualifications:

• Active TS/SCI clearance.

• Master's degree. Will consider an additional 8 years' experience with bachelor's degree OR 12 years' work experience may be substituted for a master's degree.

• 10+ years of operations planning experience supporting MAJCOM, Combatant Command or equivalent.

• In-depth knowledge of operational planning, and service and joint doctrine.

• Demonstrated understanding of C2IE and JOPES and other requirements tools

• Advanced proficiency with using Microsoft applications such as Excel, Teams, Words, Power Pt., etc.

• Possess a working knowledge of the Pacific theater, and an understanding of the relationships and general interactions between each nation.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Strong interpersonal/social skills; proven staff officer/contractor support excellence.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

Individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including but not limited to: business considerations, local market, internal equity, candidate qualifications such as skills, education and experience. ANSER provides employees benefits to support all aspects of their life including health, financial and well-being. For more information, please visit: http://www.anser.org

Full-Time Salary Range for this position:

$119,000—$172,000 USD

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position with ANSER, please call 703-416-2000 or e-mail Recruiting@anser.org

ANSER is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We seek individuals from a broad variety of backgrounds with varying levels of experience who have a desire to do meaningful work. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote regardless of race, color, gender, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, age, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Insurance Client Services Associate
jobs.description:
Start a Career in Insurance

Pyron Group is seeking a friendly, dependable, and growth-minded Client Services Associate to join our team.

This role serves as the first point of contact for clients while supporting the day-to-day administrative and processing work that helps our agency run smoothly. No insurance experience is required. We are looking for someone who enjoys helping people, stays organized, pays attention to details, and is eager to learn.

This position is a starting point for a long-term career in insurance. We will support the right candidate in studying for and obtaining a Property & Casualty insurance license, with opportunities to grow into Account Management, Sales, or other insurance-related roles over time.

At Pyron Group, our purpose is simple: Lighten the load and lift the spirit.



What You'll Do

Client Service

 - Welcome clients and visitors to the office.

 - Answer incoming calls and route them to the appropriate team member.

 - Assist with routine client requests and questions.

 - Help create a positive and professional client experience.

Processing & Administrative Support

 - Accept and process client payments.

 - Assist with policy documents, ID cards, and routine servicing requests.

 - Support Account Managers with renewal and quoting preparation.

 - Process and organize incoming insurance carrier correspondence and documentation.

 - Maintain accurate records and documentation in agency systems.

 - Create follow-up reminders to ensure requests are completed.

Team Support

 - Assist Account Managers, Risk Advisors, and Office Managers with administrative needs.

 - Help ensure client requests are handled accurately and efficiently.

 - Participate in training and professional development opportunities.

 - Take on additional responsibilities as skills and experience grow.



What We're Looking For

Required

 - Strong communication and customer service skills.

 - Dependable, organized, and detail-oriented.

 - Comfortable working with technology and learning new systems.

 - Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

 - Ability to manage multiple tasks.

Preferred, But Not Required

 - Customer service, administrative, reception, banking, hospitality, or office experience.

 - Experience handling payments, documents, or client records.

 - Interest in insurance, financial services, or sales.

No Insurance Experience? That's Okay.

Many successful insurance professionals started without any insurance background.

We're looking for people who are:

 - Coachable

 - Caring

 - Reliable

 - Curious

 - Professional

 - Eager to grow

We can teach insurance. We can't teach character.



Professional Development

We believe in developing people, not just filling positions.

As a Client Services Associate, you'll have access to:

 - Insurance training and mentorship

 - Property & Casualty licensing support

 - Carrier education programs

 - Continuing education opportunities

 - Ongoing coaching and development



Benefits

Pyron Group offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, including:

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) with employer match

 - Paid time off and holidays

 - Company-paid life insurance

 - Company-paid short-term disability

 - Ongoing training and career development



About Pyron Group

Pyron Group is a people-first insurance organization serving individuals, families, and businesses across Mississippi and beyond.

We believe insurance should be easier to understand, easier to navigate, and backed by people who genuinely care. We work hard, support one another, and create opportunities for our teammates to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on the lives of our clients.

jobs.title: Occupational Therapist
jobs.description:
At Engage Senior Therapy, we provide on-site physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech therapy services to senior living communities across New England. Our team is committed to delivering compassionate, relationship-centered care that helps patients maintain mobility, independence, and confidence in their daily lives. Engage fosters strong clinical collaboration and a supportive environment where team members continue to grow while making a meaningful impact every day.

Engage Senior Therapy is excited to welcome a passionate and experienced Occupational Therapist to our team at our new partner senior living community in Concord, NH.

About the Role

As an Occupational Therapist at Engage, you’ll provide individualized, evidence-based care that helps older adults maximize independence, safety, and participation in meaningful daily activities. You’ll work with a diverse geriatric population across independent living, assisted living, dementia, and memory care settings while building meaningful relationships with patients and collaborating closely with the broader Engage team.

Your day-to-day:

• Conduct comprehensive evaluations to assess functional abilities, activities of daily living (ADLs), cognitive performance, safety awareness, and mobility needs.

• Develop and implement individualized treatment plans focused on improving independence, functional mobility, self-care, and overall quality of life.

• Provide hands-on interventions including ADL retraining, therapeutic activities, cognitive rehabilitation, balance and coordination training, and adaptive equipment recommendations.

• Assess environmental and safety risks while implementing fall prevention strategies and functional modifications that support safe daily living.

• Provide care across one or more assisted living communities while maintaining strong communication with residents, families, and interdisciplinary care teams.

• Educate residents and caregivers on adaptive strategies, home programs, energy conservation techniques, and equipment recommendations that support independence and safety.

• Maintain timely, accurate documentation and monitor patient progress using EMR systems in compliance with state and facility standards.

• Collaborate with physical therapists, speech therapists, nursing staff, and support teams to deliver coordinated, patient-centered care.

• Participate in ongoing professional development through mentorship, continuing education, workshops, and clinical training opportunities.

• Build meaningful relationships with residents, families, community staff, and colleagues to support exceptional patient outcomes.

Why Join Engage?

As a proud member of Fusion Physical Therapy Partners, Engage combines the close-knit feel of a local team with the support and resources of a growing network. For you, this means:

• Flexible schedules designed to support work-life balance

• One-on-one patient care that supports focused, relationship-centered treatment

• AI-assisted documentation tools through Prediction Health Sidekick for faster, more efficient documentation

• Structured mentorship and onboarding support for both new graduates and experienced clinicians

• Network-wide clinical education and collaboration opportunities

• Clear pathways for professional growth and long-term career development

• Opportunities to work with a diverse geriatric population in meaningful, relationship-centered settings

Plus, a compensation package that includes:

• $1,000 annually in CEU reimbursement

• 401(k) with company match

• 4 weeks of paid time off + 6 paid holidays

• Bonus incentive opportunities

• MedBridge subscription with unlimited online CEUs

• Medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance

What You Bring

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

• Graduate of an ACOTE-accredited Occupational Therapy program

• Active state OT license in good standing (or eligibility for licensure)

• Passion for delivering compassionate, evidence-based patient care to a geriatric population

• Experience or interest in geriatrics, adaptive equipment, and ADL training

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a collaborative, team-oriented mindset

• Ability to work independently while staying connected with a supportive clinical team

• Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth

Engage invests in a culture of inclusion and positivity and encourage all to apply to our open roles. You will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Engage is a proud member of Fusion Physical Therapy Partners.

jobs.title: Vice President, Integration
jobs.description:
Position: VP of Integration
Organization: Cobalt Service Partners (https://cobaltsp.com)
Location: New York, NY (flexible, near a major airport, ~50% travel)
Reports To: COO

Cobalt Service Partners Overview

Cobalt is a private equity-backed company aiming to build the most impactful business in the commercial access and security industry (access control systems, video surveillance systems, intrusion detection systems and other low voltage systems integration). Cobalt is backed by Alpine Investors, a private equity firm specializing in middle market companies in the services and software industries and with $15bn+ of AUM. Cobalt's Co-CEOs (Tyler Hoffman and Anthony Gonzalez) are experienced investors and operators. In just 3 years, Cobalt has successfully acquired 23 partner companies and established itself as one of the leading platforms in a highly attractive and fragmented industry that is benefiting from substantial secular growth tailwinds.

Position Overview

Cobalt is hiring a VP of Integration to build and lead its integration capability, bringing acquired and existing businesses onto one stronger operating model. This leader owns the portfolio of integration and transformation programs, is accountable for the financial value they deliver, and builds the team that sustains it.

The role is hands-on, with about half of the time spent traveling and onsite with local teams. The VP of Integration delivers change while protecting customer service and retaining critical talent, so teams can share customers, talent, expertise, and resources while each business keeps what makes it successful.

Key Responsibilities

• Deliver enterprise value: identify, validate, and deliver integration and transformation initiatives that drive profitable growth, better margins, and cash.

• Build a lasting capability: develop the integration team, bring each business onto the agreed upon operating model, equip leaders to sustain results, and continuously improve the playbook.

• Own the portfolio: set priorities, sequencing, staffing, and tradeoffs across integration and transformation programs.

• Hit the financial plan: meet targets on amount and timing, with results validated by Finance and spending within approved budget.

• Plan before launch: start every acquisition with an approved 100-day plan, and every program with an approved thesis and plan.

• Protect what works: partner with regional and functional leaders so customer service holds and critical talent stays.

Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience across management consulting and operating leadership.

• Transformation experience from a leading consulting firm, then a Director or VP operating role owning outcomes.

• Personally led complex acquisitions and multi-business integrations from planning through cutover and operating handoff.

• Builds and challenges integration business cases, separating recurring annualized benefits from results realized in-year.

• Has sequenced concurrent programs, allocated scarce resources, and managed dependencies and budgets at the executive level.

• Translates business end states into clear roles, workflows, and repeatable playbooks across organization, process, data, and systems.

• Field services experience strongly preferred. Industrials or manufacturing experience also valued.

• Based near a major airport and able to travel about 50%, with significant time onsite.

Leadership Characteristics

• Metrics-driven: uses numbers to create clarity, urgency, and accountability.

• Exceptional EQ: earns trust with founders, operating leaders, frontline technicians, and staff.

• Executive influence: challenges senior leaders with candor and care, without damaging relationships.

• Ownership: sets an uncompromising standard for follow-through, sustained adoption, and continuous improvement.

• Talent builder: builds a high-performing integration team and empowers it to lead.

• Hands-on: gets into the details and resolves problems onsite.

Cobalt's Core Values are

• Unwavering stewardship: We believe advancing founders' legacies is a privilege. We do right by our founders, teams, and customers in good times and in bad.

• Excellence in action: We hold ourselves accountable to the highest standards. We're bold in our pursuits, don't make excuses, and relentlessly empower each other to get the job done.

• Seek and tell the truth: We're honest with ourselves and others. We do what we say we'll do, say what needs to be said, and search for the right answer regardless of where it comes from.

• Love learning: We're always learning as individuals, as a team, and as a business. We show up humble, curious, and with the courage to change our minds.

• Enjoy the ride: We're fired up by our mission, love our team, and don't take either for granted. We show up authentically, assume best intent, and try not to take ourselves too seriously.

Compensation & Benefits: The expected base salary for this role is $200,000 to $250,000. It also includes an annual performance bonus and Cobalt’s full benefits package, which covers medical, dental, and vision, a 401(k), and paid time off. This is a good-faith range. Where an offer lands depends on experience and scope.

jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Consultant (New York, NY)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 8–15+ years of experience selling technical products to technical buyers

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.


NICE TO HAVES

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York, NY, the estimated range for total on-target earnings (including base salary and on-target incentive pay) for this role is $360,000 - $400,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Everpure is seeking a highly motivated Cloud Sales Specialist with experience selling cloud-based solutions into large Enterprise customers.  Reporting to the Global Cloud Sales leader, the Cloud Sales Specialist will be part of the Lifecycle Subscriptions and Consumption Sales (LSCS) team reporting into our CRO.  This Cloud Sales Specialist will coordinate with the Everpure Enterprise sales teams, partners and the Microsoft and AWS field sales teams to lead Everpure’s customer expansions into the Azure and AWS Clouds. They will be responsible for team-selling efforts, inclusive of our strategic partners to close business on a quarterly and annual basis. The ideal candidate will currently be selling and living in the Western half of the United /states.

This includes identifying key accounts, establishing relationships with decision-makers, and positioning Everpure’s cloud offerings as the superior choice.

• Drive revenue growth: As a Cloud Sales Specialist, you will be responsible for achieving sales targets and driving Cloud revenue growth within the Enterprise business. You will actively prospect and qualify leads, conduct product demonstrations, negotiate contracts, and close deals to achieve and exceed sales quotas.

• Build and maintain customer relationships: Cultivating strong relationships with key stakeholders within Enterprise organizations is crucial. You will engage with customers to understand their unique business needs and challenges, provide consultative guidance, and position Everpure’s cloud-based solutions as the ideal fit to address their requirements.

You will leverage this knowledge to identify new opportunities, anticipate customer needs, and provide strategic guidance to internal stakeholders.

• Thought leadership, creativity and a Challenger Mindset; the ability to apply your customer insights and expertise in technology solutions to position Everpure’s portfolio for seamless expansion into Azure and AWS Clouds.

• Excellent interpersonal skills including written and oral communication, able to build relationships easily and deepen them over time

jobs.title: Implementation Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us
Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners specifically within cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audit. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

As an early stage start-up employee, you’ll have the opportunity to build out the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners’ lives easier by bringing together up to 50% of their work and giving them better work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide.



About the Role:

As an Implementation Analyst at Fieldguide, you will be an integral member of our go-to-market team, working directly alongside Implementation Consultants and the broader Go-To-Market organization to drive successful customer adoption of our platform.

Reporting to our Director of Implementation, you will play a hands-on role in onboarding customers onto Fieldguide — configuring their environments, migrating their data, and ensuring every detail is right so customers can realize value quickly. You'll work alongside Agentic powered tools that are transforming how audit and advisory firms operate, giving you front-row exposure to the future of this industry.

This is an early-career role designed as a launchpad into implementation consulting. As you build deeper product expertise and client relationships, you'll grow into an Implementation Consultant position with increasing ownership of the end-to-end customer journey.



What You’ll Do:

 - Set customers up for success. Configure customer environments — including engagement templates, user roles, and permissions — to ensure a smooth day-one experience.

 - Own data migration. Execute data migration and setup tasks (e.g., importing trial balances, control matrices, mapping fields, validating configurations) so customers can go live on schedule.

 - Turn requirements into reality. Translate documented requirements into system configurations under the guidance of senior implementation team members, building your expertise with every project.

 - Leverage vibe coding agents. Build and use AI-powered “vibe coding” agents to accelerate configuration tasks, automate repetitive setup work, and prototype solutions quickly.

 - Be the quality gatekeeper. Perform quality assurance checks to ensure setups meet client specifications and internal best practices before anything reaches the customer.

 - Drive issues to resolution. Support testing cycles, document issues clearly, and coordinate fixes with internal teams (Support, Product, Engineering) to keep implementations on track.

 - Support seamless go-lives. Assist with go-live preparation — including final configuration reviews, documentation updates, and post-launch support — to help customers cross the finish line with confidence.

 - Build client exposure. Join customer calls alongside senior consultants to observe client interactions and progressively take on direct client communication as you develop.



About You:

 - Hands-on experience with 2+ years in technology consulting, customer onboarding, implementation, or similar, at a top management consulting firm (preferred) or high-growth startup, with familiarity manipulating, transforming, and translating data between systems or formats.

 - You bring strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail, especially when working across repetitive or manual configuration tasks.

 - You have an analytical mindset with comfort working with AI agents, spreadsheets, structured data, and systems.

 - You take ownership of assigned workstreams and drive them to completion, proactively flagging blockers and proposing solutions.

 - You are a team player and mission-first. You're joining a hard-working team that trusts each other deeply. We won't compromise on this.

 - You communicate clearly in writing and verbally, follow documented processes, and ask thoughtful clarifying questions when something isn't right.

 - You're comfortable working in a fast-paced, client-facing SaaS environment with multiple concurrent projects.

 - You have a genuine interest in audit, risk advisory, or professional services. Prior industry experience is helpful but not required — curiosity and willingness to learn are what matter most.



More about Fieldguide:

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

 - Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

 - Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

 - Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

 - Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

 - Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

 - Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.



Some of our benefits include:

 - Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

 - Unlimited PTO

 - 401k

 - Wellness benefits, including a bundle of free therapy sessions

 - Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

 - Flexible work schedules

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer (C++) - Hardware Safety
jobs.location: Pittsburgh, PA, Palo Alto, CA, Detroit, MI, Remote
jobs.description:
Latitude AI (lat.ai) is building the future of Ford’s autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in-house developed hands-free ADAS platform will debut on the all-new Ford Fathom in 2027.

When you join the Latitude team, you’ll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers.

As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif.

Meet the team:

The Embedded Software team develops foundational platform software critical to development across the company. The Hardware Safety & Power Systems group specializes in the real-time firmware that orchestrates safe system behavior during fault conditions, power transitions, and thermal events.

We develop FreeRTOS and SafeRTOS-based drivers, state machines, and diagnostic frameworks for power management, thermal monitoring, voltage supervision, and hardware watchdog systems on TDA4 (Jacinto 7) embedded targets. Projects often require deep collaboration with hardware teams (PMIC vendors, SoC architects), safety engineers (ISO 26262 compliance), and system integration teams across the company.

What you’ll do:

• Own the end-to-end architecture of hardware safety and power management systems: design safe-state strategies, power sequencing across multiple cores and PMICs, thermal throttling, and watchdog orchestration. Your designs must meet ASIL-B/C safety goals

• Implement low-level drivers and firmware for safety-critical integrated circuits (PMIC, voltage supervisor, thermal monitor) directly from datasheets and the TDA4 Functional Safety Manual. These drivers run on bare metal and FreeRTOS; they must be bug-free and testable

• Lead the development of hardware-software safety diagnostic frameworks — integrate TI Safety Diagnostic Library (LBIST, PBIST, ECC, DCC, ESM) into the firmware; ensure diagnostic coverage maps to ISO 26262 hardware fault metrics; mentor engineers on coverage traceability

• Consistently perform deep-dive code reviews across all hardware safety modules. Ensure PRs are simple, bug-free, and adhere to unified architectural vision (clean driver interfaces, consistent error handling, testable design patterns). Root out assumptions that could lead to latent ASIL-rated failures

• Serve as the SME for hardware-firmware-safety interfaces. Navigate ambiguity in hardware requirements (PMIC sequencing, watchdog timing, thermal limits, voltage thresholds). Mediate disagreements in technical approach through evidence-based influence and clear understanding of safety constraints

• Mentor engineers on embedded safety patterns — code review discipline, hardware driver architecture, RTOS integration, ISO 26262 traceability, and functional safety reasoning. Build capability across the team

What you'll need to succeed:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field and 4+ years of relevant experience (or Master's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience, or PhD)

• Experience in embedded C/C++ with deep understanding of advanced language features, design paradigms, and embedded constraints (no exceptions, no RTTI, careful memory management). Proven ability to design clean abstractions and interface-based code for testability

• Proven expertise in ARM-based SoC architectures, specifically ARM Cortex-R5F: memory-mapped I/O, interrupt controllers (VIM), MPU configuration, cache behavior, and memory barriers. Experience debugging at the register level using datasheets

• Direct experience configuring MPUs and hardware-level firewalls to enforce spatial and temporal isolation in multi-core, safety-critical environments

• Experience building or significantly refactoring Hardware Abstraction Layers (HAL) to support multiple hardware targets, RTOS environments, or variant configurations. Understands the role of HAL in isolating driver complexity and enabling testing

• Ability to root-cause complex system failures — power sequencing hangs, missed watchdog feeds, thermal throttle race conditions, interrupt latency issues — involving shared memory, RTOS task scheduling, and hardware peripherals without supervision

• Ability to see potential pitfalls in low-level designs (e.g., power rail ordering dependencies, watchdog timeout misconfiguration, voltage threshold hysteresis). Can express designs in sufficient detail (state diagrams, timing requirements, register-level sequences) for rapid, correct implementation

• Expert-level use of embedded debugging tools (JTAG, on-target debugging, logic analyzers) to verify low-level hardware-software interactions and timing-critical behavior

• Deep understanding of Real-Time Operating Systems — FreeRTOS and/or SafeRTOS: task lifecycle, inter-task synchronization, interrupt handling, timing constraints, and periodic task patterns. Comfortable reasoning about task preemption, priority inversion, and stack requirements

• Direct experience developing drivers for safety-critical integrated circuits (PMIC, voltage supervisor, thermal sensor, or equivalent) from datasheet: SPI/I2C protocol implementation, register-level configuration, fault handling, and diagnostic integration

• Foundational knowledge of ISO 26262 ASIL-B/C functional safety concepts — safe-state strategies, diagnostic coverage, hardware/software fault tolerance allocation, and traceability. Ability to map code behavior to safety requirements without constant guidance

Nice to have:

• Direct experience with TDA4 / J784S4 (Jacinto 7) or other TI automotive SoCs — familiarity with TI PSDK, SDL (Safety Diagnostic Library), register maps, and peripheral architecture significantly accelerates ramp-up

• Expertise in Linux-based embedded software development including gtests, Python scripting, Bazel build system, and Docker containerization for embedded CI/CD

• Prior involvement in ISO 26262 functional safety audits or certification — experience with Jama requirements traceability, FMEA/HARA, and safety case argumentation

• Experience with hardware diagnostic frameworks — LBIST (Logic BIST), PBIST (Programmable BIST), ECC integration, or other ISO 26262 diagnostic mechanisms

• Proficiency with advanced embedded debugging tools — Tracealyzer for RTOS visualization, logic analyzers for protocol decoding, or in-circuit emulators

• Prior automotive or safety-critical domain experience — body control, powertrain, medical devices, industrial control, or aerospace/defense

What we offer you:

• Competitive compensation packages

• High-quality individual and family medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Health savings account with available employer match

• Employer-matched 401(k) retirement plan with immediate vesting

• Employer-paid group term life insurance and the option to elect voluntary life insurance

Soros Fund Management LLC (SFM) is a global asset manager and family office founded by George Soros in 1970. With $28 billion in assets under management (AUM), SFM serves as the principal asset manager for the Open Society Foundations, one of the world’s largest charitable foundations dedicated to advancing justice, human rights, and democracy.

• Educate members on the surgical process, available incentives, and program benefits.

• Proactively engage new members while maintaining strong relationships with existing ones.

• Consistently go the extra mile to help members navigate the complexities of surgery

• 1–3 years' experience in a customer service, service center, and/or sales enablement role

• Ability to work effectively in a team environment

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

• Ability to organize work activities to meet deadlines

• Bilingual (Spanish & English) preferred

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Lead
jobs.description:
About Dashlane

Dashlane’s mission is to deliver the credential security every business and employee needs to thrive. Millions of consumers, and over 25,000 brands worldwide, such as Michelin, Air France, and Forrester, trust Dashlane for industry-leading innovations, patented zero-knowledge security, and an unmatched user experience. Founded in Paris, Dashlane has since established offices in New York and Lisbon, and has grown to more than 300 Dashlaners globally.

We're looking for people who actively use AI tools to drive efficiency, creativity, and impact in their work. At Dashlane, we drive innovation and value learning, strive for excellence in everything we do, and thrive as one team. Learn more about life at Dashlane, including how we work, how we hire, and the benefits of being a Dashlaner.

About the Role: As Dashlane accelerates its expansion up-market with our Omnix platform—extending credential protection beyond the vault into the browser and using AI to surface credential risk—the way we plan, forecast, and resource the business is evolving rapidly. As Strategic Finance Lead, you will be our key finance partner on the ground in New York and a direct strategic thought partner to the VP of Finance. As a senior individual contributor who also mentors the broader finance team, you will own our forecast, annual budget, and long-range modeling, along with the operating rhythm that connects Sales, Marketing, RevOps, and Product around a single source of truth. Rather than acting as a reporting desk, you will build the financial architecture that explains why the numbers move, and drive alignment on where we invest, where we pull back, and how quickly we react. It's a chance to shape how finance operates in our New York hub, working directly with a VP of Finance who sets a high bar and invests in helping you clear it. This role is based in our New York, NY office on a hybrid schedule.

At Dashlane you will:

• Own the weekly New and Expansion bookings forecast, the monthly forecast, and the annual budget, driving quarterly bookings accuracy to within ±5% of actuals.

• Retire manual spreadsheet rebuilds by moving our monthly forecasting and annual budgeting processes end-to-end onto Datarails and FinQore.

• Spot pipeline or cohort issues early—before quarter-end—and partner directly with revenue leaders to model scenarios, find coverage, and close gaps in real time.

• Quarterback our operating rhythm by uniting Sales, Marketing, RevOps, and Product around single-source-of-truth dashboards in Omni (powered by Salesforce and FinQore) to drive fast, confident decisions.

• Serve as the VP of Finance's primary strategic partner in New York, building long-range and scenario models, evaluating strategic initiatives, and shaping the financial story for the executive team.

• Over time, extend finance's influence on business decisions by linking Marketing spend to outcomes, turning Product roadmap opportunities into rigorous financial business cases, and helping Sales leaders own their forecast.

• Mentor the team's analysts, setting the bar for modeling quality and analytical rigor and helping them take on more ownership of the forecast.

• Reimagine how strategic finance operates by using AI and automation to turn recurring, rules-based reporting into smart monitoring and forecasting systems.

Requirements:

• 6+ years of experience in strategic finance or FP&A, including time in a sales-led B2B SaaS environment.

• Proven track record of directly owning bookings or ARR forecasts, building complex strategic models, and running an end-to-end budget cycle.

• Deep, hands-on expertise in financial modeling, unit economics, and data analysis.

• Experience mentoring or coaching analysts, formally or informally.

• Daily, practical use of AI tools in your analytical, modeling, or executive writing workflows, and the systems thinking to break a recurring process into the rules, inputs, and thresholds that make it automatable.

We're Also Looking For:

• You bring an owner-operator mindset and are comfortable moving between granular financial models and executive-level strategic reviews.

• You have sharp operating-cadence judgment and know how to design dashboards, forecast reviews, and decision forums that keep cross-functional teams aligned.

• You influence without authority, earning credibility with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, and Product so they take ownership of their numbers without escalation.

• You approach numbers with a skeptic's eye, connecting cross-functional dots and catching discrepancies in the data before they ever reach leadership.

• You make the people around you better, raising the bar on rigor through feedback and example rather than authority.

• You are relentlessly curious about the "why" behind business performance and bring the executive presence to grow into broader finance leadership.

Salary Range: The base salary for this role is $177,000-205,000. Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes benefits, and other opportunities at Dashlane. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Dashlaners.

Location-Specific Information: You will be based in New York with English as your working language. At Dashlane, we embrace a hybrid culture that combines the best of both worlds: the creativity and energy of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Our model is designed to strengthen team connections, while supporting individual productivity and work-life balance. To maximize collaboration, we come together in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, while Wednesdays and Fridays offer more flexibility for focused work.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging at Dashlane:

As a truly international company—founded in France and distributed across France, US and Portugal—Dashlane thrives off diverse perspectives. We value all aspects of diversity: gender identity, sexual orientation, ability, ethnic origin, social background, age, lifestyle, and more. We are committed to hiring a diverse community and fostering a culture where everyone is heard and belongs. See more about this here.
