Company Overview (Who are we? Why should you join us?)

At ecoATM the proof of our success is in our staggering growth, extraordinary impact on protecting the planet, and providing a work culture unlike any other. We are a technology company and a pioneer of device re-commerce. Through our 7,500 automated kiosks and online marketplace Gazelle.com, we enable people all over the world to join the mobile device re-use revolution, a revolution that will get billions of used smartphones out of the e-waste cycle and into the hands of people who don’t have affordable access to the empowerment of the latest mobile technology.

At ecoATM we know our employees are our greatest strength and the key to our continued growth and success. When you join our team, you will enjoy more than just a job, you will be empowered to develop and utilize your unique talents and skills to build a rewarding career while making a lasting, positive impact on the planet.

Our Values and Leadership Behaviors

Position Overview

The Gazelle Operations Team Lead position is responsible for ensuring the success of their department. The Team Lead will work closely with an Operations Supervisor and the Operations Manager. The main component of this position includes responsibility for distributing work and providing support to team members to ensure all processes are completed accurately. The team lead is expected to have a thorough understanding of all departmental processes and actively perform operational tasks as needed to support daily business needs.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage the processes for the product line(s) and ensure they are running efficiently and effectively

• Achieve warehouse operational objectives by implementing production, productivity, quality, and customer-service standards; resolving problems; completing audits; identifying trends and proposing solutions and improvements

• Monitor, assess and guide performance of team members. Escalate any personnel issues with team members to the Operations Management Team

• Provide training and on-going support to team members on the assigned product line(s)

• Participate in device reviews to provide input on functional requirements, testing procedures, schedules, or potential problems

• Review procedure documentation to ensure technical accuracy, compliance, or completeness, or to mitigate risks.

• Continuously evaluate product flow and product handling systems and make recommendations to improve efficiencies; evaluate and recommend new equipment

• Actively promote safe and healthy work environment by establishing, following, and enforcing safety standards and procedures and complying with all legal regulations

• Other duties as assigned

Education & Experience

• High school diploma or GED required, college coursework or degree a plus

• 1 - 2 years of experience in a warehouse environment working with multiple product lines and variable processes which require critical thinking and problem solving skills

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Must be able to coach and mentor team members

• Computer proficiency

• Capable of learning details about mobile phones and consumer electronics

• Able to work independently, make decisions and exercise good judgment without immediate supervision

• Attention to detail

• Sense of urgency and ability to meet service level agreement and deadlines

• Ability to work flexible hours and different shift requirements

• Dependable, trustworthy and able to work well within a team environment

• Ability to identify issues and recommend creative solutions using problem -solving skills

• Positive and energetic attitude

• Excellent written/verbal communication skills

Physical Requirements

Ability to frequently read fine print, inspect product, differentiate fine details, and repeatedly manipulate small electronic devices. Repetitive manipulation of objects, tools, or controls. Regularly operate a computer at a standing work station, using a keyboard, mouse and scanner. Frequently positioning of oneself (e.g., stand, walk, stoop, bend, twist, kneel, crouch) to perform work tasks. May need to move boxes weighing up to 40 lbs. and occasionally up to 70lbs a distance of up to 50 feet. Frequent use of hands to sort & package material. With assistance, may need to operate push carts weighing up to 3000 lbs. across a concrete surface. jobs.title: Manager, Business Risk and AI Automation
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Position Overview

We're seeking a Manager, Business Risk and AI Automation, to help shape the next chapter of Internal Audit at Reddit. You'll lead day-to-day oversight and hands-on execution of our SOX program across Business Process Controls, Entity Level Controls, Key Reports, and Tech Application Controls, while helping build an AI-first approach to assurance. As part of our Risk Advisory and Assurance team, you'll tackle complex control questions and turn emerging technology into practical improvements. You’ll have opportunities to apply your expertise more broadly to strengthen internal controls and improve processes across the business. This is an opportunity for a strong internal controls practitioner who enjoys owning delivery and building better ways to work.

This is an individual contributor role. The Manager owns SOX program delivery and partners with a Senior teammate who performs business process testing, providing review, technical guidance, and cross-functional coordination.

What You’ll Do

• Own day-to-day SOX delivery from risk assessment and scoping through testing and reporting, keeping the program on track and focused on key risks.

• Lead walkthroughs and hands-on testing of control design and operating effectiveness across business process controls, entity level controls, key reports, and technology application controls.

• Ensure high-quality, well-supported SOX testing through workpaper review, actionable feedback, and technical guidance to other team members.

• Build trusted relationships across Finance and Accounting, Sales, People & Culture, Legal, and Technology to help control owners strengthen controls and improve processes while maintaining audit objectivity.

• Serve as a primary point of contact for external auditors, coordinating testing coverage, timelines, and evidence requirements to support our SOX reliance strategy.

• Evaluate testing exceptions, support deficiency assessment, and coordinate remediation tracking and retesting to confirm control issues are resolved.

• Help transform how SOX work gets done by identifying, piloting, and scaling AI and automation opportunities across evidence analysis, testing, documentation, and reporting.

• Build repeatable AI-enabled workflows, validate their accuracy, and help the team adopt them through clear documentation and coaching.

Who You Might Be

• An experienced audit or risk professional with 6+ years in public accounting and/or internal audit, including leading SOX workstreams and delivering high-quality audit work.

• A hands-on SOX practitioner who independently drives delivery and applies sound judgment to complex control issues.

• A curious, practical problem-solver who connects audit work to business priorities and finds opportunities to improve established ways of working.

• A trusted partner who builds strong relationships with business stakeholders and external auditors, communicates findings constructively, and works through complex control judgments.

• Experience at a platform company preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Professional certifications such as CPA, CIA, and/or CISA preferred.

• Strong knowledge of SOX and COSO, including risk-based scoping, walkthroughs, control design and operating effectiveness testing, evidence evaluation, and deficiency assessment.

• Strong project management, workpaper review, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex processes and risks into clear conclusions and practical recommendations.

• Hands-on experience using AI tools and prompting to improve professional workflows, with the ability to test, refine, and critically evaluate results.

• Experience with agentic AI, data analytics, or low-code automation is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Regulatory Affairs Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT INSPIRE MEDICAL SYSTEMS

Inspire is the first of its kind medical device designed to make a difference in the lives of those living with Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA). We are revolutionizing the sleep industry with our FDA-approved medical device, designed to reduce OSA severity for those who cannot tolerate or get consistent benefit from CPAP. Inspire Medical Systems is committed to enhancing patients’ lives through sleep innovation.  We are steadfast in our commitment to prioritize patient outcomes, act with integrity and lead with respect. With positive persistence at our core, we are committed to all those we serve.

WHY JOIN OUR FAST-GROWING TEAM

At Inspire, we value people – your diverse experiences, backgrounds, and thoughts. We elevate voices and encourage learning opportunities to build a professional network that grows into community. We embrace a people-first culture by offering excellent benefits, 401k matching, ESPP, flexible time off (FTO), and tuition reimbursement.

If you’re passionate about making a difference in people’s lives and want to work with innovative technology, come be a part of our great team!

JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Regulatory Affairs Specialist will lead and execute regulatory strategies for digital health products and software accessories for an implantable neurostimulation therapy for the treatment of obstructive sleep apnea. This position is responsible for providing regulatory guidance on digital health technologies throughout the software development lifecycle. This role supports global regulatory activities with primary focus on the United States and European Union.

Working independently under the direction of Regulatory Affairs Management, this position will serve as the Regulatory Affairs lead on assigned projects, owning regulatory impact assessments and developing compliant submission pathways. The role requires strong collaboration with cross‐functional partners and combines regulatory expertise, scientific knowledge, and business acumen to ensure products are designed, developed, and maintained in compliance with applicable global regulatory requirements.

MAIN DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

• Serve as a strategic regulatory partner to Software Engineering, Product Security, Systems Engineering, Clinical, Design Assurance, and Product Management teams to ensure software design, risk management, cybersecurity, usability, verification, validation, and release activities meet regulatory expectations.

• Independently assess regulatory impact for new digital product features, interoperable system features, software changes, cloud infrastructure changes, cybersecurity updates, and third-party software updates.

• Develop regulatory strategies for digital health technologies and software-enabled medical devices, including assessment of submission requirements, premarket pathways, global market access implications, and lifecycle change management.

• Compile, prepare, review, and submit high-quality regulatory submissions in the US and EU, including Q-submissions, PMA supplements, and IDE-related submissions, Annual Reports, Technical Documentation, Notification of Change, and interactive correspondence with regulatory authorities.

• Collaborate with subject matter experts to prepare accurate, timely, and professional responses to regulatory authority questions.

• Review and provide regulatory guidance on software requirements, architecture, cybersecurity risk assessments, threat modeling documentation, software verification and validation documentation, traceability matrices, anomaly assessments, and release documentation to ensure regulatory compliance and submission readiness.

• Support development and maintenance of cybersecurity documentation, including Secure Product Development Framework (SPDF) deliverables, vulnerability management procedures, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), cybersecurity risk management documentation, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure activities.

• Lead regulatory intelligence activities related to software, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, interoperability, cloud-connected medical devices, and digital health technologies, and translate emerging requirements into actionable business recommendations.

• Independently assess regulatory impact for post-market product changes to implantable devices and accessories, including design, manufacturing, labeling, and supplier changes.

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining high attention to detail, accountability, and execution quality.

• Complete all required training and maintain competency for assigned responsibilities.

• Comply with applicable Quality Management System procedures and regulatory requirements.

• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in regulatory processes, tools, and documentation practices.

QUALIFICATIONS

Educational Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, life sciences, regulatory science, or related scientific discipline (or equivalent experience)

Required Experience:

• 5+ years of experience in medical devices, digital health, software, cybersecurity, or other highly regulated environments, with demonstrated experience supporting regulated software products and product development activities.

• Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, software risk management, software verification and validation, and design control requirements.

• Demonstrated experience evaluating software changes and determining regulatory impact for product releases, maintenance updates, defect corrections, and cybersecurity remediations.

Preferred Experience:

• Experience supporting AI-enabled, machine learning-enabled, or advanced software technologies in regulated healthcare environments.

• Regulatory support experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Mobile medical applications

• Connected medical devices

• Cloud-based healthcare platforms

• Digital health ecosystems

• Software as a Medical Device (SaMD)

• Software in a Medical Device (SiMD)

• Secure Product Development Frameworks (SPDF) for medical devices

• Active implantable medical devices with software-enabled functionality

• Working knowledge of applicable regulations and standards:

• Section 524B (Cyber Device Act)

• 21 CFR Part 11, 806, 814, 820

• EU MDR (EU) 2017/745

• ISO 13485, ISO 14971

• IEC 60601, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, IEC 81001-5-1

#LI-Onsite

The salary for this position will be offered at a level consistent with the experience and qualifications of the candidate. This information reflects the anticipated salary range for this position at the time of posting. The salary range may be modified in the future and actual compensation may vary from the posting based on various factors such as geographic location, work experience, education and/or skill level.

Salary

$110,000—$150,000 USD

BENEFITS AND OTHER COMPENSATION

Inspire offers a highly competitive benefits package including (general description of the benefits and other compensation offered):

• Multiple health insurance plan options.

• Employer contributions to Health Savings Account.

• Dental, Vision, Life and Disability benefits.

• 401k plan + employer match.

• Identity Protection.

• Flexible time off.

• Tuition Reimbursement.

jobs.title: Senior Google Workspace Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview of 66degrees

66degrees is an end-to-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.

At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.

Overview of Role

In the role of Senior Google Workspace Engineer, you will direct technical architecture, strategic planning, and hands-on execution for small to mid-market projects, while also driving complex enterprise migrations to Google Workspace. This senior engineering position calls for comprehensive technical expertise spanning both Google Workspace and Microsoft environments (including Microsoft 365, Exchange On-Premises/Online, SharePoint, and OneDrive). You will function as the primary technical leader across all client tiers:

• Small and Mid-Market Projects: Drive full end-to-end migration initiatives from initial architecture and discovery through cutover execution, hypercare support, and operational handoff.

• Enterprise-Level Engagements: Partner with deployment teams to execute multi-phase migration roadmaps, serving as the subject matter expert during implementation.

Responsibilities

• Architect, deploy, and support Google Workspace solutions, tenant consolidations, and multi-source migrations (Exchange, M365, Google-to-Google, legacy IMAP/file servers) across small to enterprise-scale environments.

• Lead architecture design sessions and executive-level technical discussions, translating complex business requirements into scalable collaboration architectures.

• Design and deploy advanced mail routing, split-domain configurations, dual delivery, secure relays, and email authentication standards (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).

• Configure enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO), automated provisioning, Google Cloud Directory Sync (GCDS), Entra, SCIM, and multi-tenant IAM architectures.

• Implement enterprise security frameworks, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Context-Aware Access, Google Vault retention policies, Zero Trust controls, and Client-Side Encryption (CSE) with KMS integration.

• Deploy and manage endpoint and browser policies to enforce compliance using Google Endpoint Management, third-party MDMs (JumpCloud, Omnissa), and Chrome Enterprise Core/Premium.

• Engineer automated migration, administration, and reporting workflows using GAM/GAMADV-XTD3, Google Apps Script, Python, and PowerShell.

• Provision and manage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) service accounts, Workspace APIs, OAuth consent scopes, and third-party SaaS management tooling.

• Produce enterprise-grade architecture diagrams, cutover runbooks, migration schedules, and disaster recovery procedures.

• Conduct technical enablement sessions for client administrators and contribute specialized documentation to internal knowledge repositories.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of progressive IT engineering experience, with at least 3+ years directly architecting and managing enterprise Google Workspace environments.

• 3+ years of hands-on administration in Microsoft environments (Entra ID / Azure AD, Active Directory Domain Services, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive).

• 3+ years executing data migrations using enterprise tooling such as Google Workspace Migrate (GWM), CloudM, BitTitan MigrationWiz, or Movebot.

• Strong mastery of enterprise identity federation and directory sync utilities (Okta, Entra ID SSO, GCDS, ADFS, PingIdentity).

• Demonstrated proficiency with admin tooling and CLI automation, specifically GAM / GAMADV-XTD3, PowerShell, and either Python or Google Apps Script.

• In-depth networking and messaging protocol expertise: DNS records (MX, TXT, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, CNAME), SMTP transport, TLS enforcement, and firewall routing.

• Firm understanding of security, audit, and compliance tools (Google Vault, Context-Aware Access, S/MIME, Endpoint Management).

• Exceptional client-facing communication skills with proven ability to present complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders and C-level executives.

• Demonstrated ownership of project deliverables, cutover planning, and issue escalation triage.

• Willingness and ability to travel to client sites when required for project milestones.

• Preferred Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Collaboration Engineer (strongly preferred), Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer, Microsoft Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert or Identity and Access Administrator Associate

Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.

66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.

AI Transparency & Disclosure

As an AI transformation partner, 66degrees leverages intelligent solutions to enhance our recruitment experience. We utilize AI tools—including LinkedIn Recruiter’s Hiring Assistant and interview transcription technologies—to assist with sourcing, role analysis, and capturing interview highlights.

These tools augment our process, but we "Commit to Our Craft" by ensuring all final hiring decisions are made by our human Talent Team. By applying, you acknowledge the use of these technologies to help us "Win Together" in finding the best fit for our team.

• Support the Supervisor and SME Supervisor roles at the site, ensuring shift operations and workstream execution are running effectively

• Serve as the site-level escalation point for issues that exceed Supervisor or SME Supervisor authority

• Coordinate site facilities, physical security, and access management with relevant site/facility points of contact

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Diversified
jobs.description:
About Definitive Healthcare:

At Definitive Healthcare, our mission is simple: to connect with the real people who make healthcare happen. With real data on real people, our customers get the Definitive picture of the Healthcare market to move their businesses and organizations forward.

We’re committed to delivering the industry’s most reliable, actionable, and differentiated insights and empowering the innovators and organizations transforming healthcare. Because when our customers succeed, healthcare improves—for everyone.

Since our founding in 2011, we’ve grown into a global company headquartered just outside Boston, Massachusetts, supporting more than 2,100 customers around the world. Along the way, we’ve built a culture centered on purposeful work, collaboration, curiosity, and meaningful impact.

We’re passionate about the work we do and the people we do it with. Through programs like Definitive Cares and our employee-led affinity groups, we create opportunities for our teams to connect and give back to the communities where we live and work.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Account Executive to act as a trusted advisor to a named portfolio of medium-to-large existing Diversified accounts. You'll own the overall client relationship for retention and expansion, building your book of business over time — turning existing accounts into long-term, growing revenue — supported by Solutions Consultants, Customer Success, and Sales Development.

What You’ll Do

You'll own the full lifecycle of a named portfolio of existing Diversified acting as a trusted advisor and strategic partner long after the initial sale. Your day-to-day will be supported by Solutions Consultants, Customer Success Managers, and Sales Development Representatives as you build and execute Strategic Account Plans, apply pricing and negotiation judgment to renewal and expansion proposals, resolve account-level risk, and grow your book of business year over year. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced, strategic account manager ready to own larger, more complex relationships within a high-growth healthcare commercial intelligence company!

• Meet and exceed revenue targets within your assigned client portfolio.

• Own retention and expansion of a book of business consisting of medium-to-large Diversified accounts — you are accountable for keeping these relationships and growing them over time.

• Build and nurture relationships across your existing accounts going deeper within the teams you already serve, wider into new departments and functions (Sales, Marketing, Commercial Operations), and up to senior and C-suite stakeholders to uncover expansion opportunities and grow your book of business.

• Identify up-sell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts, including across therapeutic areas, in partnership with Customer Success.

• Apply pricing, margin, and contract-structure judgment when shaping renewal and expansion proposals and negotiation strategy.

• Flag and help resolve account-level risk that could affect renewal or expansion — partnering with Customer Success and leadership when a relationship needs intervention.

• Lead renewal negotiations — including with Legal, Finance, and Procurement stakeholders — and close multi-year service contracts.

• Build and maintain Strategic Account Plans with internal stakeholders, tied to client objectives and measurable KPIs.

• Accurately forecast opportunities and maintain pipeline hygiene in Salesforce.

• Use AI tools to enhance account research, deal preparation, and personal productivity.

• Coordinate with Solutions Consultants, Customer Success, and Sales Development to execute account strategy and maximize client value.

• Develop a deep understanding of how Diversified organizations (commercial, market access, sales operations, and business development teams) use healthcare commercial intelligence and data to inform go-to-market strategy.

• Manage all facets of complex sales cycles, often involving multiple stakeholders — including Sales Ops, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and IT — and data-driven buying decisions.

• Lead value engineering and ROI conversations tailored to each account’s business case.

• Track industry trends and evolving client needs to spot new opportunities early.

What You'll Bring

• BA or BS degree.

• 8+ years of experience selling into Strategic or Enterprise accounts, with experience in data or consultative selling; healthcare data experience a plus.

• Documented history of meeting or exceeding a competitive sales quota and account targets, with strong negotiation and closing skills.

• Strategic account planning and execution skills.

• Exceptional written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills; you prioritize and value a disciplined sales process.

• You independently lead deals from first call to close, making judgment calls on pricing and contract terms without needing manager sign-off, and you're a go-to resource for less experienced reps.

• Ability to work with and influence a wide range of stakeholders — from day-to-day end users to C-level executives — including commercial leadership within Diversified organizations.

• Skilled at navigating complex organizations to identify and engage key decision-makers.

• Experience negotiating and closing multi-year service contracts.

• Financial acumen, including pricing and margin trade-offs as part of negotiation strategy.

• A passion for solving customer business problems.

• Willingness to travel approximately 40% of the time, including participation in quarterly business reviews, industry events, and onsite customer visits.

• Experience selling into the Diversified industry strongly preferred.

Compensation and Benefits

The base salary range for this position is $88,000–$132,000 per year, which represents the base pay the company reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this role. Target on-target earnings (OTE), including commission, is $176,000–$264,000 per year. Actual pay within this range will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

Depending on the position, employees may also be eligible to participate in a company bonus or commission plan. All employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, and participation in the company’s 401(k) plan with employer contribution.

Why we love Definitive Healthcare, and why you will too!

At Definitive Healthcare, our values shape how we work, how we treat one another, and how we deliver for our customers.

• We’re obsessed with data. Great companies are built on data customers can rely on. As responsible stewards, we validate rigorously, question assumptions, and use data to make better decisions.

• We’re accountable. We take ownership of results, not just tasks. When something needs doing, we step up. When things break, we fix them. We follow things through until the job is done.

• We care deeply. About our teammates, our customers, and the impact of what we build. We assume good intent, communicate openly, and support each other through challenges. We always bring maximum energy to everything we do.

We're also committed to creating an environment where our people feel supported in their work, their wellbeing, and their financial future.

• We invest in our people. We offer a competitive benefits package, including comprehensive healthcare benefits and a 401(k) match.

• We make room for connection and impact. Definitive Cares is our 100% employee-driven program that creates opportunities to connect with colleagues through affinity groups and make a positive impact on our communities.

• We’re a great place to work. In 2024 and 2025, we earned multiple workplace honors, including Built In’s 100 Best Places to Work in Boston (both years), a Stevie Bronze Award for Great Employers, and recognition as a Great Place to Work in India.

What our Employees are saying about us on Glassdoor:

“Great Work atmosphere, great work life balance, excellent company to work for, amazing top notch product, incredible customer service, lots of tools to help you succeed.”

-Business Development Manager

“Great team. Amazing growth. Employees are treated very well.”

-Research Analyst

“I have waited 36 years to work at a dream job for a dream company, and I am so happy to have finally got there.”

-Profile Analyst

If you don’t fit all of these qualifications, but believe you’re still a great fit, feel free to apply and tell us why in your cover letter.

If you are a California, Colorado, New York City or Washington resident and this role is a remote role, you can receive additional information about the compensation and benefits for this role, which we will provide upon request.

Definitive Hiring Philosophy

Definitive Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other status. If you’re interested in working in a fast growing, exciting working environment – we encourage you to apply!

You're sociable and eager to contribute to maintaining a pleasant and engaging work environment, fostering strong relationships with colleagues and clients alike. Additionally, you bring:

A leader in personalized customer experiences

jobs.description:
Registered Veterinary Technician

Salary: $30.00-$32.00 per hour dependent on skills and experience

What to Expect as an RVT at 5280 Veterinary Care

As a Registered Veterinary Technician at 5280 Veterinary Care, you'll be empowered to practice at the top of your license. We believe RVTs are the driving force behind exceptional patient care, outstanding client education, and a thriving medical team. Your knowledge, technical skills, and clinical judgment are respected here—and you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact every single day.

You'll work alongside a collaborative team that values your expertise while encouraging continued growth through mentorship, advanced medicine, and a wide variety of interesting cases. We also believe experienced RVTs have an invaluable role in developing those around them. From mentoring veterinary assistants to helping educate our client care team on medical concepts and patient advocacy, you'll help elevate the entire hospital through your knowledge and leadership.

To support your career, we offer:

• License reimbursement

• Continuing education assistance and CE pay

• Professional development opportunities

• Uniform allowance

• 401(k) with company matching

• Health insurance

• Vision insurance

• Dental insurance

• Paid time off and flex time for holidays

• Employee discount

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

No two days look exactly the same here. You'll see a diverse caseload, work alongside experienced doctors, and have opportunities to continue expanding your technical skills while practicing high-quality, gold-standard medicine.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an experienced RVT who is passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and takes pride in the details that make a difference. Although every RVT at 5280 Veterinary Care contributes across the hospital, this position has a strong emphasis on surgery and dentistry. We're looking for someone who enjoys the fast pace, technical precision, and teamwork that come with surgical nursing while still embracing the variety that general practice offers.

The ideal candidate will have:

• Current Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT) license

• Recent, hands-on experience assisting with veterinary dentistry, including dental radiology, ultrasonic scaling, polishing, and anesthesia monitoring

• Strong technical nursing skills with confidence in anesthesia, surgery, dentistry, and patient care

• A passion for mentoring veterinary assistants and sharing knowledge with the medical team

• Exceptional attention to detail and a personal commitment to providing gold-standard medicine

• Outstanding communication skills with both clients and teammates

• A positive, collaborative attitude and a genuine desire to continue learning and growing

Schedule

• Full-time

• Four 10-hour shifts

• One rotating late shift each week (9:30 AM–8:30 PM)

• Rotating Saturdays (every other week)

Why 5280 Veterinary Care?

Our culture is just as important as the medicine we practice. We've intentionally built a team where kindness, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning are everyday expectations—not just buzzwords. We value longevity, and we're proud that many of our team members have been with us for years. That kind of retention doesn't happen by accident; it's the result of investing in our people, supporting professional growth, and creating an environment where team members genuinely enjoy coming to work.

We believe exceptional medicine starts with exceptional communication. That's why client education is a cornerstone of everything we do—we take the time to explain the why behind our recommendations so pet owners can make informed decisions and become true partners in their pets' care.

Our community has recognized that commitment by honoring us with Nextdoor Neighborhood Fave Awards every year from 2022–2025, a Top 3 Best of Mile High finish in 2024, and the 2025 Colorado Companies to Watch – Caring for Colorado Award.

We're proud of what we've built, and we're looking for an RVT who wants to grow with a team that's committed to raising the standard of veterinary medicine every day.

We are dedicated to establishing a culture that celebrates all forms of diversity and allows us to be an inclusive service provider in this community.

jobs.title: VP, Finance and Business Operations
jobs.description:
A Note From the Founder

Citizen builds with agents now, and that changes what a finance leader does. The close, the forecast, the board package, the variance analysis: producing these is no longer the job. The judgment behind them is.



Consumer subscription revenue is growing, the enterprise business is working and ready to scale, and the product that made us the #1 safety app in America is going global. Each of those is a financial question as much as a product one: what to price, what to fund, what to stop. I need one leader who owns the whole financial model, keeps the books and board materials ready, leads our investor and board relationships alongside me, and gives me a straight answer when the numbers say something different from the plan. That person works next to me, every day.



The Role

Citizen is the #1 safety app in the U.S. Every day, thousands of videos are captured live at the scene of real incidents and distributed in real time to people in every major American city. No other consumer product has this. It is a live network, a newsroom, and a safety tool at once, and it is growing. Our mission is simple: Protect the World.

The VP of Finance & Business Operations owns Citizen's financial and operating engine end to end: planning and forecasting, accounting and the close, audit, tax, treasury and cash, fundraising and investor reporting, board management, the company KPIs and the instrumentation behind them, strategic planning and OKRs, vendor negotiation, strategic partnerships, and the data room that keeps the company ready for its next financing or its exit. You report to the Founder and serve as his partner on capital, the board, and strategy. You sit on the leadership team and work most closely with the leaders of engineering and technology, product, applied AI, growth, and enterprise sales. You manage the finance team: a Finance & Business Operations Manager, to be hired in New York, and an Accounting Manager.

You will not build a large finance organization. The production work of finance is carried by agents you design and operate, with your team holding the controls and the signatures. One leader with the right systems and the right judgment now carries what a finance organization of ten carried three years ago. This seat is built on that premise.

This is the seat for a Series B to C stage finance leader who has run the function before, or been the clear number two in a larger one, and wants to own it outright.



Why Now

Citizen built the public safety category and became the #1 safety app in the country. The next chapter is a product people open every day rather than only on a bad one, a subscription business that funds it, an enterprise business that is already working and needs to scale, and Citizen in every country in the world. Every one of those bets has a financial decision underneath it, and the company is about to make several at once. This seat is for one executive who sees the whole model, knows which growth lever is real, keeps the books and the board ready, and can run the capital process alongside the Founder. Until recently that person needed a department. Now they need agents, rigor, and the nerve to decide.



How We Work

Every role at Citizen is two things: the craft, and the operation of AI to multiply it.

You are a finance leader first. Judgment about what a dollar should do and what it should not. The discipline of a clean close, an audit-ready set of books, and a forecast the board can rely on. The standing to run a solo conversation with a board director or an investor and come back with the company's position intact.

You will work alongside colleagues who are not people. Eve is our engineering agent; she lives in the codebase and ships. Athena is the Founder's chief of staff; she runs operations and will be in your inbox on day one. You will build your own. The close, reconciliations, variance analysis, forecast refreshes, board materials, KPI reporting, and vendor spend review are carried by agents you design and operate. You decide what runs without a human, you hold the bar on accuracy, and you keep the judgment calls for yourself. What this job is not: a controller with a larger title, a reporting function, a layer between the Founder and the numbers, or a department to build. The agents produce the artifacts. You produce the decisions.



What You Will Own

Planning and forecasting. The annual budget, the operating model, and the rolling financial forecast across consumer subscription, enterprise, international, headcount, infrastructure, and cash. FP&A as a discipline: driver-based, refreshed from source systems, with every variance explained before anyone asks. Product, Growth, and Sales own their driver inputs; you own the model's integrity.

Accounting, close, and audit. A timely monthly close measured in days, not weeks. Books that are audit ready at any moment. The annual audit, run on schedule with no surprises. A control environment designed for a function where agents do the work and people hold the signatures, and that would satisfy an auditor, an acquirer, or a public-company diligence team.

Tax, treasury, and cash. Federal, state, and local tax compliance and planning. Runway, burn, scenario planning, banking relationships, and the cash management discipline that keeps the company's options open.

Fundraising, investors, and the board. Partner to the Founder on financing: timing, size, terms, and the story. Investor reporting that is current and accurate. Board management end to end: materials, calendar, follow-ups, and the ability to take a solo conversation with a director and handle it.

KPIs, instrumentation, and strategic planning. The core company KPIs, defined once and instrumented so that they are measured the same way every time. The strategic planning process and the OKR cycle that runs from it. The business growth levers, identified, quantified, and argued for in the leadership room.

Pricing and unit economics. The economics of the consumer subscription: acquisition cost, payback, lifetime value, plan mix, margin. The economics of enterprise: pricing, contract structure, gross margin, cost to serve. Infrastructure cost per user is a number you know and move.

Business operations and partnerships. Vendor management and contract negotiation across the company's spend. Negotiation and close of strategic partnerships, run by you with the Founder. Organizational change, when the plan calls for it, carried through rather than recommended.

New opportunities and new business lines. Citizen is about to make several bets at once: new product lines, new markets, and international expansion. You run the process that decides which ones get funded. For each opportunity: the market and the unit economics, the capital and the time it needs, the operating requirements underneath it (entity, tax, payments, compliance, local cost), the downside, and the kill criteria. You build the business case, pressure-test it with the leaders who will run it, and bring the Founder a recommendation with the model open. International expansion is the first of these; the discipline you set for it is the discipline every later bet gets.

Data room and exit readiness. A data room that stands ready rather than gets assembled, maintained continuously so that a financing, a strategic conversation, or an exit process starts from a complete position.

The agentic finance function itself. Which decisions an agent makes and which a human signs. Where the controls sit when the ledger is written by a machine. This is finance for a company that runs on agents, and you set the standard.

The team. A Finance & Business Operations Manager (to be hired, New York) and an Accounting Manager, led, developed, and held to the same standard you hold yourself to. You will hire the first of these in your opening months.



Your First 90 Days

Days 1–30. Learn the model, the books, the cap table, the board history, the subscription data and the enterprise pipeline. Use the product every day and pay for it. Meet every board director and key investor with the Founder. Own the weekly cash and revenue read by month's end. Assess the close, the tax calendar and the data room. Stand up your first agent on the close or the variance analysis.

Days 31–60. Build the one operating model the company runs on, with the budget and forecast refreshed automatically, not rebuilt by hand. Run your first close and cut the days. Define the core KPIs and how each is measured. Bring the Founder a 24-month capital plan with scenarios. Set the framework for vetting new business lines and markets, starting with international. Run the first board package through the new process.

Days 61–90. Present the 12-month plan, capital strategy and OKR calendar to the Founder and the board. The data room is complete. First vendor renegotiations closed. Finance & Business Operations Manager hired or in final rounds.



How Success is Measured

 - Forecast accuracy: actuals against your forecast, monthly, improving

 - Close: days from month end to final numbers, falling; audit delivered on schedule without findings

 - Cash: runway and burn against the plan you own

 - Unit economics: subscription contribution margin, enterprise gross margin, infrastructure cost per user, against targets you set

 - Board and investor readiness: time from a request to a complete, current answer; data room always current

 - KPI integrity: one definition per metric, instrumented, trusted across the leadership team Spend: vendor savings negotiated and partnership terms closed against targets you set Loops running without you: the count of finance functions carried end to end by agents you built, with the controls intact



Who You Are

 - You have been the finance leader of a venture-backed startup, or the clear number two in a larger finance organization, through at least one financing and a full board cycle. Series B to C scale is the shape of this job.

 - You have run FP&A, a monthly close, an audit, and a tax calendar yourself, and you have managed the people who run them.

 - You have raised capital alongside a founder, produced the investor reporting afterward, and handled a board director one on one.

 - You have set a company's KPIs and built the instrumentation to measure them, and you can name the growth levers in a business after a week inside it.

 - You have negotiated vendor terms and strategic partnerships, built the business case for a new line or a market launch, told the room which bets not to make, and carried an organizational change through.

 - You keep a data room ready and you know what an acquirer or a crossover investor will ask before they ask it.

 - You have replaced work you used to manage with a system you built. You already run reporting and operational work on AI tools and agents, you can show what they do without you, and you have opinions about where they fail.

 - You have told a founder no, with the model open, and been right often enough that he kept asking. Investment banking or similar analytical training is a plus, not a requirement.



Compensation

Base salary $325,000 to $350,000, plus meaningful equity.

The Enviva team is driven by our shared vision for a renewable energy future. We are a fast-growing, purpose-driven, global energy company specializing in delivering sustainable wood bioenergy solutions. We are the world’s largest producer of sustainable wood pellets, which provide a low-carbon alternative to fossil fuels.

The Electrical Technician assists in the production process, troubleshooting and repair of electrical, controls, and some mechanical aspects of port and facilities equipment on assigned shifts. This position provides technical support, analyzes production data, and improves safety, uptime, quality, energy consumption, tool change cycle times, and other operational metrics.

Responsibilities

• Perform installation, maintenance work, electrical field work, inspections/maintenance of heavy equipment obeying OSHA and Enviva standards for work practices

• Maintains adherence to workplace and safety practices and principles, and electrical standards in compliance with the relevant Federal, State, and Local Codes.

• Troubleshoot electrical issues relating to the PLC controlled devices, motor control centers, VFD’s instrumentation (multi-meter, megger, process meter, hart meter, amp meter) and other standard electrical devices using electrical drawings.

• Wire, Troubleshoot, repair, AC/DC circuits and equipment, replace wiring electrical issues relating to the PLC, motor control centers, 480V and 4160V electrical distribution equipment and all electrical devices, equipment, sensors and fixtures

• Troubleshoot different communication and IT technologies (D-Net, E-Net, Fiber Optic).

• Identify corrective action and troubleshooting to improve reliability of equipment.

• Perform electrical field work including preventative, predictive, and corrective maintenance on electrical systems, process control, drives and actuators, instrumentation and telemetry equipment.

• Ensure equipment is properly maintained and calibrated before use and reports abnormalities

• Monitor production process operating parameters and makes appropriate adjustments to ensure safe and efficient equipment performance

• Perform additional duties as assigned and directed.

• Four (4) years of electrical experience.

• Proficient in mathematics and measurements.

• Wood products background.

• Experience in PLC programming and working with automated devices and electrical distribution equipment.

Working conditions

• Willing and able to work in a hot, humid, cold and noisy industrial environment

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Now is an amazing time to join Nozomi Networks as we build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.

We defend some of the world’s largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we’re just getting started. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.

As we expand our product portfolio and global presence, our Customer Success department is hiring a Strategic Customer Success Manager to engage and build meaningful relationships with our Critical Accounts driving a high level of customer satisfaction, successful product use, and customer retention. You will serve as the primary point of contact for key customers, understand customer success criteria, drive adoption & value realization, address questions, resolve issues and grow into a trusted customer advocate.

For the right candidate, this is a career-defining opportunity to join Nozomi at a crucial moment and have a truly significant impact. The ideal candidate should have a proven track record of exceptional account management, maintaining high customer renewal rates as a result of ongoing customer engagement, technical leadership, and outstanding communication skills.

If this sounds like you, read on. You could be the next "Nozomier"!

In this role, you will:

• Develop and manage customer portfolio.

• Drive business outcomes and value realisation

• Manage customer relationships up to the economic buyer

• Own and drive the customer lifecycle – protect, nurture and deliver exceptional service to all customers.

• Drive revenue growth by demonstrating successful achievement of customer guided value measures

• Resolve customer requests and concerns ensuring improvements to customer experience.

• Improve customer experience through data and trend analysis, ensuring relevant reporting to influence communication and engagement strategies with the customer and internally.

• Maintain customer information accuracy to ensure that internal stakeholders always have clean data and customer information.

• Be a reliable point of contact and brand ambassador for Nozomi and its products.

• Aid in product design and product development through customer feedback.

To be successful in this opportunity, you will have:

• Deep understanding of customers concerns and thoughts regarding the use of products, recommending operational best practices, and the ability to troubleshoot as needed.

jobs.description:

Role Summary

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better.

As the Head of Performance Partnerships, you'll help shape how buyers discover, evaluate, and trust HubSpot in an AI-first internet.

This role leads HubSpot's global affiliate, AEO/citation, nano/micro creator, and forum-growth ecosystem, driving efficient ARR growth while expanding HubSpot's visibility across emerging discovery channels including AI search, Reddit, nano/micro creators, review platforms, and third-party recommendation ecosystems.

You'll partner closely with Growth, Product, PMM, Brand, and Paid Media leaders to build scalable, experimentation-driven partnership strategies that connect discovery to measurable business outcomes.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone excited about defining the future of performance marketing in the AI era.

What You'll Do

• Lead HubSpot's global Performance Partnerships strategy across affiliate marketing, AI-native discovery, nano/micro creator partnerships, forum growth, and emerging acquisition channels.

• Scale affiliate and publisher ecosystems that drive efficient customer acquisition and ARR growth across key products and go-to-market motions.

• Build AI-first partnership strategies that increase HubSpot visibility across LLMs, Reddit, review platforms, nano/micro creator ecosystems, and third-party recommendation surfaces.

• Design and operationalize experimentation programs across affiliate models, nano/micro creator partnerships, indirect demand measurement, and emerging growth channels.

• Own partner investment strategy, commission frameworks, attribution models, and portfolio optimization across a multi-million-dollar investment portfolio.

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing global team spanning affiliate partnerships, optimization, AI visibility initiatives, and forum growth programs.

• Partner cross-functionally with Paid Media, Product, Product Marketing, Brand, Community, Finance, Analytics, and Growth teams to integrate partnership-led discovery into HubSpot's broader go-to-market strategy.

• Develop reporting frameworks and executive-ready narratives that connect partnership activity to ARR growth, demand generation, and AI visibility outcomes.

• Identify emerging discovery trends and translate ambiguous market signals into scalable growth opportunities.

• Champion data-driven decision-making while balancing experimentation, operational rigor, and long-term strategic impact.

What You'll Bring

• Strong understanding of modern discovery behaviors, including AI search, Reddit, creators, review platforms, and emerging acquisition channels.

• Experience managing significant marketing investments and optimizing toward revenue and efficiency metrics.

• Strong analytical and experimentation mindset with the ability to translate ambiguous signals into scalable growth programs.

• Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across Product, Marketing, Growth, Analytics, and external partners.

• Experience with creator partnerships, influencer ecosystems, or community-led growth.

• Familiarity with attribution, incrementality, or indirect demand measurement frameworks.

• Experience working in B2B SaaS and/or product-led growth environments.

• Experience scaling emerging acquisition programs from experimentation to operational maturity.

Where You'll Work

jobs.title: Product-Led Growth Marketer
jobs.description:
WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.




ABOUT THE ROLE

More of Socure's next customers will start without a sales call. Some start with an engineer in our docs. A growing share start with an AI agent evaluating identity APIs on someone's behalf. We're hiring a Product-Led Growth (PLG) Marketer to own that self-serve path for both audiences.

You'll own how Socure gets discovered, evaluated, and adopted with no human in the loop: from the first docs visit or agent query, to a sandbox key, to a first successful API call, to production and expansion. Developer marketing stays at the core of the job. The scope now adds two things: making Socure the identity infrastructure AI agents can find, understand, and integrate on their own, and modernizing how self-serve marketing works end to end.

This is a senior, hands-on role in Revenue Marketing. You'll work daily with Growth Engineering, Product, Engineering, DevRel, and Sales, and you'll be measured on activation, conversion, and revenue, not content output.

Location: We can only hire candidates based in one of our hubs: New York City, NY, or San Francisco, CA.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


OWN THE SELF-SERVE GROWTH ENGINE

 - Own the PLG strategy and funnel for Socure's API and platform products: discovery, signup, sandbox, first API call, production, and expansion.

 - Find the friction at every step and remove it. Run experiments on signup, onboarding, pricing and packaging pages, and in-product prompts with Growth Engineering and Product.

 - Build lifecycle and in-product programs that move sandbox users to production and production accounts to expansion.

 - Define product-qualified leads with Sales and RevOps, and route the right accounts to a human at the right moment.


BUILD THE DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE

 - Define developer ICPs, technical value propositions, use cases, and competitive positioning for engineers, architects, and technical decision-makers.

 - Treat docs, quickstarts, sample apps, SDKs, and the developer portal as growth surfaces. Partner with Engineering and DevRel to cut time to first successful call.

 - Translate Socure's AI-driven identity and fraud capabilities into technically credible content developers trust and share.

 - Own developer content and community: technical blogs, video walkthroughs, webinars, hackathons, and developer events.


BUILD THE AGENT EXPERIENCE

 - Make Socure easy for AI agents and coding assistants to discover, evaluate, and integrate. That includes machine-readable docs (llms.txt, clean OpenAPI specs), MCP servers, agent-friendly sandbox provisioning and auth, and structured capability and pricing data.

 - Make sure Socure shows up accurately when developers ask AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Copilot which identity API to use. Partner with Digital Marketing on answer engine optimization for technical queries.

 - Track agent-driven traffic, signups, and API activity as its own channel, and grow it.

 - Bring what you learn about agentic workflows into positioning and roadmap conversations.


MEASURE AND PARTNER

 - Own the self-serve KPIs: signups, sandbox activations, time to first call, sandbox-to-production conversion, product-qualified leads, self-serve pipeline and revenue, and agent-driven activity.

 - Partner with RevOps and Growth Engineering on instrumentation and attribution so every number is trusted.

 - Act as the PLG owner in planning cycles, QBRs, and product launches.

 - Bring developer and agent signals, competitive intelligence, and market trends into GTM strategy.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 6–8 years of B2B marketing experience, with a meaningful share in product-led growth, developer marketing, or growth for API or platform products.

 - A record of moving self-serve numbers (activation, conversion, expansion, self-serve revenue), and you can show the before and after.

 - Real technical fluency. You can read API docs, make a call against a sandbox, find your way around an OpenAPI spec, and spot where an integration breaks.

 - Hands-on time with AI agents and coding assistants. You've used tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or MCP servers, and you have opinions on how agents choose which tools and APIs to use.

 - Experimentation and analytics chops. You design tests, read them honestly, and work in product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or GA4.

 - The ability to translate complex AI and data-heavy technology into clear narratives for technical audiences without losing the nuance.

 - A track record of influencing Product, Engineering, and Sales without direct authority, and running several initiatives at once.

Bonus points

 - You've built or shipped an MCP server, llms.txt file, developer portal, or self-serve onboarding flow.

 - You've worked on usage-based pricing or self-serve packaging.

 - Experience in identity, fraud, fintech, or other regulated industries.

 - Comfort with SQL.

Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.




Follow Us!

YouTube https://www.youtube.com/c/Socure  |  LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/socure/ |  X (Twitter) https://x.com/socureme  |  Facebook https://www.facebook.com/socure/

jobs.description:
Territory Coverage: Hudson County, New Jersey. Travel throughout the assigned service area is required. Salary Range 155K - 165K

About Clover Health

At Clover Health, our mission is simple but powerful: to improve every life by delivering care that is high-quality, accessible, and rooted in compassion and innovation.

This is not a clinic churn. It's healthcare in the home, caring for medically complex Medicare members where their real-life barriers are visible.

You see the medications on the table, the fall risks, the caregiver dynamics, the food insecurity, the missed follow-ups, and the small clinical changes that can become major health events if no one catches them early.

Clover is building a model around that level of visibility.

We are seeking a compassionate and driven Nurse Practitioner to join our growing Clover Home Care Team in New Jersey.

This hybrid role supports Medicare Advantage members throughout Hudson County, NJ, combining in-home visits with telehealth care. This is an opportunity to build meaningful relationships with patients while improving outcomes for medically complex and vulnerable senior populations.

What You'll Do

• Conduct in-home and telehealth visits for Medicare Advantage members.

• Perform comprehensive assessments, medication reviews, and chronic disease management.

• Develop and implement individualized care plans that address both clinical and social determinants of health.

• Identify barriers to care, including fall risks, food insecurity, caregiver challenges, and gaps in treatment adherence.

• Collaborate with physicians, care coordinators, social workers, and other interdisciplinary team members to deliver holistic, member-centered care.

• Leverage Clover Assistant and EMR technology to support proactive care management and close gaps in care.

• Monitor health status and intervene early to help prevent avoidable emergency department visits and hospitalizations.

• Educate members and caregivers on disease management, preventive care, and treatment plans.

Qualifications

• Active Nurse Practitioner (NP) license in New Jersey or ability to obtain licensure.

• National board certification as a Nurse Practitioner.

• Active DEA and New Jersey CDS registration, or ability to obtain.

• Experience caring for adult or geriatric populations in primary care, complex care, chronic care management, transitional care, home-based care, or value-based care settings.

• Strong clinical assessment and chronic disease management skills.

• Passion for serving vulnerable senior populations.

• Comfortable utilizing technology and telehealth platforms to enhance patient care.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Home care, home health, home-based primary care, palliative care, geriatrics, or population health experience.

• Experience caring for Medicare Advantage members.

• Prior experience in value-based care models.

• Experience managing medically complex and high-risk patient populations.

• Bilingual skills are a plus.

Why Clover Health?

At Clover, we are transforming healthcare by meeting members where they are. Our innovative care model allows clinicians to see beyond the exam room and provide proactive, personalized care that improves lives.

What You Can Expect

• Hybrid field and telehealth model

• Mission-driven work with measurable impact

• Collaborative interdisciplinary care team

• Innovative technology designed to support providers

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits

• Opportunity to help shape the future of home-based care

Join Clover Health and help redefine what exceptional care looks like for Medicare members in their homes and communities. Apply today to make a lasting difference.

Benefits Overview:

• Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive hourly rate. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.

• Support for Our Clinicians: Professional liability (malpractice) coverage, Clover-branded scrubs, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), mileage reimbursement at the IRS rate, license and certification renewal reimbursement, and WiFi reimbursement for select roles.

• Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.

• Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous time-off policy.

• Full-time employees accrue up to 18 days of vacation per year.

• Clover recognizes 10 federal holidays, including New Year's Day, Juneteenth, and Christmas. There are also 4 additional paid holidays, and 1 floating holiday.

• Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer paid Continuing Medical Education (CME) days, a role-based CME allowance, learning programs, mentorship, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

• Reimbursement for office setup expenses

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities

• Paid parental leave for all new parents

• And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

#LI-ONSITE

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company.

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is:

$140,000—$165,000 USD

jobs.location: Remote, United States or Austin, TX HQ
jobs.description:
Do work that matters.

At AlertMedia, we help organizations protect their people, operations, and brand. Our modern Risk Intelligence and Response platform empowers teams to detect emerging threats, assess impact, and respond with confidence. We believe building resilience should be simpler—and it starts with bringing critical information and workflows together in one unified platform.

Our core values drive us in our important mission of keeping people safe & informed:

• We’re humans not robots

• Customers always come first

• We work better together

• Simplicity is our strength

• Our reputation is priceless Hard work pays off

AlertMedia is seeking a Global Intelligence Analyst (Tues-Sat, 3pm-11pm CST) to join our Global Intelligence team. This role will play a critical part in making sure our customers are provided with timely and accurate information when there is a critical event in their area. As a Global Intelligence Analyst, you will discern what information is important and relevant through the utilization of a variety of source tools then relay that information to our customers. This position requires laser-sharp focus, pristine attention-to-detail, clear and effective communication skills and the ability to reason. jobs.title: Home Health Occupational Therapist
jobs.description:
About the Role

Help patients regain independence and return to the daily activities that bring meaning to their lives. As a Home Health Occupational Therapist, you'll work one-on-one with patients in their homes, using creativity, clinical expertise, and problem-solving to help them rebuild the skills needed for everyday living. From dressing and bathing to cooking, managing routines, and engaging in meaningful activities, you'll guide patients as they rediscover their ability to live safely and independently.

This role is ideal for a licensed Occupational Therapist who thrives in a flexible, patient-centered environment and enjoys tailoring care to each individual's unique goals and home setting. You'll assess functional abilities, design personalized treatment plans, and develop adaptive strategies and solutions that support independence and safety. Working closely with patients, families, and an interdisciplinary care team, you'll provide education, hands-on training, and encouragement as patients progress toward greater confidence and independence in their daily lives.

Location

• Office Location: 24255 W 13 Mile Rd, Suite 250, Bingham Farms, MI 48025

• Main Service Area: Sterling Heights and surrounding area

• This role is a high travel position and requires daily travel within the service area to provide care to patients in their homes, assisted living facilities, or nursing homes

Hours

• Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

Required Qualification

• Graduate of an accredited occupational therapy program (ACOTE accredited)

• Current state license as an Occupational Therapist

• Minimum 1 year of experience as a licensed Occupational Therapist

• Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license, and valid automobile insurance coverage

• Willingness to travel daily for home visits within service area

Preferred Qualifications

• Home health experience

• Experience with adaptive equipment and home modifications

• Knowledge of Medicare home health documentation

Essential Skills and Competencies

• Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning abilities

• Knowledge of medical terminology and home health regulations

• Excellent problem-solving and creative thinking skills

• Strong verbal and written communication abilities

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• Organizational skills and attention to detail

• Comfort working in varied home environments

• Interpersonal skills for professional interaction with patients, families, and teams

Pay Range

$84,000—$94,000 USD

How We Care for You

• Mileage Reimbursement

• Minimum of 3 Weeks Paid Time Off for Full Time

• Part Time/Per Diem also accrue Paid Time Off

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• HSA and FSA options including Dependent Care

• Company paid Short Term Disability

• Company paid Life Insurance

• 401(k) with Employer Match

• Pet Insurance

• ID and Fraud Protection

• And more...

Optimal Care is where your dedication meets a rewarding career.

Top Work Places for 12 consecutive years, Great Places to Work certified for 6 consecutive years, and we believe that exceptional care starts with exceptional people. We’re committed to supporting your professional growth, valuing your expertise, and creating an environment where you can do your best work every day.

As a clinician-owned and operated organization, we empower our team members to provide personalized, compassionate care to patients and families every day.

We are a leading provider of Physician Services, Home Health, and Hospice that encourages collaboration, innovation, and clinical excellence. From chronic disease management and rehabilitation to end-of-life care, our focus is on improving outcomes and enhancing quality of life.

We live a simple Mission: Serve Together, Provide Value, and Deliver Exceptional Quality Care.

Background Screening

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check. Screening is completed by a third-party administrator, the Michigan Long-Term Care Partnership, and is performed in compliance with the Fair Credit Report Act.

Reasonable Accommodations

We offer reasonable accommodations throughout the application process, interview stages, and during employment to ensure all team members can thrive. Please reach out to us if you would like to request a reasonable accommodation.

Equal Opportunity Employer
