jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Product Development
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Join Natera’s Oncology Product Development team as a Senior Scientist focusing on Assay Development. You will design, develop, and validate Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) and circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) assays used in liquid biopsy and Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) testing. Every sample represents a real person, and you will operate with pace and precision to ensure the highest quality clinical assays are developed and launched for our patients.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design and plan feasibility, development, verification, and validation studies under design control using stakeholder input, coordinating efforts to achieve milestones within established timelines

• Independently execute high-complexity experiments, both manually and using automated liquid handlers

• Take ownership of challenges, relying on data to root-cause issues and execute actionable solutions

• Think team by partnering directly with automation, engineering, R&D, bioinformatics, and lab operations to develop robust, automated workflows

• Generate high-quality NGS data, managing library preparation, QC, and sequencing runs while flagging technical effects

• Deliver data-backed updates on progress and outcomes to technical and non-technical audiences and cross-functional teams, pushing

• Write SOPs, study protocols, reports, and manufacturing/QC documents, maintaining rigorous documentation, sample tracking, and data provenance

• Lead the integration of automated workflows with digital systems such as LIMS and LabVantage (LV), ensuring data integrity between automation and digital platforms through rigorous integration testing

• Adapt to evolving science and operational needs, executing tasks that move the work forward without waiting for a finished playbook

• Travel up to 25% of the time to Austin, TX, and other laboratory sites as needed

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Ph.D. with 5+ years of industry experience (or 2+ years of postdoctoral research and 3+ years of industry experience), or a Master’s degree with 7+ years of industry experience in assay development

• Deep scientific background in Molecular and Cell Biology, Genomics, Biotechnology, or Biochemistry

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Extensive hands-on experience with molecular biology techniques, specifically NGS technologies, DNA extraction, multiplex PCR, hybrid capture, and nucleic acid quantification

• Direct experience with cell-free DNA, circulating tumor DNA, or liquid biopsy

• Experience with Laboratory Developed Tests (LDT) product development and validation under CLIA/CAP guidelines is highly desired

• Experience developing or executing assays on automated liquid handling platforms is highly desirable

• Proficiency in primary data analysis using tools such as Excel, JMP, or R

• Manage competing priorities while operating with pace and precision in an evolving scientific environment

• Clear, direct communication and presentation skills with meticulous attention to detail

• An outcome-focused ownership mindset with demonstrated success in collaborative and individual projects

• Demonstrated ability to write clear, precise project plans, study protocols, reports, and SOPs

• Experience with reagent QC is a plus

Compensation & Total Rewards

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of  hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

• Annual performance incentive bonus

• Long-term equity awards

• Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

• 401(k) with company match

• Generous paid time off and company holidays

• Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range

$138,100—$172,600 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (Voyager)
jobs.description:
Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. We do this by replacing financial guesswork with real visibility, transforming cash flow from a constant source of stress into a clear signal owners can use to run stronger, more resilient businesses.

Our Engineering team is at the heart of building banking products that help millions of small businesses succeed. We’re on a journey to reinvent banking, and we’re looking for a curious, impact-driven Senior Software Engineer (Voyager) to join our growing team – someone who thrives on taking smart risks, experimenting boldly, and learning from every challenge.



Voyager works a step ahead, exploring what’s next for Relay. We build the technology foundations that make AI and insights possible across the product, and we partner with product teams so they can build quickly on top of them. We also act as Relay's innovation center: running fast, exploratory spikes on emerging technologies to establish what's viable before the company commits to it. That means the work spans both ends of the maturity curve, from hardening infrastructure that other teams depend on to prototyping things that may not exist yet.



If you’re excited to tackle new problems and care as much about building strong foundations as delivering an impressive end product, you’ll feel at home on Voyager. If you believe the most interesting part of applied AI is the engineering behind it, this is the role for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

 - AI Infrastructure: Build and deploy secure, reusable LLM systems that enable differentiated product experiences, and own them across the full lifecycle, from design through deployment and monitoring

 - R&D and Proof-of-Concepts: Lead exploratory initiatives that evaluate and validate emerging technologies, producing a clear recommendation on whether and how Relay should adopt them

 - Developer Enablement: Give teams across Relay the tooling, patterns, and guidance they need to ship AI workflows quickly and safely

 - Consultative Partnership: Work alongside product teams as the AI expert in the room, helping them make good technical decisions rather than building everything for them

 - Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify areas for technical, process, and product improvement, helping the team raise the bar and influencing technical direction and long-term strategy



Who You Are

 - Have hands-on experience building with LLMs, including self-hosting or serving open models, retrieval systems, evaluation, or agentic workflows

 - Have built platform or shared services used by other engineering teams

 - You can move between exploration and production, knowing when a rough spike is the right answer and when something needs to be built to last

 - You have strong judgment about emerging technology, and can evaluate what's genuinely useful versus what's currently loud

 - You mentor junior engineers, sharing expertise and fostering the growth and skill development of the entire team

 - You proactively drive enhancements and lead initiatives to enhance code quality, optimize performance, and streamline development processes

 - You thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments and are comfortable navigating ambiguity and change

 - You’re a collaborative team player, eager to pitch in, ask questions, and provide and receive feedback

 - You take ownership end-to-end, solving problems creatively and proactively, while keeping the customer and business impact front-of-mind



The Interview Process

 - Stage 1: A 45-minute Google Meet video call with a member of the Talent team

 - Stage 2: A 60-minute live coding exercise with two members of the Engineering team

 - Stage 3: A 60-minute Google Meet video call with two Engineering Leaders

 - Stage 4: A take-home system design challenge, followed by a 60-minute Google Meet video call review with two members of the Engineering team

 - Stage 5: A 45-minute in-person interview with a member of the Leadership team



Our Compensation Approach

We believe Relayers should feel rewarded for the impact they have on our mission and growth. Compensation follows impact. As impact increases, compensation grows, and we do not limit compensation changes to a once-a-year review cycle.



The annual salary range for this role is $144,000 CAD to $176,000 CAD.



For candidates who demonstrate full readiness for the defined scope of the role, the typical starting salary is $160,000 CAD. Offers below this point reflect candidates we believe can grow into the full scope of the role with support and development. Offers above this point reflect impact that meaningfully exceeds the role’s defined expectations or an expanded scope from day one.



We encourage you to have a conversation with your recruiter and ask questions about compensation throughout the hiring process. For more information on our compensation philosophy and perks and benefits, visit our Candidate Hub https://www.notion.so/Candidate-Hub-1c7da8b7f88580a893f7d7c7852b064e?pvs=21.



Why Relay Might Be the Perfect Fit For You 

 - You push relentlessly for reinvention: You're always asking "how can this be better?" -- in your work, in your craft, in yourself. Comfort is a signal to push harder, not coast. You'd rather build something better than defend something familiar.

 - You crave autonomy: We trust our team with big challenges and the freedom to solve them. If you’re someone who takes initiative, is comfortable taking risks, and seeks input when needed, you’ll find the freedom here empowering.

 - You own your work: You take pride in your work, follow through on commitments, and feel a deep sense of responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

 - You build with AI, not just use it: You're actively embedding AI into how you work, pushing what's possible, and bringing your team along with you.

 - You care about impact, not noise: You care deeply about the substance of your work. You measure success by results, not recognition, and you let your work speak for itself. 

 - You’re energized by complexity and ambiguity: You enjoy tackling problems that don’t come with a playbook. You’re comfortable building from scratch, iterating as you go, and collaborating to shape the best path forward.

 - You seek out feedback: You see directness as respect, not criticism. You actively seek input, sit with hard truths, and use feedback as fuel for improvement.

 - Small businesses are why we're here: Relay exists to help them thrive -- and that mission has to resonate with you.



Join Us

We're looking for people who are relentless, curious, and care deeply about the work. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description -- your perspective and drive matter more. We welcome diverse backgrounds and people who think critically, challenge the status quo, and want to help small businesses thrive.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the hiring process, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

Disclaimer: For compliance reasons, all offers of employment at Relay are conditional upon a successful background check and employment verification through Certn.

Important Notice: Relay’s recruitment team only contacts candidates and corresponds from official corporate email addresses ending in @relayfi.com. We will never ask for sensitive personal data (such as bank account details, credit card numbers, or social security/insurance numbers) during the initial application or interview stages.

This role reports to the Global Real Estate Transactions Lead, based in South San Francisco, while you will be based in our New York office.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities:

• Prepare, recommend and implement geo-specific real estate strategies from business case to site selection through lease execution. Develop needs assessments and market analyses, propose deal structure, and drive negotiation of leases, serviced office agreements, and sublease agreements

• Gather & evaluate real estate market & portfolio scenarios, staying up to date on market changes and researching market, companies, landlords, & potential subtenants

• Liaise with Workplace pillars (Experience and Environments) as well as Mobility, Tax, Regulatory, Employment Legal, Finance, Accounting and other cross-functional teams on the impacts of real estate on business operations

• Work with Portfolio Strategy to predict and identify where and when we will have an imbalance of space, and proactively drive solutions that balance local needs with what is best for Stripe.

• Create written analyses, documents and presentations including but not limited to: project initiation documentation, market reports, RFPs, proposal comparison spreadsheets, letters of intent

• Perform detailed document review of all lease documents in partnership with internal and external Legal

• Connect with regional and local business leaders to understand headcount growth by business unit by location, site-specific programming needs, and field other real estate-related requests.

Minimum requirements:

• 5+ years experience on a Workplace or Real Estate team with 3+ years experience directly leading complex office space deal negotiations and lease transactions, preferably at a high-growth company

• Superior negotiation and leasing skills, with understanding of legal complexities (JD not required)

• Strong analytical skills, and comfort with modeling lease financials

• Experience leverage AI tools to expedite legal document review, financial modeling, executive presentations, etc

• Excellent written communication skills, able to progress projects asynchronously across timezones through written channels and to deliver compelling written business cases, presentations, and memos for an executive audience

• The ability and willingness to travel for work as needed, including to international destinations, and to work across time zones as is necessary to support projects in EMEA and APAC and collaborate with Real Estate Strategy Team, who are all based in AMER.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience with real estate deals across AMER & EMEA both serviced office and direct leases

• Experience working for both in-house real estate teams for tenant end-user and external service provider

• Strategic thinker who excels at finding creative solutions to short and long term questions, and writing clear and compelling business cases

• The ability to maintain high performance while managing multiple projects under tight timelines, and a “roll up your sleeves” mindset to get any job done

• Ability to ask the right questions and to use sound business judgment

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

CoLab is the AI platform for driving stronger engineering decisions. Every design review in CoLab builds a knowledge repository of design feedback, decisions, and lessons learned - which AI agents draw from to flag issues on future designs before they compound. The more your team works in CoLab, the smarter it gets and the faster you arrive at the ideal design. Companies like Ford, Komatsu, and Johnson Controls use CoLab to catch issues earlier, eliminate rework cycles, and bring products to market faster.

Founded in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab has grown quickly from our first customer in 2019 to a rapidly scaling company. We’ve recently been recognized on Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, and named a Canadian company to watch by The Globe and Mail and Financial Post.

About the Role

You’ll take ownership of our US-based cloud infrastructure across both Commercial and Public Sector environments, including our FedRAMP High authorized environment in AWS GovCloud.

This is a hands-on role focused on operating, securing, and scaling a production system supporting regulated workloads. You’ll work inside highly controlled environments, contribute directly to infrastructure and application reliability, and help maintain our FedRAMP authorization through ongoing continuous monitoring (ConMon), security operations, and audit readiness.

You’ll also partner closely with third-party vendors and internal teams to support customer onboarding, system improvements, and ongoing compliance requirements.

What success looks like in your first 90 Days:

30 Days: You’ve passed onboarding, completed security training, contributed code and are comfortable working across both Commercial and Public Sector environments.

60 Days: You’re contributing a substantial amount of code (Terraform, Python), reviewing others' work, and managing tasks in the Public Sector environment independently.

90 Days: You’re operating independently across Commercial and Public Sector environments, proactively identifying and resolving issues, contributing to system reliability, and supporting ongoing compliance and monitoring activities.

Our Ideal Candidate

You’re a senior engineer with deep hands-on cloud experience who is comfortable writing infrastructure as code, navigating complex environments, and adapting to a security-first approach. You bring technical depth and the curiosity to learn our unique systems and constraints.

You’ll thrive here if you:Have a security-first approach to solving problems or designing solutionsHave a strong point of view on how cloud infrastructure should be managed and a bias for clean, auditable codeCan dive into unknowns, break down stack traces, and own infrastructure problems end-to-endAre comfortable in ambiguity and thrive in a “figure-it-out” environmentHave a self-starter attitude but know that you have a team to support you if you need help

Job Responsibilities

• Own and operate CoLab’s US-based cloud infrastructure, including our FedRAMP High authorized GovCloud environment

• Support ongoing continuous monitoring (ConMon) activities, including vulnerability remediation, logging, and audit readiness

• Partner with internal and external stakeholders to maintain compliance posture and support audits and assessments

• Contribute to scaling infrastructure to support customer onboarding in regulated environments

• Write and maintain Terraform to support infrastructure deployments via SpaceLiftBuild and troubleshoot Lambda functions (primarily in Python) to support application and infrastructure automationInvestigate stack traces, diagnose application issues, and contribute to monitoring improvements (especially in APM tracing via DataDog)

• Support the broader Platform Team with secure, scalable infrastructure design and implementation

• Collaborate closely with Third Party Vendors during the Public Sector implementation and assessments

• Actively contribute to internal codebases (Python + IaC) and participate in PR reviews

• Take on and eventually lead technical initiatives in Public Sector infrastructure and deployments

Qualifications

Must-Haves:

• 5+ years in a hands-on DevOps, Platform, or CloudOps engineering roleDeep experience with AWS (GovCloud preferred) and strong Terraform fluencyProficiency with Python (especially writing Lambda functions)

• Experience with Kubernetes in production environments

• Familiarity with CI/CD tooling and secure deployment practices

• Strong debugging skills and comfortability in analyzing logs, traces, and error stacks

• US Citizenship

Bonus Points:

• Familiarity with Okta for Government, Azure GCC High, or Google CloudDataDog and/or Cloudflare configuration

• Experience operating in regulated environments (e.g. FedRAMP, GovCloud, IL4/IL5)

• Familiarity with security controls, audit processes, and continuous monitoring practices

jobs.title: Video Editor
jobs.description:
HelloFresh's Performance Innovation studio is scaling a cross-channel video engine built on a single core principle: one production, many platform-native cuts. Post-production is where that model wins or stalls.  This role is what makes it win. We're looking for a Video Editor who is fluent in paid social and used to high volume and fast turnaround. An editor who has experience using performance data to version and create scroll-stopping hooks.  Someone who reaches for GenAI tools (AI-assisted editing, voiceover) as naturally as a timeline. You will own end-to-end post-production for the paid social pipeline, and operationalize the studio’s global footage library so markets can localize independently. This is a high-output, high-craft role at the center of how the team scales.

You Will...

• Own end-to-end post-production. From ingest through multi-format delivery and versioning at the speed and volume the studio’s model demands.

• Operationalize the global footage library. Cut, adapt, and localize central footage for each market.

• Use performance data to iterate and create scroll stopping hooks.

• Use AI tools to optimize workflow

• Edit short-form video from scratch for paid social channels (TikTok, Meta, YouTube, Snap, OTT) using sharp creative instincts, platform-native best practices, and data from Creative Strategy.

• Build motion graphics, titles, lower thirds, and end cards in After Effects; collaborate with design teams to communicate graphic needs clearly.

• Manage multi-format, multi-market video workflow across delivery stages, partnering with the Senior Video Editor, Creative Strategy, and Production teams as needed.

• Work proactively to bring edits to near-final state, minimizing feedback rounds and meeting or beating stakeholder deadlines without sacrificing quality.

• Develop and adapt work from written and verbal feedback quickly and independently.

• Quality-check all video content against brand guidelines and platform specs before delivery.

You Are...

• An editor who treats GenAI tools as part of the craft.

• A high-output editor who thrives on turning a single shoot into a volume of finished, platform-native assets.

• Deeply fluent in the performance content / paid social landscape. You know how to prioritize what works based on data, not just personal taste.

• An expert in Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Adobe Creative Suite; experience with apps like CapCut and other UGC content creator tools. Eager to try new things as the UGC market and trends evolve.

• Organized, self-starting, and reliable. You manage complex multi-market, multi-format workflows without dropping anything.

• A strong collaborator who can work across Creative, Creative Strategy, Production, and Brand teams and communicate clearly at all levels.

• Calm under pressure, professional, and positive when deadlines compress.

• Committed to on-brand quality at every stage of the editing process.

At a Minimum, You Have...

• 5+ years of video editing experience in digital, paid media, or social content with a portfolio that proves output at volume and platform-native quality.

• Demonstrated, hands-on experience using GenAI tools in a post-production workflow .

• Familiarity with GenAI content policies and compliance requirements, particularly for EU/global markets, or the demonstrated ability to get up to speed rapidly.

• Strong experience developing assets for Paid Social, particularly TikTok, Meta, YouTube, & Snap.

• Expert proficiency in Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Adobe Creative Suite; working knowledge of CapCut and UGC-first editing platforms.

• Extensive knowledge of color grading, pacing, and timing for performance-oriented content.

• Experience managing multi-format, multi-market asset workflows, conversion tactics, ideally including localization or global content adaptation. Knowledge of creative advertising principles.

• Experience working within tight deadlines, handling multiple projects simultaneously, and turning around same-day edits.

• Impeccable organization, attention to detail, and a strong eye for quality.

• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.

• Ability to work on-site 4 days a week in NYC.

• Bachelor's degree in Film, Media, or equivalent. Preferred but not required.

You'll Get...

• Competitive Salary & 401k company match that vests immediately upon participation

• Generous parental leave of 16 weeks & PTO policy

• $0 monthly premium and other flexible health plans effective first day of employment

• 85% discount on your subscription to HelloFresh (as well as other product initiatives)

• Snacks, cold brew on tap & monthly catered lunches

• Company sponsored outings & Employee Resource Groups

• Collaborative, dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

New York Pay Range

$72,000—$82,000 USD

jobs.title: Head of Commercialization
jobs.description:
Vulcan Elements is manufacturing American rare-earth permanent magnets for a secure, resilient future. With a focus on national security and economic resiliency, we serve critical industries such as defense, aerospace, and automotive powering a high-technology future. Vulcan Elements is building a team of ambitious professionals committed to Mission Focus, Technical Excellence, and Integrity.

The Head of Commercialization will lead Vulcan Elements’ commercial development and customer program execution, converting market demand into qualified magnet products, long-term supply agreements, and recurring revenue. This role is accountable for commercial pipeline performance and for building a scalable customer-facing organization across defense, aerospace, automotive, and industrial markets.

This position spans both near-term execution - advancing customer quotations, samples, and qualifications through pilot-scale operations - and the commercial systems, relationships, and processes required to support high-volume production.

You will lead the Commercial Development team and work closely with, R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance to align customer commitments with technical feasibility, manufacturing readiness, capacity, and business priorities.

Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Revenue Growth

• Lead execution of Vulcan’s commercial strategy across priority markets, translating business objectives into customer and segment plans.

• Oversee the performance of the commercial pipeline, bookings, revenue conversion, and account development; coach Commercial Leads on opportunity priorities and execution.

• Guide pricing, quotation reviews, and negotiations for production awards and long-term supply agreements in alignment with margin and capacity objectives.

• Build senior-level relationships with strategic customers, OEMs, defense primes, and partners while supporting the commercial team’s day-to-day account ownership.

Customer Qualification & Program Execution

• Oversee customer opportunities from initial engagement through feasibility review, sampling, validation, qualification, contract award, and production ramp-up.

• Establish clear program ownership, qualification milestones, and internal review processes to maintain accountability for customer deliverables and timelines.

• Coordinate with, R&D, Manufacturing, and Quality to resolve technical and operational barriers to customer qualification.

• Ensure effective handoffs of qualified products into production, including agreed specifications, pricing, volumes, documentation, and customer commitments.

Commercial Operations & Forecasting

• Establish scalable processes for customer engagement, quotations, sample requests, opportunity management, and commercial program reviews.

• Own CRM discipline and the accuracy of commercial pipeline, bookings, revenue, and customer demand forecasts.

• Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Finance to translate customer demand into production, material, and financial planning inputs.

• Develop and monitor commercial KPIs, including qualification conversion, quotation turnaround, program milestones, bookings, revenue, and margins.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Scale-Up Readiness

• Serve as the voice of the customer internally, translating market and customer requirements into clear technical and operational priorities.

• Align commercial commitments with product development schedules, manufacturing capabilities, material availability, and capacity ramp-up.

• Build, mentor, and lead the Commercial Development organization, including Commercial Leads, application engineering, and supporting commercial operations capabilities.

• Partner with the Chief Commercial Officer on market priorities and strategic partnerships while taking ownership of day-to-day commercial execution.

Responsibilities and tasks outlined are not exhaustive and may change as determined by the needs of the business.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, materials science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

• 8+ years of experience in technical sales, commercialization, business development, or customer program leadership within advanced manufacturing or industrial markets.

• Proven record of advancing complex, qualification-driven engineered products from customer engagement through commercial production.

• Experience leading customer-facing teams and coordinating execution across engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain organizations.

• Strong commercial and financial judgment, including pricing, quotations, contract negotiation, margin management, and sales forecasting.

• Ability to interpret customer technical requirements and communicate effectively with both engineering and senior commercial stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to build processes and lead hands-on execution in a fast-growing manufacturing environment; willingness to travel as required.

Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with permanent magnets, NdFeB materials, rare earths, or other specialty engineered components.

• Experience serving customers in defense, aerospace, automotive, industrial motor, robotics, or other high-reliability markets.

• Familiarity with customer qualification requirements, including PPAP, first article inspection, and technical validation.

• Experience negotiating long-term supply agreements and managing qualification-driven sales cycles and production ramps.

• Familiarity with domestic sourcing, supply chain traceability, and relevant defense procurement or export-control considerations.

• Experience building a commercial organization in a startup or rapidly scaling industrial business.

jobs.title: Senior Franchise Producer
jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Senior Franchise Producer

Franchise Development // PlayStation Studios™

PlayStation Studios has created some of the most loved worlds, characters, and stories in entertainment. Our opportunity now is to build those IP with greater intention — growing audiences, deepening fandom, and creating more ways for people to engage with PlayStation franchises beyond the release of a game.

We are looking for a Senior Franchise Producer to help turn that ambition into coordinated high-quality work across a varied portfolio of franchise initiatives.

This is a project management and production role with an unusually broad remit. The producer may support or lead work across franchise resources and documentation, location-based experience, linear media, publishing, internal partner and contractor-led projects, and other initiatives that bring franchise strategy to life.

The role sits within a broader production team and contributes to shared sprint planning, prioritization, and delivery. While the team works collectively, this senior producer will independently own a defined set of workstreams from planning through completion.

A major part of the role is partnering with teams across Sony Interactive Entertainment to translate franchise strategies and roadmaps into executable plans, track activity and dependencies, and directly produce selected initiatives where appropriate.

This producer will also work closely with stakeholders within the PlayStation Studios’ development studios, coordinating approvals and reviews throughout production, maintaining trusted relationships, and ensuring that franchise work reflects both studio intent and wider PlayStation priorities.

Key Responsibilities

• Own a portfolio of franchise production workstreams from initial brief and scoping through delivery, review, launch, and closeout.

• Translate franchise strategies and roadmaps into practical project plans with clear objectives, milestones, owners, dependencies, budgets, risks, and decision points.

• Track franchise activity across teams, maintain integrated plans and status reporting, and provide clear visibility of progress, risks, trade-offs, and required decisions.

• Produce selected franchise initiatives directly, coordinating internal contributors, studios, external partners, and vendors to deliver against agreed creative, quality, schedule, and budget expectations.

• Support a varied range of productions, which may include location-based experiences, publishing projects, franchise resources, documentation, presentations, toolkits, and partner-facing materials.

• Lead day-to-day project communication, meetings, action tracking, production reviews, approvals, and follow-up across multiple concurrent workstreams.

• Partner across PlayStation Studios, Portfolio Strategy, PlayStation Productions, brand, marketing, insights, finance, consumer products, licensing, legal, and Sony Group teams to align plans and unblock delivery.

• Scope, onboard, brief, and oversee contractors, agencies, and specialist production partners; manage deliverables, capacity, performance, and associated resource needs.

• Contribute actively to team sprint planning, backlog management, prioritization, estimation, retrospectives, and continuous improvement as part of the wider franchise production team.

• Create and maintain production standards, templates, trackers, documentation, and repeatable ways of working that improve clarity and consistency across the team.

• Identify issues early, recommend practical solutions, escalate appropriately, and keep work moving through ambiguity and changing priorities.

What We’re Looking For

• Substantial production or project management experience in games, entertainment, media, experiential, publishing, consumer products, licensing, or a related creative industry.

• A track record of independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and concurrent deadlines.

• Strong command of production fundamentals, including scoping, scheduling, budgeting, resource planning, risk management, approval workflows, status reporting, and delivery governance.

• Experience translating strategic or creative ambition into structured plans, practical next steps, and high-quality deliverables.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the judgment and confidence to work with senior leaders, creative teams, specialist functions, and external partners.

• Clear and concise communication, with the ability to adapt detail for working teams, studio leadership, and executive audiences.

• A highly collaborative approach, combined with the accountability to own workstreams and drive them through to completion.

• Experience working in agile or sprint-based teams and contributing to shared planning, backlog, prioritization, and review routines.

• Experience briefing and managing agencies, contractors, vendors, or other external production resources.

• Experience in one or more of the following is a plus: location-based entertainment; publishing, including books or comics; franchise or IP documentation; licensing or consumer products; live experiences; or multi-format entertainment production.

• Knowledge of games and the PlayStation ecosystem is valuable, but relevant experience from adjacent entertainment sectors is equally welcome.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a calm, proactive, and highly organized senior producer who enjoys bringing structure to ambitious creative work. They can move comfortably between long-range roadmaps and the operational detail needed to deliver a specific project.

They are equally effective facilitating a team sprint, building an integrated plan, briefing a contractor, preparing a studio review, or helping cross-functional partners understand how their activity contributes to a wider franchise roadmap.

They build trust through clarity, follow-through, and good judgment. They know when to drive, when to facilitate, and when to escalate. They are motivated by collective success, while being fully accountable for the workstreams placed in their care.

Success in This Role Looks Like

• Assigned productions have clear plans, accountable owners, realistic schedules, visible dependencies, and well-managed risks.

• Franchise strategies and roadmaps are translated into coordinated activity that progresses across PlayStation and Sony teams.

• Studio stakeholders and cross-functional partners experience a clear, responsive, and trusted production process with timely reviews and approvals.

• Projects and resources are managed responsibly, with issues surfaced early and delivery kept aligned to creative intent, quality, timing, and budget.

• The wider production team benefits from strong sprint participation, transparent workload planning, dependable ownership, and improved tools and ways of working.

• The producer successfully owns multiple workstreams while contributing flexibly to the collective priorities of the Franchise Development team.

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

This is a flexible role that can be remote, with varying pay ranges based on geographic location. For example, if you are based out of Seattle, the estimated base pay range for this role is listed below.

$134,100—$201,100 USD

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.

jobs.title: People Team Intern, EMEA Employment Compliance & Manager Enablement (Spring 2027)
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available location(s): London

Term: 6-month internship from January 2027

About Cloudflare's People Team

At Cloudflare, we are helping build a better Internet, and our People Team is at the heart of that mission. We are looking for an organised, curious and tech-savvy People Team Intern to join our EMEA People Team on a defined project with a clear beginning and end.

Together with our Employment Legal team, we are reviewing what each EMEA country requires by law, what policies, training and manager guidance Cloudflare already has, and where the gaps are. You will also help us find new, technology-led ways to give our managers the training and resources they need.

About the role

• Compliance Research: Research employment requirements across EMEA countries using official government and legal sources.

• Audit & Gap Analysis: Map our existing policies, guidance and training against those requirements, and help prioritise the gaps.

• Manager Enablement: Help design practical, innovative training resources and guides for managers, using AI and other tools.

• Project Management & Execution: Keep timelines on track, coordinate with HR, Legal and Learning & Development, and ensure no detail is overlooked.

• Knowledge Management: Keep our audit tracker and documentation accurate, sourced and easy to use.

• Internal AI Advocacy: Become a power user and internal champion for our internal AI tools, sharing what works with the team.

You can check out our internship blogs to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• Currently studying law (ideally with an interest in employment law), or a business or HR degree with a focus on compliance or employment regulation.

• Exceptional Organisation: You are the person who has a spreadsheet for everything. You can juggle multiple projects without dropping the ball.

• Detail-Oriented Mindset: You catch the issues others miss and care deeply about the "small things" that matter.

• AI Fluency: You are familiar with AI tools and how they can be applied to improve business processes and team efficiency. Experience with LLMs or automation tools is a major plus.

• Adaptability and Stakeholder Empathy: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are comfortable working with colleagues across countries and teams.

• Communication: Strong written and verbal skills, with the ability to explain complex processes simply.

• Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week) for a minimum 6-month internship.

• In office 3 days a week in London, UK.

Bonus Points

• Interest in employment law or HR compliance.

• A second European language.

• Experience with internal wikis or knowledge bases (e.g., Confluence, Notion).

• A background in project management (PMO) or business operations.

Please Note:

jobs.title: US FinCrime Analyst
jobs.description:
We’re Capital on Tap 👋
💳 Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier.

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started!

📍 Union Square, New York  | 🏢 2 days in Office | $70,000 - $105,000

US Compliance 🚀
Our US Compliance team is fully accountable for keeping our fast-growing US business compliant - covering financial crime investigations, regulatory reporting, policy, and every new product and feature we launch in the US. They also own the relationship with our partner bank.

What You’ll Be Doing 🗃️

• Escalations: Process and decision financial crime escalations from the 1st line FinCrime team and other business units.

• Regulatory Reporting & Sign-off: Handle 314a, AML, and OFAC Reports for the US, and execute final sign-offs for PEPs, and High-Risk entities.

• SAR Drafting & Review: Draft, review, and finalize internal suspicious activity reports raised by cross-functional teams (e.g., credit, customer operations).

• Policy Maintenance: Maintain and update AML policies, procedures, and standards for the 1st line, ensuring all regulatory updates and feedback from Compliance Monitoring, QA, and Independent Audit are integrated.

• Cross-Functional Intelligence: Participate in FinCrime team meetings to provide input and share knowledge regarding identified, emerging operational threats and trends.

• External Coordination: Liaise directly with internal teams to gather necessary documentation for external law enforcement inquiries and partner bank requests.

Our Values & Culture 🌞

• Just Pilot: We never settle for “good enough”. We pilot new ideas fast, ask questions to figure it out, and scale quickly.

• Why Not Today? Fast is as slow as we go - speed and simplicity gives us a competitive advantage.

• Be a Buddy: We tap in from day one to help the team, we do the right thing even if it’s hard.

• Owners and Dates: We don’t chase people. If you own a task and agree to a date, the expectation is that it gets done.

• Feedback: We want our employees to flourish, so we regularly provide direct and constructive feedback.

We’re Looking For 🔎

• 2 years owning and completing FinCrime Investigations

• Experience in drafting suspicious activity reports (SARs)

• Experience in managing 314(a) requests

• Experience in Financial Crime investigations, EDD, or escalations

• Strong analytical skills and risk-based judgement

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

• Strong prioritization, accountability, and ability to apply feedback

Interview Process 🤝

• Stage 1: 30min Initial Video Call with Talent Partner

• Stage 2: 60min Technical Interview with Hiring Manager

• Stage 3: 60min Stakeholder & Values Interview

• Stage 4: 30 min Interview with the CFO

Our Hiring Bar

• Self-driven. You research problems yourself and bring proposals, rather than waiting to be given direction.

• Ownership and time management. You keep track of several regulatory deadlines and reprioritise when urgent work lands.

jobs.title: Warehouse Supervisor
jobs.description:
WAREHOUSE SUPERVISOR

Location: Brighton - St Josephs Business Park (BN3)

Working pattern: Onsite | Full-time | Shift-based (37.5 hours per week)

Pay: £14.30per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Supervisor to join our Brighton team. In this role, you’ll be the beating heart of our daily site operations, maximizing customer satisfaction by ensuring our loyal customers receive their household essentials as quickly as possible.

Get to know our Site Operations https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/operations/ team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You’ll be joining the HOP Operations team. This team is responsible for the end-to-end management of our rapid grocery delivery sites, ensuring inventory accuracy and lightning-fast dispatch.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

 - Drive Dispatch Excellence: Oversee that all orders are picked to meet time targets and lead the dispatch area to ensure seamless packing for our customers.

 - Manage Inventory Rigour: Unload deliveries according to procedure, ensuring total accuracy of product locations, date rotations, and claims logging.

 - Maintain Operational Standards: Ensure the warehouse remains clean, tidy, and safe at all times, dealing with hazards urgently and conducting regular H&S checks.

 - Collaborative Leadership: Partner with the Warehouse Assistant Manager and Manager to ensure the site runs smoothly and employees follow company procedures.

 - Ownership of Stock Integrity: Ensure stock counts are 100% accurate across all designated counting areas.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO THRIVE

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

 - Operational Experience: Proven ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments (FMCG, Retail, Warehouse, or Last-mile delivery is a major plus).

 - Performance Driven: A track record of hitting goal targets, such as pick times or dispatch KPIs.

 - Natural Leadership: A "lead by example" mentality with a genuine passion for motivating and coaching junior team members.

 - Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to finding new ways to improve site operations and resolve challenges as they arise.

 - Adaptability: The ability to work autonomously while contributing to a high-energy, positive team environment.




OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

 - Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

 - Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

 - Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

 - Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!




WHY JOIN US?

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. In Operations, you’re at the heart of our marketplace — working directly with customers, riders and partners to keep Deliveroo moving.

 - 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences.

 - 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop leadership skills in a fast-paced environment with structured progression pathways.

 - 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

 - 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Many roles offer flexible scheduling, including evening and weekend shifts.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Free monthly Friday lunch on Deliveroo

 - 25 days’ holiday (with increases based on service)

 - Career development and access to learning opportunities

 - Life assurance and wellbeing support

 - Access to great discounts and free Deliveroo Plus!




OUR GLOBAL STRUCTURE

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.




DIVERSITY, EQUITY AND INCLUSION

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support or reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application.

jobs.title: Event Content Strategist
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

As a member of the Elastic Global Events team, you'll work in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and diverse perspectives. We are seeking an enthusiastic and highly organized Event Content Strategist to shape the story, sessions, and speaker programs behind our proprietary events and sponsored tradeshows, from early concept through onsite delivery. This person is a sharp writer and editorial thinker who can work cross-functionally to turn business priorities into compelling event content that resonates with our audience. This person understands how to craft narratives and curate sessions that lead to customer acceleration and expansion with Elastic.

This is an exciting opportunity for an individual who wants to own the creative and editorial backbone of a dynamic events program, working closely with event managers, the product team and the larger marketing organization to make sure every session, speaker, and story earns its place on the agenda.

Our ideal candidate translates market insight and product priorities into agendas, session abstracts, and speaker lineups that hold an audience's attention and drive measurable engagement. You must be able to own the content strategy, ensure to execute it within time limits and refine it across a series of concurrent events.

Excellent collaboration skills are a must, as you will be working directly with subject matter experts, executives, and external speakers.

The ability to multitask and prioritize is essential, as this role involves developing content for multiple events at different stages at once.

What You Will Be Doing

• Deeply understand the markets and latest trends from a content and storytelling perspective, and know what themes and formats resonate with our target segments.

• Know the key events our target segments are attending and stay abreast of the content and programming competitors are producing.

• Use these insights to creatively design and optimize the event content strategy globally.

• Lead the development of event narratives, agendas, and session tracks to ensure goals and audience expectations are always exceeded and the Elastic brand is well represented.

• Drive economies of scale across content assets and formats that can be reused or adapted across multiple events.

• Partner closely with event managers and business peers to ensure cross-functional alignment on event goals and target outcomes. Effectively collaborate with Field Marketers, Events Team and Product Marketing on event messaging, session content, curriculum, and speaker selection to ensure a compelling story is presented that engages our key target audience.

• Own the end-to-end content lifecycle for each event, including speaker recruitment and briefing, run-of-show scripting, and internal/external content communications, to ensure the event story is delivered with the highest standards, within brand guidelines, and in support of KPI attainment.

• Support onsite presence with a focus on content execution, including speaker readiness and rehearsal, stage messaging, session moderation support, AV content checks, and real-time troubleshooting of content or speaker issues.

• Track session ratings, engagement, and audience feedback to measure content performance, assess opportunities for improvement, and optimize future programming.

• Strong communication skills, and the ability to present content plans and agendas to stakeholders and leadership, as well as strong editorial judgment, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.

• Commitment to the mission, vision, cultural values, and expectations of Elastic.

• Potential travel up to 25%.

What You Bring

• 5-7 years of relevant work experience in content marketing, editorial, event programming, or a related field.

• Experience in marketing B2B technology products or services preferred.

• Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, marketing, or a relevant field of study.

• Strong storytelling instincts and an aptitude for building productive relationships.

• Demonstrated success in content development, editorial planning, and project management.

• A willingness to travel and ability to work independently and autonomously.

• Superior oral and written communication skills with an innate attention to detail.

Bonus Points

• A career path that demonstrates increasing levels of responsibility and proven success delivering measurable content or marketing results.

• Ability to manage time and juggle multiple priorities to execute high-quality deliverables.

• Skilled editor and coach, with proven experience shaping a speaker's message and getting the best out of a session with limited prep time.

• Experience working in a fast-paced and highly cross-functional organization.

• Proven knowledge of industry tools, such as Salesforce and content or session-management platforms.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary.  This role does not have a variable compensation component.

$106,900—$169,100 USD

$128,200—$202,700 USD

jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We're looking for a Cinematographer / Video Editor who is equally at home behind the camera and in the edit bay. You'll join Elastic's in-house video team, reporting to the Video Creative Lead, and help drive the look of our live-action work from the first lighting setup to the final export.

You'll shoot and cut everything from executive thought leadership and customer stories to product launches, event coverage, and fast-turn social. Success in this role means making technical topics look and feel cinematic - on lean budgets, small crews, and tight timelines.

What You Will Be Doing

• Shoot and edit live-action content - interviews, b-roll, customer stories, executive thought leadership, product launches, and event coverage - in studio and on location.

• Collaborate with the Video Team to craft setups that look cinematic and repeatable with small crews from in-house or agency support.

• Edit from assembly through picture lock and final delivery, including color grading, audio mixing, captions, and versioning for each platform (YouTube, LinkedIn, X, web, events).

• Turn scripts and briefs into shot lists, lighting plans, and shoot schedules. Scout locations and oversee on-set logistics.

• Direct on-camera talent - many of them engineers and executives, not actors - and help them come across clearly and confidently.

• Work closely with our motion graphics animator to integrate titles, lower thirds, and animated elements into live-action edits.

• Partner with stakeholders to tell compelling stories that simplify complex technology

• Develop repeatable production workflows that improve speed, quality, and efficiency.

• Some travel will be required, globally.

• Hands-on command of cinema cameras (Sony FX / Cinema Line, Canon C-series, RED, Blackmagic, or similar), lenses, gimbals, and LOG / RAW workflows.

• A real eye for light. You can set up and shape LED lighting quickly in an office, a conference hall, or a hotel room and still make it look intentional.

• Solid production audio skills.

• Advanced editing skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, plus color grading and audio cleanup and mixing.

• Working knowledge of After Effects or similar for light motion graphics, titles, and captions.

• Strong storytelling instincts - you know how to find the story in a 45-minute interview and cut it to 90 seconds.

• FAA Part 107 remote pilot certificate and drone experience.

• Multi-camera and live / livestream production experience.

• Experience with remote recording platforms.

• Photography skills.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Equipment Monitoring team, you will build the backend systems that give fleets unmatched visibility into the location, utilization, and health of their equipment - trailers, reefers, construction machinery, and small assets. Our data comes from IoT devices in the field: Asset Gateways, BLE environmental and door sensors, and Beacons. You will design and operate the ingestion and stream-processing pipelines (Kafka, Flink) that turn this raw sensor telemetry into accurate real-time locations, geofence events, trips, and alerts. You will collaborate closely with our Embedded/firmware and IoT teams on device payloads and end-to-end data flows, making this a great role for engineers who enjoy working near the hardware while building cloud services at scale.

What You'll Do:

• Develop highly observable, reliable, and scalable backend services that process telemetry from hundreds of thousands of IoT devices (sensors, beacons, asset gateways).

• Build and operate stream-processing pipelines (Kafka, Flink) powering geo-fencing, alerting, trip construction, and asset location.

• Design, build, and maintain scalable APIs for both internal and external applications.

• Collaborate with Embedded, IoT, and cross-functional teams on device data contracts and end-to-end feature delivery.

• Champion engineering excellence by proactively reducing technical debt and improving code quality.

• Leverage AI tools such as Cursor, CoPilot to increase productivity and code quality.

• Actively work on our AWS Cloud infrastructure, and mentor and learn from other engineers to foster a culture of continuous growth.

What We're Looking For:

• B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or related field

• 5+ years software development experience

• Experience building distributed systems and event-driven/stream-processing pipelines (Kafka, Flink, Kinesis or similar)

• Experience in modern programming languages. Proficiency in Ruby, Golang, Kotlin/Java is a plus.

• Experience with Relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, and Cassandra

• Experience building for Cloud Infrastructure such as AWS, GCP, Azure or private clouds

• Experience with IoT/sensor data or geospatial systems (geofencing, location) is a plus

• Ownership and Problem Solving mindset.

Pay Transparency

Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

• Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.

• Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.

• Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.

• Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.

• Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.

• Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.

• Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.

• Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

About this role:

GiveDirectly has put more than $1B directly into the hands of people living in poverty. Now our finance function needs to scale with that.

We’re hiring a Finance Manager, a brand-new role in our Malawi/US pod (with room to take on additional entities), to build the capacity that growth demands. The pod backs programme operations and owns the core accounting in both countries.

You’ll lead the pod’s accounting, drive internal and external reporting, and shape budgeting, and that’s just the start. When the money moves this fast, the finance team keeps it moving accurately and on time.

Reports to : Senior Finance Manager

Level : Manager

Location : This is a remote role, that is open to citizens and permanent residents of the following countries only: DRC, Malawi, Mozambique, Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda

Travel Requirements: Must be able to travel 1-2 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats or colocations

What you'll do:

• Drive accurate financial reporting: Act as preparer and reviewer for day-to-day accounting across the Malawi and US pod, including transaction review, coding, and financial data integrity. Coordinate month-end, quarterly and year-end close for assigned entities. Coordinate donor invoicing and donor financial reporting, ensuring accuracy, completeness and on-time delivery. Lead reconciliation of GD bank and investment accounts, Wallet accounts, central payroll reconciliation and postings, and other asset and liability accounts. Support budgeting, forecasting and budget-to-actual reviews for both countries, working with budget owners to keep forecasts grounded.

• Strengthen controls and manage risk: Strengthen internal controls, compliance and fraud prevention across the pod as transaction volume grows. Serve as a trained backup for accounting and record-keeping Ensure compliance with donor requirements, local regulations, tax obligations and organisational policy in both jurisdictions. Coordinate audit preparation for assigned entities, respond to auditor requests, and follow through on findings to closure. Conduct spot checks on transactions, advances, allowances and supporting documentation.

• Keep finance operations running smoothly: Provide cover across the pod POD during planned and unplanned absence, and continuity through team transitions. Drive process and system improvements to raise efficiency, accuracy and consistency across finance operations. Collaborate with the broader finance team on systems improvements, create standardized templates, automation, better use of AI, and process standardisation. Build strong working relationships across country and global teams, acting as a bridge between local operations and central finance.

What you'll bring:

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, or equivalent practical experience.

• A professional accounting qualification — ACCA, CPA, CA or equivalent.

• 5+ years of professional experience in accounting or finance, including experience at manager level or equivalent scope.

• Demonstrated working knowledge of both IFRS and US GAAP

• Experience in multi-national, multi-currency and multi-entity operations.

• Experience reviewing and approving the work of others.

• Competence in spreadsheets and financial and accounting software (e.g. Intacct), and enthusiasm for using AI and automation.

• Proven experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume, or matrixed work environment.

• Fluency in English.

• Alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

The total compensation for this role in the various locations is broken down as follows:

Kenya:

• Base Salary: $54,050

• Bonus at Target Performance: 10%

Malawi:

• Base Salary: $54,050

• Bonus at Target Performance: 10%

Mozambique:

• Base Salary: $67,380

• Bonus at Target Performance: 10%

Rwanda:

• Base Salary: $54,050

• Bonus at Target Performance: 10%

Uganda:

• Base Salary: $54,050

• Bonus at Target Performance: 10%

Why work at GiveDirectly?

At GiveDirectly, we work to ensure that you have everything you need to excel in your role and on your team, including:

• A supportive team that works hard and cares hard

• A robust health benefits plan (exact details will vary by country)

• Flexible paid time off that staff is encouraged to take

• Allowances for desk set-up and learning and development

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing,  reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or  exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at careers@givedirectly.org with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

DATA INFRASTRUCTURE OPERATIONS SPECIALIST II (STARLINK)
