jobs.title: Lead Legal Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together.

Join us on our mission to make a better world of work.

Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day.

Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company.

For more information visit cultureamp.com.

How you can help make a better world of work

Culture Amp is looking for a Legal Operations Lead to build the operating engine that helps our Legal team move quickly, consistently and at scale.

This is a new role with broad ownership across legal knowledge, intake, contract workflows, legal technology and operational reporting. You’ll turn established legal positions into clear, findable resources; improve the way requests enter and move through Legal; and help Sales, CX, Marketing and People teams get the right answers at the right time.

You’ll work closely with the General Counsel, lawyers, Sales, RevOps, Applications Support and other business partners. This is an operations and enablement role rather than a legal-advice role: you’ll handle routine requests within established guidance, escalate novel, high-risk or out-of-threshold matters to the appropriate lawyer, and fundamentally transform how legal support is delivered at Culture Amp to improve quality, speed and efficiency.

What you’ll do

Your aim is to improve the quality, speed and efficiency of legal support at Culture Amp, through better technology, tighter process and consistent, easy to use approaches and materials. You’ll do that by:

• Making Legal’s knowledge easy to find and use. Turn established positions, playbooks and templates into a single, trusted source for Sales, CX, Marketing and People teams, and for customers. Keep it current and drive adoption, so more questions are answered accurately without a lawyer.

• Designing how work flows through Legal. Own intake, triage and routing so routine requests are handled within established guidance. Anything novel, high-risk or out of threshold reaches the right lawyer early, with the context they need.

• Streamlining quote-to-contract. Partner with Sales, RevOps and Applications Support to make the path from quote to signature faster and more consistent. Keep templates, approvals and terms aligned with current guidance.

• Choosing and governing the right tools. Shape Legal’s technology roadmap with the General Counsel. Select, roll out and govern CLM, workflow and AI tools, with lawyer oversight built in where it matters.

• Using data to prioritise and show impact. Build simple reporting on volumes, cycle times and compliance, and use it to decide where to improve next and to demonstrate the return.

• Managing the cost and consistency of Legal’s wider support. Run the operational side of external counsel relationships, including routing, service levels and spend. Maintain lawyer-approved template libraries and self-serve guidance for People teams.

What you’ll bring

• 5–8 years’ experience in legal operations, contract management, deal desk, sales operations or a related function, ideally in a B2B SaaS or technology business.

• Hands-on experience configuring and administering a contract lifecycle management system such as DocuSign CLM, Ironclad or a similar platform, alongside e-signature and Salesforce integrations.

• Working knowledge of CPQ and quote-to-contract processes, ideally including DealHub or a comparable tool.

• Experience building and improving a legal, policy or contract knowledge base, playbook or FAQ library and driving adoption of it.

• Practical familiarity with SaaS commercial agreements and related concepts, including MSAs, order forms, DPAs, SLAs, NDAs, liability and data protection.

• A track record of reducing contract cycle time, request volume or operational friction, with metrics that demonstrate your impact.

• Experience evaluating, implementing or governing legal technology, workflow or AI solutions.

• Confidence working with stakeholders globally, particularly Australia, the UK, Germany and across US timezones

• A bachelor’s degree in legal studies, business, information systems or a related discipline.

A law degree or paralegal qualification is a plus, but admission as a lawyer is not required. Legal operations, Lean Six Sigma or project management credentials are also welcome but not essential.

Experience with Salesforce administration, DocuSign CLM or DealHub administration, SQL, Python, Confluence, Glean or generative AI tools will be valuable.

How you’ll work

• You’re a systems thinker. You see the full workflow and fix root causes rather than repeatedly treating symptoms.

• You have strong judgement. You know what can be answered from an established position, what needs more context and what must be escalated to a lawyer.

• You make knowledge usable. You turn expert judgement into clear, accessible content that people can find, trust and apply.

• You influence without formal authority. You can build adoption across Sales and other teams, not just configure a tool or publish a page.

• You’re commercially minded. You understand SaaS deal mechanics, thresholds and why contract speed matters to revenue.

• You’re data-driven. You use simple, meaningful reporting to set priorities and show impact.

• You’re an AI-forward builder. You use AI thoughtfully in your own work and understand where lawyer oversight is essential.

• You take ownership. You’re comfortable building from scratch, working independently and creating structure where there isn’t yet a dedicated legal operations function.

Working at Culture Amp

This role is based in our Chicago hub and requires working in the office at least three days each week. You’ll join a global Legal team and work cross-functionally with colleagues across the United States, APAC and EMEA.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is listed below. In addition to base salary, your compensation package will include additional components such as equity and benefits. For sales roles, your package may also include sales commission

The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual skills, capabilities and experience, objectively assessed during the interview process. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We believe in fair & equitable pay at Culture Amp, and therefore, we build pay equity into all our programs in addition to conducting annual pay equity audits.

Base Salary Range (US)

$145,400—$176,000 USD

Perks & Benefits

At Culture Amp, our people are at the heart of our success. We offer competitive pay and a total rewards package designed to support you at work and in life. This includes:

• Equity through our Employee Share Option Program, so you can share in our long-term success

• Learning programs and coaching to help you thrive and grow

• Quarterly refresh days, an extended end-of-year break and a monthly allowance to support your wellbeing and lifestyle

• Inclusive parental leave from day one

• A MacBook and budget to set up your home workspace, enabling flexibility

• Five annual social impact days to to give back to causes that matter to you

• Medical insurance coverage for you and your family (Available for US & UK only)

Our rewards are designed to support different needs and life stages, recognising that what matters most can vary from person to person.

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every requirement, but your unique experience matters. If you’re interested in joining us, we strongly encourage you to apply and help us build a more diverse and impactful team.

Accommodations & Data Privacy

If you require reasonable accommodations or adjustments due to a disability to complete the online application or to participate in the interview process, please contact accommodations@cultureamp.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Culture Amp will retain your CV & personal information for a period of two years (four years for the US) from the date of your application process completion. Culture Amp may contact you in relation to future job opportunities during this time period. For further information please see our privacy policy here or contact privacy@cultureamp.com.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant II
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and capital-efficient approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to support a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and supporting a growing space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to design, build, and operate its own spacecraft in orbit. Next, Haven-1 is targeted to become the world’s first commercial space station, with launch anticipated in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced two new offerings leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo: Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line; and Vast Lunar Systems, power, communications, and habitats for the Moon.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities capable of manufacturing America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for Mars, dedicated modules for government partners, and other crewed systems designed to unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for an Executive Assistant II, reporting to the General Counsel. We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Executive Assistant to support both the General Counsel and the Chief Policy Officer in managing the day-to-day operations and play a crucial role in providing administrative support, facilitating communication, and contributing to our overall success. This role will serve as a highly trusted operational partner, managing day-to-day logistics, enabling cross-functional coordination, and helping increase leadership effectiveness through continuous improvement.

This will be a full-time, exempt position located in our Long Beach location.

Responsibilities:

• Act as a central point of contact, facilitating communication between executives, internal teams and external partners

• Handle sensitive information and matters with a high level of discretion and maintain confidentiality

• Skillfully manage and coordinate executive calendars, including scheduling meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements

• Coordinate with external partners including investors, law firms, banks, customers, etc., on high sensitivity and high urgency matters

• Partner with multiple primary executives to maintain organizational structure, strategic direction, and cross-functional relationships built on trust and partnership

• Prepare legal and corporate documentation, filings, presentations, etc. for highly sensitive corporate matters for both internal and external audiences

• Draft, review and send communications on behalf of company executive

• Prepare and distribute materials for meetings, attend meetings and ensure all documentation is readily available

• Organize and execute on potential customer visits and tours to inspire and capture business

• Collaborate with other departments on projects as needed

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and other EA’s to ensure meeting requests and VIP visits are well-scoped, and aligned with the executives priorities

• Create opportunities and initiatives to bring department team members together with a goal to further team building and team engagement

• Track and manage executive expenses, travel, and process reimbursements

Minimum Qualifications:

• 3-5+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant to VP+-level executives in both internal and external/partner/customer environments

• Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace and Slack

• Ability to push back when protecting an executives time and objectives

• Bachelor’s Degree

• Familiarity with AI/SI and its applications for increased efficiency and effectiveness

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• Experience supporting executives in a fast space startup environment

• Experience exercising discretion and confidentiality with highly sensitive company information

• Experience supporting a Legal Executive (General Counsel, Chief Legal Officer, etc.) and/or a Government Affairs Executive

• Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and handle competing deadlines

• Ability to grow and maintain a network of external Executive Assistants within Vast ecosystem

• Event and meeting planning

• Excellent communication, both written and verbal

• High level of attention to detail and accuracy

• Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively

• Strong organizational and time-management skills

• Discretion in handling confidential and sensitive information

• Strong business acumen and understanding of how legal and government affairs functions support organizational objectives

• A passion for fostering a positive work culture

• Ability to learn and anticipate executive needs

• Proven ability to be an independent and self sufficient team member — tasks that are handed off get done, no follow-up needed

Additional Requirements:

• Ability to be on site daily at our HQ in Long Beach

• Willingness to work evenings and/or weekends to support critical mission milestones and multiple time zones as needed

Pay Range:

• Executive Assistant II: $96,000 - $137,000

• Senior Executive Assistant: $118,000 - $168,000

Pay Range: California

$96,000—$168,000 USD

We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

jobs.title: Patient Outreach and Support Specialist-Temp
jobs.description:
Patient Outreach and Support Specialist

Position Summary:

Natera’s portfolio of innovative molecular and genetic testing solutions helps patients and

providers make informed healthcare decisions throughout the patient journey.

The Patient Outreach & Support Specialist serves as a patient-focused resource responsible

for conducting proactive outreach, providing education, gathering feedback, and supporting

patients after testing. Working within the Patient Coordinator organization, this role helps

ensure patients have access to the information, resources, and support needed to navigate

their ongoing care journey. The Specialist engages patients through phone, SMS, email, and other approved communication channels to answer questions, identify potential barriers to care, provide

educational resources, and facilitate coordination with healthcare providers and internal

Natera teams when appropriate. This role requires exceptional communication skills, empathy, attention to detail, and the ability to build trust while supporting patients through potentially complex healthcare experiences.

Bilingual Spanish preferred.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct proactive outreach to patients following testing to provide support, education,

and resource navigation.

• Engage patients through phone, SMS, email, and other approved communication channels

while delivering a positive and professional customer experience.

• Educate patients on testing processes, available resources, patient portal tools, scheduling

options, and other relevant support services.

• Gather patient feedback regarding their testing experience and document insights that

help improve patient programs and services.

• Identify and help address common barriers to care, including scheduling challenges,

provider communication needs, access to resources, and general process questions.

• Provide patients with approved educational materials, discussion guides, and support

resources.

• Coordinate with Patient Coordinators, field teams, provider offices, and other internal

stakeholders to support patient needs.

• Escalate clinical, billing, technical, or service-related concerns to the appropriate internal

teams.

• Maintain accurate documentation of all patient interactions and follow-up activities within

Salesforce and other internal systems.

• Support outreach initiatives, patient education programs, and operational projects

designed to improve the overall patient experience.

• Maintain compliance with all privacy, regulatory, and communication requirements.

• Demonstrate empathy, professionalism, and sound judgment when interacting with

patients and caregivers.

Qualifications:

• 2+ years of experience in patient support, customer service, healthcare operations, patient

engagement, care coordination, or a related field.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred.

• Experience interacting directly with patients or customers in a healthcare or service-

oriented environment preferred.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex

information in a clear and supportive manner.

• Excellent listening skills and ability to navigate sensitive conversations with empathy and

professionalism.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced

environment.

• Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms preferred.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word.

• Bilingual Spanish preferred.

Core Competencies

• Patient-centered communication

• Relationship building

• Active listening

• Problem solving

• Attention to detail

• Collaboration

• Adaptability

• Professional judgment

• Time management

• Compliance and confidentiality

Compliance & Training Requirements:

• Handle PHI in both electronic and paper formats in accordance with company policies.

• Complete HIPAA/PHI privacy, compliance, and security training within 30 days of hire.

• Maintain ongoing compliance with all Natera training requirements.

• Adhere to all patient communication, documentation, privacy, and regulatory

requirements.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$25—$30 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

For more information:
- BBB announcement on job scams
- FBI Cyber Crime resource page

jobs.title: Spacecraft Environmental Test Technician
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

Apex is seeking an Environmental Test Technician to support qualification and acceptance testing of spacecraft flight hardware. In this role, you will work directly with Test, Mechanical, Electrical, and Integration Engineers to validate spacecraft performance in simulated launch and space environments. You will be responsible for setting up, executing, and maintaining environmental test campaigns including thermal vacuum, thermal cycling, vibration, and shock testing. The ideal candidate is highly hands-on, mechanically inclined, adaptable, and thrives in a fast-paced hardware development environment.



Responsibilities:

• Assemble, instrument, and test spacecraft flight hardware throughout development, qualification, and production test campaigns.

• Set up, operate, monitor, and maintain environmental test equipment including thermal vacuum chambers, thermal chambers, vibration systems, shock equipment, and supporting infrastructure.

• Install, troubleshoot, and maintain instrumentation including thermocouples, accelerometers, strain gauges, pressure transducers, and associated harnessing.

• Support spacecraft integration, activation, and functional testing before, during, and after environmental test campaigns.

• Monitor test article and facility performance, identify anomalies, and support troubleshooting and root cause investigations.

• Collaborate closely with engineers to develop, improve, and execute test procedures, tooling, fixtures, and test infrastructure.

• Support the build, activation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of test racks, data acquisition systems, and automated test equipment.

• Perform mechanical assembly, disassembly, and rework activities on spacecraft hardware and test systems.

• Maintain accurate documentation of test configurations, procedures, results, discrepancies, and hardware status.

• Ensure compliance with quality standards, contamination control requirements, and safety protocols throughout all testing activities.

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that increase test throughput, reliability, and operational efficiency.



Requirements: 

• U.S. Person status is required as this position requires access to export-controlled data.

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• 3+ years of hands-on experience working with aerospace, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, automotive, or test systems.

• Experience operating, maintaining, or supporting environmental test equipment, laboratory equipment, or production test systems.

• Experience using electronic test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, or data acquisition systems.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, work instructions, procedures, and technical documentation.

• Strong mechanical aptitude and hands-on troubleshooting skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.

• Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering and production team.



Preferred: 

• Experience supporting spacecraft, satellite, launch vehicle, aviation, defense, or other high-reliability hardware programs.

• Familiarity with thermal vacuum (TVAC), thermal cycling, vibration, shock, acoustic, HALT, or HASS testing.

• Experience installing and troubleshooting instrumentation including thermocouples, accelerometers, strain gauges, and pressure transducers.

• Experience fabricating and repairing cable harnesses, including crimping, soldering, and connector assembly.

• Familiarity with IPC-620, J-STD-001, NASA-STD-8739, or equivalent aerospace workmanship standards.

• Experience working in cleanroom environments and following contamination control requirements.

• Experience operating cranes, lifts, rigging equipment, or supporting large hardware moves.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and manufacturing execution systems (MES), ERP systems, or related production software.

• Experience working in a fast-paced development or production environment with aggressive schedules.


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Cash bonus eligibility: share in Apex’s success with eligibility for a performance-based cash bonus on top of your salary, rewarding the impact you make

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan: Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave: Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

 - Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks: To keep you fueled throughout the day

 - Vibrant community: Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family

 - Your dream desk setup: All the tools you need to be your most productive self

 - World-class Playa Vista office: With the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life

 - Real impact opportunity: Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

Compensation ranges are set by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. A candidate's specific level and base pay are determined case by case and may vary with job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities, and internal equity. jobs.title: Executive Recruiter
jobs.description:
SentiLink https://www.sentilink.com/ helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 https://www.forbes.com/companies/sentilink/?list=fintech50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260330439998/en/SentiLink-Named-a-2026-FICO-Industry-Vanguard-Decision-Award-Winner-for-Leadership-in-Identity-Theft-Detection. We were also the first company to go live https://resources.sentilink.com/blog/sentilink-makes-history-as-first-ecbsv-provider with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress https://resources.sentilink.com/media/dr.-david-maimons-congressional-testimony-on-emerging-fraud-threats-and-the-evolving-fraud-landscape on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.




ROLE:

We're looking for an Executive Recruiter (Staff or Principal level) to lead some of SentiLink's most important and complex searches, with a primary focus on leadership hiring and strategic talent opportunities. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines deep recruiting expertise with strong business judgment, exceptional stakeholder management, and an operational mindset.

You'll work closely with the Head of Talent and senior leaders to shape hiring strategies, identify exceptional talent, and bring structure to ambiguous or evolving business needs. You'll be equally comfortable building a detailed market map, advising an executive on a difficult hiring decision, engaging a passive leadership candidate, or improving how the recruiting team operates.

Success in this role means becoming a trusted recruiting partner to SentiLink's leadership team, consistently delivering on high-stakes searches, building relationships with exceptional talent ahead of business needs, and contributing to a more strategic, effective, and scalable talent function.

This is a remote, U.S.-based position. Candidates based in Austin who are able to work regularly from one of our office locations are especially encouraged to apply.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own complex leadership and strategic searches from initial scoping through close, taking accountability for search strategy, candidate quality, stakeholder alignment, and hiring outcomes.

 - Develop comprehensive talent-market maps to identify target companies, leadership profiles, emerging talent, and competitive dynamics. Translate that research into actionable sourcing and hiring strategies.

 - Partner directly with executives and senior hiring managers to define talent needs, challenge assumptions, calibrate candidate profiles, and guide difficult hiring decisions with sound judgment and market insight.

 - Build and maintain relationships with exceptional talent, including passive candidates and individuals who may be relevant to future or opportunistic hiring needs.

 - Deliver a highly personalized candidate experience, managing sensitive conversations, complex stakeholder dynamics, and nuanced closing processes with professionalism, discretion, and attention to detail.

 - Navigate ambiguous and evolving priorities, bringing structure to loosely defined searches, identifying tradeoffs, and proactively driving decisions and next steps without requiring extensive direction.

 - Serve as a strategic and operational partner to the Head of Talent, helping prioritize recruiting investments, identify gaps and opportunities, and drive initiatives that improve the effectiveness of the broader talent function.

 - Build scalable recruiting practices by improving search planning, market intelligence, reporting, candidate engagement, and recruiting workflows. Use data and operational insights to identify problems and implement practical solutions.




REQUIREMENTS:

 - 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally within a technology company or high-growth startup.

 - Demonstrated success independently leading complex, senior-level recruiting searches, including Director-level and above, with accountability from search strategy through close.

 - Deep expertise in talent-market mapping, research, sourcing, and proactive relationship building, with the ability to identify and engage exceptional talent beyond active applicants.

 - Proven ability to advise and influence executive stakeholders, navigate competing perspectives, and drive alignment on hiring strategy and talent decisions.

 - Strong judgment and comfort with ambiguity, including the ability to independently structure undefined problems, prioritize competing opportunities, and turn incomplete information into clear action.

 - Exceptional candidate relationship management, with a track record of delivering thoughtful, high-touch experiences and managing confidential or sensitive searches.

 - Strong operational and analytical skills, with experience using recruiting data, structured processes, and practical improvements to increase recruiting effectiveness.

 - Experience contributing to broader talent strategy, recruiting operations, or cross-functional initiatives beyond individual requisition ownership (preferred)




COMPENSATION:

$180,000-$220,000 + equity + benefits

Note: This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels, and the actual base salary within that range will be determined by several components including but not limited to the individual's experience, skills, and qualifications.




PERKS:

 - Employer paid group health insurance for you and your dependents

 - 401(k) plan with employer match (or equivalent for non US-based roles)

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Regular company-wide in-person events

 - Home office stipend, and more!




CORPORATE VALUES:

 - Follow Through

 - Deep Understanding

 - Whatever It Takes

 - Do Something Smart

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Safety
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER, SAFETY

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to support our Safety teams. You will play a critical role in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining cutting-edge tools and applications that enable trust and safety across SpaceXSI's organizations and products, including brand safety as well as legal and operations. You'll have the unique opportunity to work across the stack and across SpaceXSI, collaborating with cross-functional teams and all of our products to deliver scalable, mission-critical solutions that enhance operational efficiency, provide critical insights, and meet the unique challenges of protecting users, advertisers, and the platform at global scale.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own the architecture of safety systems end to end, from design and development through deployment and ongoing operation.

• Design, build, develop, and deploy mission-critical tooling for content moderation and enforcement, abuse and risk detection, brand safety controls, legal request processing and compliance, reviewer workflows, and ops case management.

• Monitor and optimize applications for security compliance.

• Build and maintain scalable back-end systems using languages like Java and Scala.

• Integrate with and maintain secure, reliable databases (e.g., PostgreSQL or MySQL).

• Collaborate with trust and safety, brand safety, legal, and operations partners to understand their needs, drive cross-org alignment, and translate those needs into actionable technical solutions.

• Develop APIs and middleware to connect systems and facilitate seamless data exchange, including data pipelines and insights that support safety operations.

• Ensure high performance, reliability, and scalability in all applications, and provide technical leadership in ambiguous, high-scale environments.

• Mentor engineers and set engineering standards for the Safety organization.

• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or software engineering.

• 5+ years of experience as a full stack developer, with experience in both front-end and back-end technologies.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and one or more front-end frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js).

• Strong experience with back-end frameworks.

• Expertise in designing and working with RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL.

• Hands-on experience with SQL databases.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization tools like Docker or Kubernetes.

• Experience owning system architecture end to end, providing technical leadership, mentoring other engineers, and setting engineering standards.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a commitment to delivering quality solutions, including in ambiguous, high-scale environments.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and drive alignment with trust and safety, brand safety, legal, and operations partners.

• A security-first mindset, with a commitment to protecting the privacy of our users' data.

• A demonstrated ability to succeed in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

$180,000 - $330,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Sr. Project & Program Manager, Quality - Trust & Safety
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US
jobs.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Trust and Safety Quality helps ensure that enforcement decisions are accurate, consistent, and fair for Pinners. As a Sr. Project & Program Manager, Quality, you will independently own key quality programs for content moderation, including the quality operating mechanisms used to evaluate and improve BPO performance. You’ll turn complex and sometimes conflicting quality signals into clear decisions, practical recommendations, and measurable improvements.

This role calls for deep QA and Trust & Safety expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to lead work across teams without relying on direct authority. You’ll partner with Policy, Training, Vendor Management, Enforcement Operations, and Product and Engineering to strengthen quality processes, address performance gaps, and prepare for new product and policy launches.

What you’ll do:

• Own core BPO content-safety quality processes, including sampling strategy, reporting, review guidance, and quality escalations. Identify emerging risks and determine when to resolve issues directly or bring them to the right partners.

• Develop and improve quality measurement approaches, such as golden datasets, sampling methods, and precision/recall analysis, so results are reliable and useful for operational decisions.

• Monitor quality metrics and related signals across workflows. Investigate changes, identify underlying causes, and distinguish meaningful performance shifts from noise or limitations in the data.

• Translate findings into prioritized recommendations and lead feedback loops with BPO partners and internal teams. Track follow-through and assess whether interventions improve decision quality and operational performance.

• Help shape and operationalize a scalable moderation quality strategy. Balance accuracy, consistency, efficiency, and policy intent when recommending changes to quality processes.

• Establish quality plans for new product and policy launches, working with stakeholders to clarify standards, review methods, readiness criteria, and escalation paths before launch.

• Partner with Trust & Safety Product and Engineering to define QA tooling needs, clarify requirements, and evaluate whether tooling changes improve quality workflows and outcomes.

• Communicate complex or sensitive quality issues clearly to partners and leaders, align stakeholders with competing priorities, and influence action without direct reporting authority.

• Use AI or automation where appropriate to accelerate analysis and quality work; validate outputs, apply critical judgment, and remain accountable for recommendations and decisions.

What we’re looking for:

• Demonstrated experience in quality assurance, quality operations, or Trust & Safety, with the ability to independently own complex work and improve established processes.

• Experience working with BPOs or other external partners to set expectations, evaluate performance, resolve quality issues, and achieve shared outcomes.

• Strong knowledge of QA principles and methods, including quality measurement frameworks, golden datasets, sampling strategy, and precision/recall analysis.

• Experience in Policy, Content Moderation, Content Quality, Content Safety, labeling, or a closely related domain.

• Strong analytical judgment: able to identify patterns in incomplete or conflicting data, test assumptions, and make sound recommendations.

• Proven ability to lead multiple concurrent initiatives, manage tradeoffs and escalations, and adapt plans as priorities change.

• Clear communication and collaboration skills, including experience building trust and driving decisions across distributed, cross-functional teams.

• Interest in using AI or automation to improve analysis or operations, paired with a thoughtful approach to validating accuracy and owning final outcomes.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in quality control/assurance or Trust & Safety.

Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement

• We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.

• This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times every 6-months and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

GLOBAL SUPPLY MANAGER, CONSTRUCTION (STARSHIP)

SpaceX is on a fast track to become the market leader in various product categories like internet services through the Starlink constellation, US based human spaceflight, rapid vehicle reusability, and others exciting projects. The SpaceX Supply Chain Department is a critical player in our operations. The functions within the department include procurement, planning and fulfillment, supplier development and quality, logistics and inventory. SpaceX Supply Chain will play a key role in enabling SpaceX to meet these ambitious growth targets and greatly contribute in making us a multi-planetary species. This individual will support construction projects and capital purchases for the construction and facilities organizations.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Work directly with key internal stakeholders to develop and implement a comprehensive contract management process that ensures a successful project execution cycle

• Create sourcing strategies for assigned categories to reduce risk and meet targets for the purchasing department including, but not limited to, payment terms, cash targets, and cost savings

• Develop and maintain key internal stakeholder relationships to create strategic sourcing models that optimize the value of products and services that support business unit requirements to maintain continuous cost reduction programs for controllable expenditures

• Identify and execute cost reduction projects including planning, coordinating with stakeholders, estimating completion, and project updates

• Perform advanced quantitative and business process analyses to identify financial impacts of decisions, cost improvement, and performance for assigned categories

• Collaborate with stakeholders to define SLAs and KPIs for suppliers and measure the appropriate criteria such as delivery of business results, cost reduction, quality, and timeliness of delivery

• Conduct research, perform benchmarking, and gather market analysis for assigned categories

• Create contract documents in collaboration with the legal department

• Manage contracts to ensure the supplier's performance meets contract obligations

• Understand interrelationships between contracts and terms while applying creative solutions

• Maximize value and cost savings benefits while lowering risk through strategic negotiations

• Identify and drive year over year cost optimization through reducing usage and eliminating waste within our operations

• Establish preferred suppliers for assigned categories

• Create and implement management programs to develop, continuously improve, manage the performance of, and monitor KPIs of the supply base

• Place purchase orders and resolve blocked invoices related to assigned categories

• Develop and lead efforts to reduce number of transactions and for assigned categories

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree and 6+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 10+ years of experience working in one or more of the following: Engineering Purchasing Contract negotiation Material or production planning Operations or supply chain management Master production scheduling Construction, facilities, or industrial plant management

• Experience in industrial engineering, construction management, and/or facilities management

• Strong budget tracking and cost analytical skills

• Extensive project management and organizational skills

• Experience managing large scale industrial and commercial construction projects

• Strong contract negotiation and document management skills

• Remarkable problem-solving skills with a bias for speed

• Quick learner and ability to prioritize appropriately to meet customer and company needs

• Excellent customer service skills

• Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills

• Exceptional analytical and organizational skills

• Strong technical knowledge and skills in current technologies and applications (e.g. MS Office Suite, SQL, PowerBI, etc.)

jobs.title: Craft Workforce Planning Specialist
jobs.description:
At Keeley Companies, we believe in empowering our people and fulfilling career aspirations. Keeley is a career destination with countless opportunities for advancement, and a world-class family culture that is centered around creating the best possible environment for our people to thrive.

Keeley Construction is offering an exciting career opportunity for a Craft Workforce Planning Specialist located at our Corporate Headquarters in St. Louis, MO. This role is responsible for managing and optimizing the deployment of craft employees across all operating groups. This role serves as a strategic partner to field leadership by maintaining workforce data, assessing labor needs, coordinating employee movement between projects, and ensuring the right people are placed in the right roles at the right time. The position will build strong relationships with superintendents and project leadership to support workforce planning and maximize craft talent utilization.

Primary Responsibilities

• Maintain and manage workforce data within excel, UKG and other workforce management systems.

• Track and document performance, skills, certifications, and experience of craft team members.

• Build and maintain strong working relationships with superintendents, project managers, and field leaders across all operating groups.

• Coordinate the movement and allocation of craft employees between projects based on skillset, project demands, and workforce availability.

• Analyze workforce reports and labor data to identify staffing trends, utilization rates, and workforce needs.

• Assist in forecasting labor demands for upcoming projects and peak workload periods.

• Ensure certifications, training records, and workforce qualifications remain current and accurately documented.

• Identify opportunities to maximize workforce utilization and reduce downtime between assignments.

• Coordinate the sharing of craft talent across divisions and operating groups to support project success.

• Support workforce planning meetings and provide labor utilization reports to field leadership.

• Maintain accurate workforce records and ensure compliance with company policies and applicable regulations.

• Travel to job sites and office locations as needed to support workforce planning efforts, onboarding, and build relationships.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Construction Management, or related field preferred.

• Minimum of 1 years of experience in workforce planning, human resources, construction operations, recruiting, or related field.

• Experience working within the construction industry and understanding craft labor classifications preferred.

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. Within Premium Support, Dedicated Support Engineers combine deep technical troubleshooting with an enduring understanding of our most strategic customers’ architectures, critical workloads, and business priorities. Through proactive reliability work, ownership during incidents, and AI-powered support capabilities, we help customers operate successfully as their use of OpenAI grows.

jobs.title: Sr. Regulatory Affairs Engineer
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. REGULATORY AFFAIRS ENGINEER

This Sr. Regulatory Affairs Engineer supports the Falcon, Dragon, and Starfall programs in FAA launch and reentry licensing and related regulatory affairs. The role demonstrates compliance with applicable U.S. government requirements and works with SpaceX engineers across disciplines, with frequent engagement with commercial space, airspace, radio spectrum, and maritime regulators. The role also supports Falcon, Dragon, and Starfall engineering, which oversees each SpaceX mission and drives continuous improvement from prior flights.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Support interactions with offices within the FAA, DoD, NASA, USCG, FCC, and other agencies regarding existing licenses, new applications, and compliance matters

• Maintain Falcon and Dragon vehicle operator licenses, and submit modifications as necessary for these mature programs

• Support Starfall reentry vehicle licensing, including the initial license and later expansions as the vehicle, concept of operations, and payload applications evolve

• Prepare, track, and transmit mission-specific deliverables as well as licensing and permitting materials to the relevant regulatory entity

• Assist with the regulatory compliance and certification function within Falcon, Dragon, and Starfall Engineering, with a particular focus on upcoming program milestones

• Create, coordinate, and organize information across technical, reliability, mission management, Legal, Government Affairs, Environmental, and operations disciplines within SpaceX

• Closely interact with the Flight Reliability, System Safety, Change Engineering, Trajectory Analysis, and Chief Engineering teams to ensure that licensing materials are accurate and timely

• Participate in pre-flight and pre-reentry readiness reviews during launch and recovery campaigns to verify that risks are mitigated, site issues are dispositioned and verified, and critical testing and review activities are completed

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline

• 5+ years of experience in a system design, manufacturing, or test engineering role

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Master's degree in an engineering, physical science, or space policy discipline

• Systems engineering or system safety engineering education and experience

• Project management skills, including organizing information, concisely communicating within a team and excellent time management abilities

• Experience with multi-system engineering design

• Experience coordinating across responsible engineers and technical areas

• Able to work well in an integrated collaborative team environment, including frequent interactions with other engineers, managers, and U.S. Government agencies

• Excellent communication and writing skills, and the ability to succinctly present information and assessments

• General familiarity with the disciplines necessary for spacecraft flight including: structures; propulsion; avionics; guidance, navigation & control; flight software; dynamics; launch and mission operations; systems engineering; and integration

• Highly self-motivated with strong organizational skills – able to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment with ongoing drive for continuous improvement in all aspects of work

• Ability to quickly grasp knowledge of a diverse range of hardware and analyses that go into making SpaceX missions reliable and successful

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be available to work extended hours, and weekends as needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

Level 3: $135,000.00 - $215,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

jobs.title: Regional Business Development Director - West Region
jobs.location: Boise, ID; Kent, WA; Novato, CA; West Covina, CA; Laguna Niguel, CA; Denver, CO; Colorado Springs, CO
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

At Guardian Restoration Partners, we are on a mission to build the most impactful restoration business in the industry. Our network of "Guardians" helps property owners in crisis rebuild their lives after devastating events like water, fire, and mold damage. As part of our team, you’ll be contributing to a company that values results, integrity, and putting customers first.

Guardian is a high-growth, private equity–backed company building a national platform in the restoration and field services industry. Through a focused acquisition strategy and strong organic growth, we are creating a best-in-class organization that combines local market expertise with the scale, systems, and discipline of a national platform. We are a passionate group of professionals committed to preserving the legacy of small and medium-sized businesses while accelerating their growth. We bring deep expertise and a hands-on approach to support our partners, expand the Guardian network, and make a lasting, positive impact across every organization

What We're Looking For

Guardian Restoration Partners is seeking a Regional Business Development Director to lead sales performance and drive profitable revenue growth across five restoration partner companies throughout our West Region. This hands-on leader will build and develop high-performing Business Development teams, expand strategic referral partnerships, and strengthen commercial execution across residential and commercial restoration markets.

A key focus of this role is accelerating growth through property management and plumbing referral channels, including developing relationships with regional and multi-location partners. We're looking for an experienced sales leader who understands how to turn strong relationships into sustainable revenue while building the processes, accountability, and talent needed to scale.

Reporting to our VP of Growth, the Regional Business Development Director will partner with regional leadership, and General Managers, this leader will play a critical role in expanding market share, improving underperforming businesses, and establishing a consistent approach to business development across the region.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Sales Leadership & Team Development

• Lead, coach, and develop Business Development Representatives (BDRs) across five restoration partner companies, driving accountability for individual and regional performance.

• Recruit, hire, onboard, and develop sales talent, building strong teams capable of delivering consistent results.

• Establish clear performance expectations through regular one-on-ones, field ride-alongs, pipeline reviews, and hands-on coaching.

• Identify performance gaps and implement targeted development plans to improve sales effectiveness and execution.

Strategic Partnerships & Referral Growth

• Develop and execute regional growth strategies across property management, plumbing, and other high-value referral channels.

• Build and manage strategic relationships with property management organizations, including regional decision-makers, facilities leaders, and multi-property operators.

• Pursue preferred-vendor opportunities, portfolio-wide agreements, and long-term partnerships that generate recurring restoration business.

• Expand plumbing referral networks through relationships with company owners, operational leaders, and field teams, including multi-location plumbing organizations.

• Personally lead high-value account development while coaching BDRs to acquire, grow, and retain referral partners.

• Partner with Operations to ensure service delivery supports customer expectations, account retention, and continued referral growth.

Revenue Growth & Business Performance

• Own regional business development goals, translating revenue objectives into actionable sales priorities and measurable performance expectations.

• Partner with General Managers to align local business development strategies with regional growth opportunities and operational capabilities.

• Evaluate market and partner company performance, identify growth opportunities, and implement improvement plans for underperforming businesses.

• Monitor referral volume, lead conversion, revenue contribution, and partner profitability to prioritize the most valuable growth opportunities.

• Identify and scale successful sales practices across partner companies to strengthen regional performance.

Sales Execution & Performance Management

• Establish consistent sales processes, weekly operating rhythms, and KPI scorecards to improve visibility and accountability across the region.

• Drive disciplined use of CRM and available sales tracking tools to manage referral relationships, pipeline activity, opportunities, and follow-up.

• Analyze BDR productivity, referral trends, conversion rates, and account performance to identify gaps and guide coaching.

• Partner with regional leadership and Operations to improve lead quality, customer experience, and conversion of referral opportunities into completed jobs.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field preferred.

• 7+ years of progressive sales or business development experience, including 3+ years directly leading outside sales teams across multiple locations.

• Experience growing referral-based businesses within restoration, plumbing, HVAC, roofing, or similar home services industries required.

• Strong understanding of property management organizations, including decision-making structures, vendor qualification processes, service expectations, and opportunities for multi-property partnerships.

• Demonstrated success building, coaching, and developing sales teams while delivering measurable revenue growth.

• Proven ability to develop strategic referral relationships, expand existing accounts, and generate new business across multiple markets.

• Experience establishing sales KPIs, managing pipelines, and using CRM and performance data to improve results.

• Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to evaluate referral performance, customer acquisition costs, and profitability.

• Ability to influence and collaborate with General Managers and operational leaders across multiple businesses.

• Willingness to travel regularly throughout the West Region.

Skills Needed to Succeed

• Hands-on Sales Leadership: Develops people through active coaching, clear expectations, and consistent accountability.

• Strategic Relationship Building: Establishes trusted partnerships and converts relationships into sustainable business opportunities.

• Commercial Acumen: Understands what drives profitable growth and prioritizes opportunities based on business impact.

• Performance Orientation: Uses data, KPIs, and field insights to identify gaps and improve results.

• Influence & Collaboration: Builds alignment across independently operated businesses and diverse leadership teams.

• Execution & Adaptability: Balances strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, evolving organization.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will:

• Deliver measurable regional revenue growth through increased qualified referrals and referral-generated restoration jobs.

• Expand plumbing and property management partnerships, increasing new account acquisition, referral activity, and growth from existing partners.

• Improve BDR productivity and sales effectiveness through consistent coaching, performance expectations, and KPI accountability.

• Strengthen performance in underperforming partner companies through focused sales improvement plans.

• Establish greater visibility into referral partner performance, customer acquisition costs, and profitability to support sustainable, high-value growth.

Compensation

Guardian Restoration Partners is committed to providing competitive, equitable compensation. The target total on-target earnings (OTE) for this position are $250,000 to $275,000, inclusive of base salary and variable compensation. Actual compensation will depend on skills, experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other relevant factors. Compensation ranges are reviewed periodically and may be modified as business needs evolve.

Location & Travel

This is a hybrid position supporting our restoration partner companies throughout the West Region. Preferred locations include Boise, ID; Kent, WA; Novato, CA; West Covina, CA; Laguna Niguel, CA; Denver, CO; and Colorado Springs, CO.

Regular travel of approximately 50% is expected, including visits to partner company locations and Guardian's Denver headquarters.

Application Deadline

The anticipated application deadline is December 1, 2026, although this date may change based on the volume of qualified applications received.

Ready to Apply?

If you're a results-driven sales leader who enjoys developing people, building strategic relationships, and creating meaningful business growth, we'd love to hear from you. Join Guardian Restoration Partners and help shape the next phase of growth across our West Region.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

At Guardian Restoration Partners, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Director, Global People Operations
jobs.description:
Director, Global People Operations

Human Resources

Remote – Austin, TX or Toronto, ON

Narvar is growing! We are hiring a Director, Global People Operations to lead HR and People Operations across North America and India. You will own the function, the systems, and the team that keep a fast-scaling, multi-country workforce running.

You'll deploy People Operations strategy, lead the team that runs day-to-day service delivery, and partner with senior leadership on the org and talent questions that matter at a company level. You'll lead a distributed team of 3 supporting US, Canadian, and Indian based employees.

What you'll own:

1. Lead the Global People Operations function and team

• Work with the Exec Team to set the strategy and operating standards for People Operations across North America and India, and build a function that scales with the business.

• Manage, coach, and develop a distributed team of three across multiple time zones and regions. Own hiring, leveling, and succession within People Operations, and raise the bar on how the team delivers in both regions.

2. Own service delivery across North America and India

• Be accountable for People Ops service delivery across regions (HRIS and people systems, onboarding and offboarding, and the full employee lifecycle), with your team running day-to-day execution.

• Set consistent, documented processes that work the same way in all regions, and keep policy, documentation, and records accurate and accessible.

• Modernize the function by bringing AI and automation to employee data, reporting, and routine operations to reduce manual work and improve accuracy.

3. Own multi-region compliance, risk, and employee relations

• Be accountable for statutory and employment-law compliance in India (Shops & Establishments Act, POSH Act, Provident Fund, ESI, Gratuity, Professional Tax, and state-specific regulations) and across North America (US and Canadian federal, state, and provincial employment law).

• Partner with legal, payroll, and external consultants in each region, own relationships with statutory bodies and auditors, and oversee POSH Internal Committee responsibilities.

• Serve as the senior escalation point for employee relations and workplace investigations, ensuring fair, timely, and locally compliant resolution.

4. Partner with leadership on org and talent strategy

• Act as a strategic people partner to senior and functional leadership, advising on org design, workforce planning, and talent strategy at a company level.

• Guide leadership effectiveness and organizational health, and support reorgs and scale-ups as a change partner.

• Bring people data and analytics (attrition, engagement, span/layer, representation) to leadership as insight-led recommendations, not just administrative support.

5. Own compensation, performance, and people programs

• Own the design and governance of compensation across regions, including annual reviews, equity refresh cycles, and market benchmarking (including India-market benchmarking against local tech and GCC employers).

• Own the frameworks for performance, leveling, and engagement, and set the cadence the team runs them on.

• Shape and localize global people programs, including engagement surveys, career frameworks, recognition, and total rewards.

What success looks like in your first year:

• The North America and India people teams operate as one function, with consistent, documented processes across regions.

• Statutory compliance run clean in both regions, with zero major findings.

• Senior leaders view you as a trusted partner, not only as a transactional HR contact.

• Clear, consistent frameworks for leveling, performance, and compensation are in place across regions.

• Engagement and attrition metrics improve year-over-year.

What we're looking for:

• 12–15+ years of progressive HR / People Operations experience in multi-country, high-growth tech environments.

• People leadership: 7+ years managing and developing HR / People Ops teams, ideally across multiple regions and time zones.

• Multi-region operations ownership: demonstrated accountability for People Ops (HRIS, compliance, and lifecycle) globally.

• Compliance depth across regions: strong working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory requirements (including POSH) and North American (US and Canadian) employment law.

• Strategic business partnering: a track record of advising and influencing senior and executive leaders on org design, workforce planning, and talent strategy.

• Compensation and performance: experience owning comp planning, benchmarking, and performance frameworks.

• Employee relations judgment: excellent judgment on investigations, with a bias for fair, timely resolution.

• Systems and automation mindset: comfort modernizing People Ops with HRIS and AI/automation for employee data and reporting.

• Education: bachelor's degree required; MBA or PG in HR or equivalent preferred.

Preferred qualifications

• Prior experience in a high-growth SaaS, product, or platform technology company.

• Experience standing up or scaling People Ops in a multi-country or GCC setting.

• Familiarity with people analytics and HR tools (ADP, Lattice, Pave, or equivalent).

Why Narvar?

We're on a mission to simplify the everyday lives of consumers. Post-purchase is a critical phase of the customer journey. That's why we created Narvar — a platform focused on driving customer loyalty through seamless post-purchase experiences that allow retailers to retain, engage, and delight customers. If you've ever bought something online, there's a good chance you've used our platform! From the hottest new direct-to-consumer companies to retail's most renowned brands, Narvar works with GameStop, Sonos, Nike, and 1,500+ other brands. With hubs in San Francisco, London, and Bangalore, we've served over 125 million consumers worldwide across 10+ billion interactions, 38 countries, and 55 languages. Pioneering the post-purchase movement means navigating into the unknown. Our team thrives on this sense of adventure while nurturing a mindset of innovation. We're a home for big hearts and we leave our egos at the door.

jobs.description:

Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.

Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.

We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”

Analyze complex supply chain data and key performance indicators (KPIs) to forecast operational capacity, mitigate risks, and present actionable insights to executive leadership.

• Experience managing complex logistics projects while leading and influencing various stakeholders, from frontline associates to corporate leadership.
