jobs.title: Industrial Security Specialist
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.



Hadrian's Industrial Security team protects the classified and export-controlled work behind our factories, and the people cleared to do it. Our cleared population is growing quickly, and the program needs to run like a mature industrial security program while keeping pace with a company that moves fast. Where most companies split this work across an Assistant FSO, a personnel security lead and a security education manager, we are building one senior seat backed by automation.

You will own the day-to-day execution of personnel security, classified space readiness and security education within the program led by our Corporate Facility Security Officer, and report to the Corporate FSO. You'll serve as the designated alternate for routine facility security matters and handle day-to-day contact with our DCSA representative under the FSO's direction, while the FSO keeps accountability for the facility clearance and strategic DCSA engagement. You'll work closely with program leadership, Facilities, People and IT, and be the person who holds the line on a requirement. This is a hands-on, on-site role at our Torrance, CA headquarters.

What You’ll Do

 - Run personnel security for our cleared workforce end to end: initiate and track investigations, reinvestigations and continuous vetting in DISS and NBIS, keep NISS records current, and process visit requests, reportable events and debriefings.

 - Keep classified spaces inspection-ready: support closed-area and security-container controls, classified material accountability and the self-inspection cycle, and close out findings with the owners responsible for them.

 - Own security education: deliver initial, annual refresher, foreign travel and termination briefings, plus insider threat and threat-awareness training that people remember.

 - Act as the FSO's alternate for routine facility security matters and day-to-day DCSA contact, and keep the records and evidence behind every decision ready for review.

 - Partner with program leadership, Facilities, People and IT so new programs, spaces and hires meet security requirements before work starts, not after.

 - Turn manual tracking into repeatable, automated workflows so one person can carry a program that usually takes three.

What We’re Looking For

 - 4+ years of hands-on industrial security experience under the NISP at a cleared defense, aerospace or space contractor, or at DCSA.

 - Working command of 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM) and day-to-day experience with DISS, NBIS and NISS.

 - Personnel security at volume: you have kept clearance records, reinvestigations and reportable events current for a large cleared population.

 - Experience building and delivering security education, including insider threat awareness, to technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Active U.S. Government security clearance, or the ability to obtain and maintain one.

 - The credibility and judgment to hold the line on a requirement with program leaders, Facilities and government representatives, and the ownership to run your work without hand-holding.

What Will Set You Apart

 - Experience as an AFSO, ITPSO or CPSO, or experience preparing a facility for a DCSA security review.

 - Experience at a fast-scaling defense, space or aerospace company where the security program was still being built.

 - Closed-area, SAP or SCIF experience, or a background in military security, counterintelligence or DCSA.

 - ISP certification or SPēD certifications (SFPC, ISOC), or completion of the CDSE FSO curriculum.

 - Experience automating security workflows with modern tools, or pairing them with existing government systems.


BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

 


HADRIAN IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.

jobs.title: Director of Institutional Marketing
jobs.description:
At Harris, the true value of what makes us successful is found in our people. It is our unique mix of cultures, experiences, beliefs and backgrounds that sets Harris apart from the rest.  We constantly strive to cultivate, nurture and amplify an unparalleled environment, where we value intellectual curiosity and uniqueness of thought.  Inclusion is embedded in the very fabric of our culture of collaboration and openness.

We understand that a job description only tells one part of a broader story, and Harris is seeking dynamic candidates who can add to our best-in-class environment. We recognize that qualifications can be gained through both traditional and non-traditional paths, and we are committed to considering candidates who possess the potential to be excellent in this role regardless of prior experiences.

Therefore we encourage ALL interested individuals to submit their applications, even if they do not meet every requirement outlined in the job description.

The Position

The Marketing team at Harris | Oakmark supports the firm’s distribution efforts across its institutional and intermediary channels, spanning product marketing, content, campaigns, public relations, social media, and events. The department is evolving to provide more dedicated, channel-specific support to distribution.

The Marketing Director, Institutional leads marketing strategy and campaign execution for Harris | Oakmark’s institutional business, partnering closely with the Head of Marketing and with sales representatives to develop and deliver initiatives that support institutional revenue growth. The role combines product marketing with the development of collateral for integrated campaigns that engage and influence institutional investors and investment consultants, driving lead generation, brand awareness, and deeper client engagement in support of Institutional Distribution objectives. It also owns institutional and investment strategy materials, works with international distribution partners, and supports public relations, social media, content, sponsorships, and events.

Responsibilities

Strategy and campaigns

• Own overall strategy for institutional marketing campaigns and partner with the Marketing team on execution

• Develop impactful Marketo-enabled campaigns that support institutional revenue generation

• Work with sales representatives to align campaigns and materials with prospect needs, supporting lead generation and growth of the institutional client base

• Coordinate with the intermediary marketing team to ensure consistent brand voice and campaign strategy across channels

• Analyze email journeys and web metrics in partnership with Marketing to inform institutional channel strategy

Materials and content

• Manage end-to-end development and ongoing updates of institutional- and strategy-level materials, including clear, concise, channel-specific collateral that supports Institutional Distribution objectives

• Lead institutional vehicle-specific pieces and initiatives, including go-to-market strategy

• Partner with the content team on ad hoc and off-cycle market updates for institutional email and social campaigns

• Collaborate with non-US distribution and marketing partners on collateral needs

• Partner with Compliance to ensure content is compliant for use across distribution channels and regions and suited to evolving client needs

• Draft institutional client communications, in partnership with Marketing leadership

Brand, PR and events

• Support social media strategy and collaborate on the content calendar for the institutional channel

• Identify and prioritize sponsorship and conference/event opportunities, manage related vendor relationships, and execute institutional channel participation

• Support public relations initiatives, including content dissemination and pitch and talking-point development with agencies and partners, in partnership with Marketing leadership

Qualifications

Required

• 10+ years of experience in asset management marketing, distribution, or a related channel-marketing role (ideally some within the institutional channel)

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, finance or a related field

• Demonstrated experience developing marketing strategy and campaigns for an institutional audience

• Experience with marketing automation and content platforms such as Marketo and Seismic

• Deep knowledge of institutional distribution and product, with a strong understanding of the asset management industry and compliance processes

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills and attention to detail, with experience drafting client-facing communications, press releases and talking points

• Ability to convey complex investment and financial topics in a clear and engaging way

• Client-centric approach with thorough understanding of client needs and how to best position our investment strategies

• Innovative thinking to develop unique and impactful marketing deliverables that differentiate the firm from competitors

• Strong project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, materials, and stakeholders concurrently in a fast-paced environment

• Experience with public relations and media relations coordination, including working with outside agencies

• Collaborative approach, with proven ability to build partnerships across Marketing, Sales, Distribution, Compliance, and external distribution partners

Preferred:

• Experience with value investment managers and/or multi-affiliate models

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to integrate life and work and to support our employees and their families. Benefits include, but are not limited to; medical, prescription drug, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, profit sharing plan, 401k plan, tuition reimbursement, commuter and holistic wellness benefits along with volunteer programs.

Actual annual base salaries may vary based on factors including but not limited to education, training, experience, and other job-related factors. If hired, base pay will be determined on an individualized basis and is only one part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include a discretionary performance bonus and other Harris sponsored benefit programs.

Expected range for this Chicago-based role

$175,000—$225,000 USD

Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement
Harris Associates L.P. pursues a policy of equal opportunity in all areas of employment including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, benefits, advancement, and treatment on the job. This means that Harris does not discriminate against employees, or qualified applicants, based on an individual's race, color, religion, creed, sex, age, national origin, physical disability, sexual orientation, trans-gender status, transsexual status, status as a veteran or disabled veteran, genetic information or for any other reason prohibited by law.  Harris reserves the right to review publicly available information about applicants (i.e., via social networking sites), to the extent permissible under applicable law.

Reasonable Accommodation Notice
We provide reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in job application procedures. If you have any difficulty using our online system and you need an accommodation due to a disability, you may use the alternative email address below to contact us about your interest in employment at HR@harrisassoc.com or you can call us at 312-646-3600.

Privacy Statement
The information you send to us is used for employment purposes only. What you send is kept confidential—we will not give your personal information to outside parties without your consent.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Conversational AI
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Conversational AI team is a key part of our broader Platform Engineering organization, focused on building innovative solutions that enable customers to design and deploy intelligent agents that automate tasks and workflows.

Our platform gives users the capabilities to define, configure, and scale AI-powered experiences that can operate autonomously, helping organizations improve efficiency and optimize processes across industries.

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

As an Assistant Electrical Project Manager (APM) within our Mission Critical team at Loenbro, you will be an essential part of our project team leading the delivery of next generation hyperscale and artificial intelligence (AI) data center campuses supporting cloud, AI, and high-performance computing workloads. You'll work on 50+ MW builds (multiple builds could be constructed) with projects ranging from 3+ months up to 2 years per project.

Under the direction of the Project Manager (PM) or Senior Project Manager SPM), you'll provide full lifecycle ownership of mission-critical infrastructure projects from site development through commissioning and turnover along with successful execution of several projects. You’ll work closely with Project Managers, gaining valuable experience and contributing to the project’s overall success.

We are seeking candidates interested in work within our Iowa and/or Colorado markets. Projects in each market could consist of 60+ MW per project with multiple projects at each location.

• Provide close support and oversite of third-tier subcontractors.

• Assist in creating and enforcing the project budget.

• Assist in creating and submitting the Schedule of Values (SOV).

• Oversee Project Engineers in the processing of Requests for Information (RFIs), Submittals, quantity takeoffs, and material tracking.

• Oversee the project-closeout process to ensure all documentation is submitted to the owner.

Preferred:

• Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management or related field.

• National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 70E or Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Certification.

• Experience utilizing project management (PM) software and tools such as Bluebeam, Procore, Accubid, and Primavera P6.

jobs.title: CNC Programmer
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and capital-efficient approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to support a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and supporting a growing space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to design, build, and operate its own spacecraft in orbit. Next, Haven-1 is targeted to become the world’s first commercial space station, with launch anticipated in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced two new offerings leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo: Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line; and Vast Lunar Systems, power, communications, and habitats for the Moon.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities capable of manufacturing America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for Mars, dedicated modules for government partners, and other crewed systems designed to unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for a CNC Programmer, reporting to the Manager, Supply Chain, to support the development of the systems that will be required for the design and build of artificial-gravity human-rated space stations.

This will be a full-time, non-exempt position located in our Hawthorne facility.

This role will specifically support the Launcher E-2 liquid rocket engine program. Vast has the ambitious goal for E-2 to be the world’s highest-performing engine for small launchers, optimized for mass production and low cost. You will be a key team member helping complete the development of our E-2 engine into a reliable, high-performance product.

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Programmer who works on lathe machines to join our team to machine E-2 parts and tools. You will play a crucial role in the development, fabrication, maintenance, and repair of various tools, jigs, and fixtures used in our production processes. Your precision, attention to detail, and ability to work with a variety of materials and machinery will contribute to the efficiency and quality of our manufacturing operations.

Responsibilities:

• Experience in Mastercam for turning centers.

• Design, develop, and manufacture tools, dies, jigs, fixtures, molds, and other equipment required for production, ensuring they meet exacting specifications and tolerances.

• Choose appropriate materials for tool construction based on factors such as strength, durability, and compatibility with the manufacturing process.

• Interpret engineering drawings, schematics, and technical specifications to accurately create or modify tools.

• Inspect finished tools to verify their accuracy, precision, and quality, making necessary adjustments to ensure optimal performance.

• Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain existing tools to extend their lifespan and ensure continuous production operations.

• Work closely with design engineers, production managers, and other team members to ensure tools align with production requirements and goals.

• Identify opportunities for process improvement and innovation in tool design and manufacturing techniques to enhance efficiency, safety, and product quality.

• Maintain comprehensive records of tool designs, modifications, maintenance procedures, and any troubleshooting activities.

• Adhere to all safety protocols and guidelines, promoting a safe working environment for yourself and your colleagues.

Minimum Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

• 2+ years experience in related machining role, 1+ years experience with programming

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• Experience with Fanuc controller and Doosan / DNM PUMA turning centers.

• Experience turning aerospace materials like Inconel 718, SS304, SS316, AL7075.

• Experience fixturing and turning metal additive manufacturing parts.

• Strong GD&T skills, and experience creating and reviewing drawings.

• Proficiency in operating a variety of machine tools, including lathes, mills, grinders, and EDM machines.

• Meticulous attention to detail and precision in all tasks, ensuring tools meet strict tolerances and specifications.

• Strong problem-solving skills to identify issues, troubleshoot problems, and implement effective solutions.

• Ability to adapt to changing manufacturing needs and work in a dynamic environment.

• Effective communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and provide insights on tool design and manufacturing processes.

• Commitment to maintaining a safe work environment and following all safety protocols.

• Capable of standing for extended periods and performing manual tasks that may require moderate physical effort.

Additional Requirements:

• Willingness to work overtime, or weekends to support critical mission milestones.

• Ability to lift up to 25 lbs unassisted.

Pay Range:

• Machinist I: $23.22 - $32.96

• Machinist II: $29.35 - $41.66

• Machinist III: $34.61 - $49.13

Pay Range: California

$23.22—$49.13 USD

PEOPLE OPERATIONS COORDINATOR @ CLAY


At Clay, People Operations is about creating the environment where people can do the best work of their careers. As we grow, the details matter — and this role is all about getting them right.

As our People Operations Coordinator, you'll be the engine behind our day-to-day People Ops work. You'll run onboarding every week, keep our systems and data accurate and up to date, and make sure employees always have clear, reliable resources to turn to. This is a role for someone who takes pride in execution, loves bringing order to complexity, and genuinely cares about making every experience smooth and consistent.

Lead Onboarding

 - Execute a smooth, consistent onboarding experience for every new hire — coordinating logistics, sending communications, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks

 - Partner with IT, Recruiting, and People Experience to ensure new hires are set up and ready to go on day one

 - Track and follow up on onboarding tasks, keeping the process moving even when things get busy

 - Maintain data integrity across our HR tech stack, catching discrepancies before they become problems

 - Support offboarding by ensuring all system access and records are properly updated

 - Build and maintain workflows and automations in Rippling and across our other tools

 - Use tools to speed up everyday work, like drafting communications, answering common questions, and keeping documentation current

 - Be the first point of contact for all questions that come our way, giving answers or directing someone to the right spot

 - Maintain and update our internal People Ops documentation (policies, guides, and FAQs) so they're always accurate and easy to find

 - Keep our employee self-service resources current and accessible, helping employees find the answers they need

 - Partner with the broader People team to document new processes as we build them

Support the People Ops Team

 - Help with day-to-day People Ops tasks and projects as the team and company grow

 - Support compliance tracking and reporting as needed

What You'll Bring

Experience & Expertise

 - 1–3 years in People Operations, HR, or a related coordination role

 - Hands-on experience with Rippling or a similar HRIS platform (Rippling strongly preferred)

 - Experience building workflows or automations (Rippling workflows, Zapier, Slack workflows, or similar)

 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and the details really matter

Core Competencies

 - Exceptional attention to detail: you notice when something's off and fix it before anyone else does

 - Strong ownership: you take your work seriously, follow through, and don't let things fall through the cracks

 - Warm, people-first approach: you genuinely care about the employee experience and it shows.

 - Genuine kindness and compassion: you care about the employee experience and it shows.

 - Builder mindset: you're excited about automation, you pick up new tools quickly, and you're always thinking of a better way to do something

 - Highly organized: you juggle multiple tasks and deadlines without dropping the ball

 - Outstanding communication: your written and verbal communication is clear, warm, and easy to follow

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

As an Offensive Security Engineer on the Application Security team within Security, you'll pioneer how Coinbase uses frontier AI models to scale vulnerability discovery, red team AI systems, and automate security workflows. This role bridges traditional penetration testing with next-generation AI-augmented offensive security, directly accelerating our ability to protect products and customers. You'll own the development of AI-driven security tooling and collaborate across Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security, and Incident Response to fundamentally shift how we operate.

What you'll do:

• Build, deploy, and maintain custom security scanners that leverage frontier models to detect vulnerabilities at scale across Coinbase's product surface.

• Lead red teaming efforts against internal AI systems, including jailbreak testing, prompt injection analysis, and tool abuse simulation.

• Develop AI-driven automation for vulnerability triage, validation, and remediation workflows to accelerate the bug bounty and vulnerability response pipelines.

• Partner with engineering teams to prioritize, remediate, and verify fixes for critical vulnerabilities discovered through AI-augmented and manual testing.

• Mentor junior security engineers on integrating AI into offensive security workflows to scale team capabilities.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 3+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or offensive security with demonstrated ability to build custom security tooling.

• Hands-on experience using LLMs or frontier models to automate security tasks, scale vulnerability research, or build security scanners.

• Demonstrated experience red teaming AI-based systems (prompt injection, jailbreak testing, tool abuse).

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT HYPERBOUND

Sales runs on conversations. At Hyperbound, we’re building the AI Agent that turns those conversations into action, helping sales teams sharpen their skills, make better decisions, and move deals forward.

Hyperbound is the Revenue Activation Platform: an agentic OS for sales that connects what happens to what should happen next.

We came out of YC S23 and went viral with Voice Agents that reps could call to put their skills to the test. Today, we’re building AI that understands sales conversations, coaches in real time, reasons across deals, and takes action to move them forward.

We are trusted by companies like LinkedIn, Amazon, Intel, Notion, and Vanta. We raised a $15M Series A in October 2025, grew ARR 5× over the past year, and are growing nearly 20% month over month.


THE TEAM YOU'LL BUILD WITH

We’re assembling a team of builders and operators who do their best work together. You’ll work alongside former founders, founding engineers, and people who care deeply about the problems we're solving.

We work with high trust and real autonomy. You'll have the context to make decisions, the freedom to choose your approach, and the responsibility to deliver great work. We move quickly, challenge each other's thinking, and believe the best ideas come from people who aren't afraid to build something new.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring Product Managers to rethink how AI-native products are built. You'll work directly with customers, turn ambitious ideas into working software in days rather than months, and validate what deserves to become a real product. This is a hands-on role for former engineers who love building, have strong product instincts, and want to challenge the traditional product development process.


WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

 - Engineering background: You've worked as a software engineer and have the technical skills to independently build functional applications, from frontend interfaces to backend integrations.

 - AI-native builder: You're highly proficient with tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or similar, and use AI to dramatically accelerate how you prototype, experiment, and ship software.

 - Customer obsession: You love talking to customers, digging into their workflows, asking thoughtful questions, and uncovering problems they might not know how to articulate.

 - Strong product judgment: You can turn ambiguous problems into compelling product experiences, distinguish interesting ideas from valuable opportunities, and know what to build, iterate on, or kill.

 - Bias toward action: You're comfortable operating with little structure, moving incredibly quickly, and putting imperfect but functional software in customers' hands to learn what actually matters.


HIGHLY PREFERRED

 - Experience building zero-to-one products, whether as a founder, early-stage engineer, or technical product leader.

 - Experience building AI-powered applications, including LLM integrations, agents, and novel human-AI interfaces.


WHAT YOUR REGULAR THURSDAY LOOKS LIKE:

 - You're on a call with a customer, digging into a frustrating part of their sales workflow and identifying an opportunity for something entirely new.

 - You're using Claude Code or Cursor to turn yesterday's idea into a working prototype, making product and technical decisions yourself rather than writing a spec for someone else.

 - You're putting that prototype in front of customers, watching how they interact with it, asking questions, and making changes in real time based on their feedback.

 - You're sharing what you've learned with our founders and engineering team, making the case for what we should build, what we should abandon, and which experiments could become our next big product.


WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - A traditional PM role. You won't spend your days writing PRDs, managing backlogs, or coordinating sprint ceremonies. We expect you to build, not just specify.

 - A production engineering role. Your job is to explore, prototype, and validate new ideas. Our engineering team will take proven concepts and build them into scalable, enterprise-grade products.

 - A role for someone who needs a roadmap. You'll be expected to find opportunities, challenge assumptions, and create momentum without waiting for detailed direction.


INTERVIEW PLAN

 - Intro call with our recruiter James (30 min)

 - Conversation with Atul, CTO and Co Founder (30 min)

 - Take home technical exercise (60-90 min)

 - Take home exercise review call (45 min)

 - Final onsite with Co Founders and Eng leads (60 min)

We move fast, from first conversation to decision in 1-2 weeks.


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - $200,000-$225,000 + equity package

 - Medical, dental, and vision

 - Commuter benefits

 - Lunch and dinner in the office

 - Unlimited PTO

 - 401k and HSA options


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Hyperbound is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you need accommodations during the interview process, let us know and we'll make it work.

jobs.title: Operations Lead (Full-Time) - La Encantada
jobs.description:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

The Operations Lead is a member of the store leadership team and is responsible for driving and coaching to profitability and efficiency. The Operations Lead will work closely with Operations & Visual Managers in initiating, delegating work, and providing feedback to the team to achieve optimal results supporting total store operations. Duties require constant movement in and around the store, including the sales floor and back of house. When not actively assisting guests, this position takes initiative to perform other tasks, as needed, to keep store clean, safe, inviting and operating efficiently.

Business Leader

JUST SOME OF THE PERKS

jobs.title: Patient Billing Support Supervisor
jobs.description:
Who we are

Midi Health is the only comprehensive virtual care clinic for women in midlife navigating perimenopause, menopause, and other common midlife health challenges. Our platform provides care designed by experts, scaled by technology, and delivered by trained and compassionate clinicians.

We accept most major PPO insurance products, and we offer convenient access to clinical care through telehealth visits, 24/7 messaging, and responsible prescribing of medications, supplements, and other therapies. We are an entirely virtual company, so employees can live anywhere in the United States.

The opportunity

We are seeking a proactive, coaching-driven Patient Billing Support Supervisor (Internal Title: PSR-R Supervisor) to build and lead a new team of Patient Service Representative - Revenue (PSR-R’s). In this impactful leadership role, you will manage daily queue traffic, provide real-time oversight, and deliver quality coaching, while serving as the accountable bridge between Patient Experience and Revenue Cycle. You understand billing and insurance, you lead with empathy, and you are energized by building people up and fixing systems. If making a confusing bill feel clear sounds like your kind of challenge, this is the role for you.

This job is “HOT”: 🔥

Operational Oversight & Traffic Management

• Own daily traffic management so the right specialists are on the right workflows (Zendesk billing queues, Clinician Hub billing questions, and inbound billing calls) at the right times.

• Actively monitor real-time queues and coordinate live adjustments in team responsibilities to meet SLAs.

• Maintain a clear understanding of team capacity and ticket distribution, and partner with workforce planning on staffing and schedules.

• Manage coverage, PTO, and handoffs so patients keep a named owner at each step.

Coaching, QA & Performance Feedback

• Deliver weekly 1:1 coaching with a focus on accuracy, communication, and efficiency.

• Perform daily and weekly QA reviews of tickets and calls, and provide actionable, empathetic feedback.

• Partner closely with the Complex Patient Experience Manager to surface performance trends, and manage performance concerns and improvement plans in partnership with the People Team.

• Set and hold the documentation standard: what happened, who was involved, the next step, the owner, and the due date.

Team Leadership & Support

• Serve as the first point of escalation for day-to-day team questions, and the first stop for complex, stalled, or high-emotion billing cases, including patient calls.

• Hire, onboard, and train a team of 6 growing to 8 Patient Billing Specialists, and support peer mentoring for new team members.

• Run a weekly team meeting with an agenda, shared topics, and notes sent the same day.

• Build trust and rapport with your team and drive a culture of ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

Escalation Gatekeeping & Cross-Functional Partnership

• Review and approve escalations before Revenue Cycle is tagged, so cases arrive investigated, with EOB review, carrier call notes, and denial reasons attached.

• Enforce the escalation protocol with partner teams, including PSR and PSR-B, and manage the billing Slack channel.

• Serve as the primary liaison with Revenue Cycle, Eligibility, Patient Experience, Finance, and Product on billing support matters.

• Work with Finance on adjustment thresholds and the write-off policy, and approve adjustments above specialist authority within your limits.

• Apply the Complaint Management process and appeasement matrix for billing-related complaints, and recognize compliance flags that need escalation.

• Protect the team’s charter as a dedicated billing support function.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

• Co-own SOPs, training curriculum, and QA rubrics with Revenue Cycle and Customer Support Operations, and keep documentation current as processes change.

• Share frontline insights with leadership, Revenue Cycle, and Product, such as denial drivers, network status errors, and statement confusion.

• Deliver weekly reporting on team and individual performance, and lead the 30, 60, and 90-day post-launch reviews.

• Foster a feedback-forward environment that emphasizes learning and growth.

Business impact: not just surviving but thriving 📈

• Identify and implement workflow improvements that raise first-contact resolution and reduce repeat contacts and avoidable escalations.

• Make sure specialists have the tools, context, and clarity to do their best work.

• Balance empathy and accountability in a high-paced, high-impact environment, and free Revenue Cycle capacity for revenue recovery.

What you will need to succeed: 🌱

• Revenue cycle experience (required): 3+ years in revenue cycle, patient billing, or healthcare accounts receivable, with working knowledge of EOBs, denials, coordination of benefits, payment plans, and patient responsibility.

• 2+ years of experience in a team lead, QA, or training capacity. First-time supervisors with a strong track record are welcome, and current Midi Revenue Cycle and Billing team members are encouraged to apply.

• Experience with Zendesk, Athena, and Google Workspace.

• Proven ability to manage workload distribution and prioritize tasks in a dynamic setting.

• Strong communication and coaching skills, with a track record of helping others grow and de-escalating frustrated patients.

• Data literacy: you turn KPIs and QA themes into coaching and process change.

• High attention to detail, a commitment to operational excellence, and sound judgment with PHI and HIPAA.

• Nice to have: telehealth or women’s health billing, experience building SOPs and training, and comfort with AI-assisted support tools.

What we offer

• The chance to build a team from the ground up and shape how patients experience billing.

• 100% remote, with comprehensive health benefits (medical and dental), paid time off, and paid holidays.

• Leadership development support, because growing supervisors is a priority in our CX organization.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager (Founder's Associate)
jobs.description:
Business Operations Manager (Founder's Associate)

Backpack Healthcare | Remote (U.S.-Based) | Full-Time

Compensation: $72,500 annually + Benefits

About Backpack Healthcare

Backpack Healthcare is a venture-backed, Medicaid-first behavioral health company bringing pediatric and whole-family care to the communities that need it most. We partner with schools, health plans, and health systems across Maryland, Virginia, Georgia, Michigan, Illinois, and Kansas.

With 219 employees, more than 170 clinicians, and over 100 payer relationships, Backpack Healthcare is growing rapidly and expanding access to meaningful behavioral healthcare.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful Founder's Associate to work directly alongside our Founder and CEO. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious early-career professional who wants firsthand exposure to how a high-growth healthcare company operates, scales, and makes strategic decisions.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted partner to the CEO, helping manage day-to-day priorities, executive communications, scheduling, travel, and special projects. You will also have opportunities to contribute to research, data analysis, board and investor materials, and cross-functional initiatives as you grow in the position.

This is a hands-on role that requires exceptional attention to detail, sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment. No two days will look the same. You should be comfortable anticipating needs, solving problems independently, and keeping multiple priorities moving without losing sight of the details.

This position begins as a three-month temp-to-perm engagement, with the opportunity to transition into a permanent, full-time role based on performance and overall fit.

What You'll Do

Executive Support & Administration

• Manage the CEO's calendar, inbox, meeting schedules, and daily priorities.

• Coordinate meetings, resolve scheduling conflicts, and prepare agendas and materials in advance.

• Draft executive communications, internal announcements, and responses for the CEO's review.

• Maintain organized Google Drive folders, executive documents, board materials, and communication channels.

• Manage executive expenses, receipts, vendor invoices, and expense submissions to ensure timely reconciliation.

• Prepare daily summaries outlining upcoming meetings, outstanding priorities, and items requiring attention.

Executive & Group Travel Management

• Coordinate end-to-end travel arrangements, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, restaurant reservations, and event registrations.

• Organize group travel for company offsites, leadership retreats, conferences, and team events.

• Negotiate hotel blocks, group rates, and venue packages.

• Monitor travel disruptions and proactively coordinate alternative arrangements when needed.

• Maintain travel itineraries, booking preferences, and a company-wide tracker of travel and event expenses.

• Partner with Finance to review contracts, manage travel budgets, reconcile expenses, and ensure timely submission of receipts.

Meetings & Cross-Functional Coordination

• Attend key meetings, capture notes, and document decisions, owners, and deadlines.

• Track action items and follow up with team members to ensure timely completion.

• Coordinate with department leaders across Finance, Operations, Clinical, Technology, HR, and Growth.

• Maintain project trackers and provide follow-through on CEO-led initiatives.

• Ensure open questions and outstanding requests are communicated and resolved.

Research, Data & Strategic Projects

• Develop familiarity with company KPIs, dashboards, and reporting systems to quickly retrieve business information.

• Assist with preparing presentations, board materials, and investor updates.

• Conduct research on companies, industry topics, and individuals ahead of executive meetings.

• Support special projects and operational initiatives as assigned.

• Develop simple SOPs, templates, and processes to improve efficiency and organization.

Events & Special Projects

• Support the planning and coordination of leadership retreats, company offsites, board dinners, and business events.

• Coordinate venues, reservations, registrations, and event logistics.

• Take ownership of special projects with increasing responsibility as you grow within the role.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• 1–3 years of experience in an administrative, operations, coordinator, or associate role, preferably within a startup or fast-paced organization.

• Demonstrated experience managing executive calendars, travel arrangements, and administrative responsibilities.

• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft professional communications for executive audiences.

• Experience coordinating travel logistics, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, and group arrangements.

• Experience negotiating hotel blocks, group rates, or venue packages.

• Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, and budget tracking.

• Familiarity with Google Workspace, presentation tools, spreadsheets, and project management platforms.

• Experience managing expenses, receipts, and travel budgets.

• Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude to support research, drafting, summarization, and organization.

• Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

• Ability to receive feedback, adapt quickly, and take ownership of responsibilities.

The Qualities That Will Help You Succeed

• Highly proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented.

• Able to anticipate needs and address potential challenges before they become problems.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change throughout the day.

• Calm under pressure and capable of making sound decisions in real time.

• Strong follow-through and accountability, with a commitment to closing the loop on every task.

• Comfortable communicating with senior leaders, external partners, vendors, and investors.

• Curious about business operations, healthcare, and the inner workings of a growing company.

Preferred Qualifications

• Interest or experience in healthcare, behavioral health, or venture-backed startups.

• Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or executive leadership team.

• Experience with travel booking platforms, expense management systems, or event coordination.

• Familiarity with dashboards, reporting, and basic data analysis.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

• Healthcare or HIPAA-regulated environment experience.

• Professional certifications in administration, corporate travel, or meeting and event planning.

• Notary Public commission.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position means becoming a dependable and trusted partner to the CEO while helping improve the efficiency of executive operations.

Within your first 90 days, you will:

• Establish reliable systems for managing the CEO's calendar, inbox, travel, and daily priorities.

• Ensure executive communications are triaged and addressed within one business day.

• Maintain accurate expense documentation and ensure receipts are submitted before month-end close.

• Become familiar with company KPIs and contribute to research and executive presentations.

• Take ownership of at least one project from start to finish.

• Successfully coordinate travel and collaborate with Finance on budget tracking and reconciliation.

Position Details

• Employment Type: Full-time opportunity beginning with a three-month temp-to-perm engagement.

• Location: Remote (U.S.-based).

• Schedule: Must be available during Eastern Time business hours.

• Travel: Occasional travel for company offsites and events.

• Reports To: Founder and CEO.

• Compensation: $72,500 starting annual rate, plus benefits.

• Permanent Conversion: Based on performance and overall fit following the initial three-month engagement.

Why Join Backpack Healthcare?

This is an opportunity to work directly with a founder and gain meaningful exposure to executive leadership, business strategy, financial operations, and organizational growth.

You will have the opportunity to make an immediate impact, take ownership of important initiatives, and develop your skills alongside a growing team committed to expanding access to behavioral healthcare.

If you are someone who thrives on organization, enjoys solving problems, and wants to be part of building something meaningful, we would love to hear from you.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a resume along with a few sentences explaining why they are interested in working directly alongside a founder.

Finalists will participate in a short practical exercise that may include organizing a sample executive calendar and travel itinerary, reviewing and summarizing emails, planning a group trip within a designated budget, or drafting an executive response.

Backpack Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Motion Designer, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

Position Overview:
As a Senior Motion Designer at Fanatics Sportsbook, you will play a pivotal role in conceptualizing and executing high-quality motion graphics and social-first video content that resonates with our target audiences. This role will primarily work within our performance marketing environment, creating assets built to drive acquisition, engagement, and conversion across paid channels. You will work closely with our creative and marketing teams to develop compelling visual narratives, animations, and effects that elevate our brand and messaging, built for how people actually watch: fast, scrolling, and often with the sound off.

Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with the creative and performance marketing teams to conceptualize and storyboard motion graphics projects.

• Design for performance: strong hooks in the first few seconds, sound-off storytelling, captions, and clear offer and CTA end cards, delivered across 9:16, 4:5, 1:1, and 16:9.

• Cut UGC, creator, and live-action footage into short-form ads, adding captions, music, sound design, and platform-native elements, and optimizing lengths and formats for each channel.

• Animate in-app UI screens and product flows to show features and offers clearly.

• Design and animate engaging motion graphics for paid social, websites, and other digital platforms.

• Produce high-volume creative, including variations and iterations for testing, and apply learnings from performance data to improve results.

• Create title sequences, transitions, and other graphical elements for videos and multimedia projects.

• Incorporate internal feedback and iterate on designs to meet project objectives.

• Stay up to date with trends and best practices in motion design, social video, animation, and generative AI tools.

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining high-quality standards.

About the Positions

We’re seeking Contracts and Claims Specialists of various skill levels to support large, complex heavy civil infrastructure programs, including highways, roads, bridges, transit (bus and rail), aviation (international airports), and water/wastewater projects delivered through both traditional and alternative delivery methods. These are construction claims and disputes roles, meaning contract claims rather than insurance adjusting. You’ll evaluate claims and requests for equitable adjustment for entitlement and quantum, test claimed cost and time against the contract and the contemporaneous record, and develop a position that holds up in negotiation, in front of a dispute review board, and in whatever comes after that. Contract administration is part of the job, but the center of it is what happens when the parties stop agreeing.

This post is for future roles and not for a specific opportunity that is available right now. We accept applications and conduct interviews in advance of upcoming hiring needs. When a candidate is selected, their profile is activated in our talent pool for this specialty area. We notify our talent pool candidates first whenever we have a project need.

• Analyze claims and notices of potential claim and lost productivity, and evaluate entitlement against the contract provisions that govern each one.

• Evaluate requests for equitable adjustment and disputed change proposals for entitlement, merit, and cost reasonableness, and recommend a position supported by the record.

• Review claimed costs, including labor, equipment, materials, extended field and home office overhead, and markup, against contract provisions, force account records, and submitted cost backup.

• Identify unsupported, duplicated, or misclassified amounts.

• Coordinate with scheduling staff to evaluate time impact analyses and time extension requests against the accepted baseline and the contemporaneous progress schedules.

• Prepare claim position papers, findings of fact, and recommendations for program decision-makers, dispute review boards, and mediation or arbitration panels.

• Support negotiation and settlement of disputed changes and claims by developing entitlement and quantum summaries, cost comparisons, and a documented basis of settlement.

• Evaluate claims arising in active operating environments, including restricted service windows, access limits, and facility shutdowns.

• Coordinate with counsel, claims consultants, project controls, and finance staff on claim strategy, document production, and responses to formal demands.

• Track open claims and disputed exposure by contract for program leadership.

As a Product Manager I you will be a fully independent product managemer. You will serve as the product owner for a delivery team backlog and owns outcomes for a bounded feature, capability, or product area. You will lead discovery for their area, prioritize the backlog, make day-to-day product tradeoff decisions, and track whether the work succeeds.  This role works with a lead Product Manager, manager, or senior product leader to contribute recommendations and information product strategy. The Product Manager I is trusted to operate independently within a defined scope and is expected to ground recommendations in customer insight, product objectives, and measurable outcomes.

These positions own the integrity of the project record: which revision is current, who holds it, where it lives, and whether it will still stand up when someone pulls it years from now. Luster’s quality management system is ISO 9001:2015 certified, so controlled document practice on our programs is a standard we are audited against rather than a preference.

Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

About the Role:

Crusoe Cloud seeks a highly skilled and experienced Staff Software Engineer to lead the development and execution of our cutting-edge Software Defined Networking strategy. You will play a pivotal role in driving innovation and performance improvements within our network infrastructure by leveraging advanced technologies such as XDP/EBPF, DPDK, SmartNICs, and DPUs/IPUs.

 - Deep expertise in network accelerators such as Mellanox/NVIDIA SmartNICs (ConnectX-6/7), DPU BlueField-3, or Intel IPU.

jobs.title: Retail Trade Account Executive (full-time)
jobs.description:
About Ernesta

Ernesta is on a mission to bring gorgeous, design-focused custom rugs to homes and places of gathering through an enjoyable, frictionless, and affordable experience. At the same price as a store-bought standard-sized rug, a custom-cut rug from Ernesta will not only be a better fit, but also a better buying experience. We believe that high-quality custom design shouldn't be out of reach for consumers and aim to address this need in the multi-billion-dollar global rug industry.

Driven by our collective mission, our team is hungry, hardworking, and highly ambitious. We’re problem solvers, innovators, design enthusiasts, and executors. We are relentlessly focused on creating and delivering beautiful and delightfully simple solutions and experiences for our customers. Together, we are excited and humbled by the opportunity to expand the market for custom rugs and allow more people to live in elevated design settings. Put simply, we believe more soft surfaces mean happier homes.

About the Role

Ernesta is looking for an experienced Retail Trade Account Executive to join our Retail team. This role will report to the Showroom Leader and be responsible for building and growing Ernesta’s trade business within the local design community.

At Ernesta, we believe long-term partnerships are more valuable than one-time sales. As a Retail Trade Account Executive, you will own and nurture relationships with interior designers, architects, and other trade partners—becoming a trusted resource for their projects and helping them incorporate Ernesta into their work.

You will be equally focused on growing existing relationships and creating new ones, proactively developing a pipeline of trade business through thoughtful outreach, exceptional service, and consistent follow-through. You will build relationships both inside and outside of the showroom, spending approximately 20–30% of your month in the local trade community through firm and office visits, Lunch & Learns, industry events, networking, and other relationship-building opportunities.

This is an entrepreneurial sales role for someone who is energized by building a book of business, passionate about design, highly organized, and motivated by results. You will work closely with the Showroom Leader and Design Assistants to ensure our trade partners receive a best-in-class Ernesta experience from initial introduction through project completion and beyond.

What You’ll Do

• Build and grow Ernesta’s local trade business by developing meaningful, long-term relationships with interior designers, architects, and other trade partners.

• Own a portfolio of trade accounts and proactively develop those relationships to drive repeat projects, retention, and revenue growth.

• Identify, prospect, and acquire new trade accounts within the local design community through targeted outreach, referrals, networking, and community engagement.

• Activate new trade accounts by understanding their business, introducing them to Ernesta’s products and services, and identifying opportunities to support active and future projects.

• Business Development:

• Spend approximately 20–30% of your month externally meeting with the trade community through designer and firm office visits, Lunch & Learns, industry events, networking opportunities, and other relationship-building activities.

• Develop a strong understanding of each trade partner’s business, aesthetic, project pipeline, and needs to provide relevant and personalized support.

• Deliver exceptional product and design expertise across materials, construction, sizing, styling, custom services, and the Ernesta assortment.

• Provide an elevated, consultative sales experience rooted in listening deeply and recommending solutions tailored to each project.

• Maintain consistent and thoughtful follow-up across sample orders, open quotes, active projects, and previously engaged accounts.

• Maintain an organized and actionable account pipeline, including clear next steps, project timelines, relationship activity, and opportunities for growth.

• Partnerships within Retail and HQ:

• Partner with Design Assistants and the Showroom Leader to deliver a seamless experience when trade partners bring clients or projects into the showroom.

• Host and support showroom events that strengthen Ernesta’s presence within the local design community.

• Share feedback from the trade community with internal partners to help improve our products, services, tools, and overall trade experience.

• Track performance and maintain accountability to goals across trade revenue, new account acquisition, account activation, pipeline development, retention, and relationship growth.

• Represent Ernesta externally with professionalism, integrity, enthusiasm, and a genuine passion for design.

What Success Looks Like

• You develop trusted relationships with trade partners who increasingly turn to Ernesta as a resource for their projects.

• You consistently grow revenue from your portfolio through repeat business and deeper account relationships.

• You proactively build the business by creating new relationships rather than relying solely on inbound showroom traffic.

• New trade accounts become active customers with meaningful project pipelines and repeat purchasing behavior.

• You maintain a healthy and well-managed pipeline with clear visibility into opportunities, next steps, and expected timing.

• You are known within the local design community as a knowledgeable, responsive, and reliable partner.

• You work collaboratively with the showroom team while taking personal ownership of your accounts and results.

• You consistently demonstrate Ernesta’s values of customer centricity, integrity, passion for design, collaboration, growth mindset, and reliability.

Qualifications Include

• 1–2+ years of relevant experience within interior design, home furnishings, architecture and design sales, trade sales, account management, or a related design-focused industry.

• Demonstrated ability to build strong professional relationships and develop trust with clients or accounts over time.

• Passion for interior design, home décor, architecture, and the broader design community.

• Entrepreneurial and self-motivated, with the drive to proactively create new business opportunities and grow a book of business.

• Commercially minded and motivated by achieving sales and relationship-growth goals.

• Highly organized with strong time management skills and disciplined follow-through.

• Comfortable prospecting, initiating new relationships, and engaging people you have not previously worked with.

• Confident communicating and presenting one-on-one and to groups, including designers, architects, and design firms.

• Curious and consultative, with the ability to listen deeply, understand project needs, and recommend thoughtful solutions.

• Solutions-oriented with sound judgment, business sense, high integrity, and a willingness to take ownership.

• Comfortable managing multiple accounts, projects, quotes, samples, and follow-up timelines simultaneously.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills across in-person, phone, email, text, and video interactions.

• High level of comfort working across digital tools and systems used to manage customer relationships, communication, and sales activity.

• Ability and willingness to travel locally for trade meetings, office visits, Lunch & Learns, and industry events.

• Ability to work a flexible retail schedule as needed, including occasional evenings, weekends, or events based on the needs of the business and local trade community.

Nice to Have

• Existing relationships within the local interior design, architecture, or home furnishings community.

• Experience working in a high-end or design-focused showroom environment.

• Experience managing a portfolio or book of trade, designer, or professional accounts.

• Experience with custom products, textiles, rugs, furniture, or other home furnishings.

• Experience with design tools, spatial planning, or custom measurement processes.

• BA or experience working in a creative field such as interior design, architecture, art history, or a related discipline.

Ernesta is committed to inclusion. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array and parabolic ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role

Northwood Space is looking for a backend-focused Senior Engineer to join our Software team and lead the development of the platform that makes our global antenna fleet operate as one network. You will design and build the services behind scheduling, customer booking, resource allocation, billing and data delivery, spanning our cloud platform and remote ground stations.

Our software operates in a network shaped by physics. Satellites move in and out of view. Weather, interference, pointing accuracy and equipment health change what each link can deliver. Scheduling and failover decisions must account for those conditions while meeting customer requirements for throughput, reliability and where their data is allowed to travel.

You will set technical direction, write production software and lead work across teams to build toward adaptive scheduling, predictive maintenance and autonomous recovery. That starts with dependable distributed services, clear APIs and telemetry that connects network behavior to customer outcomes. As those foundations mature, you will help integrate models and AI where they measurably improve diagnosis, planning and recovery. Our goal is to grow network capacity much faster than the human effort required to operate it.



Responsibilities

 - Scheduling and resource allocation: Design and develop our global antenna scheduling system, allocating sites, antennas, modems and network capacity around spacecraft visibility, customer priorities and service commitments. Evolve it to account for predicted link performance and equipment health.

 - Customer APIs and service provisioning: Build secure, scalable interfaces for booking, real-time communications, Telemetry, Tracking, and Control (TT&C), and payload data transfer. Work directly with customers to keep complex capabilities simple to consume and extend.

 - Control and data planes: Design services that coordinate antenna operations and data delivery across cloud and on-premises environments. Build predictable behavior through retries, partial failures, configuration changes and intermittent connectivity.

 - Resilient routing and failover: Partner with network operations on traffic steering, SD-WAN integration and recovery across antennas, sites and network paths. Make these decisions respect visibility, capacity, customer SLAs and data-sovereignty requirements.

 - Observability and autonomous recovery: Connect cloud, site and RF telemetry to individual contacts so we can diagnose failures and verify customer delivery. Build the data pipelines and orchestration needed for predictive maintenance, calibration and model-assisted recovery, with clear visibility and controls for operators.

 - Production reliability: Own the performance, security and reliability of the services you build. Define meaningful service-level objectives, investigate production issues and validate changes through automated testing, simulation and staged deployments.

 - Technical leadership: Lead architecture and design reviews, mentor engineers and turn ambiguous requirements into deliverable work. Collaborate with customers, network operations, hardware teams and the broader software organization to build a resilient global network.

An example of the problems you’ll help solve

An antenna starts losing receive performance even though its software is healthy and it still completes some contacts. Is the cause weather, pointing error, calibration drift, interference, a failing component or the spacecraft itself? Which upcoming contacts are at risk? Should the network recalibrate, allocate more aperture, move a contact to another compatible site with visibility, or schedule a repair? Any action must account for other customer commitments and routing policies. The system then needs to verify that performance and customer delivery recovered, and use that outcome to improve the next decision.



Basic Qualifications

 - 5+ years of professional software development experience

 - 3+ years building and scaling cloud-based services and APIs in production environments

 - Experience with distributed scheduling systems, resource allocation, or booking platforms

 - Proficiency in modern cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)



Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with Rust, Go, or other languages suitable for cloud services and distributed systems

 - Experience building global-scale customer-facing platforms with high reliability requirements

 - Knowledge of API design, authentication, and access control best practices

 - Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues, and telemetry or streaming data pipelines

 - Familiarity with billing systems, usage tracking, or subscription management

 - Understanding of simulation and modeling, including satellite propagation, constraint optimization or resource scheduling

 - Experience with Kubernetes, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines

 - Experience with network orchestration, policy-aware routing, or failover across distributed infrastructure

 - Experience applying forecasting, anomaly detection, or ML models to production systems and evaluating their operational impact

 - Experience leading technical work across teams, mentoring engineers and owning systems through deployment and operation

 - Knowledge of satellite communications or relevant domain experience (beneficial but not required)



We value depth in a few of these areas. Prior space-industry or machine-learning experience is not required.



 



Additional Information:



To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

About the Positions

We’re seeking Change Managers to support large, complex heavy civil infrastructure programs, including highways, roads, bridges, transit (bus and rail), aviation (international airports), and water/wastewater projects delivered through both traditional and alternative delivery methods. You’ll support the change control process, develop the independent analysis that tests submitted entitlement, cost, and time, keep the scope, cost, schedule, and technical baselines accurate and traceable, and give program leadership a defensible position before money moves, on assignments ranging from a single contract package to a program-level change function.

This post is for future roles and not for a specific opportunity that is available right now. We accept applications and conduct interviews in advance of upcoming hiring needs. When a candidate is selected, their profile is activated in our talent pool for this specialty area. We notify our talent pool candidates first whenever we have a project need.

Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:

Note: We are seeking candidates of various skill levels, and the following responsibilities represent the core of these roles. Scope and complexity increase with experience level.

• Support the program’s change control process from early identification through entitlement determination, pricing, negotiation, and executed change order.

• Track every change notice and open change item in the log to a documented decision within the timeframes the contract allows.

• Evaluate change proposals, requests for equitable adjustment, and claims for contractual entitlement, and recommend a position supported by the contract language and the factual record.

• Develop and review independent cost estimates and time impact analyses that test contractor-submitted pricing and delay claims rather than accepting the submitted numbers.

• Coordinate with the estimators, schedulers, and analysts supporting change evaluation, and apply a consistent approach to how changes are analyzed, priced, and documented.

• Prepare change board packages that carry the recommendation, the independent analysis, the funding source, and the consequence of not acting, and present them to program decision-makers.

• Process approved change orders through the contract, and confirm each one is reflected in the contract value, the baseline schedule, the budget, and the affected drawings and specifications.

• Coordinate change evaluation with the program’s engineering, inspection, right of way, and operations groups.

• Evaluate impacts to active operations and existing facilities before a change is approved.

• Analyze differing site conditions, design changes, and third-party-driven changes on bridges, underground work, and systems, and separate what the contract already covers from what it does not.

• Report change trends, open change exposure, and pending time extensions to executive program leadership so cost and schedule risk is visible before it lands.

• Experience evaluating change proposals, requests for equitable adjustment, or claims for entitlement, cost, and schedule impact, and recommending a position to the owner.

• Experience developing or reviewing independent cost estimates and time impact analyses that test contractor-submitted pricing and delay claims.

• Experience preparing change board or governance packages and presenting recommendations to owner decision-makers.

Preferred Qualifications

• Active professional certifications such as CCM (CMAA), PMP (PMI), and/or CCP or CFCC (AACE).

• Experience managing a program-level change control function across multiple contract packages, including supervising change analysts and standardizing how packages are evaluated.

• Experience negotiating individual change orders exceeding $10M in value.

• Experience leading the owner’s position on a claim through a dispute resolution board, mediation, or a formal claims process.

• Experience analyzing delay and schedule impact on a CPM schedule, including concurrency and the difference between excusable and compensable delay.

About the team

Customer Education helps enterprises develop the capabilities their workforce needs to use AI effectively, build and deploy AI solutions, and get more value from OpenAI’s products.
