jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager, Federal
jobs.description:
ABOUT HANDSHAKE

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

Why join Handshake now:

 - Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

 - Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions

 - Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

 - Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Strategic CSM on the Federal Accounts team, you are Handshake's most senior customer-facing partner, responsible for owning the full success lifecycle of our most complex government agency relationships. You will drive value realization, strategic alignment, and deep adoption across a focused book of high-stakes accounts, while navigating the unique procurement cycles, compliance requirements, and stakeholder hierarchies that define the federal space.



This is a role for someone who can command a room with a Chief Human Capital Officer and then turn around and troubleshoot a workflow with a recruiting coordinator, someone equally at home in a strategic vision conversation and a tactical problem-solving session. You will be a critical voice internally, too: translating federal agency needs into product and program insights that shape how Handshake serves the public sector.

 - Adoption & Expansion: Own onboarding, implementation, and ongoing adoption for large, complex government organizations, building tailored workflows and programs that map to each agency's mission, hiring priorities, and compliance requirements.

 - Federal Relationship Management: Build and maintain deep relationships across agency hierarchies, contracting officers, HR leads, program managers, and senior officials, and serve as a trusted, long-term partner across every level of the org.

 - Strategic Value Delivery: Lead Executive Business Reviews and strategic planning sessions that tie Handshake outcomes directly to agency hiring goals, diversity mandates, and workforce development priorities.

 - Expansion & New Business Lines: Identify and pursue opportunities to grow within accounts, new business units, additional budget owners, and adjacent agency teams, using a data-driven, outcome-first narrative.

 - Training & Enablement: Design and lead training for large, distributed government teams, making a complex platform accessible and valuable for users with varying levels of technical experience.

 - Cross-functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to advocate for federal customer needs, surface product gaps, and bring the right internal resources to every account.

 - Voice of the Federal Customer: Synthesize feedback from your portfolio into clear, actionable insights that help Handshake evolve its public sector strategy.

 


DESIRED CAPABILITIES

 - 5+ years managing large, high-touch enterprise or strategic accounts (typically 10–20 accounts) with $3M+ ARR responsibility.

 - Proven track record working with enterprise-level or federal customers, including navigating multi-stakeholder org charts, complex procurement processes, and long sales and renewal cycles.

 - Comfortable presenting to and building relationships with senior leaders and executive decision-makers, both virtually and in-person.

 - Ability to move fluidly between tactical conversations with end users and strategic discussions with agency leadership, without losing the thread of either.

 - Skilled at translating product workflows and usage data into compelling business value narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

 - Strong accountability muscle, you hold customers to milestones and timelines, and you hold yourself to the same standard.

 - Data-driven communicator who can build a story from metrics and make that story land with an executive audience.

 - Exceptional organizational and time management skills, you manage complexity across multiple stakeholders, timelines, and workstreams without dropping the ball.

 


EXTRA CREDIT

 - Direct experience working with federal agencies in a talent, HR tech, or workforce development context.

 - Familiarity with government procurement structures (e.g., contracting officers, option years, agency budget cycles).

 - A track record of building internal playbooks, processes, or frameworks that upleveled your team's approach.

 - A bias toward creative problem-solving in ambiguous, evolving environments.

 - A genuine passion for Handshake's mission, connecting students to opportunity, and excitement about expanding that mission into the public sector.

 


PERKS

Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life.

The below benefits are for full-time US employees.

🎯 Ownership: Equity in a fast-growing company

💰 Financial Wellness: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching

🍼 Family Support: Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching

💝 Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend

📚 Growth: $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development

💻 Remote & Office: Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office

🏝 Time Off: Flexible PTO, 15 holidays + 2 flex days

🤝 Connection: Team outings & referral bonuses

jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?



As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will lead the architecture, research, and productization of these next-generation ML systems, bridging deep research with deployment at scale and shaping the future of enterprise automation.

What You Will Do
• Define and drive technical strategy for agent-based automation, including how autonomous agents use LLMs, reinforcement learning, simulation environments, tool use, and multi-step reasoning to integrate with the UiPath platform.
• Architect, prototype, and deploy advanced ML and AI systems, covering LLM fine-tuning, multimodal pipelines, computer-use modeling, agent orchestration frameworks, and decision-making systems.
• Lead the design and implementation of ML infrastructure and services for model training, fine-tuning, large-scale inference, model serving, monitoring, drift detection, continuous learning loops, and ML operations for agentic systems.
• Partner closely with product, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to translate research advances into customer-facing capabilities.
• Research state-of-the-art techniques in prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, chain-of-thought, tool use, long-term memory, and RL or imitation learning for agent behavior, and apply them to automation workflows.
• Establish best practices, frameworks, and metrics for evaluating agentic systems, including offline evaluation, simulation environments, human-in-the-loop feedback, A/B testing, and cost, latency, and quality analysis.
• Serve as a technical leader and mentor across ML engineering, data science, and software engineering, fostering a culture of experimentation, reproducibility, versioning, and rigorous evaluation.
• Represent UiPath in the broader community through publications, open-source contributions, conference participation, and collaboration with academia or ecosystem partners.

What We Are Looking For
• Advanced degree (MS or PhD preferred) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• 6+ years of industry experience in machine learning, including substantial experience building and operating ML systems in production.
• Deep expertise in modern ML frameworks and libraries, strong proficiency in Python, and experience integrating ML models into large-scale software systems.
• Proven experience with large language models or foundation models, including fine-tuning, data preparation, inference optimization, or model evaluation.
• Experience with large datasets, distributed training or inference, scalable architecture design, and optimization for latency, throughput, and cost.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex ML concepts to product and business audiences.
• Demonstrated technical leadership in mentoring, influencing strategy, balancing research with delivery, and driving high-impact outcomes.

#LI-MH1

Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.

Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.

Role

As a Product Manager for Intrinsic’s Agentic Tooling, you will own the strategy, and execution of the AI tooling portfolio for acceleration of solutions with industrial robots. Your primary user is the Software Engineer (SWE). You will build an enterprise-grade cloud-managed SaaS platform powered by autonomous agents that guides these engineers through the complex journey of turning a raw robotics prototype into a fully productized, site-hardened, and deployed solution.

Your focus will be on operationalizing the enterprise pipeline. You will design agentic workflows that automate and de-risk the critical stages of the development lifecycle: from initial solution design and virtual validation, through physical hardening, reliability and performance optimization, to site-specific customization and deployment.. • Translate said strategy into a comprehensive development roadmap covering different steps of the robotics application lifecycle, pragmatically defining what user journeys should be automated with agents, co-assisted with agents, or maintained.

• Align requirements with enterprise software developer workflows, and partner with AI research and platform engineering teams for planning and execution.

Skills that will differentiate your candidacy

jobs.title: Thermal Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

Apex is seeking a Lead Thermal Engineer to drive the thermal design, analysis, and performance of our spacecraft and payload systems from concept through flight. In this role, you’ll serve as a technical leader for spacecraft thermal engineering, owning complex thermal challenges, establishing design strategies, and guiding critical engineering decisions across the vehicle. You’ll lead the development and validation of spacecraft-level thermal models, provide technical direction to thermal engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure mission success. This is a highly hands-on leadership role where you’ll balance technical ownership, mentorship, and execution, taking thermal systems from early design through integration, testing, launch, and on-orbit operations.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead the thermal design, analysis, and integration of spacecraft and payload systems from early concept and requirements definition through qualification, launch, and on-orbit operations.

 - Serve as the technical lead for thermal engineering efforts, providing guidance, mentorship, and technical oversight to engineers while driving best practices and design consistency across programs.

 - Own the thermal architecture and technical strategy for spacecraft and payload systems, driving key design decisions, trade studies, and risk mitigation efforts.

 - Act as the primary thermal technical interface with internal stakeholders and external customers, including requirements definition, interface development, design reviews, and resolution of complex thermal-related challenges.

 - Lead the development, maintenance, and validation of spacecraft- and payload-level thermal models using Ansys Thermal Desktop, ensuring accuracy across applicable mission environments.

 - Drive the development and implementation of advanced passive thermal control solutions, including high-performance heat transport and heat rejection technologies.

 - Lead the design and analysis of active thermal-fluid systems, including component sizing, system-level performance analysis, and integration with spacecraft thermal architectures.

 - Partner closely with mechanical, systems, avionics, GNC, and other engineering disciplines to ensure thermal requirements are incorporated into spacecraft design and successfully executed.

 - Own thermal engineering milestones, technical deliverables, and design reviews, including SRR, PDR, and CDR, ensuring program objectives, schedules, and technical requirements are met.

 - Provide technical leadership during thermal hardware development, integration, build, and test, including component- and spacecraft-level thermal vacuum testing.

 - Oversee thermal model correlation using test and flight data, driving improvements in model fidelity, thermal performance, and design methodologies.

 - Identify and resolve complex thermal engineering challenges, proactively managing technical risks and driving continuous improvement across thermal engineering processes and tools.


REQUIREMENTS

 - U.S. Person status is required as this position requires access to export-controlled data.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.

 - 8+ years of experience in thermal engineering, analysis, or thermal systems design, including demonstrated technical leadership or ownership of complex engineering projects.

 - Strong experience developing and validating thermal models using industry-standard thermal analysis tools.

 - Deep understanding of heat transfer, thermal control systems, and thermal engineering fundamentals.

 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical design decisions, manage engineering tradeoffs, and drive complex thermal systems from concept through validation.

 - Experience providing technical guidance, mentorship, or leadership to other engineers.

 - Strong cross-functional communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to drive technical execution in a fast-paced environment.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Extensive experience with spacecraft or aerospace thermal systems, including spacecraft-level thermal architecture and design.

 - Advanced proficiency with Ansys Thermal Desktop.

 - Experience leading thermal design and analysis efforts for spacecraft or payload programs through multiple phases of development.

 - Demonstrated experience designing and implementing spacecraft thermal control systems, including passive and active thermal management solutions.

 - Experience leading thermal vacuum test planning, execution, instrumentation, data acquisition, and model correlation.

 - Experience correlating thermal models with test or flight data.

 - Familiarity with spacecraft thermal margin standards, requirements development, and technical design reviews.

 - Working knowledge of two-phase thermal control systems and advanced heat transport technologies.

 - Experience mentoring engineers, establishing technical standards, and improving thermal engineering processes.

 - Experience with Siemens NX and Teamcenter.

jobs.title: Video and Photo Specialist

The Adorama Used & Trade division is the best kept secret in the professional photography and video production world. We’ve been buying and trading used photography, film/video, audio and lighting equipment since 1989. When customers are looking to upgrade their systems or trade them in for cash, they send their equipment to us! Our team of highly-trained professionals and technicians evaluate customers’ equipment accurately and we make it our mission to provide our clients with an honest and fair offer. We are proud of our high success rate and positive customer experience. We’ve since expanded our categories and have included popular items such as musical instruments, hi-fidelity audio as well as drones, gaming computers and virtual reality headsets - nothing is too big or too small!

Job Summary

We are on the lookout for our next Video and Photo Specialist to join our team! If you have a video, photo or general technical background, we’d like to hear from you! You would be joining a growing team of professionals in our rapidly expanding Adorama Used & Trade division. You'll help us ensure that all incoming video and photo equipment – used or open-box - is thoroughly inspected and all quality assurance standards are met. Daily tasks will include testing the functionality of the equipment and assessing imperfections. You'll also be researching product history, exploring current market used rates and writing copies using our powerful inventory management software.

• Inspect and operate video & photo camera and accessories, audio and lighting equipment to ensure functionality.

• Conduct quality control procedures and identify any imperfections with the equipment.

• Identify key missing parts.

• Assess like-new equipment for any defects and record results with accuracy in our proprietary inventory software.

• Prepare write-ups to be listed on our website and various e-marketplaces.

What you bring!

• Industry-relevant education and/or experience in film and video production is desired.

• Excellent communication and writing skills.

• Must possess a positive attitude and willingness to learn how to use and identify equipment.

• Must be detail-oriented, exhibit strong organizational skills, and demonstrate the ability to handle multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.

• Demonstrate curiosity in learning several types of video, photo, audio and lighting equipment

• Able to work independently on assigned tasks and accept direction on given assignments.

• Able to lift up to 50lbs worth of equipment throughout the workday.

$20.50—$20.50 USD

jobs.title: Associate, Project Controls
jobs.description:
What The Role Is

The Planning Analyst is responsible for the development, maintenance, and reporting of the project scheduling, the end-to-end project spend curve and liquidity forecasting process, and the coordination of SAP budget uploads and Ad hoc procurement project reporting across Clearway's development portfolio. This position is responsible for automating and optimizing the scheduling process and communication. Reporting to the Director of Procurement Operations, this role serves as the primary point of coordination between Development, Procurement, Estimating, Engineering, Pre-Construction, and external vendors.

This position can be based in our San Francisco, CA, San Diego, CA, Denver, CO, or Scottsdale, AZ offices.

If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications but see yourself contributing, please submit your resume

What You'll Be Doing

Project Schedule Management

• Develop and maintain detailed project schedules in the scheduling software for development projects.

• Facilitate schedule review meetings and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, document schedule changes, decisions, and impacts to validate schedule accuracy

• Monitor project progress, flag potential delays, and lead the development of recovery plans to keep projects on track.

• Prepare schedule status reports, look-ahead schedules, and variance analyses and communicate results to stakeholders in a timely manner.

• Perform schedule risk analysis and support recovery planning and coordination.

• Maintain schedule templates, standardization, and lessons-learned collaboration to improve scheduling practices across the project portfolio.

• Implement a streamlined scheduling update process, communication, and reporting using AI-enabled tools.

• Ad hoc procurement project reporting.

Project Spend Curve Management & Liquidity Reporting

• Responsible for coordinating the consolidated spend curve commitments aligned to the project schedule with input from internal and external stakeholders.

• Perform variance analysis, document and communicate key changes to the project team, highlighting changes to the spend exposure pre-FNTP as it compares to the approved spend.

• Periodically create comprehensive spend forecasts reporting with variance analysis, identified risks, and potential impact.

• Utilize AI-enabled tools to automate reporting and variance reporting.

WBS Budget Data Management

• Monitor and track approved spend commitments and upload the approved budget value into the SAP system.

• Communicate posted budget information to the project team for purchasing.

• Utilize AI-assisted status checks for approved-but-not-yet-uploaded SAP budgets, and auto-draft the completed budget communication to the project team for analyst review before sending.

What You'll Bring

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• 4+ years of progressive project scheduling experience, including scheduling large-scale capital construction; renewable energy (solar, wind, or battery storage) experience is strongly preferred, along with experience applying project management best practices and spend forecasting.

• Strong working knowledge of critical path method (CPM) scheduling principles, schedule risk analysis, and earned value management (EVM).

• Demonstrated ability to build, analyze, and maintain complex schedules with project activities across multiple work streams.

• Familiarity with supply chain finance/reimbursement structures and contract payment milestone structures.

• Working knowledge of the SAP budget module for Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) creation, budget upload, and project coding workflows.

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to independently manage a recurring, deadline-driven reporting cycle across multiple projects at once.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present schedule status and risk clearly to the project team and leadership.

• A team player, willing to collaborate with other functional groups.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Project, including resource loading, baselining, multi-project consolidation, and custom reporting, along with strong general Microsoft Office skills.

• Ability to work independently while maintaining accountability in prioritizing competing deadlines and proactively escalating risks or delays to management.

• Ability to travel up to 10%

No visa sponsorship or any kind of sponsorship for employment authorization is available for this role, now or in the future.

jobs.title: Staff Product Software Engineer, Consumer Money
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

As a Staff Engineer, you will play a key role in building new products and scaling existing ones to further evolve Gusto’s personal finance platform. Your work will focus on improving financial tools for everyday employees, helping them reduce financial stress, build healthy money habits, and gain greater control over their paychecks. You will collaborate with a talented cross-functional team, contributing technical expertise throughout the product development lifecycle—from ideation and architecture to development, release, and long-term scaling.

About the Team:

The Consumer Money team is on a mission to help employees achieve financial peace of mind by bridging employment and personal finances. The team's product suite gives workers complete control over their money—including on-demand pay, high-yield cash accounts, and automated savings—all anchored to the paycheck relationship Gusto uniquely powers.

Operating as one of the fastest-growing engines within Gusto Money, the team builds at a fast, startup-like pace. Beyond scaling core worker-facing products, the team is actively incubating 0-to-1 foundational technologies to power Gusto’s broader financial platform vision. Handling people’s livelihoods in a regulated banking space requires combining rapid innovation with deep technical rigor, system reliability, and an uncompromised focus on user experience. This role represents a high-impact opportunity to help shape the future of personal and platform finance at Gusto.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Build products & services and scale the platform that powers consumer money and accounting experiences at Gusto

• Take ownership of projects, ensuring they meet high standards of quality and performance

• Adopt the latest best practices for using AI technologies across all aspects of product development

• Collaborate on complex and ambiguous problems with partnerships from Engineering, Product Management, Design, Data Science, Compliance, Operations, and other cross-functional teams

• Engage in a highly supportive environment working with others to drive productivity and innovation

• Help drive the product development process from concept to launch

Here’s what we're looking for:

• 8+ years of professional software development experience

• Proven track record architecting, building, and testing large-scale, resilient distributed systems and software platforms

• High-agency ownership: a self-starter who independently takes ambiguous workstreams and drives them to the finish line, rather than waiting for assigned tasks

• Technical leadership experience guiding multiple engineers through large, complex initiatives from concept to delivery

• Proactive cross-functional partnership, comfortably driving alignment with Product, Design, and other functions to resolve ambiguity

• Fluency with modern AI developer tooling, paired with an enthusiasm for modeling and mentoring the team on AI-assisted development practices

• An aptitude for bringing clarity and simplicity to ambiguous, fast-moving environments with tight iteration cycles

• Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to distill technical complexity and guide well-reasoned architectural and product tradeoffs

Nice, but not required:

• Experience in the Fintech industry building scalable backend systems to power financial services and products

• Experience with banking, lending, or personal financial systems and familiarity with these financial workflows

• Ruby/Ruby on Rails, GraphQL, React, Typescript, AWS

Please note that a two day travel to a Gusto office for onboarding is required for this position. If you have any questions regarding this requirement, please share with your recruiter.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $197,000–$247,000 for San Francisco. Stock equity is additional. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Partnership Marketing
jobs.description:
TITLE: Account Manager, Partnership Marketing

DEPARTMENT: Corporate Partnerships

TYPE: Full-Time Regular

ROLE TYPE: Individual Contributor

OUR CLUBS

Seattle Sounders FC and Seattle Reign FC are united as one soccer family, driven by a shared commitment to excellence, growth, and impact on and off the pitch. Each club has independently forged a rich history of performance while connecting deeply with the community. Our clubs are continually pushing the boundaries of what's possible while fostering an inclusive culture- championing causes and building community connections to expand our reach and impact. Each match is an opportunity to bring together our community, celebrating our resilience, inclusivity, and a commitment to excellence. United in professional dedication- we are two clubs with one shared vision of progress and greatness.

POSITION SUMMARY

As Account Manager, Partnership Marketing, you own the revenue and results of a portfolio of marquee corporate partners. You are accountable for renewing every account in your portfolio and growing it through amendments, upsells, and new assets. You earn those outcomes by delivering contracts flawlessly, knowing each partner’s business, and building executive relationships that make renewal the obvious decision. You will plan and run activations across match day, media, events, signage, tickets, merchandising, and hospitality, and you will show partners the results in recaps tied to their goals.

This role requires a strategic-minded individual who is passionate about client service and building impactful, objective-focused partnerships, and who brings a positive, collaborative attitude in line with the club's vision, values, and objectives.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Revenue, Retention and Growth

• Own retention, renewals, and revenue growth for an assigned portfolio of marquee corporate partners, and answer for the results each partnership delivers.

• Own overall day-to-day account management including contract activation and fulfillment, strategic direction, and budget for assigned corporate partners.

• Develops a written account plan for each partner that captures the partner's goals and key performance indicators, aligns the right assets to them, and updates as goals change.

• Maintain strong relationships with each partner's leaders and decision makers.

• Hosts partner executives at matches and events, and uses those moments to build trust and surface new opportunities.

• Tracks activation performance and fan engagement throughout the season, reports results to the partner, and adjusts plans to keep each partnership on target.

• Prepare a recap for every assigned partner that measures results against the partner's goals, and use it in renewal and next-season planning.

• Plan an activation calendar for each partner that is tied to the partner's business goals.

• Fulfill contracted elements on time and to standard, including match-day activations, media, events and promotions, signage, tickets, merchandising, and hospitality. Make sound calls in real time when plans change.

• Keep partner records accurate and ensure every activation complies with league guidelines and internal processes.

• Develop and propose new activations that meet partner goals and engage fans.

• Support the Corporate Partnership Sales team with research and creative ideas, and lead presentations.

• Work collaboratively with internal teams to deliver client services and solutions, influencing teams you do not manage to keep partner commitments on time.

QUALIFICATIONS

We’re looking for an experienced partnership marketing professional who positions partnerships strategically in addition to facilitating them. They grow accounts through upsells that deliver revenue, work through the gap between what a partner expects and what is possible, and proactively lead renewals. They build genuine relationships inside the club and with partners, look for the levers that grow a partnership beyond the deal in front of them, and put AI to specific, practical use. They are a genuine fan of the game and a student of the business, and they take pride in turning partner commitments into results for our partners and the club.

Required Qualifications

• Demonstrated multi-year experience owning partner or client accounts in sponsorship, client services, sports or event marketing, agency, media or B2B account management.

• A strong track record of retaining and growing partner or client revenue.

• Experience building proposals and business cases for senior executives and negotiating terms within a contract.

• Strong organization and attention to detail across many fulfillment elements at once, such as signage, promotions, content, event activation, merchandise, hospitality, and more.

• Strong financial acumen.

• Self-starter who works independently and prioritizes projects effectively.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage clients, C-level executives, colleagues, and vendors.

• Experience using AI and building and running AI agents and automated workflows as an extended teammate to improve partnership performance: researching partner businesses for strategic insights, speeding responses and time to market, checking contract fulfillment at scale, managing projects across the portfolio, and drafting recaps and renewal cases, while the Account Manager keeps ownership of relationships and judgment calls.

Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Commercial Acumen and Negotiation: Understands how a partnership creates value for the partner’s business and the club, prices and packages assets accordingly, and negotiates amendments and renewals to a result.

• Consultative Partner Management: Learns each partner's business objectives, brings ideas they did not ask for, and measures results against their goals.

• Entrepreneurial Mindset: Takes full responsibility for retention, renewals, and revenue growth in the portfolio. Spots needs early, acts without being asked, and follows through on commitments. Brings creative ideas to activations across the department and the club.

• Pipeline and Forecast Discipline: Tracks every renewal and upsell opportunity in the CRM with accurate stage, value, and timing, and gives leadership a forecast they can rely on.

• Strategic Thinking and Judgment: Assesses the long-term implications of current choices, connects partner decisions to club and partner goals, and makes sound calls quickly in live moments such as match days, when plans change and partners are on site.

• Builder Mentality and Systems Thinking: Sees opportunities to improve how things work, creates structure where needed, and develops solutions that are practical, connected, and sustainable.

• Influence and Partnership: Builds trust across teams and with executive leadership, communicates with clarity, challenges assumptions constructively, and helps others make better decisions.

• Ownership and Accountability: Takes initiative, follows through on commitments, measures impact, and demonstrates sound judgment, integrity, and a commitment to equitable and inclusive practices.

• Committed to principles of diversity, equity and inclusion, and to living organizational values and the organizational mission: Create Moments, Enrich Lives, and Unify & Uplift Through Soccer, in all interactions with colleagues, partners, vendors, and fans.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position is based at our headquarters and training facility, the Providence Swedish Performance Center & Clubhouse in Renton, Washington.

We work together in person Monday through Thursday, with flexibility to work remotely on Fridays. Our work follows the rhythm of the soccer calendar, so match days, evenings, and weekends are part of the role, and workloads may vary throughout the season, particularly on match days and around key partner activations.

• Work match days at Lumen Field, including evenings and weekends, to deliver on-site partner activations, hospitality, and fulfillment.

• Must reside within Washington state upon date of hire.

• Must be able to facilitate own local travel.

• Must be eligible to work in the US without sponsorship.

• Responsibilities may include regular work outdoors and require standing on feet for long periods of time, as well as some lifting of up to 20 pounds.

COMPENSATION, BENEFITS AND PERKS

We offer competitive compensation and an engaging, supportive environment that prioritizes the health and well-being of our people.

The salary range for this position is $75,000 - $110,000 and eligible for bonus opportunity. Positioning within the range at time of offer is based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, internal equity, and current market conditions.

In addition to financial compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your overall well-being and professional growth, including:

• Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: We offer 100% employer-sponsored medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents. For employees enrolled in our HSA healthcare plan, we provide employer contributions to a Health Savings Account (HSA) — $1,000 per year for employee-only coverage and $2,000 per year for spouse or family coverage.

• Generous Paid Time Off & Leave: We offer discretionary paid time off, paid company holidays, and paid sick leave in compliance with Seattle’s Paid Sick and Safe Time ordinance. We also provide paid bereavement leave and paid jury duty leave to support you during life’s critical moments.

• Retirement Planning Support: 401(k) retirement plan matching, helping you secure your financial future with ease.

• Fertility & Family-Building Support: We provide a $10,000 lifetime maximum fertility benefit through our healthcare plan to support employees in their family-building journeys. This benefit includes coverage for infertility treatment, IVF, IUI, embryo transfer, fertility preservation, and related medications.

You’ll combine strong messaging and hands-on execution with experimentation and analysis to understand what drives results.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Lead
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Every day, Airbnb hosts provide unique Stays and Experiences that connect guests with local communities in authentic and meaningful ways. These offerings are the core of what makes Airbnb special, creating connections and unforgettable memories for travelers worldwide.

The Enterprise Account team represents the largest and most strategic supply partnerships within Airbnb and plays a vital role in growing the business. This role goes far beyond traditional account management.

The Difference You Will Make

As an Enterprise Account Lead, you will own the commercial performance of Airbnb’s largest property commercial partners. You will design and cultivate strong, collaborative relationships to shape their strategic roadmap, negotiate commercial terms, and optimize their listings at scale so Airbnb is competitive and the preferred distribution partner.

You will own the end to end  full relationship and commercial growth of  C-Suite partners. You will shape the strategy for how these partners perform on Airbnb, driving outcomes that matter for hosts, guests, and Airbnb's business.

A Typical Day

• Act as a strategic partner to relevant stakeholders to inform Airbnb enterprise account strategy, and communicate impact to relevant teams clearly

• Partner and influence key internal leaders on their roadmaps, ensure their teams support these key partnerships, and unlock revenue through product and policy enhancements

• Build and maintain trusted relationships with founders, board members, and executive stakeholders from partner accounts

• Navigate complex commercial conversations — multi-stakeholder deals, evolving usage patterns, and competitive evaluations in partnership with internal stakeholders

• Serve as the voice of the customer by gathering feedback and conveying market needs to inform our product roadmap

• Proactively identify and mitigate retention and competitive risks while maintaining high customer satisfaction

• Own and influence the business outcomes for assigned high valued accounts, strategically planning for the next phases of commercial growth

• Have a deep understanding of Airbnb policy, processes, and procedures to provide strategic decisions to (balancing long term success of Airbnb and our partners)

• Provide data driven insights quickly and accurately to inform business decisions that support commercial growth. This includes monitoring and analyzing over and underperformance, market trends, growth opportunities, and anomalies, and regularly communicate performance to executives to influence desired outcomes

• Present strategy, business performance, and recommendations directly to senior leadership and executive stakeholders, and drive alignment on the path forward

Your Expertise

Required qualifications

• 10+ years of experience leading business development, account management, business operations, or partnership initiative with large enterprise clients.

• Experience analyzing, structuring, and negotiating complex deals that align across multiple business units.

• Experience developing and selling complex business solutions at the C suite level.

• Ability to analyze data to uncover trends and inform decisions.

• Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to travel at least 30% of the time for client and internal meetings.

• Track record of setting strategy and delivering measurable results.

• Comfort negotiating commercial deals that balance short term needs and long term implications.

• Ability to balance time between strategic initiatives and hands-on execution when needed.

• Experience leveraging AI tools for data analysis and deck development.

• Interest in travel, hospitality, and working with a high performing team.

• BA and MBA preferred

Key Skills:

Strategic thinking & Analytics

• Define and execute a win-win commercial strategy for a portfolio of top tier partnerships

• Translate market and performance data into a clear roadmap for growth

• Ability to problem solve and solution large scale challenges

Partner and internal influence

• Shape partner behavior, not just manage it. Earn deep trust with partners while driving the outcomes Airbnb needs.

• Build and maintain relationships at the C-suite level clients

• Drive pricing, availability, and booking strategies.

• Advocate for roadmap prioritization and maintain alignment with stakeholders

• Identify gaps and address issues in partner facing workflows

Execution and ownership

• Drive projects from strategy through execution, holding yourself and cross functional partners accountable for deliverables and timelines.

• Ability to execute under ambiguity

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list  If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

$160,000—$200,000 USD

Highwire is seeking a Director, Influencer & Social Marketing to help lead our growing team across creator-led and organic social campaigns. This role serves as a senior partner and driver of both strategy and execution, owning workstreams, leading client conversations, and guiding teams to deliver smart, high-impact programs for our B2B, tech, and consumer clients.

Ideal candidates are confident client leaders, culturally fluent, and deeply embedded in the creator ecosystem, with the social strategy expertise to connect creator work to a brand's broader organic presence. You bring fluency across platforms and creator tiers, can brief and negotiate with creators or agents, and thrive when working across cross-functional teams to bring creator-led and social programs to life with insight, cultural relevance, and operational excellence.

We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in the B2B and tech space, who understand how creators, industry voices, and organic social can drive business impact, brand awareness, thought leadership, product discovery, brand engagement, and target audience action. Experience with consumer brands is also valued, especially fast-moving, culturally driven brands with high volumes of social content and integrated marketing activity.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as a senior leader across creator-led and social workstreams, owning client relationships, driving strategy, and ensuring flawless execution.

• Develop and implement influencer and organic social strategies that align with client business goals and perform across paid, earned, shared, and owned channels.

• Build and maintain relationships with creators, industry experts, talent agencies, and managers across all tiers of talent, including B2B thought leaders, LinkedIn creators, and subject-matter voices as well as consumer-facing talent.

• Advise clients on platform trends, creator and social strategy, content formats, community engagement, and KPIs that drive performance.

• Lead creator sourcing, briefing, contracting, and content feedback/approvals, and collaborate with creative and account teams to develop high-quality social content that resonates with target audiences and drives engagement.

• Ensure proper measurement planning and monitor, analyze, and report on creator and social performance (engagement, reach, audience growth, content effectiveness), contributing recap storytelling that demonstrates campaign impact and ROI.

• Support new business and organic growth opportunities by identifying ways creator and social work can extend across clients and help grow the practice.

• Mentor and manage team members, fostering development, setting goals, and guiding project prioritization and timelines.

• Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging platforms, and lead or contribute to trend briefings, POVs, internal training, and workshops to inspire teams and elevate creator and social thinking across the agency.

• Solid understanding of how influencer and organic social fit into a broader integrated communications strategy.

• Experience managing or mentoring junior and mid-level staff.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including professional client communication and internal collaboration.

• Experience using creator discovery, contracting, and reporting tools (e.g., CreatorIQ, Captiv8) and social analytics platforms.

• Ability to distill platform trends and translate them into actionable recommendations.

• Confident presenter with strong presence in client conversations and internal settings.

• Passionate about the creator economy, digital culture, and how social and culture shape brand relevance.

• Experience with B2B-specific creator approaches, such as executive and employee advocacy, industry expert and analyst partnerships, thought leadership content, and LinkedIn-first programs.

jobs.title: Physical Security Operations, Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

Verkada’s Global Security team protects our people, offices, events and executives – and uses Verkada’s suite of products to do so. In this role, you will own day-to-day physical security across our Americas footprint and lead our Global Security Operations Center (GSOC). The role combines office physical security operations and GSOC leadership under one owner. You will also be a player/coach:  you will set the standard, build the playbooks and run the vendor, and you will also be on the floor managing incidents. And you will play a critical role in our product development as well, serving as one of the most important internal voices shaping how Verkada’s products work in a real security operation.

This role is based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA because are committed to a thriving in-office culture and believe in fostering a culture of security excellence through direct, in-person collaboration.

What You'll Do

• Own security operations for HQ and every Americas site: guard force, access control, video, alarms, visitor management and emergency response

• Lead the our newly established GSOC and scale it into a 24/7 intelligence and response hub covering the Americas and, over time, the world

• Manage our GSOC, ERT and guard force vendors: contracts, staffing, post orders, SLAs, QBRs and performance against KPIs

• Act as incident commander for major security events, from workplace violence and protests to natural disasters and site emergencies

• Build and maintain SOPs, post orders, escalation paths and runbooks that a vendor operator can follow at 3 a.m. without a phone call

• Stand up consistent incident reporting and metrics so leadership sees every security event across the enterprise

• Run Verkada products as customer zero: deploy, stress-test and report gaps to Product and Engineering, and help shape features for security operations customers

• Partner with Workplace, Facilities, People, Legal and IT on site openings, office moves, terminations and investigations

• Hire, coach and develop the operations team as it grows

What You Bring

• 8–12+ years of security operations experience, including at least 4 years leading teams or vendor workforces in a corporate, high-growth tech or similar environment

• Experience running or directly overseeing a SOC or GSOC, including 24/7 vendor staffing models

• A track record of building programs and playbooks from scratch, not only running existing ones

• Hands-on fluency with physical security technology: access control, video management, alarms and visitor systems

• Calm, decisive incident command, with experience leading responses to serious events

• Strong judgment and the confidence to say “no” to stakeholders when the risk calls for it

• Clear written and verbal communication, including briefing senior executives

• Willing and able to regularly work onsite at HQ five days per week, and to travel to Americas sites as needed

• Bonus: law enforcement or military background, CPP or PSP certification, or experience

Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

• Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

• Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage

• Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee’s 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary

• Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options

• Expanded mental health support

• Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits

• Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time

• Professional development stipend

• Wellness/fitness benefits

• Healthy lunches provided daily

• Commuter benefits

Additional Information

You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

Below is the annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position, comprised of base compensation and commissions (if applicable).

Estimated Annual Pay Range

$185,000—$220,000 USD

As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant (Contract)
jobs.description:
Attention recruitment agencies: All agency inquiries are vetted through 4DMT’s internal Talent Acquisition team. No unsolicited resumes will be accepted. The 4DMT Talent Acquisition team must expressly engage agencies on any requisition. Agencies contacting hiring managers directly will not be tolerated, and doing so may impact your ability to work with 4DMT in the future.

4DMT is a leading late-stage biotechnology company advancing durable and disease-targeted therapeutics with potential to transform treatment paradigms and provide unprecedented benefits to patients. The Company’s lead product candidate 4D-150 is designed to be a backbone therapy forming the foundation of treatment of blinding retinal vascular diseases by providing multi-year sustained delivery of anti-VEGF biologics (aflibercept and anti-VEGF-C) with a single intravitreal injection, which substantially reduces the treatment burden associated with current bolus injections. The Company’s lead indication for 4D-150 is wet age-related macular degeneration and the second indication is diabetic macular edema, which are both in Phase 3 development. The Company’s second product candidate is 4D-710, which is the first known genetic medicine to demonstrate successful delivery and expression of the CFTR transgene in the lungs of people with cystic fibrosis after aerosol delivery.

We are taking genetic medicine to new heights and into new disease areas to overcome challenges not addressed by existing medicines. This incredible challenge drives our relentless and talented team. Our people are the essence of our inspiring, innovative and collaborative environment that encourages individual contributions and provides opportunities for career development. We seek the best in the industry who identify with our mission and our bold and innovative results-driven approach. Our Core Values drive the way we work together:

• Dare to Cure

• Break Boundaries

• Beyond Yourself

• Prepare & Execute Relentlessly

Join us in creating the future of genetic medicine.

GENERAL SUMMARY

The Senior Accountant will support the accounting and financial close activities related to the Company’s research and development operations, with a primary focus on clinical trial and R&D accruals. The position will work closely with the Senior Accounting Manager and cross-functional partners, including Clinical Operations, Development, Research, Technical Operations, and FP&A, to ensure R&D expenses are accurately recorded in the appropriate accounting period.

This role will be responsible for preparing monthly and quarterly accrual analyses, reconciling estimates of actual invoices and vendor data, investigating variances, and maintaining supporting documentation. The Senior Accountant will also support the monthly close, external audit, SEC reporting, and ongoing improvements to R&D accounting processes and controls.

This is a hybrid role with a minimum in-office work of once per week.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

R&D and Clinical Accrual Accounting

• Prepare monthly and quarterly R&D and clinical trial accruals, including CRO, CMO, investigator grants, pass-through costs, and other outsourced research and development activities.

• Obtain and analyze information from Clinical Operations, Development, CMC, Supply Chain, FP&A, and external vendors to estimate incurred but unbilled expenses.

• Review clinical trial information, including study progress, patient enrollment, site activity, CRO reports, vendor statements, contracts, purchase orders, and invoices to support accrual estimates.

• Prepare supporting calculations for clinical trial, manufacturing, and other R&D accruals in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

• Perform reconciliations between accrual estimates, actual invoices, purchase orders, contract commitments, and vendor reports.

• Perform monthly estimate-to-actual analyses and investigate significant accrual variances.

• Maintain clear and complete supporting documentation for accrual calculations, assumptions, and key accounting judgments.

• Assist in monitoring clinical and development program activity and identify changes that may impact accounting estimates.

• Work closely with the Senior Accounting Manager to identify and resolve unusual or complex R&D accounting matters.

• Assist with improvements to R&D accrual models, documentation, controls, and close processes.

Monthly Close and General Accounting

• Prepare journal entries and account reconciliations as part of the monthly, quarterly, and annual close.

• Review R&D-related general ledger activity for completeness and accuracy.

• Investigate unusual transactions and account fluctuations and prepare supporting explanations.

• Assist with accrued liabilities and other balance sheet reconciliations as assigned.

• Coordinate with Accounts Payable to identify invoices received after period-end that may impact accrual estimates.

• Maintain organized accounting schedules and supporting documentation in accordance with internal control requirements.

Audit, SEC Reporting, and Controls

• Prepare supporting schedules and documentation for quarterly reviews and annual audits.

• Assist with audit support requests related to R&D expenses, clinical accruals, and assigned balance sheet accounts.

• Assist with the execution and documentation of SOX controls related to assigned accounting areas.

• Ensure accounting documentation is complete, accurate, and audit ready.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Develop effective working relationships with Clinical Operations, CMC, Development, Research, Supply Chain, FP&A, Accounts Payable, and other business partners.

• Follow up with business partners and vendors to obtain timely information needed for period-end accruals.

• Communicate accounting questions, data inconsistencies, and significant accrual changes to the Senior Accounting Manager.

• Support process improvements that increase the accuracy, efficiency, and scalability of the R&D accounting process.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field.

• CPA or active CPA candidate preferred.

Experience:

• Minimum 3 years of relevant accounting experience.

• Biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industry experience required.

• Big Four public accounting experience preferred.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.

• Ability to organize and analyze large amounts of financial and operational data.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Experience with month-end close, journal entries, account reconciliations, and accrual accounting a plus.

• Experience with preparation or audit of R&D or clinical trial accrual accounting is strongly preferred.

Travel: N/A

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

• Physical Requirements - Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.

jobs.title: System Engineer
jobs.description:
Voyager is an innovative defense, national security and space technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

The System Engineer for Voyager's Data and Cloud team is responsible for designing, building, and operating the cloud and on-premises infrastructure that supports the organization's systems, using automation to improve reliability and scale.

The position reports to the Director, Data and Cloud and is part of the Data and Cloud department. This role is based in San Diego, California or remote within the United States.

In this role, the essential functions are:

• Design, deploy, and operate infrastructure in Microsoft Azure and AWS, including compute, storage, networking, and identity and access controls.

• Administer on-premises virtualization environments on VMware vSphere and/or Microsoft Hyper-V, including host and cluster management, capacity planning, patching, and lifecycle.

• Build, patch, configure, back up, and recover Windows and Linux servers across on-premises and cloud environments.

• Automate provisioning, configuration, and routine operations with Python and PowerShell, and manage scripts and configuration in Git.

• Develop infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Bicep) to standardize deployments across cloud and on-premises platforms.

• Plan and execute migrations of workloads between on-premises, Azure, and AWS environments.

• Monitor system health, performance, and cost; maintain backup and disaster recovery procedures; apply security baselines and remediate vulnerabilities in line with organizational policy.

• Serve as Tier 3 escalation for complex infrastructure incidents, perform root cause analysis, and maintain runbooks and documentation; partner with the Data and Cloud team and other IT teams on projects.

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now, Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field with 10 years of experience in systems engineering or administration OR Master's degree in a related field with 8 years of experience OR 14 years of experience in systems engineering or administration in lieu of a degree

• Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating workloads in Microsoft Azure, including virtual machines, storage, networking, and Microsoft Entra ID

• Hands-on experience with AWS, including EC2, S3, VPC, and IAM

• Hands-on experience administering on-premises virtualization on VMware vSphere and/or Microsoft Hyper-V

• Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for infrastructure automation and administration

• Proficiency in Python scripting for automation and API integration

• Experience with Windows and Linux server administration, Git version control, and infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Bicep)

• Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance at the level required for the position and applicable government contract. The position also requires appropriate access eligibility and a need-to-know. Clearance eligibility is determined by the U.S. Government.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working in regulated or compliance-driven environments (ITAR/EAR, CUI, NIST 800-171, CMMC), including Azure Government or AWS GovCloud

• Certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, VMware VCP, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate

Travel, Physical and/or Government Mandated Requirements:

• Occasional after-hours availability for maintenance windows, migration cutovers, and incident response

jobs.title: Power Electronics Test Intern
jobs.description:
Power Electronics Test Intern

Lunar Energy builds home energy products that make clean power abundant and accessible: inverters, batteries, and the software that ties them together. As a Power Electronics Test Intern, you will test those products, from the first bench measurement to the certification report. Your work covers two jobs that usually sit apart: power electronics performance testing, and compliance testing for safety, grid interconnection, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC). You will work on inverters, batteries, energy storage systems, and electric vehicle supply equipment (EVSE, or EV chargers), in our high-voltage lab, alongside design, firmware, reliability, and manufacturing engineers. What you find will change what we ship.

What you will gain: Gain practical experience in designing and testing Lunar’s products, while developing a comprehensive understanding of the full lifecycle from design to validation and certification. You will collaborate closely with design engineers, observe how testing data directly informs engineering decisions, and deliver key insights derived from test results and rigorous data analysis.

Lunar Energy was founded to transition homes to 100% clean energy—making our electricity greener, our air cleaner and our energy more safe, secure and reliable for all. We’re a fast-growing, global company building the world’s best clean energy products to electrify all homes and connect communities to form clean, resilient virtual power plants.

On a given day at Lunar, you’ll likely…

• Test inverters, batteries, energy storage systems, and EVSE for efficiency, power quality, protection response, fault behavior, transients, and thermal performance

• Run compliance and pre-compliance tests against safety, grid interconnection, and EMC standards, and help prepare products for testing for certification.

• Work with Compliance Engineers, & write test plans and procedures that trace each test back to a clause in the standard it supports.

• Build and run test setups with grid simulators, programmable AC and DC sources, battery cyclers, electronic loads, power analyzers, oscilloscopes, EV simulators, and environmental chambers.

• Automate test sequences and data processing in Python so a test that takes a day by hand takes an hour.

• Design targeted experiments to isolate failure modes, then diagnose them and drive root cause analysis with corrective and preventive actions.

• Analyze test data, report findings clearly, and bring early compliance risks to design reviews before they become redesigns. Review engineering changes for their effect on existing certifications

• Keep detailed records of tests, analyses, and corrective actions, and prepare test reports and technical files for internal teams and outside certification bodies.

• Work with design, firmware, reliability, and manufacturing engineers to protect design integrity and inform design decisions.

Desired Skills:

Required

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field (Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering, or Physics) or recently graduated.

• Strong grasp of electrical engineering fundamentals: AC power, three-phase systems, power converters (AC/DC, DC/DC, DC/AC), and basic control and protection concepts.

• Hands-on lab experience with oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters, and current and voltage probes.

• Experience with Python, C, or C++, and with processing and plotting measurement data.

• Strong debugging instincts: you can isolate a failure mode, design an experiment, and close a finding with a documented root cause.

• Careful, safety-minded work habits, with the discipline that high-voltage lab work demands.

• Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining a technical result to both engineers and non-engineers.

• Comfort with ambiguity, a fast pace, and working across teams and with outside labs.

• An ownership mindset: you follow a problem through to the end

Preferred

• Coursework or project experience in power electronics, grid-connected inverters, battery systems, or EV charging

• Familiarity with safety and grid standards for energy products, such as UL 1741, IEEE 1547, UL 1973, UL 9540

• Familiarity with EMC testing and standards, such as FCC Part 15, and IEC 61000: conducted and radiated emissions, electrostatic discharge, electrical fast transient, and surge immunity

• Experience with automated test systems, such as instrument control with SCPI, PyVISA.

• Experience with battery testing (cycling, thermal chambers) or with reliability, abuse, or environmental stress testing.

• Data analysis and visualization experience in Python.

• Prior lab research in power electronics, energy storage, or high-voltage systems

• Comfort using AI tools to speed up analysis and documentation, with the judgment to check their output and protect confidential data.

Our DE&I Philosophy: Lunar Energy is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, developing and retaining diverse talent by supporting an inclusive workplace. Lunar recruits, hires, trains, promotes, compensates, and administers all personnel actions without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other status protected by applicable law.

Our Compensation Philosophy: Our goal is to ensure that all Lunar Energy employees are fairly compensated. The hourly range estimate for this position depending on level of experience is $30-$40 USD

The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package will be at the company’s sole discretion, and determined by factors including but not limited to years of experience, job level, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations.
