jobs.title: Applied AI Architect - EDU
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.



Within Education, we partner with universities, schools, research institutions, and countrywide education systems to advance responsible, mission-aligned uses of AI. These environments require more than technical deployment: success depends on institutional trust, thoughtful governance, stakeholder education, change management, and a value narrative that resonates with academic leaders, researchers, IT teams, faculty, administrators, and students.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Applied AI Architect for Education, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of education customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business,” shaping each institution’s AI strategy and guiding its journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable institutional impact.



You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Edu, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate institutional priorities into a focused portfolio of use cases, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable value and growth. The Account Director owns the commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.



You will work across academic, research, administrative, and operational contexts—helping customers determine where AI can responsibly improve teaching and learning, accelerate research, strengthen student and faculty services, and make institutional operations more effective. You will account for the realities of education environments, including shared governance, complex stakeholder networks, academic calendars, accessibility, data privacy, responsible-AI expectations, and the need to build confidence among communities with differing levels of AI readiness.



You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, education programs, and partners. This role calls for strong education-sector fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy, academic and operational workflows, and hands-on technical conversations.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing education customers and pre-sales prospects.

 - Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, value-realization path, and expansion opportunities.

 - Lead discovery with institutional executives, academic leaders, researchers, faculty, administrators, and technical teams to identify and prioritize use cases connected to meaningful institutional objectives.

 - Translate education priorities into clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, institutional data, identity, integrations, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.

 - Guide institutions through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, building confidence in both the solution and its responsible path to production.

 - Translate institutional objectives into actionable adoption roadmaps with clear workstreams, sequencing, milestones, stakeholder ownership, governance, risks, success measures, and change-management needs.

 - Develop a focused use-case portfolio across areas such as teaching and learning, research, student and faculty services, knowledge management, software development, and administrative operations.

 - Translate institutional objectives into actionable adoption roadmaps with clear workstreams, sequencing, milestones, stakeholder ownership, governance, risks, success measures, and change-management needs.

 - Build trusted relationships and technical champions across CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, provosts, deans, research leaders, faculty, administrators, and other institutional stakeholders.

 - Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, Product, Research, education specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.

 - Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.

 - Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.

 - Identify repeatable education patterns and reusable architectures that can accelerate responsible adoption across institutions, departments, campuses, and education systems.

 - Translate field insights into actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, and Research, representing the needs and production patterns of education customers.

 - Help identify expansion opportunities where OpenAI can support additional academic, research, administrative, or operational workflows.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.

 - Have guided complex organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable value realization.

 - Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.

 - Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.

jobs.title: Senior Flight Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ODYS

At Odys, we’re mobilizing power, with Hybrid Power Systems developed for aerospace and in-demand everywhere. It’s the kind of mission diversity that demands a fresh way of thinking.

We began with an early bet on hybrid, when the mobility industry was focused on batteries. We designed, tested, and validated our first 1 MW high-speed generator in 12 months. And then we pushed further, developing systems with greater power density in less time. Today, our Hybrid Power Systems offer outputs ranging from 20 kW to 4 MW, with applications in the air or on the ground.

One of those applications is Laila, an unmanned drone designed for critical logistics and defense missions. With its 100 kW-class onboard Hybrid Power System, Laila can support medical cold-chain transport or serve as an aerial platform for counter-UAS measures.

The market interest has been overwhelming: Over 30 inbound requests from leading US and global manufacturers, and 14+ DoD contracts.

Our team comes from deep tech and aerospace, with backgrounds spanning drone and aircraft development, high-volume production, and electrified mobility.

We operate with urgency and ownership at every level. We validated high-speed generator technology faster than our peers, not because we skipped steps, but because we've been doing this long enough to know which ones matter most.

Creating the future of power, in the air and on the ground, is a challenge we’ve been training our entire lives for. If that sounds like you, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Flight Controls Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the behavior of our UAVs, from initial concept to real-world flight. Our Flight Dynamics and Controls team is responsible for designing, implementing, and validating control algorithms that enable precise, stable, and agile flight. You will work closely with our aerodynamics, mechanical, software, and flight test teams to ensure seamless integration and execution of control strategies. This role offers the opportunity to directly impact the way our UAVs fly, through hands-on development, real-time testing, and flight validation.



 


RESPONSIBILITIES


CONTROL LAWS AND AUTOPILOT

 - Design, implement, and tune flight control laws for large VTOL UAVs across hover, transition, and wingborne flight, including stability/control augmentation, mode logic, and transition scheduling.

 - Develop guidance, navigation, and state-estimation functions around inner-loop control laws within the agreed autopilot architecture.

 - Define control-system requirements for stability margins, handling qualities, and performance; demonstrate compliance across the flight envelope.

 - Establish failure detection, reconfiguration, and fault response for sensor, actuator, and power failures; collaborate with systems and safety engineers on redundancy management.

 - Lead technical reviews of control laws and address follow-up actions.


IMPLEMENTATION AND FLIGHT SOFTWARE

 - Develop control laws using a model-based workflow with requirements, traceability, and reviews suitable for safety-critical software.

 - Implement control laws for real-time embedded execution, ensuring that airborne software aligns with the design.


MODELING AND SIMULATION

 - Build and refine simulations to develop and verify control laws, including effects from airframe, propulsion, actuators, and sensors.

 - Plan and execute model-in-the-loop (MIL) and software-in-the-loop (SIL) simulations to identify issues prior to hardware and flight testing.

 - Perform system identification on ground and flight data to update models, ensuring simulation accuracy.


AIRCRAFT INTEGRATION

 - Collaborate with aerodynamics, mechanical design, avionics, and flight software teams to iterate control strategies as the vehicle and its interfaces evolve.

 - Define control-system interfaces to sensors, actuators, and flight computers, addressing timing, latency, redundancy, and fault response.


TEST AND FLIGHT VALIDATION

 - Plan and execute hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), ground-test, and flight-test activities to validate control-system performance.

 - Create test procedures and flight-test cards; analyze simulation and flight data to verify requirements and inform design iterations.

 - Work with the flight test team to ensure campaign safety and data usability for control system improvements.

 - Prepare control-law design and verification data for technical reviews (internal and external).

 - Mentor less experienced engineers in analysis, implementation, and data review.

 


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field, with depth in flight dynamics and control (Master’s/Ph.D. welcome but not required if experience is met).

 - 5–12 years developing flight control systems for crewed aircraft, UAVs, or flight vehicles, including leading control laws through flight test on at least one program.

 - Strong foundation in flight dynamics and control theory (classical and modern control-law design, gain scheduling, stability-margin analysis).

 - Experience with fly-by-wire or full-authority autopilot architectures, including mode logic and redundancy.

 - Solid understanding of guidance, navigation, and state estimation (Kalman filtering, INS/GNSS sensor fusion).

 - Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink (control-law design/analysis) and C/C++ and Python (implementation, test tooling, data analysis).

 - Experience with real-time embedded control law implementation and debugging on HIL rigs.

 - Experience with MIL/SIL simulations and analyzing flight/test data to close design loop.

 - Experience leading technical reviews and mentoring engineers.

 - Clear communication skills with multidisciplinary engineering teams; ability to document design decisions and updates.

 


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with vertical takeoff and landing aircraft, especially transitions between powered lift and wingborne flight.

 - Familiarity with aircraft system identification tools (CIFER, SIDPAC, or equivalent).

 - Proficiency with flight-control analysis and optimization tools (e.g., CONDUIT).

 - Knowledge of Embention or other integrated UAV flight-computer/autopilot hardware.

 - Hands-on experience with HIL rigs and participation in flight-test campaigns, including test-card development and test safety planning.

 - Understanding of actuator dynamics, redundancy management, and sensor fusion.

 - Expertise in envelope protection, loss-of-control prevention, and contingency management for unmanned aircraft.

 - Experience with safety-critical development (DO-178C, DO-331) or flight control system certification (UAV or crewed-aircraft).

 - Familiarity with system safety processes (ARP4754B, ARP4761A—FHA, FMEA) as applied to flight controls.

 - GNSS-denied navigation or vision-aided state estimation experience.

 - RC, remote-pilot, or crewed-pilot experience.

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Prime Video - Ads Science
jobs.description:
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video subscriptions such as Apple TV+, HBO Max, Peacock, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video team member, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Key job responsibilities
The science challenges include:
- Heterogeneous customer responses. The same customer responds differently to ads depending on what they’re watching, how engaged they are, and their broader streaming context. We need to understand and predict this variation to make better advertising decisions in real time.
- Signal sparsity in streaming. Unlike search or retail advertising, streaming offers no clicks, no conversions, and limited direct feedback. We must develop creative approaches to infer customer preferences, intent, and tolerance from indirect behavioral signals.
- Personalization at scale. A one-size-fits-all ad experience leaves value on the table for both customers and the business. We build systems that adapt ad load, placement, and content to individual viewers across 100M+ customers and 100k+ titles.
- Small effects, large variance. Ad interventions typically produce 0.1-2% shifts in engagement, effects easily overwhelmed by natural behavioral variance. Measuring, attributing, and optimizing these small signals requires rigorous experimental design and causal methodologies.
- Competing objectives. Revenue, customer engagement, long-term retention, and advertiser value are in tension. We develop principled frameworks to navigate these tradeoffs and optimize for sustainable outcomes rather than any single metric.

A day in the life
- Lead the research and development of ML models that personalize advertising decisions for 100M+ customers across 100k+ titles, with production deployment in mind
- Develop deep learning architectures (multi-task learning, embedding-based representations) for customer behavior prediction at scale
- Design and analyze large-scale A/B experiments, applying causal inference techniques to measure and optimize the impact of ad strategies on customer engagement and monetization
- Partner with engineering to ensure models meet production latency and scalability requirements
- Collaborate with product managers to frame business problems as tractable ML problems and translate findings into product decisions
- Shape the team’s scientific roadmap, identifying high-impact research directions

About the team
Prime Video Ads is pioneering the use of Generative AI, Deep Learning and Causal ML to empower the next generation of Ads experience in Prime Video. Our vision is to build the world’s most valuable and differentiated ad-supported streaming platform: one where every ad is relevant to the viewer, and every dollar spent by an advertiser delivers measurable results. We are seeking lead applied scientists who have demonstrated experience in advancing state of the art ML algorithms, particularly in Personalization, Relevance, Casual Inference and Gen-AI areas. Your role will be to deliver these innovations as production-ready systems at Amazon scale.

Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with large scale machine learning systems such as profiling and debugging and understanding of system performance and scalability

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager – Technical, Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is building a constellation of 3,000+ Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites to deliver fast, affordable broadband connectivity to customers around the world. The Leo Connectivity Product team is responsible for defining and delivering the end-to-end networking and service experiences that connect customers — consumers, enterprises, and the public sector — to the Leo network.

We are seeking a highly technical Sr. Product Manager to own product definition for future generations of Leo’s satellite connectivity system. This is a strategic, cross-functional role focused on identifying the customer problems we will solve with next-generation architectures. You will work at the intersection of vehicle engineering, software engineering, modeling and simulation, and the PMT teams building our first-generation network, constellation and customer devices — synthesizing insights across all of them to define what comes next.

This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity. The problems are not yet well-defined, the solution space is wide open, and the timelines may be long. You will frame ill-defined challenges into actionable product strategies, drive system-level trade studies with modeling and simulation teams and translate technical possibilities into customer-centric product direction. This is a high-visibility individual contributor role based in Redmond, WA.

*** Export Control Requirement ***
- Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Define the product vision and requirements for future-generation satellite connectivity systems, grounded in deep understanding of customer problems across consumer, enterprise, and public sector segments.

- Drive system-level trade studies in partnership with modeling and simulation teams — translating simulation outputs into product requirements and investment recommendations.

- Partner deeply with vehicle engineering and software engineering to understand technical constraints and opportunities that inform future system architectures.

- Collaborate with PMTs owning first-generation constellation systems and customer antenna products to identify gaps, lessons learned, and opportunities that shape future generations.

- Frame ambiguous, long-horizon problems into structured product strategies with clear hypotheses, evaluation criteria, and decision frameworks.

- Write PRFAQs, technical narratives, and investment proposals that articulate the customer need, technical approach, and business case for future system capabilities.

- Represent the futures roadmap in leadership reviews, clearly communicating trade-offs, dependencies, and strategic rationale to senior technical and business stakeholders.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin with a review of simulation results from the modeling team — a new trade study has landed overnight comparing architectural approaches for a capability that could unlock performance improvements for enterprise customers. You dig into the data, identify the assumptions that need stress-testing, and draft follow-up questions for the simulation engineers.

Mid-morning, you’re in a working session with vehicle engineering, walking through how a proposed design change to the satellite bus impacts the connectivity services you’re defining. You push on the customer experience implications and propose a set of requirements that preserve flexibility for future service evolution.

After lunch, you sit down with a PMT colleague who owns our payload software. Together you review field data and customer feedback, looking for patterns that signal where the current architecture falls short and where the next generation needs to leap forward. You capture three hypotheses to validate with simulation runs.

The afternoon is heads-down writing time. You’re drafting a narrative that frames a customer problem — one that doesn’t have an obvious solution yet — and propose an evaluation framework for the engineering team to assess multiple architectural paths. You end the day in a cross-functional sync, aligning vehicle, software, and simulation teams on priorities for the next sprint of trade studies.

About the team
You’ll be part of the Leo Global Product team — a group of product and technology leaders responsible for defining the end-to-end connectivity experience for Leo’s customers. Our team spans device products, networking services, enterprise solutions, and future systems.

We value deep technical curiosity, comfort with ambiguity, and a relentless focus on the customer problems worth solving. We operate with a builder’s mentality — moving fast on the things we understand and moving deliberately on the things that require getting it right. We are a team that debates rigorously, decides clearly, and supports each other once a direction is set.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe the best products come from teams with varied perspectives and experiences.

- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- Experience in aerospace, satellite communications, telecommunications systems, or a related field

jobs.description:
Every dollar AWS invests in hardware shapes the cost, performance, and competitiveness of the AWS cloud that powers the internet. Come join AWS Finance as a Strategic Finance Manager, where you will own the economics and investment strategy behind the next generation of AWS servers. Your analysis will shape multi-billion-dollar capital decisions, define where AWS invests to win on cost and performance, and go directly to senior leadership. Using tools such as Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and Net Present Value (NPV), you will translate complex technology choices into a clear investment thesis. You do not need to be a hardware expert to join this team.
What you will do:
- Own the investment thesis for major hardware programs, shaping multi-billion-dollar capital allocation decisions.
- Define the cost and performance strategy that determines where AWS invests to win competitively at scale.
- Bring recommendations directly to AWS senior leadership and influence the hardware roadmap.
- Lead TCO and NPV analysis to evaluate technology trade-offs and rank investment options against customer requirements.
- Own the cost framework that underpins every hardware investment decision, and drive it to be faster and sharper.

Key job responsibilities
- Influence high-stakes business decisions with sharp, data-driven financial analysis.
- Shape technology development and deployment choices to maximize performance per dollar.
- Own accurate, defensible hardware costing that leadership can trust.
- Build and improve the financial tools and processes that scale decision-making.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing variance analyses and preparing a narrative for an upcoming leadership review. By midday, you are partnering with business teams to pressure-test assumptions in a new financial model, then refining the outputs using data management tools like SQL and Excel. In the afternoon, you could be designing a control improvement with stakeholders or coaching a teammate through a reporting workflow. Throughout it all, you balance deep analytical work with cross-team collaboration, ensuring your recommendations move from insight to action.

About the team
Our Finance team is dedicated to providing the insights and financial stewardship that help Amazon make smart, long-term investments on behalf of our customers. We operate in a collaborative environment where analytical curiosity is valued and new ideas for improving how we work are always welcome. As a member of this team, you will contribute to an inclusive community that prioritizes knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and professional growth. We are focused on building scalable processes and strengthening our financial capabilities, and your expertise will play a meaningful role in that mission.

Join Amazon's Investments & M&A Accounting team as a Principal, where you'll own the accounting strategy for high-profile acquisitions and equity investments from diligence through integration. Represent accounting across the full M&A lifecycle, from pre-close diligence to post-close integration.

Research and resolve the toughest technical accounting questions — business combinations, purchase accounting, valuations, and equity instruments.

Influence senior leaders and drive decisions on transactions that shape Amazon's future.

Build and improve the processes that let a team scale with Amazon's pace of dealmaking.

You will join a team of 20+ VAT specialists covering Amazon's Digital and Devices portfolio, with a focus on supporting Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios. Our team supports some of Amazon's most recognised and fastest-growing businesses — including Alexa, Kindle, Audible, Amazon Music, Twitch, Devices (Ring, Eero), Appstore, Digital Software and Games, Amazon Prime, and M&A — as well as Amazon Leo, launching low earth orbit satellite broadband service for unserved and underserved communities worldwide.

jobs.title: Environmental test engineer
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is an initiative within Amazon to transform global connectivity with a state-of-the-art Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite communication constellation. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide by delivering high-speed, low-latency internet to underserved, unserved, and remote communities around the world. Using the latest satellite technology, we are building a future where everyone can get reliable, high-quality internet no matter where they are.

The Amazon Leo Government (ALG) Engineering organization is a multi-disciplinary team that quickly builds solutions for targeted government and international customers, with the potential to scale. ALG Engineering leads the development and delivery of custom satellite and ground applications and works closely with Amazon Leo to use its constellation of advanced satellites.

We are looking for an Environmental Test Technician who specializes in vibration and thermal testing. You will set up and run dynamic and thermal environmental tests that prove Leo Government hardware can survive real-world conditions. Dynamic conditions include launch loads, mechanical shock, engine-induced vibration, ground and air transport, and flight turbulence. Thermal conditions include hot and cold cycles hardware sees in transport, storage, and operation. Working with test and design engineers, you will support units, subsystems, and space vehicles through qualification, protoflight, and acceptance testing in both R&D and production.

The success of Leo Government depends on the quality, reliability, cost, manufacturability, throughput, and security of the products we deliver. If you want a fast-paced, hands-on environment where your work has a direct impact on flight hardware, this role is a strong next step. To succeed, you need to be highly motivated and detail-oriented, and you need to hold yourself to the highest standards of execution.

We are a group of test and production technicians with diverse skills and experience. Each team member is willing to train others and brings positive team energy. You will own some tasks as an individual contributor and work in a group on others to reach team goals. We are in R&D today and moving toward production.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.

Key job responsibilities
Vibration and shock testing:

- Set up and run vibration tests (sine sweep, random, sine burst, and low-level signature runs) on electrodynamic shakers and slip tables, following approved test procedures
- Set up and run mechanical shock tests under the direction of test engineers
- Install, route, and secure accelerometers, and check channel mapping, sensitivity, and polarity before each test
- Mount test articles and fixtures, apply the correct torque, and verify the setup before engineering review
- Set up vibration controller profiles from engineering-provided test parameters, and watch tests in real time against abort limits
Thermal chamber testing:

- Set up and run temperature tests, including thermal cycling, hot and cold soaks, and temperature-humidity tests, in environmental chambers, following approved test procedures
- Program chamber controllers with engineering-provided profiles, including setpoints, ramp rates, dwell times, and number of cycles
- Install and secure thermocouples and other temperature sensors on test articles, and check sensor readings and data acquisition setup before testing
- Monitor chamber and test article temperatures throughout the test, and respond to alarms, out-of-tolerance conditions, and chamber faults
- Operate chambers that use LN2 or CO2 cooling safely, following cryogen handling and PPE requirements
- Support powered testing inside the chamber, including harness routing through feedthroughs and monitoring of hardware functional checks during temperature plateaus
General:

- Handle flight hardware safely, following ESD, cleanliness, and FOD requirements
- Collect, organize, and back up test data, and produce basic plots (PSD, transfer function, signature overlays, and temperature vs. time) for engineering review
- Record test activity accurately in travelers, test logs, and as-run procedures
- Spot and report anomalies, nonconformances, and equipment issues right away, and support troubleshooting and failure investigations
- Do routine maintenance, functional checks, and calibration tracking on shakers, amplifiers, controllers, chambers, sensors, and cables
- Suggest improvements to procedures, fixtures, and workflows to raise test throughput and repeatability as the program moves to production
- Train and support newer technicians on environmental test setup and safe practices

A day in the life
You might start the shift checking the shaker system and sensor calibration dates, then mount a unit on the slip table and install the accelerometers. After the test engineer reviews your setup, you would run the low-level signature and random vibration profile, watching control and response channels the whole time. In the afternoon, you might move a second unit into the thermal chamber, install thermocouples, load the cycling profile, and confirm stable readings before starting the first ramp. At the end of the day you would export the data, fill out the as-run procedures, and hand off notes to the next shift.

About the team
Citizenship requirement:
- This position requires that the selected candidate be a U.S. Citizen to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

Basic qualifications:
- High school diploma, or equivalent
- 4+ years of hardware development, test lab, space/aerospace maintenance or hands-on engineering environment experience
- Experience in product validation (Shock/Drop, cycle testing, environmental testing)
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings, or experience in electrical or mechanical engineering
- Experience with precision torque, measurement and inspection devices (i.e., automated and manual torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, profilometers, optical inspection devices, multi-meters, torque wrenches)
- Current, active TS/SCI US Government Security Clearance

Preferred qualifications:
- Technical degree in related field, or Associate's degree in Mechatronics
- Experience with vibration control software such as Siemens Simcenter, m+p, Data Physics, Spectral Dynamics, or Vibration Research
- Basic understanding of random and sine vibration, PSD, and shock response spectrum concepts
- Familiarity with industry test standards such as GSFC-STD-7000 (GEVS), SMC-S-016, or MIL-STD-810
- Experience with ESD-safe handling, cleanroom work, and FOD prevention
- Technical degree in related field, or Associate's degree in Mechatronics.

jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms

About this team and role:

Mozilla Communications, Marketing and Policy (CMP) Team is looking for an operator to make sure the entire team runs smoothly. That covers budget, people, process, offsites, templates, tools and the systems underneath all of them. The team has grown quickly across brand, product marketing, media, creative, communications and policy, and its operations have not kept pace with the work.

This is a hands-on, technically fluent operations role. The largest part of the job is the tools and automations the team uses to run itself, so that budget tracking, onboarding, planning, partner management and everyday workflows take less manual effort and hold up as the team changes. You will choose and set up those tools, build the automations, and get the team using them. The wider marketing technology and data stack stays with our MarTech team, and you will work closely with them.

What you’ll do:

• Own the tools the team uses to run itself (project and workflow management, budget and spend tracking, partner and contract records, shared knowledge, AI assistants), and decide what gets added or retired.

• Keep the team's operational data and shared sources of truth (budget, headcount, partners, projects, the contract library, planning and process folders) accurate, current, and in one place, so no one is reconciling spreadsheets by hand.

• Lead the team's automation program: design and build AI agents and automated workflows that take manual effort out of how the team operates, and set the guardrails, ownership, and maintenance for the automations staff build themselves.

• Run the marketing budget cycle in partnership with our Finance lead: set up annual envelopes by function, keep spend tracking current, support monthly reconciliation and forecasting, and run the spend approval process so every dollar has an owner and a line.

• Own people operations for the team with our People partners: new hire onboarding, the org chart, headcount and open roles, and the basics every new team member needs on day one.

• Run the partner contract process for marketing: draft SOWs and change orders with the team that owns each agency, technology or creator partner, move them through review to signature, track renewals, and run partner onboarding and regular reviews against scope and cost.

jobs.title: Materials Engineer, Metals Joining (Starmind)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

MATERIALS ENGINEER, METALS JOINING (STARMIND)

SpaceX is leveraging its experience deploying and operating the world’s largest satellite constellation to develop Starmind, a new constellation of satellites capturing solar energy in space to power low-cost, high-performance AI compute for Earth. Realizing this vision demands highly reliable, high performance electrical compute hardware, solar power systems, thermal radiators, and more. These systems must operate in the extreme environment of space while delivering the connectivity, control, power distribution, and processing needed for orbital AI inference.

The Starmind team designs, builds, and operates the orbital compute fabric of the future, developing key in-house technologies from satellites’ flight computers and power systems to custom compute electronics, memory, and networking for on-orbit data centers. As a Materials Engineer you will serve as a technical owner for metal joining across Starmind hardware—developing, qualifying, and sustaining welding, brazing, soldering, and diffusion bonding processes for compute, power, and thermal management assemblies, including liquid-cooled cold plates, heat exchangers, thermal radiators, and hermetic electronics packaging. You will define joint designs and process specifications, establish the joint properties and acceptance criteria the design community relies on, and scale robust joining processes from prototype to high-rate production.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Owned development, qualification, and troubleshooting of metal joining processes for Starmind satellite and ground hardware, including fusion welding (laser, electron beam, and tungsten inert gas), friction stir welding, resistance welding, vacuum and controlled-atmosphere brazing, soldering, and diffusion bonding

• Supported material selection and manufacturing for metallic and joined assemblies such as liquid-cooled cold plates, heat exchangers, thermal radiators, structures, power electronics, and hermetic enclosures

• Defined joint designs, filler metals, braze alloys, interlayers, and process parameters, and wrote the material and process specifications, process control plans, and acceptance criteria

• Developed mechanical and physical properties of base metals and joints, including strength, fatigue, fracture toughness, and thermal and electrical conductivity, through thermal cycling and on-orbit environments

• Set inspection and nondestructive evaluation methods, including computed tomography, radiography, ultrasonic C-scan, helium leak testing, and proof and burst testing, to verify joint integrity and leak-tightness

• Investigated joint and material failures with fractography, metallography, and characterization testing, and drove corrective actions into design and production

• Partnered with design, manufacturing, quality, and suppliers to design for joinability, qualify outsourced welded, brazed, forged, and cast hardware, and move processes from prototype to high-rate production

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in materials science, materials engineering, welding engineering, metallurgical engineering, or another science, technology, engineering, or mathematics field

• Experience with metal-joining processes, including welding, brazing, soldering, and diffusion bonding, and with alloys commonly joined in aerospace and electronics hardware, such as aluminum, copper, stainless steel, nickel, and titanium

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Master’s degree or PhD in materials science, materials engineering, welding engineering, metallurgical engineering, or another science, technology, engineering, or mathematics field

• First-principles understanding of joining metallurgy, including solidification, wetting and capillary flow, interdiffusion and intermetallic formation, heat-affected-zone behavior, and residual stress, and of how process variables drive joint performance

• Experience with characterization techniques and equipment, including scanning electron microscopy and energy-dispersive spectroscopy, optical microscopy, hardness testing, mechanical property testing, and spectroscopy for composition or phase

• Hands-on experience developing and qualifying welding, brazing (vacuum, furnace, or induction), and/or diffusion bonding processes, including joint design, fixturing, and parameter development

• Experience joining aluminum, copper, and dissimilar metals for thermal-management hardware, such as cold plates and microchannel heat exchangers, or for electronics packaging

• Familiarity with joining standards and specifications, such as American Welding Society D17.1 and C3.7, Aerospace Material Specification 2675, and American Society of Mechanical Engineers Section IX, and with their use in process qualification and procedure development

• Experience applying design of experiments, statistical process control, and process capability analysis to joining processes in production

• Demonstrated success in a rapidly growing, fast-paced, and highly competitive environment

• Drive to execute in a scrappy, entrepreneurial environment with tight timelines and aggressive schedules

• Hands-on experience in a high-volume manufacturing environment

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.description:

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

As a Service Technician, you will be responsible for diagnosing, maintaining and repairing Lucid Motors vehicles.  You will demonstrate your passion for sustainable transportation and creatively solve problems in a fast-paced environment.   As a Service Technician, it is expected to have ASE certifications obtained within 6-8 months of hire date.     Lucid will reimburse the cost associated with successful completion.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
PRODUCT DESIGNER

Greptile is building the independent code validation layer for humans and AI agents. We combine code review, testing, and security with deep codebase context so teams can delegate more to coding agents and ship software they can trust.

Greptile reviews 5B lines of code every month for 22,000+ customers. A new repo starts using Greptile every 2 minutes. We also offer self-hosted, air-gapped deployments for enterprises across defense, financial services, and healthcare.

Greptile's founding product designer. You'll own how developers experience AI code review across GitHub/GitLab, our dashboard, and new surfaces we haven't built yet, and set the design system the whole product is built on.


PROBLEMS WE'RE EXCITED ABOUT

 - What does a great interface for reviewing code with an agent look like, beyond comments on a diff?

 - How do we show an engineering leader the value Greptile creates in one glance?

 - How do we keep a fast-shipping product consistent and beautiful?


TRAJECTORY

 - 22,000+ customers

 - 5B lines of code reviewed every month

 - Scaled from $0 to eight figures in ARR

 - Raised $80M from Menlo Ventures, Benchmark, Y Combinator, and Initialized


TEAM

 - Small, talent-dense team who have scaled critical functions at companies like Open AI, Stripe, Google, and Figma.


RESPONSIBILITIES (IN ORDER OF TIME SPENT)

 - Own end-to-end design for core product flows, from research through polished, shipped UI

 - Build and maintain the design system and components with engineering

 - Prototype quickly, including in code, and test with real users

 - Partner with PMs and engineers on scope and tradeoffs

 - Raise the craft bar across the product and marketing surfaces


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years of product design experience, ideally developer tools or technical products

 - Portfolio showing strong interaction design, visual craft, and systems thinking

 - Comfortable working directly in Figma and in code

 - Understands how developers work; can read a diff


YOU'LL LIKE THIS ROLE IF

 - You want design to be a first-class part of how a fast-growing AI company builds

 - You want to work on a product that thousands of developers rely on

 - The chaos of high growth and things breaking is exciting to you

 - You like being in an office every day around other smart people who are excited about what they're building

 - You specifically prefer working in-person over working remote

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Hummingbird is a remote-first, fully distributed team united by the shared mission of helping fight financial crime. Since our launch in 2017, we’ve helped major financial institutions and tech-savvy trailblazers alike (e.g. Plaid, Raymond James, Crypto.com etc.) orchestrate their compliance programs through our thoughtfully designed, intuitive, AI powered compliance tools. We believe finding and stopping financial crime is a problem rooted in code, language and design, so we built the product that the heroes doing this work deserve.

We are customer-obsessed, and we love building and shipping great products. We set a high bar, challenge our assumptions, seek diverse opinions, and support each other to do our best work.

We do our best to write inclusive, descriptive and accurate job descriptions, but we’re not always perfect. If you’re interested in the role, we’d love to hear from you even if you don’t feel like you meet everything we’re looking for. We’re always iterating and improving, and it’s possible that your experience is even more impactful than we could have imagined.

About the Role

Our customers trust us with their most sensitive data and with the compliance work that keeps financial crime in check. The Trust team keeps that trust: we own Hummingbird's infrastructure, security, reliability and data platform. We're looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead the team. You'll own its roadmap, still write code, and help us grow from serving fast-moving fintechs to serving some of the largest banks in North America.

What you’re looking to do:

• Lead and grow the Trust team. Manage, coach and hire a small, senior team of infrastructure, security and data engineers, and take over from our current leader.

• Own the Trust roadmap. Act as the team's technical product manager. Weigh enterprise customer needs against reliability, security and platform investments, and explain those trade-offs across the company.

• Stay hands-on. Contribute to our AWS and Terraform infrastructure, review designs and PRs, and help during incidents. You'll be technical, while keeping yourself out of the critical path.

• Raise the bar on security and reliability. Lead work on disaster recovery, incident follow-ups, security posture, and our compliance programs.

• Support enterprise growth. Help run single-tenant deployments for large financial institutions, and work with Sales and CS on customer security reviews.

• Partner closely with (and, depending on your background, lead) our IT and security functions, which sit within the Trust team.

What we’re looking for:

• A US-based engineering leader who has managed people and is still technical enough to ship infrastructure code. You'd be comfortable in a Terraform PR or in front of a production dashboard.

• A strong background in cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and running production systems where reliability and security really matter.

• Practical about process: you shape how a team works around what it actually needs, keeping what works and fixing what doesn't.

• Security instincts built from real experience. Hands-on SOC 2 or PCI work is a big plus.

• A clear communicator who can explain the same incident to an engineer, an executive, and a bank's InfoSec team.

• Bonus: you've owned a technical roadmap or done technical product management. You'll own the Trust roadmap here, but we'll support you as you grow into it.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. jobs.title: Technical Trainer
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About This Role:

We are seeking a skilled Technical Trainer to deploy Crusoe's workforce development initiatives in a critical dual-purpose role. You'll be responsible for both hands-on training and supporting factory-level workforce development initiatives, including sheet metal fabrication, powder coating, and the assembly of modular data centers. Your efforts will be pivotal in ensuring efficient onboarding, consistent production quality, and delivering high-impact, hands-on technical instruction for our employees. This role will have a direct impact on employee retention and engagement, ensuring our teams have the expertise to maintain our high-quality standards. This is a full-time position.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Training Needs Analysis & Program Support: Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA) to identify skill gaps and utilize TWI (Training Within Industry) Job Instruction methods to standardize and deliver training. You will support structured learning paths for various manufacturing roles, from new hires to experienced employees, aimed at upskilling the workforce and supporting internal mobility. You will continuously improve training to meet the needs of an evolving workforce and align with industrial trends.

 - Hands-on Technical Training: Directly train employees on core manufacturing processes, with a primary focus on electrical and wiring proficiency, including control panel assembly, LV wiring, and termination. You will also instruct on sheet metal fabrication, powder coating, and switchgear integration, teaching essential skills to ensure consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and safety protocols.

 - Content & Systems Management: Deliver engaging training materials, such as video tutorials, written manuals, and hands-on exercises, and update them regularly to reflect new technologies and production techniques. You will maintain accurate training records, certifications, and completion data.

 - Evaluation & Certification: Utilize a system for assessing employee skills and knowledge through practical tests and certifications. This system will provide tangible recognition for their accomplishments, supporting internal mobility and career progression.

 - Collaboration & Support: Work closely with department managers to support department leads and deliver training aligned with existing factory initiatives. You will use data and performance metrics to measure the effectiveness of training programs and collaborate with Corporate Learning & Development to integrate new tools and company-wide initiatives.

 - Retention Support: Act as a champion for employee development by providing clear opportunities for growth and recognition, directly contributing to a more engaged workforce and helping to reduce turnover.

 - Employee Onboarding: Create a positive new employee culture for all manufacturing employees by partnering with corporate teams to ensure new hires have the necessary tools and systems to be effective on their first day. You will serve as the representative to corporate teams to ensure company-wide approaches are representative of the manufacturing workforce.



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - Extensive Manufacturing Experience: At least 5+ years of hands-on experience in a manufacturing or production environment. Experience with fabrication, electrical assembly, or a related field is essential.

 - Instructional & Training Proficiency: Proven expertise in delivering effective technical training. You have a strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, hands-on learning experiences, particularly in electrical and wiring, while conducting training needs analysis to identify skill gaps.

 - Technical Knowledge: A deep understanding of manufacturing processes, including the ability to interpret technical drawings, schematics, and blueprints.

 - Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences. You must be able to work strategically across all manufacturing and corporate functions to deliver cohesive training.

 - Strategic Thinking: The ability to deliver a sustainable, scalable training program that supports long-term business goals.

 - Instructional Versatility: The ability to instruct at all levels of employee development.



Bonus Points:

 - Experience in learning management systems (e.g., Workday, Success Factors, WorkRamp, Lattice, LinkedIn Learning).

 - Certifications in training, instruction, or a relevant technical field.

 - Experience with TWI (Training Within Industry) Job Instruction methodology.



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation:

Compensation will be paid in the range of $85,000 - $100,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Salary will be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. (#INDMFG)

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Director, US Business Development & Sales (Western US Territory)
jobs.location: California, Washington, Oregon, Nevada, or Arizona
jobs.description:
We are LOTTE BIOLOGICS! Delivering Therapies That Enable a Healthier World.

A new company, built on 80 years of tradition. We embody our core values of being Inspired by Science, Embracing Diversity, Fostering Talent, and Connecting Lives. Our mission is to be the most trusted partner in the industry, with high standards of quality and continuous innovation, to reliably deliver benefits for patients worldwide.

Position Summary

The Director, US Business Development & Sales is a strategic sales role responsible for driving signed manufacturing contracts and growth for the LOTTE Biologics Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO). Supporting an assigned territory across the Western United States, this individual will develop and execute strategies to identify, pursue and close new business opportunities; cultivate strong client relationships; and expand the company's reputation and brand recognition in the biopharmaceutical sector. This role will work closely with cross-functional teams to organize and lead client meetings, RFIs, RFPs and proposals and negotiate competitive contracts in alignment with business objectives and operational capabilities.

Duties & Responsibilities

Strategic Business Development and Sales

• Develop and execute comprehensive business development and sales strategies that align with LOTTE Biologics’ strategic priorities, goals and marketing opportunities to achieve revenue targets and market growth.

• Identify and prioritize target clients, key accounts, and potential partnerships within the biopharmaceutical industry.

• Conduct market research to stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape, client dynamics and emerging opportunities.

Client Acquisition & Relationship Management

• Build, cultivate and maintain strong, long-term relationships with new and existing clients (primarily based in the United States), acting as the primary point of contact.

• Identify client needs and propose tailored solutions, highlighting LOTTE Biologics' capabilities and value proposition.

• Collaborate with LOTTE Biologics technical SMEs and proposals department for preparation of Requests for Information and Requests for Proposals and to support technical meetings with clients.

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner with LOTTE Biologics development, analytical and project management teams to align client requirements with service capabilities.

• Provide input to product development and service offerings based on market feedback and client demands.

• Collaborate with marketing teams to create targeted campaigns, presentations, and promotional materials.

Revenue Growth & Reporting

• Track KPI’s to report on sales performance metrics, ensuring goals are met or exceeded and make data-driven adjustments.

• Manage opportunity pipeline and forecast.

• Report to senior leadership on pipeline status, market trends, and strategic initiatives.

Education & Experience

• This position supports clients and business development activities throughout the Western United States. Due to territory coverage, customer engagement responsibilities, and travel requirements, candidates must reside in California, Washington, Oregon, Nevada, or Arizona.

• Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Biotechnology, Business Administration, or related field.

• Advanced degree (Master’s, MBA, Ph.D., or equivalent) preferred.

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in business development, sales, or related roles within a biopharmaceutical CDMO or life sciences industry.

• Proven track record of achieving and exceeding year-over-year sales targets with a focus on new account acquisition.

• In-depth knowledge of biopharmaceutical development and manufacturing processes, including regulatory and compliance aspects.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

• Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills.

• Skilled in crafting tailored solutions and navigating internal processes.

• Expertise in the business development documentation utilized in the biopharmaceutical CDMO industry (e.g. Confidentiality Disclosure Agreements, Requests for Information, Requests for Proposal, Manufacturing Supply Agreements, Work Orders). This includes contract negotiation experience and skills.

• Exceptional interpersonal and communication abilities, with the capacity to influence at all organizational levels.

• Transparent, ethical, and adaptable with a proactive, collaborative approach in remote and global environments.

• Expertise in CRM tools and business development analytics.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with a customer-focused mindset to navigate the complexities of the CDMO landscape and drive business growth.

• Strong financial modeling, pricing strategies and risk analysis skills.

• Ability to work with global colleagues and clients, across time zones as needed.

• Strong network of contacts in biologics and bioconjugation CMC, External Manufacturing, MS&T, Technical Operations, Procurement and Strategic Sourcing roles.

• Key Competencies: Leadership: Ability to inspire and guide teams toward achieving common goals while also advocating for your clients and the LOTTE Biologics business as needed. Problem-Solving: Effective at resolving client challenges and internal obstacles to drive success. Adaptability: Capable of pivoting strategies to respond to market changes. Networking: Strong connections within the biopharmaceutical industry and the ability to leverage these relationships effectively.

Physical Demands

• Frequently operates standard office equipment, including computers, telephones, and video conferencing technology.

• Regularly communicates with clients, colleagues, and business partners in both virtual and in-person settings.

• Must be able to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer, participating in meetings, and conducting presentations.

• Must be able to travel by air and ground for business purposes.

• May be required to move, transport, and set up presentation materials, marketing collateral, luggage, and other business-related equipment.

• Must be able to navigate client facilities, manufacturing sites, convention centers, and conference venues, which may require extended periods of walking and standing.

Work Environment

• Work is performed in a combination of home office, corporate office, client-site, manufacturing facility, and conference/trade show environments.

• The role requires frequent interaction with internal and external stakeholders across multiple functions, locations, and time zones.

• Work schedules may occasionally extend beyond standard business hours to accommodate client meetings, business travel, industry events, and collaboration with global colleagues.

• Use of appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required when visiting manufacturing, laboratory, or regulated production environments.

• The role operates in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and customer-focused environment requiring adaptability, responsiveness, and strong relationship management skills.

Travel

Travel is a significant component of this role and is expected to comprise approximately 50% of working time, depending on business needs and sales opportunities.

Travel responsibilities include:

• Regular visits to prospective and existing client sites throughout the United States.

• Travel to the LOTTE Biologics manufacturing facility in Syracuse, NY and Songdo, Korea for leadership meetings, client visits, business reviews, and strategic planning sessions.

• Attendance and participation in industry domestic and international conferences, trade shows, networking events, and professional association meetings.

• Support of client meetings, technical discussions, proposal presentations, contract negotiations, and site visits.

• Ability to travel by air and ground transportation, including overnight and multi-day travel, is required.

Target Bonus

23%

Work Location:

Western U.S. Territory (California, Washington, Oregon, Nevada, Arizona)

New York Pay Range

$155,000—$214,000 USD

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity (“EEO”) Employer.

We believe that women, people of color, veterans and LGBTQ communities must participate in the work we do, so we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of underrepresented communities!  If this is the work that you want to do, in a culture of inclusion and excellence with the goal of making our world to be a healthier place, then please apply today!

jobs.title: Hospice RN Case Manager (Easton, PA)
jobs.description:
About Us

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, Ohio, Kentucky, Mississippi, and Georgia. Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. Ennoble Care offers a variety of programs including, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health management, and chronic care management, to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care by a team they know and trust. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

Job Summary:

Ennoble Care is hiring for a full-time Hospice RN Case Manager who resides within or in close proximity to Easton, PA. As a member of the interdisciplinary team, the RN Case Manager works under the general direction of the Director of Nursing, the attending physician and the interdisciplinary group in providing skilled nursing assessments, planning, and care in order to maximize the comfort and health of both patients and their loved ones/caregivers.

Responsibilities:

• Manage your assigned patient caseload within your territory and be responsible for the following tasks, including but not limited to: assessing, planning, implementing, and evaluating of patients care throughout all phases of the nursing process.

• Document all notes in the EMR and submit them accurately and in a timely manner

• Communicate and partner cross-departmentally with all attending physicians, hospice staff members, and other agencies as needed to coordinate optimal care for all patients

• Educate and coach all relevant parties on the best practices regarding call levels of care for the patient including: physical, mental, emotional, etc

• Partner with clinical leadership to manage/address any issues, share professional support, and exchange feedback to enhance professional growth.

• Attend patient care conferences and facilitate discussion of issues from caseload for full staff discussion, consultation and evaluation

• Supervise and document the NAC every two weeks or as assigned

• Assume the role of associate nurse when responding to patient/loved ones/caregivers of other primary nurses during off hours time or as requested by the Patient Care Coordinator to fill patient/family needs during the absence of other primary nurses

• Provide appropriate support at time of death and period of bereavement for family members and loved ones

• Participate in the Hospice orientation, in-service training, and community programs as related to hospice care

• Maintain familiarity with policies of the agency and rules and regulations of State and Federal bodies which govern hospice

• Accept other assignments as appropriate

Qualifications:

• Valid State license to practice as a Registered Nurse in the State of Pennsylvania

• 1-2+ years of work experience as a professional nurse preferably at least one of the years in hospice care

• Ability to assess and respond to the needs of patients and loved ones/caregivers in varied settings.

jobs.title: Research Associate 2
jobs.description:
LOCATION: On-Site in Boulder, CO (Foresight Dx business unit, a Natera company)

ABOUT OUR COMPANY:

Foresight Diagnostics is a molecular diagnostics company pioneering non-invasive cancer detection through highly sensitive, cell-free DNA-based liquid biopsy technologies. Our proprietary methods - originally developed at Stanford University - are designed to detect smaller tumors earlier and enable more personalized treatment strategies for patients with cancer.

We sit at the intersection of molecular biology, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS), and we translate rigorous science into clinically meaningful solutions. Following our acquisition by Natera, we now combine the agility of a mission-driven startup with the scale and resources of a global leader in cell-free DNA testing. It’s an exciting moment to join us.

Headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, our team operates in a high accountability, collaborative environment where quality and continuous improvement aren’t just values - they’re how we work every day.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Every liquid biopsy result starts at the bench, and this role puts you right there. As part of our Boulder R&D team, you’ll work hands-on with scientists developing ultrasensitive, cell-free DNA technology designed to detect smaller tumors earlier and enable more personalized treatment for patients with cancer. You’ll run experiments across the NGS workflow, from gDNA isolation and library prep to hybrid capture and sequencing, using automated liquid handlers and instruments like the TapeStation and Qubit. Along the way, you’ll learn to troubleshoot, keep instruments running smoothly, and understand why an experiment behaves the way it does, not just how to run it.

You won’t work in a silo. You’ll partner daily with Associates and Scientists, summarize and present your data to the team, and write SOPs that shape how we work. Your notebooks, results, and attention to detail will be trusted and relied on by the people around you. Foresight’s Stanford-born science now has the backing of Natera, a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, so you’ll get the agility of a mission-driven startup with the resources and reach of an established company. If you have a few years of molecular biology experience and want to build deep expertise in one of the most exciting areas of modern diagnostics, in a collaborative, high-accountability culture where quality and continuous improvement are part of everyday work, we’d love to meet you.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

You will work primarily with R&D assisting Associates/Scientists in various lab duties. Responsibilities will include:

• Independently execute simple experiments and perform basic troubleshooting

• Produce competent, reproducible results to a high technical standard

• Maintain accurate and well-organized laboratory records, worksheets and notebooks

• Summarize data in spreadsheets, graphs and presentations

• Write standard operating procedures (SOP) and other lab-related documents as needed

• Maintain equipment and instruments in good operating condition, recognize any malfunctions and troubleshoot as needed

• Utilize molecular biology techniques in performing laboratory tests. This role will have occasional access to PHI both in paper and electronic form and have occasional access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job.

• Adhere to environmental, health and safety (EHS) guidelines and good laboratory practices (GLP)

• Perform other tasks as specified by the manager/director

QUALIFICATIONS:

• BS/BA in a biological science or equivalent

• Minimum of 2 years Molecular Biology laboratory experience required

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• gDNA isolation from biological samples (preferred).

• Experience with library preparation for next generation sequencing and sequencing platforms

• Experience with hybrid capture technologies

• Experience with laboratory automated liquid handler platforms

• Sample analysis/QC on the Agilent Tapestation, Nanodrop, Qubit, electrophoresis

• Must have proven interpersonal, communication, computer, and technical skills.

• Excellent oral and written communication skills required.

• Microsoft Excel experience required

Compensation & Total Rewards

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

• Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

• 401(k) with company match

• Generous paid time off and company holidays

• Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range

$74,800.00 - $89,000.00

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other.
