jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Vehicle Software team develops the safety-critical software that runs on Terran R. The work spans a distributed, real-time control system operating under extreme conditions like Mach 5 atmospheric flight, with a deployment pace that allows you to see your code run on rocket engines daily. The team is building new system architecture from the ground up and just as importantly, testing, releasing, and deploying it. You don’t need an aerospace background: what matters is experience with high-reliability software for complex systems. This is a rare opportunity to shape the foundation of Terran R’s software stack while directly influencing performance, reliability, and flight success.

About the Role:

Aerospace experience isn’t required. We value driven engineers with strong computer science fundamental who collaborate well to solve meaningful problems. As a Flight Software Engineer II, you will be a technical leader within the team with a high level of autonomy tackling core flight software products that directly impact the Terran R program and be responsible for setting standards and best practices for the team along with mentoring junior engineers. Architect and deliver core flight software with a strong focus on meeting system and performance requirements such as latency, allowed jitter, and control frequency. Work closely with GNC engineers to integrate complex algorithms for vehicle ascent and re-entry, descent and landing. Work closely with Embedded Software Engineers and Avionics to integrate vehicle sensor data such as GPS, IMU, Radar, and to control vehicle equipment such as valves, thrust vector controls, and landing grid fins. Develop telemetry system that prioritizes, filters, stores and forwards, and encodes/decodes telemetry to RF format, and routes that data through ground stations and to data centers. Support the development and integration of testing infrastructure such as HITL (Hardware-In-The-Loop) and HOOTL (Hardware-Out-Of-The-Loop) and physics and fluid sims. Focus on maximizing the team's velocity by defining processes, best practices, integrating modern tools and technologies, and mentoring junior engineers.

About You:

• An undergraduate or graduate degree in a relevant engineering discipline (Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering)

• 2+ years experience of production development experience

• Experience delivering production-level and high reliability software

• Expert in Rust, C++, and/or other system languages, as well as algorithms and data structures

• Expert in Linux Operating System concepts such as memory management, CPU shielding, scheduling, etc

• Expert in networking concepts such as TCP/IP, UDP

• Experience with software development processes including: source control, bug tracking, and CI/CD

Nice to haves but not required:

• Experience with systems-level programming like synchronization primitives, memory management, etc.

• Experience with different inter-process communication methods

• Experience with message passing protocol such as flatbuffer or protobuf

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

jobs.title: Vice President, Corporate Controller
jobs.description:
About Us

We are developing potentially best-in-class therapies for patients living with severe autoimmune diseases. Our lead antibody, claseprubart (DNTH103), is purposefully engineered with extended half-life, improved potency, and high selectivity for only the active C1s complement protein that drives disease pathology – enabling less frequent and more convenient self-administered subcutaneous injections. Our second clinical candidate, DNTH212 is a first and potentially best in class, bifunctional inhibitor that targets clinically validated and complementary disease modifying mechanisms, Type 1 IFN suppression and B cell modulation – enabling potential for improved clinical outcomes and patient friendly convenient, self-administered subcutaneous injections. Our newest candidate, DNTH312, is an internally developed, investigational, first-in-class, next-generation bifunctional fusion protein combining claseprubart and TACI to target potent inhibition of aC1s and BAFF/APRIL. DNTH312 aims to be Phase 1 ready by year end 2027. To learn more, please visit www.dianthustx.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

About the Role

Dianthus Therapeutics is seeking an experienced accounting and finance leader to serve as Vice President, Corporate Controller. Reporting to the Chief Accounting Officer, this individual will provide leadership across the Company’s accounting organization, including general accounting, payroll, SEC reporting, technical accounting, and SOX compliance.

As Dianthus advances toward commercialization, this leader will play a critical role in building and implementing the processes, systems, and controls required to support commercial operations, including inventory management and revenue recognition, and will oversee these activities following launch. The VP will partner closely with the Chief Accounting Officer and cross-functional leaders to ensure Dianthus has a scalable, compliant, and operationally effective accounting infrastructure to support continued growth.

This role will also provide important leadership depth and continuity within the Accounting organization, supporting the continued evolution of the function as Dianthus grows.

We are building a culture of individuals who hold our core principles at the center of our operations, with the goal to elevate the care of our patients’ lives. We are open to you working remotely.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide leadership and oversight across accounting activities, including general ledger, close and consolidation, SEC Reporting, accounts payable, payroll, technical accounting, and related financial operations.

• Lead accounting readiness for commercialization, including development and implementation of processes, systems, policies, and controls required to support first revenue.

• Establish and oversee commercial accounting capabilities, including revenue recognition, gross-to-net accounting, inventory and cost accounting, and related commercial processes.

• Partner with Supply Chain, Commercial, Legal, IT and other functions to ensure systems, data flows, controls, and business processes appropriately support commercial operations.

• Oversee the Company’s internal control environment and SOX compliance, ensuring controls and processes appropriately evolve as the organization grows.

• Drive continuous improvement and scalability across financial systems, processes, controls, and the financial close.

• Support quarterly reviews and annual audits and serve as a senior partner to the Company’s external auditors.

• Support tax, treasury, and other corporate finance activities as appropriate in partnership with the Chief Accounting Officer and external advisors.

• Develop and mentor members of the Accounting organization and provide leadership depth and continuity across the broader Finance function.

• Support Audit Committee and Board-related financial reporting and communications, as appropriate.

• Perform other responsibilities and strategic Finance initiatives as the needs of the organization evolve.

Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related discipline required; CPA strongly preferred.

• 15+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including significant leadership experience within a publicly traded company.

• Strong knowledge of US GAAP, SEC reporting, SOX compliance, and technical accounting requirements.

• Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or life sciences is required.

• Demonstrated experience building or scaling accounting processes, systems, and controls within a growing organization.

• Commercial-stage or commercial-launch experience is required, including experience with ASC 606 revenue recognition, gross-to-net accounting, and inventory/cost accounting.

• Experience leading external audits and partnering effectively with independent auditors and advisors.

• Demonstrated ability to operate both strategically and hands-on in a dynamic, growing organization.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to partner effectively across Finance, Commercial, Supply Chain, Legal, IT, and other business functions.

• Strong judgment, communication, and executive-level presence, with the ability to communicate complex accounting matters clearly to senior leadership.

• Proven ability to develop teams, establish scalable operating processes, and balance strong financial controls with the needs of a growing business.

jobs.title: Senior 3D Motion Designer, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

Position Overview:
As a Senior Motion Designer at Fanatics Sportsbook, you will play a pivotal role in conceptualizing and executing high-quality 2D and 3D motion graphics and short-form video that resonate with our target audiences. This role will primarily work within our performance marketing environment, creating assets built to drive acquisition, engagement, and conversion across paid channels. You will work closely with our creative and marketing teams to develop compelling visual narratives, animations, and effects that elevate our brand and messaging, built for how people actually watch: fast, scrolling, and often with the sound off.

Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with the creative and performance marketing teams to conceptualize and storyboard motion graphics projects.

• Design for performance: strong hooks in the first few seconds, sound-off storytelling, captions, and clear offer and CTA end cards, delivered across 9:16, 4:5, 1:1, and 16:9.

• Animate in-app UI screens and product flows to show features and offers clearly.

• Design and animate engaging 2D and 3D visuals for paid social, websites, and other digital platforms.

• Produce high-volume creative, including variations and iterations for testing, and apply learnings from performance data to improve results.

• Create title sequences, transitions, and other graphical elements for videos and multimedia projects.

• Incorporate internal feedback and iterate on designs to ensure they meet project objectives.

• Stay up to date with trends and best practices in motion design, 3D, animation, and generative AI tools.

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining high-quality standards.

• Oversee and manage 3D media libraries and assets

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Animation, Motion Graphics, or a related field.

• 6+ years of proven experience as a Motion Designer or similar role, with a strong portfolio showcasing your creative work.

• Demonstrated experience in 3D motion design, with 3D work featured in your portfolio.

• Proficiency in industry-standard design and animation software, such as Adobe After Effects, Adobe Premiere Pro, and Adobe Illustrator, plus a 3D tool such as Cinema 4D, Blender, or similar.

jobs.title: Director, People Operations Solutions
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

Every hire, move, pay change and request for help at Crusoe runs on a process, and as we grow, each one either creates leverage or creates drag. The People Operations Solutions Team builds the processes, products and AI-enabled services that create leverage.

Reporting to the Senior Director, People Operations, you lead the team that designs, builds and continuously improves Crusoe's People products, such as joining Crusoe, changing jobs, getting paid and rewarded, growing and performing, and getting help. We run People like a product organization: design thinking keeps us close to the employees and managers we serve, agile delivery lets us ship and learn in short cycles, and lean discipline makes results measurable and repeatable.

You'll build and lead a team of Solutions Managers, Designers, Knowledge Managers and Analysts who operate in a product model as builders for People products and services, from the talent lifecycle to service delivery, case management, knowledge and automation.

You'll also own a portfolio yourself: core HCM, compensation, plus the people data foundation that our Workforce Intelligence team relies on. You'll partner closely with Lifecycle Operations, Employee Care, our Centers of Excellence, including Workforce Intelligence, and IT.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Vision and roadmap: set the multi-year roadmap and investment plan for People products, grounded in business outcomes, employee experience and data quality.

 - Team leadership: hire, coach and develop a high-performing team of product-minded builders.

 - Core HCM: own the business design of Crusoe’s core HCM, including worker data, organizations, positions and lifecycle transactions, so Lifecycle Operations can run it well and every system downstream can trust it.

 - Compensation: partner with the Total Rewards team to design and run compensation processes and systems, including annual cycles, job architecture and pay administration.

 - Workforce Strategy and Intelligence partnership: support and enable the Workforce Intelligence COE, which owns People analytics, by delivering the data management processes and analytics technology it needs, with clear definitions and data that ties out with Finance.

 - Solution teams: lead cross-functional solution teams that bring together program owners, operators, design, analytics and IT to deliver end-to-end, scalable products.

 - AI and automation: find where AI agents, automation and self-service should take on manual, repeatable work, and design the human roles around them.

 - Delivery cadence: run quarterly planning, short delivery cycles and regular demos with business owners, and hold the team to measurable outcomes.

 - Measurement and improvement: own product measures such as touchless resolution, cost to serve, employee satisfaction and data quality. Drive root-cause fixes and continuous improvement.

 - Technology partnership: be People Operations' single voice to IT on requirements and roadmap for Workday and the tools around it, and lead the work with IT using agile development practices: a shared backlog, sprint planning, regular demos and joint testing.

 - Global scale: design solutions that work across countries, entities and sites, including manufacturing and data center teams.
   
   

What You'll Bring to the Team:

We don't expect anyone to bring everything below. If you meet the requirements and some of the rest, we'd like to hear from you.


REQUIRED

 - 12+ years across people operations, HR technology, HR product management or process improvement, including 5+ years leading teams

 - A track record of delivering end-to-end People products or services across people, process and technology, from discovery through adoption

 - Deep expertise in core HCM and compensation processes at a global, multi-entity company

 - The ability to build trust and influence across People leaders, IT, Finance, Legal and executives

 - Energy for the pace of a fast-scaling company and a path not fully paved


EQUIVALENT EXPERIENCE WE VALUE EQUALLY

 - Process improvement: Lean or Six Sigma training, an industrial or systems engineering background, or a track record of measurably improving operational processes

 - Product delivery: running internal services as a product with design thinking and agile delivery, or product management at an HCM or employee-service software company

 - Technology: Workday HCM and Advanced Compensation, or comparable depth in another enterprise HCM platform

 - Data: People data management and reporting technology, or data governance work in Finance, IT or operations

 - Education: a degree in industrial or systems engineering, business, human resources or a related field, or equivalent professional experience



Bonus Points

 - Applying AI, automation and self-service to employee services

 - Supporting manufacturing, construction or data center workforces

 - Experience with Workday Onboarding, Recruiting, Talent or Prism Analytics, and HR service delivery platforms
   
   

Benefits:

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $215,000 - $255,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

jobs.title: Senior People Operations Solutions Manager, Talent Lifecycle
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

Crusoe is growing fast across offices, data centers and manufacturing sites in several countries. How we set goals, review performance, develop our people and bring new talent in shapes how every employee experiences Crusoe, and how quickly they grow with us.

As Senior People Operations Solutions Manager for the talent lifecycle, you are the product manager for how Crusoe reviews, grows and hires its people. Your focus is the systems that enable talent performance cycle and ongoing talent development: goals, check-ins, mid-year and year-end reviews, calibration, learning and career growth. You also design the recruiting lifecycle in Ashby and Workday and its hand-off into onboarding. You start from the outcome the business needs, partner with Centers of Excellence, design with the employees and managers who use the process, and deliver a complete solution across people, process and technology.

Reporting to the Director, People Operations Solutions , you lead solution teams partnering with our Talent and Learning teams, Talent Acquisition, Lifecycle Operations, UX design, analytics and IT. You'll bring a bias toward automation and AI, and the judgment to add process where it creates value and keep it light where it doesn't.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Talent performance cycle: partner with Talent and Performance Management to deliver  the performance cycle end-to-end, owning the workflow, system configuration, cycle operations, and user experience, making each cycle simpler and more useful for employees and managers.

 - Ongoing talent development: build the processes and tools that deliver learning, career paths, internal mobility and succession programs designed by the Talent and Learning teams, so growth at Crusoe is continuous, visible and easy to act on.

 - Manager enablement: partner with Talent and Performance Management to give managers the tools, data and prompts to coach, recognize and develop their teams between formal cycles.

 - Recruiting lifecycle: own the recruiting workflow across Ashby and Workday, from requisition to offer accepted, and its connection to onboarding, including the candidate portal.

 - Discovery and outcomes: define success with program owners and the people who use the process. Map the current journey, measure it and find the constraints.

 - Solution design: use design thinking to frame the problem and prototype with employees and managers. Then design future-state journeys across people, process and technology, including service blueprints, standard work, controls and where AI or automation should take on manual work.

 - Roadmap and delivery: own the roadmap and backlog for talent lifecycle products, and deliver in short cycles with demos to business owners.

 - Technology partnership: lead the work with IT using agile development practices, including a shared backlog, sprint planning, regular demos and joint testing. Translate requirements into configuration and integration decisions for Workday Talent, Performance and Learning, Workday Recruiting and Ashby, and the tools around them.

 - Launch and adoption: prepare readiness, enablement and adoption with Change Management, and hand each product to Lifecycle Operations with clear standards.

 - Measurement and improvement: enable tracking of measures such as cycle completion and quality, manager and employee satisfaction, internal mobility, time to hire and data quality, and keep improving after launch.

 - Global scale: design for many countries, entities and sites, including manufacturing and data center teams.



What You'll Bring to the Team:

We don't expect anyone to bring everything below. If you meet the requirements and some of the rest, we'd like to hear from you.




REQUIRED

 - 8+ years in talent management, performance and development programs, HR technology or HR product management, with several end-to-end launches

 - Deep knowledge of performance management and talent development processes

 - Process design skill: journey and process mapping, standard work, SOPs and RACI

 - Comfort with data: you define the measures and act on what they show

 - The ability to lead without authority and build trust with managers, talent and learning partners, recruiters and IT

 - Energy for the pace of a fast-scaling company and a path not fully paved


EQUIVALENT EXPERIENCE WE VALUE EQUALLY

 - Talent technology: Workday Talent and Performance, or comparable depth in another talent management system

 - Recruiting: an applicant tracking system such as Ashby or Workday Recruiting, or hands-on recruiting operations experience

 - Product delivery: design thinking and agile methods from business case through adoption, or product management at a talent management, learning or HCM software company

 - Process improvement: Lean, Six Sigma or industrial engineering training, or a track record of measurably improving processes
   
   

Bonus Points

 - Moving performance cycles from tools such as Lattice to Workday

 - Calibration, job architecture or career framework design

 - Applying AI to performance, coaching, learning or recruiting



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $175,000 - $215,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.



Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Art Director + Designer, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

Overview:
We are looking for a Senior Art Director + Designer to help lead and design the creative for Fanatics Sportsbook’s performance marketing team. In this role, you will create high-impact static and digital assets built to drive acquisition, engagement, and conversion across paid channels, including paid social, display, and other performance placements. You will develop new visual concepts within our existing visual identity, build systems that let those concepts scale, and work with performance marketers and key stakeholders to ensure each project brief is aligned to campaign goals.

The ideal candidate has expert knowledge of digital graphic design and strong art direction experience, with the ability to set a clear visual point of view and carry it consistently across campaigns and channels. You approach every brief as a problem to solve, not a layout to fill. You can find the single idea that makes an ad worth stopping for, and you can explain why it will work for a specific audience, offer, and placement before you open a design file. You have a sharp eye for trends, both in creative performance and in the broader landscape of sports betting and social content, and you know how to act on them. A real feel for sports, tech, and gaming audiences and their culture will help your work resonate.

Responsibilities:

• Design original, performance-driven assets for paid social, digital, display, and other advertising placements, with print and environmental design as needed.

• Provide visual direction and toolkits for campaigns, ensuring cohesive execution across channels and formats.

• Art direct imagery, photography, video, and outside creative partners as needed to bring concepts to life on brand.

• Design master templates and visual systems built to scale, partnering with Creative Ops and our Creative Engine team so new concepts can be versioned across offers, matchups, sizes, and states without rebuilding.

• Own and evolve our performance component libraries, ensuring legal and responsible gaming (RG) requirements are built into every system from the start.

• Analyze creative performance data and user behavior to identify what’s working, and apply those insights to future concepts.

• Optimize visual hierarchy, layout, and composition (placement of offers, headlines, calls to action, and focal points) to maximize attention, click-through, and conversion.

• Partner with performance marketers to define test hypotheses and recommend design changes based on results.

• Use AI tools to accelerate concepting, asset production, and variation building.

• Review and guide work from designers and AI-generated outputs to keep craft and brand standards high at volume.

• Monitor trends in performance creative, social platforms, design, and emerging AI tools, and translate them into fresh, testable concepts.

• Develop and pitch new creative ideas for global and local campaigns.

• Oversee design projects from concept to delivery, collaborating with stakeholders and project managers to align creative to campaign goals and meet deadlines.

• Maintain brand consistency across all marketing projects.

Skills and Qualifications:

• 6+ years of proven experience as a Senior Designer, Graphic Designer, Art Director, or similar role.

• Portfolio that shows not only polished work but the thinking behind it, including digital and paid social creative, test results, iterations, or before-and-after performance.

• Experience designing for performance marketing or paid media, with a strong understanding of how design choices (contrast, scale, placement, copy treatment) affect metrics such as click-through rate, conversion, and cost per acquisition.

• Demonstrated ability to optimize hierarchy and layout based on user data, with examples of design decisions that improved performance, and comfort reading performance dashboards and creative analytics.

• Experience designing visual systems, master templates, or component libraries that scale across many formats and versions, including variations built for testing and iteration.

• Comfortable using AI tools (such as generative image tools and AI features within Adobe Creative Suite and Figma) to streamline workflows and expand creative output, with a strong eye for quality control.

• Proactive awareness of design, social, and advertising trends, with the judgment to know which are worth testing.

• Working knowledge of platform specs and best practices for paid channels such as Meta, TikTok, Google, and programmatic display.

• Hands-on experience with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.

• Strong aesthetic skills with the ability to combine colors, fonts, and layouts effectively.

• Experience working in the sports, tech, or gaming industries is a plus.

• Animation experience is a plus, but not required.

• Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to meet deadlines and collaborate with a team in a fast-paced environment.

• Open to regular travel to events and other Fanatics offices for offsite and team meetings.

For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Salary Range

$90,000—$120,000 USD

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here.

jobs.title: Test & Validation Integration Engineer - Federal
jobs.description:
Test & Validation Integration Engineer

(On-site role - 5 days per week - Active TS/SCI required)

The Test & Validation Integration Engineer serves as the critical bridge between staging and field deployment, ensuring enterprise-grade infrastructure operates seamlessly before reaching production sites. In this role, you will physically rack, stack, cable, and configure complex, multi-vendor compute, storage, and networking systems within a controlled lab environment. You will execute rigorous pre-deployment functionality tests, validate interoperability across network and container stacks, and fine-tune staging workflows to guarantee that onsite field teams can bring systems online rapidly with minimal friction. When configuration defects, hardware anomalies, or deployment bottlenecks arise, you will troubleshoot issues down to the component or protocol level, author prescriptive deployment runbooks, and collaborate directly with systems and network architects to ensure repeatable, zero-defect rollouts.

What You’ll Do

● Rack, Stack & Physical Integration: Physically assemble, mount, and cable high-density Dell PowerEdge servers, high-performance storage arrays, and network appliances within standard data center racks following structured cabling and thermal best practices.

● Multi-Vendor Device Provisioning: Apply baseline firmware, out-of-band management settings (iDRAC, console), and initial configurations across Cisco, Arista switches, Palo Alto firewalls, and Dell storage systems.

● Execute End-to-End Functionality Testing: Perform comprehensive pre-shipment validation, testing network throughput, VLAN segmentation, routing protocols, firewall policy enforcement, and storage volume availability prior to crating and shipping.

● Container & Platform Validation: Deploy, bootstrap, and validate baseline Kubernetes clusters across bare-metal and virtualized nodes, verifying container runtime health, CNI network plumbing, and persistent storage integration.

● Build & Optimize Deployment Runbooks: Formulate and refine step-by-step staging and commissioning procedures, identifying failure points in the lab so that field technicians can execute plug-and-play onsite activations with minimal engineering overhead.

Required Qualifications

● Systems & Network Integration: Hands-on experience racking, stacking, cabling, and configuring enterprise infrastructure—specifically involving Cisco, Arista, and Palo Alto hardware platforms.

● Server & High-Performance Storage: Practical proficiency provisioning enterprise compute (Dell PowerEdge) and enterprise storage fabrics (SAN/NAS, iSCSI, NVMe-oF, or NFS), including RAID configuration and out-of-band management (iDRAC).

● Kubernetes & Container Fundamentals: Practical experience installing, configuring, and verifying Kubernetes environments, container runtimes (containerd), and basic container networking/storage plugins.

● Pre-Deployment Diagnostics & Validation: Demonstrated ability to isolate physical and logical faults across Layer 1 through Layer 4 using CLI diagnostics, optics validation tools, and packet captures.

● Technical Authoring & Process Discipline: Strong documentation skills to write clear, foolproof Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), cabling diagrams, and site activation runbooks tailored for field deployment teams.

● Clearance: Active TS/SCI and the ability to maintain access as required by the program.

● Physical Requirements: Candidates must be able to lift up to 50lbs.

Preferred Qualifications

● Professional Certifications: Intermediate to advanced networking, systems, or security certifications such as Cisco CCNP, Arista ACE, Palo Alto PCNSE, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).

● Automation & Infrastructure as Code: Experience deploying configurations using Ansible, Terraform, Python, or Bash to accelerate repetitive staging workflows and validation suites.

● Advanced Network Architecture: In-depth understanding of leaf-spine architectures, BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, and stateful security inspection policies.

● Linux Systems Administration: Strong command of Linux internals, systemd services, kernel networking parameters, and driver/firmware upgrades.

● Lab & Data Center Operations: Familiarity with power distribution units (ePDU), high-density optic standards (QSFP28/QSFP-DD), and lab asset-tracking tools.

What We Offer

● Cutting-Edge Lab Access: Direct access to enterprise-class hardware, sandbox environments, and emerging software stacks.

● Technical Growth: Sponsored training, conference attendance, and certification support to continuously sharpen your engineering toolkit.

● Collaborative Engineering Culture: A multidisciplinary team that values bias for action, intellectual curiosity, and autonomous problem-solving.

jobs.title: Tech Compensation Business Partner
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About the team

The Cohere Total Rewards team is entering an exciting growth phase!  Our mission is to deliver a reward strategy that attracts, retains, and rewards world-class AI talent, in support of Cohere’s rapid global growth.  To help us achieve that goal, we’re hiring an experienced Technical Compensation Business Partner to own compensation design and execution for our Technical organization, and help build the compensation foundations for the wider business too.

About the Role

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who brings deep experience with AI/ML compensation, and who wants to have a foundational impact on a global business.

Reporting into the Head of Total Rewards, you will partner closely with Technical leaders, HR Business Partners, Talent, Finance, and other cross-functional teams, leading market benchmarking, offers,  and program design for highly sought-after technical talent - as well as contributing to wider compensation projects.

You’ll thrive in this role if you’re comfortable operating in ambiguity, have strong judgment and the ability to independently execute, and understand how to balance speed with thoughtfulness.  This role also requires significant experience with international compensation.

Key responsibilities

 - Act as the dedicated Compensation Business Partner for the Technical organization - owning compensation benchmarking, competitive intelligence, market analysis, and offer management for Technical roles across all markets;

 - Act as a trusted compensation advisor to our HRBPS and to leaders in our Technical org, supporting them with complex, high-stakes decisions

 - Design compensation programs, processes, and ways of working that support Cohere’s fast-growing business;

 - Support the design and delivery of our cyclical pay reviews, equity incentives, and other major programs, and own your groups’ compensation cycle actions end to end;

 - Act as a SME for our compensation technology and tooling;

 - Collaborate with the wider Compensation team and other stakeholders (Legal, Finance, HR Ops, Payroll) on a range of other compensation-related work including policy design, M&A, and pay equity and transparency.

Required Experience & Qualifications

 - 6+ years of compensation experience, including significant experience with compensation for AI/ML talent;

 - Demonstrated expertise in compensation strategy, benchmarking, and pay range design, preferably in a high-growth environment;

 - Significant experience with compensation in North America, the UK, and Europe;

 - Proven ability to bring clarity to ambiguous bodies of work, and own the outcomes;

 - Strong working knowledge of international compensation practices and the regulatory landscape (e.g. pay transparency);

 - Strong working knowledge of equity compensation;

 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage complex data to support rapid decision-making;

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build trust with senior stakeholders;

 - Adept at educating leaders and managers on compensation fundamentals and driving engagement with compensation programs and initiatives;

 - Experience deploying and managing Pave or similar compensation platforms.
   




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

regulatory compliance and international product registrations. Primary activities include coordinating

leading key regulatory submissions, and serving as the regulatory voice on project teams to ensure new
product requirements are met.

The Senior Regulatory Affairs Specialist will develop a thorough knowledge of Cadwell’s processes and
will drive performance feedback loops to improve overall product compliance. This is an on-site position
at our company headquarters in Kennewick, WA, with the option of a hybrid schedule.

Key duties and responsibilities

• Plans and prepares regulatory submissions for the US, EU and other key international markets, with a primary focus on EU MDR technical documentation and FDA 510(k) submissions; ensures timely execution to support product launches Prepares and performs document legalization for international product registrations and tenders

• Performs label reviews and approvals to ensure product labeling meets applicable regulatory requirements

• Clearly communicates information about regulatory submissions, new or changing regulatory requirements, and projects to appropriate internal and external contacts

• Participates in product recalls, vigilance decisions and the global response to product compliance issues

• Participates in internal and external audits and regulatory inspections

• Ensures products are shipped only to regions where regulatory approvals have been obtained, and resolves import or shipment holds in a timely manner

• Researches and applies appropriate regulatory strategies to support business needs and projects

• Evaluates applicable laws and regulations to determine their impact on company activities

jobs.title: 2027 Mission Operations Engineer Intern
jobs.location: Honolulu, Hawaii, United States; Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

We are seeking a Mission Operations Engineering Intern to join our Connected Warfare - Mission Command team. This multifaceted internship offers a unique rotation program that includes gaining hands-on experience with our software development team, program management team, and delivery team. This position is designed for an individual pursuing a degree in engineering, product management or a related field, who is eager to dive into the world of forward deployed software development and fielding.

This is a paid, in-person, 12 week summer internship but may require up to 75% travel.

ABOUT THE JOB

Orchestrate the deployment of Anduril products. Lead the planning and deployment of Anduril’s flagship hardware and software products in support of customer missions. Through collaboration with our engineering, logistics, and technical operations teams, Mission Operators are in charge of deploying our products to the field, training end users, and ensuring the high performance of our products. We are obsessed about engagement and keeping our finger on the pulse of how customers interact with our products. This helps us improve the user experience and evolve their operational tactics and techniques. And if something isn’t quite right, we work with product teams to quickly address the issue on behalf of our customer.

Grow your business through customer success. In addition to the operational and executive relationships you own, you will be responsible for meeting commercial targets that drive top line growth. This requires establishing committed and trust-based partnerships with our customers to not only help them solve their immediate problems, but also to foresee future opportunities where Anduril’s technology can make them more effective. Understanding Anduril’s value proposition and articulating how we can have an impact on a customer’s problem set, from the executive level to the end user, is critical to positioning Anduril for the future.

Shape our products to meet mission needs. Work side-by-side with our customers to understand their specific mission challenges and represent the customer as you work with Anduril engineers to shape products that solve critical national and international security challenges. Anduril engineers rely on Mission Operators to understand the lay of the land and bring a perspective that informs the product development process.

Collaborate across nearly every Anduril team. Successfully deploying our complex hardware and software products requires collaborating with nearly every internal Anduril team - business development, engineering, product, logistics, finance, legal, contracting, technical operations, and many more. You’ll be responsible for ensuring each party is engaged and informed, and will therefore become well-versed in what it takes to really bring the best of Anduril to our customers.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Serve in a customer-facing Account Manager capacity, working directly with the Department of Defense to develop and deploy Anduril integrated hardware-software C2 products to meet customer and operational needs. Own the delivery of contract deliverables to include the developing and implementing measures of performance and effectiveness, writing technical reports, and creating user engagement roadmaps

• Design & implement user feedback loops to gather, triage, and prioritize requirements, feedback, issues, and challenges found through the employment of Anduril C2 products during training, exercises, and normal use within unit schedules.

• Provide input to program and engineering teams to drive the development of product features and configurations that enhance or greatly improve efficiency of user workflows and employment of Anduril C2 products.

• Support engagement with other service components, Geographic Combatant Commands, and other Government organizations as required to integrate Anduril products laterally across Department of Defense customers for increased adoption.

• Develop and contribute to a streamlined user feedback and engagement system, which include issue tracking, training sessions, refreshers, and focused preparation for large scale exercises and events.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• Mission First Mindset. We put the needs of the mission and our customers first and understand that the US and its allies have no preordained right to victory in any future conflict. We actively seek out opportunities to better understand our customers’ mission needs, with a goal to build the best possible products for the warfighter and radically evolve our national and international defense capabilities. We push ourselves and the limits of our capabilities in the pursuit of this goal.

• Ownership Mentality. We’re looking for owners; those who have a natural bias to assume responsibility, a healthy dose of skepticism, and contribute to a culture of performance. We empower our Mission Operators to quickly assume high levels of responsibility and entrust them to actively own their account and shape its success. Our Mission Operators are just as comfortable helping to shape a proposal or pitch a new customer as they are working with engineers on new features or deploying products in the field.

• Technical Aptitude and Intellectual Curiosity. We are first and foremost a technology company, working at the leading edge of capabilities like machine learning, autonomy, distributed networking, and multi-modal sensor fusion. Do you have a natural desire to see beyond simple cause and effect relationships to really understand how complex systems operate? Do you actively seek out opportunities to educate yourself? These capabilities form the foundation of our product offerings, so we are looking for those who are comfortable communicating technical concepts and can articulate them in the context of the customer’s mission.

• Structured Thinker and Problem Solver. Leading technical programs requires clear communication and well thought-out plans. We are looking for assertive communicators who bring a thoughtful perspective and honest dialogue. A solution-driven approach, the ability to distill complexity into its essential, digestible components, and the ability to supervise execution are critical to ensure mission success.

• High Value Team Member. Do you enjoy working as part of a team? At Anduril, the path to success weaves through the organization - account teams, engineering, logistics, technical operations, and more. It requires humility, an eagerness to learn, and empathy toward your fellow team members. We assume best intentions and empathize with customers just as we do with our colleagues. Can you develop rapport at both the user and executive levels? Do you enjoy sharing successes? We are a low ego group that promotes teamwork and collaboration to bring about success.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Must be pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in a related field.

• Must be returning to school at the end of the internship to continue academic studies for at least one quarter or semester.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program.

• Ability to complete an in-person 12-week internship in one of our offices in summer 2027.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience in technical program/product/account management roles

• Experience translating and decomposing highly technical concepts into operational requirements and performance specifications

• Experience in program management and product deployment roles

• Experience and familiarity with Army intelligence, operational planning, targeting, and fires systems and workflows

• Familiarity with doctrinal, functional, and technical command and control concepts, processes, and principles

• Prior military or government acquisition and/or government contracting experience

• Active Secret Clearance strongly preferred

US Hourly Range

$28—$45 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

jobs.title: Associate Forward Deployed Solution Engineer Intern (Bachelors Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
Team bio

ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is where bold ideas meet real-world impact. We work with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. We find high-value opportunities, speed up business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that make the ServiceNow AI Platform even better.

Why this internship matters

Enterprises want AI that delivers real value, not just potential. Our Associate FDEs turn the latest LLM capabilities into secure, scalable software that customers rely on. As an Associate FDE Intern, you’ll learn how that happens by doing it. You’ll join a live delivery team, build real features, and see how great engineers take an idea from whiteboard to working solution.

Who you are

You’re a curious, hands-on builder who likes making things work. You’ve experimented with LLMs, APIs, or AI tools in class projects, hackathons, or on your own time. • Familiarity with SQL, pandas, or basic ML concepts

jobs.title: Ad Operations Manager
jobs.description:
State Affairs is the nation’s leading news and policy intelligence platform focused on state governments. We combine nonpartisan coverage of Statehouses across the country alongside state government data and AI-native tools into a singular platform.

We inform and empower decision makers, policy professionals and citizens through our award-winning journalism and data – delivering profound insights to help our customers decode and act on state politics and  policy. We’re building a category-defining business that will reshape America as we strengthen visibility into what’s happening and why at the state level.

We are hiring an Ad Operations Manager to join our team in Washington, DC.

As the Ad Operations Manager, you will:

• Own end-to-end campaign execution across newsletters, digital display, sponsored content, and new product offerings, from insertion order through final reporting

• Traffic, schedule, and QA all campaigns in our ad server and newsletter platforms, ensuring creative, targeting, links, and tracking are accurate before launch

• Manage the production calendar and inventory availability across all O&O newsrooms and national products, flagging conflicts and avails to the sales team

• Serve as the operational point of contact for advertisers and agencies on creative specs, asset deadlines, approvals, and campaign questions

• Monitor campaign pacing and delivery daily; troubleshoot underdelivery, broken creative, and tracking issues and resolve them quickly

• Build and deliver post-campaign and in-flight performance reports that clearly communicate results to clients and internal teams

• Coordinate sponsored content production with sales, design, and product teams, keeping disclosure and brand standards consistent

• Partner with finance on billing, makegoods, and reconciliation so invoices match delivered impressions and placements

• Maintain accurate records in our CRM and order management systems, and support sales with forecasting and inventory data

• Document and improve ad operations workflows, specs, and processes as State Affairs scales its advertising business

Essential Qualifications for this position include:

• 3+ years of professional work experience in digital advertising operations, campaign management, or ad trafficking at a publisher, media company, or agency

• Prior professional work experience with ad servers (such as Google Ad Manager) and email newsletter platforms

• Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines at once with exceptional attention to detail

• Ability to analyze campaign data and build clear, accurate performance reports

• Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with clients, agencies, and internal teams

• Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with sales, editorial, product, marketing, and finance

• Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently, including creative rendering, tracking pixels, and UTM parameters

• Proficiency with spreadsheets and CRM systems (such as HubSpot)

Preferred Qualifications for this position include:

• Bachelor's degree in relevant field

• Experience supporting advertising for policy, public affairs, advocacy, or B2B media audiences

• Familiarity with sponsored content and native advertising workflows

• Basic HTML and CSS knowledge for email and display creative

• Prior professional work experience in a start-up organization

This is an in office work opportunity and our teams operate from the Washington, DC office located at L and 15th St. NW five days per week. State Affairs offers a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package to employees.

The annual compensation range for this role as it is posted is $100,000 to $120,000 (on target earnings) for candidates working from the State Affairs office in Washington, DC. The final job level and annual salary will be determined based on the education, qualification, knowledge, skills, ability, and experience of the final candidate(s), and calibrated against relevant market data and internal team equity.  Benefits listed in this posting may vary depending on the nature of your employment with State Affairs.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future company sponsorship.

State Affairs is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit and business needs.  State Affairs does not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with federal, state, and local law.
