jobs.title: Member of Data Science Staff
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABRIDGE

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.




THE ROLE

Our generative AI-powered products are revolutionizing the practice of medicine, and we’re looking for a highly motivated Senior Data Scientist to join our growing US-based Data Science team. Your work will be instrumental in driving product strategy, directly influencing how healthcare professionals engage with patient data. You’ll work across Abridge’s full product portfolio, partnering with product, engineering, science, commercial and finance teams to drive decisions with data.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Extract meaningful insights and identify trends and patterns relevant to our business and product, by collecting, cleaning, and analyzing internal and external data.

 - Ensure end-to-end visibility and understanding of our AI generation pipelines, from internal quality metrics to automated assessment in production.

 - Investigate and correct issues identified through data operations monitors, tools, and reports.

 - User Behavior Modeling: Identify user patterns and insights by analyzing user interactions, engagement metrics, funnel analysis, etc. for product improvement and feature development. It is critical for data to drive increased user engagement and retention.

 - A/B Testing: Design and analyze A/B tests to evaluate the effectiveness of product features and design changes.

 - AI model evaluation: Design and analyze metrics to evaluate our AI models, guide the team on gaps in evaluation processes, and drive solutions to improve measurable outcomes.

 - Collaboration with Product Teams: Work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate data insights into product priorities.

 - Serve as a domain expert for the business context of our analytics data, sharing your understanding of the assumptions and limitations of our business metrics.

 - Continually enhance our understanding of the business and product, by identifying and filling gaps in our data sources. This includes working closely with multidisciplinary teams such as product, engineering, partner success, and the executive team.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 8+ years using Python, R, SQL for analytics

 - 5+ years in product-facing roles, driving product outcomes through A/B testing, defining aggressive project and company-level goals, and helping teams achieve them.

 - Experience with data visualization tools, both BI tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, Sigma) and code-based tools (e.g. Seaborn, ggplot2)

 - Excellent communicator capable of effectively delivering quantitative findings to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and compelling fashion.

 - Comfort building data capabilities from the earliest stages through rapid growth, including interfacing closely with data engineering and machine learning

Bonus

 - Knowledge of healthcare settings, electronic health records (EHR), and healthcare billing are all a plus
   
   

Must be willing to work from our SF or NYC office at least 3x per week

This position requires a commitment to a hybrid work model, with the expectation of coming into the office a minimum of (3) three times per week.

We value people who are eager to learn new things and recognize that great team members might not perfectly match a job description. If you’re interested in the role but aren’t sure whether or not you’re a good fit, we’d still like to hear from you.




WHY WORK AT ABRIDGE?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.



HOW WE TAKE CARE OF ABRIDGERS:

 - Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

 - Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

 - Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

 - Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

 - Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

 - 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

 - Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

 - Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

 - Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

 - Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

 - Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

 - Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

 - ... and much more!


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.




STAYING SAFE - PROTECT YOURSELF FROM RECRUITMENT FRAUD

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com http://abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2023/05/scammers-are-hijacking-job-ads-heres-how-spot-fakes. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

jobs.title: Per Diem Digital Clinician | NP (CA license)
jobs.description:
About Us

Galileo is a team-based medical practice working to improve the quality and affordability of health care for all. Operating across 50 states, Galileo offers high-touch, data-driven, multi-specialty, longitudinal care to diverse and complex patients—on the phone, in the home, and everywhere in between. Regional and national health plans, employers, and Fortune 500 organizations trust Galileo as the leading solution to improve population health. Founded by Dr. Tom X. Lee, the healthcare pioneer behind One Medical and Epocrates, Galileo is a team of leading innovators from healthcare, technology, and human-centered design. Our mission is to apply that talent and scientific thinking to transform society by solving our largest, toughest healthcare problems, while at the same time bringing patient and provider closer.

About The Role

Galileo is looking for culturally sensitive clinicians to join our digital-first, primary care medical group. In this role, you will use asynchronous text-based chat and synchronous video to provide high-quality, comprehensive and evidence-based primary care. As a part of our collaborative clinical care team, you will leverage data, technology, and operational rigor to optimize great patient outcomes while offering highly personalized care and shared decision making with patients.

Here’s What You'll Do:

• Provide best-in-class care for Galileo patients managing complex and chronic illnesses through our innovative, proprietary app and technology and your excellent clinical judgment.

• Provide compassionate and empathetic care to patients from age 0-100 across all needs, including complex, chronic medical conditions such as: diabetes, hypertension, obesity and mental health.

• Work with a diverse patient population. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture that is inclusive of all backgrounds.

• Solve patient problems in an efficient, nimble manner by drawing on resourcefulness, collaborating with team members to leverage their expertise, and a “can-do” approach.

How We Work

Galileo is a 24/7 medical group utilizing asynchronous text-based chat and synchronous video to provide high-quality, comprehensive primary care. We work in 4-hour shifts (mornings, afternoons, evenings, overnight on weekdays and weekends) and require a minimum of 14 hours a week (alternating 12 and 16 hour weeks). At 24+ hours you will be considered full-time and benefits eligible.

We are currently looking for CA licensed Nurse Practitioners who are able to work 12 hours/month.

Compensation: $80/hour (regular rate) and $90/hour (premium rate)

About You

We look for passionate clinicians who are invested in solving complex problems that impact millions of lives and are excited about fixing what’s broken to improve care quality and health outcomes for everyone. We believe in a culture that fosters teamwork, excellence, and sound decision-making—one that is based on mutual respect and trust. We appreciate individuals who are open and honest about what they’re looking for so we can ensure it’s a fit on both sides.

We would love to hear from you if you have the following or equivalent experience:

• Have 5+ years of clinical experience post residency in complex care, chronic care management, or primary care.

• Are experienced in or have an appetite for learning digital-first healthcare (e.g. virtual medicine).

• Are interested in new, innovative models of care that balance evidence-based approaches with creative ideas.

• Are highly comfortable with using technology and various applications to deliver care to patients virtually. Our current tech stack is:

• Proprietary built clinician-patient platform

• Google Suite (gmail, sheets, docs, etc)

• Slack

• Are board certified in Family Medicine or Adult Medicine

• Active state licensure in CA, with the ability to obtain additional state licensures.

• It's a bonus if you are professionally fluent in English/Spanish including reading, writing, speaking, and understanding the cultural nuances for native Spanish speakers in a medical setting.

How We Care for You:

• Flexible scheduling - design the schedule that works best for YOU

• Competitive health, vision and dental plans

• Company paid short and long term disability

• 12 weeks paid parental leave

• Malpractice insurance provided, including tail coverage

• 401(k) with company match

How We Hire

Galileo Health is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

We have recently become aware of the fraudulent use of our name on job postings and via recruiting emails that are illegitimate and not in any way associated with us. We will never ask you to provide sensitive personal information as part of the recruiting process, such as your social security number; send you any unsolicited job offers or employment contracts; require any fees, payments or access to any financial accounts; and/or conduct text-only interviews. If you suspect you are being scammed or have been scammed online, you may report the crime to the Federal Bureau of Investigation and obtain more information regarding online scams at the Federal Trade Commission.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELICIT:


Elicit is an AI research agent built to radically improve reasoning for high-stakes decisions. AI will transform how organizations operate, and we want to make sure that goes well. Today, 8 of the top 20 pharmaceutical companies use Elicit. The problems we solve are specific to pharma today and fundamental to every high-stakes domain tomorrow. We build Elicit to be systematic, transparent, and rigorous enough to enable high-quality reasoning at scale.

We’re a Series A startup and Public Benefit Corporation with about 35 mission-driven people doing the work of many more. We’ve reached strong product-market fit and are seeing significant inbound interest from leading research-driven enterprises.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTER:

As an early member of the Customer Success team, you’ll own a book of enterprise accounts, from mid-market up to strategic pharma relationships at $200K+ ACV, and be accountable for adoption, retention, and expansion across it. Beyond your own accounts, you’ll help build how we do CS: working with a small, early team to turn what works into the playbooks, frameworks, and programs that let us scale. You’ll report to the Head of Sales and work closely with Sales and Product.





WHAT YOU'LL DO:

This is an execution role with strategic contribution. Our Senior Customer Success Managers  run customer onboarding, conduct QBRs, manage expansion opportunities, and solve customer challenges day-to-day, while also contributing to CS artifacts that codify best practices and enable the team to scale effectively.

 - Own a book of enterprise accounts end to end: onboarding, health monitoring, renewals, and expansion

 - Run executive business reviews with VP and C-suite stakeholders at pharma and research organizations

 - Use product usage data to spot risk and expansion opportunities early, then act on them

 - Help build the CS foundation with the team: playbooks, onboarding sequences, QBR frameworks, and templates

 - Bring what you learn from customers back to Sales and Product

 - As the customer base grows, design scaled programs such as training series, cohort onboarding, and champion networks




WHAT YOU BRING:

 - Enterprise CS experience. 5+ years in B2B SaaS or AI-forward Customer Success supporting technical or specialized users, with full ownership of renewals and expansion on enterprise accounts ($50K–$200K+ ACV).

 - Pharma or regulated industry experience. Pharma or life sciences experience is strongly preferred. We’ll also consider other regulated industries, such as healthcare, medical devices, or clinical research, if you’re curious and quick to learn the domain. Bonus: familiarity with evidence workflows like systematic reviews, HEOR, HTA, or regulatory submissions.

 - AI fluency. You understand what AI can and can’t do well enough to explain accuracy, confidence, and responsible use to researchers who hold us to rigorous standards. You have a point of view on how AI is changing knowledge work.

 - Builder instincts. You think in systems and repeatable processes. You’re as comfortable designing an onboarding sequence as running a high-stakes QBR. You’ve worked at an early-stage startup, worn multiple hats, and built from ambiguity.

 - Executive presence. You translate product capabilities into business outcomes that land with VP and C-suite stakeholders. Your QBRs end with “we need to expand this.”

 - Data-driven operator. You’ve owned retention and expansion metrics such as NRR, gross retention, and health scores, and you’re comfortable in product analytics tools like Mixpanel.

 - Domain curiosity. You’ll read research papers to understand customer workflows because you’re interested, not because you have to.



Location and Travel
We have a great office in Oakland, CA, and we’d love to see you there if you’re local. That said, we’re just as happy for you to work remotely. We do get the whole team together for a quarterly retreat somewhere fun, because in-person time matters to us.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive OTE of $150K–$250K with above-market equity

 - Fully covered health, dental, vision, and life insurance for you + generous family coverage

 - Every Elician receives a $200 monthly wellbeing stipend to spend on whatever supports your health and wellbeing

 - Flexible vacation with a recommendation of 20 days

 - 401(k) with 6% employer match

 - $2,000 device budget + ongoing equipment refresh

 - Personal and professional development budget

 - Flexible work environment across North America and Europe, with quarterly in-person retreats and coworking events

jobs.title: Principal Incident Response Engineer (Starshield)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PRINCIPAL INCIDENT RESOPNSE ENGINEER (STARSHIELD)

At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy the Starshield constellation. Starshield is the world’s largest US government satellite constellation and is tasked with providing immediate access to critical intelligence and national security data for the US government anywhere on the globe. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – in-space sensors, on-the-ground receivers, data processing, and the mesh network that provides lightning-fast connectivity to users around the world. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starshield's global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help us further our ambitious goals.

We are looking for a principal engineer to grow and lead a team of engineers who are developing and continually testing the cyber defenses of the Starshield network. This job will be hands-on and require breadth of experience in both software and security. A great candidate for this role appreciates a challenge, thrives on curiosity, and wants to make a difference in the world.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead a team of cybersecurity engineers. This team's priority is to be prepared for immediate response to any active threat against our systems.

• Implement Starshield's cyber defense strategy. Continually assess the landscape of cyber threats and develop specific countermeasures for the Starshield systems. Continually run "red-team" style exercises to both discover vulnerabilities as well as to practice the tactics the team will deploy in the event of attacks.

• Lead vulnerability discovery efforts across Starshield. Run internal bug hunts to search for undiscovered vulnerabilities. Develop a team culture of continual curiosity and open-ended exploration. Utilize the latest tools, including AI, to accelerate both discovery and fixing of bugs in the system.

• Drive improvements into our incident discovery and response. This team will collaborate closely with the team building the internal systems we use to detect security events, and help drive improvement in our ability to discover active attempts at network intrusions.

• Work across teams to get results. This team will collaborate closely with the engineers implementing security features into our systems, as well as the team developing our internal incident discovery tools.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer security, or a similar field, and 7+ years of professional experience in cybersecurity for active production systems; OR 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity for active production systems.

• Experience leading a team of direct reports.

• Experience in implementing systems for adversary detection and incident response.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Expertise in computer networks and large-scale distributed compute platforms.

• Experience leading a team of 3-5 engineers on a technical project in cybersecurity.

• Expertise in vulnerability discovery and triage.

• Experience in continuity of operations planning.

• Experience with performing Blue Team or Red Team assessments.

• Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to nontechnical audiences.

• Ability to deal with ambiguity and to learn new technologies quickly.

• Advanced degree in a technical or engineering discipline.

• Active Top Secret, Top Secret SCI, or DOE Level Q clearance.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

• This position requires successfully obtaining and maintaining a Top Secret Security Clearance as a condition of employment. While the clearance may not be immediately necessary upon hire, we encourage you to initiate the application process promptly upon accepting this offer. Your ability to secure the necessary clearance is essential for fulfilling key responsibilities of the role. Should you be unable to obtain it, SpaceX reserves the right to modify or terminate your employment to align with operational needs.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

Level 3: $225,000.00 - $340,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

About Us

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, Ohio, Kentucky, Mississippi, and Georgia. Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. Ennoble Care offers a variety of programs including, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health management, and chronic care management, to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care by a team they know and trust. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

Job Summary:

Ennoble Care is looking for a Full-time Hospice On-Call Registered Nurse (7 On / 7 Off) to provide care and support to terminally ill patients within and around the Philadelphia, PA area. Your presence and services should bring comfort to the person who faces the end of their lives and help them reach acceptance and peace of mind. A compassionate nature and excellent interpersonal skills will make you a good candidate for this position. We expect you to be knowledgeable in caring for the terminally ill, performing tasks such as administering medication and providing emotional support. The goal is to help patients live their final days with dignity and comfort.

Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with physicians and other professionals to plan care

• Triage phone calls

• Make visits to the patient as needed to evaluate their condition

• Provide support and comfort according to individual patient’s needs

• Work with caregivers to plan and execute excellent patient care

• Help in administering medication

• Alleviate sudden symptoms of the disease’s end phase

• Notify a doctor for a patient’s condition when deemed necessary

• Assist patients and their families with paperwork

• Maintain accurate records

• Help relatives cope with the upcoming loss and provide post-mortem support

Qualifications:

• Must be a graduate from an accredited School of Nursing.

• Must be licensed in PA as a Registered Nurse by Pennsylvania State Board of Nursing.

• One year of RN experience. Hospice experience preferred.

• Must have excellent assessment skills and problem solving skills.

• Should be skillful in organization and in the principles of time management and have knowledge of case management processes.

• Must be a licensed driver with an insured automobile in good working order.

• The ability to communicate well, both verbally and in writing.

• Must have no exceptions to RN license, and be able to administer pharmaceuticals, perform medication reconciliation, and any nursing procedures or special treatments needed within the scope of nursing practice for state. All skills to be competencies before actual hands-on patient care, and when procedures or treatments are not usually performed.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Kubernetes Control Plane - Lambda Kubernetes Service
jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.



If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.



*Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco or Bellevue office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.


About the Role

Lambda Kubernetes Service (LKS) is an API-first Kubernetes platform for AI training and inference on Lambda infrastructure. We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the team designing and building LKS’s control plane: the platform that manages the lifecycle of hosted Kubernetes control planes across customers.

This is a control plane of control planes. The team builds the systems to provision, configure, upgrade, scale, monitor, back up, and recover hosted control planes and their supporting host fleet. You’ll set the technical direction and grow the team to make these operations automated, reliable, and scalable as LKS adoption grows.

This team is the reliability and scalability spine of LKS. It owns the availability and lifecycle of customer control planes, including provisioning, upgrades, backups, recovery, observability, and incident response. You’ll build the team and operational practices needed to deliver a dependable service.


What You’ll Do

 - Build and lead the engineering team, develop technical leaders, and establish clear operational ownership.

 - Collaborate with technical leads in designing the architecture and roadmap for the LKS hosted control-plane platform and its supporting host fleet.

 - Build automated systems for control-plane provisioning, configuration, upgrades, scaling, health management, replacement, and decommissioning.

 - Build and own the platform that provisions, scales, and operates LKS hosted control planes, including the API server, etcd, scheduler, and controller manager so customer clusters can be managed reliably and with minimal manual intervention.

 - Own the reliability and operation of the hosted Kubernetes control plane, including the API server, etcd, scheduler, and controller manager.

 - Manage the control-plane host lifecycle: provisioning, patching, scaling, monitoring, replacement, and decommissioning.

 - Deliver safe upgrade, backup, restore, and disaster-recovery processes.

 - Define service objectives, observability, capacity practices, and incident response for a customer-facing service.

 - Lead a sustainable on-call rotation, including escalation, runbooks, and follow-through on incident actions.

 - Automate provisioning and operations to make cluster bring-up predictable and repeatable.

 - Partner with the Kubernetes Platform team on service boundaries, compatibility, and release readiness.

 - Work with Compute, Networking, IAM, and Security teams to meet LKS reliability and security requirements.

 - Communicate service health, risks, and operational readiness clearly to leadership and partner teams.

You

 - Have 9+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years leading engineering teams.

 - Have built and operated highly available distributed systems or infrastructure services with production on-call responsibilities.

 - Bring strong technical judgment across Kubernetes control planes, Linux hosts, reliability, and failure recovery.

 - Have experience setting or delivering against SLOs or SLAs.

 - Can guide tradeoffs across availability, security, performance, cost, and operability.

 - Build strong teams and work effectively across infrastructure and product organizations.

 - Communicate clearly and set a high bar for operational discipline and ownership.

 - Hold a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or a related field, or have equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

 - Experience operating Kubernetes control planes, etcd, or managed Kubernetes services.

 - Experience with host fleet management, infrastructure automation, or cloud compute and networking APIs.

 - Experience with disaster recovery and stateful distributed systems.

 - Experience operating customer-facing services with strict reliability or security requirements.

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.




About Lambda

 - Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast

 - Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove

 - We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG

 - Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers

 - We offer generous cash & equity compensation

 - Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

 - Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles

 - 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)

 - Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

Equal Opportunity Employer

Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Connected Warfare
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Connected Warfare is the division at Anduril dedicated to the modernization of the global command and control systems of U.S. and Allied forces.  New technologies and new adversaries demand a new approach to battlefield intelligence, and our hardware and software products are rapidly scaling in production to deliver the volumes and capabilities that our customers need.  Our ecosystem enables connected warfare with disproportional impact by connecting every robot, human, and sensor in every domain, bringing together hundreds of thousands of end points across the globe.

As a Senior Mechanical Engineer in Connected Warfare, you will be the driving force behind designing, building, and sustaining the physical systems that give soldiers on the front lines the computing, communications, and command and control capabilities they need to succeed and survive in any environment. If this sounds exciting to work towards, please learn more on our website here.

After reviewing our website above, please note that within Connected Warfare, our Menace-I and Menace-X teams are actively hiring Mechanical Engineers to work in our Costa Mesa, CA headquarters.  If these products look interesting and you're either already living in Orange County, CA, or are open to a paid relocation there, we invite you to read further to learn about the open roles on these teams!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a hands-on owner of hardware across its lifecycle, you'll take real technical ownership from concept through fielded, in-production systems. Your responsibilities will include:

* Own Hardware End-to-End: Take designs from concept generation through prototyping, qualification, production ramp, and sustained use in the hands of warfighters.
* Design From the Ground Up: Engineer novel hardware for demanding mission sets, sometimes starting from a blank sheet, and sometimes revising and improving existing designs as products evolve.
* Understand the Mission: Work directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand real battlefield challenges and translate them into hardware that solves them.
* Engineer for Survival: Apply engineering first principles, analysis, and rigorous testing to ensure designs survive the harshest battlefield conditions and pass qualification campaigns.
* Get Hands-On: Build and iterate on prototypes and first articles yourself, moving quickly from idea to physical hardware.
* Resolve Production Issues: Investigate quality issues, drawing errors, and manufacturing challenges using root cause analysis (RCA) and permanent corrective action (PCA), and partner with manufacturing to feed design-for-manufacture-and-assembly (DFMA) improvements back into the design.
* Deliver at Scale: Partner with manufacturing and production teams to build and ship hardware at volume.
* Collaborative Innovation: Work day to day as part of a tight-knit product team alongside designers, manufacturing engineers, and production partners, moving fast in an environment of rapid iteration and technical excellence.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* 7+ years of professional, post-graduate mechanical engineering experience.
* Demonstrated ability to design, prototype, and ship hardware, with a proven track record of design ownership in a team setting (professional or otherwise).
* High competence with, and fluid application of, engineering first principles.
* Strong CAD skills and the ability to produce high-quality engineering drawings and documentation.
* Demonstrated hands-on fabrication skills.
* BS or higher in an engineering field.
* Must be a U.S. Person, due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.
* Excitement to work onsite at our headquarters in Costa Mesa, CA the majority of the time!

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Experience with Siemens NX and Teamcenter PLM.
* Ability to integrate electronic components into mechanical designs (motors, controllers, sensors, etc.).
* Hands-on experience with machining, sheet metal, composites, and 3D printing.
* Knowledge of static, dynamic, or thermal analysis methods and their application in ANSYS.
* Experience managing products in medium- to high-volume production, including BOM ownership and formal change management across multiple configurations.
* Experience with root cause analysis (RCA) and permanent corrective action (PCA) for quality improvement.

US Salary Range

$150,000—$191,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior People Operations Solutions Manager, Service Delivery
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

When someone at Crusoe needs help with a People question, they should know exactly where to go and get a fast, accurate answer, whether they sit at a desk or work a shift on a manufacturing floor. You'll build that front door.

As the Senior People Operations Solutions Manager for HR Service Delivery, you are the product manager for how employees and managers get help: the People portal, case management, the knowledge platform, AI agents and the channels people use to reach us, from mobile and text to phone and on-site kiosks. AI and knowledge answer first, and people step in where judgment and care matter. Every case a person solves should make the knowledge, and the AI, better next time.

Reporting to the Director, People Operations Solutions you lead solution teams with Employee Care, the Knowledge Manager, Lifecycle Operations, UX design, analytics and IT. You'll bring a bias toward automation and AI, and the judgment to keep a human in the loop where it counts.

 - Case management: design intake, routing, tiering and escalation so every request is tracked, owned and closed by the right team, and reaches the right expert with full context.

 - Knowledge platform: with the Knowledge Manager, build the knowledge base and the practices that help content owners keep it accurate, so AI and self-service resolve more questions over time.

 - AI and automation: design AI agents and automated workflows that answer questions and complete simple requests, with clear hand-offs to people and guardrails for sensitive matters.

 - Service catalog: define and maintain the catalog of People services, with owners, tiers and service levels for each.

Starshield is the world’s largest US government satellite constellation and is tasked with providing immediate access to critical intelligence and national security data for the US government anywhere on the globe. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – in-space sensors, on-the-ground receivers, data processing, and the mesh network that provides lightning-fast connectivity to users around the world. jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

The Compliance Data team owns the foundational data layer that every regulatory obligation at Coinbase depends on. We are a centralized team within Coinbase's Platform organization, and we build the trusted, certified data that the rest of the company relies on to answer regulators with confidence.

At the center of our work is the Compliance Data Mart (CDM), Coinbase's canonical source of truth for user, transaction, and compliance data. Our focus is the data foundations beneath every regulatory report, making sure they are accurate, consistent, well-modeled, and trustworthy. When a number is wrong in a regulatory filing, the root cause usually traces back to the data layer. We own that layer, and we make sure it holds.

While building durable foundations is our core mission, we also support live regulatory exams, audits, and time-sensitive data requests. You should be comfortable balancing long-term foundational work with occasional reactive, deadline-driven asks. Regulators operate on their timelines, not ours.

Analytics Engineer is a hybrid role that blends data engineering and data science. You'll bring the engineering discipline to build durable, production-grade pipelines and data models, and the analytical instincts to understand what the data means, where it breaks, and how stakeholders will use it. The details matter here, because everything built on top of our foundations inherits our quality.

What We Do:

• Own the Compliance Data Mart (CDM): Build and certify Coinbase's single source of truth for user, transaction, and compliance data across retail and institutional entities

• Build Foundational Data Models: Design the user, transaction, and compliance data models that downstream reporting, analytics, and AI workflows all build on

• Keep Foundations Current: Evolve our core data models as Coinbase's products, entities, and regulatory requirements change, proactively absorbing upstream changes before they break anything downstream

• Drive Data Quality at the Source: Monitor quality from source system into the CDM, catching and fixing issues before they ever reach a report

• Support Live Regulatory Needs: Provide accurate, timely data for regulatory exams, audits, and ad hoc regulator requests when they come up

• Enable Self-Serve and Automation: Build the foundations and tooling that let downstream teams and AI agents answer their own questions, instead of depending on manual data pulls

jobs.title: ML Research Scientist, Active Learning
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Nuro believes self-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that’s why we’re building a universal autonomy platform: self-driving for all roads and all rides.

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.

With years of real-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected.

Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.

About the Role

In this role, you will be working as a member of the Foundation Models team and leveraging the cutting edge of machine learning research to solve practical, real-world, challenging problems. You will focus on developing and implementing innovative strategies in active learning, data curation, and quality research, to enhance the effectiveness and adaptability of our core behavior prediction, planning, foundation models (LLMs, VLMs and VLAs). Your contributions will play a crucial role in optimizing our data utilization, model performance, and decision-making processes for real-world autonomous driving applications. If you love solving challenging new problems with a mindset of deriving practical solutions to eventually be used on the vehicle, come join us!

About the Work

• Develop and implement innovative active learning methods to refine data selection, filtering, and mixing strategies for our core behavior prediction, planning, foundation models (VLMs, VLAs).

• Lead initiatives to improve data quality, detect anomalies, and manage out-of-distribution examples to ensure robust model training and deployment.

• Work as a part of an autonomy team to build effective and efficient ML data pipelines and processes.

• Experiment quickly and fail fast, develop and leverage state-of-the-art ML models and techniques, and publish blog posts and/or papers highlighting successes.

• Work with data collection and labeling teams to set a high quality bar for incoming data

• Develop practical ML solutions, deploy models to the Nuro Driver, and witness their real-world impact on the road.

About You

You have deep expertise and prior experience in some or many of the following areas:

• You have 3+ years of experience working with machine learning using deep networks and large volumes of data either in industry or as part of a PhD.

• You have subject matter expertise and research in one or more of the following areas: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Robotics (bonus), and have some familiarity with the state of the art in ML for autonomous driving and data utilization (bonus).

• You have an expertise in at least one of the following domains:

• Active learning, data selection and curation

• Curriculum learning, continual learning

• Out-of-distribution (OOD) and anomaly detection

• Influence functions and data attribution methods

• You have strong problem-solving and programming skills (Python)

• Strong culture fit and good team player

• You have an M.Sc. or Ph.D. focusing on one or more of the following areas: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or a closely related field

• Demonstrated research publications in any of the major conferences is a bonus (RSS, ICRA, CoRL, CVPR, ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, ICCV, AAAI, etc.)

At Nuro, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity, and a competitive benefits package.

jobs.title: Avionics Production Supervisor, Sensors (Falcon)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

AVIONICS PRODUCTION SUPERVISOR (SENSORS) – 1st SHIFT

The Avionics Sensors Production Supervisor leads a team of technicians responsible for the assembly, test, and rework of flight-critical sensors and transducers. Manufacturing processes include precision electromechanical assembly, torque and adhesive operations, wire bonding, laser and resistance welding, and thermal and high-pressure testing.

The supervisor drives hour-by-hour and day-by-day progress on the production floor while building a productive, disciplined, and high-performing team. This role requires a hands-on leader with a strong technical understanding of electromechanical assemblies who works closely with technicians, engineering, and support teams to achieve safety, quality, and production rate targets.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead daily Avionics Sensors production operations, providing clear work assignments and priorities aligned with production schedules and organizational goals

• Lead, manage, and develop a team of production technicians, including recruiting, onboarding, training, performance reviews, recognition, and corrective action

• Establish clear expectations for performance and adherence to processes, area standards, and run rules; provide respectful, actionable, timely, and documented feedback

• Develop and execute production schedules and recovery plans; identify and mitigate risks to rate, yield, and on-time delivery

• Partner with production control, supply chain, materials, engineering, quality, and maintenance to resolve shortages, equipment issues, and other production interruptions

• Work alongside technicians and engineering to troubleshoot assembly and test issues, resolve recurring problems, and maintain continuous production flow

• Ensure product quality, traceability, and conformance to engineering specifications and controlled manufacturing processes

• Coordinate with engineering and quality to resolve nonconforming hardware, ensuring approved dispositions and rework are documented and executed correctly

• Ensure employee safety through regular assessments of equipment, tooling, training, and PPE use; halt production when necessary to address unsafe conditions

• Drive a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and cooperation within and between shifts and departments; maintain 5S standards

• Monitor staffing, labor hours, and overtime; align technician skills and available capacity with production needs while maintaining a sustainable workload

• Establish and analyze area metrics to drive:

• Personnel training, cross-training, and development

• Increased throughput, first-pass yield, and on-time delivery

• Optimization of product flow, cycle time, and work-in-process inventory

• Root cause analysis and implementation of effective corrective actions

• Identification and elimination of defects, rework, and production bottlenecks

• Improved labor and equipment utilization and reduced downtime

• Cost reduction and efficiency improvement projects

• Coordinate equipment preventive maintenance, calibration, tooling readiness, and consumable availability to support production requirements

• Lead efforts to transition products and processes from engineering development to full-rate production

• Review drawings, technical data packages, and work instructions for manufacturability; partner with engineering to implement changes that simplify assembly, improve process reliability, and increase output

jobs.title: Senior UX Researcher
jobs.description:
Senior UX Researcher — First Research Hire

Finni empowers therapists to launch their own clinical practices quickly. After clinic launch, Finni has a suite of products (EHR, CRM, etc) and services that helps therapists manage clinic operations.

We’re hiring our first UX researcher to bring a deeper understanding of our customers into how we define problems, design solutions, and build products. You’ll partner closely with product, design, engineering, and customer service to understand customers’ workflows, identify their underlying needs, and test our assumptions. Your work will shape product requirements before design begins and evaluate proposed experiences directly with customers before we build them.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with the opportunity to establish how research works at Finni.

What you’ll do

 - Shape product decisions early. Partner on product requirements documents (PRDs) to clarify customer problems, identify assumptions, and define the questions we need to answer before choosing a solution.

 - Understand customers in context. Conduct interviews and observe workflows to understand what customers are trying to accomplish, where they struggle, and how they work around problems today.

 - Turn feedback into research questions. Bring together support conversations, customer feedback, and available product data to identify patterns and investigate the needs behind feature requests.

 - Test designs with customers. Work with designers to plan and conduct usability studies using concepts, prototypes, and existing experiences. Evaluate whether customers understand the proposed solution, can complete important tasks, and see their needs addressed.

 - Make findings useful. Translate evidence into clear implications for product scope, design decisions, and priorities. Communicate what we know, what remains uncertain, and what deserves further investigation.

 - Build a lightweight research practice. Establish practical approaches to participant recruitment, study planning, consent, synthesis, and sharing findings.

 - Keep the team close to customers. Involve teammates in research and build shared understanding across product, design, engineering, and customer service.

What we’re looking for

 - 3-5 years of experience independently owning product research, from framing the question and choosing a method through analysis and recommendations.

 - Strong skills in customer interviews, workflow observation, and moderated usability testing.

 - Examples of research that changed a team’s understanding of a problem or influenced what it built.

 - The judgment to balance research rigor with the pace of a small product team.

 - Comfort working through ambiguity, challenging assumptions constructively, and collaborating with people across disciplines.

 - Experience establishing research practices or working as a team’s sole researcher is especially valuable.

 - Experience with healthcare, B2B products, or complex operational workflows is a plus.

 - Ideally based in San Francisco, CA. Ability to travel onsite to clinic locations for problem discovery and usability testing as needed.

What success looks like in your first 90 days

 - You’ve built relationships with customers and teammates and developed an understanding of our most important workflows.

 - You’ve helped shape priority PRDs with direct evidence about customer needs and explicit assumptions to investigate.

 - You’ve tested proposed designs with customers and helped the team act on what you learned.

 - You’ve established a repeatable way to recruit participants, share findings, and bring research into upcoming product decisions.

We’ll evaluate your impact through the decisions your research improves and the shared customer understanding it creates.

Benefits

 - Competitive compensation

 - 401(k)

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Flexible work schedule

 - Paid time off

 - Paid holidays

 - Opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the growth of a rapidly scaling healthcare company

jobs.title: Manager, Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
jobs.description:
The field of gene therapy is growing rapidly and Genezen is here to meet the exacting needs of our clients. We provide process development, produce GMP viral vectors, and provide cell transduction for gene and cell therapy clinical trials and are proud to be a part of the process that leads to new cures.

WORKING AT GENEZEN

Many people have worked in environments where you feel like just another nameless part of an enormous machine. Genezen is different. We want our employees to be innovative, collaborative problem solvers who are dedicated to meeting the challenges of working at a fast-growing company. We are dedicated to empowering our employees to be their best and making Genezen a rewarding place to work. Every employee contributes to the success of the company and you can be part of that team.

JOB SUMMARY

Lead hands-on operational excellence and continuous improvement for a gene therapy contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO). Partner with site leaders to build a culture of daily problem-solving, employee engagement, and disciplined execution that improves safety, quality, delivery, and cost while protecting patient safety and GMP compliance.

Establish and sustain practical daily management routines, leader standard work, visual controls, and accountability for follow-through. Coach supervisors and cross-functional teams to identify gaps, address root causes, and sustain improvements across manufacturing and supporting functions, enabling reliable viral vector production and delivery against client commitments.

Initially an individual contributor manager, leading cross-functional improvement teams and coaching leaders without direct reporting authority. Direct supervisory responsibility may be added as business needs evolve.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Partner with site leaders to implement a lean daily management system that connects site priorities to team-level work and makes performance gaps visible.

• Facilitate tiered daily huddles and visual performance boards with clear targets, actual results, escalation paths, action owners, and due dates; coach teams to solve problems rather than only report status.

• Develop leader standard work with supervisors and managers, including routine shop-floor observation, process confirmation, coaching, and follow-up on commitments.

• Build a respectful, improvement-focused culture by engaging frontline employees, encouraging early identification of problems, and addressing process weaknesses rather than assigning blame.

• Manage a prioritized portfolio of cross-functional improvements aligned with site objectives and client commitments; define scope, baselines, milestones, resource needs, and measurable benefits with project sponsors.

• Personally lead Kaizen events and structured problem-solving using PDCA, A3, root-cause analysis, value-stream mapping, and DMAIC as appropriate to the problem.

• Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, MSAT, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management to improve viral vector manufacturing flow, material readiness, campaign changeovers, equipment availability, and handoffs through testing and batch review.

• Apply standard work, 5S, visual controls, and error-proofing to reduce waste, variability, recurring deviations, and avoidable batch losses in a multi-product, client-driven GMP environment.

• Establish practical measures for right-first-time execution, schedule adherence, cycle time, throughput, and recurring deviations; validate capacity and cost benefits with process owners and Finance as appropriate.

• Coach leaders and teams through real problems, building internal capability to maintain daily management routines and lead small improvements independently.

• Support Quality-led investigations and CAPA through facilitation and data analysis. Ensure improvements follow approved change control, validation, training, and client requirements without compromising contamination controls, data integrity, or Quality’s disposition authority.

• Verify sustained results through process confirmation, management-system checks, and effectiveness reviews; transfer ongoing ownership to process leaders and address backsliding.

• Support consistent practices across Lexington and Indianapolis while adapting to site and process needs; communicate verified results, barriers, and escalations to site leadership and the Head of Global Operational Excellence.

SPECIAL JOB REQUIREMENTS

• 35% travel to the Indianapolis site is required to support on-site coaching, daily management, and improvement execution.

• Regular on-site presence in GMP manufacturing and supporting work areas; comply with applicable gowning, safety, and contamination-control requirements.

• Flexibility in schedule to support manufacturing shifts, team coaching, and critical improvement activities.

• Criminal background check required.

• Other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION / CERTIFICATIONS / LICENSES:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Operations Management, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

• Formal training in lean management and continuous improvement, with demonstrated practical application. Lean or Lean Six Sigma certification preferred.

ON-THE-JOB-EXPERIENCE:

• At least 7 years of relevant experience in GMP pharmaceutical, biologics, or advanced therapy operations, including hands-on operational excellence or continuous improvement responsibilities.

• Demonstrated experience implementing and sustaining daily management, visual performance systems, and leader standard work—not solely facilitating improvement events.

• Track record of leading cross-functional projects, coaching supervisors and frontline teams without direct authority, and delivering sustained quality, delivery, productivity, or cycle-time improvements.

• Gene therapy, viral vector manufacturing, or CDMO experience preferred, including familiarity with multi-product operations and client delivery commitments.

SKILLS / ABILITIES:

• Practical knowledge of lean daily management, tiered accountability, leader standard work, visual controls, process confirmation, and employee-driven improvement.

• Ability to coach through observation and questions, facilitate effective huddles, and establish clear ownership and follow-through while building trust and respect.

• Hands-on problem-solving skills using PDCA, A3, 5 Why, cause-and-effect analysis, Kaizen, value-stream mapping, standard work, and error-proofing.

• Working knowledge of cGMP, deviation investigation, CAPA, change control, validation, and data integrity; ability to improve flow without bypassing quality controls.

• Ability to analyze operational data, establish credible baselines and measures, distinguish normal variation from meaningful change, and verify sustained benefits.

• Understanding of manufacturing and support-process interdependencies, including scheduling, materials, equipment readiness, testing, and batch documentation in a client-driven environment.

• Strong facilitation, communication, change-management, and influencing skills across functions and organizational levels; ability to translate analysis into practical action.

COMPENSATION RANGE:

• The anticipated annual salary range for the Manager is $130,000 - $165,000. Salary determined based on relevant experience, skills and education.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to meet the following physical demands:

Work Environment:

• Regularly sit for long periods of time

Movement:

• Frequently required to stand; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms

• Occasionally required to walk; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl

Lifting:

• Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds

• Rarely lift and/or move up to 25 pounds

Vision:

• Frequently utilize close vision and the ability to adjust focus

Communication

• Frequently required to communicate by talking, hearing, using telephone and e-mail

GENEZEN'S CURES VALUE-BASED COMPETENCIES

Committed to Science
We are committed to scientific excellence, staying current with industry developments, making data-driven decisions, and pursuing innovation to advance healthcare.

Urgency in action for the patients
We operate with urgency and a commitment to delivering timely treatments to patients by accelerating our partners' programs.

Resilience & Grit in operations
We are committed to overcoming challenges, learning from failures, and persistently striving for success.

Execute with Excellence & Integrity
We are dedicated to delivering quality results and upholding ethical principals.

Solutions driven for our partners
We are committed to being a proactive, collaborative, creative and open-minded partner.

GENEZEN'S BENEFITS

• Paid vacation days, amount based on tenure

• Paid sick time

• 10 observed holidays + 2 floating holiday + 1 volunteer day

• 401(k) plan with company match up to 6% of salary

• Share Appreciation Rights

• Choice of several healthcare plans

• FSA and HSA programs

• Dental & vision care

• Employer-paid basic term life/personal accident insurance

• Voluntary disability, universal life/personal accident insurance

• Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

• Nothing in the job description for this role restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

• This position requires a criminal background check.

• Genezen is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Genezen participates in EVerify.

Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. Echodyne is seeking a Facilities Support Associate to join our fast-growing team.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Day Porter / Facilities Support Associate is responsible for maintaining the cleanliness, organization, and overall appearance of the workplace throughout the business day. This role provides daily cleaning and facility support across office spaces, restrooms, kitchenettes, break rooms, common areas, and designated ESD areas.

The position also supports employee amenities, meetings, company events, and general workplace operations by ensuring shared spaces remain clean, stocked, organized, and ready for use.
