SOC Operator - Federal Customer (Chantilly, VA)

(On-site 5 days per week: TS/SCI Clearance Required) Please note: Candidates without existing Required Clearances will be auto declined.

The SOC Operator serves as the first line of defense for monitoring, detecting, and resolving network and infrastructure incidents. In this role, you will actively track alerts across enterprise systems, perform initial diagnostics, and apply standard operating procedures to restore service promptly. You will manage incoming incident tickets, maintain meticulous shift documentation, and communicate real-time updates to stakeholders throughout the event lifecycle. When issues exceed triage scope, you will efficiently escalate incidents to the respective engineering teams, field technicians, or third-party vendors.

What You’ll Do

● Monitor Infrastructure Health: Continuously watch enterprise network dashboards, servers, and circuit links in a 24/7 environment to identify alarms, performance anomalies, and outages in real time.

● Conduct Initial Diagnostics: Perform first-touch technical triage—such as executing CLI network diagnostics, verifying interface states, validating basic configurations, and restarting services—using standard runbooks.

● Manage Incident Tickets: Create, update, and prioritize incident records within the ticketing platform, documenting symptoms, diagnostic steps taken, and resolution paths with meticulous detail.

● Escalate & Coordinate: Seamlessly escalate complex issues to Tier 2/Tier 3 engineers, field technicians, and telecommunication carriers, tracking progress to uphold established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

● Maintain Communications & Documentation: Publish incident notifications to stakeholders, conduct thorough shift-handoff briefings, and contribute updates to operational knowledge base articles and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Required Qualifications

● Network Fundamentals & Protocols: Solid grasp of the OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and basic routing/switching concepts.

● Basic Command-Line Diagnostics: Proficiency using network troubleshooting commands such as ping, traceroute, nslookup, netstat, and ipconfig/ifconfig.

● Monitoring Tools Experience: Practical familiarity with enterprise monitoring and alerting platforms (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, Datadog, or Zabbix).

● Ticketing & Incident Management: Experience managing ticket lifecycles, following ITIL incident management practices, and using service desk tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Remedy).

● Clear Technical Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to document shift handoffs, log detailed ticket updates, and escalate issues accurately under pressure.

● Clearance: Active TS/SCI and ability to maintain access as required by the program.

● Physical Requirements: Candidates must be able to lift up to 25lbs.

Preferred Qualifications

● Industry Certifications: Foundational networking credentials such as CompTIA Network+, Cisco CCNA, or ITIL 4 Foundation.

● Multi-Platform OS Navigation: Hands-on comfort working in both Linux/Unix and Windows server environments.

● Basic Scripting & Automation: Familiarity with Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate routine triage tasks or parse logs.

● Packet Inspection Tools: Foundational experience capturing and reading packet data using tools like Wireshark or tcpdump.

● Hardware & Cloud Basics: Introductory exposure to enterprise hardware components (chassis, transceivers, cabling)

What We Offer

● Cutting-Edge Lab Access: Direct access to enterprise-class hardware, sandbox environments, and emerging software stacks.

● Technical Growth: Sponsored training, conference attendance, and certification support to continuously sharpen your engineering toolkit.

● Collaborative Engineering Culture: A multidisciplinary team that values bias for action, intellectual curiosity, and autonomous problem-solving.

jobs.description:
ABOUT GREENPEACE
Greenpeace is a global, independent campaigning organization that uses peaceful protest, creative communication and people power to expose global environmental problems and promote solutions that are essential to a green and peaceful future. In just the past year, we’ve secured a Global Oceans Treaty to protect wildlife and people who depend on healthy oceans. We persuaded the Biden Administration to phase out single-use plastics from federal operations. And we safeguarded healthy spaces, from national marine sanctuaries to bans on seabed mining to stopping liquefied national gas terminals poisoning Gulf Coast communities. Our work spans more than 50 years of fights and successes.

As an independent campaigning organization, Greenpeace does not accept funds from any corporations or government entities. The global Greenpeace network is headquartered in the Netherlands, with offices around the world in over fifty countries. Greenpeace USA is headquartered in Washington, DC.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Research Director helps drive GPUS’s campaign victories by leading the Research and Investigations Team to deliver high-quality research that underpins GPUS’s credibility, visibility and strategic impact. Serving as a key leader within the organization, this role provides data-driven strategic advice to the Program Department, Senior Leadership, and cross-functional teams. The Director manages research staff and contractors, ensuring that the unit’s outputs successfully power campaigns, engage donors and supporters, and mitigate organizational risk. By uncovering critical data and answering complex questions, the Research Director transforms raw research into a powerful catalyst for advocacy and systemic change.

Reporting to the Program Director, this full-time, benefits-eligible role follows a hybrid schedule. Candidates must reside in one of Greenpeace USA's authorized locations, including California, Washington D.C. metro area (DC, MD, VA) or NY metro area (NY, NJ, CT).

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership:

• Strategize with GPUS senior leadership on questions of science, policy, and strategy, and execute decision-making in internal leadership spaces.

• Partner with senior departmental leadership to develop and strategize the annual and multi-year research plans for all aspects of GPUS’s Research Program, including short- and long-term measurable goals.

• Strengthen the level of understanding within the organization about research as a form of activism, engagement, communication, and education.

• Identify opportunities to fundraise for major research initiatives, and provide the technical support needed to submit proposals and secure funding for them.

• Guide Research Team members in developing appropriate research questions that expose and illuminate complex problems, while also creating space for people-powered campaigns to push for solutions.

Research and Investigations:

• Oversee the planning, project management, and delivery of original, creative and incisive research and investigations to accelerate GPUS’s campaigns.

• Direct the Research Team’s investigative pipelines to uncover high-impact data, drive long-term strategic planning, and equip campaigns with the intelligence needed to achieve goals and victories.

• Manage the Research and Investigations Unit budget, regularly monitoring expenditures, allocating resources and negotiating with subscription vendors to match research priorities and ensure quality and value.

• Lead the Research Team in targeted power mapping and background research to uncover influence levers and inform strategic planning for campaigns.

• Represent GPUS in high profile and strategically significant external scientific and policy venues.

Quality Assurance and Innovation:

• Mitigate risks to the organization by providing the factual and scientific basis for outputs and campaign activities and via research that identifies risks and opportunities for the organization.

• Supervise the use of rigorous research design and methodology for all projects.

• Lead the Research Team’s development of new tools and techniques for scientific research, data visualization, and campaign investigations, and build capacity for their use within GPUS.

• Drive efforts to publish GPUS research in peer-reviewed scientific journals.

Unit and Team Management:

• Oversee the day-to-day operations, project pipelines, timelines and budget of the Research and Investigations Unit.

• Direct, coach, and evaluate internal research staff, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team environment that deepens expertise in critical research methods and guides external stakeholder relationships in the broader research community.

• Develop trainings to expand research capacity among staff, researchers, campaigners, and volunteers.

• Source external researchers and investigators and manage deliverables to ensure projects meet the organization’s quality standards, timelines and budget.

Collaboration and Networking:

• Serve as a senior spokesperson, representing GPUS to the media on campaigns and research.

• Cultivate and maintain investigative partnerships with reporters, relationships with senior academic researchers, industry experts, policy thought leaders, and external research organizations.

• Partner with Campaign Directors to foster a collaborative and innovative research environment across teams and departments, and advise Campaign Directors to align research goals and outputs with campaign strategy and tactics.

• Represent GPUS in discussions and meetings with Greenpeace International and other National and Regional Offices.

• Serve as the primary liaison driving collaboration and strategic communication between the Research Team and the Campaigns, Actions, Communications and Development teams.

Other Duties:

• Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned by the manager, as organizational or team priorities arise and/or shift.

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

Knowledge and Experience:

• Minimum 10 years experience in public interest campaign research (with environmental organizations preferred)

• Minimum 3 years people management or high level task management experience in a non-profit organization

• Masters Degree or higher preferred in Environmental Policy or Science, Environmental Studies, Journalism, or other relevant scientific or research field

• Demonstrated track record of publishing influential, policy-relevant research and investigations that are able to shift the public conversation on important topics

• Senior level environmental science and policy expertise and deep knowledge of a range of current environmental issues

• Advanced research and investigative expertise, and a track record of applying creative, high-level analytical thinking to unpack and resolve complex research issues

• Extensive experience directing sophisticated research initiatives from design, to implementation, to public release

• Demonstrated leadership in guiding teams to conceptualize high-impact investigative concepts, paired with a proven track record of securing strategic media coverage and managing relationships with journalists and reporters

jobs.title: Applied AI Architect, Beneficial Deployments (Non-Profits)
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Beneficial Deployments

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.

About the Role

We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join Beneficial Deployments, focused on helping nonprofits and foundations get real value from Claude. You'll be the technical lead for a portfolio of partners, working alongside our Account Executives from first conversation through deployment. You'll help partners find where Claude makes a real difference to their mission and their operations, design solutions that fit their budgets, data and teams, and turn early pilots into lasting adoption. What works for one partner becomes something the whole sector can use.

Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary technical advisor to a portfolio of nonprofit partners from discovery through deployment, turning their priorities into scoped use cases with clear measures of success.

• Partner with Account Executives on account plans, discovery and technical evaluation.

• Design and demo solutions with Claude, the API and Claude Code across program delivery, fundraising, operations and data analysis.

• Guide partners through security review, data governance and procurement.

• Run workshops and trainings that build AI fluency across partner teams.

• Build reusable assets (reference designs, connectors, prompt and eval templates) so one partner's work helps the next.

• Spot patterns across partners, bring field insight back to Product and Research, and help partners measure what changed.

• Travel to partner sites for workshops, technical deep dives and relationship building.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have

• 3+ years in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward-deployed engineering or technical consulting.

• A track record of getting lean, skeptical or slow-moving teams to adopt technology and keep using it, including working through how they buy and govern it.

• Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs: you have built and evaluated working prototypes or agents, and can guide a partner's own engineers on architecture and evals. You don't need to write production code.

• Clear written and spoken communication across a broad audience. The ability to explain technical tradeoffs to program leads, operations staff and executives.

• Patience with long buying cycles, a knack for knowing how to make them go smoothly, and real care for public benefit.

• A track record of agency and autonomy: you spot what needs doing before anyone asks, agree that it matters, drive it to a finished result and know when to pull others in.

• Comfort operating in ambiguity: you bring clarity to fuzzy problems, wear multiple hats and do whatever it takes to further the mission.

• Bonus if you've worked in a sales team, or with or at nonprofits, foundations or other mission-driven organizations.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$240,000—$315,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Head of Sales & Business Development — AEO
jobs.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.

• We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.

• We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.

• We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Bloomreach is building the future of commerce experiences, helping businesses create more relevant, intelligent, and measurable interactions with their customers. As AI reshapes how people discover, evaluate, and buy products, we are expanding our capabilities in Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) -helping brands become visible, credible, and preferred in the new generation of AI-driven search and answer experiences.

We are looking for a commercial leader to help turn a high-quality AEO product into a scaled, repeatable growth business inside Bloomreach.

The opportunity

The AEO product has strong product and engineering leadership along with proof points selling to large enterprises and SMBs. The next phase is to accelerate the business into the next phase of growth with B2C brands.

This is a build-and-scale role - not a traditional sales leadership position focused only on optimizing an established motion. You will own the commercial strategy, validate where the product wins, shape the sales and customer lifecycle around those insights, and create the operating model needed for sustainable growth.

You will lead the existing four-person AEO commercial team, while also building a strong partnership with Bloomreach’s broader sales organization. A central part of the role will be determining how AEO can be cross-sold into Bloomreach’s existing customer base or co-sold with existing Bloomreach products - and how our core sellers can confidently identify, position, and help sell the product as part of broader customer solutions.

What you will own

1. Establish product–market fit in B2C Enterprise Brands segment

• Translate product strengths into a crisp commercial narrative that resonates with B2C Enterprise Brands.

• Build a disciplined learning loop across prospects, customers, partners/broader ecosystem, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success.

• Personal product mastery: Identify where the current product is strongest, where it needs to evolve, and which opportunities should be prioritized commercially.

• Turn early wins and customer evidence into repeatable messaging, qualification criteria, sales plays, and proof points.

• Help champions turn an emerging AEO mandate into a funded initiative: shape the business case with marketing leadership, secure executive sponsorship, and align relevant teams and budgets.

2. Scale to $10M ARR

• Create and execute the commercial plan to grow the business to $10M ARR.

• Establish the right balance of new-logo acquisition, expansion, renewal, and strategic account development.

• Build a measurable operating cadence across pipeline creation, conversion, deal velocity, forecast accuracy, retention, expansion, and team productivity.

• Set the right coverage model, territories, quotas, incentives, capacity plan, and hiring roadmap as the business scales.

• Personally engage in strategic opportunities and executive-level customer relationships where they can materially accelerate growth.

3. Build a high-performing AEO commercial team

• Lead, coach, and develop the current AEs and CSMs, creating clarity on roles, expectations, priorities, and measures of success.

• Strengthen the end-to-end customer journey from qualification through implementation, adoption, renewal, and expansion.

• Define the skills, profiles, and structure needed for the next stage of growth.

• Hire selectively as evidence supports expansion of the team.

• Create a culture of accountability, customer empathy, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

4. Create the cross-sell and partner motion with the core sales organization

• Develop a clear strategy for introducing AEO into Bloomreach’s existing customer base and co-selling alongside existing Bloomreach sellers.

• Identify the customer segments, account signals, trigger events, and use cases that indicate cross-sell potential.

• Design a practical engagement model between the AEO team and Bloomreach’s main sales organization—including ownership, qualification, account planning, compensation, handoffs, and deal support.

• Equip core sellers with the messaging, training, discovery questions, collateral, demos, and commercial plays needed to identify and open AEO opportunities.

• Build trust and shared incentives so the AEO team is viewed as a growth partner—not a competing sales channel.

• Establish a repeatable model for specialist-led, core-sales-assisted, and core-sales-led opportunities.

5. Partner cross-functionally to shape the business

• Work closely with Product and Engineering to connect market feedback to roadmap priorities and commercial readiness.

• Partner with Marketing on positioning, category creation, demand generation, customer proof, events, and thought leadership.

• Collaborate with Finance and Revenue Operations on planning, forecasting, reporting, compensation, and business performance.

• Bring customer and market insight to the broader Bloomreach leadership team and help shape the role of AEO in the company’s overall strategy.

• AI operating skills. Use AI tooling like Codex and Claude Code to test hypotheses against company data, inspect deals, build forecasts, and build leverage into GTM

What success looks like

In the first 90 days

• Establish Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) Repeatability - demonstrating that the team can win cleanly within a tightly defined target sandbox, rather than taking any random deal that comes along including

• ICP Concentration: 80%+ of closed-won deals match your designated Ideal Customer Profile firmographics and personas.

• Consistent Positioning: Marketing and AEs use the exact same value proposition, resulting in a predictable cost-per-meeting and inbound conversion rate.

• Customer Time-to-Value: A repeatable customer success framework ensures customers hit their "first value milestone" within a defined, predictable number of days post-sale.

• Create and agree “rules of engagement” of selling AEO to Bloomreach prospects and customer base

• A team and hiring plan aligned to the path toward $10M ARR.

In the first 6 months

• Evidence-based refinement of the ICP, positioning, qualification process, and sales motion.

• A repeatable set of winning use cases and referenceable customer outcomes.

• A functioning cross-sell motion with clear account selection, roles, incentives, enablement, and handoffs.

• Improved pipeline generation, conversion, forecast accuracy, and customer expansion.

Over time

• AEO becomes a repeatable, scalable growth business within Bloomreach.

• The business is on a credible path to $10M ARR.

• Bloomreach’s core sales organization consistently identifies and helps create AEO opportunities.

• Customers see AEO as a strategic capability in their AI-era growth agenda.

• The commercial team operates with strong execution, clear accountability, and a culture of learning.

What we are looking for

• Significant experience leading Sales, Business Development, or a full commercial function in a B2B SaaS, martech, ecommerce, data, or AI-related business

• Growth mindset to be able to embrace and build AI native sales motion

• A track record of taking a product or business from early commercial traction to meaningful scale ideally including hypergrowth or a step-change in ARR.

• Experience establishing product–market fit or refining a GTM motion when the ICP, positioning, and sales process are still evolving.

• Strong commercial judgment and the ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution.

• Demonstrated success selling to senior business and technology stakeholders, with a strong grasp of value-based and consultative selling.

• Experience building repeatable enterprise sales motions, including pipeline generation, forecasting, deal inspection, and account expansion.

• Experience designing or scaling cross-sell, partner-selling, overlay, or specialist-led sales motions within a broader sales organization.

• Strong people leadership skills, including coaching sellers, developing customer success talent, and hiring for the next stage of growth.

• Comfort working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Revenue Operations in a highly collaborative environment.

• Exceptional communication skills, executive presence, and the ability to create alignment across teams with different goals and incentives.

• A data-informed, experimental approach: you form hypotheses, test them with customers, learn quickly, and make clear decisions.

Particularly valuable experience

• Commercial leadership at an AI-native company or a company undergoing a major shift in how customers discover, evaluate, or buy products.

• Experience with AEO, AI search, generative AI, SEO, digital commerce, martech, customer data, or adjacent categories.

• Experience selling an emerging category where the market narrative and buyer education still need to be created.

• Experience taking a product to $10M+ ARR.

• Experience building a productive partnership between a specialist product team and a larger, established sales organization.

• Experience working with customers whose needs, buying process, and commercial profile differ from the product’s historical customer base.

How you lead

• Customer-led: You seek evidence from customers and the market before locking in a strategy.

• Builder-minded: You are energized by creating the motion, not just inheriting it.

• Commercially rigorous: You connect activity to outcomes and make trade-offs explicit.

• Collaborative: You know how to create leverage through a broader sales organization rather than building a silo.

• Clear and decisive: You bring structure to ambiguity, communicate simply, and make decisions at the right pace.

• Coaching-oriented: You raise the performance of the team through context, feedback, and high standards.

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

• A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.

• We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.

• We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.

• We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.

• We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.

• We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.

• The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

• We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.

• Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*

• Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.

• Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

• The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*

• Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*

• We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.

• We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.

• Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.*

Compensation:

• Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.*

• Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.*

• We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!

• We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!*

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful!

Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees.

jobs.description:
DevOps Storage Engineer - Federal

(on-site 5 days per week, Chantilly, VA: TS/SCI Required)

Job summary

If you enjoy working with new technologies, enterprise-leading equipment, and seek to design, deploy, and maintain enterprise storage solutions, we would like to speak to you. This position will play a key critical role in building, maintaining, and optimizing the underlying infrastructure to support Enterprise Information Technology (IT) workloads.

You will join a diverse team of engineers to design, deploy, maintain, and secure platform infrastructure. You will collaborate with people inside and outside the organization to deliver the highest standards for building, deploying, and securing infrastructure.

Key Job Responsibilities

DevOps Storage Engineers demonstrate the ability to build, maintain, and troubleshoot complex storage infrastructures to maintain a secure, performant, and available solution.

· Knowledge of Linux distributions, including user management, security hardening, and system troubleshooting

· Understanding of iSCSI, Fibre Channel, Fibre Channel over Ethernet, NFS, SMB/CIFS, NVMe/TCP, NVMe/RoCE for efficient and performant data transfer

· Experience with ext4, XFS, Btrfs - knowing when to use each based on performance needs

· Knowledge of RAID levels and disk management techniques for redundancy and performance

· Proven ability to deploy, configure, and manage storage area networks and network-attached storage solutions

· Hands-on experience with major vendors like Dell EMC, NetApp, or HPE Nimble - including firmware updates and troubleshooting

· Experience setting up synchronous/asynchronous data replication for disaster recovery

· Knowledge using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix to track performance metrics and identify bottlenecks

· Intermediate scripting experience for automating routine tasks and creating custom monitoring solutions

· Experience with Ansible, Chef, or Puppet to manage storage infrastructure as code

Required Qualifications

· Proven experience configuring, managing, and troubleshooting enterprise SAN, NAS, and unified storage platforms (e.g., NetApp, Dell PowerStore/PowerMax, Pure Storage), with deep knowledge of block and file protocols including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, and SMB/CIFS.

· Proficiency in automating storage provisioning, lifecycle tasks, and configuration management using tools like Terraform and Ansible, backed by scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

· Strong hands-on experience integrating persistent volumes with container platforms, specifically leveraging Kubernetes Container Storage Interface (CSI) drivers, storage classes, and dynamic volume provisioning.

· In-depth Linux systems administration skills (Red Hat/CentOS, Ubuntu), including multipath I/O configuration (DM-Multipath), volume managers (LVM), filesystem tuning (ext4, XFS, ZFS), and performance troubleshooting (I/O latency, IOPS, throughput).

· Active TS/SCI and the ability to maintain access as required by the program

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience designing and managing S3-compatible cloud and software-defined object storage solutions (e.g., AWS S3/EBS/EFS, MinIO, Ceph) across hybrid or multi-cloud enterprise footprints.

· Hands-on experience embedding automated storage tests and provisioning workflows into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and managing storage declarations via GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD).

· Familiarity with telemetry and observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to track storage metrics, monitor SLA thresholds, and build automated forecasting models for capacity planning.

· Industry certifications such as Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, vendor storage credentials (e.g., NetApp NCDA,

Pure Certified Architect), or an advanced cloud provider specialty (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect).

We offer

· A dynamic and collaborative working environment that fosters professional growth and development.

· Opportunities for personal and technical skill enhancement through ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

· A supportive and inclusive team culture that values diversity and encourages individual contributions.

If you are passionate about storage, have a strong technical background, and thrive in a collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Company Introduction

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we are collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and establishing an unparalleled reputation for being leading and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Role Overview

This is the on-site IT owner for Coupang's Washington, DC office, a fast-growing hub for government affairs, public policy, and communications teams. The Staff IT Operations Engineer is the office's first point of contact for all things technology, from executive and VIP support to AV, events, endpoints, vendors, and access to corporate systems.

The office is expected to double over the next year and regularly hosts senior executives and external stakeholders. Success in this role is defined as much by relationships, responsiveness, and ownership as by technical skill. This person works independently, partners with global infrastructure, security, and governance teams across time zones, and makes sure the local team never has to navigate corporate processes alone.

What You Will Do

• Office ownership and stakeholder engagement: Serve as the single, visible IT point of contact for the DC office. Build proactive relationships with leaders, executive assistants, and office operations so needs are anticipated before they become escalations.

• Executive and VIP support: Deliver high-touch, white-glove support for senior executives and visiting leadership, including meeting, travel, and event readiness. Provide responsive, scalable support for all office staff.

• End-to-end issue ownership: Own every request from intake to resolution, including those that depend on other teams. Acknowledge requests the same day, give regular status updates, and close the loop with requesters.

• Cross-functional process navigation: Guide staff through corporate processes for access, external collaboration, security reviews, and exceptions, such as ServiceNow requests, guest and vendor accounts, and software approvals. Find process owners, submit or shepherd requests, and escalate when work is blocked.

• Event technology and AV operations: Own the office's AV and event technology, including control systems, digital signage, microphones and audio, displays, video walls, and Zoom and Microsoft Teams rooms. Prepare and staff executive visits, media monitoring setups, and office events.

• Endpoint management: Provision, maintain, and support Windows, macOS, and mobile (iOS/Android) devices, including new-hire onboarding, offboarding, and asset tracking.

• MDM and endpoint security: Administer MDM solutions (such as Microsoft Intune and Jamf) and endpoint protection tools to keep devices compliant and configured.

• Networking and identity: Troubleshoot local wired and wireless networks, basic switch and firewall issues, and identity and access (Active Directory, Entra ID, SSO, MFA), partnering with global network and IAM teams.

• Vendor and facilities coordination: Manage local IT, AV, and building contractors, including scoping, purchase orders, scheduling, site readiness, and quality of work, so vendors arrive with everything in place.

• Operational excellence: Maintain runbooks, SOPs, and user guides for office systems. Identify recurring friction points and drive fixes with the owning teams.

• Reporting and communication: Provide weekly status reports to IT leadership covering office needs, completed work, open items, and blockers.

Basic Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in IT operations, enterprise IT support, or IT operations engineering, including time as the primary on-site IT resource for an office.

• Demonstrated experience delivering executive and VIP support, ideally in a high-visibility, fast-paced environment.

• Hands-on experience supporting Windows, macOS, and mobile devices.

• Proficiency with MDM tools (Microsoft Intune, Jamf) and enterprise endpoint security solutions.

• Working knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, and identity lifecycle processes.

• Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, Wi-Fi and LAN troubleshooting, and basic switching and firewall diagnostics.

• Hands-on experience with conference room and event AV, including video conferencing (Zoom, Teams), displays, audio, and control systems.

• Proven track record managing third-party vendors and contractors through delivery.

• Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to set expectations and keep non-technical stakeholders informed.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting government affairs, public policy, legal, communications, or executive office teams.

• Experience with AV control and signage platforms (such as Q-SYS, Crestron, or BrightSign) and live event or media monitoring setups.

• Experience navigating governance, risk, and compliance processes in a large or global enterprise, including access requests, security reviews, and exceptions.

• Familiarity with ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and ServiceNow.

• Experience collaborating with distributed global teams across time zones and cultures.

• Strong documentation skills: SOPs, knowledge base articles, and user guides.

• Process improvement experience: analyzing workflows, finding friction, and implementing fixes.

• Familiarity with automation and self-service concepts (automated intake, AI assistants, scripted tasks) without needing software engineering skills.

• IT asset management across the full lifecycle, from procurement to secure disposal.

Pay & Benefits

Our compensation reflects the cost of living across several US geographic markets. At Coupang, your base pay is one part of your total compensation.

The base pay for this position ranges from $155K/year to $267K/year. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

General Description of All Benefits

• Annual bonus is 0-20% of the base salary

• Medical/Dental/Vision/Life, AD&D insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) & Health Savings Account (HSA)

• Long-term/Short-term Disability

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) program

• 401K Plan with Company Match

• 18-21 days of the Paid Time Off (PTO) a year based on the tenure

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 6 weeks of Paid Parental leave

• Pre-tax commuter benefits

• MTV - [Free] Electric Car Charging Station

General Description of Other Compensation

“Other Compensation” includes, but is not limited to, bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation that would be offered to the hired applicant in addition to their established salary range or wage scale.

Recruitment Process and Others

Recruitment Process

• Application Review - Job Fit Interview - Focus Interview – Offer

• The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances.

• Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e-mail address submitted at the application stage.

Details to Consider

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, or gender (including pregnancy, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, transgender status), national origin, age, disability, medical condition, HIV/AIDS or Hepatitis C status, marital status, military or veteran status, use of a trained dog guide or service animal, political activities, or affiliations, citizenship, or any other characteristic or class protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. jobs.title: Operations Engineer (Space Planning - Office & Seating)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

OPERATIONS ENGINEER (SPACE PLANNING – OFFICE & SEATING)

The Corporate Operations Engineering team supports overall business operations through strategic planning, optimization of processes, and alignment of resources to tasks. In this role, you will own office and desk space across the Hawthorne campus, turning program headcount, growth, and reorganizations into floor plans, seating charts, and office moves that keep teams together and productive. You will be challenged to stay up to date with headcount and timelines across every program while balancing building capacity limits and new office build-outs. We are looking for an engineer with a history of managing multiple projects, communicating clearly with stakeholders at every level, and providing creative solutions that make the best use of office space. This position is based out of the Hawthorne campus and will require an active on-site presence.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own office and desk allocations across the Hawthorne campus, including block plans, neighborhood layouts, and seating assignments for programs and groups

• Partner with program Operations Engineers, Executive Assistants, and group leaders to gather headcount, growth forecasts, and adjacency needs, and turn them into seating plans that keep teams together

• Plan and run office moves end to end, from requirements, layout redlines, and budget estimates through move lists, employee notifications, and post-move updates, coordinating with Workplace, IT, Facilities, janitorial, and moving vendors

• Manage incoming office space requests, including new-hire seats, team relocations, and expansions, and close the loop with requesters on timing and outcome

• Maintain accurate floor plans, seat inventories, and desk assignments in CAD, workplace management software, and mapping tools, and run regular seating audits to keep systems in sync

• Lead office capacity and occupancy studies with architects and Facilities, covering density, egress, ventilation, and restroom fixture limits, and translate results into how many people each floor can support

• Partner with Facilities and Construction on new office build-outs and renovations, defining desk counts, layouts, furniture needs, and move-in sequencing

• Own the office portion of the plan of record for changes and trades across campus, including rationale, owners, and timeline of events

• Create and operationalize standard templates, checklists, and workplace tools (such as desk booking and digital nametags) that make office requests and moves consistent and scalable

• Communicate effectively with different levels of the organization, including everything from layout reviews with teams to presentations with upper leadership

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Architecture, or other engineering/STEM discipline

• 2+ years of space planning, workplace planning, or operations/process improvement experience

• Experience with Excel, SQL, Power BI, or Python/R

• Experience with CAD software (AutoCAD, Revit, or similar)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience planning office space, seating, and moves for a large, fast-growing organization or multi-building campus

• Experience with workplace management, desk booking, or integrated workplace management system (IWMS) software such as Kadence, Archibus, or OfficeSpace

• Experience with CAD software, ArcGIS, Power BI, and JIRA

• Familiarity with building code and occupancy limits (egress, ventilation, plumbing fixture counts) and experience working with architects on capacity studies

• Familiarity with modular office furniture systems, workstation standards, and ergonomics

• Proficiency with data analysis, data visualization, and cost benefit analysis

• Experience or education in operations engineering, industrial engineering, architecture, or interior design

• Experience as a contributor to multi-disciplinary and cross-functional teams

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

• Excellent written and communication skills

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed, including evening and weekend office moves and occasional short-notice domestic travel

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $160,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Lead GNC Engineer - A700
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Tactical Recon and Strike team at Anduril develops aerial small drones (Group 1-3) and all equipment to test, deploy and operate. The team is responsible for taking products like Ghost, Anvil, Bolt and Altius from paper sketches to operational systems. We work in close coordination with specialist teams to solve some of the hardest problems facing our customers. We are looking for software engineers, hardware engineers, roboticists, and front-end mobile developers who are excited about creating a powerful robotics platform that can be tasked and viewed in real-time through a variety of interfaces.

The guidance, navigation, and control (GNC) team within TRS performs implementation, analysis, test, and validation for GNC software solutions supporting our autonomous drone fleet. Applications include attitude and position control, waypoint and terminal guidance engagements, and navigating contested environments including communication and GPS denied environments.

ABOUT THE JOB

This role will be responsible for guidance and control law development and validation, hardware and software in-the-loop test and analysis, and cutting edge navigation solutions supporting the entire range of drones within TRS.

This position will be on-site at our headquarters in Costa Mesa, CA (relocation benefits provided.)

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Develop, debug, and test flight controllers and guidance algorithms

• Develop and test Software-In-The-Loop and Hardware-In-The-Loop tests in preparation for flight testing

• Work closely with the flight software team to define requirements, integrate GNC software and test functionality in simulation

• Review test data captured from the flight control system, subsystems, and other test instrumentation to verify vehicle performance, evaluate GNC algorithm/controller behavior, or debug incidents during testing or from fielded assets

• Develop models required to support functional evaluation of GNC software

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field with a focus on dynamic systems and control

• 8 years professional experience in a GNC role, preferably on airborne platforms

• Experience with Matlab and Simulink

• Experience in modeling and simulation of linear and nonlinear dynamic systems and model linearization

• A passion for defending the Unites States of America and its allies

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Master’s Degree of PhD in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field with a focus on dynamic systems and control

• Experience with state estimation - Kalman filtering, sensor fusion, etc.

• Experience with integrating and debugging navigation systems for aerial platforms

• Experience with flight control design and analysis for fixed and rotary wing aircraft or missile systems

• Experience with guidance algorithm development

• C/C++ Proficiency

• Experience with Simulink Embedded Coder

US Salary Range

$220,000—$292,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Advanced Manufacturing Scheduler
jobs.location: Long Beach, California, United States; Torrance, California, United States
jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Shift Availability:

M - F

Day Shift: 6:30am - 3pm

Night Shift: 2:30pm - 11pm

Purpose

We are seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Production Scheduler (known internally as Advanced Manufacturing Operations Specialist) to provide both tactical scheduling support and long-range production planning expertise for our advanced manufacturing team. This role helps drive schedule accuracy and operational efficiency by aligning inputs from the Demand team to ensure on-time delivery of machined hardware thru Machining, Assembly & Final inspection. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in MRP/MES systems, strong cross-functional collaboration skills, and thrives in dynamic, high-volume production environments.

The Role

• Provide scheduling expertise for machining, inspection, and assembly work centers to support forecasted build plans and production readiness.

• Aid in developing and maintaining work center schedules specifically for machined parts, in-process inspection, assembly, & final inspection operations.

• Help prepare and update daily, weekly, and monthly production schedules for these critical work centers, ensuring alignment with Program and Planning Teams.

• Actively host daily production standups and cross-functional readiness meetings to communicate status, resolve blockers, and adjust work center priorities.

• Proactively push/pull jobs within machining, inspection, assembly, and shipping phases to reduce WIP stagnation and to meet build targets.

• Validate that Material Requirements Planning (MRP) dates reflect actual shop floor conditions, making corrections with Planning Teamt to avoid misalignment in downstream workcenters.

• Help Investigate part shortages and labor constraints impacting these work centers; coordinate with planning and manufacturing engineering to resolve gaps.

• Provide schedule visibility and performance updates to shop leads and senior leadership, highlighting risks and opportunities within assigned work centers.

• Support the development and implementation of tools to improve real-time tracking, capacity planning, and resource forecasting in machining, inspection, and assembly.

• Identify and implement initiatives to improve product quality, throughput, and efficiency within the focused work centers.

• Identify and execute flow improvements across machining and assembly areas to streamline operations and reduce WIP.

• Clearly communicate daily execution priorities to machine shop, inspectors, and assembly supervisors to maintain alignment with production goals.

Basic Qualifications

• Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls

• 5+ years of production planning or scheduling experience in aerospace or high-complexity manufacturing environments

• Strong knowledge of ERP/MRP and MES systems

• Expertise in production planning, forecasting, and schedule optimization

• High proficiency with Microsoft Excel, project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet), JIRA, and Confluence

• Ability to navigate and influence in cross-functional teams (engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, production, quality)

• Strong analytical, communication, and leadership skills

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Siemens NX PLM and master BOM conversion (eBOM to mBOM)

• Track record of improving on-time delivery, reducing schedule variance, and driving systemic improvements

Work Environment

• This role operates in a fast-paced, high-mix production environment where priorities can shift rapidly based on engineering changes, supply chain constraints, and program milestones. The environment demands tight cross-functional collaboration with engineering, manufacturing, quality, logistics, and program teams to ensure daily execution aligns with long-term build plans.

• Success in this environment requires hands-on engagement on the shop floor, strong systems knowledge, and the ability to anticipate and resolve scheduling risks before they impact key deliverables.

• The culture emphasizes proactive communication, data-driven decision making, and continuous improvement to meet aggressive program timelines while maintaining high standards for quality, safety, and efficiency.

Compensation

At Divergent, our pay range is based on the level of the job. For this role, we will consider candidates at S02 - S04 as evaluated through our interview process.

• Specialist II / S02: $75,070 – $103,220

• Specialist III / S03: $86,710 – $119,230

• Specialist IV / S04: $100,170 – $137,730

Pay Range

$75,070—$137,730 USD

What We Offer Our Regular, Full-Time Employees:

• Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.

• Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.

• Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.

• Investment in Growth: We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.

• Collaborative and High-Performing Environment: Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected characteristic. jobs.title: Robotics Operator
jobs.location: Long Beach, California, United States; Torrance, California, United States
jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Shift Availability

M - F

Night Shift: 2:30pm - 11pm

Purpose

The Robotic Technician is a core production role responsible for operating, monitoring, and supporting multiple automated manufacturing cells, including robotic assembly, anodize automation, scan box inspection, and future robotic systems. This technician ensures stable day-to-day operations, maintains equipment health, supports material flow, and helps drive production efficiency, quality, and safety on the shop floor.

This role requires a hands-on, detail-oriented technician who excels at troubleshooting automation and mechanical issues in a fast-paced production environment.

The Role

As a Robotic Technician, you will support daily production across several automated work centers. You will operate equipment, maintain part flow, assist with routine maintenance, and respond to issues in real time to ensure consistent delivery of high-quality components for automotive, aerospace, and defense applications. You will collaborate with engineering, production leads, and other technicians to maintain safe, efficient, and reliable operations.

Multi-Cell Production Operations

• Operate, monitor, and support daily production across multiple automated cells—robotic assembly, anodize automation, scan box, and future robotic systems.

• Maintain proper flow of parts through automated cells to avoid delays or bottlenecks.

• Perform part preparation activities including masking, cleaning, light mechanical assembly, and adhesive-ready prep.

• Complete digital assemblies and validation steps using required software, tools, or inspection systems.

• Safely operate hand tools, power tools, forklifts, and general shop equipment

• Maintain clean, organized, and well-staged work areas; support other cells as needed.

• Assist with material movement between work centers, including forklift operation.

• Support shipping/receiving needs and basic shop logistics as required.

• Help stage, organize, and track materials across multiple automated work cells

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

• Perform routine operational maintenance on robotic and automated equipment.

• Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve basic robotic, mechanical, and electrical issues to reduce downtime.

Documentation, Quality & Continuous Improvement

• Assist with updating work instructions, process documentation, and checklists.

• Report nonconformances and support corrective action processes.

• Participate in continuous improvement activities focused on workflow, equipment reliability, and production efficiency.

Safety & Housekeeping

• Follow all safety protocols around robotic equipment and moving machinery.

• Help keep the work area clean, organized, and compliant with safety standards.

• Report any unsafe conditions or concerns immediately.

Basic Qualifications

• Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• 1–3 years of experience operating industrial robots (Kuka, ABB, FANUC, Yaskawa) or automated equipment in a production setting.

• Strong understanding of robotic operation and basic automation troubleshooting.

• Mechanical and electrical assembly skills with the ability to diagnose equipment issues.

• Experience in automotive, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing environments.

jobs.title: Quality Inspector - Starlink Aviation
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

QUALITY INSPECTOR - STARLINK AVIATION

Starlink is building aviation hardware that has to work the first time it reaches a customer. In this role you will be the person who checks that work: inspecting electrical and mechanical assemblies, catching issues early, and signing off only what actually conforms. You will sit with design, integration, quality, and supply chain every day, and your inspections are part of how Starlink gets reliable products into the field.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Run in-process and final inspections on electrical and mechanical assemblies, using drawings, CAD models, and released work instructions to confirm the build matches the design

• Check parts and assemblies against approved design data before anything is cleared for release

• Build and review FAA Form 8130-3 airworthiness release packages, including part identity, work performed, and traceability, and stop the release if the record or the hardware is not ready

• Write up production and test escapes, partner on root cause, and push corrective action through to close

• Raise and track nonconformances so the Starlink Aviation team can disposition them quickly

• Travel to install sites when needed to inspect hardware in the field

• Keep quality-system records current, check work against company and industry requirements, and look for practical ways to tighten the process

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalent

• 2+ years inspecting or performing quality control in manufacturing or production

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 4+ years inspecting hardware in a production environment

• Prior work preparing or checking FAA Form 8130-3 in aviation or other regulated manufacturing

• Associate or bachelor’s degree in a technical or engineering discipline

• Material review board, root cause, and corrective action experience

• Day-to-day use of AS9100 or ISO 9001

• Comfortable setting your own priorities and writing a clear inspection record

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Onsite role; overtime and weekends when a deadline requires it

• Shifts: 1st, 5:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m., or 2nd, 3:30 p.m.–2:00 a.m.

• Lift up to 25 lbs without help

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Assistance Engineering team builds world-class tools for Airbnb's global network of support agents, so guests and hosts get a great experience 24/7, 365 days a year. Airbnb's operational staff must scale with our user base, and we own the entire tech stack behind their success.

Within Assistance Engineering, Assistance Foundations builds the shared platforms that support runs on: case management, the agent workspace, quality and coaching systems, money tooling, data services, agent routing, provisioning and training, and reliability. We are forming a dedicated Machine Learning Engineering group so that intelligence is built once on this foundation and reused across support, rather than rebuilt by each team. We use machine learning to understand our complex data landscape, drive structured insights, and resolve customer issues faster and more accurately. The work is highly visible and has company-wide impact.

Some of what we are building and shipping:

• LLM-based quality evaluation that scores support cases against the quality standard, at scale

• AI coaching that turns quality evidence into coaching plans for team leads

• Simulation environments that train agents on realistic support scenarios

• Natural language search and chat tools that help agents and supervisors find answers faster

The Difference You Will Make:

As Engineering Manager, you will build and lead the founding group of ML engineers who bring machine learning and LLM-based systems to Assistance Foundations: quality, coaching, case intelligence, and decision support for agents.

• Lead and mentor: Hire, manage, and grow a new team of machine learning engineers, setting clear expectations, coaching careers, and building a collaborative, high-performing culture.

• Set ML strategy: Define the roadmap for ML across Assistance Foundations, balancing a shared core ML platform with close partnership to the teams you serve (case platform, quality, money, data services, routing, and agent training). Cover LLM evaluation, quality and coaching intelligence, retrieval, routing and matching, capacity forecasting, and decision support, with a focus on quality, scalability, safety, and reliability.

• Deliver at pace: Own end-to-end delivery of ML and LLM-based systems, batch and real-time, from experimentation through production, A/B testing, and operation at scale.

• Partner across the org: Work closely with platform, backend, and frontend engineers, data scientists, product managers, and support operations and quality teams to identify high-impact opportunities, prioritize requirements, and quantify results.

• Decide with data: Evaluate technical trade-offs and drive decisions grounded in experiments and measurable business impact.

• Raise the technical bar: Lead design and architecture reviews, and uphold standards for ML best practices such as rigorous offline and online evaluation, minimizing training/serving skew, feature and model selection, and incremental, test-driven delivery.

Your Expertise:

• 8+ years of industry experience building and shipping applied machine learning, including 3+ years managing ML engineers or applied scientists, ideally building a new team or shared ML platform that serves multiple product teams

• BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field

• Depth in Natural Language Processing and LLM-based systems, with hands-on experience taking models to production

• Strong programming (Python, Java, or Kotlin) and data engineering skills

• Experience with 3 or more of: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Kubernetes, Spark, Airflow (or equivalent), Kafka (or equivalent), and a data warehouse such as Hive

• Experience building end-to-end ML infrastructure and productionizing ML models, both batch and real-time

• Strong grasp of ML best practices: evaluation design (offline metrics, human labeling, LLM-as-judge), training/serving skew minimization, A/B testing, feature engineering, and feature and model selection

• Familiarity with architectural patterns of large, high-scale systems: well-designed APIs, high-volume data pipelines, and efficient algorithms

• Track record of test-driven development, incremental delivery, and safe deployment

• Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with stakeholders at every level and navigate ambiguity

Nice to have

• Experience with LLMs in production, including evaluation, grounding and guardrails, and alignment techniques (SFT, RLHF, DPO)

• Experience with ranking, matching, forecasting, or optimization systems (for example search, recommendations, routing, or capacity planning)

• Experience applying AI to customer support, quality assurance, workforce tooling, trust and safety, or fraud

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states.
