Our people are at the heart of everything we do. When you join our team, you become part of a collaborative, supportive environment where your work helps create a positive experience for children and families each day.

• 401(k) options

• Ongoing leadership development and career growth opportunities

jobs.title: International Trade Compliance Analyst, Omen
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

THE TEAM

Anduril’s International Trade Compliance team is a resourceful and collaborative group dedicated to deploying cutting-edge defense technology to the United States and its allies. Operating in a fast-growing, high-impact environment, we take creative ownership of complex regulatory matters to build and manage efficient, top-tier compliance processes. We are deeply passionate about the law and policy of defense technology and foster a supportive culture that offers tremendous opportunities for professional growth.

THE JOB

Anduril’s International Trade Compliance team seeks an experienced Export Compliance Analyst to help build our Compliance team supporting the future technology of defense. In this role, you will work across many aspects of Anduril’s business including helping obtain and manage export authorizations, implementing compliance best practices and supporting our internal teams as a primary interface to Compliance. This position is based in Costa Mesa, CA and will primarily support Anduril’s Omen line of Autonomous Air Vehicles.

Anduril is a fast-growing company at the early stages of growth. Consistent with this fast growth, members of Anduril’s International Trade Compliance team must be resourceful, creative, and eager to take ownership of complex matters. The Export Compliance Analyst role will require creativity and resourcefulness to implement and manage efficient, high-compliance processes for complex rules, with a singular focus on helping Anduril deploy its technology into operational settings for the United States and its allies. The Export Compliance Analyst will be expected to take responsibility for significant, material projects, which will have a significant impact on the business. Our team is passionate about the law and policy of defense technology and you should have an independent interest in the key issues in this field. Anduril fosters a diverse, collaborative, culture with tremendous opportunities for ownership and professional growth.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Ensure compliance with International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR)

• Prepare and submit export authorization applications

• Support implementation of ITC program requirements

• Review and determine export classifications

• Provide guidance and training to staff on ITAR and EAR regulations

• Monitor and implement changes in export control regulations

• Draft, submit, manage and track export authorizations

• Liaise with U.S. government agencies

• Support the logistics team on hardware exports

• Assist in the development, review, and improvement of compliance procedures and processes for U.S. subsidiaries

• Perform compliance assessments of export/import authorizations and related transactions and assist in any investigations of potential compliance issues

• Support and implement corrective actions that result from compliance issues

• Participate in working groups, independent projects, and collaborative efforts with within the compliance function or cross-functionally

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of compliance work in export control

• Prior defense industry or U.S. Government experience

• Strong understanding of U.S. export control regulations and compliance requirements

• Experience developing, deploying, and maintaining compliance processes

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Quick learner and able to contribute to the broader start-up legal function, including topics that may be completely new to you.

• Capability to manage multiple complex tasks and work efficiently

• Ability to obtain and maintain DoD Top Secret and Special Access Program (SAP) security clearances

• Willing and able to travel at least 15% of time

• Experience with export compliance software and/or databases

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Significant compliance process management experience in defense sector

• Experience with Australian and UK trade regulations

• Experience with integrating trade compliance tools into ERP, PLM, and other systems

• Prior experience as an Empowered Official

• Experience in using collaboration tools, including Slack, Confluence, and Jira

US Salary Range

$132,000—$175,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Project Manager - LNP
jobs.description:
About GenScript

Founded in 2002 in New Jersey, GenScript Biotech Corporation accelerates innovation in biotech and healthcare by providing researchers and companies with the building blocks needed to develop groundbreaking treatments and products. Guided by its mission to Make People and Nature Healthier Through Biotechnology, and its role as a well-recognized biotechnology company, GenScript has a team of approximately 6,165 employees and has served more than 200,000 customers across over 100 countries and regions.

Role Description:

We are seeking a dynamic Project Manager to lead customer-facing mRNA and lipid nanoparticle (LNP) projects, with a primary focus on LNP development and delivery. You will be responsible for ensuring all project deliverables are executed on time, within scope, and aligned with client expectations.

The ideal candidate brings a solid scientific foundation, exceptional communication skills, sharp problem-solving abilities, and strong business acumen. You’ll serve as the key liaison between external clients and internal cross-functional teams — from R&D to manufacturing — requiring agility, diplomacy, and a results-driven mindset. Success in this role demands someone who thrives in GenScript’s fast-paced, collaborative, and high-performance culture.

Key Responsibilities:

• Partner with Commercial and Production teams to ensure seamless project execution and customer satisfaction.

• Capture detailed project requirements, clarify specifications, and align expectations with clients.

• Develop and communicate customized project plans to clients and internal stakeholders.

• Monitor order production progress, evaluate performance metrics, and implement process improvements.

• Provide scientific troubleshooting for unexpected results and propose data-driven solutions.

• Deliver timely project updates to clients via email/telecom, adhering to agreed milestones.

• Lead cross-functional coordination across all project phases (initiation to closure).

• Address client complaints or quality concerns, collaborating with Production to resolve issues.

• Maintain comprehensive project documentation (reports, records, and compliance files).

• Support Production in analyzing and expanding service offerings for the US market.

• Serve as an R&D consultant, translating client needs into actionable research plans.

• Represent the company at customer visits and scientific events (conferences, workshops).

• Fulfill additional tasks assigned by Project Leaders, upholding service excellence.

Qualifications:

• Master’s degree or higher in Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related field.

• Strong technical foundation in RNA biology and lipid nanoparticle (LNP) formulation, with hands-on laboratory or process development experience.

• Prior project management experience preferred — demonstrated success in coordinating cross-functional teams to deliver projects on time, within scope, and on budget.

• Direct research or development experience with mRNA and LNP platforms is a strong plus.

• Customer-centric mindset with excellent interpersonal and client-facing communication skills — both written and verbal.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and familiar with common bioinformatics or lab data management tools.

• Highly organized with strong analytical, prioritization, and time management skills.

• Proven ability to juggle multiple projects simultaneously without compromising quality or deadlines.

• Resilient under pressure — thrives in fast-paced, high-stakes environments.

Perks:

• Free colleague meals during shift

• Onsite gyms

Compensation:
Salary range: $65,000 – $80,000 total compensation, including bonus, depending on experience and qualifications.

Benefits:

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as a 401(k) retirement plan with a company match that vests fully on day one. We offer paid parental leave after just three (3) months of employment, and a paid time off policy that includes vacation time, personal time, sick time, floating holidays, and company holidays. Additional benefits include flexible spending and health savings accounts, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, legal assistance, and supplemental plans such as pet, critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance. We also provide commuter benefits, well-being initiatives, and peer-to-peer recognition programs; demonstrating our ongoing commitment to building a culture where our people feel empowered, supported, and inspired to do their best work.

It is the Company's policy to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, national origin, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, genetic information, citizenship status, uniformed service member or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Internship - Finance (Undergraduate)
jobs.description:
BioMed Realty is seeking part-time Finance Interns to join our Finance team at our San Diego headquarters. This internship offers hands-on experience in financial analysis, reporting, and data management within a fast-paced Finance function. You will learn from professionals across multiple teams while supporting projects that inform executive decision-making and investor reporting.

Through exposure to real estate fundamentals, tenant analysis, and portfolio reporting, you will develop technical proficiency in financial modeling, data analysis, and business communication while contributing to team deliverables with guidance from Finance professionals.

This internship is a job-share opportunity. You will be paired with a fellow intern who works on the same or similar projects on alternating days.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

Interns support the Finance team under the guidance of experienced professionals, building skills while contributing to real projects.

• Financial Analysis and Tenant Underwriting: Assist with financial review of tenant companies, help prepare credit analysis, and draft summary outputs that support underwriting and portfolio management decisions.

• Portfolio Performance Reporting: Help prepare recurring dashboards and reporting packages for senior management and investors, including portfolio occupancy reporting, quarterly investor presentations, and analysis of leasing activity, occupancy trends, and tenant mix.

• Data Management and Quality Assurance: Help maintain leasing and portfolio databases, support the monthly rent roll variance review process, and review reporting materials for accuracy, consistency, and quality.

• Lease Analytics and Documentation: Review and summarize lease transactions and related documentation to support portfolio metrics and underwriting analysis.

• Cross-Functional Support: Work with teams across Finance and the broader organization to support data flow and forecasting activities (including opex and capex reforecasting) and help keep reporting accurate and timely. Help maintain departmental deliverable and workstream calendars and send timeline reminders to keep teams aligned on key deadlines.

• Ad Hoc Analysis and Research: Assist with analysis and research requests related to tenant pipeline, market updates, and portfolio performance, and summarize findings in clear takeaways for the team.

• Job-Share Partnership: Work with your job-share partner on shared projects and keep a shared handoff log so work continues smoothly across your alternating days.

Opportunities for Growth

• Cross-Functional Exposure: Gain visibility into leasing, cash flow forecasting, and portfolio management while building relationships with stakeholders across the Finance department and broader organization.

• Technical Development: Develop proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and enterprise reporting tools (Oracle EPM Cloud) while learning real estate financial analysis and market dynamics.

Skills, Experience, and Competencies

Required

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's degree program in finance, business, accounting, economics, or a related field.

• Exposure to financial statements, financial analysis, or accounting concepts.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with eagerness to keep building them on the job.

• Basic understanding of commercial real estate, or openness to learning real estate fundamentals.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.

• Availability for two on-site days per week on one of the alternating-day schedules listed below.

• Attention to Detail: Produces accurate, well-organized deliverables; reviews work carefully and incorporates feedback.

• Time and Priority Management: Organizes assigned tasks, meets agreed-upon deadlines, and communicates when priorities conflict.

• Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing, and provides timely updates on assignments.

• Collaboration: Works respectfully with colleagues, contributes to team objectives, and builds positive working relationships across departments.

• Initiative: Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, seeks guidance when needed, and identifies opportunities to support the team.

• Organization: Maintains organized work and documentation while managing multiple assignments and deadlines.

• Adaptability: Responds constructively to changing priorities, feedback, and new assignments.

The internship begins as early as possible in January 2027 and runs through May/June 2027, with potential to extend based on business needs and performance.

Each intern is paired with a job-share partner who works the alternating days, so the pair's projects advance throughout the week. jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Regulatory Counsel

As Regulatory Counsel at Astranis, you will be responsible for performing research on complex Federal Communications Commission (FCC) regulatory constructs, preparing satellite and earth station applications, tracking those applications (and ensuring that they are ultimately granted!), and writing comments that persuade government officials to our point of view. You will work closely with engineers across the company, as well as the Spectrum Engineers and attorneys on the Regulatory Team. As Astranis continues launching satellites to connect millions around the world, we need to secure orbital slots and regulatory approvals.

If you are detail oriented, a problem solver, and thrive in a fast paced environment you should apply!

Role

• Work on mission-critical regulatory projects that span commercial, technical, and operational functions

• Deliver end-to-end licenses, moving from initial information gathering, application, implementation,to ongoing execution of license conditions

• Master d highly complex topics related to particular regulatory regimes in space -- e.g., the International Telecommunication Union rules around filing for orbital slots or the FCC’s two degree spacing regime for satellites

• Develop knowledge that becomes a competitive advantage for the company, aggregating everything publicly available and supplementing with the input of our team of expert advisors

• Be ready to roll up your sleeves, dive into the weeds and take ownership of core licensing and regulatory workflows with precision and grit

• Pay close attention to details to deliver formal documents that Astranis can be proud of

Requirements

• 2+ years in a fast-paced career: experience working with the FCC or other spectrum regulatory regimes preferred

• B.A. or B.S. required, JD, MBA or other Master's optional

• Extremely high bar for quality deliverables

• Proven ability to drive projects to completion, including the final 20% that's the hardest to complete

• Commitment to work hard to help the company succeed

• Fast learner, with a demonstrated ability to learn about a technical regulatory topic down to first fundamentals

• Proven ability to synthesize complicated topics and details into presentations and documents for internal consumption and external client partners

• Don't meet all these requirements? Apply anyways, let's talk.

Bonus

• Regulatory or wireless spectrum or legal experience

• Law degree

What we offer:

All our positions offer a compensation package that includes equity and robust benefits.

Base pay is just one component of Astranis’s total rewards package. Your compensation also includes a significant equity package via incentive stock options, high-quality company-subsidized healthcare, disability and life insurance, 401(k) retirement planning, flexible PTO, and free on-site catered meals.

Astranis pay ranges are informed and defined through professional-grade salary surveys and compensation data sources. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, and the level and scope of the position.

Base Salary Level II

jobs.title: Technicien(ne) en gréage et automatisation - ECHO  | Rigging & Automation Technician - ECHO
jobs.description:
Technicien(ne) en gréage et automatisation – Spectacle de tournée 
Automatisation scénique 
 
* Il s’agit d’un poste à temps plein au sein d’une tournée internationale. La personne retenue travaillera et voyagera dans plusieurs pays avec une compagnie de tournée internationale où l’anglais est la langue de travail de la production. La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise pour exercer les fonctions de ce poste. * 
 
Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne technicienne en gréage et automatisation pour se joindre à l’un des spectacles de tournée du Cirque du Soleil. Relevant de la direction technique et travaillant sous la supervision des responsables des départements de l’automatisation et du gréage, cette personne est responsable de l’exploitation, de l’entretien et de l’inspection des systèmes de gréage et d’automatisation afin d’assurer des opérations de spectacle sécuritaires, fiables et constantes. Ce rôle à double fonction contribue à l’intégration harmonieuse des éléments acrobatiques et scéniques, tout en maintenant les normes les plus élevées en matière de sécurité, d’intégrité artistique et d’excellence technique. 
La personne idéale est polyvalente, possède de solides connaissances des systèmes de gréage et d’automatisation, d’excellentes aptitudes en dépannage et la capacité de s’adapter rapidement à un environnement de tournée dynamique. 
 
La personne technicienne en gréage et automatisation aura l’occasion de :  
Opérer et exécuter les séquences du spectacle pendant les répétitions, les représentations et les séances d’entraînement des artistes. 
Participer au chargement, à l’installation, au démontage et au déchargement des systèmes de gréage et d’automatisation ainsi que des autres installations lors des transferts entre les villes; diriger ou superviser les équipes locales, au besoin. 
Surveiller le gréage acrobatique, les systèmes d’automatisation et l’équipement connexe afin d’assurer des opérations sécuritaires et fiables. 
Participer à l’inspection, au dépannage et à l’entretien de l’équipement de gréage et d’automatisation, notamment les treuils, palans, chariots, plateformes élévatrices, plateaux tournants et systèmes de commande. 
Tenir à jour des dossiers précis sur les inspections, les modifications, les réparations, les registres d’entretien, les feuilles de conduite et les inventaires. 
Collaborer avec les responsables de département afin d’élaborer des méthodes d’exploitation sécuritaires, des routines d’entretien préventif et des procédures départementales. 
Contribuer au dépannage des problèmes électriques, mécaniques et de commande; appliquer les mesures correctives selon les directives reçues. 
Contribuer à des projets spéciaux, notamment l’intégration de nouvel équipement, les mises à niveau et les initiatives techniques. 
Préserver l’intégrité artistique du spectacle en collaboration avec la direction technique, les responsables de département, le département artistique, l’équipe des services techniques et les concepteurs et conceptrices. 
Collaborer avec les autres départements techniques pendant le chargement, l’installation, le démontage, le déchargement, les répétitions, les représentations, les événements spéciaux et les situations d’urgence. 
Participer à la gestion des stocks, aux commandes ainsi qu’à l’entretien du matériel, des outils et des consommables du département. 
Contribuer à la planification des mesures de contingence et intervenir rapidement en cas de problèmes techniques pendant les représentations. 
Veiller au respect des protocoles du Cirque du Soleil, des exigences de l’OSHA et des règlements locaux en matière de sécurité; appliquer en tout temps des pratiques de travail sécuritaires. 
Favoriser un milieu de travail collaboratif, respectueux et sécuritaire, conforme aux valeurs du Cirque du Soleil. 
Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe qui lui est confiée 
 
La personne idéale possède les qualifications suivantes : 
Requis : Disponibilité pour participer à une tournée internationale à temps plein et travailler à l’étranger. 
Diplôme d’études collégiales en arts de la scène, en production théâtrale ou expérience professionnelle équivalente. 
Minimum de 3 ans d’expérience professionnelle en gréage et/ou en automatisation dans le domaine du spectacle vivant. 
Expérience démontrée en gréage aérien/humain et avec des systèmes d’automatisation de spectacle à grande échelle. 
 Solides connaissances techniques des éléments suivants :  
Systèmes de gréage, y compris la protection contre les chutes, l’équipement d’escalade, les systèmes de poulies, les palans et la répartition des charges. 
Systèmes d’automatisation, y compris les automates programmables (PLC), la commande de moteurs à courant alternatif, les systèmes d’asservissement et la commande de mouvements multiaxes. 
Systèmes mécaniques, électriques et hydrauliques liés au gréage et à l’automatisation. 
Capacité à lire et à interpréter des dessins techniques, des schémas et des calculs de charges. 
Solides aptitudes en dépannage et capacité à intervenir rapidement pendant les représentations. 
Formation reconnue en protection contre les chutes et en accès sur corde, un atout. 
Connaissance des consoles et logiciels d’automatisation (p. ex. Navigator ou l’équivalent), un atout. 
Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office; connaissance des logiciels de CAO (AutoCAD, SOLIDWORKS), un atout. 
Excellentes aptitudes pour le travail d’équipe, l’adaptabilité et la communication; capacité à garder son calme sous pression. 
Maîtrise de l’anglais (écrit et parlé); la connaissance d’autres langues constitue un atout. 
Capacité à accomplir les fonctions essentielles du poste, notamment s’accroupir, s’agenouiller, rester debout et soulever des charges, parfois pendant de longues périodes; soulever de l’équipement lourd sans assistance, etc. Des mesures d’adaptation raisonnables peuvent être mises en place afin de permettre aux personnes en situation de handicap d’accomplir les fonctions essentielles du poste. 
 
Le Groupe Cirque du Soleil s’engage à créer et maintenir un milieu de travail accessible et inclusif. Fièrement ambassadeur de l’égalité en emploi, Le Groupe Cirque du Soleil s’est engagé à enrayer la discrimination fondée sur l’âge, la couleur de la peau, les origines, la religion, le sexe, l’orientation sexuelle et toute autre caractéristique. La rédaction neutre et inclusive est dorénavant privilégiée pour tous les nouveaux affichages de postes.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice President, Information Technology
jobs.description:
Lead Technology. Inspire Innovation. Help Shape What’s Next at Mather

Mather is an award-winning leader in wellness and senior living, recognized for creating possibilities for people to age well through innovative experiences, environments, and approaches to well-being. As Mather continues to evolve and grow, the Assistant Vice President of Information Technology will serve as a technology thought leader, helping shape how technology, innovation, and emerging solutions can strengthen our operations, elevate resident and team-member experiences, and support Mather’s continued growth.

The Assistant Vice President of Information Technology is a highly visible, hands-on technology leader who helps translate Mather’s organizational priorities into reliable, secure, and effective technology solutions across a multi-site environment. Working in close partnership with the Vice President of Information Technology and other senior leaders, this role provides leadership and coordination across IT operations, enterprise applications, infrastructure, service delivery, technology modernization, cybersecurity and risk, resident-facing technology, vendor partnerships, and change adoption. The AVP directly supervises two IT Managers, providing leadership and development, while also building and managing critical external relationships with technology vendors, contractors, consultants, and managed service partners.

To be successful in this role, candidates should bring 8+ years of progressive technology experience with demonstrated strength across IT operations, project management, service delivery, vendor management, budgeting, infrastructure, and technology modernization. We are looking for a leader who understands the interconnected nature of cybersecurity, privacy, access management, compliance, risk, incident response, and business continuity, and who can effectively guide initiatives involving Microsoft 365, cloud platforms, endpoint and network infrastructure, data and analytics, AI, automation, collaboration tools, and other enterprise technologies.

Just as important as technical depth is the ability to lead through people, partnerships, and influence. Successful candidates will be exceptional communicators who can translate complex technical matters into clear business language, bring structure and accountability to competing priorities, and move work from discussion and decision through implementation, adoption, stabilization, and measurable results. Experience within senior living, healthcare, hospitality, or another multi-site, customer-focused service environment is especially valuable, as is exposure to resident-facing technology, smart-building platforms, digital engagement, analytics, AI governance, and enterprise transformation.

The ideal leader combines strategic thinking with a willingness to stay connected to day-to-day operations. They bring strong organization, follow-through, problem-solving, documentation, and prioritization skills, while creating a collaborative, responsive, accountable, and service-oriented IT culture. A bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, business administration, technology management, or a related field is required, with equivalent experience considered. Relevant professional certifications, training, or coursework in areas such as project management, IT service management, Microsoft technologies, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity are preferred.

This is a full-time, salaried hybrid role with requirements to work out of Mather’s Headquarters office in Evanston, Illinois, along with approximately 10–15% travel throughout the year to Mather locations in Illinois, Arizona, and Virginia.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

1. Technology Strategy, Projects, Innovation, and Modernization

• Lead assigned technology projects and modernization initiatives from planning through implementation, ensuring clear scope, timelines, milestones, risks, decisions, and follow-up actions.

• Coordinate project governance, requirements gathering, implementation readiness, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communication for assigned initiatives.

• Support infrastructure, endpoint, network, cloud, software, Microsoft 365, data, AI, automation, and collaboration initiatives within approved scope and leadership direction.

• Prepare concise updates, planning materials, and recommendations that align technology workplans with operational priorities, available resources, and organizational needs.

2. IT Operations, Service Delivery, Security, and Support Readiness

• Oversee assigned IT operations, service delivery activities, escalations, and support processes to promote reliable, responsive, and well-documented technology services.

• Monitor service trends, recurring issues, ticket performance, and stakeholder feedback to identify improvement opportunities and clarify ownership.

• Ensure procedures, knowledge articles, onboarding/offboarding workflows, access processes, support documentation, and operational handoffs are maintained and followed.

• Support security, privacy, compliance, and risk management activities, including access reviews, audit preparation, security awareness initiatives, and related documentation.

• Identify and escalate security, privacy, vendor, operational, or service concerns requiring leadership review, expert guidance, or remediation planning.

• Coordinate with internal IT staff, managed service partners, and vendors to resolve issues and escalate material vendor, contract, budget, or service concerns as appropriate.

3. Resident Experience and Smart Community Technology

• Coordinate assigned resident-facing and smart community technology initiatives with community leaders, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

• Support planning, communication, training coordination, adoption follow-up, and issue resolution for resident technology projects and pilots.

• Escalate usability, accessibility, privacy, reliability, or support concerns that require leadership guidance or vendor follow-up.

4. People Leadership and Change Coordination

• Provide direction, coaching, feedback, and coordination for assigned team members, vendors, and project contributors.

• Communicate priorities, risks, progress, decisions, and change impacts clearly to key stakeholders.

• Support change adoption through readiness planning, training coordination, and follow-up.

• Model a service-oriented, collaborative, accountable, and security-minded approach.

QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, business administration, technology management, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

• 8+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, technology project management, service delivery, vendor coordination, or technology leadership.

• Experience supporting IT operations, enterprise applications, infrastructure, service delivery, vendor management, budgeting, and technology modernization initiatives.

• Working knowledge of cybersecurity, privacy, access management, compliance, risk management, incident response, and business continuity concepts.

• Experience leading or supporting technology initiatives involving Microsoft 365, cloud platforms, endpoint management, network infrastructure, data analytics, AI, automation, collaboration tools, or related business systems.

• Strong communication, organization, follow-through, problem-solving, documentation, and prioritization skills.

Preferred:

• Experience in senior living, healthcare, hospitality, or another multi-site, resident/customer-focused service environment.

• Experience with resident-facing technology, smart-building platforms, digital engagement tools, analytics, AI governance, or enterprise transformation initiatives.

• Relevant professional certification, training, or coursework in project management, IT service management, Microsoft technologies, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity awareness.

The salary range provided is a good faith estimate of what Mather reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. The actual salary rate offered will be determined based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to relevant skills, certifications, years of experience, geographic location, and current market conditions. Bonus Plan eligible ranging from 0-20% of base salary. At Mather, we are committed to being inclusive, resilient, bold, and impactful—and that includes offering a total rewards experience designed to support our team members. This position may be eligible to participate in Mather’s benefit plan and Holiday Bonus, if applicable. Eligibility for benefits is dependent on employment status and hours worked per pay period. Participation in the Holiday Bonus is not guaranteed and may vary based on factors such as hire date and program eligibility requirements. All benefits are subject to change without notice.

Salary Range

$195,000—$200,000 USD

Benefits

Mather offers a competitive benefits package.*

Team members are eligible for:

• A generous paid time off (PTO) program including vacation days/personal days, sick days, and holidays. This is an “earn-as-you-go” plan that rolls over year to year, offering long- and short-term flexibility.

• A 401(k) program with per pay-period employer match and annual employer contribution (available to those age 21 or better)

• Convenient, subsidized parking (or public transportation for certain locations)

• Wellness Spending Account: up to $300 available annually for Wellness related expenses such as gym memberships, financial planning, etc.

Benefits-eligible team members can take advantage of:

• Medical, dental, and vision plans

• Paid Parental Leave

• Adoption Assistance Reimbursement

• Tuition reimbursement for continuing education

• Extended illness benefits

• Employee wellness programs

• Short- and long-term disability insurance

• Life insurance is available to benefit eligible team members.

*Benefits are subject to change without notice. Benefits details dependent on employment status.

About Mather

Based in Evanston, Illinois, Mather is a unique, non-denominational, not-for-profit organization founded in 1941. Dedicated to developing and implementing Ways to Age WellSM, we create programs, places, and residences for today’s young-at-heart older adults. Mather has received a national certification as a Great Place to Work®, and has been selected as a Nation’s Best and Brightest in Wellness Award recipient four years in a row.

Mather is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to an inclusive workforce. Candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.title: Associate Scientist III, Metabolic Diseases
jobs.description:
Associate Scientist III, Metabolic Diseases, wanted by Insitro, Inc. in South San Francisco, CA.  Engineer complex 3D cell models (spheroids and co-cultures) using various cell types for mechanistic studies; Develop and qualify workflows to validate drug targets, define mechanism of action and conduct pharmacology studies for drug discovery using techniques such as CRISPR, siRNA and RNAseq; Independently develop and optimize in vitro assays by leveraging molecular biology techniques, advanced microscopy and automated instrumentation for metabolic disease phenotyping; Generate datasets from ex vivo samples for key efficacy and target engagement readouts to enable critical go/no-go decisions; Analyze high-throughput datasets using sophisticated Machine Learning-based pipelines; Lead small projects end-to-end and coordinate handoffs between multi-disciplinary teams to meet key project milestones; Generate presentations and publication material for effective scientific communication at the company level; Adhere to good lab practices and document all experimental parameters meticulously in an Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN) for data integrity.



Must have a Master’s degree in Biotechnology, Bioengineering or a related field plus two (2) years of experience in a related occupation.  In lieu of a Master’s degree plus two (2) years of experience, we will accept a Bachelor’s degree in Biotechnology, Bioengineering or a related field plus five (5) years of progressive experience in a related occupation. Must have two (2) years of experience handling primary, immortalized, and iPSC-derived cell lines (such as hepatocytes, fibroblasts and endothelial cells) and engineering complex disease models including co-cultures and spheroids; two (2) years of experience executing high throughput screening such as pooled optical, arrayed CRISPR screens and siRNA drug discovery screens; two (2) years of experience handling tool compounds such as oligonucleotides, small molecules and antibodies for functional validation, disease phenotyping, and mechanistic studies; two (2) years of experience applying molecular biology techniques for gene expression such as qPCR and RNAseq; and protein expression such as Jess, MSD, and Luminex; two (2) years of experience developing pharmacology and drug discovery assays, and establishing qualification metrics (Z’, % CV, IC50 and reproducibility); two (2) years of experience leveraging advanced microscopy, high-content imaging, and analysis using Machine Learning-based image segmentation pipelines; two (2) years of experience with large-scale processing of ex-vivo tissues (liver, fat or pancreas) for downstream assays; two  (2) years of experience handling state of the art automation instrumentation such as Agilent Bravo, Hamilton STAR, ECHO and Multidrop combi; two (2) years of experience with using LIMS and other lab oriented software such as GraphPad Prism (data analysis) and Benchling (Electronic Lab Notebook)

$120,349-$129,000/yr.  Please send resume to: ta-resumes@insitro.com and refer to: Job Req._2026-insitro-005P____.

#LI-Hybrid

About insitro

insitro is a drug discovery and development company using machine learning (ML) and data at scale to decode biology for transformative medicines. jobs.title: Analyst, Product and Strategy
jobs.description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we’re changing the way people buy and sell cars. With an ambitious vision and a fundamentally different approach designed to be fun, fast, and fair, Carvana became the fastest-growing automotive retailer in history. We expanded nationally, went public on the New York Stock Exchange, sold our 1 millionth car, and reached the Fortune 500, all in just eight years.

Today, with 4 million retail customers and counting, Carvana is both the fastest-growing and the most profitable public automotive retailer, and we’re just getting started. We continue to raise the bar for our customers as we tackle the enormous opportunity still ahead in the largest consumer vertical.

Working here means being part of a team that embraces change, celebrates creative problem solving, and always strives to be better. At Carvana, you’ll have the opportunity to take on meaningful challenges, learn quickly, and help shape the future of automotive retail. If you’re driven to grow and make an impact as part of a collaborative team, you’ll fit right in. Learn more about what it’s like to work here from the people that already do.

About the team and position

As an Analyst on one of our dynamic strategy teams, you'll dive into a role where data shapes the future of car buying. Our teams use cutting-edge analytics and strategic insights to help us more efficiently make improvements to our customer experience. For example, your work might focus on recommendations for how we allocate our marketing budget, uncovering patterns to enhance our fraud detection models, determining the prices we bid on vehicles at auctions, or assessing the impact of product enhancements on our website or mobile app.

You'll work with vast data sets from diverse sources, turning them into actionable strategies that drive (get it?) our business forward. Whether it's optimizing operations, enhancing customer experiences, or exploring new market opportunities, you’ll get to use your analytical skills to make business decisions and will be given the autonomy to share your insights.

This is a fully on-site position, Monday through Friday, at our Playa Vista office in Los Angeles, California.

What you’ll be doing

• Translating data into consumable, actionable narratives; regularly consulting with stakeholders including senior leadership, sharing results and strategic recommendations.

• Working closely with Product, Engineering, Strategic Partnerships, and Operations to assess performance and identify and prioritize opportunities.

• Exploring and segmenting data to identify and explain key drivers; design and build models, dashboards, and visualizations to support Product teams.

• Designing split tests, interpreting results, and communicating the broader implications.

• Taking ownership of the product track, enabling and empowering the constantly evolving customer experience that makes us leaders in our field.

• Other duties as assigned.

What you should have

• Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Math, Computer Science, Computational Math, Econometrics, Engineering, or similar field from an accredited undergraduate institution required.

• 1-3+ years of experience in analytics or quantitative practices working in data warehouse environments.

• Comfort navigating and manipulating large data sets to identify trends and underlying drivers.

• Familiarity with Python (or R) preferred.

• Strong experience in SQL.

• Experience in one or more of these areas:

• A/B testing or experimentation

• Business strategy or consulting

• Statistical analysis using methods like regression.

• Ability to thrive (and preference to work) in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with frequently changing goals and deadlines.

• Demonstrated intellectual curiosity and interest in solving problems, particularly using data to help answer somewhat nebulous questions (e.g., how consumers make purchasing decisions).

• Excellence in implementation, including attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

• Enthusiasm and positive energy to contribute to and thrive in a rapidly growing start-up atmosphere where roles continually adapt as the company evolves.

• Prior experience in Tableau or another visualization tool is a plus.

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time Salary Position with a competitive salary.

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.

• 401K with company match.

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.

• Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.

• A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development.

• A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country.

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal Stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

jobs.title: Senior Development Test Engineer - Air Dominance & Strike
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Ready to shape the future of defense technology? We are looking for a Sr. Development Test Engineer to join our fast-growing Air Dominance & Strike team in Costa Mesa, CA. In this role, you won't just run tests—you will actively shape how our air vehicle systems fly. jobs.title: Information Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Information Security Analyst – Micro Segmentation & Zero Trust Architecture

Position Overview

Western Digital seeks an experienced Information Security Analyst to design, deploy, and operationalize advanced micro segmentation solutions across our enterprise environment. This role is critical to our Zero Trust architecture strategy and will require deep technical expertise in application dependency mapping, security policy enforcement, and threat surface reduction. The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with infrastructure, security, and application teams to modernize our network security posture while maintaining operational continuity across a complex, global manufacturing and technology environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Micro Segmentation Architecture & Deployment

• Design, deploy, and maintain micro segmentation solutions across enterprise environments, including data centers, cloud platforms, and hybrid infrastructure
• Conduct comprehensive application dependency mapping and traffic flow analysis to identify communication patterns and inform segmentation strategy
• Label and classify newly onboarded assets according to Western Digital security and operational guidelines
• Create, test, and manage security policy rules to control application communication, enforce least-privilege access, and systematically reduce attack surfaces
• Develop technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and implementation guides for micro segmentation policies and operational processes

Policy Management & Zero Trust Implementation

• Work collaboratively with infrastructure, security, and application teams to identify interdependencies and define segmentation requirements aligned with business objectives
• Conduct thorough policy testing, validation, and staged enforcement to minimize business disruption during implementation
• Support Zero Trust architecture initiatives by establishing micro segmentation best practices and ensuring alignment with security frameworks
• Integrate micro segmentation solutions with existing security tools, configuration management databases (CMDB), SIEM platforms, and cloud environments

Operational Support & Maintenance

• Monitor and troubleshoot micro segmentation agent deployment, policy enforcement, and connectivity issues
• Provide ongoing operational support including system upgrades, security patching, performance tuning, and capacity planning
• Perform root cause analysis on policy violations, agent health issues, and traffic anomalies
• Assist security operations and incident response teams by analyzing blocked/allowed traffic, correlating security events, and investigating suspicious communication patterns

Secondary Responsibilities

Network Security Architecture

• Support traditional next-generation firewall (NGFW) architecture, deployment, and administration across enterprise and cloud environments
• Contribute to firewall policy management, rule optimization, and threat prevention strategy
• Participate in firewall refresh initiatives, virtual appliance migrations, and security tool integrations

Cloud Infrastructure Security

• Design and implement cloud infrastructure security architecture across multi-cloud and hybrid environments
• Evaluate and recommend cloud-native security controls that complement micro segmentation strategy
• Support cloud workload protection, network segmentation, and identity-based access controls

Technical Expertise

• 5+ years of experience in information security engineering, network security, or infrastructure security roles
• Advanced proficiency in micro segmentation platform deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting
• Strong understanding of application dependency mapping, network traffic analysis, and Zero Trust architecture principles
• Hands-on experience with NGFW platforms, security policy development, and threat prevention technologies
• Demonstrated experience integrating security tools with CMDB, SIEM, and cloud platforms
• Proficiency in analyzing network traffic, security events, and incident investigation
• Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native security controls
• Knowledge of enterprise security frameworks (CIS, NIST, Zero Trust) and compliance requirements

Professional Competencies

• Self-motivation & Resilience: Ability to work independently on complex technical projects with minimal oversight; capability to maintain focus and deliver results under pressure and during challenging troubleshooting scenarios
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively with infrastructure, application, security operations, and business teams; skilled at translating technical requirements into actionable solutions
• Documentation & Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and implementation guides for diverse audiences
• Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to policy configuration, testing, and validation to ensure accuracy and minimize security or operational risks
• Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset with ability to diagnose complex technical issues and develop sustainable solutions

jobs.title: Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
About Exa

Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. Our Search API powers agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn’t been disrupted since the ’90s. We recently raised a $250M Series C led by a16z, with Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, valuing Exa at $2.2B.

About the role

Strategic finance at Exa helps leadership decide where to put money and attention: how much compute to buy, which data partnerships to pursue, how to price our products, and which markets and use cases to go after. You’ll build the models behind those decisions and bring a clear recommendation to each one. You’ll also own Exa’s unit economics: finding where margins can get better and working with the teams involved to make those improvements happen.

You’ll be our first strategic finance hire. The role starts with compute and infrastructure economics and also covers go-to-market finance. You’ll work directly with the founders and with our Research, Infrastructure, Data Partnerships, RevOps, FP&A, and GTM teams. As we grow, we expect strategic finance to split into separate infrastructure and go-to-market teams, and you’ll have the first shot at leading one.

What you’ll do

 - Infrastructure economics – Build and own the model for what it costs to run and scale Exa: cost to serve, gross margin by product and customer, and how both change as usage grows. Turn usage metrics into cost drivers so pricing, product, and hiring decisions start from real costs.

 - Compute and GPU economics – Model what our compute spend buys us: cost per workload, utilization, and the tradeoffs between owning, reserving, and renting capacity. Bring the financial view to major GPU purchases and commitments, support negotiations with compute and cloud providers, and track committed vs. consumed spend.

 - Cost visibility and allocation – Build the framework that attributes compute and infrastructure costs to products, customers, and workloads, and give teams self-serve visibility into the costs they drive.

 - Efficiency and margin expansion – Define north-star unit metrics like cost per search, find where margins can improve, and partner with Research and Infrastructure on compute optimization, caching, and vendor strategy to capture those gains.

 - Demand to cost – Partner with RevOps and FP&A on demand forecasting, and translate expected usage into compute needs, COGS and gross margin forecasts, and pricing implications.

 - Pricing and packaging – Bring a financial lens to self-serve and enterprise pricing, credits and discount policy, and margin guardrails for our most important deals.

 - Markets and use cases – Work with GTM to size the markets and use cases we could go after, compare their growth and margins using usage and pipeline data, and recommend where Exa should focus.

 - Strategic and data deals – Model large committed-spend, ramp, and partnership deals, and tell us when to hold firm and when to bend. Work with Data Partnerships to evaluate, price, and structure data licensing deals against what each is worth to Exa.

 - KPIs leadership runs on – Define the metrics that matter (gross margin, compute efficiency, net revenue retention, cohort economics), pull data from wherever it lives, and make reporting run itself. Support board and investor materials.

 - AI-native finance – Replace recurring analysis with agents and internal tooling instead of headcount. How we run finance is part of our advantage.

About you

 - High-rigor background – You have 5–8 years in investment banking, consulting, PE or growth investing, or strategic finance at a high-growth tech company.

 - A first-principles modeler – You’ve built complex models from scratch and can defend every assumption when pushed.

 - Fluent with engineers – You want to understand our GPU and systems costs well enough to model them, challenge the engineers who run them, and turn usage into financial insight.

 - Comfortable with messy data – You pull your own data (SQL a plus) and work comfortably with large, usage-based datasets.

 - AI-native – You already use LLMs and agents to do real work faster, and you’ve built things with them.

 - Candid – You’ll tell a founder or a sales leader when a plan doesn’t pencil, and help them find one that does.

 - An owner – You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Most of what you’ll own doesn’t exist yet.

Bonus points

 - Experience with GPU, cloud, or data center economics (reserved vs. on-demand pricing, utilization, hardware purchases), or with usage-based or API businesses.

 - You’ve built cost allocation or gross margin reporting for a multi-product, usage-based business.

 - Exposure to board reporting or fundraising work.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Shift Availability:

M - F

Day Shift: 8am - 5pm

Purpose

Divergent is hiring an Advanced Manufacturing Production Specialist to coordinate materials, tooling, and workflows across the production floor, ensuring efficient operations, minimal downtime, and on-schedule output in a high-precision aerospace environment. The role acts as a link between machining, engineering, quality, and supply chain teams, resolving constraints and prioritizing work orders while monitoring production status, tracking inventory and tooling, and identifying bottlenecks

The Role

• Help coordinate daily production activities to ensure alignment with manufacturing schedules and on-time delivery commitments.

• Ensure the availability of tooling, materials, and work instructions prior to job release to minimize downtime and production interruptions.

• Assist with managing and tracking work orders through ERP/MRP systems, maintaining accurate and up-to-date production status.

• Monitor tooling inventory and usage, support tool crib operations, and initiating replenishment or replacement as needed.

• Identify and proactively help address production bottlenecks.

• Assist with production planning activities, including job sequencing, capacity considerations, and resource allocation.

• Maintain accurate documentation, including digital travelers, inspection records, and production logs, in accordance with company requirements.

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying inefficiencies and supporting process optimization efforts.

Basic Qualifications

• Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls

• High school diploma (or equivalent) or relevant aerospace/precision machining experience

• 1+ year of administrative or production support experience minimum in a manufacturing environment

• Strong organizational, multitasking, communication, and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

• Ability to work in fast-paced, deadline-driven production settings

• Familiarity with CNC machining, blueprint reading, tooling, and production workflows

• Basic knowledge of aerospace standards (AS9100) and FAA regulations

• Experience with ERP/MRP systems and proficiency in Microsoft Excel for scheduling, tracking, and data analysis

• Ability to manage and track work orders, inventory, and tooling availability

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in aerospace manufacturing environments (tight tolerances) Knowledge of First Article Inspection (FAI) & Lean Manufacturing / Six Sigma principles

• Certification or training in: APICS / supply chain fundamentals

• Prior experience in: Tool crib management Production control Inventory systems

Work Environment

• This role operates in a fast-paced, high-mix production environment where priorities can shift rapidly based on engineering changes, supply chain constraints and Program milestones. The environment demands tight cross-functional collaboration with engineering, manufacturing, quality, logistics and Program teams to ensure daily execution aligns with long-term build plans.

• Success in this environment requires hands-on engagement on the shop floor, strong system’s knowledge, and the ability to anticipate and resolve scheduling risks before they impact key deliverables.

• The culture emphasizes proactive communication, data-driven decision making, and continuous improvement to meet aggressive program timelines while maintaining high standards for quality, safety, and efficiency.

• Ability to safely lift and carry up to 50 pounds as part of daily job duties, including loading, unloading, and moving materials. Demonstrate proper lifting techniques to prevent injury, maintain physical stamina for repetitive tasks, and follow all workplace safety guidelines when handling heavy items.

Compensation

At Divergent, our pay range is based on the level of the job.

• Specialist 02 / S02: $36.00 - $50.00

Pay Range

$36—$50 USD

• Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.

• Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.

Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Etched

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.



Job Summary

We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator who thrives in fast-moving environments and takes pride in making things run smoothly behind the scenes. You’ll be at the center of our hiring engine – owning scheduling, keeping processes tight, and ensuring every candidate and interviewer has a great experience.

This role is for someone who moves quickly, sweats the details, and doesn’t wait to be told what to do. You’re highly organized, calm under pressure, and naturally step in to solve problems before they become issues.



Key Responsibilities

 - Own high-volume interview scheduling across multiple teams, balancing competing priorities and tight timelines

 - Jump on urgent scheduling changes quickly and keep everything on track without dropping details

 - Deliver a high-quality, thoughtful experience for both candidates and interviewers at every touchpoint

 - Build strong working relationships with candidates, recruiters, sourcers, hiring managers, and cross-functional partners

 - Keep recruiting operations running smoothly through strong organization, communication, and follow-through

 - Spot inefficiencies and proactively improve coordination processes as we scale

 - Partner with People Ops to support onboarding logistics and maintain clean, accurate data

 - Support new hire onboarding programs, including coordinating welcome gifts and shipping onboarding packages



Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice-to-have qualifications)

 - 1-2 years of Recruiting Coordinator experience in a fast-paced, high-growth, or tech environment

 - High sense of ownership and urgency - you take initiative and follow through

 - Low ego, team-first mindset

 - Growth mindset and eagerness to continuously improve



Benefits

 - Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage
   
   - $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits

 - Housing subsidy of $2.5k per month for those living within walking distance of the office

 - Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)

 - Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more

 - Daily lunch and dinner in our office
   

How we’re different

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson http://www.incompleteideas.net/IncIdeas/BitterLesson.html. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.
