jobs.title: Systems Verification & Development Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ODYS

At Odys, we’re mobilizing power, with Hybrid Power Systems developed for aerospace and in-demand everywhere. It’s the kind of mission diversity that demands a fresh way of thinking.

We began with an early bet on hybrid, when the mobility industry was focused on batteries. We designed, tested, and validated our first 1 MW high-speed generator in 12 months. And then we pushed further, developing systems with greater power density in less time. Today, our Hybrid Power Systems offer outputs ranging from 20 kW to 4 MW, with applications in the air or on the ground.

One of those applications is Laila, an unmanned drone designed for critical logistics and defense missions. With its 100 kW-class onboard Hybrid Power System, Laila can support medical cold-chain transport or serve as an aerial platform for counter-UAS measures.

The market interest has been overwhelming: Over 30 inbound requests from leading US and global manufacturers, and 14+ DoD contracts.

Our team comes from deep tech and aerospace, with backgrounds spanning drone and aircraft development, high-volume production, and electrified mobility.

We operate with urgency and ownership at every level. We validated high-speed generator technology faster than our peers, not because we skipped steps, but because we've been doing this long enough to know which ones matter most.

Creating the future of power, in the air and on the ground, is a challenge we’ve been training our entire lives for. If that sounds like you, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Odys Aviation is seeking a Systems Verification & Development Assurance Engineer to support the development, verification, and regulatory compliance of our hybrid-electric unmanned aircraft.

This role combines Systems Engineering, Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), System Safety, and Software Development Assurance. Working closely with engineering teams in the U.S. and Germany, the engineer will help implement structured, requirements-driven development and verification processes supporting SAIL III operations.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Development Assurance & V&V: Plan, coordinate, and implement software development assurance and verification activities aligned with SAIL III objectives, using the selected applicable methodology (e.g., DO-178C, EUROCAE ED-356, or ASTM F3201, subject to regulatory acceptance).

 - Systems Engineering & MBSE: Develop and maintain system requirements, functional architectures, interface definitions, requirements traceability, and verification matrices.

 - System Safety: Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Failure Mode and Effects Analyses (FMEA), safety requirement allocation, and verification of safety-critical functions.

 - Verification & Automation: Coordinate requirements-based testing, SIL/HIL verification, regression testing, and fault-injection activities. Support the application of automated and AI-assisted verification methods with appropriate engineering oversight.

 - Environmental Qualification: Coordinate DO-160G qualification activities, including test planning, qualification matrices, supplier deliverables, schedules, and compliance evidence.

 - Regulatory Compliance: Support and coordinate FAA civil COA and EASA SORA activities, including technical documentation, compliance tracking, and collaboration with the German subsidiary.

 - Engineering Processes: Support configuration management, engineering change control, verification records, and development assurance evidence supporting design reviews and aircraft releases.





REQUIREMENTS 

 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.

 - 2+ years of relevant engineering experience, or a strong graduate-level academic/research background in Systems Engineering, MBSE, System Safety, or aerospace system development.

 - Solid understanding of requirements engineering, system architecture, verification and validation, and engineering lifecycle processes.

 - Familiarity with model-based engineering approaches and system safety methods such as FHA, FMEA, or fault-tree analysis.

 - Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and cross-functional coordination skills.

 - Interest in software development assurance, aircraft systems, and aviation regulatory compliance.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 - Experience with requirements management and systems engineering tools such as Flow Engineering, SysML, Cameo, Capella, or MATLAB System Composer.

 - Academic or professional exposure to ARP4754, ARP4761, DO-178C, DO-160G, or comparable engineering standards.

 - Experience with Python, MATLAB/Simulink, automated testing, SIL/HIL, or CI/CD.

 - Experience in UAS, eVTOL, flight controls, hybrid-electric propulsion, or aerospace systems integration.

 - Familiarity with EASA SORA, FAA UAS regulations, or safety assurance methodologies.

 - Practical experience in requirements management, configuration control, or technical compliance coordination.

jobs.title: Content & Social Contractor, FloElite
jobs.description:
FloSports is a world-class sports media company strategically positioned to be the essential  destination for passionate sports fans, delighting them with live event coverage, breaking news,  highlights, stats, rankings, and team and player profiles. We are growing Our Sports every day  by continuing to invest in our ever-expanding ecosystem, which consists of over a dozen sport  verticals and hundreds of streaming partners. FloSports is creating the home for college  conferences/leagues and sports like grappling, hockey, track & field, racing, cheer, wrestling,  and more, and we are looking for innovative and passionate people like you to help us! 



THE ROLE: 

FloSports is looking for a Content & Social Contractor to support FloElite, our destination for CrossFit and functional fitness competition.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who deeply understands the CrossFit community and knows how to turn live competitions, athletes and storylines into compelling social content that grows our audience and drives fans to watch on FloElite.

You’ll be the primary person responsible for FloElite’s social presence, including ideating, creating and publishing content around live events and maintaining an active, relevant presence between competitions. Because FloElite’s live event calendar is more concentrated than some of our other sports, this role requires someone who can find creative ways to keep the audience engaged even when there is not an event happening every weekend.



RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 - Own the day-to-day content ideation and publishing for FloElite social channels

 - Build content plans around major CrossFit competitions, athletes and storylines with the goal of driving viewership and subscription signups

 - Identify compelling narratives before live events and develop content that gives fans a reason to watch

 - Cover live events in real time by identifying key moments, clipping competition footage and publishing social content throughout the event

 - Work with additional FloSports support when needed during larger live events

 - Maximize FloElite’s live event assets by turning full-event replays into highlights, short-form clips, athlete-focused content, compilations and other formats that extend the life of each event

 - Maintain a consistent social presence between live events through athlete stories, competition storylines, evergreen content, archival footage, trends and other relevant CrossFit content

 - Look for creative ways to keep FloElite relevant and active during gaps in the live competition schedule

 - Help establish the athletes, rivalries and broader narratives that make FloElite events feel must-watch

 - Develop social-first concepts designed to reach both highly engaged CrossFit fans and broader fitness audiences

 - Travel to selected FloElite events to support on-site coverage and capture additional content

 - Create original video content when opportunities and resources allow

 - Coordinate with FloSports teams on event priorities, assets, marketing needs and broader promotional plans



KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:  

 - Deep knowledge of CrossFit, functional fitness competition, athletes, events and the broader community

 - Strong understanding of what CrossFit fans care about and which athletes, rivalries and storylines can drive interest

 - Experience creating social-first sports content, particularly short-form video and real-time event coverage

 - Ability to identify compelling moments from live competitions and quickly turn them into engaging social content

 - Strong instincts for building anticipation and narratives around live events

 - Experience independently managing social content from idea through publication

 - Strong video instincts and an understanding of what makes a clip, highlight or social moment perform

 - Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of a vertical’s social presence without a large supporting content team

 - Ability to stay creative and productive during periods when there are fewer live events

 - Comfortable working nights and weekends when live competitions require coverage

 - Willingness to travel for selected FloElite events

 - Video shooting and editing experience is a plus



BONUS:

This is a contract role designed for someone who can provide consistent weekly support across both live-event periods and the stretches between competitions. The workload will increase around major FloElite events, with the expectation that the contractor remains actively engaged in maintaining the brand’s social presence throughout the calendar.



OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY:

At FloSports, we are bonded by our passion for sports and our purpose to unite communities around experiences that finally give underserved sports the love they deserve. We recognize the need to build a company that seeks out, embraces, and celebrates our individual differences, ideas, and talent. FloSports is committed to the pursuit of a fair, equal and inclusive workplace where everyone is given the opportunity to grow to their fullest potential.

Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure is building the Enterprise Data Cloud—the foundation enterprises need to deploy AI at scale—and the velocity of our Commercial Legal contracting directly fuels how we serve customers and grow. This senior role leads the strategic transformation of Legal-supported transaction processes, shifting the focus from routine deal ownership to AI-enabled workflows and scalable service delivery. You will reimagine how Legal engages the business, allocates expertise, and harnesses automation to elevate the contracting experience. Starting with Commercial Legal and Sales contracting, your cross-functional transformation mandate will expand across Procurement, Real Estate, and other Legal-supported functions. Partnering closely with Legal Operations, IT, and business leaders, you will drive enterprise-wide change through deep commercial expertise and cross-functional influence.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead cross-functional transaction transformation by applying deep commercial expertise and process optimization methodologies to scale Legal service delivery across Sales, Procurement, Real Estate, and other business functions.

• Advance AI, automation, and transaction innovation by identifying high-impact use cases, validating business value, and championing adoption to streamline reviews, improve accuracy, and elevate the contracting experience.

• Evolve the Legal engagement model by designing scalable intake, triage, and escalation pathways that optimize how work is allocated across business users, support resources, and negotiators.

• Partner with Commercial Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, and Finance to elevate deal readiness, contracting visibility, and transaction predictability while aligning future-state commercial workflows with Legal Operations and IT.

• Strengthen contracting standards and measure business impact by co-creating playbooks, fallback positions, and key performance metrics—such as cycle time and Legal capacity—to continuously refine our operating model.

jobs.title: Director of Accounting
jobs.description:
Honor Technology’s mission is to change the way society cares for older adults. As a leader in aging care innovation, Honor provides the technology, tools, and services that empower older adults to live life on their own terms. Honor’s growing portfolio includes its consumer care brand, Home Instead, Inc., the world’s leading provider of in-home care for older adults. With a global franchise network and more than 100,000 Care Pros, Home Instead delivers over 50 million hours of personalized care annually.

Together, Honor and Home Instead are setting a new standard for aging in place, backed by powerful technology, compassionate care, and a commitment to aging on your own terms.

Join us to create a new and better aging experience for our clients, their families, and our Care Professionals.

About the Role:

Honor is seeking a Director of Accounting to lead core accounting operations and the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, ensuring accurate, timely financial reporting in compliance with U.S. GAAP. This leader will oversee corporate accounting, consolidated financial reporting, revenue accounting, franchise billing, AP, T&E, tax-advisor coordination, and other key accounting operations.

Reporting to the Controller, the Director will lead and develop the accounting organization; improve the speed, quality, and discipline of the close and reporting process; strengthen internal controls; and ensure successful audit execution.

The Director will also be a pivotal driver, designer, and executor of the accounting systems and process transformation needed to build a scalable finance infrastructure. This includes improving data integrity, reporting reliability, process efficiency, and controls—strengthening the business today while building a foundation for future public-company readiness.

Mergers and acquisitions will be a meaningful component of this role. The Director must bring demonstrated experience assisting with and executing the accounting workstream from financial due diligence through purchase accounting and post-close integration.

As a Director of Accounting at Honor, you will:

Accounting leadership, close, and reporting

• Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, ensuring accurate financial reporting and execution against established reporting timelines.

• Lead, develop, and establish clear accountability across the accounting organization, including leaders responsible for corporate accounting and financial reporting; revenue accounting and franchise billing; AP and T&E; and related accounting operations.

• Own continuous improvement of the existing close calendar, deliverables, review cadence, and accountability model.

• Develop and execute a close-optimization plan that shortens time to close while improving the quality, consistency, and timeliness of financial reporting.

• Oversee the preparation and review of consolidated financial statements, account reconciliations, journal entries, flux analyses, and supporting schedules.

• Ensure a disciplined, well-controlled close process with timely identification and resolution of accounting and reporting issues.

• Lead resolution of complex accounting, reporting, and close issues; escalate significant judgments, risks, and decisions to the Controller promptly.

Audit, tax, and technical accounting

• Serve as the primary accounting leader for the annual audit, including audit readiness, PBC coordination, auditor interactions, issue resolution, and remediation of control or process observations.

• Oversee BDO and other external tax advisors to support timely tax compliance, provision requirements, planning, and communication of tax risks and opportunities.

• Identify, research, document, and resolve technical accounting matters; partner with the Controller on complex accounting conclusions, accounting-policy development, and implementation of new or updated accounting standards.

• Draft, maintain, and operationalize accounting policies, procedures, and controls; ensure the team understands and consistently applies them.

• Strengthen balance-sheet substantiation, accounting documentation, review controls, and overall audit readiness.

Systems and process transformation

• Lead the accounting design and execution work required for finance-system and process-transformation initiatives.

• Translate business and accounting needs into future-state process designs, reporting specifications, data definitions, control requirements, and system-configuration decisions.

• Work hands-on with the Finance Program Manager and external systems-integration partners to define requirements, make design decisions, validate data and configurations, complete testing, resolve issues, and drive accounting workstreams to completion.

• Own the accounting-side implementation readiness for new processes and systems, including process redesign, data validation, user acceptance testing, control design, documentation, training, and post-go-live stabilization.

• Drive adoption across the accounting organization so redesigned processes are embedded in the close, reporting, and day-to-day operating rhythm.

• Partner with FP&A, Legal, Operations, and other business leaders to improve reporting, processes, controls, and decision-useful financial information.

Mergers, acquisitions, and integration

• Assist with and execute the accounting workstream for acquisitions, including financial and accounting due diligence, identification of accounting risks and deal considerations, purchase-price accounting, opening-balance-sheet preparation, valuation-specialist coordination, and required financial-statement disclosures.

• Assist with and execute post-close accounting integration, including transition of accounting processes, financial reporting, data and systems, close procedures, controls, and incorporation of acquired businesses into Honor’s operating cadence.

• Partner with Legal, Operations, FP&A, external advisors, and other stakeholders to ensure accounting implications are understood and integration activities are appropriately planned and executed.

We’re Looking for You to Bring:

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field; CPA required.

• 8–15 years of progressive accounting and financial-reporting experience, including at least 3 years in public accounting.

• Required: significant hands-on M&A accounting experience, including assisting with or materially executing financial and accounting due diligence, purchase-price accounting and valuation coordination, opening-balance-sheet accounting, and post-acquisition accounting and finance integration.

• Demonstrated experience leading monthly and annual close, consolidation, financial reporting, external audits, and accounting teams in a complex or high-growth environment.

• Strong U.S. GAAP knowledge, including the ability to research, document, and communicate technical accounting conclusions.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience with accounting-process transformation and finance-system implementations or significant enhancements, including requirements definition, process design, testing, data validation, controls, training, and adoption.

• Experience supporting IPO readiness, public-company readiness, or comparable finance transformation initiatives, including building scalable close, reporting, control, documentation, and audit-readiness processes, is strongly preferred.

• Experience managing external-audit and external-tax-advisor relationships.

• Experience with corporate income tax, state and local tax, and international tax matters, including coordinating external tax advisors and supporting compliance, provision, planning, and audit requirements, is strongly preferred.

• Experience with revenue recognition, multi-entity accounting, franchise or service-based businesses, and operational accounting functions is strongly preferred.

• Strong leadership, communication, and judgment, with the ability to balance recurring operational execution with significant transformation work.

• Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Leadership Principles

Honor’s Leadership Principles are the foundation of translating our mission into action. These principles define how we show up and make decisions, and how we hire, develop and grow talent. While Honor has 13 leadership principles, the following  are particularly relevant to this role:

• Balance Incremental and Radical Change: Leaders know when to pursue incremental progress and when to completely reinvent. They value making small, systematic changes over time to solve problems and push for audacious goals and embrace unconventional approaches to deliver transformative results.

• Build Trust: Leaders are forthright and ethical. Leaders seek the truth and the best path forward, communicating openly, honestly, and respectfully. They willingly give and receive feedback. They do what they say they will do, when they say they will do it.

• Fly High & Dive Deep: Leaders operate at all levels. They know when to stay connected to the details to enable execution and when to stay high level and empower others. Leaders audit when data and anecdotes differ.

• Think Systemically: Leaders consider the full range of implications of their ideas and actions before making decisions. They anticipate downstream impacts, prioritize what is best for the broader business beyond their own team, and do not sacrifice long-term success for short-term results.

• Drive Impact: Leaders deliver meaningful, timely results. They move quickly and decisively, set a high bar, and continually strive for better. They measure success by outcomes, not activity. When looking at their impact over the course of a month, it's remarkable how much they have moved the organization forward.

#LI-AN1

Our range reflects the hiring range for this position.  We use national average to determine pay as we are a remote first company.  Individual pay is based on a number of factors including qualifications, skills, experience, education, and training.

Base pay is just a part of our total rewards program.  Honor offers equity and 401K with up to a 4% match.  We provide medical, dental and vision coverage including zero cost plans for employees.  Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability and Life Insurance are fully employer paid with a voluntary additional Life Insurance option.  We offer a generous time off program, mental health benefits, wellness program, and discount program.

Hiring Salary Range

$198,000—$220,000 USD

At Honor, we put people first. Our leadership culture is guided by Leadership Principles that prioritize integrity, compassion, and excellence. We offer a unique opportunity to lead with purpose and make a meaningful impact no matter your role.

Honor is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, political affiliation or belief.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Workload Resilience
jobs.description:
Come join and lead the Workload Resilience Team! The Workload Resilience team is focused on improving the availability of MongoDB through solutions in the data plane. We build out the core server workload management infrastructure so that MongoDB can properly queue, load shed, and prioritize operations to stabilize performance during situations where system resources are beginning to become constrained. Workload Resilience is the team behind the recent release of Intelligent Workload Management, a new product feature that introduces dynamic rate limiting and operation prioritizations when the database is overloaded.

Our team champions a strong culture of inclusivity, diversity, and collaboration, and lives MongoDB cultural values every day – we value intellectual curiosity and honesty, building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition, and working urgently to deliver value to our customers each and every day. If you want to lead a fast-moving team that applies distributed systems, operating systems, operational excellence, performance tuning, and queueing theory to maximize the resilience of MongoDB at scale, join us!

This role is based in North America.

Candidate Profile

• 3+ years of experience managing a team of software engineers, including hiring, performance and growth management, compensation planning, and mentoring.

• You have 8+ years of experience building and operating mission-critical low-level and high performance distributed systems

• Bonus points for experience with performance profiling, codebases in Rust or C++, testing resiliency of distributed systems, queueing theory, and/or managing platforms with both internal and external stakeholders

• You have experience owning the operations of a projection service

• You have strong technical judgment that you use to effectively guide engineering decisions that balance tradeoffs in performance, availability, and customer experience

• You embody customer obsession and don't hesitate to cross team boundaries in search of the right solution

• You have delivered complex, cross-functional projects to customers that required coordination across many teams, under tight timelines

• You enjoy coaching, career development, and creating growth opportunities to help your team reach their full potential

• You have experience building a diverse, inclusive team where engineers can do their best work, operating greater than the sum of its parts

Position Expectations

• Lead a team of engineers, managing all aspects of people management including hiring, growth, compensation, and performance management.

• Be directly responsible for the results your team delivers

• Lead the design, implementation, and operation of:

• A service in Rust that operates in production on MongoDB Atlas to protect the availability of the database, with a focus on operational excellence

• Production database components that protect the availability of the database, manage customer workloads, and help customers and MongoDB diagnosticians observe the behavior of the database

• Systems for preventing the introduction of availability regressions into the Server codebase

• Own the definition and execution of the team's 12-month roadmap for the Intelligent Workload Management (IWM) tuning platform, the Server features at the core of IWM, and the availability testing systems

• Work with Product Management, Program Management, and Engineering leadership to specify, prioritize, and deliver new features

• Handle (or lead the effort to handle) time-sensitive availability incidents and customer escalations

• Estimate task complexity, communicate delivery timelines, and manage risks for projects executed by the team

• Ensure the team is running smoothly by eliminating technical barriers, coordinating cross-team dependencies, and focusing on the overall health and happiness of the team

• Contribute to planning for organizational growth, including allocation of engineering resources, future hiring plans, and assignment of projects

Success Measures

• In the first month: Understand the high-level architecture of the Intelligent Workload Management (IWM) system, how the key components of the Atlas Data Plane fit together, MongoDB's availability testing framework, the team's current projects, and the required day-to-day processes. Begin developing relationships with key stakeholders across the company

• In three months: Take over full management of the team and begin building trust with your reports. Assume responsibility for day-to-day team operations. Be involved in reviewing designs for new features and helping the team navigate technical challenges. Hire engineers for the team as needed

• In six months: Establish yourself as a leader in the organization such that team members naturally come to you for guidance. Take over full ownership of the team's software components. Manage the planning and execution of major features supporting the team’s major annual goals

• In twelve months: Perform a full annual cycle of performance and growth conversations with your team members. Contribute to the long-term vision for the IWM stack and develop a plan to achieve that vision. Increase the capability and velocity of the team in measurable ways

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Fraud
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR



Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise.

We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real-world workflows.

Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence.

Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London.



About the Role

As a Fraud Engineer at Mercor, you'll help build the systems that protect the integrity of our platform at scale. You'll work on high-impact problems across identity verification, abuse prevention, and project-level fraud, partnering closely with product and engineering to understand where risk exists, quantify it, and turn that understanding into durable systems and workflows.

This role is ideal for someone who has seen fraud problems firsthand and can translate that experience into practical roadmaps, strong technical judgment, and fast-moving execution. If you don’t have that experience but are interested in helping spot and catch fraud and learn fast, feel free to apply. You'll join a small team where autonomy matters and where the right person can shape both strategy and implementation from day one.

This is a role with high impact and broad scope. Your contributions will help solve an enormous challenge. This small team is responsible for keeping the platform safe and saving the company many millions of dollars annually.

You will:

 - Own and build fraud detection and prevention systems across multiple fraud surfaces, including identity and platform abuse.

 - Partner closely with product and engineering to define a fraud roadmap, prioritize the highest-leverage problems, and ship defenses quickly.

 - Design and implement tools, workflows, and backend systems that detect suspicious behavior and reduce fraudulent activity.

 - Establish clearer visibility into fraud patterns, operational risk, and the effectiveness of prevention systems over time.

 - Work across ambiguous, fast-moving problem spaces and independently drive large scopes of work on a lean team.

What We're Looking For

 - 2+ years of experience in software engineering.

 - Preferred: Experience working on fraud or abuse prevention, with a strong understanding of how to translate patterns and threats into product and engineering roadmaps.

jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE TEAM AND ROLE

Ramp’s Strategic Lifecycle Success team helps our largest and most complex customers turn their investment in Ramp into lasting business impact. After initial onboarding and implementation are complete, we help customers deepen adoption, continuously improve their Ramp setup, and successfully launch and activate additional products as their needs evolve.

As a Strategic Lifecycle Customer Success Manager, you’ll be a hands-on product expert and trusted partner to the finance, accounting, and operations teams using Ramp. You’ll own the ongoing customer success plan, proactively improve workflows, and lead onboarding and implementation when existing customers adopt new Ramp products. You’ll also lead adoption and value-focused business reviews, connecting how customers use Ramp to the outcomes that matter to their business.

You’ll work alongside an Account Manager, who owns commercial strategy and executive relationships, and partner with Solutions Consultants and Technical Consultants on complex technical needs. Your focus is helping customers get more from Ramp over time—from optimizing what’s already live to making each new product rollout successful.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own ongoing success planning for a portfolio of customers. After a structured handoff from initial onboarding and implementation, partner with a dedicated Account Manager to align on customer goals and define clear milestones, owners, and measures of success.

 - Serve as a trusted Ramp product expert. Stay current on new products, capabilities, and best practices, and proactively translate relevant releases into recommendations for each customer.

 - Continuously enhance customers’ Ramp environments. Understand their configuration and business processes, identify opportunities to improve policies, controls, approval flows, and workflows, and work hands-on with customers to put those improvements into practice.

 - Lead new-product implementations for existing customers. Own discovery, planning, configuration, training, launch, and sustained adoption, aligning customer goals, owners, and milestones. Lead standard workflow improvements; partner with Solutions Consultants on complex design and validation, Technical Consultants on integrations, APIs, ERP connections, and data flows, and Support on troubleshooting and defect escalation. Specialists own diagnosis and execution; you own customer communication, cross-functional follow-through, and validation of outcomes.

 - Lead adoption and value-focused business reviews. Define success measures and establish baselines with customers, then track improvements in adoption, spend consolidation, operational efficiency, and controls to demonstrate the value of their Ramp investment. Run regular adoption reviews with day-to-day stakeholders and partner with the Account Manager on executive QBRs and EBRs. Bring in the Account Manager or Solutions Consultant when useful, and coordinate joint reviews for Tier 1 accounts. Use evidence of progress to agree on next priorities.

 - Build customer champions and drive change. Develop a network of champions across finance, accounting, AP, operations, and business units. Create enablement and change-management plans, including train-the-trainer approaches where useful, that equip customer teams to adopt new capabilities and sustain new ways of working beyond individual stakeholders.

 - Manage customer health proactively. Monitor adoption, engagement, outcomes, and delivery risks; identify barriers early; and lead action plans to improve customer health. Equip your Account Manager with value evidence for renewal and growth conversations.

 - Identify customer success qualified leads (CSQLs). Recognize growth signals through customer relationships, product usage, and evolving business needs, and qualify and proactively surface expansion opportunities to your Account Manager with clear customer context, value evidence, and recommended next steps. The Account Manager owns commercial strategy and execution.

 - Shape a repeatable lifecycle success motion. Partner with Solutions Consultants, Technical Consultants, Support, and Product to resolve blockers and build playbooks for ongoing optimization and new-product activation. Translate recurring customer needs and workflow gaps into actionable feedback for Product, and close the loop with customers on relevant developments without making unconfirmed roadmap commitments.
   
   


WHAT YOU NEED

 - A track record in enterprise customer success, including hands-on ownership of implementation, adoption, and ongoing value realization for complex customers.

 - Strong product aptitude and experience configuring and optimizing software to support customer business processes—not just advising from a distance.

 - Experience managing customer-facing implementations, from discovery and project planning through training, launch, and sustained adoption.

 - The ability to lead business reviews that connect product usage to financial and operational outcomes, such as stronger controls, more efficient workflows, greater visibility, and time saved.

 - Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional execution skills, including experience navigating large, matrixed organizations, aligning stakeholders with competing priorities, and prioritizing multiple concurrent workstreams. Comfortable discussing integrations, ERPs, and workflow design and knowing when to engage technical specialists.

Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Mission Assurance Engineer, Build Reliability partners closely with the design and manufacturing teams to right-size processes and controls to enable scaling the production of spacecraft hardware. Build Reliability Engineers ensure production processes yield verified, reliable hardware at rate. You will flex beyond Build Reliability to support Quality, Flight Reliability, and Mission Assurance. The ideal candidate is a responsible, collaborative, process-oriented engineer with hands-on hardware design/test/manufacturing/troubleshooting experience.

Responsibilities

• Partner with design engineering and manufacturing teams to create test, manufacturability, and inspection plans for all vehicle hardware.

• Contain suspect or known non-conforming product, providing guidance to quality inspectors, technicians, shop supervisors, and engineers.

• Lead failure investigations in production, test, and operation; identifying and mitigating immediate and underlying root causes to reduce risk and improve the reliability of designs and processes.

• Provide critical peer review of hardware during design reviews and acceptance and qualification test campaigns.

• Perform failure modes and effects analyses, build requirements compliance matrix tools, and ensure adequate test coverage, change management, and manufacturability of flight hardware.

• Own vehicle level deliverables for regulatory bodies including requirements compliance, functional or flight hazard analyses, and verification evidence.

• Support Mission Assurance's vehicle level risk management and identification/tracking/execution of mitigations.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in aerospace, computer science, electrical, manufacturing, mechanical, or material sciences engineering.

• 5+ years professional experience in aerospace, design, quality, or related engineering role.

• Hands-on hardware test, qualification, troubleshooting, or failure analysis experience.

• Commitment to lean quality principles without compromising safety or reliability.

• Demonstrated application of process controls in high volume manufacturing, test, and quality environments.

• Experience generating, processing, and/or analyzing data for production insight.

• Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills, with a drive to innovate and improve reliability in cutting-edge technology.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Full project lifecycle ownership experience (cradle-to-grave).

• Proficiency with quality tools such as measurement systems analysis, design of experiments, statistical process control, root cause analysis and corrective action, advanced product quality planning (APQP), metrology, process failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA), control plans, and various problem-solving approaches.

• Hands-on knowledge of CNC machining, additive manufacturing, casting, welding, fastening, or other special manufacturing processes.

Pay Range

• Salary range: Senior: $140,333 - $179,314/ per year.

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.

• Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.

jobs.title: Director, Quality Control and Analytical Development
jobs.description:
Amylyx has an audacious mission to usher in a new era for treating diseases with high unmet needs. Where others see challenges, we see opportunities that we pursue with urgency, rigorous science, and unwavering commitment to the communities we serve. We are a clinical-stage company currently focused on post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH), Wolfram syndrome, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

Our mission is powered by our people. Our core values – be audacious, be curious, be authentic, be engaged, and be accountable – creating a culture of caring. Amylyx has assembled an experienced team ready to take action because the communities we serve have no time to wait. If you share our passion and are determined to tackle some of medicine’s toughest problems, we encourage you to read the opportunity below and apply.

The Opportunity

The Director of Quality Control and Analytical Development (QC/AD) is responsible for managing a team that provides quality oversight of method development, method validation, in process, release and stability testing at contract laboratories and contract manufacturing facilities. This role will manage the day-to-day QC/AD activities to support the Amylyx pipeline including synthetic peptides, antisense oligonucleotides and small molecules of drug substance through finished goods across preclinical and late-phase clinical programs. The individual will interact with internal multidisciplinary teams (Preclinical R&D, External Manufacturing, CMC, Regulatory and Supply Chain) to ensure successful delivery of analytical strategy and key objectives to meet audacious program timelines.

Responsibilities

• Manage a team to provide quality control and analytical development oversight of programs across development and clinical products, ensuring patient safety and compliance with regulations.

• Lead the relationship and budget with various CMO/CTLs for method establishment, development and qualification across Amylyx programs.

• Manage specifications, reference standards, release testing and stability programs to ensure compliance, delivery of Certificates of Analysis and shelf life establishment ensuring clinical supply.

• Lead method troubleshooting, optimization and phase appropriate validation for characterization, release and stability across multiple programs across active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), drug substance (DS) and drug product (DP).

• Drive all analytical investigations of OOS, deviations, change controls, CAPAs, temperature excursions and troubleshooting with CMO/CTLs.

• Author, review and approve documentation including technical reports, SOPs, test methods, specifications and CMC sections of regulatory filings (IND/IMPD and/or NDA/BLA).

• Participate in regular meetings held by the Tech Ops and Quality organization to represent Amylyx QC/AD at cross-functional meetings to develop strategies and deliver on key objectives.

• Travel may be required up to 10%, which may include on-site review of third-party operations

Requirements

• Minimum 10-12 years and BA/BS, 8+ years and MA/MS, 5+ years PhD of experience within the Pharmaceutical or Biotechnology industry.

• Must have worked in a quality control and/or analytical development role for 5+ years.

• Managerial/supervisory experience of a small team is required.

• Technical expertise in method development and validation of complex GC, GC/MS, HPLC, LC/MS, ICP/MS analytical methods for isolation, detection, identification, and quantification of both drug substances and drug products of small molecules or/and large molecules.

• Exhibit strong technical skills and the ability to critically evaluate raw data, trend analysis and present results to all levels of the organization and external vendors.

• Experience with authoring CMC sections of and regulatory filing requirements.

• Knowledgeable in FDA cGMP regulations, Eudralex and ICH Guidance, as well as other Biopharma industry guidance and regulations.

• Highly collaborative team player with strong communication skills.

• Experience with small molecules, peptides, sterile manufacturing and oral dosage forms is highly preferred.

Work Location and Conditions

• At Amylyx, we proudly support remote work opportunities within the United States. However, due to business considerations related to health insurance coverage and state tax regulations, we are unable to hire employees who reside and/or work in certain states. Currently, we are not considering applicants from Alaska and Hawaii.

• You will be expected to travel to our corporate location in Cambridge, MA several times a year and attend other company-related events as necessary and requested.

• You must have access to work in setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role (including privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at your remote location.

Compensation

The pay range posted below represents our good faith estimate of compensation for this role, based on market data and internal benchmarks. The final offer may vary depending on a candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as considerations of internal equity.

Base salary is one component of Amylyx’s total rewards package. In addition to competitive base pay, eligible employees may receive annual performance-based bonuses and equity awards, providing an opportunity to share in the company’s long-term success. Amylyx also offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com http://Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. 

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.




THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Build and ship backend features: develop, test, and ship services supporting customer messaging and payments, with guidance from experienced engineers.

 - Contribute to our messaging platform: help build and improve how we reach members across customer preferences, email, SMS, and push.

 - Build reliable integrations: implement third-party API and webhook integrations, with attention to testing, retries, error handling, and reliable delivery.

 - Grow alongside experienced engineers: work with senior teammates to break projects into clear, manageable tasks, and take part in code reviews and design discussions where your perspective is valued.

 - Leverage AI in your daily work: from prototyping to testing to production code, use AI tools thoughtfully, then review and verify what you ship.

 - Take real responsibility: own your work and follow through, help investigate production issues, and bring ideas for improving the systems you touch.

Your Profile

 - 2–5 years of experience building production backend systems (fintech or payments experience a plus)

 - Hands-on experience building or maintaining a third-party API or webhook integration yourself

 - Proficiency in Go (our primary backend language), or a similar language with willingness to ramp quickly

 - Experience using AI tools (code assistants, MCP servers, agentic workflows) in your development work, and a habit of checking and testing what they produce

 - Comfortable with relational databases: writing queries, making schema changes, and running migrations

 - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and CI/CD pipelines, or eagerness to learn

 - Experience with, or willingness to join, an on-call rotation

 - You hold a high bar for code quality and can turn business requirements into clear, well-scoped work

 - You communicate clearly, ask good questions, and raise blockers early

 - You collaborate well with product, design, and engineering teammates

 - Based in New York, or willing to relocate
   
   

We don’t expect every candidate to match every bullet. If you’re excited about what we’re building and confident you can contribute, we’d love to talk.



Stack

Go, MySQL, DynamoDB, Temporal, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS, GitHub Actions, Datadog, Statsig.



Read more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog: https://tech.imprint.co/.




PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Leading configured work computers of your choice

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

 - Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the  option to enroll in an FSA

 - 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

 - Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity
   
   

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

jobs.title: Sr Research Associate - Fermentation
jobs.description:
About Pivot Bio:

Fueled by an innovative drive and a deep understanding of microbiology, genomics, crop nutrition and agriculture, Pivot Bio is pioneering game-changing advances in fertilizer technology. Our first commercial product harnesses the power of naturally-occurring microbes, modern gene editing and application technologies to provide nitrogen to crops.  We are dedicated to providing new solutions for farmers to improve yield as they work to help feed the world’s growing population. Read/Hear more about Pivot Bio on Forbes or PBS News Hour.

Executes multiple simultaneous workflows with limited input on prioritization and troubleshooting.  Designs complete experiments or plans complex operations with the help of colleagues.  Trusted point person for key laboratory or team operations.  Takes on accountability for tactical research decision-making. Daily work is mostly self-determined.

Essential Functions

• Plans and executes routine experiments independently with occasional input from supervisor and iterates from experiment to experiment.

• Independently executes routine data analysis and presents data in the context of the question being asked; assesses need for additional controls to narrow interpretations; executes non-routine data analysis with some supervision.

• Develops solid new hypotheses in discussion with more experienced colleagues.

• Oversees workflows or experiment types.

• Communicates results and collaborates with interdisciplinary teams.

• Actively participates in complex troubleshooting and root cause analyses (RCA) of equipment and workflow challenges.

• Adheres to safety and hygiene policies including training compliance; identifies areas for additional improvements or protocols.

Competencies

Knowledge & Application

• Advanced laboratory knowledge, including understanding of underlying mechanisms, used in complex experiment design, troubleshooting and decision making.

• Needs minimal/limited instruction to execute and prioritize day-to-day work.

• Broad scientific knowledge including understanding of project relevance and impact used to contribute to designing next steps of a project.

• Draws ideas and processes from scientific literature. Develops an understanding of the larger scientific or engineering context of all work in their project.

• Efficient and high quality operation of routine assays and procedures within areas of specialization. Demonstrates on-time delivery and follow-through.

Complexity & Problem Solving

• Identifies advanced equipment/software failures and takes corrective action. Identifies out of specification results and works with manager to resolve.

• Routinely recognizes, designs, and implements straightforward workflow improvements.

• Applies independent judgment to assigned project tasks and responsibilities.

• Routinely applies principles to new work; oversees workflow from start to finish.

• Manages time with limited input from manager.

Collaboration & Interaction

• Collaborates with cross-functional team while interacting with more senior colleagues within the team. Contributes to and may plan team meetings. Represents their team's perspective to external groups.

• May train or informally lead other RAs in the execution of work with guidance. May informally mentor less experienced colleagues.

• Provides training to colleagues on routine SOPs, team workflows and safety procedures both within and outside of immediate team. Recommends additional safety/hygiene protocols.

• Presents results and status updates at department or group meetings. Documents findings in appropriate LIMS systems, presentations, and reports.

• Writes SOPs or protocols with guidance and uses them to perform routine work consistently.

• Contributes to research project proposals, complex experiment designs, or tactical research decisions.

• Able to provide and react appropriately to constructive feedback.

Work Environment

• Lab-based work environment

• Lab and computer-based work including repetitive motion of hands, wrist, fingers

• Sedentary work that involves sitting/standing for extended periods of time

• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds on occasion

Required Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences, food science, biological systems engineering, biochemical engineering, related field or equivalent experience

• Minimum of 4 years of prior experience working in a lab environment

• Master’s degree in a relevant discipline with 2+ years of hands-on lab experience

• Experience using standard microbiology lab equipment and techniques

Must be authorized to work in the United States.

What We Offer

• Competitive package in a disruptive startup

• Stock options

• Health/Dental/Vision insurance with employer-paid premiums

• Life, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability policies

• Employee Assistance Program with free referrals and discounts

• 401(k) plan, 3% Match

• Commuter benefits

• Annual Training & Development support

• Flexible vacation policy with a generous holiday schedule

• Exciting opportunity to work with a talented and fun team

jobs.title: Manager, Media Buying
jobs.description:
Hi, We're Centerfield!

Supercharged customer acquisition. Centerfield delivers outcome-based digital marketing solutions and personalized omnichannel experiences for the world’s leading brands. Powered by our proprietary Dugout platform, Centerfield acquires customers at scale for leading residential service, insurance, e-commerce, and B2B brands. Centerfield’s digital experiences and digital brands, such as Business.com http://Business.com and BroadbandNow.com http://BroadbandNow.com, reach more than 150 million in-market shoppers annually. Centerfield is headquartered in Silicon Beach and is proud to be recognized by Built in LA as a Best Place to Work in Los Angeles.


ROLE OVERVIEW...

The Manager, Media Buying owns paid media strategy and execution for assigned verticals, accounts, or client programs within Centerfield, with opportunities to support initiatives across business divisions. The role manages media buyers, leads creative and account strategy, and turns business and client goals into campaigns, tests, and launches that deliver qualified customer acquisition and profitable growth. Campaigns support Centerfield’s owned and operated properties and client programs, with performance measured through lead quality, downstream conversion, revenue, and gross profit.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES...

 - Develop and execute paid media strategies for assigned verticals and accounts, selecting channels, audiences, bidding approaches, creative, and landing pages based on business goals and client requirements. Remain hands-on where needed to support launches, optimization, and troubleshooting.

 - Directly manage and coach media buyers across assigned programs and channels. Set priorities, assign work, review execution, provide performance feedback, and build individual skills and accountability.

 - Manage budgets, guide optimization against acquisition cost, revenue, return on ad spend, gross profit, and margin goals, using downstream lead quality and client conversion data to inform decisions.

 - Lead messaging, creative concepts, and testing priorities with Design and Creative partners. Use audience insights and campaign results to guide new assets, refresh creative, and improve conversion and quality.

 - Maintain a testing roadmap across campaigns, audiences, creative, and landing pages. Coordinate launch requirements, timelines, and quality checks; document results and recommendations for scaling or adjusting programs.

 - Develop projections for existing and prospective programs, documenting demand, channel mix, conversion assumptions, client restrictions, and performance risks. Review assumptions with paid media leadership before sharing commitments.

 - Partner with Product, Data, Analytics, Sales, and other cross-functional teams to improve funnel performance, tracking, reporting, and channel mix. Identify dependencies, coordinate solutions, and escalate unresolved issues.

 - Provide recurring performance updates with drivers, actions, risks, and next steps. Join client discussions as needed to explain media plans, projections, results, and testing recommendations.

 - Evaluate platform features and relevant new channels; manage platform relationships for assigned programs. Improve campaign quality checks, documentation, and workflows through practical use of automation and AI.

 - Consistently show up like a Centerfielder by embodying company values in everyday interactions, decision-making, and collaboration.

 - Continuously evolve yourself, your team, or the business by embracing learning, innovation, and opportunities for improvement.

 


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES...

 - 5+ years of experience in paid media or performance marketing, including hands-on campaign management and at least 1 year of direct people management.

 - Strong hands-on expertise in performance media platforms and the ability to guide buyers, evaluate channel plans, and identify performance risks across assigned programs.

 - Demonstrated success managing acquisition campaigns and budgets against measurable business outcomes, including acquisition efficiency, revenue, or profitability.

 - Ability to connect targeting, creative, landing pages, conversion signals, and downstream customer quality to campaign performance.

 - Experience developing creative briefs, directing structured testing, and translating results into campaign and creative decisions.

 - Strong Excel and data analytics skills and the ability to analyze platform and business data, build projections, and explain assumptions.

 - Ability to coach buyers, manage concurrent launches and priorities, and communicate clear recommendations to technical and nontechnical partners.



BONUS POINTS…

 - Experience in B2B acquisition, lead generation, marketplaces, or a performance-based client model.

 - Experience managing acquisition campaigns across multiple paid media platforms or introducing new channels based on business needs.

 - Familiarity with conversion tracking, offline conversion uploads, attribution, reporting tools, and landing page optimization.

 - Experience applying AI or automation to campaign analysis, creative testing, or operational workflows.

 - Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. No specific certification is required.
   




LIFE AT CENTERFIELD…

 - This is a remote position open to applicants who currently reside in one of the following states: California, Florida, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oregon, or Washington.

 - Competitive salary + generous quarterly bonus

 - Unlimited PTO – take a break when you need it!

jobs.title: Treasury Manager
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

We are seeking a hands-on and detail-oriented Treasury Manager with 3-6 years of progressive corporate treasury experience to help operationalize and scale our global treasury function. Reporting to the Assistant Treasurer and managing a Treasury Analyst, you will own day-to-day execution across global cash management, liquidity forecasting, banking infrastructure, and treasury systems, while helping to design, document, and remediate the treasury controls required to operate as a public company.

ABOUT THE JOB

This role is equally operational and build-oriented: you will close gaps in existing processes, stand up repeatable controls and reporting, and partner across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Legal, and the business to ensure Anduril's capital is secure, visible, and productively deployed.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Global Cash & Liquidity Management: Manage daily global cash positioning across all legal entities, ensuring sufficient liquidity to fund operations, payroll, and capital commitments. Prepare, maintain, and continuously improve short- and long-term global cash flow forecasts, including variance analysis against actuals. Execute cash concentration, pooling, and sweep structures to minimize idle balances and optimize working capital internationally. Support intercompany funding, cross-border payments, and cash repatriation in coordination with Tax, Legal, and Accounting.

• Treasury Operations & Systems: Own day-to-day treasury operations, including payment initiation and release, bank portal administration, and user access and entitlement reviews. Coordinate the Treasury Management System (TMS) implementation with the outside consultant engaged for the project, serving as the internal day-to-day owner across requirements gathering, configuration, testing, cutover, and ongoing optimization for cash visibility, forecasting, and payments (e.g., Kyriba, Ripple/GTreasury, FIS). Build and maintain bank connectivity and integrations between banking platforms, the TMS, and the ERP. Document treasury processes end to end and drive automation to replace manual, spreadsheet-dependent workflows.

• Controls, Compliance & Public Company Readiness: Design, document, and operate key treasury controls, including segregation of duties, payment approval matrices, and bank account authorization standards. Partner with internal control teams and external auditors to remediate identified gaps and evidence control operating effectiveness. Maintain treasury policies and procedures (cash management, investment, FX, bank account management) and monitor compliance with them. Support readiness workstreams required to operate treasury as a public company, including reporting cadence, audit support, and counterparty risk monitoring.

• Foreign Exchange (FX) Risk Management: Support execution of hedging transactions (spot and forward) in accordance with the company's foreign exchange policy.

• Banking Relationship Management: Administer the global bank account structure, including account opening and closing, signatory maintenance, and KYC documentation. Track bank fees and analyze account analysis statements to identify cost savings and service rationalization opportunities. Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for banking partners and escalate service issues to resolution.

• Investment & Debt Support: Execute and monitor short-term investment activity in line with the investment policy, balancing safety, liquidity, and yield. Support monitoring of debt and credit facilities, including draw and repayment mechanics, covenant tracking, and lender reporting. Assist with diligence and execution support for new financing initiatives.

• Reporting & Analysis: Prepare recurring treasury reporting for Finance leadership, including liquidity position, forecast accuracy, counterparty exposure, and key risk metrics. Partner with Accounting on cash reconciliations, month-end close support, and cash flow statement inputs. Perform ad-hoc analysis to support capital allocation and finance decision-making.

• Team Leadership & Development: Manage, coach, and develop a Treasury Analyst, setting priorities, reviewing daily deliverables, and providing timely feedback and career development support. Delegate and supervise recurring treasury work, including cash positioning, payment processing, bank administration, and reporting, ensuring accuracy and adherence to controls. Build training materials, desktop procedures, and backup coverage so core treasury functions run without single-person dependency. Set performance objectives, conduct performance reviews, and support hiring as the treasury team scales.

• Projects & Cross-Functional Partnership: Lead or support treasury projects such as TMS implementation, bank rationalization, new entity and market setup, and M&A integration, managing external consultants and implementation partners against scope, timeline, and deliverables. Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Legal, Procurement, and business units to support global operations and scale treasury alongside company growth.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. CTP (Certified Treasury Professional) is a strong plus.

• Experience: 3-6 years of progressive corporate treasury experience, including hands-on ownership of daily cash management and payment operations.

• International Exposure: Working knowledge of global cash pooling, cross-border payments, multi-currency bank structures, and FX transactions.

• Controls Orientation: Demonstrated experience designing or operating treasury controls, documenting processes, and supporting internal or external audit requests.

• Leadership: Experience managing, mentoring, or directing the work of an analyst or junior team member, including reviewing output and developing their capability.

• Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, pivot tables, macros, etc.). Experience with a Treasury Management System (e.g., Kyriba, Ripple/GTreasury, FIS) is highly preferred. Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., Oracle Fusion, SAP, etc.). Experience with bank reporting formats and connectivity (BAI2, MT940, host-to-host, API) is a plus.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Systems Implementation: Experience running or supporting a TMS deployment alongside an external implementation partner, including vendor management, requirements definition, user acceptance testing, and go-live cutover.

• Public Company Readiness: Experience supporting IPO preparation, SOX implementation, or treasury control remediation at a high-growth company.

• Analytical & Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.

• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex financial concepts clearly to various stakeholders.

• Self-Starter: Proactive, organized, and capable of working independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Adaptability: Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing business needs and market conditions.

• Languages: Fluency in English required; proficiency in other languages relevant to our global operations is a plus.

US Salary Range

$147,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.
