jobs.title: Shipping & Receiving Clerk
jobs.description:
Location: Onsite — Austin, TX

Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full-Time

Job Title: Shipping & Receiving Clerk

 

About 9 Mothers

The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"—we are building the shield.

Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge—on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack.



About the Role

9 Mothers builds hardware in Austin, TX, and this role is the single point of contact for everything that comes into or leaves our building. You own receiving end to end: every package, every packing list, every handoff to the person waiting on it. No prior experience is required. What matters most is that you are reliable and detail-oriented, because a shipment that is misplaced or logged wrong stalls the people who need it.

 

What You'll Do

 - Receive every delivery to the building and check it against its packing list

 - Log each shipment in our receiving system and keep packing lists filed and traceable

 - Organize incoming packages so anything can be found quickly

 - Notify recipients when their items arrive and hand them off

 - For outbound shipments, package and label the item, drive it to the carrier, and confirm it has gone out

 - Keep the receiving area clean and orderly



What We're Looking For

 - Reliable: you are here every day, on time, and no delivery goes uncaught

 - Detail-oriented: you check quantities and part numbers against the packing list and don't let a discrepancy slide

 - Organized, with basic computer skills (email, spreadsheets, or an inventory/receiving system)

 - Valid driver's license and a clean driving record

 - Able to lift and move packages up to 50 lb

 - Prior receiving, shipping, warehouse, or inventory experience is a plus but not required



Hours & Location

 - Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., onsite in Austin, TX

 - The hours are fixed so someone is always on hand for every delivery window

 

Benefits

 - Meaningful Early Equity: You aren't just an employee; you are a foundational owner. Your contributions directly drive the value of your stake in the company.

 - Direct Roadmap Influence: Forget the bureaucracy of big defense. You will have a seat at the table, directly shaping our product and technology trajectory from day one.

 - Mission-Critical Work: We don't build for "what if." We build systems the Department of War actively needs to counter immediate, real-world threats.

 - The Builder's Playground: Work in a brand-new lab fully optimized for rapid prototyping, equipped with NVIDIA Jetsons, high-end scopes, and 3-D printers.

 - 100% Employer-Paid Premiums: We cover 100% of your medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums and cover 50% of healthcare premiums for your dependents.

 - Unlimited PTO: We value results, not clock-watching. Take the time you need to stay sharp and recharge.

 - Zero Red Tape: You have the autonomy to make technical decisions that would take months of committee approval at a larger firm.

 - Austin-Based Culture: Join an onsite team in Austin, TX, where we prioritize high-bandwidth collaboration and rapid field-testing.

 - Relocation Assistance: We want the best talent in the room. If you aren't in Austin yet, we’ll help you get here, to make your transition to the Silicon Hills seamless.

 

About the Interview

 1. Initial screen with recruiter (30 min phone call)

 2. Virtual interview with Director of Hardware Operations (30 min via MS Teams)

 3. Onsite interview at our Austin facility (1 hour in-person)

jobs.title: Hygienist
jobs.description:
As a Hygienist at Tend, you'll deliver top-tier preventive care in a modern, thoughtfully designed studio — with the support of a dedicated dental assistant through our Team (Assisted) Hygiene model. You'll treat a well-booked schedule of patients with the tools, systems, and support you need to deliver clinical excellence and outstanding patient experiences. At Tend, we're committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive environment where both our patients and our teams feel respected, represented, and truly cared for.

Depending on your experience and interests, this role offers the opportunity to focus on delivering exceptional preventive care as a Hygienist, or to take on additional leadership responsibilities as a Lead Hygienist — setting the standard for hygiene excellence, mentoring your team, and driving both clinical and business results for your studio.

Our model is built for driven hygienists: those who value autonomy, crave efficiency, and take pride in high-performance care — and for hygienist leaders who want to inspire others and help build a culture of excellence across their team.

Compensation & Earning Potential

All Hygienists earn a base hourly rate plus a monthly bonus tied to adjusted production. You'll get transparency and support to help you thrive — no surprises, just opportunity. Top-earning Hygienists make $XX/hour with bonus.

Full-Time Traveling roles are also available, working 32–40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, with no Saturdays required.

What You'll Do

Clinical Care & Patient Experience (All Hygienists)

• Deliver comprehensive preventive and periodontal care — including prophylaxis, periodontal maintenance, scaling and root planing (SRP), gingivitis scaling, oral cancer screenings, iTero scans, sealants, Zoom whitening, Perio Protect, Curodont, fluoride treatments, and patient education — all in alignment with evidence-based clinical guidelines

• Collaborate with a dedicated dental assistant to optimize your schedule, manage sterilization and room turnover, and support patient care and documentation

• Partner with dentists for hygiene exams to identify and recommend treatment plans based on patient needs

• Proactively drive hygiene production by maximizing chair time, recommending preventive care, and supporting same-day treatment opportunities

• Work within Tend's Team (Assisted) Hygiene model, partnering closely with dedicated dental assistants to deliver efficient, high-quality care and create a more supported, team-driven clinical environment

• Maintain strong relationships with patients through clear communication, trust-building, and personalized education

• Collaborate closely with the broader studio team — including doctors, assistants, and operations leaders — to ensure seamless patient care

• Engage in ongoing professional development through CE opportunities, internal hygiene forums, and peer collaboration

Hygiene Leadership & Studio Impact (Lead Hygienist Focus)

• Provide hands-on training for new hygienist hires and oversee the onboarding and development of hygienists and hygiene assistants to reinforce Tend's clinical standards, workflows, and patient care protocols

• Offer ongoing mentorship to hygienists and hygiene assistants, supporting their clinical growth, confidence, and professional development

• Provide regular, constructive feedback to support performance improvement and maintain consistent hygiene standards across the team

• Collaborate with dental assistants to optimize studio-wide hygiene flow, sterilization protocols, and room turnover efficiency

• Partner with dentists on exams and treatment planning, reinforcing comprehensive care and seamless handoffs for patients

• Proactively drive hygiene production across the team by identifying opportunities, supporting same-day treatment acceptance, and monitoring key performance metrics

• Lead regular hygiene team meetings and champion continuing education and development opportunities for the team

• Lead and drive Tend's Team (Assisted) Hygiene model studio-wide, ensuring hygienists and assistants work together to maximize efficiency and elevate patient care

• Partner closely with Studio Managers and doctors to ensure the hygiene department is meeting patient care, quality, and business objectives

• Champion new clinical and operational initiatives within the hygiene team, leading by example

Who You Are

You embody our Tend values and demonstrate key competencies that ensure both patient success and team excellence. At Tend, these aren't just words on a wall — they're how we hire, lead, and grow.

Tend Values

• Tend to Others – Deliver exceptional patient experiences and team collaboration

• Be Brave Enough to Lead – Take initiative to solve problems and improve clinical care

• Savor the Ride – Celebrate wins and stay positive in a fast-paced environment

• Embrace Our Differences – Communicate with respect and value diverse perspectives

• Rooted in Growth – Seek feedback, mentorship, and continuous learning

Role-Based Competencies

• Earns Trust – Earn patient and team confidence through honesty and follow-through. As a Lead Hygienist, this means building that trust at scale — modeling it for the team and inspiring the same standard in others.

• Works Together – Work fluidly across roles and functions to ensure excellent care. As a Lead Hygienist, this means uniting roles across the studio, coordinating hygienists, assistants, and doctors toward shared goals.

• Adapts with Ease – Adjust to changes and balance multiple priorities effectively. As a Lead Hygienist, this means guiding the team through change in real time and coaching others to adapt alongside you.

What You Have

• Degree from an accredited dental hygiene program

• Current, active hygiene license in the state you're applying for

• Current Anesthesia/Nitrous license in applicable state

• Current CPR/BLS certification

• Comfort with digital charting and x-rays, intraoral cameras, and technology-driven care

• Hygienist — Open to full-time (32–40 hours/week, including AM/PM and Saturday shifts), part-time (2–3 days/week, including AM/PM and Saturday shifts), or PRN (work when you want!). Full-Time Traveling roles also available, working 32–40 hours/week, Monday–Friday, no Saturdays required.

• Lead Hygienist — Full-time only (32–40 hours/week, including AM/PM and Saturday shifts). Proven experience in a lead role supporting other hygienists — training, mentoring, and coaching a team — plus additional years of clinical experience beyond the standard Hygienist requirement.

Physical Requirements This position requires the ability to perform the essential job duties listed, with or without reasonable accommodation:

• Ability to sit and stand for extended periods while performing hygiene procedures — and, for Leads, while coaching team members

• Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to handle instruments, perform scaling and polishing, and operate clinical equipment

• Adequate vision (with or without correction) to read charts, assess oral conditions, interpret radiographs, and document findings

• Ability to bend, reach, and maintain ergonomic positioning for patient care throughout the day

• Occasional lifting or movement of equipment, instrument trays, and supplies up to 25 pounds

• Ability to communicate effectively and compassionately with patients, team members, and other healthcare professionals in person and via technology

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

What We Offer

We believe taking care of people starts with taking care of our own. Here's how we've got you covered at Tend:

• 🦷 Assisted Hygiene – A dental assistant to support your patient flow and prep

• 🎓 CE & Professional Development – Virtual and in-person learning opportunities, with added leadership training for Leads

• 🛡️ Malpractice Insurance – Full coverage provided

• 🩺 Health Comes First – Medical, dental, and vision insurance — plus our own Dental Wellness Program

• 🌴 Time to Recharge – Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and company holidays, because rest is productive

• 💰 Plan for the Future – 401(k) plan to help you grow your nest egg

• 💡 Support, When You Need It – Life & AD&D insurance, EAP, legal support, and more

• 🛍️ Smart Spending Options – FSAs, HSAs, and pre-tax transit

The base pay range listed reflects the hourly wage for this position and is determined by a variety of factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, and market conditions.

Base Pay Range

$44—$52 USD

Hygienists at Tend are eligible for a monthly performance bonus based on clinical and operational key performance indicators (KPIs). Bonus pay is distributed monthly but reflected in the listed range as an hourly equivalent. Bonus amounts vary by provider, market, and schedule, and actual earnings may differ depending on individual productivity and studio performance.

Bonus Pay Range

$1—$20 USD

jobs.title: IT Engineer (Active Top Secret Clearance)
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

The IT Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, administration, and optimization of Apex’s technology infrastructure. This role encompasses systems engineering, network management, cloud operations, cybersecurity practices, and cross-functional project delivery. Unlike help desk or support roles, this position will focus on architecture, engineering solutions, and infrastructure lifecycle management.

Key Responsibilities

 - Provide hands-on engineering, administration, and troubleshooting of systems, servers, networks, endpoints, and cloud infrastructure.

 - Build, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot physical and virtual servers from initial deployment through ongoing management.

 - Administer and troubleshoot Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and Linux environments, including various Linux distributions.

 - Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot LAN, WAN, VLANs, Wi-Fi, VPNs, routing, switching, firewalls, and network policies.

 - Administer and support Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Entra ID, Intune, Jira/Confluence, and Slack environments.

 - Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure.

 - Evaluate solutions, recommend the best approach, and implement fixes while minimizing operational impact.

 - Develop and maintain automation and administrative scripts using PowerShell, Bash, and Python.

 - Lead or participate in IT infrastructure projects and ensure assigned projects are completed promptly, accurately, and within established requirements.

 - Provide Tier 3 technical support and assist other IT teams with complex infrastructure issues.

 - Document configurations, troubleshooting procedures, solutions, and project changes.

Required Skills & Qualifications

 - Strong hands-on technical engineering and troubleshooting experience.

 - In-depth knowledge of Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and various Linux operating systems.

 - In-depth knowledge of server deployment, configuration, administration, and troubleshooting, including the ability to build servers from the ground up.

 - In-depth networking knowledge, including LAN, WAN, VLANs, Wi-Fi, VPN, routing, switching, firewalls, and network policies.

 - Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to dig into complex issues, identify root causes, and develop multiple solutions.

 - Experienced with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Entra ID, Intune, Jira/Confluence, and Slack.

 - Experienced with Microsoft Azure and AWS, including AWS GovCloud environments.

 - Proficiency with PowerShell, Bash, and Python scripting.

 - Ability to manage multiple technical projects and complete assignments promptly.

 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.

Education Requirement

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field is required.

Experience Requirement

 - 5–7 years of progressive hands-on experience in IT engineering, systems administration, network engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Additional Requirements

 - Must be a US Citizen

 - Must hold an active Top Secret Security Clearance

 - Must be willing to work full-time on-site in the Playa Vista of Los Angeles

This position may be filled at the Senior, Staff, or Principal level. The stated compensation range spans all of these levels, and final placement within the range will be based on the candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, and the responsibilities ultimately assigned.

#LI-JC1


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Cash bonus eligibility: share in Apex’s success with eligibility for a performance-based cash bonus on top of your salary, rewarding the impact you make

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan: Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave: Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

 - Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks: To keep you fueled throughout the day

 - Vibrant community: Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family

 - Your dream desk setup: All the tools you need to be your most productive self

 - World-class Playa Vista office: With the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life

 - Real impact opportunity: Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference

Beyond base salary, full-time hires are also eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

As a Staff Technical Writer at GitLab, you’ll shape how users, and the AI agents working on their behalf, understand, adopt, and succeed with GitLab. You’ll partner with engineers, product managers, designers, and UX researchers to turn features and design decisions into clear, scalable documentation and intuitive UI text across multiple product stages and sections.

As AI increasingly drafts and reviews our content, you’ll bring the judgement that upholds quality and the system thinking that scales that judgement across our documentation. When you see the same problem repeating, you’ll fix the cause rather than just the page, whether that’s through a style guide update, a lint rule, or an AI skill. You’ll model effective use of AI, lead improvements to our docs site and processes, and contribute to one of the world’s largest open-source projects while engaging with our wider community.

What you’ll do

• Own and maintain documentation across product areas (which GitLab organizes by engineering stages and sections), driving improvements and balancing priorities.

• Champion AI best practices by modeling approved tool use, establishing governance and quality checks, and integrating AI workflows that improve efficiency and quality.

• Lead efforts to improve the product user experience through UI text, creating model examples and improving the style guide.

• Design scalable information architecture and content types optimized for both human readability and AI retrieval.

• Model review practices that improve the quality of contributions and feed back into AI review flows.

• Design and lead process improvements. Identify systemic problems and the most efficient solution, building alignment with stakeholders and driving adoption.

• Partner with engineers to translate documentation, content-quality, and user needs into improvements to documentation systems and docs-site functionality.

• Use data to prioritize work, measure impact, and establish team KPIs.

• Lead large cross-stage content initiatives, driving collaboration across functions to achieve shared customer and company outcomes.

• Address feedback from internal teams, customers, support, and community contributors, identifying patterns for wider improvements.

• Act as a thought partner to management on technical and project decisions, and act as primary lead for a specialist domain such as AI, UX writing, metrics, or tooling.

• Mentor technical writers and team members on best practices and prioritization.

What you’ll bring

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Robotics Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Your Impact at LILA

The Robotics Operations Manager builds and leads the team that keeps Lila's production robot fleet running safely and reliably. You will own how we find, train, and grow Robotics Operations Engineers and technicians, turning strong mechatronics and robotics fundamentals into confident, production-ready operators.

You will also run day-to-day fleet operations across shifts, serving as the escalation point for live issues and the bridge between the people on the floor and our robotics software and hardware teams. This role is hands-on and sits in a lab production environment. The schedule is mostly standard hours, with some early-shift overlap for training and handoffs.

What You'll Be Building

Build the team

• Partner with Talent to define the profile, interview loop, and hiring bar for Robotics Operations Engineers and technicians, and act as hiring manager for the team.

• Build sourcing pipelines with technical colleges, mechatronics and robotics programs, and co-op, internship, and apprenticeship pathways.

• Design skills-based assessments, such as hands-on troubleshooting exercises, that recognize practical training alongside years on the job.

Build the training program

• Design and run an onboarding curriculum that takes new team members from robotics fundamentals to independent, production-ready operation, and maintain the SOPs, runbooks, and training materials behind it with robotics software and hardware engineers.

• Cover the core skills of the role: safe intervention (pause, stop, reset), mechanical and electrical troubleshooting, ROS2 fundamentals and introspection tools, log and sensor review, robot swap procedures, and incident documentation.

• Define competency levels and sign-off criteria for independent operation and shift coverage, measure the program (time to independent operation, incident rates, retention), and build growth paths from technician to engineer.

Lead fleet operations

• Own operational readiness and shift coverage for the production robot fleet as operating hours expand.

• Serve as the escalation point for live incidents, stay hands-on in live operations and maintenance, and lead post-incident reviews with logs, video, and reproduction steps captured.

• Track fleet health (uptime, incident frequency, time to recovery, maintenance actions) and turn recurring failure patterns into prioritized requests for robotics software and hardware teams.

• Manage the team: set goals, hold regular 1:1s, give timely feedback, and address performance directly.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• 5+ years of experience operating, deploying, or maintaining robotic or automated systems in production, lab, or manufacturing environments, through a degree, technical program, or equivalent hands-on experience.

• Experience training, mentoring, or leading technicians or engineers, formally or informally, with evidence of getting people to independent competence.

• Solid grasp of core robotics concepts, including kinematics, sensors, actuators, and control systems.

• Working experience with ROS2, including nodes, topics, launch files, and debugging or introspection tools.

• Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills, including cabling, connectors, sensors, and fasteners.

• Sound judgment and a safety-first mindset for quick decisions during live operation.

Bonus Points For

• Experience building or running a training, onboarding, or certification program for technicians or operators.

• Experience partnering with technical colleges, apprenticeship, co-op, or internship programs to develop early-career talent.

• Prior people management experience, especially leading shift-based or operations teams.

• Experience supporting robots or automated systems through a production rollout or pilot phase.

• Familiarity with Nav2, Behavior Trees, or related robotics tooling, plus scripting in Python for log review, data collection, or simple automation.

• Experience with fleet management, monitoring dashboards, telemetry tools, or issue-tracking systems, and with robot and machine safety practices such as lockout/tagout and risk assessment.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range

$180,000—$298,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer (Top Secret)
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

The IT Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, administration, and optimization of Apex’s technology infrastructure. This role encompasses systems engineering, network management, cloud operations, cybersecurity practices, and cross-functional project delivery. Unlike help desk or support roles, this position will focus on architecture, engineering solutions, and infrastructure lifecycle management.

Key Responsibilities

 - Provide hands-on engineering, administration, and troubleshooting of systems, servers, networks, endpoints, and cloud infrastructure.

 - Build, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot physical and virtual servers from initial deployment through ongoing management.

 - Administer and troubleshoot Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and Linux environments, including various Linux distributions.

 - Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot LAN, WAN, VLANs, Wi-Fi, VPNs, routing, switching, firewalls, and network policies.

 - Administer and support Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Entra ID, Intune, Jira/Confluence, and Slack environments.

 - Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure.

 - Evaluate solutions, recommend the best approach, and implement fixes while minimizing operational impact.

 - Develop and maintain automation and administrative scripts using PowerShell, Bash, and Python.

 - Lead or participate in IT infrastructure projects and ensure assigned projects are completed promptly, accurately, and within established requirements.

 - Provide Tier 3 technical support and assist other IT teams with complex infrastructure issues.

 - Document configurations, troubleshooting procedures, solutions, and project changes.

Required Skills & Qualifications

 - Strong hands-on technical engineering and troubleshooting experience.

 - In-depth knowledge of Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and various Linux operating systems.

 - In-depth knowledge of server deployment, configuration, administration, and troubleshooting, including the ability to build servers from the ground up.

 - In-depth networking knowledge, including LAN, WAN, VLANs, Wi-Fi, VPN, routing, switching, firewalls, and network policies.

 - Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to dig into complex issues, identify root causes, and develop multiple solutions.

 - Experienced with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Entra ID, Intune, Jira/Confluence, and Slack.

 - Experienced with Microsoft Azure and AWS, including AWS GovCloud environments.

 - Proficiency with PowerShell, Bash, and Python scripting.

 - Ability to manage multiple technical projects and complete assignments promptly.

 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.

Education Requirement

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field is required.

Experience Requirement

 - 5–7 years of progressive hands-on experience in IT engineering, systems administration, network engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Additional Requirements

 - Must be a US Citizen

 - Must hold an active Top Secret Security Clearance

 - Must be willing to work full-time on-site in the Playa Vista of Los Angeles

This position may be filled at the Senior, Staff, or Principal level. The stated compensation range spans all of these levels, and final placement within the range will be based on the candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, and the responsibilities ultimately assigned.

#LI-JC1


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Cash bonus eligibility: share in Apex’s success with eligibility for a performance-based cash bonus on top of your salary, rewarding the impact you make

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan: Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave: Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

 - Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks: To keep you fueled throughout the day

 - Vibrant community: Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family

 - Your dream desk setup: All the tools you need to be your most productive self

 - World-class Playa Vista office: With the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life

 - Real impact opportunity: Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

Compensation ranges are set by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. A candidate's specific level and base pay are determined case by case and may vary with job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities, and internal equity. Beyond base salary, full-time hires are also eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

Apex's work is governed by U.S. export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). To be eligible for this role, applicants must either (1) qualify as a U.S. Person, meaning a U.S. citizen or national, a lawful permanent resident (green card holder), a refugee admitted under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or an individual granted asylum under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or (2) be able to obtain the required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State, the U.S. Department of Commerce, or another applicable U.S. government agency. You can learn more about ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Apex Technology, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Candidates and employees are always evaluated based on merit, qualifications, and performance.
